dga' ba ni/ /ji ltar yid ni mi nyams par/ /ji srid mngon sum gyur gyi bar / /de ltar de nyid la sems bzhag /bdud rtsi lnga la gcig gus pas/ /de nyid nges par byas nas ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad blang byas nas/ /smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /smyon pa'i mtshan ma gang yin pa/ /de ni rtag tu bsten 1par bya/ /sngags pas gsang ba'i spyod pa ni/ /cho ga bzhin du spyad par bya/ /srog chags kun lus las byung ba'i/ /sgron ma rtag tu cho ga bzhin / /lha yi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /'bad pas bza' bar bya ba nyid / /sbrang ma'i skyugs 2pa 'dres pa dang / /bshang dang gci ba bsres byas nas/ /sgron ma lnga dang bsres pa yis / /rtag tu bdag nyid mchod par 4bya / /dngos med mchog tu zhi ba yi/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje can/ /rang rig tsam zhig skyed 5byas la/ /go 'phang mchog de bsgom 6par bya/ /sngags pas 'di ltar bsgom byas la/ /rang gi lus mchog bsgom par bya/ /smad par gyur pa ma lus pa/ /dpyad pa med par bya ba nyid/ /btsun mo'i rang byung me tog ni/ /byang chub sems dang bcas 7gyur pa/ /blangs la gsung gi rdo rje can/ /bde ba chen po yang dag mchog /glang po khyi rta rnga mo yi / /sgron ma mi las byung ba dag /sngags pas rtag tu bza' bya zhing / /gzhan du bza' bar mi bya'o/ /de nyid rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig rtag tu goms byed pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i ting nge 'dzin/ /de ni 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /slang 9mo spyod par bya ba'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs can gyis snod mi gzung / /grong pas zos shing bor ba yi/ /gyo dum la sogs der bza' zhing //gong du bor zhing byin pa 1 bza'/ /des ni gong 1 du zos gyur nas/ /tshim 26—46

par gyur nas de yang dor/ /de yi smad g.yogs dum bu yang / /rnying zhing dum bur gyur pas bya/ /yang na mchog 1kyi gos can gyis/ / gang du 'dod par 'gro bar hūṃbya/ /til 'bru tsam gyi dngos po yang / /yongs su gzung bar mi bya'o/ /yongs su 'dzin las sdug bsngal 'byung / /sbug bsngal gyis ni sems 'khor 'gyur/ /'khor bas sems ni zhum gyur te/ /zhum pas dngos grub nyams par 'gyur/ /dngos grub med na 'khor ba ste/ /'khor bas dmyal ba sgrub par byed/ /dmyal bar nyon mongs snyug bsngal gyis/ /grangs med bskal par gnod par 'gyur/ /bzhin skams 4sdug bsngal gyur pa dang / /gzhan gyi bran la sogs par skye/ /rnam dag legs par 'dod pa yi/ /skye ba slar yang thob mi 'gyur/ /de ltar bdag gis bdag nyid kyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa rnam bsgoms nas/ /khams gsum rnam pa gcig gyur pa/ /rnam dag thabs bzang 5la gnas pas/ /rnam dag legs par 'dod pa yi6/ /skye ba slar yang thob par 'gyur/ /gsang ba grub pa la gnas nas/ /de nas seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /ston pa'i gzugs 'dzin gyur pa yis/ /kun spyod thams cad rnam spangs la/ /gsang gsum dri med rnal 'byor gyis/ /bza' ba kun la spyad par bya/ /shing rdo sa yi rang bzhin gyi7/ /lha rnams la yang phyag mi bya//lus nyid la ni mchod pa dang / /bla mar 8gus pas phyag bya'o/ /sa rdo'i rang bzhin mchod rten dang / /glegs bam la sogs mi bya zhing / /rmi lam du yang dkyil 'khor sogs/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bya'o/ /theg pa gsum la zhugs rnams la/ /phyag la sogs pa mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dam par mi 'dzin na/ /rnal 'byor pa gzhan smos ci dgos/ /bsgom 9la chags gyur sems kyis ni/ /26—47

ngag gi rtsod pa mi bya'o/ /dam tshig dag ni nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams pas 4yid ni g.yeng 'gyur 2bas/ /spyor ba la sogs 'bad pa yis/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu spang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal nyid/ /spang nas gzhan du mi bya'o/ /dag pa de nyid la gnas pas/ /sbyor ba rnams kyang mi bya ste/ /dam tshig dag ni nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams pas yid ni sdug bsngal 'thob/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa yis3/ /ji srid de la rtog 6gyur pas/ /dngos med go 'phang la gnas nas/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis3 / /rtog las gang zhig 'byung ba rnams/ /ma brtags sapar ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bsgom pa'i shesbyor ba'i stobs kyis ni/ /dngos grub mtshan nyid gang ci'ang rung //de kun skad cig tsam la ni/ /rang nyid gnas par 'gyur ba yin/ /dgon pa 'di ni bar chad can/ /sngags pas gsang sngags mi bzla zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag kyang mi bya la/ /phyag rgya mi bcing phyag mi bya/ /lus nyid dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs te/ /shes rab phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dag bsngags11/ /de bsten pa ni phyag yin no/ /nang gi bdag nyid de byas nas/ /mkhas pas phyi rol thams cad spang 12/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa dang ldan pas/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu spyad/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag /rnam par rtog med sngags pa yis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa dang ldan pas/ /de ltar 'gyur med 'grub par 'gyur/ / spros shing thude la rab sbyor bas/ /dam tshig dag ni skyong ba dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yis/ /shes rab thabs dag rnam par bsgom/ /gar dang glu sogs spyor ba yis— / /pad+ma rdo rje rnam rol zhing / /bur chang sgron ma gus pa dang / /dri 26—48

dang phreng sogs rgya chen dang / /gling bu rnga zlum sgra dag dang / /rdza rnga'i sgra la sogs pa dang / /lha rdzas lus ldangs dri bzang 1ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgrub/ /lha rdzas bzang po mchog 'di dang / /nang gi bdag nyid bsgom 2pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub 'gyur ba/ /spyad par bya ba ma yin no/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can gyis/ /byang chub sems ni rab spros pas/ /chu skyes khyad par bza' bar bya/ /rtag tu chags pa dang ldan zhing / /mchog tu dga' ba la sred pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur/ /mang du smras pa ci zhig dgos/ /rtag tu ngo tsha spangs gyur pas/ /dam tshig spyod la ci bzhin par / /stson pa'i gzugs kyis mi smra ba/ /dur khrod la sogs gar gnas nas/ /mā ma tī dang spyan la sogs / /rgyan rnams la sogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya bsgom/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i khams sbyor bas / /der ni thams cad bsgom par bya/ /zhal gsum pa yi rnal 'byor gyis / /ye shes rgya chen rlabs spro bya/ /dbang po gnyis kyi spyor ba yis /rang dngos rim 4pa bskul byas na5/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gzugs can rnams//rab tu bsdu 6ba dag kyang bya/ /phyogs bcu dag tu rgyug byed pa'i/ /rang sems gal te 'dzin par 'dod gyur na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur rang gi sems/ /de tshe yang dag sbyor ba mchog tu bya/ /gong du nyams myong phyag rgya rjes bsams la/ /brtse 7ldan rjes 'gro bzang dga' chags 8pa can/ /chags tshopas thob gyur de la 7sems gtad nas/ /slar yang rim pa'i khyad par gsal bar bsgrub/ /bsam gtan 'di la sbyor ba yis / /rin chen sems 26—49

ni brtan gyur na1/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab gnas te2/ /byen gyis brlab pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /de lta de nyid shes gyur nas/ /der gtad nas ni bsgom par bya/ /ji srid yid ni mi skyo bar/ /blo bzang sems ni mnyam gzhag pas/ /skyo na ji ltar 'dod pa yi/ /sems kyis kun du khyab par bya/ /cung zad mig ni rgyas gyur pas/ /byang chub rin chen bsgom par bya/ /la la dgod dang smra ba dang / /la lar gar dag byed pa na/ /ji ltar skyo bar mi 'gyur bas/ /bsgom pa la chags sems kyis so/ /rnam par rtog med sngags pa yis/ /de lta'i ting 'dzin dang ldan pas/ /dus kyi nges pa yongs spangs nas / /bla med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /bzang po'i rigs lnga las byung ba'i / /dam tshig rtag tu bza' bar bya/ /khyad par gzhan dang ldan pa yi/ /dam tshig bsten pas 4mchod par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs bsam ldan chopas/ /spyan ni rgyas par gyur nas su/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom 6pas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /spyod pa rin chen la gnas shing / /rdo rje ye shes la mos pas/ /bde gshegs go 'phang 'dod na ni/ /mi dge'i sems su mi bya'o / /khams gsum du ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /btsun mo kun la 'dod par bya/ /dman las skyes dang 'gyur ba can/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas mchod bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad las byung dang / /srog chags kun lus las byung ba'i/ /srog chags rnams ni rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos grub 'dod na bza' bar 7bya/ /bshang gci sa bon la sogs pa/ /sna yi nang nas byung ba yis / /rang lus rdo rjer bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags pas rtag tu mchod par bya / /khams gsum pa las byung ba yi/ /rtag tu dam tshig la mchod pas/ /26—30

de nyid rin chen la rab sbyar/ /gzhan du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni mang du smra ci dgos/ /gang dang gang zhig dmigs 'gyur ba/ /de kun de nyid rnal 'byor du/ / rigs pas brtags 1shing blta bar bya/ /rdo rje grub 2 par gang gsungs pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ / dam tshig bzang po bsten byas pas/ /thams cad bya ba kho na'o/ /de ltar byas na sngags pa ni/ /shin tu de nyid gsang spyod pas/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di la spyad par mi bya'o/ /bdag gi de nyid la gtad pas/ / dam tshig bzang po dang ldan pa'i/ /de nyid gsum dbyer med pa'i sku/ /sngags pas rtag tu mchod par bya/ /kun kyang rtog pa sngon 'gro bas/ /khams gsum 'di dag rnam par dag /ma rig dra bas yang dag bsgribs/ /rmi lam rtsed mo'i 4 rjes su 'gro/ /phung po khams sogs mtshan nyid rnams/ /de ltar 'bad pas spyad 5na ni/ /mtshan ma med cing snang med pa'o/ /thabs dang bcas pa rnam par bsgom/ /de ltar cho ga ldan shes pas/ /sems ni de nyid byin brlabs nas / /ji ltar thos pas 'tsho byed cing / /dam tshig ma lus la rab spyor/ /tshong dpon bram ze rje'u rigs dang / /shi ba sogs kyis mgron bos nas6/ /zos shing tshims 7nas bor gyur pa'i/ /gcig tu basbus pa'i dman ma rnams//khye dang wa yis 9smad pa dag /blangs nas de ni bza' bar bya/ /de nyid bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /cung zhig sbyon pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /rigs rnams kun du mnyam par spyor/ /bzang po'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i gar/ /rdo rje gar gyis goms 2par gnas/ /glu rnams len par byed pa yi/ /rdo rje'i glu ni mi gsal bar/ /khams gsum 26—5/

dag tu grags pa yi/ /gzhan dag gsal po 1nyid du len/ /sna tshogs skad bsres 2glu len cing / /sha za bzhin du kun du 'khyams / /las dag gang gis skye bo rnams/ /gang dang gang du 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching las gol bar 'gyur/ /khyad par thams cad spangs pa yis4/ /de nyid zhi ba thob gyur nas/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis5/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /'byung po kun gyi de nyid gang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spang 6ba/ /'gro kun mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /khyad par gnas pa'i bzang po gang / /rang lus thabs dang bcas pa yis3/ de nyid rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /bus pa kun la thal mo'i sgra/ /rim gyis —gar ni bzang po bya/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs pa yis9/ /byang chub mchog tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bzang po'i go 'phang der gnas nas/ /gang dang gang du gnas na yang / /byang chub mchog tu nges byas pas/ /spyod ngan can yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /smyon pa'i brtul zhugs la brten nas/ /yid ni de nyid byin brlabs nas/ /gsang spyod mchog gi rol pa yis/ / /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te rgya chen khyem rnams ni/ /spong bar nus pa ma yin yang / /dpal ldan gsang grub las brtan pas/ /byang chub 'byung ba'i spyod pa rnams/ /khyem de nyid du gnas byas nas/ /'jig rten spyod pa la gnas pas1 / /ji ltar rig par —mi 'gyur bar/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig spyad par bya/ /mtshan mo gsal por byas nas ni/ /'o ma gcig tu goms byas pas//phyag rgyar bcas pas bya ba ste/ /yid ches pas yin gzhan gyis min/ /dri chu la sogs dam tshig rnams/ /rtag tu spyad par bya ba nyid/ /gcig tu dam 26—52

tshig goms byed na/ /de nyid bla med 'grub par 'gyur/ /shin tu gsang ba'i grogs dag nyid/ /de nyid shes shing mchog gyur pa/ /de dang lhan cig dam tshig 1rnams/ /rgyud las gsungs pa 2spyad par bya/ /bud med bzang dang longs spyod bzang / /de bzhin gnas mal bzang sogs kyis/ /de nyid bsgom pas ngal gyur pa'i/ /ye shes ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig spyod pa der gtad pas / /khyem nyid du yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig spyod pa dman gyur na/ /spyod pa min zhing khyem du'ang min/ /de ltar dam tshig mngon ldan zhing / /ye shes bzang po la dga' ba/ /cho ga 'di 4ni bskul byas nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyams su blang 5snabya thams cad ni/ /'gal ba'i dam tshig la sogs pa/ /smad par gyur pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /ma lus pa dag gang bstan pa/ /dngos grub bzang po'i rgyu yi phyir/ /de dag thams cad bya ba nyid/ /'di kun mngon sum nyid du ni/ /byed pa'i char ni dbye bya ste/ /gsang ba spyod pa ldan pa yis6/ /de nyid shes yin gzhan ma yin/ /'gal ba'i dam tshig la sogs pas7/ /gsang ba grub pa zhes byar brjod/ /rtag can gzugs la gnas gyur nas/ /'jig rten spyod las 'das gyur te/ /smad pa rnams la gsal po ru/ /nyams su len par byed gyur cing / /nus pa dag ni ma skyes par/ /kun rdzob nyid du 'jug 'gyur ba'i/ /dman pa'i rigs la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu dam tshig sogs spyod cing / /'dod dang bcas pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /thab khung dkyil 'khor sogs byed pa/ /rtag dang chad pa smra ba yi/ /gang zhig cho ga 'dir gnas pa9/ /de ni bstan pa 'jig byed gsungs/ /gal te rtag 1 dang ldan 26—53

—gyur pas/ /sgrub pa 'di ni byed 'gyur na/ /de ni mtshan mo dam tshig spyad/ /nyin mo shin tu gsang bar bya/ /dman pa'i 'gro ba nyan thos sogs/ /ji ltar gzhan gyis mi rigs 1pa/ /de ltar sngags pa'i bya ba ste/ /bdag nyid bsgrub phyir shin tu gsang 4/ /'jig rten kun 5gyis mi gnod cing / /'jig rten kun la mi gnod par/ /de bzhin sngags pas 'dir bya'o/ /bde gshegs dngos grub 'dod gyur na/ /gsang ba grub pa la gnas shing / /sgrub pa po la nus pa zhig /ji srid 'byung bar ma gyur pa/ /de srid brtul zhugs rtags mi gzung / /nus pa zhig ni skyes 'gyur ba/ /de nas gsang ba 6spyod pa spangs/ /de rjes rig pa'i brtul zhugs gzung 7/ /de dag rtag tu blang bar bya/ /go 'phang nyams dga' der gnas pas/ /rnal 'byor der gtad bsgom par bya/ /'du 'dzi thams cad dang bral nas/ /go 'phang mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /'du 'dzi ring du spangs shing rang bzhin g.yo ba'i sems nyid rab sbyar nas/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin bde ba'i mchog ldan de nyid la gnas bsgom par bya/ /nyon mongs pa yi dgra tshogs mang po las rgyal mi nyams bzang por gyur pa yi/ /sems can don ldan sems kyis rtag tu rnal 'byor pa rnams 'jig rten gsum na spyod/ /spyan ni cung zhig phye nas srid pa'i sbug bsngal bsal ba'i sems dang ldan pa yi/ /cho ga shes par gyur pas sna tshogs ma lus brdzun pa'i blo dang sgra / spangs la/ /mchog tu legs par spyod pa'i sems can don ldan 'jig rten gsum na grags par byed/ /dngos rnams dpag med byang chub go 'phang mchog gyur mnyam med sems can mchog gyur rol pa gang / /khyem gyi 'dzin pa rtswa bzhin ma lus spangs nas ma lus sgyu ma 26—54

bzhin blta 1ba/ /spre'u dang rlung dang glog bzhin g.yo ba'i sems zhes bya la dbang du gyur pas gzhag /dngos po'i de nyid bsgom 2pa'i lus can dam pa'i bde ba de nyid mchog /sems can don la spro ba'i de nyid sems la nges par rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol par byed/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las sgrub pa'i thabs kyis mnyam pa nyid kyi sems dri ma med par byed pa'i gsang ba'i spyod pa'i rim pa ma lus par bstan pa'i 4le'u ste drug pa'o// //dag cing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /sna tshogs gzugs rnams phun sum tshogs / /'chi dang mya ngan rnam spangs pa/ /lha yi phyag rgya mchog rnyed nas/ /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /de bzhin lha min bu mo'ang rung / /dri za'i bu mo gzugs ldan pa'i/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma yang rung / /'di lta'i bu mo rnal 'byor ma'am/ /de nyid rnal 'byor ldan pa dang / /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /bkug nas longs spyod nyid du bya/ /lha rdzas grub pa gang yin de / /dam tshig spyor bar rab tu brjod/ /bsgrubs nas 5mngag gzhug par 'gyur zhing / /gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur/ /des ni sems ni rnam g.yeng bar/ /nam yang byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi yis 6bu mo mthu chen gyis//dam tshig bzang po 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i rdzu 'phrul che ldan zhing / /chu dang rdul dag rnam par spangs/ /sna tshogs gzugs dag rab ston pa'i/ /lha rdzas btsun mo bsten par bya/ /de dang lhan cig mnyam ldan pas7/ /skye bo 26—55

med pa'i tshal song la/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /seng ge bzhin du rnam par spyad/ /lha rdzas btsun mo 'gugs pa yi/ /nus pa gal te med gyur na/ /'dod pas gnod pa nyid gyur la/ /des na 1mi yi bu mo bsten/ /longs spyod bzang po dang ldan pa'i/ /g.yeng ba'i myos pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /de phyir sgrub pa'i dbang po la/ /mi las byung ba'i bu mo bsten/ /rnam g.yeng khro ba mang ba dang / /skyon rnams thams cad 'byung 'gyur zhing / / rga shi zhe mya ngan gyis non pa'i/ /mi yi bu mo shin tu spangasardo/ /de lta'i lha rdzas med gyur na4 / /dngos grub bzang po'i rgyu yi phyir/ /rgyud kyi bya ba'i rim pa yis/ /mi yi bu mo bsten par bya/ /de ltar tha mal byang chub nyid/ /sngags kyis 5cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i yid can gyis/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /tha mal pa yi rim pa yi/ /phyag rgya de nyid bshad par bya/ /mthar skyes dang bor byas nas 6ni/ /gang gis 7dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'o/ /mthar skyes ma sring bu mo dang / /de bzhin tshos ma'i bu mo dang / /smad pa'i rigs las byung gyur dang / /gang yang bde ba rnyed pa dang / /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rigs 9byas pa'i/ /khyad par du ni bu mo nyid/ /dam tshig spyod pa thams cad la/ /byis pa nyid nas rim gyis bslab / /byang chub sems la dga' zhing mkhas/ /chos nyid la ni bzod byas pas / /mkhas pas cho ga ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med par bsgrub/ /rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa yi/ /mchod pa de la gnas nas brtsam/ /gus pas 'o ma sgron ma dang / /phreng ba la sogs rgyan rnams dang / /thal ba bzang po bsku bya zhing / /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan par/ /sngags pas rang gi gzugs nyid dang / /de 26—56

yi gzugs kyang bya ba nyid/ /stag gi 1pags pas gos byas shing / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga blang zhing / /dril bu cang te'us rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin rna ba mgrin dpung pa/ /rus pa'i dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /mi yi thod pa g.yon pa ste/ /de bzhin g.yas par ḍa 2ma ru/ /bdag dang phyag rgya de bzhin du/ /mā ma shī 'am spyan dag gam/ /bdag nyid rdo rje mchog 'dzin pas/ /'di 'dra'i gzugs su byas nas ni/ /rgyud las byung ba'i cho ga yis/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bzang po spyad/ /gnyis med nges par byas nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las rig pa'i brtul zhugs nges par bstan pa'i le'u ste 4bdun pa'o// //mthar skyes ngo mtshar chen po las/ /rgyud las sgrub thabs gang gsungs pa//ji ltar nges par de thob 5pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ / skyo ba'i 6nges pa yongs spongs 7la/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug gzugs byas nas/ /gang du sus kyang mi shes par/ /mthar skyes nang du 'jug par bya/ /tshogs kyi mtshan ma blangs nas ni/ /mgo bo'i skra ni byegs nas kyang / /ral pa sbom po gcig bzhag nas/ /gtsug phud gcig ni gzung bar bya/ /ru dāk+ṣa 8dang shel bzang po/ /tshan tshan dag tu spel byas pa'i/ /phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba dag /mgul pa'i rgyan du gzung bar bya/ /dpung rgyan gdu bu bzang po dag /'od zer 'phro zhing 'khrug 'gyur 9dang / /'bad pas tshan gsum 26—57

byas nas ni/ /mdzub mo la ni zangs ma'i rgya/ /mdun gyi phyogs su 'phyang gyur pa'i/ /smad g.yogs dum bu'ang kyede nas gzung / /lcags mdung la btags me tog snod/ /phrag pa dag la bkal thubar bya/ /yan lag thams cad rnam brgyan nas/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug gzugs su bya/ /phrag pa gnyis ni dgab byas nas/ /mthar phyes khyim du 'jug par bya/ /bzang po de ltar gsang byas nas/ /de nas bsgrub par bya phyir spyad1/ /gang zhig sus kyang mi shes par/ /bzang po'i yul du 'khyam par bya/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs nye ba'i mthar/ /mthar skyes nang du 'jug par bya/ /yang dag tu ni lha gzhan nyid 4 / /des ni shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu khrus dang lha mchod cing / /rtag tu rang gi grub mtha' rngubasgom/ /yi ge las ni cung zhig gis/ /rang 'byung 6lha la chags gyur pas/ /gdol pa'i gzugs kyis sde/tshogs nyid kyi/ /de ltar de yi nang zhugs la/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /chos dang grub mtha' sngon 'gro bas/ /de nas de la ston par byed/ /dus kyi phyi ma la sogs pa'am/ /yang na dbugs kyi sgom pa ston/ /de nas rgyud nas gsungs kun gyes/ /yid brtan pa nyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /dbang dang dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bas/ /bdag nyid kyi 8ni slob mar bya9/ /de yi byin pa'i rdzas rnams dang / /snga na yod pa dang bcas pas/ /de ni de la gtad byas la/ /de yi bla ma mchod phyir byin/ /de yis sbyibakas gnang blang bya ste/ /shin tu bzhin bzangs nyu mig yangs ma/ /de ni rgyud don bden pa la/ /mkhas shing dam tshig 'dod byas nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges byas la/ /blo ldan rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /nges par rgyud gsungs dam tshig gis/ /tshe 'di 26—58

nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri 'am rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag gam/ /skyon 1rnams spangs pa'i yul 'khor dang / /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs sam/ /phug dang grong khyer rnying pa dag /dri med chu yis 2gang ba dang / /me tog 'bras bu sogs pas brgyan/ /ljon shing 'khri shing gis brgyan pa/ /khyad par du ni dben gyur pa/ /der ni phyag rgya dang bcas par/ /sgrub po brtan zhing nges pa yis/ /sgom pa'i spyor ba der gtad pas / /rtag tu nags su bsod snyoms blang / /byang chub sems la dga' zhing mkhas/ /lus ni nus pa can byas nas/ /yang dag rim pas der gnas nas/ /yang dang yang du goms par bya/ /ljon shing rgyal po de dag kun/ /sgrub pa 4dbang po dang 5ldan pas//de nyid spyor bas bkug byas nas/ /zhal zas bzang po ster bar 'gyur/ /blo bzang rtag tu 'dod med cing / /blo yis rtag tu goms par bya6/ /rdo rje jeg pa la dga' zhing / /rtag tu bde gshegs sems 7pa can/ /bstan bcos ma lus la goms shing / /de bzhin gtong ldan dpa' zhing gsal/ /phongs par gyur pa'i tshe na yang / /mnyam pa'i sems nyid gcig tu bsgom/ /phyag rgya'ang de 'drar shes bya ste/ /chags med zhen pa med pa dang / /zab mo'i chos dang ldan pa dang / /sgrub po 'dod bzhin rjes su 'brang / /bzhin bzangs 9mig ni dkyus ring ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan/ /byang chub sems la dga' zhing gsal/ /rdo rje sgrub pa shin tu gsal/ /ci ltar bu bzhin brtse ba dang / /de bzhin srun dang pha ma ltar/ /rtag tu sgrub po mthong ba na/ /brtse bas shin tu goms byed na/ /bud med sgyu bral yid du 'ong / /skal ba bzang zhing snyan par smra/ /phrag dog spangs shing rjes su mthun//26—59

sgrub pa po yi bka' bzhin byed/ /dmar ser lus phra gzugs bzang ma /tshul khrims yon tan gyis brgyan pa/ /mdog snum cho ga shes pa dang / /ring min thung ba'ang snam yin pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon pa 'am/ /yang na de bzhin bcu drug gam/ /de nyid rig pa dang ldan pa2/ /mur gong mtha' ni rnam par mdzes/ /yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /skra yi rtse kun cung zhig 'khyel/ /skad snyan shin tu dga' ba can/ /lta ba bzang bos rnam brgyan pa / /'bad pas bu mo 'di 'dra ba/ /dngos grub don gnyer gyur nas su/ /rtog 4las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /de nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs brtsam/ /'bad pas de ni gzung byas nas/ /go 'phang samachog ni bsgrub — par bya /rang gi rdo rje mchod nas ni/ /byang chub sems ni gtang 3bar bya/ /de nas sgu yi rdo rje bsgom/ /ngag gi rdo rje bkug nas gzung / /de yi bha gar byung ba'i khus/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu mchod/ /de la gus pas mchod na 9ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyor ba la7/ /de nyid spyor la bsgom par bya/ /tsun+da 'am ni mā ma shī 1/ /dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam bsgoms nas/ /thams cad bya ba kho na yin / /dam tshig gi ni khyad par dang / /bud med mchog ni bsten sapar bya /bha gar liṅga gzhag 1 nas ni/ /byang chub sems ni gtang —mi bya/ /der bskyed pa yi dga' ba yis/ /sems ni bkang nas sabasgom par bya/ /ji srid rnal 'byor byang chub sems/ /gtong bar byed pa ma yin pa/ /de srid kun dga' las byung bde/ /ci yang rgyun mi 'chad par 'thob/ /bde ba de yi ngo bo dang / /yang dag ldan pa'i byang chub mchog /bdag nyid rtag tu bsgom na gluni / /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /dngos grub kun kyi gter 7gyur pa/ /26—60

—byang chub sems ni der lhang bas/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal gyur nas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /phyag rgya ma la dam 'khyud nas/ /yang dang yang du 'o byas la/ /gnas de ru ni bskyod pa yis/ /byang chub sems mang 1rab 'bab pas/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam bsgoms la/ /lha mo de la 'o yang bya/ /mig gnyis dag ni rgyas gyur nas/ /bde ba chen po'i ros gang ba/ /ma mchu cung zhig rgyas pa yis/ /nu ma cung zhig dam par 'dzin/ /brla gnyis dri ma med pa mchog /mig kyang cung zhig rgyas pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa 2ngal byas pas / /der gtad pa yi bsgom dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu der gtad bsam pa can/ /'o ma byin nas yang dang yang / /khyad par du ni rab tu mchog /rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya bzhin/ /de nyid spyor bas bsgom par bya/ /yid 'ong bcos ma'i zas dang ni/ /dri dang rnge tog sogs bsnyen bskur / /nya dang sha dang bur chang sogs/ /sems ni spro ba 4byed pa can/ /'bad pas de lta bus mchod nas/ /de nyid ched du bsgom par bya/ /cho ga 'di yis bskul nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 5bdag 'grub 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dang ldan pa yis6/ /bdud rtsi me tog myang bar bya/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje dbus gnas pa/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog7 /bsgom dang dam tshig nyams len pas/ /de lta'i dngos grub myur du thob/ /sems kyi dam tshig sdang ba la/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dngos grub med/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / /dam tshig bsrung bar bya ba ni/ /shes pas 'bad pas bsgom 9byas na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la je tshom med/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad na ni/ /sdig pa ma 26—61

lus sbyangs nas ni/ /rig ma dang bcas grol bar 'gyur/ /grong dang gong khyer dag tu 'am/ /sems ni gang du shesnadaga' ba der/ /der ni rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad2/ /dgag pa dang ni sgrub ༄ pa med/ /dpal ldan 'dus rab yongs gsal ba'i/ /sgrub thabs rgyud las gang gsungs pa/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs ldan pa yi/ /gsang ba ④spyod pas rnam brgyan pa/ /des phyani dngos grub myur thob pa6/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas gsungs/ /dam tshig spyod pa dang ldan pa7/ /rtag tu goms par bya ba yin/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsnyus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba 3las tshogs kyi brtul zhugs nges par bstan 9pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o // // teme dang chu dang dug sogs la/ /thabs ni gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni tshig dang nub pa dang / /'chi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /de bzhin gsang 'dus rgyud kyis ni/ /shes rab thabs ni spangs gyur pa/ /'gal ba dag ni spyod byed pa'i/ /bsam ngan de ni brlag par 'gyur/ /gang gis de yi de nyid shes/ /yang dag rab sbyin la gnas nas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa la dga' ba'i/ /sems can de ni steng du 'gro/ /gsang ba'i spyod dang brtul zhugs dang / /phyag rgya rgyas par 1gang gsungs pa/ /'di dag thams cad rtog don yin/ /bsgom pa 'ba' zhig tsam yin te/ /gang yang rgyas pa'i bdag nyid can/ /kun kyang sems can bsams pas gsungs/ /bsgom pa la ni rab gnas pa'i/ /ye shes ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnam rtog du 26—62

ma rgyas gyur pa'i1/ /'di ni thams cad spang 2byas nas/ /phyag rgya chen po la 'bad pas/ /shes rab ldan pas rtag tu bsgom/ /'du 'dzi thams cad spangs nas ni/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /yang dang yang du goms par byas snye/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i tshig bzhin du/ /dus mi ring bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig dag ni thams cad las/ /bla ma mchod pa mchog yin te / /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /dpal ldan 'dus pa'am gzhan du bstan / /gzugs chomin brjod pa ma yin pa/ /sems can kun la yang dag gnas / /lus ngag yid gsum lhabade ba yin/ /rnam rtog med cing gnas med pa/ /dag cing ngo bo nyid med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes dran par bya/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /de ni myur du thob par 'gyur/ /khams gsum rin po cher gyur pa/ /slob dpon las ni mchog gzhan med/ /gang las bka' drin thob pa yi/ /mkhas pas dngos grub du ma thob6/ /yang dag gsungs pas spyod pa gang / /dpal ldan mnyam nyid gnyis med gsungs/ /des ni slob dpon bya ba ste/ /gzhan gyis 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /gos dang rgyan dang longs spyod dang / /rang gi phyag rgyas brgyan byas nas/ /bla ma mchod cing phul byas pas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /rang gi phyag rgya phul nas ni/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dngos grub 'grub/ /gzhan dag phyi rol dam tshig gis/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni rgyud kyi bden don gyi3/ /dam tshig gtso bo mchog yin no/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mgon gsungs pa'i/ /dam tshig dag ni thams cad las/ /gnyug ma'i phyag rgya dbul ba mchog /gzhan du phyi 26—63

rol tshul dag gis1/ /dam tshig 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /gus par 2bla ma mchod par bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya pad+ma yi/ /mchod mchog mgrin pa'i dbyangs dag dang / /brla brdab pa yi rol mo dang / /rdo rje 'jug pa'i bskyod pa dang / /rig ma'i hūṃmachu yi ro myong 5dang / /cung zhig 'khyud par spro ba yis6/ /bza' ba mchod 7pa sna tshogs gang / / nya dang khu 8ba la sogs dang / /sha dang bur chang 9bzang po dag /rgyud nas gsungs pa sna tshogs dang / /phyag rgya gnyug ma phul byas nas/ /de nas dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di lta'i gzugs su ma byas na/ /gzhan du dngos grub 'byung mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje ston la gang gus parka/ /'di lta'i tshul du byed 'gyur ba/ /de nyid rig pas lam nyid kyis/ /dri med rdo rje gsum dbyer med/ /yang dag rab sbyin gsung 1rta'agyur ba/ /sems can des 'dir 'thob par 'gyur/ /bla ma rdo rje mnyes 'gyur bas/ /dngos grub bzang po kun sbyin byed/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig bzang / /de ltar rtag par rab bsgrubs —pas/ /rdo rje slob dpon thugs rje mchog /man ngag myur du thob par 'gyur/ /'di lta'i tshul gyis 'ongs gyur pa'i/ /de nyid gsal por yongs shes nas/ /gus pa'i dngos bo 'phel 'gyur ba'is/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchod pa'i dus su 'bab ྾pa yis/ /gus pas bla mar phyag byas nas/ /phyi nas sangs rgyas dngos grub gtso/ /rab sbyin rtse gcig sems kyis bsgom/ /slob dpon mchog la dmod pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' khyad par du/ /dkon mchog gsum la smod 18pa dang / /'di dag 'bad pas spang bar bya/ /gang gis sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /nam 26—61

mkha' lta bu mi shes pas/ /theg pa mchog 'di thos gyur nas/ /sems can de ni skrag 'gyur na/ /rdo rje theg pa smod pa de1/ /ngan 'go dag tu 'go bar 'gyur / /dman la mos pa'i sems can rnams/ /bskal pa brgya yi bar du yang / /ngan 'go dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ngan 'go dag nas byung na yang / /de ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gang zhig gus par mi byed pa/ /sdug bsngal phongs pa kun 'byung bar/ /sdig pa'i las kyis dā'agro 'gyur te/ /bde gshegs mtshan ma la brten nas/ /mnar med par ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gus pa dang ldan pas/ /chos nyid sgom 5par byed gyur pa6// /de ni sdig pa kun spangs nas/ /gtso bo'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bla med sgogs pa'i byang chub tu/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'jigs pa las sems can rnams ni nges grol 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi gnas/ /bla na med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /'jig rten kun la ston pa por/ /dus mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi shes sgrib pas ldongs gyur pa'i/ /sems can rnams la don dam gyi7/ /ye shes snang bar byed 'gyur te/ /mun pa la ni mar me bzhin/ /bde chen mgon po gcig pu nyid/ /gang zhig rtag tu dran byed cing / /zhabs kyi pad+ma gnyis gus pas / /sdog pa thams cad zad gyur nas / /sems can de nyid de yi mthus/ /pad bsnams 'jig rten mgon po ltar/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /dus mi ring bar 'gyur ba nyid//gang zhig dag pas 9de nyid sems/ /gus pas lcags kyus brtan bkug nas//dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs gang byed 1 pa/ /26—65

gal te de ni bzang gyur na/ /bzang zhes ci phyir rjod par byed/ /gal te dman dang 'dres gyur na/ /slob dpon rnams kyis 1de bzod mdzod/ /gang zhig rgyud kyi jes 'brang 2nas/ /brjod pa bdag 5gis ma shes pa zi/ /rang gi bu bzhin 'phags pa rnams/ /ma lus pa dag bzod par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mgon po bde chen gyimo/ /zhabs kyi pad+mos 6nyer 'tsho ba/ /pad+ma rdo rje dz+wa sems can kun/ /rjes su gzung phyir byas pa yi/ /gsang ba sgrub snapa zhes bya ba / /dngos grub kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /grol bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po/ /'bad pa nyid kyis bstan (snapar bya/ /blo bzang rtog spyopa'i cho ga bzhin/ /gsang ba sgrub 11par gang spyod pa/ /mi yis satshe 'di nyid la ni/ /dngos grub ma lus 'thob par 'gyur/ /sems can kun dang dus gcig tu/ /gsang ba phyaspyod pa gang grub pa'i/ /legs pa ma lus gang yod pas/ /dpal ldan slob dpon zhabs grub shog /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur pas/ /yul gzhan la ni sems zhes pas/ /sgrub dka'i sayul dang lhan cig tu/ /kun rtog thams cad spang bar bya/ /gnas skabs lnga ni gnod gyur na/ /skad cig gis ni 'khor bar ltung / /snyom 7dang gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang / /rgod dang the tshom zhes bya ba'i/ /sgrib pa lnga po sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mi bzhed do/ /lnga po de ni yongs spangs nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges byas pas7 / /smyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis rol na/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur / /gsang ba de nyid mchog de nyid/ /grub pa gang zhig der kibarten pa/ /der ni rgyal ba kun 'byung ba/ /gsang ba grub pa zhes byar brjod/ /ces bya'o//dgu bcu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa'i/ /tshigs su bcad pa lnga brgyar ni/ /dngos 26—66

grub thams cad basbu 1ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba grub pa zhes byar brjod/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i dga' bas thob gyur bsod nams gang yin pas/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i sar gyur 'jig rten gyur pa yon tan rgyan gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur gsang ba grub pa gtan du nyin dang mtshan 2du spyor gyur cig /sems can 'di kun ma lus byang chub snying po'i bar du legs par spyod gyur cig /gang zhig rgya mtsho dang bcas sa gzhi ri dang ljon shing sogs pas brgyan pa rnams//de dag de nyid gzugs brnyan bzhin du chen por gyur pa'i khong du chud par snang gyur pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dri med zla ba'i 'od zer dpal ldan gsang ba grub pa mchog /mdzad pa thugs rjes gzhan gyi dbang gyur dpal ldan pad+ma rdo rje gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las/ don dam pa'i slob dpon gyi mchod pa nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //lha dang lha min la sogs pa ma lus pas/ zhabs kyi pad+ma zung la me tog gi phreng bas mchod pa dpal mgon po bde ba chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyis 4mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛṣ+ṭa 5paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khyems rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa7 826—67

༄/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ prazlo pā 2ya be+e nibya ya sid+dhi/ bod skad du / thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo rang bzhin dri ma med cing thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin sems gang las ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog mtha' dag dri mas ma gos chos sku dang ni mtshungs med pa'i/ /dam chos char kyi gzhir gyur longs spyod dang ni sna tshogs pa yi gzugs dang spyod ldan pa'i/ /yang dag sprul pa skye 'gyur de la gus par phyag byas nas ni de nyid bshad par 4bya/ /de yi rang bzhin ma 5shes pa'i/ /skye bo ma lus la phan phyir/ /dpal ldan yan lag med rdo rje/ /bdag gis 6de nyid mdor bsdu bya/ /byis pas 'khrul pa'i bden min pa'i/ /kun du rtog 7pa las byung dngos/ /kun du rtog pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de ni srid par 26—75

mkhas pas bshad/ /de la 1bzod dka' rgyun chags pa'i/ /nyon mongs ma lus tshogs rnams dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs rgya che ba'i/ /las kyi tshogs ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de gnyis las ni skye ba dang / /'chi ba la sogs rab rgyas pa/ /mi bden la zhen sems ldan pa'i/ /shin tu sdug bsngal khor 2mor 'byung / /shes rab nyam gruchung de dag ni/ /ji srid dngos 'dzin chen po yod/ /de srid srid pa'i btson rar gnas/ /bdag dang gzhan phan ga la yod/ /de phyir 'gro ba gsum po dag /dga' bar byed 'dod rang gi ni/ /'khrul pa bsal 4bar 'dod pa yi/ / shes rab can gyis 5dngos 'dzin spang 6/ /gal te ming tsam tha dad kyang / /rtog pa nyid du dbyer rnged phyir/ /mkhas pas dngos 'dzin yongs gtang 7ste/ /dngos med par yang mi rtag go/ /mar me 'bar ba bsad rung gi/ /shi na ci yang byar med par/ /dngos por 'dzin pa nyid rung gi/ /dngos med 'dzin pa de lta zhemin/ /yang dag dngos po mi rtog pa//de yis 1 dngos po mtshon 'gyur te/ /gang phyir nam mkha' zhig pa ni/ /med pas dang po bral ba min/ /thabs dang bral bar gyur pa yisabye / /dngos med tsam zhig bsgrubs 1 gyur kyang / /med phyir nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /bdag gzhan don ni nus ma yin/ /mig 'phrul lta bur 'khrul pa'i phyir/ /de ltar dngos po yongs su btang / /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yisalke / /med phyir dngos med de bzhin no/ /de gnyis ji ltar yongs btang dang / /btang nas gang du gnas pa ni/ /'khor min mya ngan 'das min pa/ /de ni mkhas pas mnyan par gyis/ /shes dang shes bya rab phye ste/ /spyor bas yongs su brtags nas ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /shes rab de nyid 26—76

du ni brjod/ /ma lus sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang / /sbug bsngal las 'don gang yin pa/ /snying rje sems can la chags pas/ /'dod chags zhes ni bya bar grags/ /rtag tu rjes mthun spyor ba yis1/ /skye bo mngon par 'dod pa yis / /'bras bu gang yin nyer sbyin pas/ /de nyid thabs zhes bya bar bsgrags / /chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin/ /gnyis med rnam par spyor ba yis / /gnyis po 'dus pa gang yin pa/ /shes rab thabs zhes bya bar brjod / /de ltar gang la gzhag pa dang / /gsal bar nus pa ma yin zhing // gzhag dang gsal 4ba spangs pa ni/ /chos rnams de bzhin nyid ces brjod/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs spangs shing / /mtshan gzhi dang ni mtshan nyid gol/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /gnyis dang gnyis med zhi ba dang / /thams cad la gnas dge ba ste/ /so so rang rig mi g.yo zhing / /thabs dang shes rab mi 'khrugs pas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar gyur pa'i gnas/ /legs dang lha yi phun tshogs byed/ /chos kyi dbyings su rab tu grags/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis bsten pa'i/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa ste/ /yid 'ong bdag byen brlabs pa'i gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dge ba/ /theg pa gsum dang sku gsum dang / /bye ba grangs med sngags dang ni/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / /'jig rten pa dang de las 'das/ /lha dang lha min mi dang ni / /yi dwags la sogs de bzhin gzhan/ /de nyid las ni byung nas su/ /de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur/ /ma lus pa yi 'gro rnams la/ /yid bzhin nor ltar kun du gnas/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /spyod dang 26—77

—grol ba yang dag rtsol1/ /de nyid yang dag rtogs nas su/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs sangs rgyas la/ /thams cad du ni sangs rgyas zhing / /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /dpag med bde ba'i rang bzhin phyir/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhes bya la/ /kun du bzang po mchog nyid dang / /mngon par byang chub byed pa po/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i thugs rjes 'gro ba gsum gyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /'joms par byed pa gcig pu rab 'jug dang ni dpag med sna tshogs pa'i/ /tshogs la chags pa las ni rnam par grol ba'i blo mchog mnyam 'dus pa/ /bdag gzhan phan dang bde rgyu de nyid du ni thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs/ /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub 4pa las/ shes rab dang thabs rnam par spros pa'i rim par phye ba ste dang po'o// //srid pa gzhom dka' 'khrul pa yi/ /nad kyis gzhom bdag la phan pa5/ /de nyid rin chen thob bya'i phyir/ /de nas 'di la cung zad bshad/ /dpal ldan yan lag rnged rdo rje/ /snying rjer zhugs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ /thabs ni ji bzhin mdor bsdu bya/ /de 'di yin zhes rgyal bas kyang / /de ni brjod par nus ma yin/ /so so rang rig rang bzhin phyir/ /ngag gi lam gyis 6gzung bya min/ /de lta na yang dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro rnams dga' 7mdzad pas/ /mdo sde du ma gsang sngags kyi/ /spyod pa la sogs rim gyis bshad/ /dgra 8dang don dag 'byel med phyir/ /thos pa la sogs shes pa yis/ /yul du nam yang 'gyur rdzo6—78

ma yin/ /bstan bcos mtshan nyid ston pa yin/ /de phyir skyes bu dam pa yis1/ /bla ma dam pa bsten par rigs/ /de ma gtogs par de nyid ni/ /bskal pa bye bas thob mi 'gyur/ /zhing bzang shin tu sbyangs pa las/ /sa bon med pa'i myu gu bzhin/ /de nyid rin chen ma rnyed par/ /nam yang dngos grub 'gyur ma yin/ /rnam par mi rtog lam la gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab don ston pa'i/ /man ngag ldan pa 'ga' tsam ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /sa steng gi ni slob dpon te/ /nges par yongs su shes byas la /dngos grub mchog ni bdag sgrub phyir/ /de ni 'bad pas bsnyen bkur bya/ /gang zhig gi ni gzi brjid kyis/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bcas pa'i/ /'byung po kun gyis 4dge legs dang / /dpag med byang chub bde mchog thob/ /ltos pa med par thugs brtse ba'i/ /thugs rje'i sgu can de la ni/ /bsam ngan rgyu yi dri bcas pas5/ /sems kyis byu phyir 'dud par byed/ /ji srid 'dod pa rnyed bar du/ /kun du phyag dang bkur ste dang / /'bad de chang la sogs pas mchod6/ /bsnyen bkur sri zhu bla mar byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gnas/ /rin chen de nyid thob gyur nas/ /sdang la skyon rnams rtog byed cing / /'dris /med tsam yang byed mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan yang ngan pa'i bdag /bla ma rdo rje can bsten nas/ /co 'dri bar ni byed pa'i bdag /bsam ngan rang la co 'dri 'am/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 9 dang ni/ /bla ma'i phyag rgya 'phrog par byed/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dam chos la/ /ma spyad par ni smod 7par byed/ /dam tshig ngo mtshar che gyur la/ /rtag tu smod byed blo ldan pa / /nga yang shin tu skrag byed ces/ /dpal ldan 26—79

rdo rje mgon pos gsungs/ /bsnyen bkur med par myur ba ru/ /bdag ni rjes su gzung 'tshal brjod/ /sdang ba'i sems kyis gzhan bstan 1te/ /kha cig nyes pa sgrogs la brtson/ /sangs rgyas don du mi gnyer zhing / /rnal 'byor pa dang slob dpon zhes/ /bdag ni ci nas shes 'gyur ba/ /de tsam la ni zhugs pa yin/ /brgya la ye shes rnyed 'gyur na/ /khengs pas —bla ma la sdang bar/ /sngags kyi rim pa las 'ongs pa/ /'di ni bdag gis shes zhes brjod / /slar la 'bul gyis 4yas rang bzung / /de nas brtsams te yas kyi 5ni/ /slob ma nga min slob dpon min/ /khro bcas smra ba gzhan dag yod/ /bla ma slu ba'i bsam pa yis6/ /co 'dri byed cing 'khyal dz+wabyed pa/ /tshe 'di bde ba yod min na/ /de dag ji ltar 'grub par 'gyur/ /de lta bu yi sems can gang / /rang gi don la rgyab phyogs yin/ /de ni ngan 'gro kun snod du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mgon pos gsungs/ /bdag nyid sun 'byin byed pa de/ /dmyal las 'gro ba gzhan yod min/ /shin tu mi bzad 8las rnams kyis/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa mang pos 'tshed/ /de bas dam pa don gnyer ba'i/ /skyes bu 9dngos po thams cad kyis/ /dpag med 'bras bu rab ster ba'i/ /slob dpon kun du bsten par bya/ /byang chub tu ni nges byas pas/ /phrag dog nga rgyal ser sna dang / /de bzhin g.yo dang sgyu dang ni/ /skyo dub 'du shes yongs spangs te/ /rtag tu ngu yi spyod pa bzhin/ /mi g.yo ba yi sems kyis ni/ /dngos grub kun don ster ba'i bla/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bsnyen bkur bya/ /shin tu gus pas dus gsum du/ /zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas shing / /rang gi lus la'ang ltos med par/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon 'go mchod par snabya/ /de nas bla 26—80

ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa1/ /de nyid dam pa gegs med par/ /slob ma yis ni thob par 'gyur/ /rtag tu 'od gsal dag pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i gnas 'gyur byang chub sems/ /gsal ba chos kyi dbyings kyi dngos/ /phun tshogs ma lus byed par 'gyur/ /mun pa'i tshogs ni 'joms byed pa'i/ /nyi ma dang ni nye ba yi/ /rnge shel gyi ni nor bu las / /rab 'bar me lce 'byung ba bzhin/ /slob ma'i sems ni nor bu la/ /'go ba gzigs pa nyer 'gyur na/ /dri ma 'joms byed rnal 'byor gyi/ /me lce rno 'bar de bzhin no/ /dpal ldan de nyid rin chen ni/ /rab tu rtogs pas 'bar rjes la/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs sangs rgyas rnams/ /thugs rjes thugs ni 'phangs nas su/ /myur du byin nas slob ma ni/ /sangs rgyas byen brlabs — gdon mi za/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byen brlabs pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /brtan pas g.yo dang zol dang nga rgyal sgrib pa thams cad yongs su spangs nas ni/ /man ngag ldan pa'i bla ma mtshungs pa med pa dad pas 'dir ni bsten par bya/ /des de nges par rgyal ba'i yon tan gter 'gyur de nyid rin chen rnyed gyur nas/ /bde gshegs kun gyis brnyes pa'i byang chub mchog ni thob 3par 'gyur/ /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa las rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen bkur nges par bstan )pa'i rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /dbang bskur srid gsum phun tshogs gnas/ /de ni 'di la yang dag bshad/ /26—81

bde gshegs gnas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyud ni 1lam gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /mkhas pas gang tshe dbang bsgur na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum yin/ /dpag med 'jig rten khams dbang phyug /bdag byin brlab pa'i dbang thob pa / /dam tshig nyams kyi 'jigs pas na/ /blo ldan de dag gis kyang 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 2don dam du/ /sngags kyi lam las de bzhin gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'i/ /sngags kyi lam du de bzhin gsungs/ /de bas don kun la 'bad pas/ /dbang bsgur don gnyer rgyal dag —sras/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ /ji ltar rigs 5pas bsnyen par bya/ /gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /mig bzang phyag rgya rnyed nas ni/ /gos dang tsan+dan phreng sogs kyis/ /rab tu brgyan te dbul bar bya/ /dri dang phreng sogs bsnyen bkur dang / /chang dang ston mo rgya chen dang / /phyag rgyar bcas pa'i gtso bo 6ni/ /gus pas 'bad de yang dag mchod/ /slob ma dad pas pus lha nga / /sa la legs par btsugs nas ni/ /thal sbyar bcas pa'i bstod pa 'dis/ /ston pa la ni gsol gdab bya/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa yi/ /stong nyid snying po bstod phyag 'tshal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa po/ /bdag don de nyid ston mdzad pa//chos bdag med las yang dag byung / /rdo rje sems khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin yon tan/ /rtag tu mgon po khyod las 'byung / / /byang chub sems khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /dkon mchog gsum dang jeg chen gyi/ /de nyid brtan dang g.yo bcas pa/ /36——82

khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba'i sa bon khyod la 'dud/ /'gro don sna tshogs grub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /dpal ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras po khyod la 'dud / /yon tan rgya mtsho bka' drin gyis1/ /de nyid bla rnged shes par 'tshal / /kun mkhyen rdo rje'i 2dbang bskur ba/ /de ltar bka' drin mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje yis4/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen po/ /rdo rje chos la bstan pa bzhin/ /de ring mgon pos bka' drin stsol5/ /khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /bdag la gzhan ni skyabs ma mchis / /'khor ba'i dgra las rab rgyal ba'i/ /mgon pos de phyir brtse bar mdzod/ /de nas dpal ldan slob dpon ni/ /phan pa'i bsam pas rjes brtse bas/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed de/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas gang ba'i//dril bu sil snyan sgra dang bcas/ /bla re 'bar ba byes pa ru/ /me tog bdug pa nyams dga' 'khrigs/ /phreng dang 6dri zhim mchog tu bde/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lam gyi lha/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnal 'byor ldan/ /mchog tu rmad byung gnas gyur pa'i/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor bkug nas ni/ /de nas slob dpon skal bzang gis / /phyag rgya dang ni sbyar byas te/ /rgyal ba'i gnas gyur byang chub sems/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas ni/ /bkra shis glu yi tshigs bcad dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab rgyal mtshan bcas/ /phyag rgyar ldan pas slob ma ni/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor dbang bsgur bya/ /slob dpon dbang phyug mchog gis ni/ /dbang bskur rin chen byin nas su/ /rang bzhin gsal zhing mngon sbyangs pa/ /dam tshig nyams dga' sbyin par bya/ /rin chen chen po 26—83

ga pur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar po sbyar ba dang / /rdo rje yi ni chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa dag las yang dag byung / /'di ni bu khyod dam tshig ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /bzang pos rtag tu bskyang bar byos/ /de ni sdom 1pa mnyan par gyis/ /srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing / /bud med rin chen spang mi bya/ /khyod kyis 2slob dpon yang mi spang / /sdom pa shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /byang chub sems kyi dbang bsgur bas/ /slob ma sdig dang bral bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sras mchog de la ni/ /rjes su gnang ba de nas sbyin/ /byang chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun du ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /sems can mchog gis bskor bar gyis / /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag4 /yid bzhin nor ltar rgya che ba/ /chags dang bral zhing mi skyo bas/ /da ni sems can rnams don gyis/ /rjes gnang bcas pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /bya ba byas shing rab dga' bas/ /'gro kun dga' bar byed pa yi/ /'jam pa'i tshig ni brjod par bya/ /de ring bdag gson 'bras bu yod/ /de ring skye ba 'bras bu yod/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su byes/ /de ring sangs rgyas sras por gyur/ /skye la sogs pa'i rba rlabs dang / /nyon mongs 'dam ni rgal dka' ba'i/ /rtog pa'i rgya mtsho 'jigs chen las/ /mgon pos de ring bdag bsgral to/ /khyod zhabs bka' drin shes nas su/ /byang chub gang gi 5bdag 'tshal bas6 bag chags thams cad spangs nas su/ /rdzogs pa'i bzhin du bdag gyur to 7/ /mig mdangs 'dzum dang bcas pa yis8/ /gus pas zhabs la btud nas su/ /'dzin pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rdzas ni gang dang gang bzhed pa/ /de 26—81

dang de ni dbul bar bya/ /bla ma thugs rje can gyis kyang / /slob ma'i 'dzin pa spang ba'i phyir/ /de la phan phyir blang bar bya/ /bla ma'i yon ni phul nas su/ /de nas mchod de phyag byas la/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas thob nas/ /slar yang 'di yis 1mkhyen par gsol/ /de ring sangs rgyas mchog khyod kyi / /bka' drin bdag gis thob par 'gyur/ /de mthus bla med byang chub ni/ /ji bzhin bdag gis bsgrub par bgyi/ /mchog kun gyes ni mchod pa'i gnas/ /bla med byang chub thob nas ni/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i sems can rnams4/ /de nyid la ni dgod par bgyi/ /cho ga 'di dag nyid kyis 5dbang bsgur byin nas ni/ /slob ma 6lhag par mos pa'i yid kyis brtag byas la/ /zab cing rgya che ba la lhag par mos nas 7ni/ /tshig gis rin chen dbang bsgur sbyin par bya / /dbang bskur mchog ni ma lus thob par 'gyur ba ste9/ /rdo rje mchog 'dzin rnyed dka' mtshungs pa med pa'i gnas/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa dang ni dpal gyi zhing gyur pa/ /byang chub sems can 7dbang bsgur de dag 11blang bar bya/ / rjes su gnang ba thob nas 'jig rten gsum po yi/ /bya byed ngan pa'i dgra las rgyal ba'i blo ldan pas/ /dri ma rnged pa'i de nyid grub pa'i gnas der ni/ /'jug pa'i sems kyis rgyal ba de nyid rnal 'byor bya'o/ /12thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa las/ byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba nges par bstan pa'i /rim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //gzhan don la phan brtson 'grus can/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /shes rab thabs kyi bsgom pa mchog /de nas 'di la —gsal bshad bya/ /26—85

gang zhig bsgoms 1pas 'khor ba yi/ /'jigs rung rgal dka'i rgya mtshor min / /rang don tsam gyis mya ngan 'das/ /der yang rnal 'byor pa mi gnas / /gang zhig rab kyis mthar phyin pas/ /dri med rmad byung sangs rgyas nyid/ /'phel dang 'grib las rnam grol ba'i/ /bla med byang chub skye 'gyur ba'o/ /phung po lnga la sogs chos rnams/ /gang yang dor bar bya min zhing / /nam yang gzung bar bya ba'ang min/ /chos kun mi mnyam mnyam pa nyid / /stong nyid bsgom 4par bya min la/ /stong nyid min pa'ang mi bsgom 5 mo / /stong nyid rnal 'byor pas mi gtang / /stong nyid min pa yang mi gtang 6/ /stong nyid stong min nyid 'dzin pa/ /rtog pa rab rgyas skye bar 'gyur / /yongs su btang ba'ang rtog pa ste/ /de bas de gnyis yongs su spangs / /'dzin pa gnyis ka yongs btang na/ /chags bral rnam par grol ba'i gnas/ /de dang 'byel bdag ces par 7yang / /kun rtog de phyir de gnyis spang / /chags pa med cing 'gyur ba med/ /sdig pa dang bral mngon zhen med/ /thog ma tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /mkhas pas nam mkha' lta bur bsgom / /snying rjer ldan pa'i 8sems can la/ /rgyab kyis phyogs par mi bya'o/ /sems can yod dang rnged ces par/ /rnam rtog nyid ni mi bya'o/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin gang / /shes rab ces byar rab tu grags/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin du/ /ma lus 'gro don byed snying rje/ /mi dmigs gnas kyi shes rab dang / /mi dmigs snying rje chen po ste/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /blo ldan lhan cig gnyis su med/ /gang na'ang sgom 9pa po med cing / /rnam par sgom pa'ang ci yang rnged/ /bsgom bya nyid kyang yod 26—86

min la 3/ /de ni de nyid bsgom par bshad/ /bya ba'ang cung zad yod min la/ /dpyad par bya ba nyid kyang med/ /byed po dpyod pa las grol ba/ /don dam rnam par bsgom pa yin/ /gtong bar byed pa'ang yod min zhing / /'gog par byed pa'ang ci yang med/ /des na dor bar bya med cing / /'di la blang bya gang yang med/ /gzugs rnams kun du blta ba dang / /de bzhin sgra rnams nyan pa dang / /dgod dang rtsed mo byed pa dang / /ro rnams sna tshogs myang ba dang / /las rnams thams cad byed pa ni/ /sems ni mi g.yo gnas byas nas/ /de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rgyun du skye bar 'gyur / /de nyid gnyis med bstan 2pa ste/ /byang chub sems mchog 'di yin no/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi byang chub nyid/ /pha rol phyin pa kun dngos kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di nyid/ /'di ni mnyam nyid brjod pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsgom pa'i mchog /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos sogs / /brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag nyid kyis5/ /'gro ba thams cad 'di las skyes/ /dngos dang dngos med dang bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pas ni de nyid bsgom/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba/ /bsgoms 4pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyes pa ma lus dang bral zhing / /nges par sdug bsngal ldog 'gyur na/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs yon tan ni/ /mtha' yas de las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog mun pa sdug bsngal ba/ /stug pos mngon par zil gnon cing / /'dod chags la sogs bzlog dka'i 5dri mas g.yogs gyur pa'i / /rab tu 'thor rlung gis bskyod glog 6ltar g.yo ba yi/ /sems ni 26—87

'khor ba yin par rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rtog pa las ni rnam par grol zhing 'od gsal ba/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma'i sgrib g.yogs rab tu spang 1 / /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa med na de nyid ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i don du sems can mchog gis gsungs/ /de bas snyug bsngal mang po'i tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa/ /'di las gzhan pa gang yang yod pa ma yin la/ /thar 'dod 'phags pa khyod kyi bde ba dpag med pa/ /skye ba'i rgyur yang 'di las gzhan pa gang yang med/ /sdug bsngal ma lus zad bya'i go cha bgos nas ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde mchog thob par 'dod pa yis4/ /sems ni brtan byas de la 'bad de dpyad byas la/ /de yis 5rang bzhin bdag gi rang bzhin nyid du bya/ /skye ldan rnams kyi yid 'di ji srid rtog pa'i mun pa snam bu mthug 6 pos dkris gyur pa/ /de srid sbug bsngal dpag tu med yin de nas de ni ji srid bshus par gyur pa ni7/ /de srid bde ba rgya chen mtshungs med yin pas 'phags mchog de la nan tan gyis shig dang / /de zad nas ni de nyid la gnas yon tan rgyas pa rang nyid kyis ni snang bar 'gyur/ /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa'i sgrub pa las/ de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i rim par phye ba ste bzhi pa'o// //chos kun mnyam nyid rmad byung ba/ /de nyid spyod pa bla na med/ /rnam rtog dgra rnams gsod byed pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gzhan/ /rdzogs pa'i 8sangs rgyas la gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sras 9la phan bya'i phyir/ /de nyid yan lag med rdo rjes/ /de nas 'di las gsal bshad bya/ /rga ba la 26—88

sogs rba rlabs 'khrigs/ /skye ba'i rgya mcho 1cher 'jigs las/ /'byung po thams cad sgrol ba'i gru/ /nyes med par ni 'gro ba'i gru/ /yid 'ong yon tan kun gyi gnas/ /myur du dngos grub bzang po byed/ /'dod pa'i don kun rab sgrub pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /ma lus pa yi sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan rgyur 'gyur bar ni/ /2rdo rje 'dzin pas rab tu bsngags pa ste/ /'di ma gtogs par dngos grub skye bar 'gyur min de phyir thar pa 'dod pas spyod pa mnyam med 'di spyad bya/ /lha min dgra 4dang brgya byin grong khyer gsum dgra nor sbyin tshangs sogs rnams kyis 5zhabs kyi pad+mar mchod byas pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang 6mchog ni myur du thob byed sdig pa zad byed 'di ni mkhas pas spyad par bya/ /dpal ldan 7rdo rje sems dpas 'gro la phan phyir yang dag spyod pa 'di gsungs te/ /sna tshogs gzhan dag ma lus gdul bya'i skye bo du ma'i dbang du byas nas ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs bla rnged dngos grub ma lus rab bsgrub min/ /kun bzang mtshungs med spyod pa 'di las 'grub 'gyur bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs / /dpal ldan slob dpon rdo rje can/ /mgon la kun nas phyag byas la/ /bya ba byas pa'i blo can gyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa bstan 9par bya/ /de nas rang 'dod nges byas la/ /'du 'dzi kun la rgyab phyogs te/ /seng ge'i bdag nyid kun rgyu ba/ /de nyid ldan pas spyad par bya/ /'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa yis/ /ji bzhin yang dag don rig pas/ /yang dag ldan pas 'jug pa bdag /gnas med sems ni bstan —par bya/ /khams gsum 'di dag de nyid de/ /phung po khams la sogs mtshan nyid/ /thams cad sgyu ma rmi 26—89

lam bzhin/ /mdor bsdus 'di ltar shes byas la1/ /'gyod dang rmugs dang gnyid la sogs/ /longs spyod rgya chen 'du 'dzin 2dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /shin tu thag ring spang bar bya/ /gnyis med nges par byas nas ni/ /rtag tu g.yo ba med pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug spyor ba ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub bsgrub par bya/ /sems can rnam par mi rtog bzhin/ /sems can don la shin tu chags/ /sems ni byang chub nges byas la de nyid spyod pa la brten bya/ /shes rab thabs su ldan pa yis/ /chags pa kun la rgyab bstan te/ /de nyid goms pa la 'bad pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag byin brlab par rab gsal bas/ /sems ni ji ltar rjes mthun 4par/ /sngags kyi lam las rab bshad pa'i/ /dam tshig dag ni kun spyad bya/ /bgegs dang bdud tshogs zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga po byin gyis brlabs/ /bshang gci la sogs rnams gnas pa/ /'di ni srung 5/ba bla med yin/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gdon gyi tshogs6/ /bdud dang log 'dren nyid dag ni/ /'di yis 7rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /mi dang rnga mo las byung dang / /rta dang glang po las byung ba/ /lnga pa khyi las byung ba ste/ /sgron ma shes rab can gyis 8bza'/ /sems ni dga' bar byed pa yis9/ /dam tshig chen po gzhan dag kyang / /rlung ni 'khrugs 7pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can mnyes bya/ /thams cad du ni thar 'dod pas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bsten bya/ /dam pa'i don du gang gnas pa/ /kun rdzob dag pa'i lus bzung nas/ /bud med mdzes pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /thams cad du ni kun du gnas/ /de bas phyi rol don 26—90

las byung / /rdo rje mgon pos don de gsungs/ /bram ze'i rigs sogs las byung dang / /mtha' yas 1skyes dang phyag rgya dang / /gzhan gyi chung ma tshul nyams dang / /dman dang cha lugs mi sbug dang / /skyed ma dang ni sgyug mo dang / /rang gi bu mo sring mo dang 2/ /de nyid sbyor bas 'dod spyod na/ /sgrub po myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems ni tshim par byed pa yi/ /gling bu sogs las byung ba mnyan/ /phyi rol phyag rgya ka ra na/ /ro ni sna tshogs tshim byed bya/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ba yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan mchog rnams kyis//sems ni rin chen dag bya'i phyir/ /rtag tu bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /chu skyes rdo rje chu dang ni/ /sgron ma'i 'o ma rab rgyas mchod/ /phreng dang tsan+dan gos bzang sogs/ /sems ni skyo ba med par bya/ /bgrod dang bgrod min sogs pa ni/ /'dir ni nam yang bya ba min/ /sgyu ma lta bu sogs spyor bas/ /thams cad la ni longs spyod bya/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung bas na/ /mi mthun phyogs ni gang yang med/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin rab spyad bya/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa/ /'di dag thams cad longs spyad phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sprul pa yin/ /ye shes mtha' yas rnyed pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs la'ang phyag min na/ /rtag tu bsgom la 'grub 4pa yis/ /lugs ma la sogs smos ci dgos/ /dngos po kun kyi rang bzhin 'di/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /de bas bdag nyid lha yin no/ /smyung ba dang ni dkyil 'khor bri5/ /phyag rgya bcing dang mchod rten las/ /sbyin sreg dang ni gsang sngags zlos6/ /po ti klog pa la sogs pa/ /dpal 26—91

ldan rdo rje mgon po yis/ /mos pa'i dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /gzhan dag la ni bstan pa ste/ /de nyid rig pa'i sems kyis min/ /mar sar 'dod pa'i 1snying po ni/ /blangs te dar ba 'dor bar byed/ /de ltar chos kyi snying thob pas/ /rtog pa ma lus spang bar bya/ /rnam par mi rtog gnas blo can/ /gnas min dogs pa spangs byas nas2/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i bka' bzhin du/ /de nas 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /phyag rgya spyor bas kun du 'khyud/ /rdo rje bcug ste bskyod pa dang / /ma mchu'i sbrang mchog btung bya zhing / /de yis 'dren 4pa'i sgra gsal bas/ /blangs shing dul ba'i 5longs spyad na/ /nges par dga' ba rgya chen gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar yid 'khrugs mi 'gyur ba / /de lta de ltar spyad par bya/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'khrugs gyur na/ /nam yang dngos grub 'gyur ma yin/ /de bas dngos grub mchog 'dod pa'i/ /sgrub 7pa pos ni 'dzin pa spang / /sems dang rjes mthun spyor ba yis/ / mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub par bya/ /9dngul chu bzung bas bsgrubs ji bzhin/ /thabs kyi gzhi yi spyor ba yis/ /de bzhin sems kyi dngul chu bzung / /sbyor ba dag ni gang yin pa/ /de ru de yis 11gnas par bya/ /dus dang grangs ni yongs spangs nas/ /de nyid rig pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnyis med mtshungs pa med pa gang yin nyin re zhing / /de nyid mchog ni rgyun du rjes su bsten par bya/ /'di yis sadri ma med cing rdo rje lta bu dang / /grib ma lta bu'i sgu ni mtshungs med thob par 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pas shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kun/ /ཿrang bzhin gyis ni dri ma med par rnam 'byed de/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sdug 26—92

bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir/ /nyin rer brtson 'grus go cha chen po bgos nas su / /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /yon tan ma lus pa yi gter gyur bsgom par bya/ /sems ni byang chub ngo bor bzhag 1nas yul gyi ni/ /bde la dga' bas tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma lus 'di dag rnam dag ste/ /tha mal yul rnams bdag med sgyu ma lta bu dang / /mig 'phrul dang ni mig yor dag dang mtshungs pa ste/ /gnas med rtog pa'i tha snyad dag las rnam par grol/ /gang tshe skyes bu dam rīpa rgya chen bsam pa dang / /'dzin pa med pa'i sems ni kun du rtogs gyur 4pa//de tshe lhan cig skyes pa'i rtog pa zil mnan te/ /yul 'di rnams kyis 5nus pa 'ching bar nus ma yin/ /gang rnams rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang ma grags dang / /bde ba dang ni sdug bsngal rab tu rgyas pa dang / /bstod pa smad pa'i dri ma rab tu ma lus pa/ /zad pas shirang gi sems ni mnyam pa nyid du bya/ /chags pa med dang 'gro la snying ni brtse ba yisadza/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad las grol spyod pa dang / /ldan pa de yi phyag na bde gshegs go 'phang ni/ /gnas pa yin zhes rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu gsungs/ /gzhan la gnod par byed pa'i blo can gyi/ /skye bo gshis ngan kha yi bu ga ni/ /zab mo gya gyu nas byung tshig ngan sbrul/ /rtsub mo'i las kyis su zhig 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /shin tu dri me+ed dga' byed 'od kyi phreng can gyi/ /'od zer mtsho 9—skyes kyis ni bzod par mi nus ltar/ /yid 'phrog byed pa'i bdud rtsi med du bshad pa yang / /skye bo mdzangs min yid ni chags par byed pa min/ /zla ba'i 'od zer de nyid chu shel nor bu dang / /shin tu nye bar 'dus nas bdud rtsi chu 'dzag bzhin/ /26—93

de nyid skye bo bzang yid bdud rtsi'i 1ros brlan zhing / /mig nas mchi ma 'dzag bzhin chags par byed/ /de bas bdag ni chos nyid gnas pa'i skye bo bzang / /'phags pa shes ldan khyod la thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /bdag gis mdo ru basbus te gsal bar byas pa ni/ /rab mchog gang yin de ni khyod la dbul bar gyi4/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpas ji skad gsungs pa ni/ /bdag gis kyang ni 'di ru de bzhin nges par bstan/ /ci ste nyes par smras pa yod gyur pa/ /de lta na yang 'phags pa bzod pa mdzad 5par zhu/ /bla ma'i 6zhabs kyi pad+mar brten par rnam sprul pa'i/ /bdud rtsi dge ba rnams kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ /gang yin can de 'gro ba rnams kyi thun mong ne+eyun ring du/ /phan byed ma lus brtse bas bdag gis byas pa ste/ /dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal po 9yon tan mtsho/ /rab mchog lha dang lha min dbang po'i cod pan gyis/ /sgrub thabs de nyid rig pa rnams las —myur du ni//'bras bu ster ba gang yin 'di ni byas pa las/ /bsod nams dri ma med pa rgya chen thob gyur pa/ /'di yis 'gro rnams rtog pa'i dgra yi tshogs las ni/ /rgyal bar gyur rka1te blo ldan yon tan rgyur 'gyur ba/ /byang chub sems dang de dag shin tu ldan gyur cig /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa'i sgrub pa las/ de kho na nyid kyi spyod pa 1ganges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba ste lnga pa'o// //thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa'i sgrub pa slob dpon chen po yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shābye bha dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lha btsas kyis 26—9 /

༄khya/ /ye shes grub pa jes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs 1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi nā ma sā dha no pi kā/ bod skad du / ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i rna thabs/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun dang dngos grub ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur khyab gyur pa/ /rgyal mchog mchod dang bcas pa yi thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdo rje mchog /sems can kun la kun stsol ba'i/ /'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal te/ /dngos po 4kun la bdag gus pas/ /sgrub pa'i rim 'di bshad par bya/ /ma lus spyor rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na rnged/ /rmongs pa gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams5/ /gang zhig rtog pa kun spangs pa'i/ /de nyid la ni yang dag gnas/ /sgrub pa po de tshe 'di yis/ /byang chub dam par gnas par 'gyur / /sngags dang phyag rgya dkyil 'khor sogs/ /bzlas dang bsgom la 26—98

'bad pa yis/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med du'ang / /dngos grub mchog ni thob mi 'gyur/ /gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /longs spyod dbang phyug stobs rnams dang / /rigs dang rgyud dang gtsor gyur 1pa'i/ /sems la nga rgyal bcang mi bya/ /bdag ni blo ldan mkhas pa dang / /bzo dang sgyu rtsal thams cad la/ /mkhas pa dag ni rgyal po zhes/ /sems ni bskyed par mi bya'o//tshul khrims ldan zhing thos ldan brtan/ /sbyin pa la sogs yang dag ldan/ /bshad dang gzhan yang ma bshad pas/ /bdag tu dmigs par mi bya zhing / /sems can kun gyi yid khyad 2par/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid zhugs/ /de ltar bsams nas rnal 'byor gyis/ /dbang pos gang la'ang brnyas mi bya/ /byis pa drun dang dbul po dang / /tshul khrims 'khyal cing nad kyis gzir/ /de la sogs pa dpag med dang / /yang dag ldan yang brnyas mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad cing gus/ /byang chub sems kyis rnam par brgyan/ /sems can kun la rjes su brtse/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom la gnas/ /dri chen dmar dang sha nyid dang 4/ /byang chub sems dang rab bsres 5la/ /chu chen dang ni yang dag ldan/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu bza'/ /mi khye rta dang ba lang sgron/ /sna can dang ni khur skyed kyi'ang / /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs la/ /de nyid grub phyir bza' bar bya/ /srid gsum las byung gsad 6bya zhing / /pha rol nor ni 'phrog pa dang / /gzhan gyi bud med la 'dod spyod/ /brdzun gyi tshig ni smra bar bya7/ /las gang gis ni sems can rnams/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag tu'ang / /mi bzad 8dmyal bar 'tshed 'gyur ba/ /des ni rnal 'byor pa gol 'gyur/ /thabs chen yang dag ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 26—99

'jig rten don grub 1pa/ /sems can kun gyis smad pa yi/ /bya ba de la mi bya med/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa la/ /sdig par grags pa yang med ces / /rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa las/ /rdo rje can ni nyid kyis gsungs/ /bza' dang bza' min las 'das dang / /btung dang btung min rnam par spangs / /bgrod dang bgrod min rnams grol bdag /rnal 'byor pa ni mnyam 'jog 'gyur/ /rten 'brel las byung yang dag dngos/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par brtag /'gro 'ong dag las rnam grol zhing / /skye ba med pa bdag med can/ /sgyu ma 'dra sogs dpe yis ni/ /de rnams sbyor bar rab shes pas/ /nga dang bdag gi 4rnam rtog dag /de nyid shes pas der mi bya / /rdo rje chen pos kun khyab cing / /nam mkha' kun la rab tu zhugs/ /sems can kun gye yid khyab cing / /bsod nams thams cad 'byung ba che/ /phan tshun khyab mdzad rdo rje ni/ /kun rig 'jig rten 'dren pa po/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /rgyud rnams kun du gsungs pa yin/ /gang la bla ma'i drin yod pa/ /de yis 5de nyid mchog rnyed 6'gyur/ /gzhan du byis pas yun ring du/ /rnam par rmongs pas nyon mongs 'gyur/ /bla ma 7sangs rgyas chos gyur 8cing / /dge 'dun yang ni de bzhin te/ /de yi drin gyis shes 'gyur bas/ /de bas dkon mchog gsum yin no/ /mi shes rab rib kyis ldongs la/ /'di ni lam rab ston byed yin/ /bde ba kun gyi mchog 'gyur dang / /'dod pa thams cad rab ster yin/ /zab mo'i chos la nges pa'i bdag /shin tu snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkon mchog gsum rnams don du gnyer/ /chos sbyin pa la zang zing med/ /bla ma de ni slob ma sdud/ /26— 00

sangs rgyas kun rjes sgrub byed cing / /'go ba'i mgon gyis bka' stsal te/ /gzhan dag bla ma min par bshad/ /de bas de dang mnyam pa yi/ /mchod bya blo chen yod ma yin/ /des na 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /brtul zhugs can ni blo 1mchog mchod/ /de mnyam 2'go ba 'jig rten na/ /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /rdo rje sems nyid 'jig rten na/ /phun sum tshogs kun phyir zhugs yin/ /slob ma phun tshogs mchog 'dod cing / /bsod nams mi zad 'dod pa dang / /bgegs kun rnam par zlog byed pas/ /rnam pa du mas mnyes par bya/ /dam tshig dag ni thams cad kyi4/ /bla med dam tshig 'di yin te/ /phun sum tshogs kun ster ba'o/ /brtson ldan rnams kyis rtag tu bsrung / /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs pa'i/ /ye shes mchog bzang thob pa yis5/ /rdo rje ye shes dbang bskur bas/ /dngos grub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /yang dag ye shes kun ldan na/ /bris pa'i dkyil 'khor log 6gzhan du/ /dbang bskur ba ni len ce na/ /'di ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur / /dam tshig nyams pa'i 7sbug bsngal ni/ /lus dang de bzhin yid dang ni/ /de yi don rnams nyams 'gyur zhing / /myur ba nyid du shi bar 'gyur / /shi nas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag tu'ang / /myong nas gnas las 'phos 'gyur 8na'ang / /gdol pa'am dman pa'i rigs su skye/ /lkugs pa'am yang na 'on pa 'am/ /skye zhing skye bar dmus long du/ /skye bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes ni/ /rdo rje ye shes zhes byar bshad/ /blo ldan de yis 9dbang bsgur na/ /dbang bskur bar ni shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid/ /26—/01

dod— —'gro ba'i bdag po la 1sogs pa'i/ /tshogs/ kyis thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /byas nas mngon par phyag byed 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' stobs chen dang / /bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas kyang / /dpal chen bsrung ba mdzad gyur te/ /rdo rje sgu yis rtag tu bzhugs/ /bden pa'i chos 'dzin mi 'khrug cing / /sangs rgyas gdung ni rab 'jug pa/ /byen gyis brlabs dang ldan pa rnams/ /gus dang bcas pas bsngags par mdzad/ /'jig rten skyong dang de bzhin gzhan / /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa rnams/ /gnas rnams kun du rtogs pa na'ang / /gsungs nabazhin du ni rab tu gnas/ /gang yang sems can thams cad la/ /bdud dang bgegs su gnas pa rnams/ /de yang de la mi byed de/ /bgegs rnams skrag nas 'byer bar 'gyur/ /lha la sogs dang grub pa rnams/ /mkha' la rgyu dang mi rgyu kun/ /ngan 'gror 'gro bas 'jigs pas na/ /de yang de la mgon 4mi byed/ /gal te rmongs pa'i dbang gis ni/ /rnam par rmongs rnams mgon byed na/ /brtson dang ye shes rnam shes dang / /dngos grub dag kyang nyams par 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen mchog sbyin gsungs pa'o//dbyibs kun dang rgo rnam bral zhing / /'gro dang 'ong las rnam grol bdag /rlung kun gyis kyang bskyod mi nus/ /me yi phung pos mi tshig cing / /chu rnams kyis kyang g.yeng 5mi 'gyur/ /rab tu 'bad pas mtshon cha ni/ /rnon pos kyang ni chod mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar mi gnas nam mkha' ni/ /khyab cing mtshan nyid rnams dang bral/ /'di ni don dam de nyid de/ /rdo rje ye shes bla med yin / /kun du bzang po zhes bshad cing / /phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ /'di ni chos skur shes bya ste/ /me long ye shes zhes kyang bya/ /ji ltar gzugs —36 /02

dod—— dod dodabarnyan me long la/ /rang nyid nges par snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin chos sgur ye/ shes ni/ /snang bas me long zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes dang / /rang gi dang ni 'gro ba'i yang / /dngos nyid gcig pur thugs su chud/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya'o/ /gdod nas dag cing skye ba rnged/ /rang bzhin gyis 1ni 'od gsal ba/ /phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes pas/ /so sor rtog pa can zhes bshad/ /kun du kun nas sangs rgyas kyi2/ /mdzad pa thams cad la 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mdzad cig napas/ /bya ba sgrub pa jes bshad do/ /gang tshe nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib/ /thams cad las grol de yi tshe//rnal 'byor pa mchog rdo rje can/ /shin tu rnam dag ces bshad do/ /ji ltar gdul bya'i chos rnams dang / /'dod yon kun las sangs rgyas rnams/ /thams cad longs spyod gcig pas na/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgur 'dod do/ /mtshan rnams kun dang yang dag ldan/ /sna tshogs sgu ste mtshan nyid rnged/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa bas/ /sprul pa'i sgur ni bshad pa yin/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub 4phyir/ /shes nas rnal 'byor pas de bsgom/ /kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs na/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis 5phyag mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya chen 6zhes shes par bya/ /grub sde du ma'i rgyud rnams su/ /rnal 'byor mchog rnams la brten te/ /mngal 'byung rim pa gang yin dang / /zhing dang zhing du so sor btul / /de ba'in gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /der ni yang dag brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /gzhon nu'i rol pa thams cad dang / /de bzhin bzo gnas yang dag bstan/ /btsun mo'i 'khor las mngon 'byung zhing / /bdud rnams 'dul bar mdzad —)6 —/03

nyid dang / /lha yul nas ni 'bab pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang //mya ngan 'das chen yang dag bstan/ /gang yang rol pa gzhan rnams dang / /thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin las/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgom/ /'dir ni sngon chad ma byung med/ /sngon gnas pa ni spyor mi bya/ /de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad pa ni/ /thams cad rdo rje'i dngos gzhi ba1/ /dus gsum lam gyi mthar thug pa/ /thams cad de bzhin blta 2bar bya/ /ngag gi spyod yul kun las 'das/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas nyid kun ster ba po/ /rnal 'byer 'di 'drar bsam par bya/ /sa kun las ni rnal 'byor zhing / /rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam spangs la/ /grub pa bzhin du rnal 'byor bsgom/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje can kun rnal 'byor pa/ /thabs kyi cho ga kun shes nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung bzhin du/ /bla med de ni grub par 'gyur/ /'dug dang nyal dang gnas pa dang / /yang na 'chag pa dag la yang / /rdo rje tshig ni smra byed na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid thob 'gyur/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ro dang reg /brtul zhugs can ni rtag spyod tshe/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa ni/ /bya'o zhes ni yang dag spyod/ /de bzhin bza' dang gos sogs sam/ /gzhan gang 4ci yang rung ba dag /sems can rnams la ci ster ba/ /cho ga de bzhin sbyad par bya/ /glu gar de bzhin rol mo dang / /me tog phreng sogs rgyan rnams dang / /chun 'phyang rnga yab gdugs rnams kyis/ /pha rol bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /dri bzang 5dri yi byug pa sogs/ /cho ga ji bzhin 6byugs pa dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad rjes dran zhing / /rnal 'byor pas ni thams cad mchod/ /26—/0/

brtul zhugs can nam mgo byegs pa'am/ /khyem pa'am bsnyen bkur ba dag gam / /rgyal po'am sde dpon rnams kyang rung / /brtul zhugs can gyis ji bzhin spyad/ /rnal 'byor pa ni ci spyod pa/ /thams cad du ni smad mi bya/ /rtog pa kun las rnal gol bas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa 1bya ba byed/ /de ni dngos kun ngo bo ste/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rang nyid ji ltar 'dod par spyod/ /sems can kun kyi snying la bzhugs/ /de nyid thams cad bla med pa/ /de nyid rnal 'byor dbang pos bsgom/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun 'grub pa/ /rdo rje nyid ni myur thob 'gyur/ /'dir ni bgegs med bdud kyang med/ /thams cad kyang ni dbang du 'gyur/ /sbug bsngal kun las rnam par gol/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 2bdag nyid 'grub / /bdag nyid thams cad yang dag ldan/ /brtul zhugs che ldan gang tshe mthong / /nyin zhag dang ni tshad bral bar/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nyid 'grub 'gyur/ /mchod pa kun gyi khyad par gyis/ /bdag nyid la ni rtag tu mchod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bla med pa/ /phan tshun du yang de bzhin sbyin/ /sems can kun lus las byung dang / /phyi sa las byung srog chags rnams/ /rnal 'byor chen pos legs blangs la/ /de nyid grub phyir bza' bar bya/ /sgron ma che dang yang dag ldan/ /smad pa'i dam tshig gzhan rnams dang / /bdud rtsi lnga rnams rtag bza' zhing / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang mchod/ /yan lag kun ni smad pa dang / /brnyas pa dag tu mi bya ste/ /bud rnged rigs kun las byung ba / /rdo rje can gyis mchod par bya/ /ma skyes me tog yang dag ldan/ /byang chub sems dang ldan pa dag /me tog 4cho ga la gnas te/ /de nyid grub 26—/05

phyir bza' bar bya/ /sme sha can gyi rigs las byung / /sme sha can dang khyad par du/ /smad pa'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ /brten na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /bram ze la sogs rigs las byung / /bu mo rnal 'byor pas spyad de/ /ji ltar sems sun mi 'byin pa/ /de ltar shin tu mdzes par bya/ /sbrang ma skyugs pa 1'dres pa dang / /bshang la sogs dang bsres nga/ yi/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdas nyid mchod/ /ci 'dod bya ba byed pa dang / /ji dga' bar ni spyod pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgrub bya ste/ /gzhan du nges par nyon mongs 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs smyung ba sdom pa dang / /sna tshogs phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i/ /lha yi gzugs su bsgom pa yis2/ /sgrub pa 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dzam gling rdul phran mnyam pa yi/ /gsang sngags bzlas dang bsgom pa la/ /brtson pa che dang ldan gyur kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa dpag med pa'i/ /byis pa rnams kyis rtag 4tshul gyis/ /bde 'gror 5skye ba rnyed dka' na/ /rdo rje sems dpar ji ltar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor gzugs la sogs/ /bcom ldan thub pas gsungs pa ni/ /yang dag ye shes mnyam sbyor gyi6/ /skal ba dang bral bdag nyid la'o/ /gang zhig rang rig ngo bo nyid/ /de nyid rin chen bla med pa/ /lung dang rigs 7pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /gang zhig 'dzin par mi nus pa/ /mi shes rmongs pas kun du khebs/ /spyod pa med pa'i blo can rnams/ /dang po'i las can rnal 'byor te/ /dman pa'i chos kyi snod yin te/ /'gro ba'i mgon gyis de don du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sogs bsgom pa/ /sgu mdog phyag mtshan kun ldan zhing / /phyag rgya'i dkyil tsho0 /06

— doda'akhor de bzhin gsungs/ /gang yang gzhan rkyen khar ma/ nga sa// /zab mo'i ye shes dag gi sgod/ /sdig pa'i grogs dang bdud dang bsesas// /lo sa 'dren rnams kyis mi bskyod pa/ /de la de nyid dag pa ni/ /rtog pa tham/sa/ cad rnam/ spangs pa/ /sems can kun dang tshangs sogs kyis/ /rnam pa kun du ri/ rtogs 1pa'i/ /shin tu rmad byung 2ye shes ni/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos zhi ba dag /tshe 'di nyid la grub byed pa/ /'jig rten mgon gyis gsungs pa yin/ /ye shes grub pa las/ phyag rgya chen po bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //sangs rgyas lnga yi ngo bo las/ /phung po lnga ni rgyal bar bshad/ /khams rnams spyan la sogs yin te/ /de bas sangs rgyas sgur 'dod do/ /de lta yin na srog chags kun/ /srid gsum rtag tu rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyid phyir byang kun dang / /thos dang sgom 4pa don med do/ /'jig rten thams cad sangs rgyas na/ /phongs pa kun kyang mi 'byung la/ /bde dang sdug bsngal sgom 5la sogs/ /gnod pa de la yod ma yin/ /gal te sangs rgyas skur gyur na/ /mngon shes drug la sogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas yon tan 'byor ba yang / /ci phyir de dag med par 'gyur/ /gang yang de ltar mi shes pa / /de ni rdzogs sangs ji ltar 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig de ltar shes pa ni/ /'di ni sangs rgyas 'gyur ba yin/ /gang zhig rim gyis bslabs 6pa yi/ /spyor bas sems ni 'jug 'gyur ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pa ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /gzhan dag sangs rgyas 'grub pa min/ /gal te ngang gis sangs rgyas na/ / bslabs pa dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /rigs par bcas pa goms bya yin/ /26—/07

rigs 1pa med par goms bya min/ /gal te mgon med skye bo 'ga'/ /rgyal por 'gyur ro 2zhes bsgoms pas/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya yis kyang / /'di ni rgyal po thob mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig log pa'i rtog pas ni/ /gang la rgyal po yod min ltar/ /de bzhin log par bsgoms pa yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rgyud rgyal du/ /phung po skye mched la sogs pa/ /de nyid dam tshig skal ldan 4pas/ /de dang de ming gis bstan pa//dri chen rnam snang zhes bshad de/ /gci ba de bzhin rdo rje chu/ /ji ltar mo dbang pad+ma ste/ /ji ltar pho dbang rdo rje yin/ /gang phyir lung dang rigs 5pa yi / /rjes 'brang smra bar mi nus pas/ /de bas gang gis lha yi sku/ /smra bar nus pa ma yin no/ /gal te byas pa'i lha yi gzugs/ /rdo rje sems dpar gyur na go/ /gang phyir 'dus byas las byung bas/ /bum pa la sogs bzhin du 'jig /de bas byang chub spyod pa ni/ /du ma'ang 'bras bu med par 'gyur / /gal te byung nas zhig gyur na/ /bsgom pa nyid ni don cir 'gyur/ /yid kyi rang bzhin byas pa'i gzugs/ /ji ltar 'dus bya 7yin zhes bshad/ /de dang de ni ji ltar 'jig /rmongs pa'i rgya mtsho khyod nyon cig /'di rnams sems kyis brtag pa ste/ /de yang 'dus byas mtshan nyid na/ /yid kyis brtags pa gang yin de/ /mi 'jig 9par ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /phyag dang sku mdog yang dag ldan/ /ji ltar sngon nas rnam bzhugs pa/ /ma byas pa yi lha yi sgu/ /gal te de nyid du bsgom bya/ /ma skyes ngo bor gnas pa ste/ /bsgoms pas dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /de 'dra'i gzugs su ma gyur pas/ /de 'drar —bdag ces bsgoms 1rkapas na/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams gzugs bsgom pa/ /26—/08
