246 dzo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ tre7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga 'i shes pa/247 sna〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/ rngu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gi/ sgyu 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉giphyir/248 shā〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ni/ tre〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ras/ gru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉da ba ni/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sa/thu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rtog sku〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zorabab/ thu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ngajam/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/tsu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sharang rig bye sna〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉med/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rten/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgro /1 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 nye bar/249 tshosna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉girtes/ 〈〈snar 〉7)—sa/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1༷58)

༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ t+tha ti sa mutshwa 2ya/ bod skad du/gnas pa bsdus pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rdo rje kyibye brag smra rnam rig /dbu ma'i rim bzhin gsal ba yi/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med la/ /btud de de nyid bshad par bya/ /kha cig gang zag ces bya smra/ /rtag min mi rtag ma yin zer/ /nam mkha' dang ni 'gogs /pa gnyis/ /'dus ma byas gsum rtag pa yin/ /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ste/ /'gro ba phung po lnga bdag nyid/ /srid pa sdug bsngal bden pa ste/ /de ni 'bras bu shes par bya/ /rgyu ni kun 'byung bden pa ste/ /las dang nyon mongs bdag nyid do/ /bden pa de gnyis zag bcas te/ /phyi ma gnyis ni zag pa med/ /las dang nyon mongs yongs zad nas/ /shin tu'ang 'gogs ltapar gyur pa na/ /dam pa'i rnam thar mngon sum don/ /zhi ba sdug 26—253

bsngal zad pa yin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad de ni/ /goms pas nges par 'byin pa'i mchog /yang dag bstan pa la sogs zhes/ /yan lag brgyad lam thub pas gsungs/ /de nyid nyan thos mya ngan 'das/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi bsgom pa yang / /lung bstan pa la mi ltos par/ /rang gi sngon gyi smon lam gyis/ /don mngon byas nas mya ngan 'das/ /lhag mar bcas pa'i lus kyis 1su/ /bdag nyid chen po de kun nas/ /bdag dang gzhan don nus pa nyid/ /rang gi 'dod pa bsten 2nas su/ /mar rnge ltar yongs mya ngan 'das/ /'di ni 'bring po'i sangs rgyas te/ /bye brag smra ba'i gnas pa'o / /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma//de dag bdag med pa ru ni/ /yang dag shes pa'i yul du byas/ /dam pa'i shes pa gnyis kyis tshul/ /mngon sum dang ni rjes dpag ste/ /yul gyi rang gi mtshan nyid la/ /mngon sum gog tu gyur pa'o/ /yul dang dus ni nyi tshe ba//phra rab rdul dang skad cig mas/ /don gyi bya ba nus pa'i phyir/ /de nyid don dam dngos po yin/ /nam mkha' la sogs lta zhog gi/ /bya ba'i don kun 'dod pa yis/ /tshad ma'i yul du byas nas su/ /de nyid 'dir ni yongs su brtag /'di ltar bum pa la sogs gzugs/ /rtag tu don gyi bya byed pa / /so so'i skad cig de nyid la/ /rang gi dngos po nyid byed pa'o/ /bya ba'i don gcig 5byas nas ni/ /de nyid byed pa ma yin la/ /byed pa byed par mi sbyor te / /byas na de nyid gzhan du 'gyur/ /snga ma'i rang bzhin rnam kun du/ /26—254

skad cig gzhan gyi rjes mi 'jug /skad cig ma yi rgyun 'dra bas/ /mngon shes la sogs so sor gnas/ /da ltar mngon sum gyur pa'i don/ /yongs su gcod 7 pa de bzhin yang / /de ni rnam par gcod pa ste/ /mngon sum las byung bsgom pa yin/ /snang ba rnam par nyams nas ni/ /rgyud gzhan dgod pa ma yin te/ /bskyed pa gzhan ni 'jigs pas ni/ /rang rig rgyu yis 3 nyams par 'gyur/ /phra rab rdul ni 'dus pa las/ /rags pa'i gzugs su mthong ba yi/ /lus la shing dang sa la sogs/ /rags pa cung zad gcig pa min—/ /ji ltar de bzhin bde dang sdug /bum pa la sogs so sor ro /gcig la bskyod dang dmar bas su // /kun bskyod pa dang dmar por 'gyur/ /gcig la g.yo /pyabar gyur pa yis/ /lus kun khyab 'gyur de bzhin no/ /'on kyang cha shas bskyod sogs pas/ /yan lag can la min zhe na/ /yan lag can nyid mi bskyod na/ /ji ltar yul gzhan thob par 'gyur/ /rdul phran 'dus pas cho phyi rol gyi/ /snang ba skad cig gang yin pa/ /shes pa rang gi rnam pa ni/ /skyes pas yul nyid thob par 'gyur/ /de nyid tsam gyi spyod yul kyis / /thams cad mkhyen pa thob min te/ /tshogs pa gcig la rag las pas / /rgyu ni dbang po dang mnyam 'gyur/ / phyed dang ma phyed rnam brtags 6pas / /shes pa'i bye brag skyes don med/ /be+ems po bems 7min rnam brtags pas/ /kun nas skye ba yod ma yin/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po yang / /'di la blo dang ldan pas bsgom/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems / /tshogs ma rdzogs na yod ma yin/ /mngon du byed pa mi bya ste/ /byas na theg pa dman par gyurasgo/ /zab mo'i rim la goms pa yis/ /byang 26—235

chub rtsa ba snying rje yin/ /snying rje rtsa ba rab spyor bas/ /bye brag smra ba'ang de bzhin te/ /zeg chen rim pas goms pa yis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub cis mi 'gyur / /gzhan du mdo sde pas 1rtogs pa'i/ /blo de ji ltar theg chen yin/ /gang phyir dbu ma dang bral bas/ /de la'ang sangs rgyas yod ma yin/ /gnas pa tsam gyi bye brag gis/ /jeg pa nges pa med pa'i phyir/ /shes rab 'ba' zhig dgra bcom dang / /dbu ma pas kyang mthong ba'o/ /theg chen snying rje spyor ba las/ /sbyin sogs lam ni lhag par 'gyur/ /snyug bsngal la sogs bden pa rnams/ /gnas pa'i dbye ba gzhan du 'gyur/ /gal te chung ngu 'bring sogs pa'i/ /dbye ba phye ste rab brtags nas/ /de ni so so rnam pa dgu / /de ni theg pa gnas par phye/ /mdo sde pa yi gnas pa bsdus — / /rdul phran cha shas med pa'i phyir/ /phan tshun yang dag spyor ba med/ /thams cad 'bral med bdag nyid pas/ /rags pa cung zad tsam yang med/ /dbang po las 'das rang rgyud pas/ /'dus pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /gal te rags pa'i chos kyi don/ /shes pa ji ltar dngos med 'gyur/ /phye dang ma phye rab brtags pas/ /don gyi chos de med pa ste/ /phra mo'i dbye bas bye /hūṃb ni / /rdzas de ji ltar rags pa yin/ /dngos dang dngos med 'gal bas na//phye dang ma phye gcig pa med/ /'gul dang mi 'gul sogs skyon pas/ /gcig la'ang cha shas yod ma yin/ /phyogs dang snam sogs bye brag gis/ /sgrub 4 pa'i don la nges pa med/ /gang phyir 'di don dngos med de/ /rmi lam gzugs brnyan la sogs bzhin/ /sngon po la sogs don med phyir/ /rnam 26—256

par shes pa 'thad ma yin/ /sna tshogs rnam par snang bas na/ /ji srid sngo sogs gcig pa min/ /phan tshun 'thad pa ma yin pas/ /rnam shes sna tshogs ma yin no/ /bag chags stobs kyis gzung ba dang / /'dzin pa lta bur phye ba'i phyir/ /snang ba'i bye brag sngon po sogs/ /bden min 'khrul pas rnam pa rnged / /'gro ba rnam rig tsam du ni/ /de bzhin bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs—/ /de ltar bus pas rnam brtags pa'i/ / phyi rol don ni yod ma yin / /lhabag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du rab tu snang bar 'jug /rnam pa med par mos pa yis / /gsum po dmigs pa med pa ste/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /so sor 'khor gsum rtse gcig bya/ /thos dang bsams pa las byung dang / /bsgoms 4pa las skyes shes rab ni/ /bsam gtan las skyes rnal 'byor gyis/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de gsungs pa/ /sems tsam la ni brten nas su/ / pha rol don du mi brtag srigo/ /de bzhin nyid la gnas bcas nas/ /sems can 'ulas kyang 'brang 7bar bya/ /sems tsam nyid la 'das nas su/ /snang ba med las 'da' bar bya/ /snang med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /des ni theg pa chen po mthong / /'jug pa lhun gyis grub cing zhi/ /smon lam rnam par dag nas ni/ /ye shes dam pa bdag med pa/ /snang ba med pa mthong ba yin / /zhes gsungs so/ /sna tshogs gsal ba de nyid kun du brtags pa sdug bsngal te/ /kun 'byung gi 8ni bag chags gzhan gyi dbang gis 9rang bzhin no/ /sbyin pa la sogs lam nyid yongs su rdzogs pa 'gog pa ste/ /sdogs par yongs su grub pa rnam med rnam par rig pa tsam/ /rnal 'byor 26—257

spyod pa'i lam rnam pa med pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa'o// //gang gang cung zad snang ba ni/ /de de sems la shin tu gsal/ /ji ltar de bzhin rmi lam sems/ /gzugs la sogs pa so sor snang / /ji ltar so sor snang ba'i sems/ /bag chags la ni rnam gnas pa/ /ci ste don med rnam shes ni/ /dze+e ltar gzhan las shes par 'gyur/ /don gyi snang ba'i phyi rol na/ /bse ru lta bur thub pas gsungs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa stong par ni / /snang med pa dag 'dod pa yin/ /rnam shes so sor snang bas na/ /sngon po la sogs don me+ed de/ /de phyir kun gyis 7rnam pa bsgom/ /mi rtog snying rje chen po yin/ /kun 'byung bag chags bstan pa ni/ /sbyin pa la sogs bag chags spang 2/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'gog pa yang sna tshogs gnyis su med pas mthong / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa stong pa nyid/ /gsal bar byed pa'i chos sku las/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa 'phro/ /gzung ba la sogs med pa'i dngos/ /snang ba'i bag chags yod ma yin/ /de bzhin gnyis ka yod 4ma yin/ /gzugs las gzhan du mi rtog 5go/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /dngos po 'di ni med pa min/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin yang / /ye shes rang rig nyams myong yin/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i las rnam pa dang bcas pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa'o// //mu stegs sangs rgyas par ma btus/ /gsum ni med par mi 'dod 26—258

pas / /legs shing mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /med par gnas pa'i spyig pa yin / /dbu ma chen po'i rang bzhin nyid/ /gnas pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /btud de gnas pa zad byed nyid/ /lung dang rigs 1pas bshad par bya/ /khams rnams nyid las grub pa gang / /rkyen las skyes pa skad cig ma/ /gcig dang du ma dang bral bas/ /de nyid dngos po med pa 2yin / /de yang lus la rkang lag dang / /mgo dang rgyab sogs phye ba las/ /lag pa la sogs gcig kyang med/ /so sor phye bas byung ba yin/ /ji srid de yi cha phye ste/ /rdul phran rnam par dpyad pa ni/ /lus po nyid ni bshad pa las / /rten dang brten pa la sogs shes/ /gcig gi dngos po bkag pas na//du ma'ang yod pa ma yin no/ /rmi lam dang ni mnyam gnas par/ /sngon du bkag pa nyid kyis 4min/ /shes pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /rig pa nyid dang 'gal ba min/ /gang phyir spyi yi gtan tshigs kyis/ /brjod pa dam pa'i tshul thuyin no / /khukun rdzob don byed nus pa yi/ /sna tshogs 'di ni rang bzhin med/ /de ni shes dang shes bya nyid/ /kho bos ci zhig yongs su brtag /gzugs sogs so sor snang ba nidz+wa/ /de nyid rnam par shes pa la/ /de ltar sgrub thabs lta bu stecho/ /blo ldan rigs 9pas mi 'grub med/ /kun rdzob tu ni skye ba dang ⑫/ /de ni skye ba med pa'i don/ /de phyir skye ba med pa'i sems / /rang bzhin med pa'i phyir bzhin no/ /skye ba grub pas yod pa yin/ /yod pa yin pas med pa'ang med/ /rgyu yi dngos po med pas na/ /rang bzhin gzhan las skye ba min/ /ji ltar gzugs brnyan 'byung ba ltar/ /bden min brdzun pa ma yin gzugs/ /de nyid chos rnams thams cad de/ /26—259

rang bzhin rig pa rnams kyi lugs/ /'dus pa mkhar dang gos la sogs/ /brtsams pa kun rdzob dngos po ste/ /'di ni rang bzhin ma skyes pas/ /'dus pa nyid kyang de bzhin no/ /de phyir bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis/ /'gro ba 'di dag ming tsam gsungs/ /gzhan gyis smras pa 'di dag kun/ /bdag gis legs par brjod pa yin/ /phyogs ni snga mar brjod pa dag / 'di ni blo gros rnam par gsal/ / tūde yi blo gros bsal nas su/ /rang gi phyogs ni bdag gis bshad/ /ji ltar me long la gzugs brnyan/ /gcig dang gzhan nyid spangs pa ltar/ /snang las gzhan na yod min te/ /de ltar dngos po'i rang bzhin no/ /'jig rten sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni rnam par spangs / /rtag tu rgyun med par snang bas/ /rnam par rtog pa mi 'jug go/ /gang la dngos po yod min pas/ /sems tsam du ni rtogs par bya/ /ji ltar dngos po med pa'i sems/ /sems tsam du ni rigs pa min/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i bye brag gis/ /gal te sems ni 'jug pa nazhe/ /'jig rten pa yi sems 'di dag /sems tsam du ni mi rigs so/ /lus dang longs spyod dbang po ni/ /gal te rmi lam ltar skyes na/ /sems ni gnyis su 'gyur ba ste//sems kyi mtshan nyid gnyis min no/ /gang phyir ji ltar ral gri'i so/ /ji ltar rang gi mdzub rtse yis / /mi chod pa dang mi reg pa/ /de bzhin sems nyid rang snang ba'o/ /gzugs brnyan bzhin du snang ba'i sems/ /sngon du goms par gyur pa'i blos/ /ji ltar 'byung ba rnam par mthong / /don gyi rnam pa don yod min/ /gang zag rgyu dang phung po dang / /de bzhin rkyen dang rdul phran dang / /gtso bo dbang phyug byed pa po/ /sems tsam po la rnam 26—260

par brtags/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa ste/ /don gzhan med pa'i sems nyid do/ /rigs lku/pas yid la brtags nas ni/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa 'gog pa'o/ /blo yis du byernam par gzhig snyen ni/ /rang bzhin nges par gzung du med/ /de ni brjod du med pa'i phyir/ /dngos po med par bstan pa yin/ /yid la blo yis ④rnam brtags na/ /gzhan dbang med cing kun brtags med/ /yongs su grub pa'i dngos med na/ /ji ltar blo yis 'u/rnam par dpyad/ /rang bzhin med cing rig byed med/ /dngos med gzhi yang yod ma yin/ /nus pa ro dang mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /rtog ge ngan pas 'di dag brtags/ /dngos po mtshan ma rnam rig go/ /yid log g.yo ba gang yin las/ /nga yi lus rnams 'das nas su/ /rnam par mi rtog pa yis 'uspyod/ /de bzhin nyid dang stong nyid mtha'/ /mya ngan 'das dang chos kyi dbyings/ /skye ba med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /dam pa'i don kyi rang bzhin no/ /phyi rol dngos dang dngos med de—/ /sems kyis tsuyongs su gzung ba med/ /lta ba thams cad spangs pa gang / /skye ba med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gang phyir tshogs pa'i rkyen yod na/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog par 'gyur/ /tshogs pa so sor gyur na ni/ /skye ba med cing 'gag pa med/ /yod med dngos po skye ba med/ /sems ni yod min med pa min/ /gang phyir las gzhan 'dus pa las/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa min/ /gang tshe 'jig rten 'di dag kun/ /'dus pa nyid ni mthong ba ste/ /tshogs pa tsam po 'di nyid ni/ /de tshe sems la mnyam par gnas/ /gang la cung zad skye med pas/ /dgag trepa cung zad yod ma yin/ /de ni yod dang med min te/ /'gro 'di brjod du rnged par blta'o9/ /zung du 'jug pa 26—261

yongs shes na/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje che/ /mkhas pas kun rdzob de nyid kyang / /mi spang bar ni spyad par bya/ /gang phyir kun rdzob log na ni/ /de phyir de nyid ci yang med/ /kun rdzob nyid kyis skye ba gang / /de nyid skye ba sped pa'i don/ /'di ni zung 'jug mtshan 7nyid de/ /rkyen las skyes pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de bzhin nyid dang chos kyi dbyings/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mchog /yang dag mtha' dang skye ba med/ /mi dmigs pa dang mya ngan 'das / /stong nyid mtshan ma med pa dang / /smon pa med dang 'dus ma byas/ /rmi lam sgyu ma la sogs dpe/ /de nyid rgyal ba rnams kyis bsgrubs/ /theg chen 'di ni mchog yin te/ /nges don mdo sder bsdus pa yi/ /mdo sde lta zhing nyan pa la/ /'di ltar 'bad pas bsam par bya/ /snying rje sems can la bskyed de/ /byang chub sems ni brtson byas nas/ /byang chub sdom gnas brtson chen pos/ /rang bzhin med pa bsgom par bya/ /'phags pa'i lam brgyad la gnas te/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs la 'bad/ /mkhas rnams gang phyir bden gnyis gnyis med 'dis/ /ji ltar de nyid don de chad pa lta bur ni/ /mngon sum grub pa skye dang 'gag pa'i snod yin te/ /gal te don skyes rnam par nyams pa'i skyon yin no/ /gang phyir ji ltar me long nang du gzugs brnyan mthong / /rigs pas brtags pa'i stobs kyis de med de mthong med/ /phyi yi don med 'di yang med de rnam pa sna tshogs sems/ /'on kyang rten 'byel dag la rigs 4pas 'gal ba med/ /'di ni dbu ma'i gnas su 5bsnyus pa'o/ /26—262

de ltar mtha' bzhi rnam spangs pa/ /brtags te brtan par byas nas su/ /skye ba med cing gnas pa med/ /'gag pa med cing mtshan nyid med/ /rang rig rkyen las skyes pa ste/ /de nyid pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi rang bzhin lung / /sngags kyi tshul la bsten 7nas su/ /bla ma'i khyad par myong ba yinake / /ma brtags par yang som nyi med/ /stong pa nyid ni rang rig ste/ /thabs dang shes rab bde chen po/ /'bras gnas bzhin du rtsod pa med/ /byang chub sems ni rnam par bsgom/ /de skad du yang / gsang sngags tshul de shes pa yis/ /sngags kyi lugs kyi khyad par gsungs/ /don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba rnged pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi bstan bcos khyad par 'phags/ /gang phyir stong pa rig bye snapa nyid/ /ye shes rang bzhin skad cig ma/ /gang phyir rdo rje sems dpar nges/ /phung po de bzhin gshegs par rtogs/ /rigs 7pa'i stobs kyis gzhag pa gang / /ma brtags pa ru spyor ba don/ /ci ste yongs su brtag bral ba/ /sngags kyis byetshul dang bral na ni/ /rnam pa kun du dpe med nakhu / /zag pa med pa'i bde ba che/ /lha yi nga rgyal blta 3byas pa/ ji ltar stong nyid nyams su myong / /las kyi phyag rgya legs grub nas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya rab phye bas/ /phan tshun re ba med na ni/ /dam tshig 'bras bu ji ltar yin / /thabs ni mang po rnams kyis su/ /nyams su myong ba'i khyad par dang / /las dang chos dang phyag rgya che/ /dbye ba gzhan du ji ltar yin/ /shin tu dbang po rnon po yis/ /stong nyid nyams su myong ba yang 8/ /bde chen mngon par byang chub la/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /der ni shin tu bde 26—263

ba nyid/ /de ltar thabs kyi dngos po yis/ /dang phyapo'i dus la goms pa las//gzhan du ji ltar dka' ba min/ /pha rol phyin pa kun bdag nyid/ /bsgom pa'i stobs ni rdzogs pa naldu/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub grub zhupa la/ /dbang po rnon pos cis mi 'grub/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rtogs pa'o/ /e baṃ las ④ni phyag byas nas/ /phyag rgya'i rang bzhin mdor bsdus pa/ /sngags kyi theg pa bshad par bya / / phyoshes rab sprul pa'i gzugs can ma/ /las kyi phyag rgya bdag med nyid/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi las/ /ye shes gtso bo'i rang bzhin no/ /gang phyir de las shes pa gang / /dga' ba la sogs rim skyes pa//dbus su rnam par shes pa ste/ /de ni shes rab ye shes brjod/ /rnam bcas dang ni rnam pa rnged/ /de bzhin dbu ma'i rtog dupa'o/ /ji ltar mos pa'i ye shes ni/ /man ngag gis ni thob par 'gyur/ /gsum pa'i lhan cig skyes par rtogs / /btsan thabs dbang gis bzhi pa ste/ /rlung gi bkod pas sna rtse la//mi 'gyur ba yi sbyor ba yin/ /ji lta ji ltar bde ye shes/ /thabs kyis rab tu bsgrub pa yin/ /de lta de ltar rtogs pa ste/ /rtog pa lhan cig skyes pa mchog /gang phyir 'bras bu 'dra ba'i dbang / /btsan thabs lhan cig skyes par 'dod/ /yun ring 3dus su 'bral med gnas/ /ma bcos pa yi tshogs yin no/ /de gsungs pa/ dga' ba khu ba 'bab pa ste/ /gtsug tor smin phrag pad+ma'i tshal du//mgrin pa snying gar mchog dga' ste/ /de nas dga' ba bral bar 'gyur/ /sna tshogs rol mos lte ba nas/ /ji srid gsang ba'i pad+mar son/ /de srid gsang ba'i nor bu nas/ /ma 'phros 6bar du lhan cig skyes/ /mi gnas pa yi mya ngan 'das/ /'dod chags chen po'i khyab bdag gtso/ /ma 'phros bde ba 26—264

chags bral te/ /'di ni mya ngan 'das par gnas/ /chags bral las ni sdig pa med/ /bde ba mchog las bsod nams med/ /de phyir mi 'gyur bde ba'i sems / /rtag tu der nyuganas mos par bya/ /'pho ba las ni chags bral 'byung / /chags bral las ni snyug bsngal 'byung / /sbug bsngal bas ni khams zad de/ /khams zad pas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /shi nas de dag bzhin dudu'ang 'byung / /srid par 'ching zhing skye ba ste/ /de phyir 'bad pas thams cad kyis/ /chags pa dor ba rnam par spangs/ /chags bral 'dod ldan ma yin te/ /'dod pa'i sbyor thabs 'di 5'dod na/ /nga yis d+nghabastan pa rgyun du yang / /ci ste rnal 'byor snyug bsngal bskyed/ /bde ba mi 'gyur rang bzhin gyis/ /mi 'gyur mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /rten ni shor bar gyur pa yis / /rten snyepa chags dang bral ba yin/ /spyi bor rgyas pa'i thig le ni/ /shes rab chags las zhu bar 'gyur/ /gang bar gnas pa'i go 'phang ni/ /bcings pa dam pa'i don yin no/ /ji ltar zla ba 'char ba'i rimathu 'phel ba'i dus kyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems bskyed rim pa ni/ /'phel ba'i dus kyis rdzogs pa yin/ /de ni gtsug thunas byung nas su/ /rdo rje nor bu gang bar 'gyur/ /de ni chags dang bral na nyams/ /rdo rje rtse mor rab rgyas 'gyur/ /bde chen rang bzhin 'di nyid ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sgra yis bstan pa yin/ /rdzogs pa mi bskyod gyur pa yin8/ /skad cig gcig mngon sgogs byang chub/ /ji ltar chu yi 6chu sna tshogs/ /rgya mtsho chen por ro mnyam 'gyur / /de bzhin dngos po sna tshogs kyang / /mi 'gyur ba der nyams par 'gyur / /ji ltar khams rnams 'dus pa nyid/ /gang zhig dngul chus phug 26—265

pa ltar/ /dngos po sna tshogs 'di dag kyang / /mi 'gyur mchog gis za ba yin / /mi 'gyur mchog gi bdag nyid kyis/ /rnam pa kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin / /stong pa las skyes dngos po rgyu/ /mi 'gyur las skyes bde 'bras bu//rgyu la nyu'abras bu bde rgyas btab/ /'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas btab/ /stong nyid dngos po 'dzin pa'i 37rgyu/ /mi 'gyur snying rje 'dzin pas 'bras/ /byang chub sems de ma 'phos sgon/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes pas/ /'byung ba zad par mi 'gyur te/ /sna tshogs 'di ni rang bzhin med/ /dngos dang dngos med mtshan nyid gcig /yul dang dbang po'i sgo yis su/ /sems ni rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin te/ /gzhan du sbrul gyis zos pa yi/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba rig pa min/ /ji ltar lcags kyi phyogs gcig na/ /gang phyir gser 'gyur rtsi gnas pa/ /'bar ba'i me yis bsregs na ni/ /thams cad gser du 'gyur ba yin/ /de bzhin sems kyi phyogs gcig tu'ang / /mi 'gyur bde la legs gnas pa/ /'dod pa'i me yis rab bsregs nas/ /thams cad bde bar gyur pa yin/ /ji ltar lcags ni gser gyur na/ /nam yang nag por 'gyur ba min/ /de bzhin sems nyid rtogs pa yang / /nam yang bag chags 'gyur ba min/ /gang phyir me yis yesbyangs pa'i gser/ /lcags su gyur pa ma yin no/ /de bzhin phyir zhing phyir zhing sems/ /'dod chags me yis 7dri ma med/ /'dir mang smra ba ci zhig dgos—/ /'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa la/ /lcags ni 'gyur bar byed pa yi / /rtsi yi rang bzhin bsam mi khyab/ /don dam par ni rab brtags na/ /glo bur dri mas gos 7pa yi/ /sems nyid rtogs par gyur pa na/ /ye shes 26—266

rang bzhin smos ci dgos/ /ji ltar rtsi yis snabasgyur ba'i lcags/ /lcags kyi rjes su 'gro ba min/ /de bzhin bde bas bsgyur ba'i sems/ /sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur ba min/ /zhes so/ /yang gsungs pa/ rdo rje dbyings phyug ma yi rtsa/ /bha ga'i dbus na rnam par gnas/ /'bad pas nye bar thob nas su/ /bla ma'i bka' la goms pa yis/ /mdzub mo cung zad bskyod 3pa yis phyi nang 1lce dang rdo rje yis/ /rtsa de rgyas par gyur pa las/ /mchog tu bde ba rab tu 'bab/ /pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa ste/ /stobs dang dbang po rnams dang ldan/ /sa bcu las ni 'das nas su/ /de la 4rtags su gyur pa med/ /ces so/ /yang gsungs pa/ gang tshe ye shes mthong ba ni/ /rnal 'byor pa ni bde bar gnas/ /'gyur med thun nas zhag gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo gcig gam/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa stong du 'am/ /ye shes mngon par sbyor bas gnas/ /yang gsungs pa/ ji srid rnal 'byor byang chub sems/ /gtong bar byed pa ma yin pas/ /de srid rgyun mi 'chad pa 'thob/ /dga' ba las skyes bde ba yi/ /byang chub sems de lhang gyur na/ /dngos grub kun gye gter yin pas/ /rnam shes phung po brgyal 'gyur nas/ /dngos grub ma smad ga la yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /las dang dam tshig phyag rgya yi/ /dus su lhan cig skyes pa rtogs/ /chos kyi phyag rgya phyag rgya che/ /gnyis ni lhan cig skyes pa mchog /byang sems bral na bde ba yin5/ /brgya lam na yang mi 'thob po/ /bde chen nyid ni ma gtogs 6pa/ /nam yang gsang sngags jeg pa med/ /shes rab ye shes thob pas na/ /las kyi phyag rgya lhan cig skyes/ /tha ma 'bring sogs dbye ba yis7/ /de nyid rang bzhin dkyil 'khor bsgom/ /26—267

las kyi phyag rgya snyoms 'jug ngh+rupas/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya /tha mas bskyed pa bsgom pa ste/ /las kyi yan lag dang bral 'bring / /rab kyis kyang ni bsam bya ba/ /myur du rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /chos kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa ni/ /tha mas rtsa dang yi ge rim/ /gtum mo'i bye brag 'bring gis so/ /mi shigs pa ni rab ekyis te/ /thig le phra sogs rnal 'byor pas/ /bsdus pa rig par 'dod pa yin/ /rab kyi tha mas bsgom bya na/ /khams gsum po ni gzhal yas khang / /sems can rnams ni dkyil 'khor pa/ /rnal 'byor pa ni dkyil 'khor bdag /de bshad pa/ 'di ni gnas gsum ma yin gzhal yas khang pa yin/ /srog chags ma yin 'di ni rgyal ba yin/ /'khor lo'i bdag po nga yin dbang po ma yin te/ /sa la sogs pa'ang ma yin gzugs la sogs pa'ang min/ /chos nyid bdag nyid de nyid des na dkyil 'khor pa yang yin/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shes na ci ste 'khrul par byed/ /ces bstan to/ /khams bzhi dang ni phung po dag /lha mo ye shes he ru kas/ /'khor lo rgyas btab de bzhin nyid/ /rab kyi 'bring po'i bsgom bya ba/ /sna tshogs bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /thabs dang shes rab stobs kyis su/ /zung 'jug lhun gyis grub pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bsdus pa nyid/ /sems ni rtog med sbyor bas kyang / /sems de nyid ni brtag mi bya/ /kun nas thams cad mchog yin te/ /rnam med zhudabang po'i yul las 'das/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol zhing / /mtha' bzhi dag ni mnyam par brten/ /sna tshogs sgro btags gnas pa med/ /26—268

chags med bde ba chen po nyid/ /'bras bu de nyid mi mthun phyogs/ /brtags pa de nyid ma brtags pa'o/ /de rkyen thob pas skye ba ste/ /skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /bems 1po med de rang rig pas/ /mi shes pa dang ma mthong ba/ /brtags pas nam mkha' dngos med de/ /de ni mi 'gyur brtan pa'o—/ /chad pa min pas dngos med min/ /skye ba med pas 3/rang bzhin nyid/ /kun rdzob las skyes dngos po ste/ /chos rnams thams cad lhan cig skyes/ /gnyug ma'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin nyid/ /bdag byin brlabs snepas rang byung ste / /mi nyams pas na mi shigs pa'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya phyag rgya che/ /gnyis med mos pas ldan pa'o/ /dbang po mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ /rab kyi yang ni rab yin no/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu dbyer med pas/ / sgom pa'i rig ④ pa bdag la med/ /ji ltar bskyed pas nyams myong bas/ /dran dang dran pa nyams pa nyid rngo/ /ma skyes pa yi ro tshor bas/ /de bzhin bsgom pa'ang rtogs pa'o—/ /gang phyir shes rab bsgom pa yis/ /stong nyid so sor rtogs pa yin/ /dpal ldan dgyes rdor sogs rgyud du/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsal bar gsungs / /chos rnams thams cad yongs shes na6/ /bsgom pa nyid ni bsgom ljopa min/ /gang phyir bdag byin brlab rim des/ /zung 'jug rim pa'ang de bzhin no/ /bde chen mngon par rdzogs byang chub/ /de bzhin phyag rgya chen po mchog /chos kyi de nyid rig pa yis/ /ngal bar gyur pa ma yin te she / /chos kyi de nyid la bzhugs phyir/ /de yis 9'byed par rab tu bstan/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis/ /gsal bar gyur 7gyi gzhan du min/ /'di la gzhan gyis bstan pa yis/ /don rtogs pa ni ma yin no/ /chos 'byung las 26—269

—byas ye shes ni/ /ji bzhin 'di la rtogs par 1gsungs/ /rang gi mos pas tshig gi don/ /gzung ba dngos nyid ma yin no/ /de bzhin bzhi po thams cad kyang / /'di la sogs pa gsungs pa ni/ /ji ltar de bzhin sku bzhi pa'o//bla ma dam pa'i thabs kyis gsal/ /stong nyid bde ba dngos po ste/ /bde ba bde ba chen por 'dod/ /bde ba ro mnyam bde ba nyid/ /lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku/ /de nyid bde ba'i don byed pas/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa yang / /rnam pa lnga yi ro de nyid/ /thams cad gnyug mar bye brag med/ /ces pa dang / sangs rgyas sgu lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes pa la sogs gsungs pa yang / /sku lnga thob par gyur pa ni/ /de nyid ro gcig pa yi tshul/ /sgu bzhi ru ni rnam phye ba/ /dbyer med pas na rnam lnga pa'osri/ /de nyid tsam du gcig pa 'di/ /sku yang de ltar 'dod pa yin/ /ji ltar 'di ni bdag gi blos / /so sor rig pa mnyam 1par 'jug /dam chos yul la shes rab kyis/ /ji ltar blo gos kyis thob ltar/ /'di ni cung zad brjod pa las/ /ji ltar 'byung 4ba'i don rtogs pa/ /'gro rnams de yi snod du shog /gnas pa basbus pa rdzogs so// //slob dpon chen po dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa bla ma dha ri shrī dz+nyā na'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ltab rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o / /6phyis bar ston gyes zhus nas bla ma rgya gar ba dang / mtshur lo tsā bas dpe phyi mo la gtugs te gtan la phab pa'o 26—270

༄/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/1༄na / /rgya gar skad du/ /a tsin+ta kra ma u pa de sha nā man/ bod skad du/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rim pa'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab mchog gi mngal nas byung / /gdod nas gnyis med gnas pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bzang po'i zhal snga yi/ /yang dag rim 'ong bri bar bya/ /thabs dang shes rab gsang ba che/ /snying rje bsam mi khyab mtshan nyid/ /ngag gi spyod yul bsam las 'das/ /ye shes rang las 'char bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin bde ba'i 'byung gnas nyid/ /rang byung choganyis su med pa'i mchog /de ni dngos po'i rang bzhin du/ /bltas te bsgom pa dmigs su med/ /byang sems rdo rje can bcas pas/ /dngos po med pas gzigs mi 'gyur/ /rtag dang chad pa'i bye brag dag /don dam du ni gnyis 26—273

rnged gzigs/ /dngos po dang ni stong pa nyid/ /gnyis su med par mnyam par bsgom/ /gnyis po 'di dag yod min pas/ /rnam pa thams cad gnyis su med/ /gnyis po dag ni rnam dpyad rten/ /gnyis med ye shes 'char bar 'gyur / /mnyam pa ro mnyam rnam 2pa ste/ /bsam kyis mi khyab ye shes mchog/rtog dang brtag pa'i spyor ba yis/ /gnyis rnged mchog ni bsgom pa min/ /bde ba'i rdo rje mi rtog pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab kyis thob 'gyur/ /bskyed pa rnam par rtog pa'i rgyu/ /mi skye ba yang de bzhin no/ /gnyis kyi rnam pa dang bral bas/ /bag chags bag chags ldan par spangs/ /ye shes bag chags dang bral bas/ /bzang po'i zhabs kyi rim kyis 'ong 4/ /rang byung khrem gnyer med pa ni/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos dang dngos rnged rang bzhin gyis/ /gnyis kyi bag chags 'ching ba nyid/ /mi rtog pa yi rang bzhin gyis/ /bsam emi khyab pa 67nyid kyis dpyod —/ /rtog pa'i dri ma 'dra ba yis/ /rin chen sems ni dri dwacan byas/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes nyid / /dri ma bral phyir sangs rgyas brjod/ /thams cad rtog tshemed bdag nyid du/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rkurtag tu blta/ /ting 'dzin bsgom pa 'di nyid ni / /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan/ /rang spyogi rang bzhin ma skyes la/ /'jig pa nyid rgo yod ma yin/ /ye shes de ni gnyis med min/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje can/ /mi rtog don skyed sabyed pa po/ /phyi rol nang gi rnam rtog gis⑫/ /'jig rten thams cad yang dag bstan7/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyis/ /rtog pa phyi rol nyid du bstan/ /gnyis med gnyis las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes rang nyid skye 26—274

bar 'gyur/ /dngos po med par bsgom pa min/ /dngos por yang ni bsgom pa min/ /'jig pa med pa'i bde bsams na/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis med gnas/ /sems can kun gyi bsam pa gang / /shes rab mngal na rnam par gnas/ /snying rje sad pa'i mda' yis ni/ /bde ba chen po'i 'ben la 'bigs / /dogs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /gnyis su med cing mchog tu zhi/ /mkha' mnyam rnam rtog las grol ba/ /de nyid gnyis su med par brjod / /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor gyis/ /dngos po thams cad rnam par bsgom/ /chos kyi zhal snga'i rim 'ong hūṃni/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs / /rnam pa'i dbye ba gnyis med la/ /dpal ldan mgon po bde ba che / /gcig tu gyur pa'i rang bzhin las/ /'gro ba rnams ni rnam par sprul//stong pa dmigs pa smra ba yis/ /brdzun du smra bas bslus pa rnams/ /rnam rtog rmongs pa'i 'ching ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa gnyis mi rtogs/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam dag las/ /phyi rol rtog pa ngan pa'i rtags༄ —/ /gnyis sped ye shes rnal 'byor che/ /bde ba chen po gcig nyid du/ /brtan 4dang g.yo ba'i dngos po kun/ /gnyis su med pa'i rnam par gnas/ /de rnams rang bzhin rnam dag cing / /mkha' ltar dri med gnyis med la/ /nga rgyal gyis ni tha snyad brtags/ /tha snyad de yang yod ma yin/ /tshor dang tshor po mtshon bya thubral/ /gnyis med bde ba chen po nyid/ /gang yang bsam med rang bzhin phyir/ /sangs rgyas blo yi spyod yul min/ /thams cad de yi rang bzhin nyid/ /rang byung 6bsam pa rnams las 'das/ /sa steng ④srog chags thams cad ni/ /rtog pa'i dra bas nyams par 'gyur/ /ye shes gcig pu 26—275

gnyis med pa/ /rnam par rtog pa rnam spangs pa/ /rtag dang chad pa ji snyed pa'i—/ /phung po gnyis ni yod min pas/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs pa'i//gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /gnyis dang gnyis med rnam rtog ste/ /thabs dang shes rab rnal 'byor che/ /ro gcig gnyis su med par brjod/ /'dod chags 'dod chags bral ba spangs/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro//rang rig pa yi bde ba nyid/ /de nyid gnyis su med par brjod/ /mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid rnam par grol/ /rig pa po dang rig bya spangs/ /bdag med so sor rtog 3pa yis/ /rin chen sems ni rab rtogs byas/ /dngos po rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /dngos med nyid kyang mthong mi 'gyur/ /dbang po'i shes pas rtogs pa yis/ /gnyis med ye shes ngo mtshar che/ /spros pa thams cad rnam bral zhing / /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /rtog pa'i dra ba kyernam gcod cing / /bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis med mchog /gnyis med bcud kyis phug pas na/ /rdo dang shing yang de yi dngos/ /lha yi rnam par 'gyur ba ni/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs/ /thabs dang shes rab snying rje che / /gabyug tu ro gcig rnam pa nyid/ /der ni ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /gnyis rnged bde ba chen po nyid/ /gzugs dang sgra dang ro las 'das/ /dri dang reg bya la sogs spangs/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dge/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /dogs pa kun las rnam par grol/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /rang bzhin rnam dag ma gos pa/ /gnyis med don ni dam pa'o/ /ma skyes pa dang mi 'jigs pa/ /mi 'gyur ba dang mi gnas pa/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /'di ni phyag rgya chen 26—276

po nyid/ /yon tan rnams dang skyon rnams ni/ /sems kyi rnam par brjod pa ste / /de la dmigs pa ye shes mchog /khrem gnyer med pa'i rang bzhin can//ye shes rang las skye bar 'gyur/ /cung zad kyang ni bsgom pa med/ /gang phyir bsam med chos 'di nyid/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas/ /shin tu dri med ches dag cing / /sgom pa po dang bsgom bya spangs/ /dpal ldan bde ba'i 'byung gnas kun/ /rnam rtog med pas nges mthong 'gyur/ /lha yi gzugs ni du ma dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs sku/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor pa phyayi dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad dang / /de bzhin rig pa'i lha mo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bzang po ru/ /snang ba'i rnam pa dri med nyid/ /de bzhin mdo sde'i 1sde snod dang / /gzhan yang pha rol phyin rim dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya rig pa dang / /de bzhin snying nyid bskul ba dang / /sngags kyi smra ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni sbyin sreg dang / /bzlas dang mchod pa'i cho ga rnams/ /gnyis med las ni rang nyid skyes/ /zhi ba nyi ma kyelta ba dang ④//de bzhin mchod 'os khyab 'jug pa/ /rig byed tshad mar smra ba dang / /gzhan yang rang bzhin 'a skye bar 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen gnas kyi sbyor ba 'di/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mi rtog ⑥pa/ /kun du bzang po zhes bya'i lha/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /sa 'og ral gri ril bu dang / /shing lham bum pa gnod sbyin mo/ /bcud dang mig sman bzang po yang / /rang nyid 'grub ste gzhan du min/ /sngags pas dngos po bsgom bya min/ /dngos med nyid kyang bsgom bya min/ /rnam par mi rtog mos pa yis/ /thams cad rang nyid skye 26—277

bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid 1kyang 'grub 'gyur na/ /zhi ba khyab 'jug sogs ci smos/ /de la tha snyad yod ma yin/ /gzugs dang kha dog mtshan nyid med/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'dzin bzang mo nyid/ /dang po'i rang bzhin dri ma med / /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam dag ste/ /rtag tu dga' bde'i 'byung gnas nyid/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dang bral/ /me long me lce 'bar ba 'dra / /mchog dga'i bde ba rnam pa ste/ /rtag tu bde chen 'byung ba'o/ /yi ge dang ni ming brjod pa/ /sbyor ba'i 3snatshig tu rab tu bstan/ /gzhan du ngag gi lam 'das phyir/ /smra ba nyid de mi nus so/ /bya ba'i tshul la zhugs pa yin / /'dod pa'i don la rol pa yi/ /mchod pa bhe mchog gi dus su ni/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan/ /shes rab gnyis su med pas ni/ /gcig pu'i rnam pa'i rang bzhin las/ /bag chags zad par gyur pas na④/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni nges par 'thob/ /sna tshogs rigs kyi mthu yis ni/ /lta ba sna tshogs spyor ba las/ /bag chags dri ma bsags pas ni/ /gnyis med nyid ni rtogs pa min/ /thog mtha' dbus dang mtha' ma bral/ /bskyed pa dang ni sdogs pa spangs/ /bsam dang sems pa dang bral ba/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /gnyis med ces bya sangs rgyas su/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs/ /de phyir sangs rgyas rtogs pa las/ /sgrub po dam pa sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /tshig gi sbyor ba bstan pas thun/ /sangs rgyas dang ni gnyis med brtags6/ /don dam tha dad med tshul gyis/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas gnyis su me+ed/ /bstan pa'i ye shes 'char bas na/ / rtogs pa'i 7rtog pa ring spangs te/ /dngos po la sogs rtog pa kun/ /de nyid las ni sgog tu 26—278

gyur / /bzang po'i 7zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ / nyams pa gso ba'i 2spyor ba las/ /gnyis med ming du gzung ba la/ /bdag ma 'byor ba bye /bzod par mdzodad+ngha / /mkhas pas rab tu 'bad pas kyang / /bag chags rnams ni zad par byas/ /gzhan du bskal pa grangs med du/ /bye ba sangs rgyas nyid ma yin//ye shes gnyis med mgon pos ni/ /bag chags rnams ni zad par byed/ /bag chags zad par gyur pa na/ /gnyis su rnged pa'i sangs rgyas brjod/ /bag chags bral ba'i gnas skabs na/ /skyes bu tha ma 'bring po dag /gang gi 3phyogs ni yod min pas/ /de ni sangs rgyas brjod par bya/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin kyis/ /shes rab cha ni yang dag gnas/ /thabs ni dngos po bskyed skyopa po/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan/ /de dag 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /ro gcig rnam par sbyor ba las/ /'di ni gnyis su med pa'i mchog /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs/ /bsam dang sgom klu pa por bstan med/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can ma/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob bya'i phyir/ /bzang pos bzang po gsungs pa nyid/ /dpe ni chos rnams thams cad la/ /bzhag kyepa nyid du de mi nus/ /mig sogs yid kyi rnam shes kyi1/ /dpe yi dngos po rnam par spangs/ /gcig nyid thog ma med pa dang / /mtha' med rnam par yang dag gnas/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las/ /mchog gcig migis ni shes par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor skyes bur bshad pa ste/ /rjes su rnal 'byor rig pa'i mchog /gnyis 'das shin tu rnal 'byor te/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor pa nyid sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /nyi zla gza' yis 7zin pa na/ /shes rab rdo rje'i spyor ba 26—279

las—/ /zhu bas gnyis med ye shes kyis/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /don dam dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /grub pa'i gzugs su the tshom med/ /snying rje gnyis su med pa'i mchog /1gzugs kyi thog ma 'bring po ni/ /gang yang mig gis mthong gyur pazhu/ /don dam don gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /gnyis med dam par blta ke bar bya/ /gang yang rna bas thos 'gyur ba'i/ /sgra dang sgra ngan rnam phye ba/ /sgra las 'das pa thuye shes gtso/ /thos pa gnyis su med pa'i mchog /gang yang lce yis ⑤myong 'gyur ba'i/ /ro mchog ro ni ngan pa yi/ /ro drug gcig tu gyur pa yi/ /gnyis med mchog ni rtogs par bya/ /sna yis ⑥dri ni snam shes pa'i/ /ri dwags lte ba la sogs dri/ /gcig tu gyur pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /gnyis med mchog ni shes par bya/ /lus kyi reg bya'i rang bzhin rnams/ /rigs bzang rigs ngan rnam phye ba/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis/ /snyoms 'jug gnyis su med pa'i mchog /mtha' med thams cad khyab pa polnga/ /ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer las/ / rang byung phyamachog tu dga' ba nyid/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas dam pa ste/ /'du byed tshor ba 'du shes dang / /gzugs dang rnam par shes pa nyid/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin sku/ /lnga med gnyis su med pa'i bdag /rtag pa mi bskyod 7rin chen dang / /tshe dpag med dang don yod bdag /lnga bdag gyur pa'i ril po ⑩ni/ /drug pa bde ba chen po nyid/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha'i nyid deng 4nyani/ /'byung lnga lhan cig skyes pa ni/ /byang chub gnyis su med par 'gyur/ /me long mnyam nyid bya nan tan/ /so sor rtog pa chos dbyings rnams/ /rnam par rtog pa e26—280

rkyen gyis brtags/ /rang byung hūṃgacig pu gnyis su med/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /lta ba la sogs rnam par phye/ /zhi sogs khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /kun mkhyen gcig pu gnyis su med/ /mig las byung sogs ma lus dang / /yid kyi spyod yul las 'das pa/ /don dam gnyis med ces bya ba/ /ngag gi spros pa kun rdzob kyi4 / /gnyis su med la kun du brtags/ /don dam gnas skabs dbyer med pa/ /gnyis su med la sangs rgyas med/ /rtog pas nam mkhar spyor ba ①ni/ /ngag gis ④spros pa bstan pa yin/ /bstan bcos rim pas tshig tu ni/ /rnam par phye ste bshad pa yin/ /gnyis med las gzhan sangs rgyas ni/ /smra ba nyid du mi nus so/ /stong pa bcu drug bshad pa dang / /shes rab bcur ni brtags pa dang / /sangs rgyas lngar yang bshad pa dang / /rnam rig dag ⑤ni gnyis su med/ /me long snang ba'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /ji ltar kun du snang 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gnyis med ye shes 'dir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab/ /khams gsum dag ni thams cad du/ /skye dang gnas pa'i rgyu rnams kyibye / /de kun gnyis med ye shes las/ /skye bo thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho ri dang shing dang ni//rtswa lcug gel ba la sogs pa/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ྅ba/ /'di la the tshom yod ma yin/ /pha dang ma yang gcig pa ste/ /'di la gnyis yod ma yin no / /gnyis med ye shes rang bzhin las/ /gzhan yang thams cad skye bar 'gyur / /'di ltar thabs dang spyor ba yis/ /shes rab gnyis med rang bzhin las/ /skye ba 'dir ni rnal 'byor pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'phral du rnyed—/ /ye shes dag gi rang bzhin mchog /bla ma brgyud pa cherim pa'i 26—281

gzhung / /snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs / /bzang po'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las/ /bsam med sgom 7pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni nges par 'thob hūṃ / /rta mchog pa yi rduzhal snga nas/ /in+d+ra byu ti legs smrar bcas / /sgeg pa'i rdo rje gun ༷ltadi ri/ /slob dpon pad+ma snying rje che/ /chos kyi zhal snga'i rim pa las/ /bzang po'i zhal sngar phrad pa nyid/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /thams cad kyi ni dgongs pa gcig /sngags kyi smra ba ma lus dang / /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /mdo sde sde snod la sogs pa/ /'dir gcig gnyis med bde chen pos/ /mchod 'os zhi ba nyi ma sogs / /so so'i rtsegrub pa'i mtha' nyid dang / /khyab 'jug dang ni shes bu'i chos/ /gnyis su med par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis med phyi rol yod min pas / /lha dang lha min tha ma ni/ /thams cad gnyis med ye shes las/ /so sor snang ba gsal bar 'gyur/ /stong pa'i bye brag tu phye ba/ /snying rje dang ni gnyis med 'dres/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam par ldan/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin kun bla ma/ /'di ni bzang po'i zhal snga'i gzhung / /ye shes rgya mtsho dam pa nyid/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /dam pa thams cad skye 'gyur zhing / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /gang yang sangs rgyas sogs grags dang / /nyi zla gza' skar bcas pa yang / /ye shes rgya mtsho las byung zhing / /legs smin dang ni dbyangs can nyid/ /ro yi mchog ni myang ba dang / /tshangs bcas lha min mi rnams ni/ /bdud rtsi las ni thams cad —long 7/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum du yang rnam bshad pa/ /26—282

gru gsum rnam par 'byung ba ni/ / 7'di ni chos kyi 'byung gnas brjod/ /nyi zla chu yis gang ba yis/ /shes rab gzugs ni cher 'bar ba/ /bde las bde ba chen po kun/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob ri byed ma/ /pad chen 'dab ma bye ba nyid/ /de yi dbus na rnam par gnas/ /rtag tu ge sar bcas pa'i nang / /ā li kā li yang dag ldan/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gos kyis bkab/ /shes rab dgu dang yang dag ldan/ /'dzag cing 'bar ba'i rnam pa nyid/ /thig le zla ba 'char ba'i mchog /dga' ba skyed byed bzang mo ste/ /ma lus don gyi 'bras ster ma/ /dang ba'i bdud rtsi shin tu gang / /nor bu rin chen mnyam par ldan/ /yon tan mtha' yas sa snyeyi gzhi/ /bde dpal rdo rje can gyi gnas—/ /thams cad tshim par byed pa mo/ /'byin byed skyed par byed pa mo//lha yi gzugs ni du ma dag /gnyis med rgya mtsho las ni 'byung / /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs gzugs dang / /sprul pa yi ni sku nyid kyis/ /sems can du ma kun gyi don/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams kyi/ /mtha' yas mthar thug thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba po/ /stobs bcu yi ni ye shes ldan/ /shes rab gtso bo dam pa nyid/ /mkha' 'gro pad+ma nges par rig /lam mchog bzang po'i rim las 'ongs/ /snying ga lte ba'i pad+ma dang / /de bzhin sgog ma'i pad+ma nyid/ /dril can skye 4gnas pad+ma yi/ /dngos su 'dzag pas rnam par gnas/ /bshang gci khu ba 'pho ba dang / /lta dang snom dang nyan pa dang / /ro mchog rnams ni rig par 'gyur/ /sgo dgu dag nas rgyu ba yi/ /sa bon pad bsnol rnam pa mtshungs/ /'og dang steng du rnam par gnas / /'di ni shes rab ces bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yul nyid do//26—283

de yi dbus na gnas pa'i lha/ /mchog gi dbang phyug gnyis med pa/ /pad+ma gsum du rol par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde chen po/ /me dang chu dang dbang chen dang / /rlung gis ①rnam par brgyan bupa nyid/ /dal bus 'khor ba'i kyesbyor ba yis/ /bye brag gsum du 'dren par byed/ /dril can bu ga'i lam gyis ni/ /sna yi rtse mor sbyor ba las/ /srol gong rdo rje'i bu ga ru/ /sangs rgyas phreng ④ba gnyis su med/ /'khor bas yongs su nyon mongs na/ /dril can rtse mor ngal so nas/ /rdo rje lce yis burab spyor bas/ /bdud rtsi btung bar bya ba nyid/ /de nas lus ni rnam dag pa/ /rang bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /shes rab bzang zhing yid gzhungs pa/ /rga rjodang 'chi ba nyams par byas/ /bzang po'i zhal snga'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag la rnam par rol par gsungs/ /ting 'dzin bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/ /bde ba'i mchog de bzhin du min/ /sna nas rngub pa'i bye brag gis/ /haṃ gi rnam pa ⑦mi shigs pa / /dril /byecan bu ga'i lam du ni/ /rtsa rnams sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas/ /so ni sum cu rtsa gnyis brjod/ /cha dang cha min gnyis su med/ /sna yis tsa rngub pa'i bye brag gis/ /haṃ gi rnam pa mi shigs pa/ /dril can bu ga'i lam gyis ni/ /nges par 'dren pa lam gyi mchog / ⑩de la sgo ru ngal so zhing / /dag pa'i rnam pa ⑪'od gsal ba/ /thog ma med nyid ces bya ba/ /bde dpal rnam par yang dag gnas/ /de nas rlung gis phul ba dang / /dbang chen yang ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /nges pa'i lam yang gsal 'gyur ba/ /mchog gi dbang phyug mi shigs pa/ /sa ni bcu gsum dbang phyug mchog /thog ma med par grub pa'i gzugs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas so/ /bzang po'i zhal 26—284

snga'i man ngag ste/ /snying po brgyud pa'i rim pa yi/ /gang yang thos pa kun bzung nas/ /de thos bsam pas bsgom pa yin/ /bzang po'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /nyan pa goms pa'i sbyor ba las1/ /dge can tog rtse zhes bya bas/ /gzhung 'di dag ni yang dag basbus/ /bdag ni bzang po'i zhal snga dang / /slob dpon gzhan dang rnal 'byor pa/ /sems can rnams ni ma lus pa'i—/ /bran du skye dang skye gyur cig /bsam pa 'di yi sgo nas ni/ /gal te bdag ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'on te dmyal bar 'gro srid na/ /dmyal nyid bde ba can du shog /bsam med gnyis med rdzogs pa yi/ /rim pa'i man ngag mkhyen pa bla/ /lha yi rang bzhin ma lus sngags gzhung rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor rgyas pa mtha' yas bla ma las byung 2dri med 'di/ /glen pa blo zhan bdag nyid dran pa tsam phyir bris pa yin/ /bsam ༄ —gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i slob dpon tog rtse zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so ④bde ba'i myu gu dang 'gos kyis bsgyur ba'o 3 626—285

༄༅/ /lta ba ngan pa sel ba zhes bya ba/( ༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku dṛṣ+ṭi niṅga ta nā matre—/ bod skad du/lta ba ngan pa sel ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'di la gnas gyur na/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob 'gyur ba/ /dang po las pa'i cho ga nyid/ /lta ngan sel ba bshad par bya/ /'dir ni sems can ni rnam pa gnyis te/ slob pa dang / mi slob pa'o/ /de la lhag pa'i bsam snyepas mos pa'i sbyor ba dang /sa la zhugs pa'i spyor ba dang / lnga la dbang thob par mthar thug pa'i bar du 4rgyu'i gnas skabs la gnas pa'i slob pa rnams shin tu rnam par dag pa'i las dang po'i cho gas tshogs gnyis bsags nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'thob bo/ /mi slob pa yang de kho na nyid dang / 'bras bu rnam par rtog pa ni gnyen po'i phyogs kyis gsal 5la/ shākya thub pa ltar sngon gyi 26—288

smon lam kyi shugs kyi nus pas zung du 'jug pa nyid du 'bad pa med par rikyisems can gyi don byed pa ni/ mtshan nyid rgyun mi 'chad par dang po'i las la 'jug go zhes bya bar gnas so/ /de yang / mgon po sems dpa' blumi mnga' zhing / /rnam rtog g.yo ba mi mnga' yang / /khyod nyid ngang gis 'jig rten la/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa 'jug par 'gyur/ /gzhan don phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyildu/ /'bras bu gtso bo gzhan ma yin/ /des na sangs rgyas 'bras bur brjod/ /kun rtog rlung dmar thams cad kyis/ /dpag bsam shing ltar mi bskyod pa/ /de ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa ma lus yongs rdzogs byed/ /'bras bu de nyid mi mthun phyogs/ /blang dang dor ba rnam spangs nas/ /blo ldan rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs/ /dang po las pa 'bad pas samakru/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /'on te las dang po pas ni slob pa'i cho ga nyid rigs na'ang mi slob zherang bzhin med pa bsgom par gyur pa rnams la las dang po pa'i rtsom pa yod pa ji lta bu/ dper na 'dir yang gser gyi sgog gis bcings pa lta bu nyid do zhe na bden te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs pa dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stso lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /de lta bas na rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes bstan pa yin no/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa lngas ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming mi thob 7po zhes gsungs pa dang / 'phags pa dri ma rnged par grags pas bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las kyang / shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs ni 'ching ba'o/ /thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyang 'ching ba'o /26—289

shes rab dang bcas pa'i thabs ni thar pa'o/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyang thar pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag ni 'di'i bdag nyid skyabla ma dam pa'i man ngag nyid las sgron ma dang snang ba bzhin du lhan cig skyes pa grub pa bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /de lta bas na/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa//sangs rgyas ye shes 'dod pa gang / /rnal 'byor pa kun bya ba nyid/ /dang po'i las can bstan pa gang / /pha rol phyin lngar gang bstan pa/ /dang po'i las can zhes bya ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yidu / /ngo bo nyid ni dpyad mi bya / /de bzhin du/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab la gus pas/ /rtag tu blo ldan gyis bsten na/ /bde bar shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa gsum/ /bsam gtan shes rab chos kyi'o/ /brtson 'grus gnyis kar 'dod pa yin/ /zhes bstan pas na/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pas/ shin tu rnam par dag pas gnas par bya'o/ /zlog 5pa ni med par smra bar thal bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang / dge dang mi dge 4gang phyir dngos med kyang / /de ltar dge ba nyid bya mi dge min/ /'jig rten kun rdzob chu yi zla 'dra yang / /de las yid 'ong sdug bsngal yid mi bde / /zhes bstan pa yin na/ de ltar na slob pas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa myong bar 'dod pas las dang po pa la 'jug pa ji lta bu zhe na/ 7lus sbyin par gtong ba dang ldan pa'i spyod pa ste/lus ni sbyin par btang byas la/ /phyin (nas spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /lus gtong ba'i sbyin pa dang lus dang ngag dang yid kyis 26—290

sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'i tshul khrims dang / grang ba dang 1 /tsha ba dang / sog les gshag 2pa la bzod pa'i bzod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyi gnod pa las mnyam pa nyid kyi brtson 'grus dang / dngos po thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i 'bad pa med pa'i rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i bsam gtan dang / chos thams cad mi dmigs par rjes su brtag pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab ste/ 'bad pa med par ro gcig pa'i ngang gis thams cad du ro gcig par 'dod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi mchog go/ /de lta bas na/ ston pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa yang dang po las la 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /tshu rol mthong bar ④grags pa nyams pa 'jig rten pha rol slu lhab thams cad du rigs pa tsam ma yin pa smra ba ltar ni ma yin no/ /de la slob ma brtul zhugs can byang chub sems dpa' la ni / dang por gso spyong sbyin par bya / /phyin dz+wa7nas bslab pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes dgyes pa'i rdo rje las gsungs so/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin pa ni/ /btsun pa'am slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /bdag dge bsnyen ming 'di zhes bya ba/ byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o—/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du bya'o/ /bdag gsum la skyabs su song bar btsun pas gzung du gsol/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol—/ bdag dge bsnyen ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas nye bar bzung nas nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du srog chags gsod pa dang / gzhan gyi nor rku ba dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / de bzhin du myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba 'thung ba dang / dus ma yin par za ba dang /26—291

phreng ba dang / kha dog dang / glu dang gar dang / rtse 'jo dang / khri stan dang / khri stan chen po las ldog par bgyi'o/ /bdag yon tan brgyad kyis dgra bcom pa'i tshul du gnas par gyi'o lhazhes bya ba ni gso sbyong sbyin pa'i tshig ste/byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'go bas/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa la spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / rang bzhin gyi pyakha na ma tho ba dang bcas pas rngo myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba chang 'thung ba dang lnga las log par bgyi'o / /mos pa dang spyod pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa'i ④mi dge bcu yongs su shes par byas la/ yang mi bya bar yongs su bsdam par bya zhing / dge ba'i las rnams ni bya'o/ /tho rangs kyi thun la langs la gdong bkru ba la sogs byas nas/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ pe zhes pas/ bdag dang / gnas dang / rnal 'byor srung bar ⑥byas la/rtog )pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsam gtan dang bzlas pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa bya ba'o2/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa yang lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de yi rjes la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra spuye swā hā/ zhes pa 1brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dpal gnod gnas la dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ 9sarba ta thā ga ⑫ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i sngags lan bdun bzlas shing /lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga brkyang ba las/ bdud rtsi lngas sgo drung na 'dug pa'i gtor ma'i zas chu dang bcas pa zan 'bru gcig gi 8kyang yul ma ga dha'i bye bo che re re 'byung bar gyur par bsams la/ yi dwags kyi tshogs ma lus pa la 26—292

se gol lan gsum gtogs pas sbyin par bya'o/ /da ni sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa'i rnam pa ltar blta ba'i byams pa dang / snyug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las 'byin par bye/bsam pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi 3snying rje'i bsam pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba spros bye par 'gyur jeba'i yid las byung ba'i dga' ba dang / mi bden pa la chags 'upa yongs su spong ba'i mtshan nyid kyi phyobatang snyoms bsgom nya7la/ sems can thams cad kyi don la spro ba'i sems kyis ba'i lci ba gtsang ma blangs la chu gtsang ma dang bsres la/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs la / sa'i cha gru bzhi pa la sogs pa gang yang rung bar 'dod pa'i byemaṇ+ḍal byas la/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar shesnazla ba dang /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ sngon po ⑫yongs su rdzogs pa'i mi bskyod pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po'o/ /de'i rjes la shar phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/⑫ yi ge oṃ dkar po las rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i rnam par snang mdzad dang / de nas lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la yi ge tram̐ nyu2ser po las yang dag par byung ba'i sku mdog ser po mchog nyu)sbyin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /de nas nub phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ yi ge tri dmar po las yang dag par byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar ba'oskye / /de nas byang phyogs kyi 'dab ma la yi ge khaṃ ljang gu las byung ba'i 7mdog ljang gu mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i don yod grub pa bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ zhes pa la sogs pa mngon par zhen pa'i sngags pas 7'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa dbul bar bya'o/ /26—293

de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po 'di dag ni/ na bza' ngur smrig bsnams /pa/gtsug tor dang bcas pa'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa ste rnam par snang mdzad ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /de la bzhi po ni mi bskyod pa la phyogs pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa ni sgrub pa po la phyogs pa'o/ /de dag gi mdun na gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa rtogs pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du mngon du byas nas gdon par bya'o/ /de la gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /sems can 'di dag thams cad mgron 4gnyer nas/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bkyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang / /gso spyong 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad/ /bsnyung 5bar bya ba spyad par bya/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas/ tshul khrims tsan+dan lus la byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos kyis g.yogs/ /byang chub yan lag me tog brgyan/ /ji ltar bde ba nyid du gnas/ /zhes brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ muḥzhes bya bas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de bzhin du 'jam dpal sogs pa yang man ngag ji lta ba bzhin 26—294

mchod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'o/ /lci ba chu dang bcas pa sbyin pa ste / /legs par byugs pa tshul khrims bzod pa ni/ /srog chags phra mo sel bar byed pa yin/ /brtson 'grus bya ba dag la 'jug pa'o/ /bsam gtan de dus rtse gcig byed pa'i sems/ /shes rab tshogs nyusogs legs par mdzes pa yin / /thub pa rnams kyi — /dkyil 'khor byas pa yis/ /pha rol phyin pa drug d+mā des thob shog /nad kun las grol gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur/ /lha dang mi'i chos 1zla ba bzhin par ④mdangs/ /nor dang gser phyug rgyal po'i rgyud skye bar / /bde gshegs gnas mchog lus kyis byas par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/dkyil 'khor gyi phan yon gyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /lci ba chu dang me tog gis/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ /cung zad phul nas bla ma la/ /dus gsum du ni gus phyag bya/ /gzhan dag gi yeni sems mgu zhing / /rang gi sems kyang 'phel bar byed/ /bde zhing tshad med nor dang ldan/ /bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu byed pa po9/ /dpag med yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa phan yon rgyas par 'byung ba yin no/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs cho ga yis/ /yang dag shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rtag tu mchod cing bklag par bya/ /de yi don yang rtogs par bya/ /tshigs bcad gcig dang tshigs bcad bzhi/ /tshigs bcad gnyis dang sgo drug pa'i/ /gzungs dang bzang po spyod pa dang / /phung po gsum pa dus gsum du/ /yi ge gcig nas nyer bzung nas/ /gsum gyi bar du mnyam gzhag pas/ /yi dam nyams pa med pa yis3/ /blo ldan ji ltar rnyed pa bklag /26—295

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i ras ris dang / glegs bam dang /lugs ma la sogs pa mchod par bya'o/ /ras ris dang glegs bam dang sku gzugs la sogs pa kyemachod pa'i cho ga'o/ /da ni dkyil 'khor chen po bkod pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ na mam man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ 3// oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ 'jim pa blang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+red bha du —bā ya swā hā/ 'bi 'bi bya ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze swā hā/ snum bsgu ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ dharma chedhā tu garbe swā hā/ rgyar gzhug pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra ā lteko ṭa ya swā hā/ gdab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ dharma ā yu ṣe swā hā/ spyan drang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ 'usu pra tiṣ+ṭha badzā ya swā hā/bzhugs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta klum ṇi sha ta dī pa 3te dz+wa la dz+wa la dharma dhā tu gasgo swā hā/ rab tu gnas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ swa bhā ba bi shudhe a ha ra a ha ra ā gats+tsha ā 1gats+tsha dharma dhā ḍa datu gasgo swā hā/ gshegs su gsol ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ ā kā 11sha dharma dh+wa tu gasgo swā hā/ bzod par gsol ba'i sngags so/ /de lta bu ni tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga'o/ /na mo bha ga ba te bai ro tsa na ⑩/ pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te ⑫samyak+shi bud+dhā ya/tar+ya thā/ oṃ susgre sukhye/ sa ma ye pra sa ma ye/ shādhe dādhe/ sa ma ro pe/a na laste/ ta raste ya sho ba ti ⑩ma hā te dza nirku le/ nir+pān sku/ sarba bud+dhā 7dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha ⑫te swā hā/18 zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di 'jim pa'am/ bye ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bzlas te/ mchod rten byas na nyu(/ de la rdul phra rab ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi bye ma snyed kyi 'gyur gyi mchod rten byas pa'i bsod nams thob par 'gyur ro/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro/ /myur du bla 26—296

na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs te/ gzungs 'di ni phan yon dpag tu med do—/ /ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tudhe ṣān+ta thā ga to khya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa dūyo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥtshigs su bcad pas rab gnas byas la/ na mo bha ga ba te rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta 3yār+ha te samyak+shi bud+dhā shāya/ tar+ya thā/oṃ rasne rasne ma hā rasne rat+na bo dhi swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i gzungs la sogs pa 'di brjod cing mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba snyel sogs pa byas nas/ mchod rten gcig la phyag byas pas/ mchod rten bye ba la phyag la sogs pa byas par 'gyur ro / 'jim pa la sogs pa la mchod rten bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /'di dag thams cad khyad par can du yongs su bsngo ba las ni khyad par can gyi 'bras bu skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba (yeshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gsungs pa'i yongs su bsngo ba chen pos yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar bya ste/ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 6sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rigs gang yin pa dang / sde gang yin pa dang / mtshan nyid ji lta ba dang / rang bzhin gang yin pa dang / chos nyid gang yin pas yang dag par gnas pa de dag gis ji lta ba )mkhyen pa de ltar bdag kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /de dag gis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o zhes brjod do/ /gzhan yang / dge ba'i las 'di bdag gis byas pa yis/ /ring por mi thogs 'jig rten sangs rgyas nas/ /26—297

'gro la phan phyir chos ni ston byed cing / /snyug bsngal mang pos mnar ba'i sems can grol gyur cig /bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / yongs su bsngo ba'i cho ga'o/ /gang dang gang gis gang 'tsho ba/ /'tsho ba dag pa de rgyal ba/ /bkres dang skom sogs zhi bya'i phyir/ /sman bzhin du ni bsam par bya / /zhes bya ba'i dzode'i rjes la ji ltar rnyed pa'i zas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya 'unut+pan na tāta bye/ oṃ s+dzahūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya bas gtor ma spyin par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ oṃ s+dzasarba budhe bo bye satwa bh+yo badz+ra nai bi bye 4hūṃ zhes bya bas bshos gtsang dbul lo/ /oṃ ha ri ti ma hā yak+ṣi ni ha ra ha ra sarba pā paṃ na k+ṣa na skuswā hā/ zhes brjod la zan chang bu gnyis sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ a gra pa ṇi ṭā si bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes bya bas ni zan gyi chang bu gsum pa sbyin par bya'o / /de'i rjes la/ oṃ āḥ'uhūṃ zhes bya bas/ rang gi snod kyi zan byen gyis brlab cing dug la sogs pa rnams zhi bar gyur gyi bar du dang po mthe bong dang srin lag gis bza' bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la ji ltar bde bar bzod 7pa'i zas lhag ma la/ oṃ uts+tsha ṭa —ban+di a si bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes bya bas lhag ma'i chang bu sbyin par bya'o/ /lhag ma 1gzhan byin gyis ma brlabs pa ni yongs su dor bar bya'o/ /de yang / gtor ma btang zhing bshos gtsang dbul/ /'phrog ma dang po chang bu dang / /lnga po lhag ma gtang ṅkab ste/ /'bras bu longs spyod chen por 'gyur/ /zhes bstan pas so/ /de'i rjes la/ 'thor 'thung la sogs pa byas la/ /blo bde ba hūṃyongs su dag cing khyad par can gyi bde ba dang ldan pas/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ lan gsum gyi bar du 'di brjod par bya ste/ rgyal po dang ni yon 26—298

bdag dang / /sems can phung po gzhan dag kyang / /tshe dang nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde ba thob gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/yongs su dag pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las ji ltar 'dod pas hūṃganas par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas lhan cig spyod pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs sam/ gtam rgyud dam/ gleng gzhi'am/rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam gyis nyin dang mtshan du yid shin tu gnas pas gnas par bya'o/ /de nas phyi dro'i dus su yang bzlas pa dang 'ebastod pa la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du skyo ba med pa'i yid kyis byas la/ yi ge a la sogs pas gtor ma byin / la rnal 'byor gyi gnyid kyis nyal bar bya'o/ /u sangs rgyas chos jel rtag tu 'jug /nye bar zhi ba'i chodage bsnyen te/ /sems can rnams la nye bar phan/ /thams cad nye bar phan gyur pas/ /rtag tu sdig pa spong bar byed/ /sdig pa can dang 'grogs pa spang / /skyes bu sdig pa spong bar byed/ /kun du sdig pa bshags byed pa'o/ /6sgo btags thams cad ྅rnam par grol/ /ting nge 'dzin la legs mnyam 'jog /kun du mchog tu dga' ba yis/ /mkhas pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub/ /dus kun du ni 'bad med pas/ /snying rjes yongs su skyong ba nyid/ /sdug bsngal gyur kyang mi 'dod min/ /phan pa mchog ni byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba'i tshig gis yi ge bzhi pa'i don 8dang ldan pa'i tshig gis 9bsnyen no/ /dge ba'i las ni yongs su byas/ /bsod nams tshogs ni nye bar bsags/ /goms pa'i dbang gis sad pa bzhin/ /dge ba rmi lam nyid na'ang byed/ /'gro ba thams cad dri med pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan gzhan 11du mthong 'gyur na/ /26—299

thams cad smra ba'i skyes bu ltar/ /rjes su mi dmigs bzhin du byed/ /de lta bas na phyir mi ldogarmye /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar nyin dang mtshan du rgyun mi 'chad par bsod nams kyi tshogs nye bar bsags pa byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du sems can la phan pa dang / bde bas yang dag par gnas so zhes bya ba yin no/ /dbu ma'i don la mchog gzhol ba/ /nam mkha' /esnying po zhes bya bas / /dang po las la mnyam 'jog cing / /yi dam nyid du 'di byed pa/ /rdo rje gdan nas 'ongs 'gyur te/ /bram ze'i rigs la zhi ba'i sems nam mkha'i snying por pyagasol btab bdag gis dang po'i lasathu/ /cho ga'i tshig 'ga' tsam zhig bstan par byas pa 'dis༅/ /byang chub goms par byas nas myur du nyon mongs pa'i/ /sdig pa'i blo yi mudri ma'i rab rib 'dis sel shog /dang po las pa'i cho ga 'dis/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang job pa/ /dang po'i las can de dag dang / /'gro ba thuganyis med thob par shog /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po nges par sbyangs pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa lta ba ngan pa sel ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi 9mkhan po bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mtshur ston ye shes 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba'o// //26—300

bsdur mchan/288 ①mtshan byang 'di chos mtshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra༅ tha snyad du chos spyod yod par ston pa lta ba ngan sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 2 〈〈pe
