༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma dh+ya ma sha ta2/ bod skad du/ dbu ma drug pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /shes pa skad cig ma yod de/ /rtog pas stong zhing dmigs pa med/ /rnam bcas smra bar shes par bya/ /chad pa ma yin rang rig ni/ /sngon po la sogs par snang ba/ /de ni mtshan nyid kyis ma skyes/ /dbu ma pa yi lam du 'dod/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /gsal ba brdzun pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /de ni sgyu ma kye/ltar gnyis med/ /tshad mar ldan pa'i grub mtha'o/ /dngos po stong par rig pa gang / /snang ba med sbung sgrib g.yogs med/ /de nyid dbu ma pa yi lam/ /rjes thob dag pa'i kun rdzob yin/ /gsal ba 'am ni mi gsal ba/ /de nyid la ni dmigs su med/ /rnam kun ma skyes pa rang bzhin/ /gzhan dag dbu ma pa ru 'dod/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /gsal ba lha 26—303

༄ / /lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dka' 'grel/1 ༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku dṛṣ+ṭi nirga ta ṭī kā2/ bod skad du/lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dka' 'grel / rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la gnas skabs ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rgyu'i gnas skabs dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang / sems can gyi 4don byed pa'i gnas skabs so/ /de la slob pa ni rgyu'i gnas skabs so/ /'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i gnas skabs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de la yang rgyu'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa nas bzung nas byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar ro/ /'bras bu'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shes bskyed pa dang 5/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spang ba yon tan thob pa'i gnas skabs so/ /sems can gyi don byed pa'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ni/ dang po chos kyi 'khor lo 26—305

bskor ba nas bzung ste/ /bstan pa ma nub kyi bar ro/ /de la rgyu'i gnas skabs ni gsum ste/ bsam pa'i gnas skabs dang / spyor ba'i gnas skabs dang / dbang gi gnas skabs so/ /de la bsam pa'i gnas skabs ni/sems can thams cad 1nges par thar pa'i smon lam mo/ /de'i nye ba'i dka' ba bzhi ni 'di lta ste/ gzhan gyi 2—sbug bsngal nye bar bsal ba la so sor rtog 4pa dang / dgos pa la treso sor rtog shipa dang / grogs la kluso sor rtog 8pa dang / longs spyod la 9so sor rtog skyepa'o/ /de la thabs su 'go ba byang chub tu smon pa ste/ de'i rjes su tshol ba bzhi ni 'di lta ste/ rigs dang bshes gnyen dam pa dang snying rje dang sdug bsngal la ji mi ༄ /snyam pa'i bzod pa dang / rkyen bzhi bzhi rnams las byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur te zhes bya ba'i tshig bcu po 'di dag gis ston te/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i gnas skabs so/ /lhag par mos pa phyasbyor bas sbyor lam pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / sa thob pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bdun no/ /de la lhag par mos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ni/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang / smon lam dang / stobs dang / ye shes te/ de dag 4ni pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o//sa thob pa'i phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ni/ bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dang /yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa ste/ sbyin pa dang /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs te/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa bdun no/ /lhag par mos pa'i sbyor bas pha rol tu phyin pa dag bye brag tu 'gyur ro/ /rnam 26—306

pa gnyis po 'di dag ni sbyor ba'i gnas skabs so/ /de la dbang lnga ni/'di lta ste/ nyon mongs pa dang / skye ba dang / las dang / thabs dang /sems can yongs su smin pa la dbang ba rnams so/ / de la ༄1rgyu'i gnas skabs la snyeganas pa las dang po pa rnams kyis thams cad bya'o/ /de la 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i gnas skabs la gnas pa rnams kyis/ shākya thub pa ltar 'bad pa med par las dang po pa la rab tu 'jug go/ / 'di dag gis choni lta ba ngan pa sel ba rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dka' 'grel lhadapal ldan nges par sbyangs pa gnyis su med pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //badz+ra pā ṇi dang mtshur gyis bsgyur ba yin no// //bsdur mchan/3༷5 hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snga / /lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dran zhes bya ba gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa bzhugs/ 2—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyi ba/ bye —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dran pa/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉rigyi/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes pa/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ngas pa/3༷6 sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉githams cad/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigazhan gyi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasal ba las 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉staXgs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas 'a〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mdogs/ bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sta gas/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gimi nyu1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo'i/ 1zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidag3༷7 nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8'i/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkal/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'dis/thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lam dran pa/26—307
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷63) 26wa 308

༄ / /lhan cig byes pa drug pa/ khye༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dza ṣa ṭa ka /bod skad du/ lhan cig skyes pa drug pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag dang chad las nges grol ba/ /de nyid bde gshegs rnams kyis bzhed/ /rang bzhin las skyes chos rnams la/ /sgrub dang sel bar phyag 2ni brjod/ /yod par smra ba la brjod paje/ /thams cad rnam par dpyad na med/ /med par smra ba la brjod pa/ /rnam par dpyad na thams cad yod/ /ji lta ji ltar sgro btags pa//de nyid rnal 'byor pa rnams skye/ /de lta de ltar sgro btags pa/ /rnal 'byor de nyid kyis ni 'joms/ /gang phyir lhan cig skyes ma bcos/ /de phyir dogs sed lhan cig skyes/ /bde bas lhan cig skyes gzhan min/ /bde ba dogs pa med mtshan nyid/ /shes phyir dogs pa med pa'i bdag /dbyer med rtogs pa dam pa bde/ /sna tshogs rang rig rtogs byas pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i 26—309

༄/ /rmi lam nges par bstan pa/hūṃ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ swasna nir de sha /bod skad du/ rmi lam nges par bstan pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dul ba dang ni chos mngon dang / /mdo las rgyal ba skyes mchog gis/ /rmi lam lta bur chos gsungs pa/ /gsal bar 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /rmi lam bden nam brdzun pa'am / /sna tshogs sems sam rnam med sems/ /sgyu ma'am yang na mi gnas las/ /dam pa ltar ni gang zhig 'dod/ /ma rtogs pa ni rmi lam bden//rtogs na de ni brdzun 'gyur te/ /dang por rtag par shes bya ste/ /gnyis pa chad par gyur pa yin/ /rab tu sad pas rtog pa sel/ /nyams su myong ba sel ma yin/ /sems bcas sna tshogs sel bdag nyid/ /gang zhig nyams su cher myong ba/ /skad cig 'jug pa kun gzhig 2rtsa/ /sna tshogs snang ba 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang der ni rnam par gnas / /sems 'di nyid ni de ltar 26—311

'dod—/ /gal te rmi lam rmi lam nyid/ /sems dngos sna tshogs de tshe brdzun//yod dang med pa 'jug med pa/ /gsal ba la ni chad pa med/ /ci ste ming med la ming btags/ /ming ni sgyu ma nyid du dogs/ /ming la ming ni rigs ma yin/ /ming ni mi gnas pa yin no/ /'dir ni drug las gnyis der byos/ /gzhi kyini rtogs par bya ba'o/ /sna tshogs 'di dag rmi lam mtshungs/ /de ltar rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs/ /mi gnas gzhung ni rtogs bya ste/ /sangs rgyas pa kun nor yin pas/ /rang rig dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ /lung gi khyad par gyis shes so/ /rmi lam nges par bstan pa/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //26—312

bsdur mchan/311 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ zhu)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagazhi/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtag312 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhi/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1065)26wa 313

༄7/ /sgyu ma nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba/hūṃ/༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ mā yā ni rut+ta 2/nā ma/ bod skad du/sgyu ma nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ /dngos med tshe na dngos — sangs rgyas / /mkhas pas bde ba'i bsam pa yis/ /'gro 'di ci phyir grol ma byas/ /sgyu ma mkhan byas sgyu ma ni/ /khyem ni rab tu 'bar ba la/ /kha cig la ni bden par snang / /sgyu ma mkhan bzhin mkhas pas rig /sgyu mar mthong bas 'bad med par/ /'dod pa gang de rang 'ong 'gyur/ /'di la thams cad sgyu ma spyod/ /gang kun sgyu mar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyis brdzun par ma rtog 4par / /sgyu ma rtag par smra bar gyis/ /chos dbyengs ma skyes pa yi phyir/ /chad par thal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /chos rnams ma skyes mi 'gag 5phyir/ /bems ngo/ra gyur pa ma yin no/ /chos rnams stong nyid la bskyed 6pa'i/ /stong 26—314

las chos nyid gzhan ma yin/ /de yi phyir na kun mkhyen gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyams par mi mdzad do/ /'bad med dbang gis thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'ang 'jug /rkang pa brkyang ba spangs nas ni/ /nga rgyal la sogs btang nas kyang / /gnas med gnas la legs gnas te/ /rnal 'byor pa yis hūṃchos la spyod/ /bza' dang btung ba'i ro rnyed nas/ /dag pa nyid kyi gtam smra zhing / /gang zhig spyad pa mi spyod pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub spyod 'di min/ /skye bo de nyid gtam smra zhing / /spyod pa 'di la yi rang byed/ /rigs 3pa bsgrub pa nyams len pa'i/ /'byor pa'i skye bo rnyed par dka'/ /sa yi lam ༄ la phyogs kyi gos/ /slong 4mo'i zas ni za ba dang / /skye med chos la bzod pa dang / /'bad med rtse 5ba 'jug pa'o/ /chos gang skye bo las rgyal ba/ /de la khurgyal ba de spyod pa/ /de yi 'bras bu tshe 'dir ltos/ /bla med 'bras bu smos ci dgos/ /sgyu ma bstan pa'i bsod nams gang / /dge ba'i sems kyis gang thob des/ /gnyis med 'jig rten las 'das pa/ /go 'phang 'jig rten gyis thob shog /sgyu ma nges par bstan pa slob dpon gnyis sed rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / lo tsā 7ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //26—315

༄khya/ /rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/sna ༄77/ /rgya gar skad du/ a pra sa ha pra ka sa nā ma/ bod skad du/rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes pa rab tu mi gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas pha 3nor thams cad 'dod/ /'on kyang 'bad med spyor ba yis/ /gang tshe sems can don byed na'o/ /gang phyir gzhan sel sgrub las skyes/ /de ni rtag dang chad la gnas/ /rtag tu ma skyes mi 'gag nyid/ /skye dang 'gag pa byol song tshig /gal te rang rig tshad ma ni / /rig de sems can 'dod ma 4yin/ /snang ba thams cad spang ba'i dephyir/ /sems can bden pa ma yin no/ /rjes la sems can 'dod ce na/ /de tshe sems can rdzas yod min/ /dam bcas gcod pa 6gnod pa'i don/ /rjes su rtag pa zhes brjod do/ /dngos gzhi la yang rig pa yod/ /rjes la de ltar snang ba'i phyir/ /dang po mi rtog par 26—317

'gyur gyis(/ /de las 'dzin pa'i shes pa'o2/ /'das dang ma 'ongs la sogs pa'o/ /sems ni gnas pa yod ma yin/ /des na de dag med par ni/ /'gro la 'gro ba'i mgon pos bstan/ /chos rnams kyi snyeni skye ba nyid/ /rang nyid gnyug ma bsam mi khyab/ /de nyid stong pa nyid ces brjod/ /chad pa'i rjes 'gro ma yin no/ /rab tu mi gnas sa bon las/ /'bras bu rab tu mi gnas 'byung / /skyob pa sdede nyid dam pa ste/ /bcos ma'i bcos ma de bzhin no / /de bzhin bsam gtan yod sked ces/ /chags med spyod la brjod du rnged / /gang phyir rten 5nas 'byung ba rnams/ /nyams myong ji 6bzhin rtag tu skye/ /rten 7nas 'byung ba gang dang gang / /de de gnyis med sna tshogs sems / /stong dang sna tshogs sems dbye bas/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa nyid/ /bdag gis mi gnas brjod pa las/ /bde 7ba bsags pa gang yod des/ /nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang / /'go rnams mi gnas thob par shog /rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar bstan pa/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //badz+ra pā ṇi dang / nags 9tshos bsgyur ba'o// //26—318

༄/ /de kho na nyid ba༅ pa zhes bya ba/sti༄zhe/ /rgya gar skad du/ tat+ta thud sha ka nā ma/ bod skad du/de kho na nyid bcu pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /yod dang med pa'i sbyor bas kyang / /spangs pa gang zhig dri med pa/ /byang chub rang bzhin rtogs pa gang / /de bzhin nyid de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de bzhin nyid ni shes 'dod pas/ /rnam bcas ma yin rnam med min/ /bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i/ /dbu ma'ang 'bring po tsam nyid do/ /dngos po 'di ni byang chub 'gyur/ /chags pa spangs pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /'khrul pa las ni chags med 'gyur/ /'khrul pa'ang gnas pa med par 'dod/ /de nyid ci na dngos rang bzhin/ /dngos po dngos med gang yin pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'ang dngos por 'gyur/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin gyis/ /de ltar chos rnams ro gcig ste/ / thog ma snamed cing gnas med par/ /ji lta 26—320

ba yi ting 'dzin kyis/ /'di dag thams cad 'od gsal te/ /ji lta ba yi ting 'dzin yang / /rab tu 'jug pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /gang phyir de yang tsho gnas rig pas/ /de nyid rgyun mi 'chad las skyes/ /shes dang shes bya rnam bral ba'i/ /'gro ba nyid ni gnyis med 'dod/ /gnyis dang bral bar rlom 2 pa yang / /de ltar 'od gsal ba nyid do/ /de lta'i de nyid nges rtogs na/ /ji lta de ltar gang de na/ /rnal 'byor mig ni rgyas 'gyur bas/ /kun du seng ge ji bzhin no/ /'jig rten chos la rnam log 'dis/ /smyon pa'i spyod pa la brten nas/ /bdag byin brlab pas rnam brgyan nas/ /dmigs pa med par thams cad byed/ /dri med de nyid gang bstan cing / /gnyis su med pa gang smras pa/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'di spangs nas/ /blo chen rnams kyis rtogs bya'i rigs/ /de kho na nyid bcu pa/ slob dpon gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma phyag na dang / mtshur gyis bsgyur ba'o/ /phyis lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ro// //26—321

༄/ /zung du 'jug pa rab tu gsal ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 1༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ yu ga na da pra kā 2sa nā ma/ bod skad du/zung du 'jug pa rab tu gsal ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dang gang snang de dag par/ /rtogs par gyur na mi 'gyur nyid/ /rkyen las skyes pa de 'gyur ba/ /de yang rkyen las de ma skyes/ /gzugs las gzugs ni yod ma yin/ /mig la yang ni yod ma yin/ /de skyes rnam shes la yang min/ /ji ltar gtsub shing mi bsten bzhin / /gtsub shing dang ni gtsub gtan dang / /skyes bu'i lag pa ma bsten par/ /mngon 4du me ni grub pa med/ /de ni 'di dag bsten 5nas 'byung / /bdag gis 6bu bas sngar rmongs sam/ /'on te bu las rmongs par 'gyur / /bu nyid la ni sngar zhen pa/ /de ni rdzas su yod ma yin/ /de ltar rkyen nyid 'ba' zhig phyir/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /de la 26—323

gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bde mchog las ni nyams mi 'gyur/ /thams cad blang dang dor med kyang / /tha snyad du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di dag sgyu ma bzhin dngos med/ /rkyen las byung bar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /ma skyes phyir na rang bzhin med/ /rkyen las byung ba mi 'gag nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med nyams pas na/ /zung du 'jug pa snang bar 'gyur/ /stong pa snying rje gcig gyur pa/ /rang gi rtog pas byas pa min/ /stong pa nyid dang rab gsal ba/ /rang bzhin zung du 'jug pa nyid/ /rnam pa kun mchog rgyas ldan pa'i / /zab mo gnyug ma'i snying po nyid/ /mngon sum rig pa sangs rgyas kyis / /mchod pa legs spyor byed pa yin/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi hūṃni/ /rtag tu blo bzang rab gnas na/ /spyod pa byed dang mi byed kyang / /de la spyod pa byed ces brjod/ /zung du 'jug pa rab tu gsal ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/slob dpon a ba dhū tīs mdzad pa nardzogs so// //badz+ra pā ṇi dang / nags 1tshos bsgyur ba'o// //26—324

bsdur mchan/༈23 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dzu gan dwa pra ka bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabarten par/ /sngon/ thu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ 'u/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/324 rmye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ bye 7〈〈pe 〉〉gipa/ jusnye‘〈〈pe 〉〉nagabasdur 'azas re'u migabyud/ (1 ༷ 69)26dod325

sngag /dga' gcugs lnga pa/) ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ pri ṇa pañtsa — ka /bod skad du/dga' gcugs lnga pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang ba mchog tu gcugs 4pa ni/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung tsam nyid de/ /med par gyur 5na stong pa nyid/ /'dod pa mo dngos 'ching bar 'gyur/ /stong nyid shin tu mchog gyur pa'i/ /mdza' bo dpe med gzugs ldan gang / /de dang brgya 6la byed na ni/ /dga' bde'i 7gtso bo brlag par 'gyur/ /de phyir dogs pas khyo shug gnyis/ /bla ma dam pa'i spyan sngar gnas/ de yis de dag sngon bzhin du / /dga' bas lhan cig gcugs par mdzod8/ /e ma'o bla ma mchog mkhas ni/ /'di lta bu la mkhas pa mtshar/ /rang bzhin gnyis med dmigs pa med/ /bla na med par gnyis ka skyes/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs / /mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs pa ste/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /26—326

rang bzhin med par rtag tu shar/ /dga' gcugs kyelnga pa slob dpon mi tri pas mabosad pa :rdogs so// //bla ma phyag na'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā tsub rma ban gyis bsgyur ba'o// / /bsdur mchan/326 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stanaga' bcugs lnga pa/rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈ñdza/ 5 bya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcugs/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toragyur/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ cime〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de yi/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thacugs par mdzad/327 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bcugs/ (6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷7༷)26wa 327

sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ nir bye da 3pañtsa ka /bod skad du/mi phyed pa lnga pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rtogs na 'gro ba dag /sangs rgyas rtogs pa can rtsa lag /e ma'o sangs rgyas gzod — —nas dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar rtogs/ /'dis ni gnyen po dang de kho na nyid 4dang / 'bras bu la rnam par rtog pa bzlog pa ni/ rang bzhin gyis dbyer med pa can te/ ngo bo nyid bstan pa'o/ /ye shes rnyog med stong pa ste/ /lhun grub snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /de yang rkyen las skyes pa ste/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /'dir ni dbyer med rtogs pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /chos rnams stong pa ya mtshan che/ /snying rje shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i nus pa mtshar/ /kun rdzob dag pa shin tu mtshar/ /'dis 26—328

ni shin tu dbyer med pa 3lhan cig skyes pa'i mthu bshad pa'o/ /ha ci brjod pa ji ltar bshad/ /bshad na skye bo su yis 2go/ /rtogs par gyur na mi 'gyur nyid/ /lhan gyis grub pa nyid du snang / /'dis ni snying rjes rab tu mi gnas pa'i chos zab mo'i tshul la mos pa'i skyes bu rnyed pa /dka' bar bstan pa nyid do/ /rang gi las kyi sa bon sku/ /gnad gcod pa yi 'bras bu gang / /bdag gis gzhan la mi gtse ste/ /e ma'o de nyid kyis ni bzod/ /'dis ni rang gi las kyi skud pa'i mdud pas dkris 4pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' yongs su 'dzin par byed cing thugs la dgongs pa'o/ /mi phyed pa lnga pa slob dpon me+e tri 5pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / lo tsā 6ba rma ban gyis bsgyur nga 71 dz+wa 26—329

1145༄༅/ /bde ba chen po gsal ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā su kha pra ka sa/ bod skad du/bde ba chen po gsal ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs shes ngo bo nyid can gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas/ /dngos po de nyid mdor bsnyus pa/ /bde ba chen po bdag gis bshad/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa gcig yin te/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim bsgom pa'o/ /de phyir gnyi ga bsgom pa ni/ /de ni bdag gis 'dir brjod bya/ /chos rnams rkyen med pa ru ni/ / skye ba sked par nges pa ste/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang bzhin phyir/ / hūṃ skyes mo skyes des ci min/ /stong nyid byang chub las sa bon/ /sa bon las ni gzugs skyes 'gyur/ /gzugs la'ang dgod dang de dgod bya/ /de phyir thams cad rkyen las skyes/ /phyi rol gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /thub pa yis ni nyer bstan gang / /de ni nang gi rtogs don du/ /rgyud du gsal bar shes 26—331

par bya/ /bde ba ngo bo nyid 'dod gang / /bde ba med na byang chub min/ /yod na'ang chags pa chen po ste/ /'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu hūṃnyid do/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung bde ba gang / / gzod nas zhi treba'i bde bar rtogs/ /de phyir dngos po med par brjod/ /bde ba yod min med pa'ang min/ /re zhig de ni ma skyes pa/ /chos rnams kyi ni don dam nyid/ /bde ba brdzun par gsal ba ni/ /dag pa'i kun rdzob tu shes pas/ /bden pa nyid ni 3rnam par dag /kun rdzob stong nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyis po gnyis med bsgrub bya ste/ /don dam rnam cepar spangs byas so/ /sngags dang dbyibs kyi sbyor bdag nyid/ /blo ldan bde ba der song nas/ /de nas sna tshogs sgyu ma bzhin/ /gnyis su med par de ltar mthong / /de nas yang dag mthar 'jug cing / /zung 'jug go 'phang 7rtogs par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug la gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /sems can don la gcig tu brtson/ /bde sems lha yi rnal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo thabs yin te/ /shes rab stong pa nyid du brjod/ /de ni bdag nyid bsgrub byar 'dod/ /phyi nang dag pa de nyid ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid de/ /bde ba gnas med rnal 'byor pas/ /mdor bsdus 'di ltar shes par bya/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung tsam nyid phyir/ /yod pa ma yin stong nyid min/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /snang ba lha yi rnal 'byor yin/ /ji lta ji ltar snang gyur pa/ /de lta de ni stong nyid bdag /gnyis dang gnyis med shes pa gang / /de ni de yi bag chags bral/ /rnal 'byor te ru'i nga rgyal byed/ /te ru ka don la rab gnas/ /87dngos 'di bla mar byas nas su/ /seng ge lta bur sa steng rgyu/ /gang zhig rgyal ba rnams kyi 26—332

dag pa hūṃsna tshogs 'di dag kun nas rtag tu snang / /gzod nas ma skyes mi 'jig 3bskal pa bye bar rang dang gzhan du rtog pa spangs pa yi/ / bden pa ༄ brdzun par snang ba srid dang zhi bar rngo mnyam pa nyid du gnyis sked rang bzhin phyir/ /'di ni 'khor lo'i bdag po rgyal ba'i yon tan 3 thub dbang rdo rje mkha' 'gro nges par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po gsal ba slob dpon a wa dhū tī snepa dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi dang / rma ban gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/༈31 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉thade ba chen po gsal ba zhes bya/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gsang sngags kyi theg pa zhes bya'o// 'bring po ni sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba'o—/ / (zhes pa'i yi ge rnams deb 'di'i ldeb 336nga1dod338nga9bar dpe bsdur byas yod/) 〈〈pe 〉〉hūṃ skyes me/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〉 skyes me/332 7bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉da/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉thazod nas zhing / 〈〈snar 〉thazod nas zhi/ — 〈〈pe 〉7ma 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ snye〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉ngadi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉girnam/ dz+wa〈〈snar 〉〉'phangs 8 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'bras/ /he ru ka yi rnam byed pas/ /gnas/༈33 nya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma rnam pa/ rte—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorajigs/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thade ba/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/bye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7du gyur/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu ti/26—333
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1༷72) 26wa 334

༄/ /de go na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tatwa rat+na a ba li nā ma/ bod skad du/de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston ka'i zla ba dri rnged 'od/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis kyi ṭ+wā/ /chu skyes la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid rin chen brjod par bya/ /brgyud pa'i gzhung lugs las nyams shing / /rab rib kyis ni mig bkab pa'i/ /skyes bu rnams la yang dag pa'i/ /de nyid rin chen rnam bshad bya/ /de la theg pa ni gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi jeg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /gnas pa ni bzhi dag ste/ bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma pa'i dbye bas so/ /de la bye brag tu smra ba'i gnas pa ni/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/ /theg pa chen po yang rnam pa gnyis te/26—335

pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / gsang sngags kyi jeg pa zhes bya'o/ /de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la yang 1gsum ste/ mdo sde pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma la gnas par snyespyad par bya'o/ /gsang sngags kyi tshul la yang gnyis te/ rnal 'byor pa dang / dbu ma la gnas pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa la yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rnam pa dang bcas pa dang /rnam pa med pa'i dbye bas so/ /de bzhin du dbu ma 1yang rnam pa gnyis te/sgyu ma lta bur gnyis su rnged par smra ba dang / chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i dbye bas so/ /de la nyan thos kyang rnam pa gsum ste/ tha ma dang / 'bring dang /mchog gi dbye bas so/ /de la tha ma dang 'bring ni bye brag tu smra ba'i phyi ma'o/ /mchog ni kha che bye brag tu smra ba'o/ /de la nyan thos tha ma'i dpyad par bya ba ni/sngon po dang / ser po la sogs pa'i phyi'i don khas len pa sngon du 'go bas/gang zag ni rtag pa dang / mi rtag pa nyid dang bral ba'o zhes rnam par dpyad pa'o / /de yang sngon po la sogs yod par ni/ /dngos 'dzin gdon kyis zin pa rnams/ /zab mo'i lus 4kyi 'jigs pa yis zhi/ /'gro ba shin tu rmongs pa la'o/ /zhes bya ba dang / khur khur ba'i gang zag kyang yod de6 /rtag pa zhes kyang mi brjod de7/ /mi rtag zhes kyang mi brjod do/ /gang zag 'dod chags dang bcas pa ni 'khor bar 'gyur bas/ 'dod chags rab tu spang ba'i phyir/ /mi sdug pa'i bsam gtan bsgom par bya'o/ /mi sdug pa bsgom pa yang lus kyi bshang ba dang / gci ba dang khu ba dang / khrag dang /ngar snabs dang / rgyu ma dang / zhag dang / glo ba dang / snying dang /26—336

mkhal ma dang / mcher pa dang / pho ba la sogs pa tshogs pa la nges par dpyod 1do/ /de yang gsungs pa/ re zhig pags pa'i kha spyor 'di/ /rang gi blo yis tha dad dbye/ /sha dang rus pa'i 1dra ba las/ /shes rab mtshon gyis dbye bar bya/ /rus pa rnams kyang dbye byas nas/ /rkang gi bar du dbye chobyas na/ /'di la snying po ci yod ces/ /bdag nyid kyis ni brtag par bgyi/ /zhes bstan pa'o snye/ /gang zag gis rtag par lta 7ba sngon du song ba ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sangs rgyas dang chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa dang / rgan po gnyis la phyag bgyi'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bsags pas8/ bdag nyid gcig pu dul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid gcig pu zhi bar bkyi'o zhes bya ba ni lta ba'o/ /'bring po'i lta ba dang / dpyod pa ni 9snga ma bzhin no/ /'di ni gzhan gyi don cung zad byed par 'dod pa'oskye/ /dbugs dbyung ba dang / dbugs rngub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ rtag pa dang mi rtag pa 11nyid dang bral ba'i gang zag la lta ba'i bsam gtan dang / rlung gi bum pa'i p+tasems med pa'i rang bzhin ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /be+ems por gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /mchog ni phyi'i don khas len cing / /lus la bdag med pa nyid du rnam par 'jig 12 cing dpyad pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su shes pas/ stong pa nyid du lta mi/ba ni bsam gtan no/ /'dir sdug bsngal ni phung po lnga'i rang bzhin te shes par bya'o/ /kun 'byung ni rnam par rtog pa ste spang bar bya'o/ /'gog pa ni lhag mthong ste mngon du'o/ /lam ni stong pa nyid de bsgom par bya'o//stong pa nyid kyang rtag tu zhi ba'i rnam pa nyid du sgro btags pa ni bsam gtan gyi 26—337

dri ma'o/ /yang 'di'i lta ba ni gzhan gyi 1don byed pa'i khyad par ro/ /yang 'dir nyan thos tha ma ni rigs nges pa nyid kyi phyir dang / snying rje dang bral ba'i phyir nyan thos kyi byang chub nyid du 'gyur ro zhes kha cig 'dod do/ /gzhan dag ni/ thams cad sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /'di na skal med 'ga' yang med/ /ces bya bas/ bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la sgyid lug par thumi bya'o snyam sems shing / nyan thos tha ma yang yang 1dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /rigs nges pa yang sangs rgyas 'ga' zhig la brten nas 'gyur ro snyam sems so/ /'bring po ni rang 4sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /ma5mchog ni bskal pa grangs med pa bzhis sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams gyedapyad pa ni/ nyan thos mchog rnams kyi bzhin no / /'di la zhugs pa'i gang zag ni stong pa nyid dang / bsam du med pa'i mtshan nyid dang / slob dpon med pa dang / rang byung gi ye shes dang /lhag mthong dang / zhi gnas so/ /de la lhag mthong ni dbang po rnams 'gog pa dang / gang zag mi dmigs pa'o/ /zhi gnas ni lus dang ngag dang yid yang dag par sdom pa ste/ 'di ni 'di'i bsam gtan no/ /'di la gnyis kyis byesems bsdus pa'i bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi sems kyi bsam gtan dang /sems las byung ba shin tu 'gags pa'i gnas skabs ni bsam gtan gyi dri ma'o/ /de la snga ma ni nyi ma'i gzhung la rjes su 8—zhugs pa rnams kyis te/ de'ang 'ongs par 'gyur ba'i gnyid dag ni/ phyi yi spyod yul nyams pa na/ /yid 26—338

kyi spyod yul gang gyur pa/ /de ni 'bad la kyebasgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba dang /gzhan yang bye brag pa'i gzhung gi pyarjes su 'brang ba rnams kyis kyang hūṃ/ klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ shes pa med pa'i ye shes gang / /gnyid kyi dpe yis bsgrub pa ni/ /dbang po 'gag 3pa'i shes pa ste/ /bye brag pa yi 'dod pa yin—/ / zhes bstan pa yin no/ /thubacom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab las kyang / rgyal byed tshal ni mnyam dga' bar/ /bdag nyid wa ru gyur kyang bla'i/ /bye brag pa yi thar pa ni/ /nam yang go tam ma 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstan pa yin no / /'di yang bskal pa grangs med pa bzhi 'das nas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'o / /nyan thos dang / rkyen rtogs 'di dag gi snying rje yang sems can rkyel dmigs pa ste/ snyug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dag la nyin re zhing / sems can la dmigs nas snying rje gang skye ba de ni/sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje'o/ /nyan thos ni ngag gis hūṃston pa'o/ /rkyen rtogs ni lus kyis ⑩ ston pa'o/ /de yang / rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams mi 'byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni / /rtog pa med par rab tu 'byung / /zhes bstan pa'o/ /da ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi brjod par bya'o/ /de la chung ngu ni mdo sde pa'o/ /yang 'di'i don du rdul phra rab bsags pa'i ngo bo rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa skyes par byed pa'i ngo bo'o/ /de yang 'di'i ngo bo nyid ni/ gang gi phyir rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa skyes 11pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de yang tha dad dus su ji ltar gzung zhe na/ mkhas pas gzung bar bya ba nyid/ /26—339

rig pa'i shes par gtan tshigs nyid/ /shes pa rnam pa len bzod pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni brtags 1pa'o/ /dbang po yul gyi gong las yongs su ldog pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni 2bsam gtan no/ /de'ang 'di ni goms par bya ba'i dus yin gyi/ mngon sum du bya ba'i dus ni ma yin no zhes gsungs pas/ de'i phyir goms par bya ba kho na'o/ /goms par bya ba'ang / sems kyi sems med rtog pa yis༄ —/ /gang tshe goms par byed pa na/ /gang nas gang du song gyur pa//de tshe sems mthong mi 'gyur ro/ /skad cig skad cig la bsten ④nas/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /sna rtser g.yo ba'i yid gtad la/ /khyim par gyur kyang bsgom par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di'i dri ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /'khor gsum mi dmigs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga la kun du spyod cing 'bras bu la re ba med par sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ni lta ba'o/ /'bring po ni lharnal 'byor spyod pa'o/ /de la rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa dang 6smra ba ni/ drug gis dz+wacig car sbyar ba na/ /phra rab cha shas drug tu 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rigs 8pas/ rdul phra rab kyang dmigs par mi 'gyur gyis9/ 'di dag thams cad ni sems tsam ste/ sems nyid gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo dang bral ba/ gsal ba nyid gsal ba rab tu ston pa'o zhes rab tu rtogs pa'o/ /'di yang kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du chos kyi grags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang / sngo sogs ngo bo blo nyid na/ /phyi yi don gyi rgyu ci zhig /blo nyid sngo sogs ma yin na'ang / /phyi yi don gyi rgyu 26—340

ci zhig /ces bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan dag nas kyang / dbang po'i don gye ngo bo nyid/ /sems las gzhan yod ma yin te/ /gzugs la sogs par nyusnang ba ni/ /sems nyid rab tu snang ba'o/ /zhes bstan pas/ de'i phyir sems kho na sna tshogs kyi rnam par gzhag pa gzhan la mi ltos pas rab tu gsal ba nyid do ṭ+wāzhes bya ba ni/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa smra ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnam par brtags pa yin no/ /rnam pa med pa'i smra ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa ni yang / 'di dag thams cad sems nyid de/ /rnam pa med pa'i rang rig pa'i ngo bo nyid 4sems zhes bya'o / /de yang / ji ltar byis pas sarnam brtags pa'i/ /phyi rol don ni yod ma yin/ /bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /gang zhig ji srid snang gyur pa'i/ /de srid sgyu ma bzhin du snang / /snang ba med pa'i de nyid ni/ /nam mkha' mtha' med dag pa bzhin/ /thub pa chen po chos sgu ni/ /spros pa med cing snang ba med/ /de la 6byung ba'i gzugs kyi sku/ /rjes la sgyu ma bzhin du gnas/ /zhes bstan pa ni rnam par brtags pa'o/ /rnam pa dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan ni/ rnam par rtog pa ma lus kyespangs shing / sna tshogs dang bcas pa gnyis su med par mngon sum du byed pa'o/ /de yang / shes bya gang dang gang dag la/ /yid kyis 8'gro ba der sbyar na/ /gang du 'gro zhing g.yo bar 'gyur/ /thams cad de yi rang bzhin no/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /rnam pa med par smra ba'i bsam gtan ni/bden pa gnyis su med byung bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ spros pa med pa/ snang ba sked pa'i ye shes ni mngon sum du byed pa'o/ /de yang / 'di yi ngo bo gsal 26—341

bar 'dod/ /rnam pa med cing ma gos pa/ /'di ni mkhas pa ma yin pas/ /nam yang shes par mi nus so/ /'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes/ /'di snyam bye du yang dmigs nas su/ /ci yang rung ste mdun 'jog na/ /de nyid tsam la mi gnas so/ /gang tshe shes pas dmigs pa rnams/ /nye bar mi dmigs pa yi tshe/ /sems tsam la ni gnas pa ste/ /gzung ba med pas der 'dzin med/ /ces bstan pas so/ /rnam pa dang bcas pa smra ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma ni don dam par rtogs 2par 'dod pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhung la gnas nas rig byed pa'i rjes su 'jug pa ste/ de yang don dam par rtag pa rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la/ tshangs pa celas gzhan ma yin pa yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bor 'gro ba rnams 'dod do/ /de yang / cung zhig gang dang gang mthong ba/ /de dang de ni tshangs par brtag snye /sems ni de las gzhan pa med/ /tshangs pa nyid la nges par gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rnam pa bcas pa'i 6ting nge 'dzin kyi dri ma'o/ /de bzhin du rnam pa med par smra ba'i bsgom pa yang rtags dze+epa snang ba med pa'i spros pa rang rig pa'i shes pa ste/ nyi ma'i gzhung gi rjes su zhugs par thal bar 'gyur te/ de yang ming dang gzugs ma lus pa dang bral ba/ spros pa'i 'khrul pa ma lus pa rnam par dag pa rab tu gsal ba mtha' med pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ rtag pa'i tshangs par khas len par byed do/ /de yang bdag rtog rgya mtsho dngas pa la/ /sna tshogs chu bur gsog 'di 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'char ba dang ni nub par 'gyur ba yang / /rnam par rtog pas kun tu ma rtog 9pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam pa med par smra ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /'di'i lta ba yang snga ma bzhin no/ /26—342

rab ni dbu ma pa'o/ /de la sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med par smra ba'i dpyad 1 pa ni/ yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis kyi min pa'ang ma yin pa/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba/ /de gnyis dbu ma pa yi rigs3/ /'di'i don ni 'di yin te/ yod pa ma yin pa ni sbyor bas gnod pas so/ /med pa ma yin pa yang bag chags kyi dbang gis mi bden par snang ba'o/ /gnyi ga la yang skyon gnyis yod pas ma yin no/ /gzhan yang sngon dang da ltar dpyad pa pred par sna tshogs su zhe ji ltar snang ba de ltar dze+es sngusu bden pa ci zhig gang du thal bar 'gyur/ /de ni sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med pa'o zhes brtags 5pa'o/ /'di nyid ni sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su rmad pa'i bsam gtan no/ /'di la'ang chad pa la mngon par zhen pa ni bsam gtan gyi dri ma'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med par lhag par mos pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su sgogs par byed pa ni lta ba'o/ /chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i rtag pa ni 'di yin te/ sna tshogs brtags tre pa ma yin te/ /chad par yang ni khas mi len/ /rtag dang chad pa gnyi ga dang 3/ /gnyi ga min pa'ang ma yin no/ /'di ni thams cad mi gnas pas/ /dngos po'i de nyid mkhas pas rig /des na/ 'di lta bu yi rnam rtog gis/ /sems ni sems kyis rig ma yin/ /ji srid sgro btags thams cad ni/ /de kun thams cad du med pas/ /dbu ma'i don la sgro btags med/ /des na dgag dang sgrub pa med/ /shes pa gang zhig 2lhun grub pa/ /de la bsam mi khyab ces brjod/ /bsam 9bzhin du ni mi sems pa/ /26—343

de la bsam mi khyab mi brjod/ /bdag gis 'gro ba ma skyes zhes/ /blo ni dag pas 7rtogs pa nyid/ /'gro ba'i gnyug ma bden pa nyid/ /blo dang ldan pas 'bad pa med/ /de yang / sgro btags kun las nges gol ba/ /bdag gis de nyid du brjod do/ /stong pa la sogs mngon brjod dang / /de la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'o/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /btags pa 'di'i don ni/sgo ma btags pa'i don gyi rang bzhin la/ /mngon par zhen pa med par mngon du byed pa med pa ni bsam gtan no/ /don thams cad chad par lta ba dang /be+ems po'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba droni ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /sgro 'dogs pa rnged par pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ni lta ba'o/ /'dir dman pa dang 'bring po'i snying rje ni chos la dmigs pa ste/ chos rnams kyi mi rtag pa nyid kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i chos thams cad la dmigs nas skye bar 'gyur bar —rtogs par bya'o/ /rab ni dmigs pa med pa ste/ rang bzhin med pa'i chos yid la byed pas mngon par rtogs pa ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'o / /'dir sku gsum rnam par gzhag rgyapa ni mgon po byams pas gsungs so / /de yang / gang gis srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam nyid mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chadaru / /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag menyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur 'dod/ /zag med chos rnams rnam kun du/ /rnam par dag gyur ljugang dag yin/ /'di dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku yin/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ / 26—344

'dir kho bos gsang sngags kyi gzhung ni lham bshad do/ /shin tu zab pa'i phyir dang / zab mo'i theg pa lhag par mos pa'i skyes bu'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir dang / phyag rgya bzhi la sogs pa'i sgrub pa rab tu bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / don gcig 37na 'ang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas pas— / /sngags kyi bstan bcos khyad par 'phags/ /zhes bstan pas so/ /de'ang kho bos dbang nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba nas ④bstan to/ /gal te theg pa chen po nas don 'di nges par bstan na don dam pa la goms par bya ba'i phyir/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ci'i phyir bstan zhe na/ de blo dman pa yin te/ thob par bya ba'i theg pa chen po rtogs 3par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di dag skas kyi rim pa lta bur bstan pa yin no/ /de yang / sems can dang po'i las can rnams/ /dam pa'i don la 'jug pa la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gyegasungs/ /zhes bstan pa dang / dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang / theg pa gcig cing lugs kyang gcig /gtso bos bstan pa 'di yang gcig /gang yang theg pa gsum bstan pa/ /nga yis thabs la mkhas pa'i dngos/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang / chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /gtso bos theg dbyer 7ma mchis kyang / /khyod kyis theg pa gsum gsungs pa/ /sems can gzhug pa'i ched du lags/ /zhes bstan pa dang / gzhan dag nas kyang / stong pa nyid kyis gol bar 'gyur//26—345

de ma shes pas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /bsgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i theg pa gsum rab tu bstan pa yang bcom ldan 'das kyis spyi dang bye brag gi rtog pa'i khyad par gyis sems can gyi don du sna rtogs par 'gyur (27ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang / gtso bo thukhyod kyi 'ga' zhig tu//yi ge gcig kyang ma gsungs so/ /gdul bya'i 'gro ba ma lus la/ /chos kyi char gyis tshim par mdzad༄5/ /ces pa dang / kun du rtog pa ma lus pas /yid bzhin nor ltar ma g.yos kyang / /de ltar sems can thams cad kyi4 / /bsam pa ma lus yongs rdzogs byed/ /'khor lo bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis mi rtogs tsubazhin du skyob pa ni/ /tshogs kyi dbye ba nus pa yis/ /bstan pa rab tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /ji srid sems ni 'jug bar du/ /theg pa hūṃmatha' la thug pa rnged/ /sems nyid yongs su gyur pa na/ /jeg pa med cing 'gro ba med / /dam chos las grub rin po che/ /dri med ngag gi skud pas brgyus/ /dga' ba skyed byed rin chen phreng / /bstan 9pas snying gar gdags par bgyi/ /bdag ni snying po la mos pas/ /rgyas par bstan pa ma lags pa/ /rgyas la dgyes pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /bdag la thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /skal ldan kyis ni gsol btab bdag gis ni/ /'bad pas bla med don ldan 'di brtsams pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams thob par gyur pa des/ /ma 'ongs sems can de bzhin gshegs par shog /de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon a wa dhū tī sbyipa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //26—346
