༄/ /thugs kyi mjod skye med rdo rje'i glu/lha༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta ko ṣa a badz+ra gī ti1/ bod skad du/thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skye bo ༷lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /rang gi nyam/sa su myong ba de kho na/ /rig dang ma rig rang rig gsal ba de kho na/ /mar me mun gsal rang gi zherang gsal rang la sad/ /'dam gyi 'upad+ma 'dam la ma zhen kha dog legs/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma ma spangs snying po gsal④/ /nags khrod gnas pa'i ri dwags gcig pur rgyu/ /rgyu la ma zhen 'bras bu de kho na/ /snang dang mi snang yul med zhen med re gsal/ /dngos stong ma dran dran med brjed / pa med/ /lhan cig skyes pa rnam 7/gsum nyams su bde/ /zhen pa med phyir rtog ge'i yul las 'das/ /sna tshogs dran phyir rjes su 'brang ba med/ /gsal dang mi mnyam 1 ye shes snying po nyid/ /mun sel nyi ma sgron me'i kha dog 26—1246

ltar / /rang rig rang la 'bar na 'dzin rtog zad/ /sgrib pa zad phyir dran med yengs pa med/ /gnyis dang yod med 1tha snyad ma skyed cig /phyag rgya chen po bsam med blo las 'das/ /rang rig rdo rje 'dzin pa rnal 'byor pa/ /'da' dka' lhan cig skyes pa'i mar me ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i don/ /skye med stong pa 'od gsal rteris dang bral/ /khyad par can gyi ye shes kho na nyid/ /gnyis la mi ltos ༄ 7bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /rang 'byung rtog med bag chags rtsad jenas gcod/ /sems can sangs rgyas khyad par bsam yas kyang / /spyod lam dag na rgyun gyi rnal 'byor che/ /dran pa'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /gdod nas dag pas dran med dbyings la thim/ /rang don skye med gnyis bral rtogs pa'i don/ /'bras bu dag pas khyo 'das yul med bral/ /rtogs lhapa'i thabs rgyun rang bzhin kun la khyab/ /thabs kyi 'gro don snying rje bsam yas kyang / /ye shes rang bzhin skye 'gag med par rtogs/ /thabs kyi bde ba skyes kyang de med ma zin 'ching / /grol ba'i ye shes rang la lhan cig 'byung / /bsgom bya sgom 6byed dmigs pa'i blo las 'das / /sangs rgyas sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /skye med rtogs pa'i yul na blor mi snang / /de nyid sad pas bde ba stong pas mtshon/ /bsgom bya'i ngo bo snang ba'i rkyen las byung / /mi rtog rtogs pas kun rdzob tha snyad 'grub/ /gnyis su med pa'i snang ba rkyen med la/ /rang bzhin dag pa skye ba'i rnam 'phrul shar/ /bral dang ma bral mi rtog blo las 'das/ /gnyis mred rtogs byar skye med yul du 'gyur/ /stong par smra bas de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur—/ /blo las 'das pas mno bsam yul ma yin/ /mtha' gsum rtag 26—/2 7

'dod dag gis rnyed par dka'/ /dga' bzhi dag la dmigs kyang de nyid dka' / /tshogs drug rang chas ye shes mchog ldan pas/ /gnyis med bcud kyi snang ba rang la 'chad 1/ /kye ho phyag rgya chen po rtogs bral kun gyi gzhi/ /dngos grub 'byung bas ngo mtshar rmad du che/ /gnyis med bag chags sad nas/ rang rig bral/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /mtshan nyid bstan pas nyan thos la sogs skrag /ste gcig bltas na yon tan mthar thug ldan / /rtse gcig byas kyang cung zad bsgom du med/ /rnam rtog rang 'bar dran med gsos su zhi/ /dran 2med snang med me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /tha snyad bral bas skye med blo 'das lam/ /mtshan ma'i dran pa dri med bag chags bstan / /thog mtha' bral zhing snga phyi'i dus mi dmigs/ /kye ho de phyir dngos med ye shes rtogs pa'i lam/ /ji ltar bag chags bral ba'i tshul zhe na/ /gnyis su ma gzung gdod mtha' bral bas zhi/ /bag chags bral bas phyogs med rgyu ba stong / /zung du 'jug pa sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab rnam gsum yul dang thabs su gsungs/ /dpe dang bral bas mtshon pa'i yul las 'das / /skye ba 'di la dam pa'i snying po min/ /thabs kyi spyor bas tshogs drug rang sar zhi/ /phung po lnga sogs yon tan dag pa'i zhing / /kun mkhyen gnyis med snang yul zhen dang bral/ /don dam smra med kun rdzob rtog ge 4tsam//mya ngan 'das lam 'khor ba'i snang ba nyid/ /bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa thug phrad du/ /rnyed nas 'khor ba'i lam las grol bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dgongs pa'i nyams rnyed dze+egs sangs rgyas/ /ma nor lam du lhan cig kho na yin5 / /kye ho gnyis med don du gsang sngags brda yis bkrol/ /yon tan rdzo6—1248

mi zad rgya mtsho nor bu mtshungs/ /thabs mchog zin na bcu bzhi'i 1sa la gnas / /gang du gnas kyang ye shes rang las rnyed/ /gter rnyed bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don la rmongs/ /snying gi ga'u pad+ma'i 2me tog dkyil/ /thabs dang ldan pa spyor ba de nas 'gyed/ /'khor lo'i phyogs kyi rtsa gnas gang du yang / /'dod dang bral bas chags med nam mkha' la/ /gyen thur 'dren dang 'khor lo bskor ba —yang / /thabs kyi 'dren tshul don gyi gting mi rnyed/ / gzung dang 'phang 4dang sbyar dang spar ba yang / /blun po dbugs mi bde dang khyad med mtshungs/ /rtogs par 'dod pas de nyid rtag tu blta/ /gus dang dang bas bla ma dkon mchog brten/ /gsang ba'i yon tan bla ma mchog las 'byung 5/ /don ldan mtshan nyid nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal/ /gsang ba'i don nyid don dang rab ldan pa'i/ /bla ma slob dpon lung dang rab ldan nas/ /mi gnyis sgo nas 'gro ba grol 'gyur shog /thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu snying po gsang ba'i don/ dpal sa ra ha pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //26—/249

༄/ /sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa zhes bya ba/gyo ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta a ma na se ka ra nā ma/bod skad du/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa zhes bya ba/ mtshan ma rab tu mi gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sku yi khyad par bdud bzhi rab tu 'joms mdzad cing / /rnal 'byor rnam par grol bas mdzad pa gang gis ni/ /'dod pa'i don ni yang dag sbyin par gang 'gyur ba/ /'gro la byams pa'i cha lugs mchog gi don ston pa/ /don dam rab tu mi gnas dgongs pa rgyal ba'i thugs/ /gang gi 2sems la 'di kun bsam du med do kye/ /khyod ni phrin las yan lag mang po ston mdzad cing / /dgyes shing nam mkha'i khams kun thams cad 'gengs par byed/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cus sgra skad sna tshogs sgrogs/ /thugs kyi khyad par dgongs pa dbyings las mi bskyod kyang / /thams cad tshim zhing mgu nas rab 26—1251

tu bstod 1par byed/ /byams dang snying rje'i 2gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar ston/ /ma hā de ba u ma de ba rab tu 'joms par byed/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /thar pa'i sgo ni rnal 'byor rnams kyi lam 'di nyid/ /gang yang gtso mchog ldan pa'i spyor ba dag gis rab tu mi dbye bar/ /rnal 'byor chen po tha mi dad pa yin/ /gang gis de ni mi shes pa'i/ /dri ma'i tshul gyis gang yang mthong ba med/ /gang gis de kun 'chang bar byed pa de yis ni/ /gzi mdangs gnyis las brten te las kun ston par byed/ /bdag med ro gcig khyab par byed pa'i gzugs ldan ni/ /'di na mi gnas kun kyang 'gro bar byed/ /sngags dang mdo sde kun gyi rgyal por dbang bsgur bas/ /'di dag kun gyi rtsa ba yid la mi byed par/ /khyed kyis gcig dang gnyis la ma sems kye/ /kun rdzob dran pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs par ston pa/ /don dam mi dmigs pa yi dbyings su ro gcig nyid/ /dug lnga la sogs nad kyis nyen pa'i mun pa sel/ /thog ma'i mtha' dang tha ma'i dngos gzhi ma mthong bar/ /'dus ma byas la yid kyi dmigs su med do kye/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi bar na ming dang bral 'dug pa/ /yan lag log na gcig gi ngo bo nyid/ /shes par bya dang bya'o cog gi tha snyad kun/ /'di las gzhan du lta ba mtshan mas myong bar 'gyur/ /sgra gcan zin gyis zla ba zos pa ji bzhin te/ /ma mthong ba nyid byis dang bar nas shor bar 'gyur/ /yengs dang gnas pa'i bar na ngo bo 'di zhes med/ /rgyu med rkyen bral skye ba mod pa gnyis par na/ /log par lta ba'i tshogs kyis 'di la gzhol du med/ /gi wang gur gum tsan+dan thig le bris pa bzhin/ /zla ba bzang po rgyu skar 'od kyis 26—/232

—'gebs pa nyid/ /snying po'i 'od kyis yan lag zil kyis gnon par 'gyur/ /'di nas 'di ru zad ces 'di byung brtag 1dka' nyid/ /gang gis nam ma/kha' dag la longs spyod pa'i/ /'dod pa'i yon tan 'di la 'phel 'grib sked par 'byung / /gang zhig nor bu dri ma med pa 'chang ba yi sems kyi yon tan gter chen 'di las 'byung 'gyur te/ /mthong ba med pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu blta ba nyid/ /chos nyid mtshon pa'i ngo bo 'di zhes 'das 'gyur ba/ /khro mchog rnams kyis kyang ni phigs par nus ma yin/ /gnyis med tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs gang nyid/ /'di nas song ba gang yang med par shes pa de/ /'di ni mi gnas gang na'ang gnas pa med/ /yul med 'di la rtag tu lta ba dang bral nyid/ /'di nas gang du 'gro ba'i phyogs mtshams de kun na/ /'jigs par byed pa'i sgra yis ma khyer bar/ /ci bde ba dang lhan cig dag tu byos / / kye ho gru/ grogs dag 'di la sems gnyis yod de med kyi brtag pa kun//rnam rtog rlung gis bskyod de smyon pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /byo bar gyur nas rgya mtshor lhung ba nyid/ /tshangs pa rdul dang mtshan ma'i mun pa dag dang ma bral ba /de nyid gnyis bral rtogs par 'dod pa dang / /rgya mtsho sa dang gshag mar nor bu 'gyur mthong nyid/ /brtul zhugs mya ngan 'da' ba'i spyod pa gang byed pa/ /'di ni mi shes de 'drar ston par byed/ /bden pa gnyis bral sgro skur med pa'i gnyug ma gang / /gang du mthong ba med pa de yin te/ /nges par grub cing 'di la rang bzhin med par 'gyur/ /gang gis ma mthong ba las de ni rgyal bar 'gyur / /theg pa gsum gyis mya ngan 'das ston pa/ /'di ru ma shes de nyid mthong ba med/ /rnam grol lam ston bye brag gang du'ang phye ba med pa de/ /26—1253

byis pa rnams kyis shes par 'gyur ma yin/ /gang zhig 'dod chags 1bral ba rtogs par 'dod 2pa de/ /sdug bsngal gsum mam brgyad la sogs pa kun spangs nyid/ /bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' thabs yu la sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad 'od zer g.yas g.yon rab tu 'gyed/ /bum ril kha sbub ma dag pa nyid dag ston pa/ /tshang tshing 'brel pa'i yul drug la sogs rab tu 'joms / /thams cad mkhyen ldan sus kyang mthong ba rnged pa de/ /grags pa la sogs kun gyis bstod dang bskyod pa med/ /kye ho 'di ltar gnas na kun gyis shes 'gyur te/ /thog mtha' me+ed nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho g.yengs 'gyur ba/ /sdug bsngal nyid kyi rtsa ba 'di ru byas/ /'di la shes dang nyon mongs la sogs pa'i / /dri mas ma gos 'dam gyi pad+ma bzhin/ /kha dog ma 'dres yul la so sor snang / /sgyu mar rtogs tsam gar mkhan mig 'phrul bzhin/ /'du byed sna tshogs gang la bsags pa de/ /glo bur rten 'byel dag las goms pa'i stobs/ /'di goms gang yang shes par mi 'gyur te/ /ma goms pas na thams cad shes par 'gyur/ /'dres pa'i chos ni gang yang gnas par mi byed do/ /sgu gsung thugs dang phyag rgya la sogs rim pa kun/ /'di la skad cig tsam du rtogs par ma byed cig /'jig rten bstan bcos dag dang glegs bam gyis/ /gsung gi bdag nyid brjod par bya ba min/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis su gnas 'gyur ba / /de dang gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas ni/ /gang gis gang spyod de yis rab tu brgyan / /skye ba med pa'i rnam par nges brjod pa'i/ /dbus su brjod pas mtha' rnams rab tu spangs/ /ji ltar bstan pas go bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /'jig rten khams su gtan 'khyams rigs chad de/ /bag chags las kyis 26—12bye

mnar ba ma tshor bas/ /chos nyid dri ma sked pa'i don mi mthong / /gang yang 'di dang bral ba med pa de/ /dran 'dzin lus las myur du skad cig grol/ /rdo rje'i sems ni yongs su brtag dka' ba/ /sems la sems su ma mthong ro sbyo mas 1nas/ /phyi nang bsam gtan rtse mos brtags pas stong / /rnal ma'i don la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /ye shes shes rab gsang ba'i dbyings la sdogs / /rang gis ma mthong mtshan nyid kun ldan pa—// /zhes ni bsngags pa brjod 'gyur ba'i/ /dran med mnyam pa'i dbyings la skur gsal mos pa med par spyod/ /thugs rjes mi gzigs sku gsung thugs kyis ma gos pa/ /gnyis su ma mthong gsum gyi dri ma bral/ /sna tshogs bar snang gang la ngos gzung med pa ste/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa'i rtsol bas gdung bar /ma byed cig /ngas ni rdo rje'i glu dang long gtam rgyob sod thudang / /'gro ba kun gyis shes pa dag dang gar bder spyod/ / mi sgrim mi lta demi spyod 'di dang 'bral ma myong / /ye nas ma bcos thams cad 'byung 'jug go 'phang yang 6/ /kye ho sna tshogs gang yang rung ba 'di la bsam pa'i sems bral bas/ /yid kyi rtog pa sna tshogs 'di ni dran pa'i sems yin te/ /gang yang gzugs dang rtsa ba med pa dag las skyes pa yin/ /tha mal shes pa ma bzung bde chen rgyal po nyid/ /mtshan nyid cir yang ma mthong phyogs cha kun dang bral/ /'khrul pas brtags pa'i bsam brjod 'di ni glo bur te/ /blo las byung phyir blo yis 7bsgom du ga la yod/ /gang la yan lag med pa de nyid kun gyi khyem du ltung bar 'gyur/ /go ba'i tshe na ci yang med pa ste/ /dngos kun ci yang gsal ba mthong ba med/ /gang la mya ngan 'das dang srid pa kha spyor 3ba/ /gnyis su snang ba khyod la rten / —dang 26—1255

'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal ba la sogs kun du sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa/ /dag pa'i rigs rnams kun la khyod kyis spyod/ /mi bsam thugs rje rang 'byung sprul pa ni/ /nor bu rin chen lta bur 'phel 'grib med par 'byung / /dngos po med pas nams kyang rtogs min pas/ /btang gzhag med cing rang bzhin rnam par grol/ /'dzin med yid la bya med rnal 'byor bsam gtan nyid/ /gang la mi bsgom gang du'ang 1btsal ba med pa de/ /bsam du med pas yid la mi byed ro snyoms kye/ /ye shes mkha' 'dra bsam bral ma bcos snying po'i don/ /'di la blo yis bsam zhing brjod du med do kye/ /ye btang rang yan tshogs drug lhag pa'i spyod pa 'di/ /tshogs drug rjes su spyor ba'i mkhas pas btang gzhag med/ /kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor lhag pa'i bsam bral bas/ /de bzhin nyid la mi gnas gang la rang bzhin med par gol/ /'od gsal rdzogs dang thim dang 'gags par 'gyur ba gang / /ji ltar bsgoms dang chags par 'gyur ba mtshan ma ste/ /phung po khams dang skye mched yan lag thams cad kun/ /gcig gi dbyings na mi mngon phra ba'i tshul du gnas / /rgya mtsho'i dbyings nas nor bu rin chen rnyed 'gyur ba/ /chu srin dung dang gdug pa can gyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /phrag dog srid pa'i nyon mongs la sogs pa'i/ /mtshan ma'i dbyings nas ngos tsobazung med par mjong / /gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'jug par byed pa ni/ /rnam rig bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas rtsol bar byed/ /ji ltar snang bzhin 'jig rten tha snyad lam/ /rnam thar sgo gsum bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /mtshan ma'i yid la byed pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'di la gnas mi byed/ /gang zhig shel sgong 26—/256

dag pa lta bur ni/ /dri ma gnyis bral srid dang 'das grol te/ /rin po che ltar dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung / /yongs su zad pa zad phyir mtshan nyid rnged / /dngos med bden pa gnyis bral gcig gi dngos po stong / /mtshan ma thams cad ye nas med pa'i phyir/ /mthong thos la sogs mtha' yi rtog pa pred / /med la med par 'dzin pa tha snyad de/ /'di ni tshor bar nus pa ma yin no/ /'di ni rtsa ba kun gyi rjes su rtog par ma byed cig /'di la gang tshe rtog par byed pa dang / /bskal par bgrangs kye kyang de nyid rnyed pa min/ /mgal me gtsub dz+wa/shing lta bur me mched 'bar ba bzhin/ /'di kun mched nas thams cad sreg par byed/ /kye ho grogs dag rgya mtsho nor bu lta bu'i sems ni 'di nyid yin te kye/ /ma te rwa rur 1seng ge'i 'o ma gang drugs pa/ /nor bu rin chen 'bar ba de yis thob par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs pa rnams nyi mas rab tu skams pa'i 'od zer 'di/ /ngan 'gro la sogs log par lta bas 'jigs pa med pa de/ /gang dag rnyed pa de dag gzhal kyis mi lang ngo ji ltar chos kyi dbyings su snang ba de srid du/ /zag pa med gang thams cad de yis spyad pa yin/ /dug sbrul phag rgod glang chen seng ges zos pa bzhin/ /de bzhin srid dang mya ngan 'das pa khyur mi 'das4/ /bskal pa brjod du med nga/ brgya stong du ma ru/ /nyon mongs la sogs bsags pa'i sa bon ni/ /sems gabyug snang bar 'gyur bas 'bras bu gcig tu log par 'gyur/ /sgron ske khang bur nor bu gnas gyur pa'i/ /'od kyis thams cad zil gyis mnan par 'gyur/ /dman pa'i lta spyod nyan thos la sogs pa'i/ /sems de yang dag blangs nas 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di la gang na byang chub sems dpar 26—1257

—gyur pa de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dka' bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /sems kyi skad cig 'di la mtha' yas mu med de/ /yan lag thams cad skad cig 'di la log par 'gyur/ /chos rnams thams cad kho na nyid la rdzogs par 'gyur ba yi / /gzhan med gang zhig gang nas 'ongs par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zla ba'i snying po mun pa'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ba 1gang / /'jig rten rmi lam lta bu 'di la yang dag rnyed par 'gyur/ /brdzun pa gang yin 'di la yang dag sus mthong ba/ /bltar med de la gzugs su mthong bar ga la 'gyur/ /don dam par ni gang yang yod par 'gyur ba ma yin na/ /pha rol gzhan du mthong nas 'gro bar 2'dod pa'i gang zag de/ /'di las gzhan du 'gro ba'i khyad par bse dri can bzhin no/ /'di ni pha rol brtol kyibs gang du ma bor bar / /gcig kyang phyin pa med par 'dis brtol cholo/ /kye ho gang 'di tha snyad lam 'dis btsal ma yin/ /thar pa rtag tu byi la lta bu'i mchongs pas nags su ltung bar 'gyur/ /gal te stag dang wa mo lta bu'i stobs ni go bzlog na//de nyid yod pas de la ci zhig phan par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid shes na mi bsam mi rtog par/ /gzugs mthong cir yang snang ba'i yul ni de ru stong par 'gyur//'di la yengs nas de la gnas par 'gyur ba ma tshor ro/ /dran dang shes bzhin gnyis ni bar gyi de la gang yang ma mthong ste/ /chos kun stor na 'di yi khong nas 5gnas par 'gyur ba yin/ /'di la dngos po med cing bsam du med pa de / /khyod kyis rtswa 6mchog tsam du gnyis ka med par byos/ /kye ho sangs rgyas kun gyi yan lag bzhi pa 'di kun gsum du ston par ni/ /khyod kyis yang nas yang du bsams pas mthong ba gang yang med mod kye/ /'khor ba'i dran 26—1258

pas rten 'brel dag las 'byung ba ni/ /sna tshogs bar snang rang gi ngo bo ma skyes phyir/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dag dang lhan cig skyes/ /sems kyi don dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i yon tan nyid/ /chos rnams thams cad gnyis su gdod nas ma byung ste / /gnyis dang gcig gi dran pas du ma dag dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ /gang yang brjod par bya ba'i /dngos po gang zhig rang gis stong pa ste/ /blo las 'das phyir mtshan ma rab tu 'joms/ /de med pa de gang yin gang na 2gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bsam gtan gang tshe thob par 'gyur ba la / /bral bas 'di las gzhan du song bas ma mthong ngo / /gsang sngags 'di kun rtsa ba de las bskyed par ni/ /de med pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ba gang yang yod pa ma yin kye/ /su zhig 'di la rtog par byed pa'i blun po de/ /bskal pa brgyar yang mchog gi don mi mthong / /gang zhig yid la byed pa'i mtshan mas brgyal ba kun/ /btang gzhag bral dang thob par mi 'gyur rgyal srid bzhin/ /cung zad drod thob byang chub sems dpa' dag /gang du g.yos pa med pa ma tshor ro/ /rnam par rtog can lam du zhugs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le rlung la gang bskyon pa/ /sa bon des ni 'khor ba 'di ru zags par 'gyur/ /yang dag pa yi de nyid thob par mi 'gyur zhing / /tshang tshing dra ba'i gseb tu 'byel bar 'gyur/ /shes rab mig gis log par tshar bcad na/ /gzhan gyi log par lta ba rang gi de ru grol/ /dka' thub la sogs gzhan du 'bad pa med/ /bdag med par ni rang byung gang yang rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /rgyu rkyen la sogs 'brel pa 'di ru stong par byos/ /rnal 26—1259

'byor 'di la bdag gi gnas su 'dug pa ma mthong ngo / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa'i long ba gang 'chal 'dis/ /srid pa'i dra ba khur nas 7rgya mtshor mchong bar byed/ /de la gru med rgya mtsho'i zabs su zag tshupar 'gyur/ /thog mtha' med pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das grol nyon mongs rgya mtsho skems par 'gyur/ /de la sems rgyun 'chad do snyam du sems shing stong par yid la ma byed cig /gang la don gyi brtul zhugs chen po 'di nyid ma thob par—/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang gis de la ma reg kye/ /byen gyis brlabs 4dang brlab bya med pas ngo mtshar che ba nyid/ /gnyis med sgo skur bral ba 'di la 5gnas pa gang / /rten dang bral ba'i tshul gyis gnas par 'gyur / /'gro ba kun gyis de ltar shes par 'gyur gang ni/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa kun gyi don shes 'gyur/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams rang gi sems yin par/ /gzhan du blta ba med par thag chod bsam med blo 'das nyid/ /de la bsgoms dang ma bsgoms rnam par rtog pa dang / /mtshan ma dgag dang spang bar bya ba mi dgos te/ /de la ci bya gang yang ma byas de nyid gsal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar rnam rtog ma bkag ma spangs par/ /gzhan du ma mthong de nyid gsal 'gyur na/ /de ni gang la gnas kyang gzhan du mthong bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ma bsgoms ched du ma byas 'bral ba med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /dus rnams kun du 'di don shes pa'i mtshan ma 'di la rtog par ma byed cig /rang la lhan cig gsal ba'i snang srid 'di la rtog med cing //de las gzhan du rtogs hūṃpa'i blo can 'dis ni rgya mtsho nang gi nor bu rnyed mi 'gyur / /gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas pa'i 'dzin pa 'di ni skye ba med 26—1260

'gyur na/ /rgyun du 'gag pa med pas gzung 'dzin de ma skyes pas ye shes nyid//ngo bo de la dri ma ma spangs de nyid ma bsgoms par/ /nags khrod dag na gnas pa'i glang po yan par khye /mtshan ma'i yul gyi rnam g.yeng rtog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /gnod cing de la g.yeng bar mi 'gyur te/ /mtshon cha bral ba'i chom rkun dag gis gsad lha bcad ma yin no/ /mtshan ma de nyid snying po med 'gyur ba/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad lta bur rang bzhin med par byos/ /gang mthong sems yin de la dngos po med 'gyur bas/ /dran med blo la mi gnas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /de las byung zhing de ru snang nas de nyid 'das /bye'agyur bas/ /'di la gzhan du g.yo ba gang yang med pa nyid/ /de la de nyid tsam du mkhyen gyis yid la ma byed kye/ /kye ho grogs dag blo la ci skyes sems de ni / /dus rnams kun du gsal ba ma yin no/ /de la gsal rgyu ci yang med pa ste/ /brtsad pa kun dang bral bar ni/ /rang gnas pas ni grol bar 'gyur//ji ltar tshul 'chos byas pa'i sangs rgyas 'di kun ni/ /dge slong ma yin rgya mtsho'i nang du ltung bye/ /'di nyid las ni gzhan dag tu/ /gcig kyang lta bar mi byed pa/ /des ni thams cad mthong ba'i dge slong yin/ /gang zhig brdzun la goms pa'i gnas brtan des/ /srid pa nyam thag 'di las 'byung bar nus ma yin/ /gang gis srid pa'i chu bo 'di brdzun par/ /shes pa de ni gnas brtan mchog thob 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor de yi spyod yul ni/ /lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya'i yan lag kun/ /'di kun shes na dbab tu yod pa ma yin no/ /de nyid shes pa de la de kun mthong ba med/ /de ltar 'di las ma gtogs pa'i/ /'du shes yul gzhan dag las ni/ /skye bar 'gyur ba yod ma yin/ /yul 26—1261

can gang gi phyogs dag tu/ /gnyis su mthong ba med par 'gyur ba de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs de nyid grol ba yin/ /gang zhig phyogs su lta bar gyur pa de/ /mtshan ma'i dran rig phra rags zugoms pa yin/ /gang zhig 'di las goms 'gyur bas/ /spyod pa ji ltar byas pa kun/ /don dang ldan par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ /nyam thag mtshan mas myur du 'ching bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di dang phyogs su ni/ /gtad la goms su yod ma sa7yin/ /bsam med yid la goms su med/ /kye ho gogs dag rig pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa rgo/ /ye shes bla na med pa'i dbang bskur chen po ste/ /rdzogs ldan dpal ldan bla ma dag gis ni/ /bskur du med pa'i tshul gyis thob par byed pa ni/ /mchog gi rnal 'byor rnams kyis ༄ bhedabang bsgur te/ /thob bya med pa'i tshul gyis thams cad rdzogs / /de nyid ma shes log sred can gyi dbang rnams ni/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa dag gis gsum du zag chopar 'gyur/ /'di la nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa las bsags kun/ /shes rab ting 'dzin mi dgos rnam par gol bar 'gyur / /khro gnyer med pas zug rngu thams cad 'joms par ni/ /ma skyes pa yi tshul gyes 'dzin par mi byed do/ /snang ba 'gag pa 'di la gsal ba'i rtog pas yid la ma byed cig /phyin ci log dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad ni / /nyon mongs lnga yi gnas su thams cad zags par 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhan dag 'di nyid shes pas 'khor ba'i dra ba dag gis stong pa nyid/ /u dum wā 5ra lta bur dkon 'gyur ba'i/ /rmongs pa'i mun sel snying po gsang ba'i don / /sus kyang shes pa med par kun la gsal 'gyur ba/ /snying gar gnas pa'i don la dri ma med 'gyur te/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas gang de mthong 26—1262

ba ma yin no/ /'di rnams rdzogs la spyor bar nus pa de/ /yan lag thim nas stong pa nyid du gnas/ /kye ho 1grogs dag gyad dang rje rigs ji bzhin du/ /gang gis khengs par myur du thob par 'gyur/ /rim par sbyang ba gang yang yod nga/ ma yin no/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig dang / /khyod kyis rdzogs par 'gyur bas thob pa ma yin no/ /gang tshe 'di la rtsa ba med par rtogs 2pa ni/ /da lta nyid du gnyis med nges par 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar srin bu spyod pas bcings par gang 'gyur ba/ /'di rnams ro la chags pas 'ching bar 'gyur ba ste/ /tshang tshing 'di la za bar nus pa gang gis ni/ /'khor lo thams cad rgyun du bskor bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs gsal ba/ /'di kun gang gis yid la ma byas par/ /ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud/ /sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha pa'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //bla ma nag pos rang 'gyur du gnang ba'o/ /gu ya sa ma pa ta mi thi // //26—1263

bsdur mchan/1 251 —1 mtshan byang 'di chos mtshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ra / /sku gsungs thugs yid la byed pa zhes bya ba sa ra has mdzad pa zhugs so// bu〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉gis/1252 rige/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ston/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rje/1253 1— 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo'o/ ( 'di'i 'og gi kye ho zhes pa rnams 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉tha kye'o zhes 'khod kyang bsdur mchan du bkod med/)1254 she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoradi 'dod chags dang / spyo〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉gipar 'dod/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spyor pa/1255 ༄1sna 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsnyams/ sno〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gipa/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadungs par/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gsod—/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉mi bsgrim mi blta/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa bsgrim mi blta/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giyang rtse 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha/ ldu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar/ ( 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharten/1256 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gigang du'ang / thu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉mongs/1257 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagrang / 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byob/ sne 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉te'i rwa ru/ tshobye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mid brdas/1 258 lku 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur pa/ du — 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉tha/ ༷ pergya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtol/ khye〈〈snar 〉ra / ñtsa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/1 259 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ṭa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/1 26༷ 2 〈〈snar 〉〉na/ 3bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zags/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gimatsho/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉 ba/ 〈〈snar 〉〉babs/3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas/ khu 〈〈snar 〉〉rtog1261 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsad/ —rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngalas/ sne 〈〈snar 〉〉lhung /1262 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ngabs/ 3/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ④ /〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉sngagazungs du zags—/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/1263 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉giho/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉smisi/26 dod1 264

༄/ /do ha mjod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngagashe༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ do ha ko ṣa nā ma ma hā mu dra u ba de sha /bod skad du/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar dngos dang dngos med snang stong dang / /rgyu dang mi rgyu g.yo dang mi g.yo ba/ /thams cad ma lus nam mkha'i rang bzhin las / /dus rnams kun du nam yang g.yo ba med/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' zhes ni rab brjod kyang / /nam mkha'i ngo bo cir yang grub pa med/ /yod dang med dang yod min med min dang / /de las gzhan du'ang mtshan pa'i yul las 'das/ /de ltar nam mkha' sems dang chos nyid la/ /tha dad cung zad yod pa ma yin te/ /tha dad ming ni glo bur btags pa tsam/ /de la don med brdzun gyi tshig tu zad/ /chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ /26—1266

sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med/ /gang gis gdod nas sems pred rtogs pa yis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dam pa rnyed/ /chos kyi za ma tog ces yongs su gdags/ /de yang log pa'i chos gzhan ma yin te/ /gzod nas lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de yi de nyid bstan du yod min rte / /brjod du med pas sus kyang go ba med/ /gal te bdag po yod na nor yod de/ /ye nas bdag med de la ci zhig yod/ /sems yod gyur na chos kun yod rigs te/ /sems med pa la chos zhig su yis rtogs/ /sems dang chos su snang ba thams cad ni/ /btsal na mi rnyed tshol mkhan gong nas med//med pa dus gsum ma skyes mi 'gag pas/ /de nyid gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa ni/ /rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /de phyir snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku/ /'gro ba sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'du byed las kun ye nas chos kyi dbyings/ /btags pa'i chos rnams ri bong rwa dang 'dra/ /kye ma nyi ma sprin bral 'od zer kun khyab kyang / /mig med rnams la mun pa rnams su snang / /lhan cig skyes pas kun la khyab gyur kyang / /rmongs pa dag la de nyid shin tu ring / /'gro ba rnams kyis sems med ma rtogs pas/ /btags pa'i sems kyis sems nyid rab tu bcings/ /ji ltar gdon byus brlabs 7pa'i sbyon pa dag /dbang med don med sdug bsngal byed pa ltar/ /dngos 'dzin rnam rtog gdon chen zin pa yi/ /skye bo don med sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig byed/ /kha byug blo yi dbye bas rmongs rnams bcings/ /bdag po khyem du bzhag nas gzhan du tshol/ /kha cig gzugs brnyan dag la gdon 2du 'dzin / /kha cig rtsa ba bor nas lo 'dab 'byeg /ji ltar byas kyang 26—1267

bslus pa ma tshor ro/ /kye ho bus pa rnams kyis de nyid ma rig kyang / /de nyid ngang las g.yos med nga yis rtogs/ /nga yis nga yir thog mtha' shes gyur pas / /nga yis nga mthong rang nyid gcig pur lus/ /gcig po nyid la bltas pas gcig ma mthong / /mthong bya mthong byed bral bas brjod du med/ /brjod du med pa su yis go bar 'gyur/ /gnyug ma'i yid la gang tshe sbyangs gyur pa/ /de tshe ri khrod nga yi rtogs par 'jug /seng ge'i 'o ma snod ngan phal par min/ /ji ltar nags na seng ge'i nga ro yis/ /ri dwags phra mo thams cad skrag gyur kyang / /seng phrug rnams ni dga' bas brgyug bye 7pa ltar/ /gdod nas ma skyes bde chen 'di bstan pas/ /rmongs pa log rtog can rnams skrag gyur kyang / /skal ldan rab tu dga' bas spu zing byed/ /kye ho ma yengs sems kyi snyerang gis rang la ltos/ /rang gi de nyid rang gis rtogs gyur na/ /yengs pa'i sems kyang phyag rgya chen por 'char/ /mtshan ma rang grol bde ba chen po'i ngang / /rmi lam dag gi bde dang sdug bsngal kun/ /sad pa'i dus na rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /re dang dogs pa'i bsam pas kun bslang nganas//dgag dang sgrub pa'i bsam pa su zhig byed/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /de nyid mthong bas rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /re dang dogs pa'i blo ni zad gyur pas/ /spang dang blang ba'i 'bad rtsol ci byar yod/ /snang grags thams cad sgyu ma smig rgyu dang / /gzugs brnyan byedang mtshungs dngos po mtshan ma med/ /sgyu mar snang mkhan sems nyid nam mkha'i ste/ /mtha' bral dbus mar ce/sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /gang gā la sogs chu klung sna tshogs pa/ /ba tsha can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar/ /btags pa'i sems dang 26—1268

sems byung sna tshogs kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par byos/ /gang zhig nam mkha'i khams ni yongs btsal kyang / /mtha' dang dbus med mthong ba yongs su 'gag /de bzhin sems dang chos ni yongs btsal bas/ /steng po rdul tsam rnyed par ma gyur te/ /yongs su tshol ba'i sems kyang mi dmigs pas/ /ci yang ma mthong ba nyid de mthong yin/ /ji ltar gzings la 'phur ba'i bya rog ni/ /phyogs rnams bskor zhing slar yang de ru 'bab/ /'dod pa'i sems kyis bstan pa'i rjes bcad kyang / /dang po'i sems nyid gnyug ma nyid du 'bab/ /rkyen gyis mi 'gul re ba'i yi chad pa/ /dogs pa'i skugs sa zhigs ⑫pas rdo rje sems/ /rtsa ba chod pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom du med pas yid la mi bya ste/ /tha mal shes pa rang lugs gnyug ma la/ /bcos ma'i dmigs pa dag gis mi babe+ed rdude/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos/ /ma bzung ma btang rang dga' nyid du zhog /gal te ma rtogs blo la sgom rgyu med/ /rtogs pa can la bsgom bya sgom byed med/ /ji ltar nam mkhas nam mkha' dmigs su med/ /de ltar stong pas stong pa sgom du sped/ /gnyis med shes pas chu dang 'o ma ltar/ /sna tshogs ro gcig bde chen rgyun chad med/ /'di ltar dus gsum rnam pa thams cad du/ /yid la bya ba med cing ma bral gnyug ma'i ngang / /de nyid skyong la sgom zhes tha snyad gdags/ /rlung ni mi bzung yid ni mi bcing b.rasgo ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta bur zhog /dran rtog byung na de nyid rang la ltos/ /chu dang rlabs gnyis tha dad ma rtogs shig /yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po la/ /sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pas mi bsgom ste/ /sgom med don dang 'bral med sgom 26—1269

—pa'i mchog /gnyis med lhan cig kyibade ba chen po'i ro/ /ji ltar chu la chu gzhag ro gcig ltar/ /ji bzhin ngang du de bzhin gnas pa'i tshe/ /dmigs 'dzin zhen pa'i yid ni rab tu zhi/ /kye ho/ gnyis med gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor gang de la/ /spang dang blang ba'i dngos po byu zhig yod/ /ngas ni chos kun ma btang bas/ /bu khyod 'di gyis bya ba mi smra'o/ /ji ltar nor bu de dngos med pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa de dngos med pa ste/ /'du byed sna tshogs cal col gang smras kyang / /rnal 'byor blo ni gcig las mi 'da'o/ /gcig nyid na ni gcig kyang yod min pas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rtsa ba bral gyur te//smyon pa bzhin du rtsis med yan pa la/ /byar med spyod pa bu chung bzhin du gnas//e ma/ srid pa'i 'dam skyes pad+ma lta bu'i sems/ /nyes pa gang gi 3gang la gos pa med/ /za zhing 'thung la gnyis sprod bde ba dang / /gal te lus sems rab tu gdungs gyur dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gang la spyod gyur pa/ /gang gis ma bcings ma grol gos pa med/ /rtogs pa'i rang spyod rtsis med dang de nas/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro ba nyam thag mngon gyur tshe/ /mi bzod snying rje'i shugs kyis mchi ma 'byung / /bdag gzhan bzlog nas phan pa nyid la 'jug /don la brtags na dmigs pa gsum bral bas/ /yang dag ma yin rmi lam sgyu 'dra ste/ /chags thogs bral bas dka' zhing skye med pa/ /sgyu ma mkhas pa sgyu ma'i don byed mtshungs/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /spangs dang thob pa'i dngos po 'ga' yang med/ /yid la byar med phyag rgya chen po ni/ /'bras bu gang du'ang re ba ma byed cig /re ba'i sems ni gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /spangs dang thob pa'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ / gal te 26—1270

kang gis thob pa'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ /1gal te gang gis thob pa'i dngos yod na/ /bstan pa'i phyag rgya rnam bzhis ci zhig byed/ /ji ltar ri dwags 'khrul pas gdungs pa yis/ /smig rgyu'i chu la rab tu brgyug 2pa ltar/ /d+mo/ngas pa gang zhig 'dod pas rab gdungs pas/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang slar ni ring bar 'gyur/ /ye nas ma skyes rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /de las khyad nga/ra cung zad yod min te/ /btags pa'i yid ni dbyings su dag gyur pa/ /nge/ la rdo rje 'chang zhes btags pa tsam/ /ji ltar e thang skam po'i smig rgyu dag /chur snang chu ni gnyis su med pa ltar/ /bzod ༄ nas dag pa btags pa'i yid sa/ngas pa/ /de la rtag chad gnyis su brjod du med/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /smon lam dbang gis re ba yongs skong ba/ /de yang 'jig rten tha snyad kun rdzob ste/ /dam pa'i don du 'ga' yang don sngum yin / /do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dpal ri khrod pa chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// / /26—1271

bsdur mchan/1266 she mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sa / /do ha mjo da ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dpal ri khrod zhabs kyis mdzad pa bzhu/gas/1267 97〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlams/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stedon/1268 ) 〈〈pe 〉〉sbyar/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sbyang / sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyug ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stekyis/ dzo⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bslangs / ci ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnan/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sped/1269 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gig khu〈〈pe 〉〉pa slad/ 〈〈snar 〉〉mo bslad/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉bcings par/127༷ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉nyanas/1271 17〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wagal te gang gis thob pa'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyug du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazod/ pya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉yod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1108)26wa 1272

༄7/ /man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ sna༄yi/ /rgya gar skad du/ dwa da sha u pa de sha gā thā/ bod skad du/man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems ni zhi ba ste/ /de la gnas pa gang yin pa/ /nam mkha' bzhin du zhi bar 'gyur/ /lus ngag yid las byung ba yi/ /de la cung zad 'gyur ba med/ /yang dag ye shes las 'das pa/ /rnam par mi rtog zhi bar 'gyur/ /rtog pa zhi ba sangs rgyas nyid/ /de nyid rnam pa mkhyen nyid do/ /dngos po dngos po mthong nas ni/ /de ltar rnam rtog gang byung ba/ /de ni rtog med ye shes yin/ /'gro ba tha dad 'dzin phyir ro/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /thams cad du ni so sor gnas/ /de dag la ni khyad par du / /nga rgyal med cing rmongs pa med/ /de phyogs phyogs gcig dngos po la//bdag tu 'dzin pa ji ltar yin/ /dud 'gro la sogs rang bzhin no/ /phyogs 26—1273

gcig tsam las gang byung ba/ /de yi ngo bor bshad par bya/ /yang dag sems kyis gzung bar byos/ /stag ni phug na gnas pa dang / /sbal pa stong pa chen po dang / /bye la ba spu ldang ba dang / /ba lang la sogs lus po sprug /sbrul la bza' ba med pa dang / /bya rnams mkha' la 'go ba dang / /srin bu me khyer 'od 'phro dang / /rnga mos sbrul rnams 'gugs pa dang / /rma bya skom las rgyal ba dang / /bung bas dug rnams zos pa dang / /chu byas dbang po bsdams pa dang / /seng ge 'jigs pa med pa dang / /'ug pas mtshan mo mthong ba dang / /bya rgod rin chen rtogs pa dang / /sbrul gyi dug ni byed pa dang / /rma byas dug rnams za ba dang / /ngur pas ma 'ongs shes pa dang / /ne+e tsho tshig la mkhas pa dang / /sbrang bus rjes rnams sdud pa dang / /dud 'go la sogs rang rig 'gro/ /ngang pas chu dang 'o ma 'byed/ /bung ba'i skad ni shin du snyan/ /chu skyar mchil grems sems can 'dzin/ /sbrul gyi mig gis thos pa dang / /ri dwags las ni gla rtsi 'byung / /gu —na sa ni mig gis snom4 / /chu yi nang na gnas pa'i nya/ /srog dang rtsol bas 'gog par byed/ /tshul ngan bzlas pa bram ze yis/ /ye shes mchog 'utu thal bar 'gyur/ /stag la sogs pa'i srog chags kun/ /snga ma'i bag chags las byung ba'i/ /rang bzhin yon tan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dag 'jig rten ye shes can/ /dka' thub ma yin grol ba min/ /snga ma'i bag chags las byung ba'i/ /de dag so sor gnas pa yin/ /de tsam ye shes yin na ni/ /dud 'gro rnams kyang gol bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes te zhen spangs nas/ /yang dag ye shes spyad par bya/ /gang gis byang chub dam pa dag /dngos grub dam pa 'byung 26—1274

༄/ /rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/hūṃ/༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ swa a dhibyu na kra ma/ bod skad du/rang byen gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag la byin kyis brlab pa'i cha'i khyad par bstan pas sprul pa sgyu ma'i bdag /dpal ldan rdo rje sgeg mo nyid la lhag par rol pa'i ro gang ci yang rung / /rdo rje bdud rtsi dpal ldan gang la gang gis bstod pa de lta'ang 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin na / /ji ltar brjod pa 'di las gzhan su bcom ldan de la kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang yang mngon dga'i rgyal ba'i sku mdzes gcig pu nyid/ /su yang mkhas rnams snying gar gnyid sad mi 'gyur ba/ /gang zhig shar bas mnyam pa'i dus na dbang po dang / /yul rnams bcas pa nub pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la spros pa dpal ldan bde ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i mtshon 'dzin cing / /gang zhig cha byad spros bral dri med shes rab rang bzhin kun du 26—1276

'gro / /dpag bsam lcug mas mngon mtshungs gnas gsum nyon mongs dra ba kacod pa gang / /dpal ldan rdo rje tshig mtshan btsun mo de la kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rdo rje yan lag ma zhes kun nas dran pas kyang / /nyon mongs bral ba'i bde ba 'ba' zhig sar ni bde 'gro ba/ /de la mi phyed gus pa'i khur gyi lcid kyis mgrin smad nas/ /de yi zhabs kyi pad+ma'i rdul la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bka' drin zer gyis spros pa bdag gis de nyid ni/ /rin chen 'od kyis bskor bas mun pa'i tshogs ni rab bcom zhing / /rnyog med mig gis rang gi rnam par rol pa ring mthong ba'i/ /bla ma rnam par snang byed de la yang dag 'dud/ /gang zhig srid pa dang ni zhi gnas 'gram du dga' ba rgyu mthun 'bab/ /ye shes nam mkha'i chu bos yid rgyas dpal ldan bla ma gsum pa nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sgeg mo btsun mo'i tshogs rnams shes rab pha rol phyin rang bzhin/ /gang zhig gnas gsum ston pa gcig pu dam pa'i dbang phyug dam pa'i sems la bdag skyabs mchi/ /gang gi lhasems ni mnyam pa nyid kyi yul du 'jog cing dug 'dra ba'i/ /'khor ba bcud kyis len gyi mi rnam par mdzad pa rang dbang sngags 'dra ba/ /gang gi zhe sa ste dbang po'i blo yi sa min 'gro gsum khang chung gi/ /dri ma 'khrud nas gcig pu bla ma dam pa'i ngag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gang dran par yang dag gnas pas snying ga pad+ma'i mdud pa ni/ /dbugs 'byin grol bar sbyor ba'i bla ma'i bka' lung de des ni/ /nyi phyed 'od 'dra'i tshogs kyis gnas gsum khang bu'i mun 'joms shing / /rmongs dang 'gal la bdag ni dul bar bcas pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul 'di cung zad dran pa yi/ /yon tan spros pa yongs su gyur pas 26—1277

dpal ldan pa/ /mi bde ba yi bdag nyid kyang ni mchog bde bar/ /gal te grub na 'di las bsgrub —1bya gzhan med do/ /bdag ni bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul la gus dang ldan pas rga shi dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs mda' 'dra'i zug dru'i tshogs 'dis ngal ba med/ /lus can rnams la ye shes bdud rtsi skal ba ma bgos mi nus pas/ /gang zhig bdag gis spyad pa de ni 3yongs su gdung ba che/ /blo yi yul min des na gang gi spyod yul min/ /gzhi yi gtam gyi rim pa bla mas gsungs pa ring / /de yi rim pas snying rje la sogs yon tan dag /dad ldan rnams la snying gi gnas su rang nyid skye/ /dngos po 'di kun gcig pa dang / /du ma'i rang bzhin cha bral te/ /'di ni zhen pa'i sbyor bral bas/ /rtsol ba'i rnal 'byor rnam par 1'gyur/ /sru langs myu gu'i tshogs kyis rab dga' yi/ /mchi mas mig gang 4snadze+e ma bkrus nas su/ /ches bstan zhegus pa'i khur gyis mgo 'dzin ni/ /dpag bsam bla ma dam pa la 'dud do/ /gsal bar spyi bor lag sngar cung zad byed/ /rab dga' bcas pas 4nor 'dzin yan lag 'khyud/ /yang dag gus pa'i skud pas yid kyi me tog ni/ /mdud par brgyus pa'i bdag gi phreng ba 'di bzhes shig /mgon po khyod kyi bka' gnad nyung 'dus shes rab ni/ /rgyal po'i bu mo cha las — 7mkhas 'dra dbang du byed/ /'gro ba rnams kyi rang bzhin rol pa'i ro yi bde ba ni/ /'ba' zhig rjes su myong ba de ni yid gcig shebasod nams can/ /lang tsho'i snying rjes brlan pas khyod kyis sngon med lam gsungs pa/ /'gro ba hūṃbagrod bya med dang 'gro med ces bya ngo mtshar che/ /gang du gom pa bor ba tsam gyis mnyam med bde ba'i rgyun bcas pa/ /gang tshe srid dang zhi ba cung zad tha dad 26—1278

ma mthong ngo / /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa ra ha chen pos mdzad pa bdag byin gyis brlab 41pa grub pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po pa srishān+ta bha dra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis btā/ra cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1276 nyamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gcu/ /rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bzhu/gas so//1277 419〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stonas/1278 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrubs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'di ni/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnal 'byor/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / 57〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtan/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyus/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig 10〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/1279 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ 〈〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1110)26wa /279

༄/ /de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtse mo do ha'i glu zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ tata twa rngu.u pa de sha shi kha ra do ha shrī ha dunā ma/bod skad du/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtse mo do ha'i glu zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma g.yos sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la//rdo rje rtse mo cig car glu blangs don/ /gang tshe lhan cig skyes pa dag /go ba dgu yis rtogs par bya/ /rgyu mtshan gzhal bya la sogs med/ /dngos po rnams kyi kho na nyid/ /dgag dang sgrub pa med pa ste/ /dbye ba la sogs med par bshad/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams ④gnyen po med/ /'chal ba'i tshul khrims ser sna dang / /le lo khong khro rnam par g.yeng / /ma rig spang bya la sogs dang / /spong byed pha rol phyin pa med/ /dngos kun med par bshad pa ste/ /rtog med snyam sems kun dang bral/ /'khor ba las gzhan phyag rgya che//gasbug kyang phog par ma bshad gang / /de nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam/ /26—1280

'dod yon la sogs ma smad pas/ /'bras bu re ba med pa ste/ /sku gsum lam kyi ngo bo gang / /ci phyir zhe na mi rtog ste/ /kho na nyid ni ji ltar rtogs/ /gzhan la mi re gang gis phar/ /rin chen gter dang rgyal po'i dkor/ /phal pa yi ni bang mdzod bzhin/ /mchog tu gces pa rang la gnas/ /sems las ma gtogs phyi rol don/ /gcig kyang yod par ma bshad de/ /sems nyid kun du 'od gsal ba'o/ /de bas sems las gzhan pa'i chos/ /yang dag par ni brtags na med/ /dngos kun zung 'jug rang bzhin la/ /skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /ngo bo ma skyes stong pa gang / /gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ /gnyis dang yod med tha snyad bral/ /gcig dang du ma la sogs kyis//brtags na med pa ma yin te/ /yod pa ma yin med ma yin/ /rigs ①pas 'grub pa ma yin no/ /dngos por snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /ngo bo nyid las ma 'das te/ /rgya mtsho gzugs brnyan me long bzhin/ /dran med dbyings nas kun 'byung bas/ /rang bzhin nyid du dus der rig /gnyis med gnyis su med min pas/ /ma 'das dbyer med ro gcig la/ /gcig tu gzhag par bya ba'ang rnged/ /dngas ma de nyid ma bslad pa'i bu/ /kho na nyid kyis gar ma g.yos/ /kho na nyid kyi 1shes pa la/ /'dzin pa med de ngo bo bral//cir yang mi 'dzin chos kyi sku/ /ngo bo nyid la dbye ba med/ /'dzin pa'i cha nas brtags pa gang / /skye med dbyings kyi rang bzhin la/ /zung du 'jug pas tha mi dad/ /sgro skur bral bas gnyug mar bshad/ /gzhal yas khang dang mtshan dpe dang / /sna tshogs sprul sku gang ston pa/ /gdul bya lam la zhugs pa'i stobs/ /mda' bsnun dag gis gang smras pa/ /'di la dmigs su rdul 26—1281

tsam med/ /phyin ci log gi skye bo la/ /nyon mongs yul gyi dug 'gyur te/ /ji ltar snang ba'i rim pa yis/ /dbyer med tshul du gnas pa ste/ /'od gsal ba nyid rnam par bshad/ /rang bzhin med pa'i ngo bo bral/ /tha dad ma yin gnyis su med/ /khams gsum blo 'das ye shes la/ /'di zhes bya ba'i ming ngam brda/ /mda' bsgrun dag gis gzung dzo du med/ /dbyer med ro gcig ma rtogs na/ /gnyis su snang ba'i chos rnams kyis/ /gal te bskal par rnyed mi 'gyur/ /mchog gi go 'phang mi 'thob 2ste/ /kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin la/ /dgag dang sgrub pa ngang gis bral/ /gnyis med ngang las ma g.yos pas/ /gang 'dir yid kyi ye shes ni/ /gcig kyang bral ba ma yin no/ /lhan cig skyes gang bde ba'i ro/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bdag nyid de/ /chu bo'i rgyun dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur dus rnams kun du gnas/ /rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs mtshan ma'i blos/ /nam yang shes pa ma yin no/ /bsam drad yul la brtag tu med/ /yul med bsgom par ga las 'gyur/ /bsgom med nyid kyang yod ma yin/ /dpe yi don la gang dris pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la'ang 4mnyam/ /bro gar glu dang rol mo yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du sgra sgrogs shing / /rnal 'byor mas ni g.yon nas bskor/ /dmigs gtad 5bral ba'i rang bzhin kyis/ /'bad pa med par kun du spyad/ /gnyis su snang ba'i rtog pa thams cad bcom gyur nas/ /brjod med rnam med 'bras bu thob 'gyur shog/ //rnal 'byor gye dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha'i zhal 6nas gsungs pa/phyag rgya chen po de kho na nyid rtse mo do ha'i glu zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //26—/282

— kṛṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi tas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //te bsdur mchan/128༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉non /man ngag rtse mo do ha'i glu bzhugs so// (〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tā/ rī 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang /1281 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig 45〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/1282 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thob/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang /nye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 snga/1283 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 kṛṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi tas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1111)26wa 1283

༄ / /dngos po spyong ba zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha phyab sañtsar nā ma/ bod skad du/dngos po sbyong ba zuzhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po med la dngos por shes/ /dngos med skye ba yod ma yin/ /rtag tu skye ba dngos po nyid / /dngos 'khrul nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos rnams ni/ /skye ba mkha' dang mnyam nyid mchog /thams cad rang bzhin gyis mkha' mnyam/ /des na srid pa dam pa'i dngos/ /rgyu med 'bras bu med pa ste/ /las kyi rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /'jig rten pa med 'jig rten med/ /'di dag thams cad bden ma yin/ /ma skyes pas ni dngos po gang / /ji ltar gzhan las shes par 'gyur/ /mo gsham gyi ni bu nyid kyang / /de tshe skye bar 'gyur byem yin/ /'jig rten gzod nas ma skyes te/ /gang gis kyang ni sprul ma yin/ /don med 'khrul pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /zla ba bzang 26—1284

—ngo/'i grong khyer bzhin/ /'jig rten rnam par rtog las kye7'byung / /rnam rtog sems las byung ba ste/ /gang phyir lus las sems byung bas/ /de phyir lus 'a/ rnam par brtag /gzugs stong tshor ba rang bzhin med/ /'du shes re/da cing 'du byed med/ /sems byung med cing byedangos po med/ /de phyir mi rtog rang bzhin no/ /des na sems min chos kyang min/ /lus min khams la so/gas pa min/ /gnyis su med pa'i lam 'di ni/ /de nyid rig pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /dmigs pa med pa'i chos 'di kun/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu bstan/ /dmigs pa med pa'i blo byas na/ /dmigs pa med par 'gyur ba yin/ /sbyin dang tshul khyems bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan las byung bsten par bya/ /dus mi ring ba nyid na ni/ /bla med byang chub thob nga/ra 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs la gnas gyur pas/ /sems can kun la brtse bar bya/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog /lha nyid dus mi ring bar 'thob/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam ste/ /tha snyad tsam du rab tu 'jug /dngos po med la tha dad pa'i/ /brjod bya yod pa ma yin te/ /bdag nyid gang dang gang gis ni/ /chos rnams gang dang gang brtags pa/ /de ni de la yod min te/ /chos rnams kyi ni chos nyid de/ /ming gis ming nyid stong pas na/ /ming la ming ni yod ma yin/ /chos rnams thams cad ming sked pas/ /ming ni btags snyepa tsam nyid do/ /mi bden par gyur chos 'di dag /brtags pa nyid du rab tu 'jug /gang la brtags pa de med na/ /stong pa nyid du brtags pa gang / /mig gis mthong ba'i gzugs rnams ni/ /de nyid rig pa zhes de bshad/ /'jig rten log pa'i nga rgyal can/ /kun 26—1285

rdzob bden pa zhes 'dir 'jog /gang du tshogs pa'i rkyen mthong ba/ /'dren pa gsal bar gyur pa yin/ /blo dang ldan pas don dam la/ /brtags te grags pa nges par mthong / /gzugs ni mig gis mi mthong zhing / /yid kyis chos rnams mi rig pa/ /'di ni mchog tu bden pa ste/ /'jig rten gang gis kyang mi shes/ /dngos po sbyong ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba rma ban chos 'bar kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o zu26—1286

༄ / /tshigs su bcad pa byed dang lnga zhes bya ba/hūṃsngal/ /slob dpon klu sgrub snying po'i zhal snga nas/ /re ba'i dpe ni ser skya 'dra/ /dog 2pa rgyal bu gzhon nu ste/ /gzhan du 'dzin pa smig rgyu chu/ /bdag 'dzin phung byed nyi zer gzugs/ /snang ba gnyis ldan ne+e lha'i bya/ /dor ba thur ma 'khru/ la pa'i gzugs/ /lta bas nga rgyal chos kyi wa/ /sgom la der 'dzin a nu lta/ /spyod pas nga rgyal 'dzin na pa/ /dka' bas zlos sems bzang skyong bu/ /dbang gi bu grol 'dod kos la/ /rtogs pas chog zer dpal gyi bu/ /bla ma bla bral bla med gaṅgā jemo/ /bka' la skur 'debs kṛṣ+ṭa 57pa/ /bde bas grub 'dod thangs bzangs glu hūṃ/ /stong pas de bzhin gdol pa dza3/ /de rnams bral ba'i shes pa ni/ /nor bu rin chen thob pa 'dra/ /sngon yul wā rā ṇa sīr khyekhyim bdag pra mo ha dang / ser skya mo gru spyan mo gnyis//chu bo ne+e 9rañdza na'i 'gram ne+e'u sing pos te/ngad can du dus byas pa las mos 26dod1288

nyin mtshan lnga zhig tu bsdad kyang 'ongs par ma gyur to/ /de nas yi mug ste ma'i drung du phyin pa dang / mas smras pa/ kye bu mo mdangs rab tu zhum par gyur pa ci'i phyir zhes pa dang / bu mos smras pa/ kye mtshan mo gnyis dang gnyis gsum bar/ /khyim bdag gzhon nu la bsdad pas/ /yid gdungs pas ni yi chad gyur/ /zas dang bral ba lto ba ltogs/ /zhes zer ba la/mas 'bras chan pa na li gang byin pas/ myur du zos pas glo ba'i sul du song nas mgo 'khrugs so/ /de nas sman pa bshes gnyen chen po la bltas pa dang /'di dag ni tshul ji lta bu yin zhes pa dang / gong gi tshul bshad do/ /sman pas smras pa/ gang gis gang la re ba ni/ /zhi bar mi 'gyur bder mi 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'phel ba ste/ /re ba med pas bde ba'i mchog /'di dag ni re bas phung ①bar 'gyur ba bstan pa ste/ re ba med par bya ba'i man ngag ste dang po'o//rjo //sngon gyi dus na rgyal bu mgron bzangs zhes bya ba zhig la/ yab thu bo'i stobs kyi byergyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur te/ kye rgyal bu sgo srung ④la nan tan gyis shig khri gzhan la ma shor bar bya ba la brtson par kyis shig ces smras nas tshe'i dus byas par gyur to/ /de nas chos sbyin byed pa'i dus su bram ze mdun na 'gro rgyal po'i pho brang du byung ba la khri phrogs kyis dogs te langs nas sgor 3bya ba la phyin pa dang / nu bo 'gro bas rten pas khri phrogs so/ /de nas ser skya mas/ khyod 'o na 'bad par 'gyur ba ci'i phyir zhes pa dang / rgyal po nas 'ubabs kyis smras pa/ bdag la yab kyis gdams pa bzhin/ /khri 26—1289

stan shor gyes dogs pa na/ /sgo yi bya ba la phyin pas/ /nu bos bdag gis bde ba phrogs/ /zhes pa dang bram zes smras pa/ dogs pa dang bcas sems kyis bde mi rnyed/ /nyam nga dang bcas rtag tu bde mi 'gyur/ /gang la dogs yod de 'jig hūṃ/yod pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dogs pa spang par bya/ /dog 2pa dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste gnyis pa'o// //sngon ri bya rkang la/ dge slong sog ma med kyis sngephyin pa dang / rab tu skom gyis gdungs par gyur pa la/ smig rgyu zhig chu ru 'khrul te/ 'thung du phyin pa dang / rab tu ngal bar gyur nas sngo'i ldum bu za zhing 'dug pa la/drang srong rkang mig ltegis smras pa/ bgrod dka' 'khor ba'i thang chen la/ /gzhan du btsal 'dod mi dag ni/ /nyon mongs tho bas gdungs 'gyur te/ /skom 6pa smig rgyu'i chu 'tshol 'dra/ /zhes so/ /de dag ni bsgom hūṃbya spang bar bya ba'i man ngag ste gsum pa'o// 3 //sngon rgyal po brla skyes la/ btsun mo lnga brgya la bu stong yod de/ sras nam ga ru drang srong dpal dga' mo bslangs te/ de gabyug bu med pas rab tu gces par byas/ rgyal bu yang bdag 9la ni gces pa med de/ bdag la ni sdug bsngal zug rngu cung zad tsam yang byung bar phangs pas/ bdag tshe'i dus byas na 'khor thams cad phung bar 'gyur ro snyam sems so/ /de nas nang par zhig khrus byas te/ khang bzangs kyi bhertse mor kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ nyi zer la mig cung zad btsums nas bsdad pa dang / nyi zer gyi gya gyu la dur khrod 26—1290

byung bar mthong nas/ bdag la dri mas gos par 'gyur snyam nas bros pa dang /khang bzangs kyi rtse mo nas lhang ste/ che'i dus byas so/ /de nas dge bsnyen sgo gros bzang pos smras pa/ bdag tu 'dzin pa ches pas sdug bsngal 'byung ba ste / /bdag bde 'dod pas gzhan gyis gnod pa byung / /bdag tu 'dzin nga/ yongs su dor byas nas/ /sems can kun kyang sman pa bzhin du bya/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste bzhi pa'o//lha //sngon dze ta'i tshal du rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa dang / bdud nag po lha/ sbyin gnyis bya ne+e lha'i lus gcig las/ mgo bo gnyis su gyes pa cig tu skyes pa/ra gyur to/ /de nas lha sbyin —7mgo bo gnyid log pa'i dus su/ don grub kyis shing gi rtsa ba srog thupa dang / sman yang chosmra dang / dug ha la gnyis rnyed pa/ la/ bcud ni mnyam por phan ro ni bdag rang myang ngo / /zhes nas sman zos pa dang / bdud lha sbyin sman gyi gregs pa byung ngo / /de nas rab tu khros pas lha sbyin gyis dug zos pas gnyis ka phung snyebar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyes smras pa/ de nyid mthong ba'i mkhas pa yis/ /sman lha 'i bsod nams mi bslang zhing / /dug lta mi mthun dor mi bya/ /blang dang dor bas phung 'ubar 'gyur/ /blang dor dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste lnga pato/ sngo /sngon grong khyer ser skyar bram ze nyi ma sbyin zhes bya ba la/ rims nad sel bar nus pa'i/ nor bu chen po mu sa ra ga — la ba zhes bya ba yod de/ khyim 26—1291

bdag de la khyim thab gnyis yod pa las/ gnyis ka la bu med par gyur nas/grong khyer bde ba can du khyim bdag mo sa man+ta zhes bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i dus btab nas phyin pa dang / sngar gyi khyem bdag mo gnyis phyi bzhin du byung bar gyur to/ /de nas shing sdong po rul pa cig tshogi khong du gab bo/ /de nas khyim thab gnyis phyir log pa dang / khyim thab mo sa man+ta dang sprad 1nas nyal ngo byas pa dang / khyim bdag gi mgo'i cod pan la gser gyi thur ma gnyis gyen du 'greng ba la/ mig yor gyi mi gnyis su 'khrul te bram ze la smras pa/ kye bzhin bzangs snye'o skol ni mi gnyis kyis nye ba nyid du non nas gda'o zhes pa dang / bram zes smras pa/ de ni nga'i khyim bdag mo gnyis lags te/ 'o skol gyi spyod lam rgyal po la smras na/ nges par chad pa gcod par gyur pas 4sa phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros la gshegs so zhes na/ na dpe'i tshal du phyin pa dang //thur ma yin par dengo shes te sa man+ta rab tu 'khrul pa la 'gyod pas smras pa dang /khyem bdag mo sa man+tas glu blangs pa/ 'o skol mi yis skrag nas bros pa dang / /'khor ba dor bar 'dod na sgrub pa 'dis/ /dang po gzhi stong pa nyid nas sdug bsngal byung ste/ gnyis med la gnyis su brtags pas gdungs par 'gyur—/ blang dor dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste drug pa'o//༷ //sngon mi yul ma ga dha na bhutshos ma ko'u 2ri ma zhes bya ba gong khyer kyi mtha'i spyil po cig na/ ngur smrig gi tshos blugs 'upa'i bur snod cig gi nang du kha shing los bcad —7de/ mo rang gi me tog thur phyin pa dang / dur khrod kyi wa cig gis tshos kyi steng du phyin pas sdib ste/ lus tshos kyi mdog gis sbangs so/ /26—1292

dur khrod du phyin pa dang / spyang ki dang phrad nas/ kye che zhe mchog tu gyur pa khyed su yin zhes pa la/ mo na re bdag ni lha'i ri dwags sha ra na zhes bya ba yin te/ lus dri dang mdog tu ldan pa'o/ /de nas dom dang stag dang spre'u dang / seng ge rnams la spyang kis ched du brjod pas hūṃkun kyang 'khor gyur to/ /de nas zla ba rgyas pa nya'i dus su ma'i drung du phyin te/ nga ni mchog go/ /bla na med pa'o/ /phul lo/ /ri dwags kyi rje mor gyur pa'o/ /zhes pa las/mas smras pa/ kye bu mo/ tshad ma'i she chu las khrus byas nas/ /dman cho pa'i sa la gnas na bde/ /rgyud ngan lpags (chopas nga rgyal ba/ /yun du 'grogs na phung 6snabar nges/ /zhes brjod pa la/ pags pa'i nga rgyal gtong na du ma btub pa'osnye// /de nas log ste gcan gzan kyegyi tshogs su phyin pa dang /rang gis skad btang bas rkewar gyur cing / seng ge'i skad btang bas /cebargyal lo / /de nas ri dwags gcan gzan thams cad kyi spu tshom pa re btogs te rtug pa dang bsres so/ /de nas lha'i bu rnams kyis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/sems kyis stobs kyis mi 'gro zhing / /pags pas nga rgyal 'gro byed pa/ /rgyun du bde bar ma gyur te/ /spu dang bral bas wa nyid phung / /bde bas 'bras bu bsgrubs ⑩pa la/ /zhe 'dod med pas mi 'gro zhing / /grub mtha' nga rgyal 'gro byed pa/ /wa bzhin thal bar brlag par 'gyur/ /rang gi lta ba nga rgyal ba dang bral bar bya ba ste bdun pa'o//ny-i ne+e //sngon ko sa la'i yul du/ dge slong ya shu ha zhes bya ba cig gis/tshogs drug 'gegs pa'i bsam gtan byas pa las rlung 'byung 'jug 'pho ba dang 26—1293

bral bas lo lnga brgya rnyed thub po/ /de nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal bo dga' sbyangs mdangs kyis smras pa/ dge slong khyod ①kyis sems la ltos/ /shes rab pha rol phyin drug ma/ /tsam du mi gnas 'di sgoms la/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa thong / /zhes pa la don la be+er skur pa ⑤btab nas sngar gyi 'du shes med pa la zhen pas/ lha tshe ring por skyes so/ / de nas ①mtha' 'khob rgyal por skyes so/ /de nas yang skyeskye ba dran pas bstan pa la skur pa btab nas/sngar gyi 'du shes med pa la zhen pas/ lha tshe ring por skyes so/ /de nas yang skye ba dran pas bstan pa la skur phyepa btab pa dang / dngos su sas thongs phye nas / mnar med pa'i dmyal bar song / de dag ni sgom pa dmigs pa dang bral bar bya ba ste brgyad pa'o//⑪ //sngon bram ze 'dzin na spyopa zhes bya ba bsil khang na nyal ba'i rmi lam na/rigs kyi bu gtsang ma'i spyod pa long cig /⑪las byang chub mchog tu bskyed / nas / shes rab dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa lnga ni mchog ma yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming tsam yang mi thob po/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni brjod du med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes brjod ⑫kyang mngon pa'i zhen pa dang ma bral lo/ /de bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs nas / srid pa'i rtse mo'i bde ba thob ste/ slar ngan song du lhung ngo / /spyod pa'i zhen pa dang bral bar bya ba ste dgu pa'o//skye //sngon rgyal po bzang skyong bya ba'i bu mos/ dge slong ma skye dgu'i bdag mo 26dod1294

—'es bya ba la/ lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod kyi sgo nas/ lo drug tu bsnyen bkur byas so/ /tshogs kyi lam rtags bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i spyod pa bcu phrag gnyis su byas so/ /dus ji snyed du thos pa yang de snyed du sbyangs pa las/dge slong ma dpal mo zhes bya bas smras pa/ kye bdag gis 'khor ba thams cad kyi snying po/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid khyod la sbyin gyi/ khyod 'khor ba'i dogs pa las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro tshozhes pa dang / bu mos smras pa/ kye dge slong ma snga ma'i dga' ba de rnams kyi 'bras bu mchog go/ /de las mchog tu gyur pa'i 'bras bu ni mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ kho mo mi 'dod do 'es pa dang / dpal mos smras pa/ chos kyi gsung nyid mi shes par/ / 'bras bu 'dod pa'i dka' thub dag /rgyal po dag 3gi pho nya bzhin/ /dka' bas mang yang don chung 'gyur/ /dka' bas mang po byas pas 1chog nga/ra 'dzin par ④bya ba ste bcu pa'o///hūṃ //dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud las/ dpal mchog dang po dbang las 'byung / /lus ngag yid kyi tha ba dag /dbang gis rab tu smin byas na/ /dpal mchog dang po thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la rgyal po ko sa las mthong nas / rgyal po in+d+ra khyu ti bye la/ dbang lan bcu bdun du byas so/ /de nas rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti④/ kye rgyal po dam pa ni sa bon lta bu'o/ /rgyun du goms pa ni chu lud kyis myu gu skyed pa lta bu'o/ /spyod pa ni lo tog 'os su rung bar byed pa lta bu'o/ /des na rgyal po chen po sgom pa goms par bya bar rigs so zhes brjod kyang / sngar gyi lung gis nges par kha lo snasgyur du ma btub po/ /der 26—1295

mkha' 'gro mas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ dbang gis ye shes mtshon byas shing / /'os su rung bar byar 'dod kyang / /goms bral chu shing 'bras bu ltar / /lan cig skyed na zad 'gyur nyid/ /zhes pa'i phyir na goms par bya'o / /dbang kho nas chog par 'dzin pa dang bral bar bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o 1 //dpal ḍo bi po7te ru ka'i slob ma shrī sdeng nga zhuzhes bya ba zhig gis/ mkha' 'gro ma dang / rnal 'byor pa pho mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshogs pa'i dus su smras nga//chos rnams stong par rtogs rgepa yis/ /de yi mtha' la sgom du med/ /gal te sgom na dman 'gyur te/ /dper na rgyal po rgyal por ni/ /slar yang 'dod pa med pa bzhin/ /budhe thams cad stong pa khyenyid du gcig par rtogs nas sgom mi dgos/ sgom sogs sbyin sreg thal ba 'dra/ /zhes pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis/ kye budhe'i gsang ba ④yongs su 'phrogs par byed pa'i log sred can khyod nyon cig /tshes gcig gi zla ba mthong bas/ nya gang ba yin nam byis pa btsas thog ne+enas stobs rdzogs pa nyid dam/ sa bon btab pa nyid nas 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa nyid dam/ rgya mtsho nang gi nor bu mthong bas lag tu yong ba sh+yinyid dam/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis sems can gyi don nus pa nyid dam/ zas mthong ba tsam gyis bkres pa sos bopa nyid dam/ ma rig (1pa'i phyir/ rtogs pa'i gtso bo la gags goms pa'i 'khor gyis mnyes par bya na/ zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /rtogs pas chog par 'dzin pa ni srun pa'o/ /phyi rol pa'o/ /bdud kyis mngon sum du 26—1296

—byen gyes brlabs hūṃpa'o/ /rang nyid phung bhe bar byas pa'o/ /zhes nas bsad de mkha' 'gro ma'i longs spyod du byas so/ /rtogs pas chog par 'dzin pa dang bral bar bya ba ste 1bcu gnyis pa'o//④ //rgyal po dharma phyepā la'i bu mo gaṅgā mo zhes khyebya ba zhig gis/ de bzhin sashegs pa'i mdo rgyud thams cad bltas pa las/ rtogs pa ji lta ba skyes te bsgoms so/ /de nas byang chub chen po la srin pos tsumachod pa'i nub mo/rnal 'byor pa thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed pa'i sar gaṅgās phyin pa dang /rnal 'byor pa thams cad mkha' 'gro mas byin gyis brlabs nas/ lus 'degs so/ /ngag gis spro ba byas so/ /yid kyis kun du zhe sdang bar byas so/ /de nas gaṅgā mo'i sngar gyi rtogs pa sked par gyur nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la smras pa/ kye bdag gis 'os su ma rung ba ci byas pa/ khyed kyis bshad du gsol zhes pa dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis gsung mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ bla ma las ni dngos grub rnyed/ /rig ma las ni bde ba 'byung / /bla ma bral ba'i dngos grub ni/ /khri phrag 'bad kyang thob mi 'gyur—/ /gzhan gyis dngos grub 'byung byed pa/ /dug dang bcas pa'i zas bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyis bye 'tshe ba dang / /bar chad sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya bas dad par byas so/ /bla ma la ma ltos khyepa spang bar bya ba ste bcu gsum pa'o//bye //ka rna'i rgyal po'i bu kṛdzha ⑪ zhes bya bas/ dbu ma mchog tu byas te/ bka' 26—1297

——dang bstan bcos thams cad la tshoskur pa btab pa dang / byang phyogs kyi gnod byin 2gyis bzung nas/ smyo bar gyur te/ de nas yab rgyal pos sngags mkhan rnams la zhu ba byas te/ bgegs bskrad pa'i sbyor ba byas pa dang / dpal na ro pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas dgongs pa dpag bsam shing lta bu'i gsung das la / /sems can blo'i 4theg pa sna tshogs byas/ /phyogs med phyogs su 'dzin pa'i bdud chen gyis/ /'di dang ma 'ongs gnyis kar slu phyabar 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i blo la thams cad bden pa nyid/ /don dam yul du gang yang yod ma yin / /de nyid rnal 'byor sems su dbyer mi phyed/ /bka' la skur pa 'debs pa dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /de'i phyir bka' mtha' dag la skur nga/ mi bya ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o//6 //rgyal po thang bzangs )glu zhes bya ba zhig /dpal kadza la la dbang blang ste akhyan 7gyi dur khrod na/ bde ba bsgom zhing 'dug pa las/ dur khrod kyi yi dwags thams cad kyis/ bar du gcod cing sems rab tu g.yengs kyeso/ /de rnal 'byor ma legs smin ka ra la zhus pa dang / des smras pa/ las kyi phyag rgya bde ba'i gru/ /stong pa'i skam sa rnyed nas ci byar yod/ /bcos ma'i bde la bcos ma'i yid zhen na/ /'khor ba'i mtsho chen rgal bar nus ma yin/ /zhes pa/ lha lcam la rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis ched du brjod pa ⑫byas so/ /bde ba la zhen pa spang bar bya ba ste bco lnga pa'o// 7 //gdol pa dza zhes bya ba zhig gis/ slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pa la brten 26—1298

—rte / don dam sems la dmigs pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa phyogs gcig pa bsgoms 2pa las/ chos thams cad brten med du zhen par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yul dz+wa lan dha hūṃrar/ rims nad kyis mi phal cher che'i dus byas so/ /lo tog thams cad ser bas bcom mo— ༷/ /lo lngar char ma bab nas/ bram ze gsang tshig mkhan la dris pa dang / sa phyogs 'di ni mi nang pa sangs rgyas pa 4 gnas nas/ phyi rol gyi grub mtha' gsang bar smra ba la phyogs te gnas pas/bkra mi shis pa sna tshogs byung ste/ 'jig rten 'di la gzhan phung zhing / /ma 'ongs pa la rang phung bar byed do zhes pa dang / dpal ku ku ri pas thos te/gdol pa dza' drung du byon nas smras pa/ dang po dngos po'i chos rnams ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis bzlog par bya/ /stong pa nyid la zhen ches nas/ /dngos 'dzin pas kyang phung ⑤bar gyur/ /dug sbrul shi na dar ya kan/ /dug la sngags btab sman gyi mchog /gang la rgyas btab bde 'gyur phyir/ /zhen pa thong 9/la gnyis med sgoms3 / /zhen nas dbang gsum pa mdzad do/ /de ltar slob dpon klu sgrub kyis 'das pa'i dpe bcu brjod pas/ mdo rgyud dang mthun pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas su 3rig par bya'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dpe drug brjod pas grub pa thob pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen par rig par bya'o/ /rkyen ḍabacu drug dang bral ba'i shes pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ nor bu rin po che dang 'dra'o/ /slob dpon klu sgrub snying po'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa phyed dang lnga zhes bya ba pya /rdzogs so// //dpal gyi ri la mnga' bdag chen pos/ rje btsun ri khrod kyis gnang 26—1299
