༄/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa/tshosnasngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ ni ra bi n+dekalpa pra ka ra ṇa/ bod skad du/rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang dang gang brtags pa/ /yongs su brtags pa 'di nyid dag /rang bzhin yod min pa kho na/ /slob dpon klu sgrub zhal snga yi/ /lam las phyi rol song gyur cing / /legs par mngon pa'i thabs med pa'i/ /kun rdzob de nyid bden pa las/ /nyams pas thar pa'i dngos grub ni/ /yod pa ma yin de dag nyams/ /gang zhig las las byung ba yi/ /rnam par rtog pa gang ci'ang rung / /de dag spangs pa'i rang bzhin las/ /mya ngan 'das pa gzhan na ni/ /yod min yul ni gang du yang / /rnam par mi sems bdag nyid do/ /gang yang dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis / /sems la bde ba 'byung gyur cing / /nyams su myong ba'i sar phyin pa/ /26—1302

de yang kun du rtog pa tsam/ /gang de 'dod chags bral ba yi/ /rang gi ngo bo de dag dang / /gnyis po gang yin pa de ni/ /srid pa'i rgyu yi mchog yin no/ /dngos po dngos po las mi skye/ /dngos po dngos med las kyang min/ /dngos ngo/ skye ba rtag tu spangasahūṃ/ /dngos 'khrul nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos rnams kun/ /skye ba mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid/ /rkyen ni mkha' dang mnyam kun nges/ /srid par gyur pa bden pa yin/ /rgyu med 'bras bu med gyur cing / /las kyi rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /'jig rten pa re/da 'jig rten med/ /mi brtan 3par gyur chos 'di kun/ /ma skyes pas ni dngos po gang / /ji ltar gzhan las shes par gyur/ /mo gsham bu yi bzhin — —yang ni/ /de ltar shes par mi nus so/ /'jig rten gzod —nas ma skyes te/ /sang gis kyang ni sprul pa med/ /don med 'khrul pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /dri za'i gong khyer ji bzhin no/ /rnam rtog las gang 'jig rten 'byung / /rnam rtog sems las byung ba ste/ /gang phyir lus las sems byung bas/ /de phyir lus la rnam par brtag /gzugs stong tshor ba rang bzhin med/ /'du shes sked cing 'du byed kyis 5/ /dngos po yod pa ma yin te/ /rang rig gsal ba'i bdag nyid do/ /de la shes dang shes bya med/ /sems dang sems las byung ba med/ /'byung ba sgemed de de yi phyir/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin no/ /de ni sems min lus kyang min/ /khams rnams ma yin chos kyang min/ /gnyis su sked pa'i lam mchog 'di/ /de nyid rig pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /dmigs pa med pa'i chos 'di kun/ /dmigs pa med las rab tu grol/ /dmigs med blo yi ngang byas na/ /dmigs pa med par 'gyur ba yin/ /26—1303

rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po ār+ya de wa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma hā kā ru ṇa dang / bod kyi lo tsā 17ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1302 nyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄7/ /rnam par mi rtog pa rab tu byed pa ār+ya de bas mdzad pa bzhugs/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉rba/13༷3 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bden/ ༷/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bu/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazod/skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spre/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/13༷4 ta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1114)26wa 1304

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ do ha ko ṣa nā ma/ bod skad du/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ srid dang zhi ba phyag rgya chen po ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis mkha' ltar rnam par dag /mtshon bya'i gnas lugs med pas tha snyad tshig lam chad/ /rang bzhin spros med ngo bo ltos chos kun dang bral/ /brtag dang dpyad du med cing mtshon pa'i dpe dang bral/ /dpe bral nyid la'ang mi gnas blo yi yul las 'das/ /rtag min chad min 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa min/ /snang min stong min dngos dang dngos med skye mred min/ /chos nyid gnyug ma ma yin blo las 'das pa'ang min/ /min pa'ang min zhing yin min blo yis brjod med phyir/ /gnyis chos gang dang 'byel med gzod nas mnyam pa nyid/ /ngo bo nges tshig byed pa'i las rnams 26—1305

bshad pa yang / /ri bong rwa brdzun de yi rno rtul brdzun dang mtshungs/ /chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid de dang khyad par med/ /ji ltar snang zhing srid pa'i kun rdzob chos can rnams/ /ngo bo nyid rnged ming tsam sgra tsam btags pa tsam / /ming dang don la khyad par bye brag cung zad med/ /gdod nas lhan cig skyes pas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /sems nyid ming stong spros bral phyag rgya chen po ste/ /nam mkha' dzorang bzhin gdod nas ming stong yin dang mtshungs//ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes mtshan ma'i spros dang bral/ /mkha' ltar kun la khyab cing 'pho dang 'gyur ba med/ /dus rnams kun du stong zhing ye nas bdag med de/ /dran rtog mtshan ma med de smig rgyu'i chu bo ltar/ /ma bcing 2/ma grol gnyug ma'i ngang las ma g.yos so/ /sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i sprul pa la/ /sprul pa'i ngo bo ye nas skye med chos kyi dbyings/ /bde sdug la sogs gnyis snang mtshan ma thams cad kyang / /chos nyid gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa'o/ /rol pa nyid la bden med mi brtan 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /gnas lugs stong pa'i rgya las nam yang ma 'das so/ /kha cig dbang bskur ba yis yongs su gdung bar byed/ /kha cig hūṃ phaṭa zer zhing phreng ba yongs su bgrang / /kha cig bshang gci khrag dang khu ba sha rnams za/ /kha cig rtsa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom ste yongs su 'khrul/ /e ma ho/ bla ma dam pas zin pas cig shos 'di ltar rtogs/ /gang yang 'khrul pa yin phyir yang dag rtogs pa med/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed med pas phyogs ris mtha' dang bral/ /bral dang ma bral med pas mnyam nyid gnyug ma'i ngang / /'di ltar rtogs na 1nges par gzhan du dri sa med/ /sna tshogs chos skur gsal bas spong len sems mi 'byung / /26—1306

—bsgom dang mi bsgom med cing mtshan mas gos pa med/ /snang dang mi snang yul la nam yang brten mi byed/ /bya dang byed pa'i sems rnged dmigs pa kun dang bral / /re dang dog 1pa'i sems med kun la zhen pa log /bla mas bstan nga/sa gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rtogs gyur na/ /dran rig sna tshogs chos kyi dbyengs su rang rlag ste/ /rnam shes yul la mi gnas chags zhen kun bral bas / /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du chos kun grol bar 'gyur/ /kun la ma chags nga rgyal la sogs dri ma bral/ /gus par ldan zhing dam pas yongs su zin pa dang / /gang yang yid byed bral na dri med the tshom med/ /shes dang shes bya dag pas chos nyid mngon sum 'char/ /gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po rtogs par ma gyur na/ /rtag tu gnyis 'dzin dbang gis kun la zhen gyur pas/ /bsam rig rab rib sna tshogs rgyun du skye 'gyur zhing / /ma nor don la mi gnas srid par 'khor zhing 'khyam/ /snyan grags bsnyen bkur kun la chags zhing zhen pa dang / /thos bsam go rtogs che dang nyams myong bzang po dang / / dngos grub byen rlabs zunus pa'i rtags byung bcos ma'i 4lam/ /don gyis thudri ma yin phyir mkhas pas yid mi gtad/ /de nyid yid la byed cing gnyis mtha'i phyogs lhung na/ /'khor bar 'khor zhing srid pa'i rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ /kun gye gzhi rtsa yid kyi ri bo gang yin ltos/ /bltas pas ma mthong yid dang bral na sdes par grol/ /sems kyis khuchos kyi dbyings la 'di zhes med pas na/ /de la sgom dang bsgom par bya ba gnyis su med/ /yod med cir yang mi rtog ma yengs ngang la zhogasngo /stong pa nyid dang skye med blo las 'das pa dang / /mtha' bral la sogs gang yang yid la byed pa na/ /gnas lugs don la mi 26—1307

gnas shin tu yengs pa'o/ /stong dang mi stong rtsis med lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /gzhag dang mi gzhag med par rang dga' yan par thong / /btang dang bzung ba'i sems med ro langs ji bzhin gyis/ /de nyid gnas lugs rig nas de yi ngang gnas na/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma'i bag chags myur du 'jig par 'gyur/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la mi gnas mtshan mas g.yengs gyur na/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma'i bag chags ldog par mi 'gyur te/ /rab rib can gyi mig gi nang du shes gyur kyang / /mig gi nad ma byang bar rab rib snang mi ldog /gnas lugs yid la byed cing nyams la 1zhen pa dang / /de nyid don la goms 4shing bsgoms na gol ba'i rgyu/ /mthun 'jug rnams la chags sdang skye phyir 'ching ba'o/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan thams cad dngos grub dam pa ste/ /mi mthun rkyen gyis rna'/ 'byor nyams kyi gsal 'debs phyir/ /rkyen ngan mi spang de nyid shes pas de la sbyang / /de ltar skyong zhing nyams rtogs mthar 'byin spyod pa ste/ /gyi ༄ —ling drag la be+eg gis bsgul ba ji bzhin no/ /gal te rtogs ldan nyams bzang spyod pa'i gogs med na/ /ji ltar mi ldan skyes bu dag ni rkang pa med dang mtshungs/ /don dam rnal ma chags med don la sbyad bya ste/ /mi spang mi sgrub mi zhen mi spyod mi 'gog par/ /rang lus rgebyu bder spyod pa rab mchog dam pa'o/ /kun rdzob sangs rgyas mi ro'i gdeng chen ldan gyur kyang / /sems can tshogs chen mi spang ci nus 'bad par bya/ /'khor ba dag la dog 5pa'i sems rnged 'jigs bral yang / /sdig pa'i las rnams phra mo dag nas 'dzem par bya/ /chos rnams stong pa mkha' ltar rtsa bral rtogs gyur kyang / /chags sdang 'dzin chags mtha' dag rtsad nas spang bar bya/ /chos nyid mtha' bral zang thal chen po'i 26—1308

don rtogs kyang / /brtan pa ma thob bar du nyams rtogs gzhan la gsang / /don dam bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa 1rtogs gyur kyang / /kun rdzob 'gro la phan pa'i don chen dag la bsam/ /'dren pa gzhan la mi ltos gdeng 2dang ldan gyur kyang / /bka' drin can gyi bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur/ /chags shing zhen par bcas pas kun la dgag sgrub byed/ /rgyud dang mi 'tsham 'gal ba'i spyod pa gol ba'o/ /mthong bya mthong byed med pas tha dad rang sar grol / /nyams su myong mkhan stor bas rtsol sgrub kun dang bral/ /thob bya'i 'bras bu stor bas re dog gekun las grol/ /nga bdag rtsad nas thon pas bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal/ /dngos 'dzin rang sar zhig pas 'khor 'das kun la 5grol/ /rig pa gzhi 6la dag pas rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes brjod/ /chos zlo zad sar zad pas mya ngan 'das zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ /ma bcos ma bsgyur spangs thob kun las yongs su grol/ /e ma ho/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya 7zab mo'i sgra chen de/ /gdags gzhi gang yin stong pa zhes bya'ang btags pa tsam / /skad byug ngo bos stong par bdag med su yis rtogs/ /rtog 8mkhan nyid med ming tsam sgra tsam 9btags pa tsam/ /de nyid yang dag ma yin gdul bya'i snang ba'o/ /gdul bya nyid la'ang bdag med sgyu ma sprul pa 'dra/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes bya byis pa'i blos brtags 7so/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul zhes bya ming tsam btags pa tsam/ /'khrul par tshor zhing rig pa'i skyes bu su zhig yin//'bras bu myang 'das rdul tsam med cing mi dmigs na/ /grol dang ma grol zhes bya glo bur sgro btags te/ /nam mkha' zhi zhing dag la med pa grol lam ci/ /kun rdzob don dam zhes bya'ang nan gyis btags pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings la 26—1309

bden pa gnyis med chos dbyings med/ /do ha mdzod ces bya ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bai ro tsa nas rang 'gyur du bsgyur ba'o// //brgyud pa ni birlu pa/ nag po pa/ slob dpon sgra mkhan zhabs/ slob dpon pu ra pa/ shrī bai ro tsa na'o// //bsdur mchan/13༷5 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄7 /do ha mdzod rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gi bi rū pas mdzad pa bzhugs so//13༷6 nyu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pakha'i/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra cings/ gru〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/13༷7 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesags/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rlag snye〈〈pe 〉ra sags sgrub byin rlabs/ 〈〈snar 〉snga sags sgrub byin brlabs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉ba'i/ ka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ khye〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gshanag13༷8 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanamigs/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ je〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thugs /thu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈jer 〉shesags/13༷9 hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ltos gdengs/ rngo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉misgrub byed/ /rgyu/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesags/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rolas/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ba 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ ḍa〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gisgra tsam/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tags/26—1310

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ do ha ko ṣa/ bod skad du/ do ha mdzod/dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dbang po rnams/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ma lus de las byung zhing de ru thim/ /lhan skyes dngos dang dngos med gtam mi 'dri/ /stong pa snying rje de ru ro mnyam 'dod/ /yid la ma byed gnyug ma'i rang bzhin la/ /brdzun pa rnams kyis skur pa ma 'debs shig /rang dbang yod pas rang nyid 'ching ma byed/ /sems la mya ngan 'das pa rgyob 'ul sod/ /khams gsum stong pa gos pa med la 'jug /sems ni mkha' 'dra mnyam pa'i bde bar zhugs//dbang po yul rnams skad cig tsam ni der mi mthong / /thog ma spangs shing 'di ru tha ma spangs/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs kyis gnyis med bstan/ /semasani gang du zhi gyur pa/ /der ni rlung yang thim par 'gyur/ /rang rig pa yi de 26—1312

par bya/ /bdag nyid 'gro ba bdag nyid sangs rgyas te/ /bdag nyid dri ma med cing bdag nyid yid la mi byed pa/ /de la 'gro ba med cing gos pa med/ /yid ni rje btsun nam mkha' rje btsun ma/ /nyin mtshan du ni gar byed lhan cig skyes la rol/ /skye dang 'chi ba dag las grol bar 'gyur/ /gnyug ma'i yid la rgyun du gnas par gyis/ /'bab stegs dka' thub nags la ma brten cig /khrus dang gtsang sbras bde ba mi rnyed do/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug lha/ /byang chub rang la 1yod bzhin gsum la bkur mi bya/ /lha rnams ma mchod 'bab stegs ma 'gro zhig /lha rnams mchod kyang thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis sangs rgyas mchod par gyes/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das la gnas par ma byed cig /shes rab thabs kyi ting 'dzin zhugs/ /gang tshe g.yo bar 2brtan par byed nus na/ /de yi tshe na nyams myong 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar dug ni zos par gyur pa las/ /dug gis kyang ni 'chi bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de ltar srid pa zos kyang rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod yon gyis ni 'ching bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kye ho rnal 'byor pas ni las la skur ma 'debs / /skad cig bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi ru de ru song / /skad cig dga' ba de yi bye brag shes par gyis/ /mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid spangs pa shes par gyis/ /kye ho mchog dang dga' bral 'di ni dpyad par bya/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs la gus par gyis la legs par long / /gang zhig dga' ba mchog dang dga' bral gyicho/ /kye ho skad cig der ni lhan skyes rtogs par bya/ /yon tan rin chen dpral ba'i klad rgyas gzhag bya ste/ /'dod pa mo'i ze'u 'bru las ni 'di nyid shes par bya/ /skad cig bye brag de ru lhan skyes gang shes pa/ /26—/314

—de ni tshe 'di nyid la rnal 'byor par brjod do/ /thog ma tha ma gzung ba 'dzin nga/ spangs/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs kyis gnyis med bstan/ /mi g.yo dri med rnam par rtog pa med/ /shar ba nub pa spangs pa 'di ni snying po yin/ /'di ni mya ngan 'das par rab tu brjod/ /yid kyi nga rgyal gang du chad gyur pa/ /skyon dang yon tan spangs pa 'di ni don dam mo/ /rang rig la ni gang yang med/ /sems dang sems med rtag tu spongs/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes 1snapa'i rang bzhin du ni gnas par bya/ /skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /rtsa ba med cing rtse mo med//'ong ba med cing 'gro ba med/ /gang du yang ni mi gnas so/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis ni snying la chud/ /kha dog spangs shing rig med pa/ /snang ba thams cad de la rdzogs/ /yid ni sod 1la sems ni rtsa ba med par gyis/ /sems kyi lhag ma zug rngu thong / /'di ru sku bzhi phyag rgya bzhi/ /khams gsum ma lus de tshe dag /bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum stong / /dri ma rnged pa'i lhan cig skyes pa la/ /dge dang mi dge gang yang med/ /yid ni gang du 'gro 'dod pa/ /de la 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /mig ni mi 'dzum pa dag gi 4 / /bsam gtan gyis ni gnas par bya/ /slob dpon chen po te lo pas mdzad pa do ha mdzod ces bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar lho phyogs ko sa phyalar sku 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po mkhas pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje'i zhal snga nas rang 'gyur du gsungs pa'o / / //26—1315

11( 0༄7/ /tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa zhes bya ba/17sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa gā thā 2nā ma/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu zad pas rni 'dam gyi pad+ma skams/ /sbrang rtsi bros pas gar song cha yang med/ /rtsa ba lo ma sdong po me yi sbyor bas zad/ /nag po na re dbang po'i bzhad gad la ni ltos / /za zhing 'thung dang gnas nas yal ga bcag nas song / /kye ho 4'di ni bdag gi las ni gtum mo lta bu yin/ /rgyun gyi bu mo lta bus pad+ma bsregs / /yon tan brgya ni skyon gcig gis ni zad par byas/ /rgya mtsho zad pas pad+ma rnams kyang skams/ /de tshe sgo bcu las ni du ba byung / /'jig rten pa ni nag po med ces zer/ /nag po theg chen zab mo'i nags na gnas/ /sems ni stong zhing gnyug ma'i ngang du sgogs/ /phung po bzhad 5gad gyur kyang 'gyod pa med/ /'o ma'i nang na mar yod pa ni mi mthong bzhin/ /'dod pa 26dod1317

yod de 'jig rten pas ni ma mthong ngo / /'jig rten 'tsho ba 'am ni 'chi ba gang yang rnged/ /'di lta'i longs spyod nag po rnal 'byor pa/ /pad+ma bzhin du lus cha skams gyur kyang / /nag po ci yi phyir na shi zhes bya/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i slob dpon chen po nag pos mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa rdzogs so / / //rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī bai ro tsa na badz+ras bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1317 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉go /tshigs su bcang pa lnga pa bzhugs/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mirga kyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rdzad/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ho/ rngo〈〈pe 〉)〈〈snar 〉sngagazhad/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1117)26—1318

sprebargyad byu rtsa bzha pa/ 1sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bi rū pa pa dā tsa tur shī ti2/ bod na/da du/ dpal birlu pa'i tshig rkang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bla ma mchog gi zhabs la 'dud/ /gzhung 'di lhan cig skyes pas 'phros nas byung / /des ni rga shi rnams la bzhad gad byas / /sems ni mi g.yo brtan par rtse gcig bya/ /des na bsam bya bsam satan dkyil 'khor phyag rgya med/ /de rnams bsgoms pas rnam par dag mi 'gyur / /lta stangs 'ching 4dang las rnams byed pa dang / /sgo rnams dgag nga/ra bya ba ma yin no/ /des ni lhan cig skyes pa'i lam mi shes/ /gang zhig sbog dang rtsol ba gang ba can dang ni/ /bum pa can gyi rlung la bstod byed pa/ /5gang gis lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du ni/ /gtum mo sbar 6bar byed cing nan tan gyis/ /sgo bcu la ni sgo lcags 'jug par byed/ /gang zhig spyi bor 26—1319

—pad+ma dkar po bsgom/ /rmongs pa des ni dang po'i thar pa mi rnyed do/ /dri' can rkan dang sna rtser bsam byed dang / /steng dang 'og dang bsdoms nas shing btsugs dang / /mgrin pa'i phugs su 'od zer 'bar byed dang / /dpra'/ bar zla ba rtag tu sgom byed dang rte/ /nam mkha'i rtse mor mi g.yo'i sna rtser bsgom//la la 'og tu pad+ma rdo rje lta/ /la la u 2rgyan 'ching zhing 'degs par byed/ /la la tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi sgom par byed/ /la la rang grib stong par byas nas chas 4la lta/ /la la dkyil 'khor til kyi 'bru tsam bsgom/ /la la bar snang sku gzugs sgom byed pa'i/ /byol song rnams ni rang nyid chos rnams shes/ par smra/ /de rnams kyis ni skye ba 'bras bu med/ /blo rnams zad cing sdig nga rnams la spyod/ /des ni lhan cig skyes pa'i cha 5yang ma mthong ngo / /de ni nam mkha' dang ni sa 'og dang / /sa steng gyedang ni tshangs pa'i gnas su'ang med / /dman pa'i slob dpon bsten par ma byed cig /des ni sdog pa'i las rnams ma spangs par/ /kha ni 'gul zhing 'gul zhing re la gnas/ /rang gis stong pa snying rje byed par rtsom/ /des ni srid pa spong 7thabs mi shes so/ /stong pa snyeng rje rtogs zhes zer zhing gnas/ /dpal ldan bde chen gtam yang mi 'dri'o/ /la la dbang phyug u ma re la gnas/ /bdag nyid srid pa'i 'ching ba'i zhags pas bcings/ /la la khu ba khrag dang rnam snang za/ /bya rog bya rgod bzhin du bdag nyid 'khol/ /la la gnas gsum skad cig gsum du bsgom/ /la la snying ga'i pad+ma 'khor lo 'chang / /la la hūṃ phaṭa zer zhing phreng ba bgrang / /byol song rnams ni 'khrul pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /dbang dang dbang bskur mang po gsungs pa rnams/ /bla ma rnams la slob mas len par 26—/320

byed / /de nas brtsams shing 1slob ma rnams la 'chad/ /dbang bskur gyi ni phyogs kyang ma mthong ngo / /la las gser 'gyur rtsi ni lta byed pas/ /des ni byem pa rnams ni dbul por byas/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mi bde ba la sbyar/ /nags la skyes pa'i rtswa dang shing rnams dang / /shing lo me tog rnams kyis skyid ma bstan/ /dus su bsam gtan 'jig rten pa rnams byed/ /des ni mchog si thar pa mi shes so/ /cal col mang po smras pas ci zhig bya/ /ji ltar smras nga/ de dag thams cad brdzun/ /gdams ngag pa rnams gsal po'i gnas lugs nyon / /gang gis gsal por thar pa grol ba rnyed/ /sems ni g.yo zhing smyon pa lta bur thong 2/ /skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa gsum po rtogs par gyis/ /mgul rgyan dang ni phyag rgya ma lus thong 1/ /des ni mgon po ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten pa ni yi ge rnams la gtod/ /yi ge med pa de ni snying la ma chud do/ /gdams ngag pa rnams nyon cig ngas ni bshad par bya/ /khams gsum bor nas dpal ldan jeg pa che/ /dang po'i mgon po la ni dge dang mi dge med/ /ma lus khyab cing bde chen stong pa nyid/ /byed pa 'phrog pa rang nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /zad pa med cing gzhan du song ba med/ /de ni mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyis ni ting 'dzin skyes byas kyang / /dang po'i mgon po de ni ma mthong ngo / /de lta'i sems ni snying la ma chud do/ /de la lus dang ngag dang yid med de/ /dpa' bo dri rnged de ni nam mkhar thim/ /birlu pa yis 4sems can don du byas/ /don dam 'di ni gdams ngag pa rnams nyon/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal bi rū pas mdzad pa'i tshig rkang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 5pa rdzogs so// //26—/321

༄khya/ /lam 'azas gsung mdo bzhugs so//—1sna༄na / /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de/ /lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya/ /sems can la nyon mongs pa'i snang ba la ma dag pa'i snang ba2 /rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba'o/ /kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud sogs la gdan sogs gsum pa bzhi yis rgyu'i dbang / lam du bskyed rim la sogs lnga pa bzhis bstan / mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig sogs bsrung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs kyi jenyams chags bskang / 'dod yon sogs lnga yis mnyes pa sogs bya/lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'dag chocing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ 'bras bu'i dbang bzhis thams cad mkhyen to/ /tshad ma 26—1323

bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab nas/ 'gal 'dus skyon med sogs gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / zas spyod lam/ rlung thig le/ phyag rgya ma bsten / dngas ma lnga'i bde ba dang / dbang po lnga nyams dang ma bral bas bdud rtsi bsten/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dang / 'khor lo rnams dang rka/gzhan rnams dang / sa thog mtha' la re re/ gsum pa bcus bar gyi rtsa mdud dral bas la dor/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgoms pas lta ba'i dug dbyung / rnam shes lngas yul lnga ma spangs pas2/bdud rtsi bstan / dag pa'i chos rnams gdod nas stong par shar bas la dor/gsang sngags snyan brgyud 4la sogs bzhi ma chad pas/ lus khyad par can la brten nas dngos 5po'i mtha' rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'byel byang chub chen po'i lam/ chos thams cad rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba lo rgyus kyis 6tshad ma'o/ /kun gzhi rnam shes dag pa'i byang chub chen po / rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba lnga yis lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi bar chad ni/ dad pa brtan pos srung 7ba'i 'khor lo/ sngags zlos/ sngags mdud/ chos rnams sems nyid snang ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'byel/ gzugs brnyan yin phyir/de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i don dang ma bral bas bsrung / shes rab la phyi'i bdud lam gnyis/ lta grub brgyad rgyur byeba'o/ /nang gi bdud lam la sogs bcu dang brda ma shes na 'od brda shes pas bsrung / grib dang sgrib pa thig le 'dzag pa bsrung / /tshogs lam nas tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid dang bral bas bral ba'i 'bras bu bzhi thabs 9nas/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyis phyogs med rnams 26—/324

dang / rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs nas/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun ltar lam bgrod na/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ las kyi rlung pho mo/ ma ning gi rlung / thod rbal gyi ye shes kyi me 'bar bas/ khams 'dus pa dang po/ rgyun gyi rlung po lag ca can gyis rtsa dral/ sems gnas/ rta rmi/ rtsa rlung gi zug 'byung /sna tshogs 'dud la sogs bzhi 1rtsa ba'i rlung la sogs zin pa'i bye brag bdun gyis yan lag gi rlung rim gyis zhe7nang du 'gag /de tsa na thig le mang du kha 'bu—/ rten mnyam du 'dre de la brten — nas sems nang du gnas/ rnam thes lnga nang du 'dus/ phung po lnga dul/ ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed/ bsgom 4pa/ mi 'chor ba'i mthong snang rmi lam nyams gsum gsum ni rnam rtog sngon du song ba ltar khams gsum kun du snang ngo / /sa chu la thim na smig rgyu/ chu me la thim na du ba/ me rlung la thim na srin bu me khyer/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim na mar me 'bar ba/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim na nam mkha' sprin med lta bu/ sa chu me rlung dang rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na khams gsum kun du me 'bar ba lta bur snang / chu rlung dang sru lus grang / rlung gi rlung 'du 'phro dang rang 'phur bya 'byung / 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang lha/ mo sna tshogs kyis gar mchod dang dri rothu/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang lha mo sna tshogs rtenam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang spu lus bde/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bzhin gshegs sgu sogs/ sih+la dang nyi ma/ ga pur dang zla ba/ rtsa bran rnams su thig phran dang skar ma/ rtsa 'dzin la sogs su shing sdong la sogs/chags sdang rnam pa lnga dang / nyam nga mya ngan 'dre'i rtsa/ mchi ma'i rtsar g.yal 26—/325

——dang mchi ma/ lte bar dang po chags pa'i rigs drug gi yi ger rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na/ rigs drug gi gar sngags der khrid pa/ rmi lam nyams lta bu khams gsum kun du snang ngo / /oṃ las bsam gtan sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin yum gyi mkha'/ a rna1las yang dag par thim na khams gsum nam mkha' yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la sogs kyi pho brang du thim na chos sku nyams su myong zhing gzung 2'dzin grol/ hūṃ las gsal zhing yang la rang 'byung gi ye shes nam mkha' shin du dri ma med/ khams 'dus pa bar pa rlung po lag ca bri bas rtsa dral/ thig le'i gzugs dang mthong snang brten no/ /mdor na rak+ṣa la sogs su srin po sogs dri 4can kyi sgra lha'i mig rnam par das pa bzhin/ srid pa'i rtse mo man cad ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams su 'byung ba snyam byed pa/ bshad kyis mi lang ba mtshon cing lnga bcu la gsang / sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i phyi'i rten 'brel rlung log sogs gsum gsum ni/ nang gi mkha' 'gro ma lnga de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lnga/ byang chub chen po'i rten 'byel mdzad pas/dngos grub rnams rang la 'byung bar shes shing re zhing stsol ba'i blo sel to/ /bdud dang gol sa rnams rang gi lam dang rten 'byel du shes pas skyon yon tan du bslang zhing rim pa yin min du skye ba'i dod byung rgyal du gtang / shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i lam la/ lha'i bu'i bdud 'ong bas 5sad pa bzhis bsrung / sgom pa mi 'tsher ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ni/ yul 'gags pas rang yi dam gyi lha dang / gug skyes kyi dgos pa bsam zhing ting nge 'dzin cha bsnyams 6pas/ khams 'dus pa tha ma rlung po lag ca dral 7bsartsa bral / skye mched drug gi nang du thig le 'dus pas rjes su dran pa drug yang 26—1326

—dag par shes/ sprul sku 'ga' mthong / sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i yang dag par spo/nga ba bzhi ni/ sprul sgu las dbang gsum gyi rjes las byung ba'i shes pa bsam 'ing / dgyes sogs bang can bcu gnyis ma'i rtsa btsal 7zhing / snying po'i a/ kun 'dar snyegyi sna rtser dal rgyu la sogs rig pa yid 'jug pas/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje skyil ga krung bcas/ thig le rlung non pas rnga sgra la sogs mi thos pas/ chog shes pa sogs kyi bdud choms pa'o/ /nang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam srid pa'i rtse mor phyin cing ma skyes pa'i chos la bzod dka' ba stong pa nyid kyi bzod pa'o/ /dbu mar sems rtog med log sems 'phos na bzod nga/ / 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing / mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos rnams rdzogs pas chos rnams kyi nang na mchog go/ /de ltar nyams skyon can skyon med dang / phyi dbyibs kyi a nas yar rlung sems mnyam par 'dus nas 'a/ma du 'byung ba rnams ngo bo rang mtshan nyid do / /4 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ phyi nang rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba'i lam gyis sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ spyod pa'i rim pa'i lam nas cholus dag par byed pa bum pa'i dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rtsa rin po che'i pho brang bzhi / gtso bo gsum ste lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong bas rtog pa'i 'go ldog byed / sprul sku'i zhing khams brgya bsgul zhing nyan6/ sbyin brgya/ 'od brgya 'gyed/ mar brgya 'chad/ ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba brgya la snyoms par 'jug nus/ rigs drug gi rtsar khyad par du mi'i rten mthong nas dga' la g.yang za/ ngo tsha la sgyug bro/ sngon bla mas rgyu dus na bstan pa'i 'khor 26—1327

—'das dbyer med de tsa na rtog1 /snying rje skye/ mchi ma ltung / gzhan gyi sems sna tshogs shes/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas dgod bro/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs skad cig mas 'byung ba rnams nang gi zhing khams mthong bas so/ /nang ma mthong bar phyi mi mthong / de tsa na ling ga brtan/ rdo rje rtser lhan cig skyes pa'i sar thig le gnas pa ltar/ lus bde bas myos shing brgyal/rang gzhan ngo mi shes/ nang rtags rlung sor gcig 'gags/ phyi rtags gsang gnas phyed thig les brtan /thus dang po'o / /1 yang sprul sku las dbang 4bzhi sgom lam sa gnyis pa nas sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams stong la sogs pa bsgul ba la sogs pa nus/ yon tan la sogs 'phel/ 'gro ldog la sogs 'gags//nang rtags rlung sor drug 'gags/ phyi rtags gsang gnas te4/ snying thig les brtan/ longs sku 'ga' mthong / sgom lam sa drug go / /7yang longs sgu las dbang bzhi bzhi bdag byin gyis brlab 8pa'i rim pa'i lam nas/longs sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ ngag dag pa gsang ba'i dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags dbang po lnga dang dngas ma'i rlung lnga la mnga' brnyes/ nus pa lnga dang lta stangs rnams la thogs pa med/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du rigs drug gi sa bon mthong / sa bon drug la mnga' brnyes/sems can rnams kyi skad du chos ston cing chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la thogs pa rnged/ lte bar yi ge'i phyi mo brgyad/ ā li kā li mthong nas/ mdo sde'i chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la thogs pa med/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ro drug la longs spyod nus9/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa rnams a ni yig 'bru ces pa drug gis gsal lo/ /sa bdun yan chad longs sku'i zhing khams 26—/328

—'khor bzhi'i brgya dung phyur la sogs bsgul 1ba la sogs pa nus/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu 'gags/ phyi rtags mgrin smin thig les brtan/ sgom lam sa bcu'o —/ /2yang dbang bzhi bzhi/ sems dag la dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thabs kyi lam nas chos sku rang bzhin gyi rīlhun grub thob par byed pa/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags/ stobs lnga ni/byang chub kyi sems kyi rlung lnga bskyod pa'i dngas ma'i dngas ma/ rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas rtags bstan pa/ sku gsum ye shes lnga la sogs dbang thob nas/ bdud rtsi lnga gar 'du mthong nas 5sangs rgyas rnams gzhan don mdzad pa mthong / sprul pa bde chen thig le 'du ba mthong nakhu/sangs rgyas rnams 'og min gyi gnas na zab mo la bzhugs pa mthong / lte ba sprul par bdud rtsi lnga dang rlung lnga 'dus pa mthong na/ longs sku'i rigs lnga yu/ma gyi bha ga na bzhugs nas skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' la gsang ba sgrogs nga/ mthong / phyag rgya ma'i dngas ma'i dngas ma mthong na mngon shes la thogs pa sked / rtsa yig rnams su dngas ma 'drongs na rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med/ de nyid slar spos na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu gnyis 'gags / phyi rtags spyi gtsug tri la thig les brtan/ sa bcu gnyis so / /7yang dbang bzhi bzhi mthar phyin gyi lam nas mthar thug rten 'brel mthar thug 'da' ba/ rdo rje'i dba' rlabs kyi lam gyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rig ma'i skyes bu/ srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sgu rang bzhin gyi 8snalhan grub thob par byed pa/ bzhi pa lus ngag yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ni/26—1329

rnam shes brgyad 'dag kar 'bras bu gnyis thob 1ste/ sa chen dga' zhing rangs la mgu/ /de rnam pa drug tu g.yo/ bdud gnas su sgra grag /phyag rgya ma'i gnas su khams gsum mthong / mkha' 'gro ma rnams ring nas 'du/ /ha ri ma la sogs pa dbang phyug gi don brgyad 'char/ nang rtags srog rtsol a/ wa dhū /tīr 'jug /phyi rtags gtsug tor phyed thig les brtan/ sa phyed —dang bcu gsum mo / /5bzhi pa yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu'i phyogs gcig 'thob ste/ 'bigs byed gzhon nu'i grong khyer chos kyi dbyings/ /byang chub sems kyis ni 'bigs/ 'bras bu longs sku'i zhing khams rab bkram la sogs pa bsgul 6ba la sogs pa nus/ sa bcu gsum/ thob kar sa bcu ma la sogs pa yid kyis bkug ste/ slob dpon dus gsum bde 7gshegs bcud 'dus yin/ yi dam lha dang bla ma dbyer med la/ /bha gar dngos grub len pa'i rten 'byel gyis/ /srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa rang bzhin gyi 8lhun grub thob par byed pa/'bras bu mthar phyin de kho na nyid kyi rtags 9longs sku'i zhing khams ma lus pa la sogs pa bsgul ba la sogs pa nus/ nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhū tī'i 'gags / phyi rtags gtsug tor tri la thig les brtan/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyis sgom nyams kyis skyon yod rnged phyed pa sa bcu gsum pa'o / / 2thams cad mkhyen tesnya/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin sar rten 'byel 'grig pa ltar snang / 'tshang rgya kar 'khor tshom bu cig dang bcas te ri'atshang rgya'o/ /gsang sngags rdo rje'i jeg pa ni/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i dbang / /rtogs pas brtags pas rtog med rtogs/ /ye shes snang ba de bzhin no//26—/330

— 'a ma zab bla ma dam tshig lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dang man ngag du bcas pa rdzogs so// //she bsdur mchan/1 //23 sna—mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar
