bsad byas zhes pa ni yul la spro ba ste/ sems kyi rgyal po bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi ral gris mi snang bar byas nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la bdag gi snade kho na nyid kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lung las kyang / gtor ma'i mchod pa'i yo byad ni/ /gtor ma chen po dga' ba yin 2/ /zhes so/ /nge'i phyir sa wa ri — ni sems kyi rdo rje'o/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa rngo/ngas su btang nas nges par rig par gyur pa'o/ /de lta bur gyur pa ni thog ma/ dang tha ma med pa'i jebag chags kyi phyadon bdag gis bsal zhing bros par gyur pa'o zhes so/ /de bzhin du sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis kyang / rtog pa rnams 6nyams nyams las sangs rgyas su/ /blo ngan rnams kyis rjes su ston par byed/ /bdag las de nyid blo ldan rnams kyis ni/ /cis kyang mkhas 7las lhag tu ster bar byed/ / dpal ldan he ru ka'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i chu gter zab mo 'dus pa la sogs 'a/sa / /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i mgon gyi gsung bsrubs pa las grub pa gang zhig 'khrungs pa ni/ /dpal ldan de nyid bdud rtsi'i ro ru gyur pa rang la ston par byed pa'i mthar gnas pa/ /dpal ldan de nyid dpung gnyen 9 kyang ni rtag tu yang dag bsdus pa rnam par spyad pa rnams/ /bsdus pa de la rnam nga/ra dpyod byed pa/ /nye bar bsnyus pa spyod pa'i glu brgya la/ /sems can rnams kyis byang chub rtogs bya'i phyir/ /blo gros dad ldan rnams kyis dang mdzod mdzad/ /de phyed thub pas byin gyis rnam dpyad nas/ /slob mas yang dag rtogs par sabya phyir dang / /kun kyis kyang ni shes par bya ba'i phyir/ /mdzod kyi don ni rab tu gsal bar byas/ /skyes bu dam pa bshes rnams la/ /26—150/

thub pas byin gyis 'grel mdzad pa'i/ /bdag gi /rtsebasod nams gang de yis/ /skyes bu dam pa rgyal gyur cig /spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu de kho na nyid gsal bar shes pa'i skye bo rnams la slob dpon thub pas byin gyis 'grel pa mdzad pa las grub pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu 'grel pa dang bcas pa sgogs so / / //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po tīrti tsan+d+ra'i zhal snga nas gdams pa dang bcas pa legs par zhus shing / chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya pa khu dbon rnams kyi sku drin la brten nas bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du bod kyi lo tsā treb ban+de grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ro// //bsdur mchan/1389 tshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /spyod pa'i gru'i mdzod kyi 'grel pa bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉koṭ+wā pyu tī bristi/139༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacings/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zo'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thig 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i dga' bas/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dbyings/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi bzhi'i/1391 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'di'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(5sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi'agrob/ 〈〈pe〉snga〈sma ra 〉5 kyang / 5〈〈snar 〉〉rems/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// //1392 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stes/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/1393 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gil/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasnyung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ nga〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7'ardong yon lnga ni spang mi bya// zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi'adod yon lnga ni spang mi bya// 6/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaradzag1394 7 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ /〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi bsam gtan/1395 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dun/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉reg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgyug 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉phrojisas /5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jas/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi gnyis/ she〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar〉phro/26dod1502

slob dpon nā ga 1rdzu nas gsungs pa'o/ /de la chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ yid kyis/ mngon sum gyi yul gzugs yid du 'ong ba dang / sgra snyan pa dang / dri thim/ pa dang / ro yid du 'ong ba dang / reg yid du 'ong ba ste/ don phyi ro' du ma brtags pa shes pa'i snang ba tsam ste/ de la dang po dga' ba dang / /mchog dga'i lus kyi bde ba dang / phyi nas yid bde ba lhan cig skyes 4dga' ste / de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la dga' ba dang mchog dga' dang /lhan cig skyes dga' 'byung ngo / /de'i steng du lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po snang stong gnyis med bsgom mo/ /de la yid 5skyo na dga' bral du 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni de la bzhi ste/ gtum mo 'byed 'dzums dang / gtum mo mar me gso ba dang / gtum mo srub shing gi 'khor lo dang / gtum mo ba spu'i bu ga bsgom pa'o/ /de la dang po ni spu mtshams nas lte ba'i bar du mar me sor brgyad pa cig gyebasams nas/ bshang ba'i lam 'byed 'dzums byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa mar me gso ba ni sru mtshams nas lte bar phyin pas lte ba'i byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pas gso ba'o/ /gsum pa ni a wa dhū tī srub 7shing la la nā dang ra sa nā lte ba khrag gi thig le las me 8'bar bas snying ga'i byang chub kyi sems zhu nas bde ba chen po bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa ba spu'i bu ga ni lte ba'i dbus su bu sa phra mo 'khyel pa bsgoms la steng gi rlung mnan par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom pa dang ldan pa'i tshe sa chu la thim pas du ba lta bu mthong ba dang / chu me la thim pas smig rgyu lta bu mthong ba dang / me rlung la thim pas srin bu me khyer lta bu mthong ba 'byung ba dang / rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas nam mkha' lta bu 'byung ba dang / rnam par shes pa rtog pa yin te/ nam mkha' mi rtog pa la thim pas 26—1512

na / nam mkha' stong pa lta bu'i rtags 'byung ngo / /de la phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa ni/ rgya dgus gdab par bya'o/ /gzung ba med de rang gi snang ba yin pas rnam par snang mdzad kyi rgyas btab pa'i bde ba chen po dang / 'dzin nga/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin pas mi bskyod pa'i rgyas btab pa dang /sems rang rig gnyis su 1med par yang mi bsam ste/ bde ba chen po 2lhun gyis grub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas btab 1nga/ dang / bsgom par bya ba dang / sgom par byed pa dang / sgom pa po ro gcig pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyas gdab pa dang / spyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang rjes ro gcig par ro mnyam pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyas gdab pa dang / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis 'od gsal ba'i ngang du rgyas gdab pa dang /snod kyi 'jig rten dang bcud kyi sems can 4brtan pa dang g.yo ba rnams te ru ka la rol pas rgyas gdab pa'o/ /de ltar rgyas 5dgus snod bcud kun bde stong gnyis kyis rgyas gdab/ sems ni 'od gsal rgya mtsho las/ /glo bur dba' rlabs tshul du brtag /sems ni nam mkha' stong pa las/ /glo bur sprin gyi tshul du brtag /bsgom du med pa lhun grub bsgom/ /rtog pa'i dra ba ngang gis stong / /mngon sum tshad mas mthong ba nyid/ /shes bya rnal ma yin par gsal/ /rtog pa thams cad 'gog pa dang / /mi rtog ye shes ngang la gzhag6 /bsgom du med pa bsgom pa yin/ /lhun gyis grub pa bsgom pa yin / /rnam par rtog pa med pa la/ /rnam rtog med pa'i sgro mi gdags/ /dngos po gdod nas gnyis med la/ /gnyis med ces bya bsam mi bya/ /bde chenasgo )skur bral ba la/ /bral lo snyam du bsams na skyon/ /nyams myong 'od 26—1513

—gsal dag pa la/ /dag go zhes kyang gis mi bya/ /gis sems med pa gnas pa'i tshe/ /rtog pa rang gi ngang gis 'gag /chos dang gang zag bdag med ces / /rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid yin te/ /rtog pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal bar//shes na de tshe nyid na 'gagasahu)/ /gnyen po'i rgyal po mngon sum yin/ /gcig dang du bral gtan tshigs rnams/ /'od gsal shes na dgos pa med/ /glang po dngos su rnyed gyur nas/ /glang po'i rjes ni tshol byed dam/ /bde chen der snang mngon sum la/ /lus dang rjes dpag btsal mi dgos/ /myong ba dngos po'i gshis yin pas/ /chad par lta ba'i dogs pa med/ /gang la de'o mi sems pas/ /sgro 'dogs pa yi dogs pa med/ /snod bcud bde chen rgyas gdab pas/ /nyon mongs dgra las ldang dogs med/ /las la byed do bya'o zhes/ /dge sdig gang la'ang mi sems shing / /rmi lam las la khyad med pas / /ngan song gsum gyi dogs pa med/ /gang dang gang la sems pa na/ /bde chen der snang ngo shes na/ /gnyen po gzhan zhig btsal mi dgos/ /bya ba btang ba'i sems nyid ni/ /lhun kyis grub par rnam par gnas/ /ji ltar chu la chu gzhag dang / /ji ltar mar la mar bzhin du/ /rang gis rang gi ye shes ni/ /legs mthong gang yin 'di phyag yin/ /de nyid gnyis med mchod pa yin 3/ /gnyen po stong nyid lta ba 'di/ /sdig pa bshags pa'i mchog yin te / /ske dang grang ba'i reg pa bzhin/ /bde stong mngon sum 'di dang 'gal//rjes su yi rang la sogs dang / /chos spyod sdom pa'i nang nas kyang / /don dam byang chub sems 'di mchog /stong nyid mngon sum mthong ste mchog /dkyil 'khor spyin sreg bzlas brjod kyi/ /nang na bde chen dkyil 'khor mchog/26—1514

—sang dang gang la blo gzhag pa/ /de dang de ni bde chen du/ /shes na mal cha sta/na dag dang / /g.yog 'khor gnyen bshes snang ba kun/ /bde chen shes pa bsgo mas pas choganyu /snod ni gzhal yas khang yin la/ /bcud ni lha dang lha mo yin/ /'gro ba rigs drug bde gshegs drug /dmyal ba'i 'jig rten bde ba can/ /yi dwags dud 'gro bde chen gyi/ /ngang du shes pa lha yi sku/ /sems la bkag pa med pa nyid/ /gnyen po mchog tu kho yis mthong /dper na rmi lam gnas skabs na/ /bde dang sbug bsngal snang ba kun/ /sad par gyur pa ro gcig ltar/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i bde sdug kun/ /skye rnged ngang du mnyam pas na/ /rnal 'byor sems la blang dor med/ /dgra sdang rmi lam 'drar shes nas/ /chags sdang gnyen po bsgom mi dgos/ /sems kyi rang bzhin yongs shes na/ /chos nyid gzhan du bsgom mi dgos/ /dus gsum khams gsum tha snyad du/ /be+ems po glo bur yin shes na/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bcos mi dgos/ /skye 'gag nam mkha'i skra shad bzhin/ /snga phyi skye bas stong pas na/ /ma skyes zhes su bsgom pa med/ /rgyal ba'i thugs gzhi rtog med la/ /skye ba med pa zhes su bsgrags/ /gnyen po spang bya dbyer med kyi / /don la bya btsal med pa nyid/ /btang snyoms chen po bsgom pa'i mchog /dper na mi 'ga' btson bye byas na/ /de la 'bad rtsol gyis 'bros la/ /de nyid btson par gtad nas ni/ /'bad rtsol med par gnas pa bzhin / /nyon mongs 'bad pas bkag kyang ni/ /ched kar 'byung bar 'gyur ba la/ /de nyid bdag nyid lcags brngol nas/ /yul la rang dga' btang na ni/ /rang gi ngang gis 7rtog med skye/ /des na thabs la mkhas pa 26—1515

yin / /'bras bu lam du byed par gsungs/ /drun po yod med sbug bsngal kyang / /gdod nas skye ba ma myong la/ /mkhas pa 'gag pa sems la med/ /ched kar gnyen po bsgom mi dgos/ /rnal 'byor nang du kha bltas la/ /sems las ma gtogs myong med pas/ /snang srid rtag dang mi rtag la/ /bkag pa dang ni sgrub pa med/ /sems kyang ye shes yin shes na/ /mya ngan 'das pa bstan mi dgos/ /gal te chags sdang skyes gyur kyang / /gnyen po mi snyug byams sogs ni/ /'gro ba'i sems rgyud gnyis mi 'chang / /ji ltar sprin ni sna tshogs dag /nam mkha'i dbyings su thim pa ltar/ /dngos 1po 'od gsal slo bur bcas/ /phyis rgo rang gi ngang 'gags na/ /gnyen po dag ni su la bsgom/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis/ /sems la smig rgyu bzhin snang na/ /mi mkhas smig rgyu 'chos pa bzhin/ /gnyen po bsgom pa kye re mtshar2/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /skye ba nyid kyang mi brtan na / /glo bur rtag par ga la 'gyur/ /de bas gnyen po mi bsgom ste/ /gnyen po med cing bsgom pa'ang med/ /mtshan mar mi 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /'di dang 'di 'ga' sems pa rnged/ /'grib pa med cing 'gag pa med/ /'du mi byed pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /'du shes las byung ting 'dzin skyon/ /'du mi byed ces sems pa med/ /mngon sum rtog bral rgyun bsrings nas/ /bsgoms so zhes su tha snyad 'dogs/ /rtog med ye nas skye na yang / /sgro 'dogs sel ba bsgom pa yin/ /bcos med rang gsal ma byas na/ /nan gyis mi rtog bsgoms gyur kyang / /mi rtog pa nyid sgrib pa'i rgyu/ /dper na sman nyid ma zhu na/ /nad kyi nang na de nyid lci/ /'bad med bsgoms la sgro 26——15/6

——'dogs bcad 1ces bya/ /sgyu ma chu zla bzhin du shes med na/ /stong zhes brjod pas sems la yongs mi 'gro/ /sems kyi rang bzhin snang stong rtogs na ni / /'gro ba rnams la snying rje ngang gis skye/ /bdag dang gzhan dag dbye ba med par yang / /chu zla lta bur 2blo ni skye 'gyur na/ /bde ba chen po sgom zhes de la bya/ /gang zhig bha gar bde ba rtog med myong / /gang zhig me long gzugs brnyan snang ba dang / /gang zhig gtum mo drod las bde myong dang / /gang zhig dgod dang lta dang lag bcangs dang / /'o byas 'khyud pa bde ba dam pa myong / /rtog med myong bar gyur kyang bde chen gyis/ /rgyas ma btab na byang chub med do zhes/ /rdo rje 'chang ba gsung zhing tshad mas grub/ /bde ba stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bya/ /rgyas gdab ces bya'i don ni 4ngo bo yang /dmigs pa'i yul ni 5sgyu mar ma zad kyi/ /rang gi myong ba sgyu mar mngon sum du//rig pa de la rgyas gdab rjes su brjod/ /rtog pa re res bcad pa rgyas gdab 6min / /de bzhin rjes dpag bsgom pa rgyas gdab 7rnged/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor spros dang bral ba yi/ /mngon sum der snang rgya yi rnam par byung / /des na rgyas gdab ces ni bya bar bshad/ /'jig rten 'di dang 'jig rten pha rol dag /bde chen mnyam par shes te bsgoms pas na/ / 'da' ba'i 8man ngag gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos kyi skur shes na / /'bras bu thob byas sar 9 du btsal ba med/ /sems kyi ngang las 'phel 'grib med shes na/ /bsgom pa shor yang spogs pa btsal mi dgos/ /legs byas nyes byas glo bur yin shes na/ /dam tshig nyams chags bshags pa de nyid yin/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar bden/ /ji ltar btags pa de ltar 26—/5/7

med / /ji ltar btsal ba de ltar skyon/ /ji ltar bsams pa de ltar bral/ /yul ni gang dang gang dag la/ /rtog bral gsal ba skyes gyur na/ / de'i tshe de 'ong mi'i sems 1la/ /de ni stong nyid bsgom pa yin/ /rang rig gnyis med bsgom bya zhes/ /gang la gdams ngag phog gyur kyang / /gnyis med nyid du ma myong na/ /gang zhig bstan kyang ming du zad/ /yul ni gang dang gang dag la / /thams cad las ni sems bsdus na3/ /nang gi bdag nyid g.yo med par / /gnas pas mig gis gzugs dag gam ༄// /gnas pas rna bas sgra dag gam/ /gnas pas sna yis 4dri dag gam/ /gnas pas lce yis sgoro dag gam / /gnas pas lus kyis 67reg dag gam/ /gnas pas yid kyis tsuchos dag gam8/ /shes pa'i blo de rtog bral yin/ /rtog pa'i skye dang 'gag pa dang / /rang rig gnyis kyis myong bas 9na/ /rtog dang bral bas mngon tsodu grub/ /gang zhig rtog bral don de la/ /tshor ba bde ba la brten nas/ /bsgoms pas pho nya'i lam du gyur/ /gang la dang po rtog med la/ /dga' ba zhes su bshad pa yin/ /rtog bral bde chen gnyis pa la/ /mchog dga' zhes su bshad pa yin/ /de ni lus kyi bde ba ste/ /yid 'ong yul las byung ba'o/ /rtog dang bral ba gsum pa ni/ /lhan cig skyes dga' zhes bshad de/ /yid kyi mngon sum bde ba yin/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma dang bral bas/ /myong bas gsal ba skye ba ni/ /rang rig bde chen zhes su bshad/ /gang zhig rtog pas bar 1 bcad na/ /dga' bde'i ting 'dzin nyams 'gyur bas/ /phyag rgya bzhi yi yul rnams las/ /tshor ba bde ba skyes gyur pas/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i stobs ldan pas/ /rtog dang bcas pas skye mi 'gyur/ /de bas bde ba'i ting 26—1pya/8

'dzin las/ /rnal 'byor pa yi yid gzhag 1snanas/ /gnyis med bde chen bsgom par bya/ /gang zhig bde ba'i ting 'dzin las/ /sems 'jog pa ni zhi gnas yin/ /des na dga' dang mchog dga' dang / /lhan skyes dga' ba phul byung yang / /zhi gnas sems las mi 'da' ste/ /lus dang yid kyi bde bar zad/ /bde chen don gyis rgyas gdab na/ /lhag mthong phul du byung bar 'gyur / /gang zhig bde ba'i chos can la/ /stong nyid sgrub pa gang yin pa/ /lhan cig skyes dga' yin snyam ste/ /de ni rjes dpag bsgom pa'i lam so sor rtog pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /bde ba chen po myong ba'ang med/ /'od gsal bde ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /dga' bde dba' rlabs tshul du shes/ /de nyid stong pa bsgom pa yin/ /bde dang yid bde gang yin las/ /de yi rang bzhin stong shes na༄ / /gtan tshigs la sogs don med yin/ /chu ni dang bar gyur pa las// /nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar/ /de bzhin stong gsal rang bzhin las/ /sna tshogs shes pa ldang zhing 'gag /snod bcud bde chen rgyas btab pas/ /sems kyi glang po yan btang yang / /gnas ma rnyed nas ldog par 'gyur/ /dngos po gsal ba mthong na yang / /de de bde bas rgyas btab nas/ /g.yeng ba nyid kyang g.yeng ba min/ /spyod lam ro mnyam yin 4shes nas/ /'gro ba nyid ni 'gro 'ong med/ /rgyu 'bras med kyang rgyas btab pas/ /skye ba nyid na'ang skye ba med/ /'gag pa thim pa'i rgyas btab pas / /bkag tsam nyid na'ang 'gag pa med/ /bde gshegs rnams ni bde chen nyid kyi sku/ /chos rnams thams cad bde gshegs nyid dang mnyam/ /byes pa'i blo can dngos la zhen pa rnams/ /rnam par rtog pas brtags pa nyid 26—/519

dodal spyod/ /dngos rnams thams cad bcos su med na yang / /grub mtha' ngan pas babe+ed pas 'chos par byed/ /gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings / /bde gshegs chos kyi sgu yis mkhyen par mnyam/ /'khor ba'i phung po sgyu mar rnam dag shes/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku sgyu mar yang dag mnyam/ /gal te sgyu ma'i rgyun la bde sbug dang / /dga' dang gdung ba'i bye brag yod min yang / /der snang skad cig re rer gnas pa las/ /bde chen bde ba chen po nyid du gcig /rnam par rtog pa tha dad med na yang / /mi rtog ngang las ro gcig gyur par snang / /dang po'i las can so so'i skye bo la/ /bde ba lam du byed par gsungs na yang / /gang zhig bla ma'i phan pa'i lung thob nas/ /bde sbug thams cad bde ba chen por 'gyur/ /gang zhig stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de la 1thar pa'i skal ba med/ /'gro drug srid pa'i btson ra ru/ /rmongs pa de ni 'khyam par 'gyur/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgom byas na/ /blo ni gzhan don la dga' bar/ /'gyur ba nyid du the tshom rnged/ /sems can gang yin thams cad sngon/ /pha ma mdza' bshes rtsa lag tu/ /gyur cing phan chen btags pas na/ /byas pa gzo ba nyid du bya/ /sems can la brten bla rnged pa'i/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang nyid thob 2na/ /tshangs dbang drag po 'jig rten skyong / /sogs pa 'thob pa mtshar ci che/ /sems can phan pa byas tsam gyis/ /'gro ba gsum pa dam par skye/ /sems can gnod pas sbug bsngal ni/ /rnam pa du ma'i tshul dag gis/ /dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro ru/ /sems can rnams ni nye bar spyod/ /dngos po kun gyis mgu bya ba/ /rang lus bzhin du bsrung bar bya/ /'bad pas sems can 26—/520

mi dga' ba/ /dug dang 'dra ba 2spang bar bya/ /sems can yongs su ma btang bas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub kun du 'thob/ /gzhan gyi gnod pa ma bzod pas/ /mnar med du yang skye bar byed/ /rang gi lus dang nor sbyin pa//'di ni mtshar zhing 'di ni bsngags/ /'di ni 'jug pa mchog yin no/ /mtshar zhes bya ba 'di min te/ /chos 'di stong par shes nas su/ /las kyi 'bras bu bsten byed pa/ /mtshar ba bas kyang 'di mtshar zhing / /ngo mtshar bas kyang ngo mtshar ro/ /sems can bskyab pa'i bsam pa 'dis/ /srid pa'i 'dam du skyes mod kyi/ /pad+ma la ni chu bzhin du/ /srid pa'i skyon gyis de ma gos / /bzang po la sogs rgyal ba'i sras/ /'di na ye shes rnge yis ni/ /nyon mongs bud shing bsregs bzhin du/ /'on kyang thugs rjes bslab 2pa mdzad / /byang chub che dang 'chi dang skye/ /dur khrod gshegs dang dka' spyod mdzad/ /bdud sde rab tu 'joms pa dang / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /lha yul gshegs dang mya ngan 'das/ /de bzhin khyem nas byung ba rnams / /snying rje'i dbang gis 'jug pa yis/ /'gro ba'i mgon po ston par mdzad/ /tshangs dbang nye dbang drag sogs kyi / /gzugs kyis rab tu 'jug mdzad cing / /'gro ba 'dul ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /thugs rjes thugs kyis rol pa mdzad/ /theg pa gnyis po dag kyang ni/ /theg pa chen por 'byung 4bas na/ /srid pa'i lam gyis dub pa rnams/ /ngal bso don de de nyid min/ /nyan thos de dag de srid du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma bsgul bar / /de srid ye shes lus gcig gis/ /ting 'dzin dregs pas myos te gnas / /bskul nas sna tshogs gzugs kyis ni/ /sems can don la dga' 26—1521

byed cing / /bsod nams ye shes nyer 'phel nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /bag chags las ni byung bas na/ /bag chags sa bon dag tu bshad/ /bag chags rjes mthong tshogs pa na/ /srid pa'i myu gu de bskyed do/ /stong nyid smra bas smra byed cing / /rtag tu lus ngag yid gsum gyis / /'di ltar sems can don byed pa/ /chad par smra ba yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dper na gser 'gyur zangs lcags thams cad la/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi nus pa'i thabs rnyed na/ /thams cad kha dog gser du 'gyur ba ltar/ /sems kyang bde chen ngang du ro gcig 'gyur/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za'i grong khyer rnams/ /rtog dang bral ba'i stong pa'i rnam pa skyes/ /de bzhin sgyu 'drar sems kyi sgyu 'drar shes/ /bde chen rgyas btab bdag byin brlab pa la/ /sgyu ma'i dpe yis 1don rnams btsal mi dgos/ /thams cad sgyu 'dra mi 'drar dgag sgrub byed/ /phyag rgya'i lam la bde ba stong par shes/ /chos kyi mdo don sems kyis 2stong par shes/ /chos rnams kun la yod med dgag sgrub rnged/ /rtog med mngon sum lam la blo gzhag pas/ /rtags kyis rjes 'brangs gzhan sel dgos pa med/ /dus gsum bde gshegs ji ltar sangs rgyas ltar/ /gang du kha bltas sems kyi gsang shes pas/ /sgrib pa kun zad ye shes phun tshogs shing / /sangs rgyas zhing grol sems can thams cad sgrol / /thams cad bzang rgyu nyid du gyur par nges/ /ji ltar sbrul gyi rang bzhin shes pa na/ /de yi dug ni gnod par mi 'gyur te/ /gang zhig nyon mongs 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes/ /des ni de ma thag tu nges grol 'gyur/ /de nyid kyis ni sangs rgyas shing / /de nyid kyis ni nyon mongs 'joms/ /26—1522

bde chen lam la brten nas ni/ /thams cad byas kyang rnam par grol/ /rnam par rtog pa rnam spangs shing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral bas ye shes 'dus ma byas pa ste/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa'o/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs spangs pa yin/ /ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /sems kyi ngang la rnam gnas na/ /mya ngan 'das pa bstan du med/ /bde chen rtogs pa'i man ngag 'di/ /sdeb sbyor go rims 3bsgrigs pa min/ /nyams myong rtogs pa'i phan pa'i lung / /dam pa'i spyi bos blang bar mdzod/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs bsgom pa zhes bya ba/nor bu gling pa'i slob dpon bde ba'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //2 bsdur mchan/1511 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉phyag rgya bathi dngos po'i gnas lugs bsgom nga bzhugs so// 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shesab/1512 —1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ཿ/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 du/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skye/ 5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yid/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma ga 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄srub/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7me/1513 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkasu/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅ra/ 〈〈snar 〉stotab/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kujig rten/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rgya/ 6〈〈snar 〉thazhag 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgros/1514 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoragag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(na/1515 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamachog 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dga' brtson/ 〈〈pe 〉〉ngang gi/ 〈〈snar 〉thang gi/1516 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodang / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoratshar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartags/1517 tsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagacad/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ste zla ba lta bu/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rjes/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra cas pa rgyas btab/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra tab/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉mda' ka'i/ 〈〈snar 〉skorada' ka'i/ 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra gsar/26dod1523

1518 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de tshe 'o ma'i sems nyid/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga mig gi gzugs dag bi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa sna yi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa yid kyi/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skal/ 9 〈〈snar 〉〉stos pas/ khe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngan/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masar/1519 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngal/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zaban/152༷ rta 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lta/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorathob/1521 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ra/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra slabs/ na〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung /1522 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/152 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 mi gus dad med brtson chung gtum/ /blun zhing log lta skur 'debs la/ /zab mo'i don bstan gnyis 'phung 'gyur/ /des na zab mo gsang bar gsungs//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1129)tsheg khyim/26dod1524

༄/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba/1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur mu dra u pa de sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med cing / /zab cing rang bzhin brtag dka' ba/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni de nyid bshad / /de la man ngag la 'jug par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas thog mar grub mtha' dag shes par bya ste/ de yang jeg pa ni rnam pa gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po'o/ /de nyid gnas pa bzhi ste bye brag tu smra bar gnas pa dang / mdo sde par gnas pa dang / rnam par rig par gnas pa dang / dbu mar gnas pa'o/ /de dag nyid spyor ba dgu ste/ nyan thos rab 'bring gsum dang / rang sangs rgyas dang/ mdo sde pa dang / rnam bcas dang / rnam med dang / sgyu ma 26—1525

lta bu gnyis su med par smra ba'i dbu ma dang / chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i dbu ma 1dag re re la yang dpyad pa'i sgo dang / bsam gtan dang / bsam gtan kyi dri ma dang / lta ba ste bzhi bzhi'o/ /de la dpyad pa ni thos bsam la brten pa'i rang gi so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bo /bsam gtan ni rang gi bsgom pa'i shes rab bo/ /bsam gtan gyi dri ma ni de'i dngos su mi mthun pa'i phyogs so/ /lta ba ni — rang gi shes rab kyis zin pa'i khyad par dang / rang gi 'bras bu la blos yul du byed pa'o/ /de la nyan thos tha ma'i spyod pa ni/ sngon po la sogs pa'i don khas len pa sngon du 'gro bas brjod du rnged pa'i gang zag 'dod pa'o/ /'bring po ni de dang mthun pa'o/ /rab ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su shes pas gang zag stong par lta ba'o//rang rgyal ni gzung ba stong zhing 'dzin pa khas len pa'o/ /mdo sde pa ni gzung ba 'dus par 'dod cing 'dzin pa tshogs drug go/ /rnam bcas ni thams cad shes pa'i rnam par 'dod pa ste/ sna tshogs gnyis su med par 'dod pa'o/ /rnam med ni 'di dag thams cad sems nyid de/ rnam pa med par rig pa'i ngo bor 'dod pa'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu ni chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu yang dag pa'i dngos pos stong pa ste/ de nyid gnyis su rnged par 'dod pa'o/ /rab tu mi gnas pa ni tha snyad thams cad ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ don gyi ngo bo cir yang mi gnas pa'o zhes dpyod pa'o/ /bsam gtan ni mi sdug pa bsgom pa dang / srog dang rtsol ba bgrang ba la gnas pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi bden pa mar me+e bsad pa lta bu ci yang mi snang ba la sems gnas pa dang / sna'i rtse mor gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor bsnyus nas sems gnas pa dang / sems kyi rnam pa 26—1526

la sems gnas pa dang / rnam pa med pa la gnas pa dang gzugs brnyan la gnas pa dang / cir yang ma grub pa'i ngo bo nyid la gnas pa'o/ /de la 1sems kyi rnam pa la gnas par bya ba ni dang por ci yang rung ba la shes pa gtad/de nyid sems tsam du shes par byas te gnas pa'o/ /rnam pa med pa la gnas pa ni thog mar mchod pa la sogs pa byas te/ slob ma stan la bzhag 2la dbugs sor bcug ste/ thog mar me tog lta bu la shes pa gtod du bcug nas lag pa spyi bor bzhag sdel sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ a ra ra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī a bye 4tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mgor rang gi yi dam gyi sngags brjod do//de nas me tog kyang med par byas na myur du skye'o/ /bsam gtan gyi dri ma rnams dang / lta ba rnams ni gzhan nas gsal bas 'dir ma brjod do/ /de ltar na mi mkhas pa rab rib can dang 5/ /mkhas pa rab rib med pa'o/ /de dag gi snying rje yang sems can la dmigs pa dang 6/ chos la dmigs pa dang / dmigs pa med pa'o/ /de la gsang sngags kyi theg pa ni theg pa gsum las ni theg pa chen po'o/ /gnas pa ni phyi ma gnyis so/ /spyor ba ni tha ma bzhi la'o/ /de la slob dpon nyid kyi gzhung gis ni rab tu mi gnas par spyor ba'o/ /de lta na yang de dang thams cad du khyad med pa ni ma yin te/ ji skad du/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas phyir/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags / /zhes gsungs pas de brjod par bya ste/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang / yongs su sgogs pa'i rim pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyi rim pa'o/ /yang de bzhin 26—1527

gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba 1dang / rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /yang kun brtags la gzhan dbang gi rgya dang / gzhan dbang la yongs su grub pa dang / yongs su grub pa la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / de nyid la bde ba chen pos 2rgyas gdab pa'o/ /yang phyag rgya bzhi las rtogs par bya ste/ las kyi phyag rgya ni zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o chos kyi phyag rgya ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen po ni ngo bo nyid kyi rim pa'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /kun brtags la gzhan dbang gi rgya ni phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /yongs su grub pa'i rgya ni lha thams cad kyang rnam par rig pa tsam mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya ni rnam rig stong pa nyid du shes pa'o/ /bde ba chen po'i rgya ni de nyid man ngag nyams su myang bar byas pa'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya ni dbang gi 4ngo bo ste/ de yang bum pa dang / gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes dang / bzhi pa'o/ /bum pa ni slob dpon gyi dbang man chad 5de/ lus dag par byed pa'o/ /gsang ba ni thabs shes rab gnyis las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems ster ba ste/ ngag dag par byed pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes ni gsum ste/ drag po dang / ngan pa dang / bzang po'o/ /de la drag po ni 'o dang 'khyud pa nas brtsams te phyi rol gyi bya ba ni dga' ba ste/ rnam pa sna tshogs so/ / bsrub pa dang srubs 6pa'i spyor ba ni rnam par smin pa ste mchog dga'o/ /rin po cher nyams su myong ba ni mtshan nyid dang bral ba ste dga' bral lo/ /pad+mar lcung ba ni rnam par nyed pa ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'o zhes 'dod pa ste lung dang 'gal ba'o/ /lung las mchog dga' bral dga' 7dbus dag tu/ /mtshon bya shes nas brtags 8 26—1528

par gyis/ /zhes pa dang / yang tso/ dga' bral dang po mchog mtha' can/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bstan 2pa dang / yang dga' ba bzhi ni dga' ba dang /mchog tu dga' ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / dga' bral gyi dga' ba'o zhes gsungs pas so/ /'on te lung las lhan cig skyes pa mtha' mar yod do zhe na/ yang bden mod kyi/ de ni bla ma la ltos pa dang bral ba glegs bam gyis mkhas par gang zag dag gis saphyed du dkrugs 6nas bshad de/'dir grangs kyi bzhi par 'dug kyang don gyi 7gsum par sbyar ro/ /de nas 'dir drag po'i sbyor ba ni go rims dang don gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa'o/ /da be+e dbang bskur ngan pa brjod par bya ste/ 'o dang 'khyud pa la sogs pa phyi rol gyi bya ba ni rnam pa sna tshogs te dga' ba'o/ /bsrub pa dang srubs 9pa'i spyor ba ni rnam par smin pa ste mchog dga'o/ /rin po cher nyams su myong ba ni mtshan nyid bral ba ste lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /pad+mar lhang ba ni rnam par nyed pa ste dga' bral lo zhes 'dod pa ste/ mu stegs pa dang khyad med pa'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyams su myong ba la yang dag par 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni go rims /1la mkhas kyang don la mi mkhas pa'o/ /da ni dbang bskur bzang po brjod par bya ste/ 'di'i lugs kyis dga' ba bzhi ni 'di ltar shes par bya ste/phyi rol gyi bya ba nas bskyod pa'i mthar thug pa ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i dga' ba'o/ /rin po che'i mthar thug pa nyams su myong ba ni rnam par smin pa ste mchog dga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /zhes bya ba'i thig le bzhi'i gzugs kyis 12bzhugs pa las gnyis ni rdo rje rtse mo'i cha la gnas/gnyis ni pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i cha la gnas pa'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba ste lhan 1 26—1529

skyes pa'o/ /thig le bzhi char yang pad+ma'i cha la gnas pa ni rnam pa rnged pa ste dga' bral lo/ /de yang / shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa gnyis kyis 'khyud nas ni/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam spyor ba/ /slob dpon dbang du shes par bya/ /zhes pa dang / dbang ni bzhi yi grangs kyis kyang / /dga' ba la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes pa dang / thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las kyang / gnyis shor gnyis ni mnyam pa'i dbus/ /rdo rje nas be+e pad+mar reg /rgyu la 'bras bus 1 rgyas gdab cing / /'di ni bde chen rgyal po'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na drag po'i spyor ba ni mi bskyod pa'i rgya dang bral la dbang bsgur ngan pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya dang bral zhing rdo rje 'chang gi dbugs dbyung ba dang bral ba'o/ /'dir rdo rje sems dpas mi bskyod pa la rgyas btab pa ni dbu ma'i lam mo/ /de yang lung las mdor bstan pa dang /rgyas par bstan pa dang / shin tu rgyas par bstan pa ste/ de dag ni dbang gi 'grel pa nyid na gsal bas 'dir ma bris so/ /de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ste yid dga' bar byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi rang bzhin dga' ba gsum dang tha mi dad pa rten 'byel gyi ngo bor zung du 'jug pa ni bzhi pa'o / /de dag ni las kyi phyag rgya ste/ rgyu mthun 2pa'i 'bras bu skyed dpar byed do zhes slob dpon klu sgrub kyis bshad do/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni snang grags kyi chos sna tshogs su snang ba nyid de/ de yang las kyi phyag rgya'i lhan cig skyes pa nyid las gol ba sna tshogs kyi rtog pa 'byung ba dang / sna tshogs kyi rtog pa 'gags shing lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs su gnas pa dang / sna tshogs dang lhan cig skyes pa nyid du med pa dang / sna tshogs dang lhan cig skyes pa gnyis 26—1530

ka'i rtog pa mi dmigs pa dang bzhi ni chos kyi phyag rgya'i dga' ba dang / mchog dga' dang / lhan cig skyes dga' dang / dga' bral lo/ /des na chos kyi phyag rgya ni dngos po ma bcos pa'i rang bzhin las ma bcos pa'i phyag rgya chen po bye ba'i phyir rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu zhes brjod do/ /phyag rgya chen po ni chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i ngo bo zung du 'jug pa/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba dang 1/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya la sogs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa/ ji lta ba 2bzhin du rang gi mtshan nyid nyams su myong ba ste/ dri ma rnged pa'i 'bras bur brjod do/ /de'i ngo bo ni mtha' dbus kyi chos thams cad gzugs can ma yin pa dang / thams cad du khyab pa dang mi 'gyur ba dang /dus thams cad pa'o/ /des na phyag rgya chen po ni skad cig ma gcig la mngon par sangs rgyas pa ste/ skad cig ma bzhi dang / dga' ba bzhi 5dbye ba ni med do/ /'on kyang phyag rgya bzhi la ltos 6nas dga' ba bzhi bzhag 7ste las kyi phyag rgya ni dga' ba'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni mchog tu dga' ba'o/ /phyag rgya chen po ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni dga' bral lo/ /de nyid ji lta ba bzhin chos kyi 'khor lo'i dus su bla ma'i zhal la ltos par bya'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni de kho na nyid mtshon par byed pa 'bras bu lha'i dkyil 'khor te/ de yang rje btsun gyis thabs mtshon pa dang /rje btsun mas shes rab mtshon pa dang / 'khyud pas gnyis su rnged pa mtshon pa'i phyir dam tshig go/ /de yang bskyed pa'i rim pa 8bdun po dag par 9byas nas rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa dang / lha mo'i 'khor lo spro ba dang / nyi ma dang zla bar thig le'i gzugs su zhu ba dang / lha mo'i dbyangs kyis bskul ba dang /26—1531

'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par gyur pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i dga' ba bzhi ste go rims bzhin no/ /'bras bu lha'i 'khor lo 'di ni 'gro ba'i don 'dzin par byed pas skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu brjod do/ /de ltar na phyag rgya bzhi la dga' ba bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug tu shes par bya'o/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i man ngag slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas ba(1ra ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1525 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du sas pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉༄7/ /phyag rgya ba'i'i man ngag ces bya ba bzhugs so//1526 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnama'o/ /de/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rang gi spyod pa la/1527 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngalas/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazhag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga dzi yi gi ni a nyi/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7mkhas pa rab rib can dang / 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang /1528 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gib/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge 'i/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khyong / nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thacad/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagatsub pa dang gtsub/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodaga' bral/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartag 1529 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dag rta〈〈pe 〉tharten/ 〈〈snar 〉thasten/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaltos/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 byedapa/'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra krugs/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉sa/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrub/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dang / 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim/ 12〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 cig153༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorathun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes/1531 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dang / 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rib/ 1〈〈snar 〉8/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdzogs par/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhir/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thalhos/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhir bzhag she/〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zor/26dod1532
⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (113༷)26wa 1533

1204༄༅/ /tshos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par ston pa'i je kho na nyid tshigs su bcad pa byed kyi 'grel pa bzhugs/1 rak+ṣa/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu skyes ye shes glang po che/ /'joms byed seng ge bdag gi gzhung / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rim pa dang la zla ba ste/ /drang ba dang nges pa'i don to/ /de yang gang zhe na/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / de sgrub par byed pa'i thabs dang / de yang dag par thob pa'o/ /de la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung gis/ rgyu gzhan las skye ba'i don dam pa'i chos/ lung rigs pas grub pa snang ba'am/ snang ba med pa'i rang bzhin chos thams cad kyi gzhi dang / rten du gyur pa/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ brtags pas stong pa/ rgyun chags pa/ mtha' bzhi las grol bas dbu ma'i lam/ 'di tsam zhig yang dag par yod de/ sgrub thabs dang 'bras bu yang de bzhin no zhes zer ro/ /de ni glang po che dang 'dra'o/ / ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyi rol gyi don yod par smra ba'i/ mu stegs dang nyan thos 26—/534

—dang / mdo sde'i gzhung rnams phal cher lung rigs kyi che bas 'joms par nus pa dang / rnam par shes pa ni sangs rgyas pa'i chos rnams kyi 1lus su gyur pas/ye mi bzhed pa ma yin pa'i phyir bstod pa'o/ /'on kyang shes bya nang gi dngos po 2lta bas na de nyid kyang / gzhom du rung ba'i phyir glang po che dang 'dra'o/ /gang gis 'joms par byed ce na/ rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i dbu ma seng ge lta bu'i lung rigs kyi mche ba ches mi bzad pas 'joms par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /lung gang zhe na 'dir mdo las 'jam dpal khyod 'di skad du/ chos la brtag 4pa'i thabs lnga po 'di dag kun yang dag pa lags sam/ 'on te kha cig ni yang dag pa lags la/ kha cig ni yang dag pa ma lags sam zhes zer ba ni/ chos la brtag 5pa'i thabs lnga po 'di dag thams cad kyang / yang dag pa yin par bzung ste/ kha cig gis ni chos thams cad ji ltar snang ba bzhin du yod pa'i chos ston to/ /snyam pa'ang yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/'byung ba bzhi nang 6des byas pa rnams ni/ tha snyad du sgyu ma bzhin du yod pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig gis ni chos thams cad sems tsam las ma gtogs pa gzhan rtsed pa'i chos ston to snyam pa'ang yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos sna tshogs su 'dogs pa rnams rtag pa ther zug tu brtag pa'i bag chags sems la gzhag pa'i mthus/ dus thams cad du bdag dang chos rnams su snang ba tha dad du snang yang / don dam du rang bzhin med de/ sems tsam las med pa'i phyir ro / /kha cig gis ni sems nyid kyang ma skyes pa yin par bdag cag la chos ston to snyam pa'ang yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di la dbyibs sam/ kha dog gam/ dus gsum mam/ mtha' dbus med pa'i phyir ro/ /kha cig 26—/535

gis ni chos thams cad sgyu ma bzhin du snang zhing sgyu ma bzhin du ma grub pa'i chos ston to snyam pa'ang yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni rgyu dang rkyen las skye zhing 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /kha cig gis ni chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis mi gnas pa/ las dang bya ba'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ rtog pa dang mi rtog par yul las 'das pa thog ma med pa'i dus nas spros pa rnam par dag pa'i chos ston to snyam pa'ang yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad rang gi ngo bo nyid phyin ci ma log pa de yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs so/ /de las gzhan bgrang 7mi dgos so/ /rigs pa gang zhe na/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis sngon du legs par bkod pa'i gang dag yod par grags pa'i chos thams cad rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba tsam las byung ba'i phyir/ sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes bya ba dang / de nyid kyis don dam par na rang dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang rgyu med pa las skye ba nam yang mi 'thad pa'i phyir don dam par nam mkha'i pad+ma lta bu'o zhes bstan pa 'di kho nas chog ste/ shes rab kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang bzhin gyi 2gtan tshigs 'di kho na'i sgo nas drang po'i zhib tu bltas na/ mthar ci yang grub pa ma rnyed pas/ chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par ma grub pa'o/ /gtan tshigs ma grub pa la sogs pa'ang ma yin te mang du brjod mi dgos so/ /de nyid kyis phyin ci log gi gzhung ma lus par yang choms par 'gyur te/ 'dir tshigs su bcad pa/ ltos rnged bdag las skye 'dod na/ /rtag par rgyur smra grangs can pa/ /rgyu gzhan dag las skye 'dod na/ /byed pa rgyur smra bye brag pa//gnyis ka las ni skye 'dod na/ /dbang phyug rgyur smra gcer bu pa/ /skye ba med 26—1536

las skye 'dod na/ /rang bzhin rgyur smra rgyang pan pa/ /skyes pa stong par 'gyur 'dod na/ /nam mkha'i yid can chad pa'i lam/ /gang yang khas mi len gyur na/ /ngan g.yo rmongs pa'i lta ba ste/ /rang bzhin 1grub dang ma grub dang / /gzhan ni rtag dang mi rtag las/ /brtags dze+en skye ba mi 'thad phyir/ /de bzhin res 'ga' ba nyid phyir/ /'di kun rten cing 'byel 'byung tshul/ /spros pa'i mtha' kun gdod nas zhi/ /zhes bya'o/ /des na chos thams cad yang dag par ma skyes pas/ yid la byar med cing / gang la yang smin ri du med pa ni/ bdag gi gzhung zhes bya'o/ /yang dag gi 4don de nyid ni/gsang sngags kyi gzhung du ni/ las kyi phyag rgya las grub pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bar 'dod do/ /de yang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bzhi pa las 5'dod pa ni/ dga' bral gyi dang po la sogs par 'byung ba'i lung dang /dga' bral ni rjes thob drod kyi shes pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rigs pa dang /mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i phyir btsan thabs la zhes bya'o/ /yang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba gsum pa la 'dod kyang / don kyis gnas sbas pa la mngon par rmongs pas mu stegs kyi gzhung dang khyad par med pa'i phyir dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya dang bral ba'i phyir dang / mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i phyir/dbang la mi mkhas pa zhes bya'o/ /de gnyis ni rnam par ma sbyangs pa'i glang po dang 'dra'o/ /yang / dga' bral dang po mchog gi mtha'/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i lung dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'i brda dang / gzhung gzhan khegs pa'i rigs pa dang / brgyud pa'i man ngag dang / rang rig pa'i mngon sum gyis shin tu phra ba'i skad cig gis gsum pa la lhan cig skyes pa'i 26—1537

dga' ba rnyed pa ni/ yang dag pa'i dbang la mkhas pa zhes bya'o/ /de nyid rnal 'byor chen po dang / rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las/ mun pa la ni mar ske ltar / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dpe sna tshogs kyis bsgrub 1pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje jeg pa'i nges pa'i tshig tu gzhag pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las thabs khyad par du gyur pa/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i spyod pa'i 3 yul/dgyes pa'i rdo rje dang / dam pa dang po dang / zla gsang thig le la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'o/ /de ltar de bzhin bzhi pa yang / /zhes 'byung bas / sgrub pa'i thabs dang / grub pa'i rang bzhin yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o zhes zer ro/ /shes rab ye shes kyi 4dbang dag gi spyir khyab pa'i man ngag /phyag rgya nye bar brtags 5pa dang / las kyi go rims khudang /rnam pa dang / dpe dang / gnas dang / brda dang / sa'i rim pa gang thob pa la sogs pa ni/ bdag gis gsal bar shes mod kyi/ /'dir brjod pa'i dgos pa rnged do/ /de ltar yang dag pa'i dbang la mkhas pas ni/btsan thabs dang / dbang la mi mkhas pa'i gzhung dag lung rigs kyi mche bas 'joms par nus pa dang / thabs kyi jeg pa'i lus su gyur pa'i phyir/ /glang po che dang / brda'o zhes bstod pa'o/ /thabs gang zhe na/ brdzun pa'i lam gyis bslus te/ yang dag pa'i lam la spyor pa ba'o/ /gang slu ༄ zhe na/theg pa gzhan las yangs pa dang / gzhan nas 'jug pa dang / tha mal pa dang / tshangs par spyod pa'o/ /ji ltar slu zhe na/ dang po gsum ni sdom pa yang dag par blangs / pa gtong ba'i nyes pa med pas/ spyod yul dngos la spyor ba 'am/ /yang na slob dpon dang 'gal na/ /thabs gzhan gyis bzung 26—/538

ste / re zhig dman pa'i yul las mi bzlog par ci rigs pa'i sgrar bstan pa'o//tshangs par spyod pa ni/ de dang chos mthun pa'i thabs gzhan gyis bzung ste/don sa gzhan la drang ba 'am/ /yang na don nyid bshad par bya'ormikyi/ /yang de nyid yang dag pa'i man ngag ma yin pa'i gzhom du rung ba'i phyir glang po che'o/ / yang dag pa'i hūṃ'ajoms par byed ce na/ yang dag pa'i lung dang / rigs pa dang / man ngag seng ge lta bus so/ /de yang / las kyi phyag rgya 'khor rgyu can / /thag ring rnam par spang bar bya/ /zhes 'byung ba la sogs pa'i lung gis gsal ba dang / gdul bya shin tu dman pa la bstan pa'i phyir/ dam pa rnams kyis spang bar bya ba dang / thabs gzhan yod pa'i phyir ma nges pa dang /las dang po'i 1tshangs par spyod pa la ma gnang ba'i phyir/ 'gal ba dang /rtsol ba las byung ba'i phyir skad cig ma ste ston ka'i pad+ma lta bu'o zhes bkod pa'i rigs dārnams kyis bcom pa dang / khu ba rlung dus su lta ba/ /kye yi rdo rje des mi shes/ /ma yin nges don gzhan du dpyad/ /ces yang dag pa'i man ngag gzhan yod par kha 'phangs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na yang dag par dpyad na/phyag rgya chen po'i don ni 5mi shes par/ las kyi phyag rgya la lam du mthong ba mtha' dag /phyi rol mu stegs pa dang / bdud kyi rigs pa dag yin par mngon te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin ni ma skyes pa/ mtshan nyid med pa/brjod du med pa zhes tshig tu brjod kyang / las kyi phyag rgya'i rgyu la nges par ltos 6pa'i phyir/ don de nyid bde ba'i rnam par 'dod par shes te/ dper na log sred can dag bag ma len par byed pa bzhin no/ /'di ltar zhi ba pa dang tshor ba'i gzhung las kyang / lha dang lha mo mi phyed spyor/ /bde ba chen po 26—1539

glo bur skye/ /yang / rin chen nang na de gnas na/ /lha med lha mo'ang yod ma yin/ /mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi las grol ba/ /ngag gis smra bar nus ma yin//'di ni rin chen pho brang nas/ /ze 'brur ltung na chags bral yin/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshim pa ni/ /bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /byed pa cung zad yod ma yin/ /yod na de nyid shes pa min/ /yang gang lkugang mthong cung zad ni / /de de tshangs par rnam par gnas/ /de las gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems//nges par tshangs pa nyid du gnas/ /yang / de la bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /de la sdug bsngal 'ong ba med/ /yang / yod pa ma yin med pa min/ /gnyi ga ma yin gnyis med min/ /de yi gnas skabs rtogs dka' ba/ /ci dka' 'am de ni bla na med/ /yang / chos dor chos ma yin pa 1dor/ bye/bden dang brdzun pa nyid dor nas/ /de gnyis dor ba nyid kyang dor/ /yang /'dod chags tha mal sems las kyang / /de snyed de ni mya ngan 'das/ /zhes 'byung ste/ de dag gis ni ye shes kyi rten dang / gnas dang / rang bzhin dang / dga' bral gyi 4nyes dmigs dang spyod pa dang / des mtshon pa'i rnal 'byor dang / phan yon dang skyon bsal ba dang / la bzla ba dang /thabs kyi khyad par dang / 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur ba bstan pa'o/ /de lta bu'i log pa'i lam sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pas shes pa ni ched che ste/ thog mar spang bar 5bya ba'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar 'dod pa'i khams kyi bdud dang / de'i rigs 6su gyur pa'i yi dwags rnams ni yang dag pa'i lam la zhugs pa dang / 'jug par 'gyur ba'i 'go ba la bar du gcod de/ nyon mongs pa shas gang che ba de'i rkyen byas te/ nyon 26—/540

mongs pa mched cing 'bar bar byed/ zab mo'i lam gyi gzugs brnyan ston par byed/ gang la re ba yod pa'i mngon par zhen pa'i yon tan sgrub par byed/des yang dag pa'i lam nyams par byed/ 'dres par byed do/ /mdo las kyang stong pa'i bdud dang / 'dod chags kyi bdud la sogs pa sems kyi khong du zhugs na tsho'adi skad du smra ste/ byang chub sems dpa' la bsrung ba dang zhig pa med kyis/ chang 'thung sha zo g.yem rgyas par spyod cig ces so/ /bdud kyi stobs kyi phyir mi dag kyang snyud de/ mi dag the tshom dang skur pa 'debs pa de dag sems la yi dwags ring du zhugs te/ bar bar rkyags 2pa za gabyun 'thung ba yang sha chang dang mtshungs so/ /de dag thams cad stong par ro gcig ces nas / sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims dang 'dul ba bshig go zhes pa dang / ma rabs glen pas grangs brgya nas khye'i bar dag la yang ston to zhes pa dang /tshig tu 'di skad kyang smra ste/ sangs rgyas chen po'o/ /sangs rgyas chung ngu'o/ /sangs rgyas snga ma'o/ /sangs rgyas phyi ma'o/ /de'i nang nas kyang yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas/ sgyu ma'i sangs rgyas/ skyes pa'i sangs rgyas/ bud med kyi sangs rgyas so zhes pa dang / bdag gi sha'i lus ni pha'i pha'o 7/ /bu'i bu/gcig las gcig skyes pa ni chos kyi sku ste/ rnam par ma chad pa/ 'di dag kun yin pas de nyid sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams yin no/ /gud na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gser gyi kha dog lta bu med do zhes smras pa dang / mi dag gis yid ches par bzung nas/ snga ma'i sems ni stor zhing brjed nas/ srog lus der bstan te/ yod ma myong ba thob bo zhes so/ /de la sogs pa ni blun zhing 'khrul pas/ bar bar ni byang chub snyam nas/ bdag gi sems brjed de 26—1541

stor nas/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims ni bshig /sgog na g.yem pa spyod do/ /ngag gis srid pa smra ste/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce kun sangs rgyas kyi zhing yin no/ /mo mtshan dang pho mtshan ni byang chub kyi lam yin te/ yang dag pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ni sus kyang mi shes so zhes pa dang / stong pa'i sems thob ste rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba rnged do zhes pa dang / yang tshig tu ni phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad nga'i bu yin/ bdag la sangs rgyas thams cad skyes/ nga ni 'jig rten du 'byung 1/ nga ni ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin te/ 'jig rten du byung mod kyi 'dus byas las skyes pa ni ma yin no zhes pa dang / bar bar nga ni rdo rje 'chang yin te/ khyod la tshe 3ring bar bya'o zhes bya ba la sogs par 'byung ngo / /yang dga' bo bdud de dag ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ nga'i gsung rab tu 'byung ste/ chos kyi lam sgrub pa'i mi'i sems kyi lam du 'jug par byed do/ /g.yem pa spyor ba la bstod cing / /sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims 'jig /sngar ni mkhan pos bslus/ phyis ni slob mas bslus te g.yem pa spyod cig par 'debs par byed do zhes pa dang / yang /nye na tshe rabs dgu/ ring na tshe rabs brgya'i bar du dge ba spyod cing bdud kyi bshes gnyen du 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshe brjes nas bdud kyi bye brag tu 'gyur ro//yang dag par khyab par shes pa'i dral stor nas mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung ngo zhes 'byung ste/ de lta bu'i bdud kyi las dag shes par bya'o//de yang stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub kyi sems la brtan par gnas pas spang bar bya'o/ /mdo sde nyid las kyang / khyod 'khor ba la ma 'jug par sngar shes par gyis shig ces pa dang / dga' bo rigs kyi bu dag 26— pya12

ting nge 'dzin la mi gnas 1pa'i yang dag pa nyid la mnyam par gzhag 2na bdud rnams sems thag chod do zhes pa dang / phyi ma'i dus ngan pa tha ma'i tshe snying rje chen po bskyed de/ yang dag par dad pa'i sems can rnams grol zhing thar bar gyis shig ces pa dang / 'di khyab par ston cig ces 'byung ngo / /sdom pa gsum 'dzin pas ni bslab pa'i yan lag tsam yang nyams par ma gnang ste / gzhung las/ khar gsil lhang bzed chos gos dang / /chu tshags sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /yan lag lung bzhin mi spang ste/ /lung ma rtogs par rnal 'byor pa/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs can du 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung ste/bslab pa thams cad ma nyams shing / phun sum tshogs par ldan pas dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog tu gsungs so/ /gzhan yang dus thams cad dang /gzugs can ma yin pa dang / thams cad la khyab pa dang / mi 'gyur ba'i yan lag rnams kyis byang chub kyi sems yin par gsungs na/ 'dzag pa'i bde ba skad cig ma ni de las bzlog pa'i mtshan nyid de/ bsam gtan gyi lha rnams la yang yod par ma grags na/ chos kyi dbyings kun du 'gro ba la mnga' brnyes pa'i ye shes kyi lha rnams la dri ma de lta bu ji ltar mnga'/ des na mtshon bya dang /mtshon byed dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu 'brel par yang ji ltar rung / de'i phyir sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung las gsungs pa ni/ srid pa'i ye shes dang / mi mthun pa'i dpe dang / don gzhan mtshon pa dang / dgongs pa gzhan yin par zad do/ /de ltar na chos kyi sku ni spros pa dang bral ba yin pas bden mod kyi / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dkyil 'khor chen po'i gzugs su bzhugs pa dang / sprul pa'i sku rigs mchog gi yab yum las skye ba zhes pa ji ltar rung zhe 26—1543

na / 'dir smras pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni ji ltar 'gro ba blo gros dman pa rnams kyis brtags shing mthong ba de ltar/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang du yang gzugs kyi skur 'byung ba mi srid de/ de'i rgyu ma rig pa'i bag chags ma lus par gtan du zad par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'gro ba blo gros dman pas brtags pa'i kyeri bong gi rwa dang mo gsham gyi bu ltar nus pa gtan med pa yang ma yin te/ thugs rje chen pos bskal pa khyematha' yas par sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rtsal sbyangs pa thob pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyud las kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 1thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de sems can rnams la rnam par phye ste/ tshul sna tshogs dang / bsam pa sna tshogs dang / thabs sna tshogs pa dag gis ston cing / kha cig la ni nyan thos kyi theg pa'i tshul/ kha cig la ni rang sangs rgyas kyi jeg pa'i tshul/ kha cig la ni theg pa chen bo'i tshul/ kha cig la ni mngon par shes pa lnga'i tshul/ kha cig la ni lhar skye bar bya ba dang /kha cig la ni mir skye bar bya ba nas ci tsam du lto 'phye chen po dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am cir skye bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston la/ de la sems can la las sangs rgyas kyis gdul bar bya ba dag gis ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su mthong / la las ni nyan thos kyi gzugs su/ la las ni rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs su/ la las ni byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs su/la las ni dbang phyug 4chen po'i gzugs su/ la las ni tshangs pa'i gzugs su/26—1344

la las ni sred med kyi bu'i gzugs su/ la las ni rnam thos kyi bu'i gzugs nas / la las ni lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bar du mthong ste/ rang rang gi tshig brjod pa'i tshul dag dang / spyod lam sna tshogs mthong la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang 'di ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par grol ba'i ror ro gcig pa lags so zhes 'byung ste/ rnam par grol ba'i ro yang chos nyid skye ba med par gsungs so/ /yang rgyud las/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad ni shākya thub par gyur to/ /'jam dpal ni zas gtsang mar gyur to/ /'jig rten dbang phyug ni sgyu ma chen mor gyur to/ /kun du bzang po ni kun dga' bor gyur to zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo / /yang de dag thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings te 'gro ba dang 'ong ba gang yang med par gsungs so/ /de la sogs pa'i lung dang rigs pas zab cing rgya che ba mthong dgos te/ gzhan du na bus pa'i blo kho nar zad do/ /'o na gong gi lam de lta bu 1dus nam yang mi 'dod dam/ de lta ni khyed nyid la yang 'gal ba'i sgo mang du mthong ngo zhe na/ ma yin te/ gang zag dam pa rnams la ni nyon mongs pa byang chub kyi yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i skabs kyang yod de/ 'di ltar bde ba chen po'i zhi gnas kyi dpung bskyed pa dang / 'gag pa med pa'i lhag mthong gi rtsal sbyangs pa dang / thogs pa med pa'i spyod pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi klung du 4 'jug pa dang / grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshad bstan pa dang / slob pa'i rnal 'byor pa spro ba bskyed 5pa dang / 'jig rten phal pa'i sgro skur bsal 6ba dang /dregs pa can rnams tshar gcad pa dang / yang dag par na chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang du yang mi gnas par bstan pa la sogs pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta 26—1545

bu la dgongs nas rgyud las/ zab mo'i chos ni ston pa la/ /gal te mos par ma gyur kyang / /smad pa dag tu mi bya ste/ /chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya//zhes 'byung ba dang / yang / mi gang gsang sngags rgyud dag gis/ /sbyor ba la ni 'phya byed pa/ /des ni dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /de ni rtag tu gdon gyis 'dzin/ /khab len rdo la lcags 'du ltar/ /mi 'dod yid du 'ong ba yi /tshe 'dir mi bde sna tshogs 'du/ /phyi mar ngan song gsum mthar lhang / /zhes 'byung ngo / /de'i phyir nyes pa'i las ni phal cher gti mug las 'byung bas/shes rab kyis brtags te smra bar bya'o/ /las dang po pa'i tshangs par spyod pa rnams la ni dgos pa'i don mthong ba'i skabs su1/ brda dang tha snyad tsam las ma gtogs pa/ don kyi dngos po nam yang ba med pas/ brtan pa ma thob bar du yang / sdom gsum ldan pas 'jug mi bya/ /zhes 'byung ste/ slar ltung bar gyur pa dang / gzhan gyi yang bzhad gad du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na gang du yangs pa'i spyod pa bstan pa de na/ rab tu dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i nus pa dang / sa mtshams la sogs pa bstan nas yod pas/ rang dang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i sngags pa/ shes rab kyi mig dang ldan pa dag gis dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung du ltos shig /mdor na 'dir mang du smra bas ci zhig bya/ rang gi lung du gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa yang dag pa'i lam du mi bzhed do/ /de bas na/ rgyu skyes ye shes glang po che/ /zhes bya'o/ /drang ba'i don bstan zin to// //nges pa'i don gang zhe na/ 'joms byed seng ge bdag gi 4gzhung / /26—/546

zhes gsungs so/ /phyag rgya chen po la gzhol bar byed pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nyid kyang gang zhe na/ snying po dang / de'i yan lag go/ /snying po gang zhe na / yang dag pa'i bla ma brgyud pa las mthong ba ni 1rdo rje lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems so/ /de ni lung dang rigs pa las kyang 'das pa'o/ /de'i yan lag gang zhe na/ lung dang rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba tsam mo/ /de'i 2cung zad dbye ba ni/ thams cad kyi gzhir gyur cing snying po len pas na de nyid dkyil 'khor ro / /'khrul pa'i dri ma dag par byed pa dang / mchog tu gyur pa dang /mi 'gyur ba dang / rang bzhin gyis stong pa dang / brdar btags 4pa dang /thams cad la khyab pa dang / rang gis 5rig pa la sogs pa'i phyir/ de nyid chu la sogs pa'i dbang ngo / /dam pa mi zad pa'i bde ba yin pa dang /brgyud 6pa'i man ngag gis gnang bas na/ de nyid gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /thams cad kyi skyed mar gyur pa dang / de nyid yul du bya ba ma yin pa dang /7 dga' ba skyed par byed pa dang / thams cad ro gcig tu gyur pa dang /mngon par zhen pa'i srog 'phrog par byed pas de nyid ma la sogs pa'i rang gi rigs kyi shes rab ma'o/ /ma skyes pa dang dpe las 'das pa dang / thams cad la khyab pa dang / rang bzhin gnyug mar gnas pa'i don yin pas de nyid gzhom pa la sogs pa'i yon tan bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /mtha' dbus rnged pa dang / rdzas med pa dang / bde ba'i 'byung gnas su gyur pas/ de nyid rab tu rgyas pa la sogs pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i pad+ma'o/ /phyin ci ma log par 'bigs pa dang / nges par 'joms pa dang / gzhan du mi 'gyur bas de nyid tha mi dad par spyor ba la sogs pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'o/ /nam 26—1547

mkha'i ro dang mtshungs pa dang / lhun gyis grub pa dang / phun sum tshogs pas de nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas rmad du byung ba dri ma med pa'i rgyun sa gsum gyi chos nyid du gyur pa'o/ /de nyid 'jig rten pa'i bya ba las grol ba dang / lung las rdo rje'i tshig tu zin pas dam pa rnams kyi gshegs shul yin pa dang / ngo bo nyid du gnas pa'i don yin pas rigs tupa dam pas brtag thub pa dang / rtog ge pa rnams la rang bzhin gyis sbas shing rnyed par dka' bas na mthar thug pa'i don yin pa dang / brgyud pa'i man ngag gis mngon sum du phrad pas/ yid ches shing slar mi nyams pa'i phyir/ dbang bzhi pa zhes bya'o/ /de nyid nam yang spang bar bya ba ma yin pa dang / 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pa la sogs pas/ don dam pa'i lha dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi dam tshig la sogs par shes par bya'o/ /de bas na lung dang man ngag dag las/ slob ma rnams ni nan tan du/ /byang chub sems kyis 4sbyang bar bya/ /sa ni dang po gang yin pa/ /sems kyi sar ni bshad pa yin/ /sbyang ba sngar ni bstan pa ste/ /de yis de ni yongs su sbyang / /chos dang chos min rnam — spyad na/ /rnam dag nam mkha' lta bur ni/ /chos kun nye bar mi dmigs pa/ /de ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang de las/ /ji ltar shes pa'i bde chen po/ /de yi dbang gis 'di yin te/ /dkyil 'khor de ni gzhan ma yin / /rang bzhin bdag med ma de ni/ /bdag gi smad 'tshong mar 'dod de / /chags pa rnged pa de yis ni/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma ni nyams myong na/ /rnal 'byor pa ru mi 'gyur te/ /gzhon nu ma ni gzhan dag dang / /'dus pas bde ba bskyed pa yin/ /shes dang 4shes 26—1548

bya rnam zad pa/ /snyoms par 'jug ces brjod pa yin/ /skye ba med pa gang yin pa/ /de ni khu ba'i sgrar bshad do/ /snying rje gang su 'thung ba dang / /dam tshig rnams ni skyong ba dang / /bla med ye shes thob gyur pa/ /de ni ka pā la zhes brjod/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes su bshad / /ces bya ba la sogs pa 'byung ba dang / yang / sngags kyi bzlas pa med cing dka' thub med cing sbyin sreg med/ /de la dkyil 'khor med cing dkyil 'khor can yang med/ /de ni sngags bzlas te dka' thub dang de sbyin sreg /de ni dkyil 'khor can dang de ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /mdor bsdus 51nas ni sems su bye 'dus pa'i tshul can no/ /zhes 'byung ngo / /de lta bu'i lung nyung zhing mi gsal la rab tu 'thor ༄ 7ba des na rgyud nas rdo rje'i tshig tu zin pa zhes bya'o/ /mdor na de nyid chos thams cad kyi zab pa dang / rgya che ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pas/ lta ba ma lus pa'i gzhi'am/ lung thams cad kyi 'byung gnas sam/ rigs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ces bya'o/ /rigs pa'i ye shes rang las shar ba'am/ sgrib pa'i mun pa ma lus par sel bas/rnal 'byor gyi nyi zla zhes bya'o/ /dngos po rnams kyi mtha' 'am don gyi gting mthong bar byed pas rdo rje'i mig ces bya'o/ /chos thams cad kyi 'bab sa'am ro gcig tu ldugs 4pas lhan cig skyes pa'i rgya mtsho dang 5zhes bya'o/ /thams cad kyi khongs na gnas pa'am/ ma lus par bsreg trepar nus pas lhan cig skyes pa'i gtum mo zhes bya'o/ /mtshan ma rnams kyi srog 'gog pa'am bus pa nye bar 'jig 7pa'i gnas yin pas/ mthar thug pa'i dur khrod ces bya'o/ /gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gyi tshul nas thams cad mnyam pa 26—1549

dang / rtogs pa dang ma rtogs pa'i rkyen gyis sems can dang sangs rgyas yon tan mi mnyam pa ni zla ba'i dpes shes par bya'o/ /don la thams cad mnyam pa yang dpe de nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /nges don gyi man ngag bstan cing thob pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin cig car yin pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan rim gyis lku'abyung bar 'gyur ba ni/ rgyal ba'i 3bu'i dpes shes par bya'o/ /yang don la yon tan yang cig car du ldan pa'ang dpe de nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /thams cad kyis mnyam pa'am ma rtogs pa tsam gyis bsgribs te snyug bsngal la spyod pa ni/ dbul po'i lus kyi nor bu rin po che'i dpes shes par bya'o/ /rang bzhin de rgyu la ltos kyepa med pa la sogs pa dang / ma nor ba'i gdams ngag la rag las pa la sogs pa'ang dpe de nyid kyis shes par bya'o//gzhan yang chos thams cad kyi rgyu rkyen so sor ma 'dres pas phyal pa ma yin pa dang rkyen gyis bskyed pas rang gi ngo bo yang dag par yod pa ma yin pas/ mu stegs la sogs pa phyi rol pa dang mi 'dra ba ni/ sgyu ma dang rmi lam la sogs pa'i dpes shes par bya'o/ /don phyi nang dang bden brdzun la sogs pa gnyis su 4med pa'ang dpe de nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /mthar phyin pa'i man ngag ces bya ba yod pa dang / thams cad kyis rnyed par dka' ba dang / ji ltar rnyed pa'i don cig car ram rim gyis chobasten par bya ba dang / des thob pa'i yul la mi slu 6ba ni mi dang lha'i sman bzang po dang / mchog gi bdud rtsi'i dpes shes par bya'o/ /cig car du 'jug pa kun gyi yul ma yin pa dang /don log par rtogs na slar gnod par 'gyur ba la sogs pa yang dpe 7nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /de la sogs pa'i dpe don gyi yan lag ma nor ba'i bshad 26—1550

pas / don gyi snying po brgyan cing yid ches pa bstan par bya'o/ /'dir bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa/ rin chen brtag phyir ka shi ka yi rdo/ /shes ldan bu la pha yis gzhag pa ltar/ /mu stegs sangs rgyas bar ma do rtogs phyir/ /rten 'byel phyag rgya thub pas 'khor la bzhag /lung gi dag byed rigs ༄1pa bzang po ste/ /rigs pa bde skyed lung gi snang bar gsungs/ /lung rigs bzang las don gyi snying po mthong / /de las gzhan du nam yang srid pa min/ /thog mar bde gshegs yon tan mos par 'gyur/ /de 'og de 'grub rgyu yi chos la mos/ /de 'og ston byed bla ma la gus 'gyur/ /mthar ni rang sems dag la dga' dang skye/ /'bar ba'i me dbus myu gu skabs rnged ltar/ /mi khom gnas su dal 'byor ji ltar 'thob/ /de phyir dge bcu'i rtog pa 'di bzang ste//mi dge las kyi rnam rtog de lta min/ /lcags dang gser las byas pa'i lu gu rgyud//'ching bar 'dra yang de nyid khyad par che/ /de phyir lung las dus gsum dge ba'i tshig /nga yi yin zhes kun la khyab par bstan/ /legs par gsungs pa'i dam chos 'dul ba las/ /mi rtag bdag med yul gyi dngos po la/ /yan lag dang bral dngos gzhi nyes med gsung / /de phyir jeg chen sngags kyi tshul du yang / /dus gzhan gang zag gzhan dang yul gzhan dang / /thabs gzhan dang ni don gzhan dgongs pa yis/ /'gal zhing 'gog pa cung zad ma gsungs te/ /dge slong rdor 'dzin des na mchog tu gsungs/ /de phyir rgyud don dpag bsam shing dang ni/ /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang po dang 2 //sngags don rig pa'i bla ma rnams gsungs te/ / sen da'i 1sgra dang chom rkun sgra bzhin no/ /ji ltar sman mchog nad pa'i bye brag gis/ /'ba' zhig dang ni 26—1531

'dren mar byin pa yis/ /zhu dang ma zhu mthu yi khyad par snang / /dam chos sman yang de 'drar bla ma gsungs/ /rang rig sgyu 'phrul bde ba chen po'i ngang / /ma rig sgyu 'phrul sdug bsngal thog mtha' med/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ /srid dang rnam grol gcig dang tha dad min/ /gzhan yang dpe ni rtogs pa'i dug tsam ste/ /yang dag tu na bcings pa lhagang yang med/ /des na chos kun blo ldan cig shos la/ /grub dang sgrub pa bstan pa de 'dir 'thad / /ji ltar dpa' bo thogs med 'gro ba yang / /dman pa'i don phyir ngal sol rim gyis 'jug /de bzhin mkhas pa chags pa'i gnas rnged kyang / /blo ldan 2don phyir grub mtha' rim gyis skyong / /de nyid phyir na rnal 'byor chen pos kyang / /thog mar 'ga' la don kyi snying po bstan/ /gdul bya dman gzigs phyi nas rim pa yang / /du ma mdzad de yang dag bzhed min gzung / /blo yi rim pas don gyi khyad par len/ /de las gzhan du skye bo 'dod rgyal gzhung / /dang po'i las pas nyon mongs lam 'jug pa/ /bdud kyi sder gsungs thar cing grol ba med/ /bkres pa zhi phyir ring du rgyug pa dang / /skom pa bsal phyir lan tshwa'i chu 'thung dang / /snyan par 'dod phyir pha ma gsod pa dang / /bde ba 'dod phyir rang srog 'dor ba 'dra/ /mi bzad dug gis nad kun zhi byed par/ /sman pa'i mchog ste phal pa rnams kyis min/ /'bar ba rnge yis khrus kyi las byed pa/ /gtsang sbra can de ri dwags kun gyis min/ /ke ta ka zos lci ba sman gyur pa / /spos kyi glang chen ba lang gzhan gyis min/ /snying rje'i mthu thob rang lus chags gred dang / /ting 'dzin dbang thob snang ba bsgyur 4nus dang / /mnyam nyid gdeng thob 'khrul pa zil gnon pa'i/ /26—/pya32

dam pas yul spyad grol te gzhan gyis min/ /de phyir snyigs ma'i dus 'dir slob ma yis/ /yang dag bla ma btsal ba ched che ste/ /de log na ni thams cad log par 'gyur/ /log pa'i lam gyi srid mtshor yun ring 'khyams/ /zhes bya ba'o / /de ltar na chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mthar rtogs pas/ lam dang lam ma yin pa bye brag shin tu phyed pa dang theg pa gsum du phye yang don mi 'gal bar bstan pa khong du chud pas 'dren pa rnams kyi bstan pa la gus par yid ches pa dang / tshad ma gsum gyis chos rnams bdag med par gtan ༄1la phebs pas don la thams cad mnyam pa nyid du shes shing gdeng du gyur pa ni yang dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa ste/ 'joms byed seng ge bdag gi gzhung / /zhes bya ba'o/ /de lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid rtogs shing nyams su lon pa med par tha snyad tsam la brten nas/ rnal 'byor du mchis shing / log pa'i lam la 'jug pa ni/ phyin ci log gi g.yangs sa bskor ba'i phyir rab tu yang nyam nang bar snang ngo / /rgyud las kyang /phyi ma'i dus kyi rnal 'byor spyod mang dag /brkam 4zhing rab gtum ma bsdams 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sdig la rab dga' rnal 'byor yo byad chags/ /rgyud chen 'di dang bzhi pa 'di spong 'gyur/ /rgod cing dbang po g.yengs la phrag dog can/ /gnas la chags shing rnyed la 'dod pa dag /sbyor ba byed pa'i skabs la rtag tu gnas/ /bzhi pa 'di ni rab tu spong bar 'gyur/ /rkang lag brdebs 5shing kha ni gya tshom smra/ /rtse 'jo la zhen dgod 7la rtag par 8 zhugs / /gcig la gcig gis mgul 'khyud lag kyang sbrel/ /grong du 'jug na spyod lam gzhan du chos7/ /mi rigs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid 'di dag ste/ /26—1503

gzhan gyi bu mo la yang rtag tu chags/ /gzugs kyis rgyags shing mdud pa bor ba yin/ /grong dang gong khyer yul 'khor kun du rgyu/ /de dag bza' dang btung ba rab tu zhugs/ /glu dang bro gar de bzhin rol mo dang / /nyo tshong lhag par byed cing rab tu brtson/ /btung ba dag la chags shing ngo tsha bor /mi rigs brtson pas spring 1yig bsgur bar byed/ /dam tshig de bzhin spyod lam btang nas ni/ /khyem pa dag dang bsten 2cing dam dral nas/ /de dag dam tshig shin tu log par gnas/ /las gang rdo rje 'chang gis rtag smad pa/ /srang dang tshad la g.yo sgyu byed pa dang / /de 'dra'i sdig pa nyon mongs las byas pas / /las ngan byed pa de dag ngan song 'gro/ /dung dang gser dang nor bu mang ba dang / /khyem dang gnyen bshes rnams spangs dkyil 'khor zhugs / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di la nges byung nas/ /sdeg pa'i las rnams shin tu spyod par byed/ /nor dang 'bru la snying por 'du shes shing / /bzhon dang ba lang shing rta rnams la chags/ /gang la rnal 'byor nan tan med pa rnams/ /de dag gis kyang ci phyir dkyil 'khor zhugs/ /ngas ni sngon tshe rnal 'byor spyod pa na/ /lus dang srog la rab tu ma bltas par/ /nga yis ting 'dzin bzhi pa 'di btsal na/ /de dag de tshe 'di thos gad 4mos 'debs//bzod pa spangs nas rab tu spros par byed/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa nged yin tshig tu smra/ /dam tshig nyams la byang chub ga la yod/ /dam tshig dral nas byang chub 'di thob pa/ /ngas ni ma thos nam yang yod ma mthong / /shes rab dman zhing yon tan rab spangs pa/ /rgyud chen mchog gi nyes pa rtag tu brjod//'tsho ba med pa mang po rnal 'byor byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rnam pa kun mi 26—/pya54

'dod / /byis pa de dag bdag tu lta la chags/ /stong pa nyid ni thos na skrag par 'gyur/ /gang dag dam tshig srung zhing yon tan ldan/ /byams la gnas shing rtag tu bzod rtog pa/ /mnyen zhing des pa shin tu bsdams pa rnams / /de dag de tshe yongs su brnyas par 'gyur/ /gang yang shin tu dam bral sems ldan dang / /mi bzad ma rungs ngan pa'i las byed pa/ /dam tshig ma yin spyod cing 'thab la dga'/ /de dag de yi dus na rtsod par 'gyur/ /yang dag mchog gis gsang chen 'dir zhugs nas/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa yin zer zhing / /bya ba ma yin kun la 'jug /'jig rten sun byed rkun po 'byung / /'jig rten dbugs ni dbyung 1 ngo zhes/ /mgo la chu rgyun ldugs —par byed/ /cod pan rdo rje dril bu sogs/ /mgo la lag pas rab tu 'dzin/ /de rjes de ni 'tsho ba sgrub/ /kha cig slob ma'i tshogs sdud cing / /nga yi tshig ni 'di nyid dag /yin zhes zer zhing byis pa 'jig /gsang ba log par rab tu ston/ /kha cig bas mthar rab 'khod cing / /bdag med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /skad byug tsam yang mi gnas par/ /'jig rten sngags sogs sgrub par byed/ /kha cig slong 4mos rgyu byed cing / /kun du 'gro zhing gya tshom smra / /mi mo rnams la rab tu chags/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig rab tu 'jig /kha cig grong du 'khod byed cing / /bza' dang btung la rab tu chags/ /khye'u dang bu mo phal mang dang / /dgod cing rab tu rtse bar byed/ /kha cig rol mo zlos gar dang / /glu dang rgyan po 'gyed byed dang / /'dus pa'i tshogs la lta byed cing / /bzo 5yi gnas la 6rab tu slob/ /kha cig tshong dang zhing las dang / /glang po ba lang sogs byed cing / /shing rta la sogs 'dren 26—1555

pa dang / /nyes pa mang po rab tu byed/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor spyod pa yi/ /dge spyong dang ni dge spyong ma/ /dge bsnyen ma dang dge bsnyen dag /phan tshun mtshon gyis rab tu 'debs/ /legs par gsungs pa'i 'dul ba la/ /rab tu mi gnas srung mi byed/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sun 'byen cing / /phas pham la sogs rab tu byed/ /gang gis btung ba'i mchog mi shes/ /sā lu la sogs bcos sbyar ba'i/ /myos pa'i khu ba 'thung byed cing / /de yis phung khrol rab tu bskyed/ /gang dag tha snyad tsam cig la/ /brten te mi dge'i las bcu spyod/ /de dag 'go ba ci 'dra ba/ /'dren pa yis kyang ga la rtogs / /zhes 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang seng ge la dper bzhag pa ni don mthun pa mang du yod de/ 'di ltar byang chub kyi sems ni 'khor ba ma rtogs pa'i dus na yang / rang bzhin gyis mthu dang ldan pa dang / byang chub kyi sems rtogs shing skyes ma thag tu gzhan zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu dang ldan pa dang / byang chub kyi sems goms pa mthar phyin pa'i dus na mi mthun pa rtsad nas 'joms pa'i mthu dang ldan pa dang / de dang ldan pa'i dam pa dkon pa dang / /de dpa' ba dang / de stong pa nyid kyi ri dang / rdzong la gnas pa dang / de bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs pa dang / de rang gi rgyud legs par 'jog pa la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar gzhung dag las kyang / ji ltar khyung dang seng ge'i bu/ /mngal dang sgo ngas bsgribs gyur 1kyang / /rang la yod pa'i rtsal gyis ni/ /gnyen por 'gyur ba'i mthu stobs ldan/ /byang chub sems la 'jug pa dang / /de bzhin smon par byed pa ni/ /mun pa lo stong lon pa yang //sgron me gcig gis sel bar byed/ /de bzhin seng ge'i / phru gus kyang / /shin 26—1556

—tu rgas pa'i gcan gzan 'jigs/ /gcan gzan rgyal po gcig pus kyang / /glang chen dregs khyu'i klad pa 'gems/ /sa la seng ge khyus 'khod sngon ma byung / /sang zag dam pa khyus 'khod sngon ma byung / /dpa' bo seng ge lta bur 'jigs 1 me+ed spyod/ /ces bya ba dang / dper na seng ge ri sul brten nas 'jigs med par/ /ri dwags phra mo mang skrag byed cing sgra sgrogs ltar/ /mi yi seng ge shes rab pha rol phyin brten nas/ /mu stegs can mang skrag byed 'jig rten sgra yang sgrog /ces 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang seng ge kho na la dper bzhag pa ni/seng ge ni ri dwags gzhan gyis gzhom par mi nus shing / mthar rang gi rkyen kyis 'chi bar 'gyur te/ de'i ro yang gzhan gyis bshig par mi nus la/rang nyid kyi ༄phung po lhag ma med par 'jig par 'gyur ba bzhin du/ chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i rnal 'byor pa yang de ltar shes par bya'o//de yang so sor rtog pa'i ye shes me dang 'dra ba dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i nying nge 'dzin lam dang 'dra ba dang / de bzhin nyid dmigs kyi ting nge 'dzin chu dang 'dra ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor la mi gnas par gnas pa'i tshul gyis/ yun ring du goms pa'i rkyen gyis mi mthun pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / gnyen po'i phyogs kyi rnam par rtog pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi 5rnam par rtog pa dang / 'bras bu'i rnam nga/ra rtog pa thams cad spangs te/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi go 'phang 6 thob nas gang ci la yang gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa/ji ltar nad med rtsis ni khyab pa yi/ /tha mal zas kyang sman gyi mchog yin ltar/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyis zin pa yi/ /bskyed rdzogs thams cad yang 26—1557

dag lam yin no/ /dba' 1dang yan dang gzung dang btang snab dang / /bskyil dang gzhug dang lta dang bsre la sogs/ /gnad kyi man ngag gang la goms byas kyang / /slu ba med de yang dag lam yin no/ /mi shes mi gnas mnyam pa nyid kyi 1nga / /dus rnams kun shes re dogs med pa'i blo/ /mthar thug don gyi dgongs pa de yin te/ /thig le chen po yi ge med pa'i lha/ /bskal pa du mar dge tshogs spyad pa'i mthus/ /byang chub sems kyi gdams ngag 'di thos na/ /rin chen rdo las bdud rtsi'i chu 'byung bzhin/ /dad pa'i mchi ma sems kyi gting nas 'byung / /ngang pa'i tshogs ni mkha' la kun du rgyu/ /gang la mdas phog de ni sa la ltung / /bus pa bde 'dod brdzun pa'i yul la rgyug /man ngag mtshon phog rnal 'byor shi dang 'dra/ /'jig rten byed spyod khe dang grags pa kun/ /rmi lam brag ca'i sa dang 'drar gzigs nas/ /chags gred thugs rje don dam khrong na 'phyo/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig a wa dhū tī yin / /rang bzhin stong pa stong pas rnam dben pa4/ /rtog pa'i gang zag chad pa'i lam gyis 'jigs/ /bde ba'i thang la mi shes mgon po'i tshogs/ /mtshan mo rgyu ba g.yas sogs dgos par ldan/ /srid pa'i glang chen 'khrul pa kun bcom nas/ /rtog med lcun grub dus gsum mnyam pa'i rdzing / /rig pa'i seng ge rang srog de ru 'dor/ /rang rgyud rtsal gyis bdag med sgra chen sgrogs / /ji ltar chu ni me yi gnyen po ste/ /rgya mtsho'i chu 'khor dag las me yang 'bar/ /de ltar skye med skye ba'i gnyen po ste/ /ma skyes chos la sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung / /de lta'i don la skye ba yod dam med/ /thub la gzhan don mdzad dam 'on te min/ /smra bsam las 'das rnam pa kun gyi mchog /de 26—1558

phyir snying po'i don la yid ches byes/ /zhes bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid thams cad kyi khyab byed du gyur pa de ni/ gzhung las kyang / de ni ngag gis 'jug pa med/ /rang rig pa yang med pa ste/ /blo ni tshu rol dag tu brlag /de ni shin tu zab pa yin/ /dngos dang dngos med spangs gsal gang / /lhan cig skyes las pha rol gyur/ /grogs mo bdag gis smras pa'o/ /der ni brtan gyis g.yo ma byed/ /don 'di thub dbang spyod yul lo/ / /zhes pa dang / yang rgyud las/ ji ltar nam mkha' phyogs rnams na/ /kun la rtag par mi gnas pa/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad la/ /gsang sngags mgon po mi gnas so/ /ji ltar dngos rnams nam mkha' la/ /gnas shing rtag tu rnam snang yang / /de ni gnas su mi 'gyur ba/ /gsang sngags mgon po'ang de bzhin notsho/ /nam mkha' dus gsum la sogs dang / /ji lta ra bral bar 'dod pa bzhin/ /de ltar gsang sngags mgon po yang / /dus gsum med kyang rnam par snang / /ming tsam du ni gdags pa'i gnas/ /byed nga/ po la sogs dang bral/ /nam mkha' la ni tha snyad du/ /mkhas pa rnams ni 'dogs par byed/ /ming ma gtogs pa cung zad kyang / /yod pa ma yin nam mkha' bzhin/ /de bzhin gsang sngags dbang phyug kyang / /tha snyad tsam du snang bar zad/ /me dang chu dang rlung ma yin/ /sa dang nyi ma'ang ma yin zhing / /zla ba la sogs gza' kun min/ /nyin par ma yin mtshan mo'ang min//skye ba ma yin 'gag pa'ang min/ /'chi ba dang ni rgud pa'ang min/ /skad cig ma yin yud tsam min/ /lo la sogs pa 2ma yin zhing / /'jig pa dang ni 'chags pa'ang min/ /bskal pa'i grangs kyang yod ma yin/ /dge dang mi dge las byung 26—1559

ba'i / /dbus su yod pa'ang ma yin no/ /kun mkhyen go 'phang 'dod pa yis/ /rtog pa rnam pa 7sna tshogs pa/ /de kun gang la'ang med 'gyur ba/ /de la rtas tu brtson par bya/ /zhes pa dang / yang rgyud las/ rnam par shes pa chos nyid 'das/ /ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang ba/ /rnam par mi rtog lhun gyes grub / /dus gsum sangs rgyas las byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med//ces bya ba la sogs pa zab cing rgya che bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag gi gzhung zhes gsungs pa ni/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus su zab mo'i don la mos pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma'i rgyud gzung ba'i phyir/ bla ma brgyud pa'i 'grel kepa bstan pa ste / 'di ltar don dam par chos thams cad gang du gami gnas par ston pa'i gzhung lho phyogs kyi nags tshal du dpal ri khrod rdo cerje'i zhal snga nas/ bdag gis rnyed pa yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'dir tshigs su bcad pa/ 'dren pa rnams kyis dus gsum bstan pa ni/ /don dam gnyis med byang chub sems nyid de/ /thub pa'i bstan pa thams cad ro gcig pas/ /phyogs ris med par sde snod gsum du ltos/ /rigs pa'i gzer ldan bstan bcos bzang por ltos / /yid ches man ngag grub pa'i gzhung du ltos/ /de dag rnams rgo blta 5bar mi nus pas/ /brgyud pa'i gdams ngag snying po 'di la ltos/ /zhes so/ /yang dag pa'i man ngag sba ba dang / gtad pa'i gnas kyang 'di ltar gzhung las / tha snyad tshig gi nga rgyal gyis/ /bla ma mi bsten bsnyen bkur med/ /dman pa'i lta ba la mos te/ /sbas gsum lta zhen mi gtong zhing / /mthar thug don la mi smos te/ /rigs pa gtsor byed shes rab kyis/ /mthar thug zab mo sun 'byin pa/ /de la 'di nyid bstan mi bya/ /gang zhig bla ma bsnyen 26—1560

bkur zhing / /thams cad stong pas mi skrag bzod/ /mthar thug don la dad mo/sa la/ /de la bla ma'i drin sbyin bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir don nye bar bsdu na/ mdor na chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni ma skyes pa dang / thams cad mnyam pa nyid do/ /sgrub thabs ni/ de'i don ni phyin ci ma log par rtogs shing 'dris pa'o/ /thob pa ni gdeng du gyur pas phyir mi ldog go/ /de ltar mi gnas seng ge'i don / /'gro ba gang gis shes gyur pa/ /log lta'i glang po myur bcom ste/ /rnam grol lam las phyir mi ldog /chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par ston nga/'i de kho na nyid tshigs su bcad pa phyed kyi 'grel pa dpal a wa dhū tī'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //nye bsdur mchan/1534 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga drang nges kyi 'grel pa bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyes pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7de/1535 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)sa/ rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaradi ltar/ 4 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags—/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rang / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartags/1536 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanang / 2—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gim/1537 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 2〈〈snar 〉snga tags/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉khron/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge la/1538 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrubs/ nya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kyi/ 〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kyi/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rim/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thaslu ba/9〈〈snar 〉sngasangs/26—1561
