༄/ /phyag rgya chen po'i man ngagashe༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra u pa de shaṃ/ bod skad du/phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag /dpal lhan cig skyes pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag rgya chen po bstan du med gyur kyang / /dka' ba spyod cing bla ma la gus pa'i//sdug bsngal bzod ldan blo ldan nā ro pa/ /skal ldan khyod kyi snying la 'di ltar byos/ /kye ho 'jig rten chos la legs ltos dang / /rtag mi thub ste rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin/ /des na skyo bskyed 'jig rten bya ba thong / /'khor g.yog chags sdang nye 'brel kun spongs la/ /gcig pu nags 'dab ri khrod dgon par bsgoms/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ /thob med thob na phyag rgya chen po thob/ /'khor ba'i chos 'dis 9don med chags sdang rgyu/ /byas chos snying po med pas don dam snying po ltos/ /blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong / /byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rnyed/ /26—1621

blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na/ /rang sems rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dngas su chug /snang ba dgag sgrub 1mi bya rang sor zhog /spong len med na phyag rgya chen por grol/ /dper na ljon shing yal ga lo 'dab rgyas/ /rtsa bcad yal ga lo 'dab khri 'bum skams2sna/ /dper na bskal stong bsags pa'i mun pa yang / /sgron me gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnams sel/ /de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal skad cig gis/ /bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus sel/ /blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na/ /rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud —la bor/ /lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis/ /rig pa dang la mi gnas bar du gcunaje/ /dper na nam mkha'i dkyil ni brtag byas na/ /mtha' dang dbus su 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems kyis sems la brtag byas na/ /rnam rtog tshor 'gag rtog med gnas gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub 7sems kyi rang bzhin mthong / /dper na sa rlangs sprin ni nam mkhar dengs/ /gar yang song med gar yang gnas pa med/ /de bzhin sems las byung ba'i rtog kyetshogs kyang / /rang sems mthong bas rtog pa'i dba' rlabs dengs/ /dper na nam mkha' kha dog dbyibs las 'das/ /dkar nag dag gis gos med 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin rang sems dz+wakha dog dbyibs las 'das/ /dge sdig dkar gnag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /dper na gsal dag nyi ma'i snying po de/ /bskal pa stong gi mun pas bsgribs mi nus/ /de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de/ /bskal pa'i 'khor bas bsgribs 9par mi nus so/ /dper na nam mkha' stong par rab brtags kyang / /nam mkha' la ni 'di 'dra brjod 26—1622

du med/ /de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang / /brjod par 'di 'dra grub ces brtag rtesnagazhi med/ /dper na nam mkha' gang la gang gis brten—/ /de bzhin rang sems phyag chen rten yul med/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la rnguzhog /bcings pa glod gyur grol bar je tshom med/ /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos rnams ma lus de ru ma 'dus med/ /lus kyi bya ba yo thong rnal mar zhog /ngag gi smra brjod ma mang brag ca 'dra/ /yid la mi sems la bzla'i snyechos la ltos/ /lus la snying po med pas smyug chesdong 'dra/ /sems ni nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsam yul 'das / /de dang btang gzhag med par glod la snyezhog /sems la gtad so med na phyag chen yin/ /de la goms pas bla med byang chub 'thob/ /dmigs pa'i yul med sems kyi rang bzhin gsal/ /bgrod pa'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin/ /bsgom med goms pas bla med byang chub 'thob/ /gzung stso'adzin kun 'das lta ba'i rgyal po yin/ / yengs pa med na bsgom pa'i rgyal po yin/ /klu bya brtsal 37rnged na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin/ /re dogs med na 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /kun gzhi skye rnged bag chags sgrib g.yogs bral/ /mnyam rjes mi bya skye med snying por zhog /snang ba rang snang blo yi chos rnams zad//myu mtha' yongs grol lta ba'i rgyal po yin/ /mu med gting yangs bsgom pa'i rgyal po mchog /byar med rang gnas spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog /re med rang gnas 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog /las ni dang po gcong rong chu dang 'dra//bar du chu bo gaṅgā dal bus 'bab/ /tha ma chu bran ma bu phrad pa 'dra/ /sngags su smra dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /'dul ba'i sde snod la sogs chos rnams dang //26—1623

rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis kyang / /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur/ /yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral/ /rang byung rang zhi chu yi dba' rlabs 'dra/ /zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs4/ /rtogs pa bsrung sdom dam tshig don las nyams/ /mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na/ /dam pa nyams len mun pa'i sgron me yin/ /zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas na/ /sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur//don 'dir gzhol na 'khor ba'i btson las thar/ /don 'dis mnyam gzhag ma lus sdig sgrib bsreg2 /bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin/ /don 'dir mi mos skye bo blun po rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu bos rtag tu khyer bar zad/ /ngan song snyug bsngal mi bzod snyeng re rje/ /snyug bsngal thar 'dod bla ma mkhas pa bsten/ /byin rlabs ri zhugs pas rang sems grol bar 'gyur/ /las rgya bsten na bde stong ye shes 'char/ /thabs dang shes rab byin rlabs zisnyoms par zhugs/ /dal bar dbab cing dkyil 'khor drang ba dang / /gnas su bskyal dang lus la khyab par bya/ /de la zhen med bde stong ye shes 'char/ /tshe ring skra dkar med cing zla ltar rgyas/ /bkrag mdangs gsal zhing stobs kyang seng ge 'dra/ /thun mong dngos grub myur thob mchog la gzhol/ /phyag rgya chen po gnad kyi gdams pa 'di/ /'gro ba skal ldan snying la gnas par shog /dpal til+li pas na 5ro pa la chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du gsungs pa 6rdzogs so// //rdzo6—/624

༄༅/ /lta ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dṛṣ+ṭi saṃ k+ṣep+ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ lta ba mdor bsnyus pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo thams cad mkhyen nyid skyob pa'i gtso/ /'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung dang rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /dngos don bsdus te gtan la dbab/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang rig sems ni gud na med/ /snang zhing gsal ba yin pa'i phyir/ /dper na rang rig nyams myong bzhin/ /gal te sems de ma yin na/ /'byel pa med phyir mi snang thal/ /de ltar kun rdzob gtan la dbab/ /chos kun sems la gnas zhes gsungs/ /chos kyi dngos gzhi sems nyid de/ /rig pa bzhi sogs kyis dpyad kyang / /dngos po sgra yi cha tsam med/ /dper na nam mkha'i pad+ma bzhin/ /de ltar yod pa ma grub phyir/ /med pa cung zad grub mi 'gyur/ /phan tshun ltos pa nyid kyi phyir/ /26—1626

tshu rol ma grub pha rol bzhin/ /yod med gnyis ka ma yin te/ /so so nyid du bkag phyir ro/ /gnyis ka med pa ma yin te/ /yod med dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir/ /lus can yang ni ma yin la/ /lus can min pa mi srid phyir/ /des na spros pa thams cad bral/ /de ltar don dam gtan la dbab/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas gsungs/ /rang rig spros bral de nyid kyang / /snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang / /de phyir snang stong dbyer med de/ /dper na chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /de ltar gnyis med gtan la dbab/ /nam mkha' ci la'ang mi gnas gsungs/ /rang bzhin spros bral de nyid ni/ /rig pa yin phyir gsal ba'o/ /rang rig min phyir mi rtog ste/ /rang rig rang la rtog mi srid / /rnam par rtog bya min pa'i phyir/ /sems de'i rang bzhin mi rtog nyid / /gsal ba mi rtog ye shes te/ /dper na bde gshegs ye shes bzhin//des na sems nyid 'od gsal la/ /sems ni ye shes yin rtogs na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal gsungs/ /'on kyang sems de glo bur gyi/ /rnam rtog dri mas nyon mongs te/ /chu dang gser dang nam mkha' ltar/ /gnas skabs dag dang ma dag gnyis/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems de dang / /glo bur rnam rtog dri ma gnyis/ /gcig gam tha dad gang yin pa/ /shin tu zab pa chen po nyid/ /shin tu zab phyir mkhas pas dpyod/ /bshad pa yod kyang ma bris so/ /stong pa de nyid rig pa sems/ /byang chub sems kyang de nyid do/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyang de nyid yin/ /bde gshegs snying po de nyid de/ /ji bzhin pa yi ro myang bas/ /bde ba chen po'ang de nyid yin/ /gsang sngags zhes pa 'di nyid do/ /thabs dang shes rab de nyid la/ /zab dang rgya che de 26—1627

nyid yin/ /kun bzang yab yum de nyid do/ /nang stong dbyings dang ye shes las / /ye sangs rgya zhes de la bya/ /dri ma dang bcas rang rig de/ /de yang gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rang byung ye shes de nyid do/ /'khor ba'i dngos gzhi de nyid de/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang de nyid yin/ /dbu ma chen mo'ang de nyid do/ /mthong bar bya ba de nyid do/ /bsgom par bya ba'ang de nyid do/ /thob par bya ba'ang de nyid do/ /tshad ma'i bden pa'ang de nyid yin//rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu yi/ /rgyud ni rnam gsum grags pa dang / /gzhi lam 'bras bur grags pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni gnas skabs so/ /rgyu rkyen rtsa ba kun gzhi dang / /'khor ba ji srid phung po dang / /gzhan dbang shes pa la sogs grags/ /e ma ho/ sems nyid dri ma dang bcas de/ /rnam 'phrul 'gro ba drug la sogs/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor bsam las 'das/ /rnam rtog dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /rang rig spros bral de nyid ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang de nyid yin/ /sangs rgyas drug pa'ang de nyid do/ /rigs drug pa'ang de nyid do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'ang de nyid yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad de yin te/ /chos kyi sgu dang bde chen dang / /zung 'jug ces pa de nyid do/ /bzhi pa'i dbang yang de yin te/ /lhan cig skyes dga' de nyid do / /rang bzhin dag pa'ang de nyid la/ /de la sogs pa mdo rgyud las/ /rnam grangs tha snyad grags pa rnams/ /phal cher de la brten pa yin/ /ji ltar rigs par sbyar bar bya/ /e ma ho/ sems nyid dri ma sked pa de'i/ /rnam 'phrul gzugs sgur bsdus pa yi/ /zhing khams rnam par dag pa dang / /26—1628

dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul la sogs pa/ /ngo mtshar dngos gzhi de nyid de/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas khyab par snang / /rang sems de la rmongs pa yi/ /phyi rol mu stegs pa dag gis/ /bdag dang gtso bo la sogs zhes/ /grub mtha' log pa'i rgya mtshor zhugs/ /rang gi sde pa nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal sems tsam pa dag gis/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pa dang / /gnyis rnged yang dag nyid du rtogs/ /gzhan yang rnam bden rnam brdzun sogs/ /rnam rtog dra bar tshud par 'gyur/ /de ltar lta ba ma nor na/ /bsgom pa dang be+e spyod pa dag /dngos dang mthun pas byang chub thob/ /dkyus bstan pa yi rta bzhin no/ /lta ba dngos dang ma mthun na/ /bsgom dang spyod pa 'khrul 'gyur bas/ /'bras bu ji bzhin mi 'thob ste/ /dmus long dmigs bu med pa bzhin/ /don dngos rgya mtsho ltar zab pas/ /khron pa'i sbal 'dra bdag gi blos/ /dpyod pas gting rnyed ga la 'gyur/ /nongs gyur mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /'di byas dge ba gang yin pas/ /skal ldan skye bo dam pa yi/ /'khrul pa'i dri ma rab spangs nas/ /rtogs pa'i shes rab skye bar shog/rje na ro pa'i lta ba ma dor bsdus pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //26—1629

༄ga /phrag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba/nya ༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ a shing hūṃm hā mu dra nā ju ma/ bod skad du/phyag rgya chen po bsam kyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye 'gag med pa'i chos nyid 'od gsal ni/ /smra bsam brjod med phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /ngos gzung ④dang bral yid la mi byed pa'ortsi/ /zab zhi 'u'adus ma byas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ rdo rje dbyer med skye 'jig bral/ /drag pos lha khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad 8'dul/ /mun khung gter la sgron me ltar/ /ma rig sbubs nas spurang rig gsal/ /chos kun rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /sems nyid rang byung ye shes te/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i thugs/ /de nyid ji bzhin rtogs gyur na/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni de la bya/ /gdod nas gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /grub med sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /de ltar 26—1631

rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gdal khyab sa nyel 'bad pa med/ /zag med rnam gol ngang du gdab2/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'di kho na/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs 'phro 'du rnams/ /ched du ma byas ngang nas zushar/ /'od gsal chu bo'i dba' rlabs kyi4/ /ngo mtshar rnam sprul ltabasam mi khyab/ /de phyir chos rnams sna tshogs kun/ /ji bzhin ma yin 6ma bcos bzhin du snang dz+wa/ /nyon mongs lnga sogs rang bzhin rnams/ /rnam grol ye shes chen por shar/ /de nyid mngon gyur brtan pa nasgo/ /mi zad rgyan gyi she'akhor lo snang rka/ /gnyis snang rnam pa mi mnga' bas/ /rang pa byedon rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /'khor ba'i rnam rtog sna tshogs las/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang ye shes 'byung / /rang bzhin ma skyes yum gyi klong / /ma 'gags shar ba yab kyi mkha'/ /de ltar gnyis med bde ba ni/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i dgongs pa yin/ /bya byed rig pa'i rtsol ba rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor ba'i nyom/ mongs dug gsum 'di/ /lhun grub ma bcos sku gsung thugs/ /'dus byas phung po'i rang bzhin ni/ /zag med rnam par grol ba dang 1 / /sna tshogs snang ba'i 'khor lo 'dibe/ /rang bzhin spyod pa sgyu ma'i grogs/ /gsang chen bla med dzeg pa 'di7/ /thabs dang shes rab phul du phyin/ /snang dang mi snang gnyis su med/ /'dzin pa bral ba de tsam mo/ /ji bzhin ma bcos sems nyid la/ /ma yengs bcos bslad samed par gnas/ /des na gsang ba'i snying po ni/ /tshig gi 7brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /rang lus dben pa'i dgon pa der/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i yo byad 'dzin/ /sems nyid 36—1632

rin chen za ma tog /chags bral nam mkha' ltar du tsho'achar/ /snang ba sgyur byed rnal 'byor pa/ / rin chen mdzes 2pa sna tshogs la/ /'phrul dga' lta bur snang bas —snan/ /don du mi 'gyur yongs ma gsungs / /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba'i sems/ /rtogs par 'dod pa dgad sabro ang / /khams gsum ye nas rgyal ba'i sgu/ /'khor ba myang 'das gnyis su med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rang gi 6sems/ /'bad cing rtsol ba'i nang dang bral/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dbyer med la/ /spong len mtshan ma 'dod pa ci/ /de nyid rang gsal 'dzin pa med/ /'dzin med grub mtha' lta ba bral/ /sems kyi ge mre long de gsal ba/ /sngags 'chang dgongs pa mnyam pa nyid dā// /rang la gnas pas gzhan du min/ /rgyun du gnas kyang gting 9dpag dka'/ /rtsol sgrub bral bar yongs la khyab/ /dngos su mthong ba bla ma'i drin/ /ma skyes spros bral sems nyid ni 7// /kha dog dbyibs dang gnas rig bral/ /zab cing rgya che gsal bar ldan/ /brtan g.yo ma lus de ltar byos/ /'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas te/ /gsal bar yod kyang rtogs pa med/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen de/ /spubs na mkha' lding phru gu 'dra/ /dam pa mnyes byed skyes bu yis/ /bde 1— gshegs dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i don/ /dug gsum sku gsung thugs su dag /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du rgyu/ /zeg chen gsang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /spyod pa'i khyad par ci spyad kyang / /tshogs bsgyur 1— len med 'dzin dang bral/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang bar zhugs/ /sku gsung yon tan phrin las la/ /'od gsal ye shes snyoms mdzad pa/ /bdag gzhan gnyis kyi na'adod pa sgrub/ /thugs rjes khams gsum sgrol la 26—/633

brtson tsho / /rol pa'i ye shes dgyes pa las/ /thabs chen zab mo'i jeg pa spro/ /mi zad bsdu 3ba zung du 'jug /de ltar mnyam spyod d+ngha —rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tidze+e 3pas go ri shar ba'i phyargyal po'i khab tu rnal 'byor pa la gdams pa/ rang bzhin bsam kyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thi⑥ klu sto /mthu can la gdams pa bzhugs/thu ༄go/ /gdug kye/pa tshar gcod ye shes chen po'i klong / /rab 'bar 'jigs byed te ru ka la 'dud/ /thabs dang ldan pa rnal 'byor chen po'i gzhung / /ma lus rgyal ba'i rjes su 'jug par bya dwa / /sdang ba'i sems can zhi bas skyemi 'dul ba/ /gnyen pos tshar gcod ⑫phrin las chen po'i lugs/ /bla ma la smod thubastan la sdang sogs la/ /rang gzhan gol phyir bsgral ba'i sbyor ba tsam/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor chos kun ni / /ro gcig zhi bas sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras snye bcad/ /thabs ldan lcags kyus 'khor lo rmyephung po dgug /thugs rje'i ⑩lcid mnan shes rab mtshon gyis dral/ /chu shing kha phye ma rig mun pa bsalaskye/ /ye shes 'od kyis 'byung ba rim par hūṃ1sbyangs/ /de sems gsal ba bye nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ / a hūṃ sbyor bas 'od kyi 3sems dpa'i tshul/ /'og min gnas su ya tsayis rab tu bskul/ /gnyis med rgyal ba'i —snyesras gyur rdo rje sems/ /rig pa'i dbang bskur gzhan don mdzad pa can/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i dpe byad ④rnams kyis sprasasnye/ /phung po la sogs 'byung ba dbang po rnams/ /mchod pa'i sprin du phyogs bcu gye khyab par spro/ /mnyam du sbyor bas de nyid nges pa yi/ /a yi rang bzhin thog mtha' med pa'i nang / / ta la mngon ༄ snamatshon bris pa'i gzugs la blta/ /26dod1634

hūṃ bltas phur bus btab bskor rtsad nas bcad/ /—1phyag rgya'i snying po bdag po dgu 'das pas/ /go 'phang ster byed chags pas 5sdig pa sgol/ /thabs dang shes rab 'byel pa gsang ba'i thabs/ /dka' thub tshogs dang bral ba grub kyepa'i lam/ /nyi zla'i rtsi jezin zhe sdang bde bar thim/ /nyon mongs dran rtog shes rab snang bar 5gsal/ /goms pa'i spyor ba legs gzhag bstan gyepa yis / /rten med 'dzin pa bral ba ye shes lha/ /mnyam par sbyor bas 3zag med bde ba che/ /gnyis 'dzin bud shing me ltar rang tshig 'gyur/ /de ltar shes pa'i skyes bu 'dzin pa dang / /'phel 'grib zag pa yod med la sogs pa/ /'ching grol khang hūṃpar sna tshogs snang ba kun/ /sgyu ma'i spyor ba rgyal ba'i mdzad pas tresnaganas/ /sbyor bas gdug ⑩pa ma lus bsgral bya zhing / /bsgral bas /1 bye med dbyings su nges par spyor/ /dngos po 15dngos med 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /spyod yul bral bas 6gsang ba'i lam mchog go/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i mthu rtsal ngan song lam/ /gnyis 'dzin zhen pas ⑩rang rgyud 'khor ba ste/ /de nyid med par grol ba srin po'i lasasnye/ /yang dag don la gnam sa lhalta bur 'gyur/ /thams cad rang byung byang chub sems yin pas/ /'di nyid ma skyes phyogs ris cha shas bral/ /ma dmigs mi dmigs dmigs su mred pa yiskye/ /phrin las chen pos /mi mthun dri ma sel/ /dgug dang bkug dang 'thab dang dgar /(/ba dang / /'dren dang 'dzin dang 'khyil bar ke bya ba ste/ /sbyangs ༄1dang spel ba'i las la legs brtsams pas trī/ /rgyun chad mred pa'i bde ba chen por 'gyur/ /gsang mchog zeg la 3dbyings la rab tu sdogs—/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye shes chen po'i sku/ /gang gis dpag par mi 26—1635

—nus bsam las 'das/ /rang byung mtha' dbus med pa snying po'i skyegasang / /dbang po dman dang rtog ge'i yul min zhing / /gang du 'ching ba'i las la spyad pas 3 kyang / /de nyid grol ba'i mchog ster rgyal sras lam/ /'phro 'du med pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug til+li pas / gyad kyi nor bu'i gong chodu mthu can la gdams pa phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thi 'u ga /glu mkhan la gdams pa bzhugs/dza ra tha/ / kye ho bye sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsang ba'i gsung / /mdzad pa rnam grol ye shes chen po la/ / dgyes mnyam rol pas she chos kyi phung po rnams/ /yid 'ong glu ru thub pas bka' stsal te / /gsang sngags brda yi tshig mthun spyobaka' lung can/ /zab mo'i skye/sgra sgrogs rnam dag sngags nyid de/ /lus can gdung ba sel ba bde ba'i sgra/ /grag stong gnyis su med pa zung 'jug dang / /snang ba sku la sgra tshig sna tshogs gsung / / mkhyen pa thugs la bya ba yon tan yin/ /mdzad pa phrin las ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang bzhin no/ /glu yi mkhan po mnyam gnas ngo bo'i sgu/ /thams cad sprul pas 'phro bar khyab par gsungs / /1 de nyid dbyer med ngang du 'dus rmepa thugs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la satha dad med pa yi/ /a yis mudrangs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi hurtesgra/ /ngo bo skye med brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /nga ro bcu drug rang byung /5dga' ba yin / /shes rab yum chen kho 1(nas 'dren pa'o/ /gsal byed 'dren pas mi 'byung tshig tu 'byel/ /thub pa'i dgongs pa gog gyur mkhyen pa gnyis/ /26—1636

thugs rjes spro phyir gsal ba'i tshig tu brgyus1/ /don chen ston pa glu yi tshig yin no/ /pho yis drangs nas mo yi rgyun dang ldan/ /gnyis med nga ro k+ṣegasal ba mtho dang dma'/ /sems byung rgyun 1gcod ngang du gnas par byed/ /de'u yi sgra ste 'dren pa glu yi rgyan5/ /sgra yis yid mtshon tshig gi 6don la sbyor/ /dgyes pa'i rang rtsal mi mthun phyogs las rgyal/ /gsang sngags bden pa'i ngag tu byin gyis rlob7/ /mi dmigs thugs rje mnyam pa'i dbyings las byung / /ye shes chen po sgyu mar 3rang snang bas/ /zag med snyan pa'i nga ro bsod nams tshogs—/ /gsang ba'i dbyings las rab tu 'phros gyur pa9/ /dkyil 'khor mtha' yas rnams la rol pas dbul/ /dbang po yul dus rags pa'i lku tshogs rnams dang / /'byung ba shes rab byang chub rdo rje ste/ /lhag pa'i ye shes de bzhin nyid mchog la/ / skal ba 7mnyam pa'i mnyes pa chen po'o1 / /de ltar glu yis 'jig rten gdung sel cing / /'jig rten 'das pa mnyes pa'i mchod pa ste/ /don du nges pa dag gi khurig byed can/ /mkhyen pa'i 'jug sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /snyug bsngal bde bar sbyar bas kimathu stobs can / /nyon mongs rnam grol ye shes chen po'i lam/ / las las ye shes 'byung bas 7'dzin pa med/ /nges par sbyor bas rdo rje'i tshitshig gi glu/ /rang bzhin gnyis med dgongs pa mtha' yas ston/ /de yi rgyu nyid don dam blo las 'das//'bras bu rol pa'i dkyil las 1narngam pa'i gdangs/ /mi dmigs thugs rje'i rtsal du rang shar ro/ /chos rnams ma lus sems su 'dus pa ste/ /sems las ma gtogs /9/shes bya gzhan me+ed pas — / /sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas rgyal ba'i thugs/ /'pho 'gyur med pas kye'aphel 'grib gol sa chod/ /rang byung 26—1637

dga' bas 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel/ /dngas ma rtser phyin mkhyen pa bsam mi khyab / /skye dgu'i bdag po tshangs pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /skyong ba'i glu mkhan tidze+e 1pa yin no / /kye/2 yon tan sgyu ma yin pas skyon la dngos ma grub/ /gnas la nges pa med pas 'pho 'gyur nyam mi nga / /sems la skye shi med de 'od gsal ngang / /dran rig sna tshogs ye shes rol pa'i rtsal/ /de ltar shes pas spang blang 'dzin pa med/ /rig pa'i ngo bo mnyam las ma g.yos par/ /dur khrod chen por sbyon pa'i spyod pa gyis/ /rnal 'byor rnams la nga yis lung bstan no / /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tidze+e pas/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tshong dus jesu glu mkhan la gdams pa rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thi 5 ༄ /mu stegs la gdams pa bzhugs/6 ༄go/ / a i 7rnal 'byor chen po kye/ /gnyis su med pa'i bde ba ni/ /rang byung rtsol ba bral ba ste/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ngo mtshar che/ /thabs chen rnam gnyis ma bstan par/ /de nyid rtogs pa med pa ste/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen la/ /'dod pa med pa'i tshul gyis rtogs/ /shes rab lcun gyis grub pa yi / /ye shes chen po bsam mi khyab/ /gnyis med lam gyi 9 'jug pa dang / /zung 'jug chen po rgyal ba'i thugs/ /sgrib med nyi ma gsal ba yis/ /dngos po ma lus snang 7bar byed / /don dam ye shes chen po la / /kun rdzob rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /mnyam nyid sems la goms pa ni/ /skyes bu seng ge lta bur brjid1 / /pad+ma 'dam gyi nyes dang bral/ /mi dbang ma yi lto na gnas/ /sel med shes pa ma bcos pa/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yin/ /gnyen pos bcos dang 26—1638

dgag pa med/ /rang lugs ye shes chen por gsal/ /mnyam pa'i gdeng dang ldan pa yis/ /dpa' bo mi mthun g.yul las rgyal/ /de ltar brtul zhugs spyod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor che la gnas par bya1/ /rma bya dug gis mdzes pa ltar/ /dpa' bo nyon mongs rgyan 2du 'gyur/ /rgyal ba gshegs yul phrin las bzhi/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pas shes mdzod/ /'dzin med ye shes chen po'i mes4/ /rtog pa'i bag chags sreg 5par byed/ /sgrib bral byang chub sems la ni/ /dri mas 6nam yang gos pa med/ /rin thang med pa'i 7nor bu de/ /bsod nams phun tshogs dag la mnga'/ /ldan min sems kyi gter mdzod de/ /bla ma'i drin thob rnams la gsal/ /rig byed sems kyi rnam pa ni/ /man ngag rim pas 8 thag bcad de/ /rang bzhin de ltar yid ches pas/ /rnam par mi rtog don dam mo/ /chos rnams nam mkha' mtshon pa ste//ngo bo sems kyi sheyul las 'das/ /smig 7rgyu'i rgyu yang nam mkha' la/ /sna tshogs snang ba de ltar byos/ /theg mchog yangs pa zab mo'i lam/ /dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das/ /chos kyi dbyings su mnyam pa yirka1/ /de nyid don chen blo la 'char/ /yod rnged sems kyi yul las 'das/ /re dogs 'dzin pa mtha' nas sangs/ /chos rnams du ma ro gcig phyir/ / sgom dang mi sgom 1 rtsol ba bral/ /sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /chos nyid gzhan du bsgom sbyimi dgos/ /yin par shes pa 5blo thag chod/ /spangs 7thob yon tan de tsam mo/ /rnam par rtog dang mi rtog kyang / /rang bzhin shes pas yongs 18mi nyams/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes pas // /rjes med bya lam bcos su med/ /mi mthun gnyen po 1dbyer med pa/ /de shes 'bad pa'i /blo 26—1639

dang bral/ /mnyam gzhag lkuchen po'i dgongs pa ste/ /gang la de yod rig pa can / /gcer bu ral pa'i gtsug phud can/ /las kyis 'phangs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'jig rten sa la mi dor 8zhing / /de nyid ye shes mthong ba med / /kun gzhi rnam dag dkar po la/ /snang ba sna tshogs ri mo bkra/ /ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' yi bar/ /shes rab sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /sprul tsam nyid na ma nges te/ /mnyam nyid rgyal po'i ngang la gnas/ /dbang bsgyur 4ye shes chen po ste/ /de nyid gzhan min bdag chopo nyid/ /sgra tshad lung gi 6mtshon cha yang / /skye med rang byung ngang nas shar/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug la sogs kyang / /yi ge 7shes par ma mthong ngo / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de//rtsol bas naring du spong 9gyur pas/ /rtsol ⑫med bla ma'i zhal las ni/ /legs nyes 11ring thang bral ba ltos/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po tikhra 7pas/rgyal po sang grags seng ge'i sgo drung du mu stegs pa la gdams pa chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thinyu // //sto /shan la pa gdams pa bzhugs/7 ༄77/ /e ma sangs rgyas e ma chos/ /e ma gtum po 1lhamadzad pa legs/ /e ma gsod pa shin tu zab/ /a a sdug bsngal gnas nas bsgral/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig ste/ /gsal zhing dngas pa thugs kyi rigs/ /rno zhing rtsub pas sa'abigs pa yang / /gang la bsnun pas 'joms par byed/ /ma skyes rdo rje ye shes kyang / /rno zhing 'bigs 7pa'i rang bzhin te/ /bsad shā)cing phrin las drag po yis/ /gdug pa ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /brtse zhing mkhas pa'i 1rternal 'byor pas/ /ci nus 26—1640

bsad snapa'i spyor ba brtsam/ /ngan song gsum du bka' stsal dang / /bsgral ba'i gnas lngar grags pa dang / /snying rje'i yul ni rnam pa gnyis/ /las dang dge bas rtebasdus pa'o/ /rang bzhin ye nas rnam dag kyang / /ma rtogs nyon mongs dbang gis ni/ /khams gsum sdug bsngal myong 'gyur la/ / bsad pas thar par ju bya phyir ro/ /de yi rig pa 'og min nam/ /sangs rgyas zhing las mi sdog pa'i/ /gnas su nges par byas pas 4ni/ /yon tan ldan pa'i gnas su'o/ /chos rnams ci yang min pa las/ /snying rjes bsad shā par dam bcas nas/ /chos kun 'dzin pa'i shes rab kyis/ /ji ltar rtogs shing 6goms pa las/ /yig 'bru 'od zer sna tshogs kyis7/ /sgrib pa sbyang 3bhezhing go 'phang bsgod bye/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes gsad par bya skru/ /de yis chos kun don gcig 11cing / /de rtsal sgrib pa'i bag chags choms/ /shes rab ting 'dzin dam tshig nyes/ /skye 'gyur dogs 1 pa med pas bsad ⑩/ /de bsad mchod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs mnyes/ /de 'ong sasems can don bya ste7/ /sdug bsngal gnas bsgral bsod nams tshogs/ /rang sems khyad par dam tshig nye/ /bdag nyu don phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ngan 'gro rnams kyi 18sgrib pa sbyangs/ /bsad pas nyu(byang chub lam la bkod 2 / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de ltar shes rab chen po yis/ /dngos 'dzin rdul tsam ma dmigs la/ /thabs su ma gyur gang yang med/ /mnyam par shes nas ci dga' gyis/ / 5ngang las ma g.yos snying rje yis/ /sna tshogs mdzad pa ston par byed/ /gsod pa'i spyor ba goms —5pa yis/ / sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul shes nas/ /yod med 26—164 1

dmigs pa las 'das pas/ /log rtog tsam la srog tu snang / /srog kyang med la gcad bya med/ /srog ni dngos por lta ba dang / /mtshan mar zhen nga/ rnams la snang / /de ltar mtshan ma bral ba dang / /snying rje'i blo can rnams la min/ /de ltar shes la spong len nam/ /'jug dang rtsol bas len mi 'gyur//sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod pa yis/ /de ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ //ma lus rgyal ba'i 2 sa la 'god/ /gtum po rang gi — gnas na 'gying / /dpa' bos g.yul las rgyal bar byed/ /nags kyi mun pa me yis bsreg /dug mtsho'i sle 5la bdud rtsis myos/ /sngon gyi 6thugs dam chen po yis/ /'jig rten 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i zhing du spyor bas na/ /bsad 7pa'i sbyor ba shes par byos/ /gzhi rtsa bral ba'i skad cig la/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul du snang / /bdag dang gzhan gyi rang bzhin rnams/ /rnam dag dbyengs su tshul gcig go/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tikhra kaipas/ rigs ngan gtum mo'i grong khyer du shan pa la gdams pa gsod pa'i sbyor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thi // //ga /rig byed mkhan la gdams pa bzhugs/ ༄7/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi gsang ba nas/ /rin chen sgron gyi 'od zer gyis/ /log rtog mun pa sel mdzad pas / /blo yi 1 legs spyad bsam ngapar rigs/ /sngon sbyangs bskal pa mang po nas/ /rgyal ba mnyes byed dge ba bskrun/ /don dam pa yi 7rang bzhin ni/ /shes rab mchog ldan de la gsal/ /ye shes sgyu 'dra'i rgyal ba dang / /log rtog sgyu 'dra'i sems can yang / /sgyu ma yin phyir rang bzhin 26dod/642

mnyam / /de ltar yongs shes 'gal ba med/ /shes rab chos skur tshul gcig cing / /thabs rnams gzugs skur tshul gcig pa/ /dbyer med dpyad 1 du med pas na/ /sems las sangs rgyas nges par bya/ /de lta bas na bsgrub bya'i lam med cing / /'bad pa byas pa —don med gyi na zhig /dper na dgra med skyes bu zhig /rang gi grib mas 4'jigs pa ltar/ /brtabs 5pa'i 'khrul blo 6can la ni/ /snying rje skye bar cis 7mi rigs/ /snying rje sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /thabs kyi spyod pa cir yang ston/ /'khor ba spong bar mi byed cing / /thar la 9'dod pa mi bskyed ⑫kyang / /rang bzhin shes rab chen po yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ltar bsgoms1 / /chos rnams rang bzhin shes pa yis/ /rnam dag sems kyi dbyings la rol ngo bo stong pas rtag 1 dang bral/ /rang bzhin bde bas —chad pa med/ /ma bcos gzod sanas rnam par dag /dbyer med zung 'jug sngags kyi lam/ /gnyis med spros dang bral ba'i phyir/ /ming tsam du yang mi dmigs so/ /rmi lam skyes bus ྾dug 'thungs ltar/ /srid las nyon mongs de ltar shes/ /dug gi 1 snyug bsngal mi bzad pa/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de tsam mo/ /rmi lam du yang nad bsal 18ltar/ /lam gyi rig pa de bzhin no/ /de nyid 'bras bu mi bslu bas / /ma rig gnyid log rnams la nges/ /'khor ba rmi lam ltar shes pas/ /mi 'gyur bde thob rlom sems med/ /mtshan ma'i log rtog bral ba na/ /ye shes chen po chos kyi sku/ /bsod nams rgyal ba'i gzugs sku la/ /ting 'dzin dpe byad dag gis spras/ /rnam smin lus la tshul bzhin du/ /sgu gsung 'byor pa 'bras bu'i mchog /rnal 'byor shes rab 26dod/643

ting 'dzin gyis/ /sems can thub pa'i spyod yul spyod/ /gnas med dmigs pa'i rdul dang bral/ /sems can khams la skye 1ba med/ /de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /mi bya ci yang yod ma yin/ /lus kyi spyod pa la sogs med/ /nam mkha'i ri mo bzhin du blta / /chos rnams kun kyi rtsa ba ste— / /sems dang sems snang tsam du 'dus/ /sems kyi rang bzhin byang chub la/ /byang chub kyang ni sems nyid do/ /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin de/ /nyan thos gang zag med par shes/ /rang rgyal zung lhadon med par shes/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa 6gzung 'dzin med/ /dbu mas don dam bden pa la/ /sngags kyi 7bden pa dbyer med rtogs/ /snang ba'i bag chags che chung gis/ /zeg pa'i dbye ba bsam mi khyab/ /rgyu la ma brten 8'bras bu ni/ /med ces thub pas 9mdo ru gsungs/ /rgyu med 'bras bur dag pa ni/ /khyod kyi yul min 11bden pa'i bka'/ /chos rnams rnam par sgrub byed cing / /mtshan nyid tsam du dmigs pa snyan/ /rigs pas 7gnod pa la sogs pa/ /dngos por lta rnams phan tshun gsal—/ /de ltar rnam par dbe+ed pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul la ni/ /phyogs tsam reg pa ma yin pasamu/ /rgya mtsho chen po mjal 7dang mtshungs/ /phyi nang snang srid chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gdod nas dag /lam gyis bcos nas bsgrub 7tu med/ /rtsol med lhan gyis grub pa'o/ /gser gyi gling na rdo rnged ltar/ /phyi nang bsdus pa'i chos rnams la/ /skyon zhes ming yang ma grub ste/ /thams cad rol pa'i rgyan du 'gyur 〉/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilpi nyu —pas/ grong khyer pad+ma can gyi rig byed mkhan —1la gdams pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab 26dod1644

pa zhes bya ba i thihūṃ // // to /sgyu ma mkhan la gdams pa bzhugs/2 ༄go/ /kye ho/ bzhin bzang — rnal 'byor brtson pas 4nga la nyon/ /legs so legs so khyod kyi 3mdzad pa legs / /jeg pa'i tshul chen thub pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /sgyu ma lta bur rgyal bas 5rab tu gsungs/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma smig 3/rgyu dang / /rmi lam gzugs brnyan sprul pa lta bu ru/ /legs par shes na nyon mongs spang du med / /rang grol ye shes thub pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /khyod kyis rde'u shing bu la sogs la/ /spyor ba goms pas ( byesngags kyis bsnun pa na/ /skyes pa bud med rta dang glang po sogs/ /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs snang ba 'byung ba na/ /dang po gang nas kyang ni ma byung la/ /snang ba'i tshe na sgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid / gang yang yod min sgyu ma bsdus pa na/ / 'gags shing 7mi snang gyur tshe gang du'ang song ba med/ /bsdus te snami snang gyur kyang skad cig rgyud 7ma chad/ /de ltar snang dang mi snang gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid med/ /gcig gnyis 7yin phyir ji srid rkyen nyid dang / /nye bar gnas par snang tsam mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /de bzhin smig rgyu zhes bya samatshan nyid kyang / /sa phyogs tsha sgo can la nye bar gnas / /nyi mas gdung 7dang ser bu'i 'jol phyogs 'bab/ /rgyang nas bltas 7pas chu klung gang bar mthong / /de nyid byung dang 1 —snang ba 'gags pas kyang nyu—/ /snang dang mi snang dbyer med mtshan nyid gcig /rmi lam zhes bya skyes bu gnyid log pas 1/ /gnyid nang kun dga' ra ba skyed mos ༄ rtatshal /longs spyod sna tshogs rmi zhing snang gyur kyang / /btson ra khri mon sdug bsngal sna 26—1645

tshogs snang / /skye dang gnas dang 'gag par 'gyur ba'i —1tshe/ /don gyi 72cha gzhan bsgrub par byas pa med/ /gzugs brnyan zhes bya me long dag pa la/ /sna tshogs gzugs su snang bar gyur pa na / /skye 'gag la sogs rnam gzhag gzhan med pas/ /snang dang mi snang dbyer med mtshan nyid gcig /sprul pa zhes bya ye shes ting 'dzin nam/ /rig sngags grub pa'i mthu las byung gyur pa//me tog kha dog dbye ba'i rnam pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs snang bar 'gyur / /de bzhin phyi nang dngos po sna tshogs snang ba dag /ji srid gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa yis/ /bag chags dbang gis nye bar gnas pa de srid du/ /dngos po sna tshogs snang ba 'byung bar gyur pa rnams/ /dang 6po byung tshe gang nas ma byung la/ /snang tsam nyid na bag chags dbang gis snang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi mebag chags zad pa na/ /mi snang gyur tshe gang du'ang song ba med/ /khyod kyi sgyu ma sems dang sems byung dang / /tshor ba 'du shes nye bar mi spyod cing / /'gro ba'i phung po sems dang sems byung dang / /tshor dang 'du shes nye bar spyod pa can/ /mgo mi mtshungs zhes yid gnyis byed gyur na/ /mtshungs par gyur pa'i 9sgyu ma la sogs pa/ /drang srong dag la bha le bcol ba 'am/ /bzang po'i sgyu mas khuthub la gdugs tshod phul/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa sgyu ma'i snang ba yis/ /bye brag gyur pa med de mgo mnyam mo/ /smig rgyu dag kyang nyams kyi sa'adu 'phro yis/ / lam gyi slobya ba byed kyang 2mgo mnyam mo/ /rmi lam dag la lha yis 4lung bstan nas/ /ma 'ongs dngos po ston te bye brag med/ /gzugs brnyan pra spuyis sngags las grub pa yis/ /gog gyur rkun mo'i gzugs mthong tha dad med/ /sprul pa 'akro 26—/646

ba'i don du rgyal bas hūṃsprul/ /bskal par gnas te mdzad pa sgrub pa yod2/ /lo zla skad cig sna tshogs snang ba yang / /sprul par rtogs te bye brag mtshungs pa'o/ /de ltar sgyu ma 'dra ba'i dngos po sna tshogs kun/ /'byin dang sdud 4dang 'phel bar byed pa yis/ /de ltar de la sdig pas yongs 5mi gos/ /bsod nams dag kyang de bzhin shes par bya/ /gang la sdig dang bsod nams gnyis med pa/ /de ltar gyur la byang chub rab tu 6gsungs/ /chu yis gnod la gzings kyis phan pa sgrub7/ /chu sked gyur tshe gzings kyis dgos pa med/ /de bzhin gnas ngan len kyis gnod kyi bar/ /sgyu mar shes pa gang la yod pa phan / /gnas ngan len gyi gnod pa bral ba na/ /bsod nams sgyu ma lta bus dgos pa med/ /sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin mnyam pa ste/ /chos rnams thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /rang bzhin 'od gsal gzod nas 'dus ma byas/ /sgyu mas gos min 9ye nas sangs rgyas so/ /de ltar shes nas bdag dang 7dbyer med pa/ /phung sogs sgyu ma tsam du snang ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs par shes pa'i 1 blo ldan ni/ /lam gyi mchog tu rgyal bas sarab tu gsungs/ /de ltar khyod kyi bya ba'i 1 chos mtshon dpe/ /bden pas — stong pa'i chos nyid gang yin de/ /nges pa'i sadon du yang dag stong par rtogs//chos kyi dbyengs yin rnam par dag pa'i ngang / /'gro ba sgyu mas lam yang der gshegs 7nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma lta bus 18don byed shog /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tikhra ༄ pas grong khyer grags pa skyong du sgyu ma mkhan la gdams pa dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya ba rdzogs so// // i this ma pa tha 126—16/7

sto /smad 'tshong la gdams pa bzhugs/1 ༄spro/ /a (ho srid rtsa bye 7bde ba che / /sems can kun gyi rang bzhin nidzu/ /gnyis med bde bas ༄detshim gyur pas6 / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor gsal/ /thabs chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dag /rol pa bde ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /phrin las mdzad pa'i dgongs pa las/ /dus gsum mnyam pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /thabs kyis bskul bas 7shes rab chags/ /de bzhin shes rab bde zhen sel/ /gnyis med rol pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rdo rje dbang 3gis stobs ldan pas/ /'khor lo bzhi dang srog shing gsum/ /me rlung thabs ldan sbyor shes pas zu/ /ye shes nam mkha' lta bu r+shamathong / /gang de thabs las byung ba ni 1/ /gnas bcud thig le mi dmigs pas rkye/ /bde chen thig le'i stobs las byung / /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid gsal/ /phung sogs 'jig rten brtags pa kun/ /rang snang sgyu mar snang tsam las/ /phyi nang bden gnyis mnyam spyor bas/ / ma 'dres rtse/gcig dang du ma bral/ /bde chen thig le rang byung las/ /man ngag ldan pas ngurgyas btab pas/ /ma rig gnyis 'dzin la sogs dang / /dman pa'i jeg pa ring du spangasastse/ /'dzag dang 'phar dang 'bar ba dang / /'dar dang rgyug dang sgra sogs dang //rang gsal lamangon shes 'chi med sogs/ /skye sked nam mkha'i rang bzhin gsal / /rtsa dang rnam shes rgyu ba 7las/ /mi dmigs brjod med gang goms pa/ /grangs las 'das pa'i ye shes kyang / /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor 18mthong / /rang byung bde ba thob phrematha' med/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bde mthong zhing / /thig le rang shar sprul pa yis/ /mdzad pa'i rnam 'phrul bsam 26—1648

mi khyab/ /bde chen theg par grol 1snab yis/ /bstan pa'i rim pa mtha' yas kyang / /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /thig le chen po'i ngang las 'byung / /dug gis 2dug nad bsal ba ltar/ /'gro ba chags pas 'dul ba ste / /skyes bu thabs kyis bder 'jug pa/ /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin no/ /bskyed bye pa thabs kyi cho'od zer gyis/ /a la 5cung zad bde bas 5reg /rang byung gsang ba'i lam du drilaje/ /rang rang 'khor lo thim par byed/ /ma lus bde bar shar ba las/ /'khor ba'i bag chags ma lus sangs8 tha dad la sogs chos med de/ /skye med bde ba'i snying por gsal/ /'chol pa sprin gyi (dum bu dang / /nyi zla sgra gcan khemakha' la 'du/ /drag po pho brang sgo la srungs 1nye/ /mgo med rang gi gnas na 'gying nyushā/ /stobs kyis gnas sa'i 11ga'u spyor/ /zla ba nam mkha'i dbyings su bstem/ /nyi mas —bkod pa'i chu g.yo zhing / /seng ge 'dur bas lam 'phrang bsalathu/ /'phen dang sdud par byed pa dang / /gyen du 'gro dang thur la bskulamu/ /'khor lo bzhi la rgyas 'debs 9pas/ /bde ba chen po lhun gyis grub/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa rnams/ /gdod nas grub par gnyis su med/ /ma lus bde ba'i gzugs su shar/ /gsang chen mi ldog rigs su nges/ /'gro la gsang lam 'di bstan parmye/ /me tog la ni chu bzhin du/ /shes rab gsum la goms pa yis / /gsang ba gsum la spyad par bya/ /thabs chen ldan la mngon sum ste/ /gnyis med thig le 'phro 'du med/ /mnyam pa chen po mchog gi 19dbyengs/ /thabs shes gnyis med rdo rje'i lus/ /phyag rgya'i spyor ba 'di yis ni/ /dpag med log par 'khyams pa rnams/ /thabs kyis ma skyes pa la bkod/ /'chi 26—1649

ba med pa'i chos skur thim/ /bde ba chen pos 1khyab pa'i ro/ /lus gnas lus las ma skyes pas / /sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /thams cad lhan cig skyes par gsal/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 1da 15༄ / /'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu/1snga ca/ /rgya gar skad du/ / sa na sa ra mā na ni yā 2ṇi ka ra nā ma sadhī ti / bod skad du/ 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /e ma'o/ /'du byed sbug bsngal 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /snyug bsngal sbug bsngal la sogs brgya rtsa bcu4/ /snyug bsngal kun las skyob par mdzad pa yi/ /sman pa'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /'khor ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pa dang las/ /nyon mongs khams gsum gnas ni dgu bcu brgyad/ /zag pa'i chu bo sbyor ba nye bar len/ /rgyu dang yul dang spyor ba'i stobs kyis byung / /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /sna tshogs 'di dag las las byung / /de yang nyon mongs stobs las byung / /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /mthong la myong dang skyes nas myong / /26—1655

gzhan du myong dang ma nges pa'i/ /dkar dang gnag dang 'dren ma'o/ /'khor ba'i las ni lci gang dang / /nye ba gang dang goms pa gang / /sngon byas/ gang yin de las ni/ /snga ma snga ma rnam smin 'gyur/ /grogs dag soms shig thog ma med pa nas/ /ma rig la sogs bcu gcig rga shi'i mtha'/ /yan lag bcu gnyis cha gsum zo chun tshul/ /nang gi rten 'byel yang dang yang du 'khor / /tshe rabs tshe rabs grangs med de dang der/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi ba yi/ /snyug bsngal rnams kyis yang dang yang du gdungs/ /'khrul nas 'khor gyur 'khrul cing 'khor bar 'gyur/ /kyi hud srid pa'i lam gyis dub pa'i 'gon po rnams/ /sdug bsngal bde bar bzung nas mi skyo ba ) / /khyed yid de la rtag tu chags byed pa/ /phyugs dang khyad par med par bla ma gsung 2/ /bla mas zin pa'i skye bo —mkhas pa dag /skad cig skad cig 'go ba lnga po kun/ /'khor ba'i snyug bsngal tsher ma zug 'dra la/ /rus pa'i gting nas snying rje su mi skye/ /las ngan dbang gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /yang yang skye zhing yang yang rga dang na/ /yang yang 'chi 'gyur 'di ni mi sems par / /yul la chags byed bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /grogs dag srid pa gsum nang gnas pa kun sbug bsngal/ /de yang mi yi sdug bsngal bdag gis mthong / /mngal gyi snyug bsngal 'di lta bu ru gnas/ /nur nur mer mer gor gor nar nar po/ /ltar ltar mkhrang dang rkang lag rim gyis rdzogs/ /nu zho mar gyis gso byed cing / /shin tu nyam 4chung gan rkyal nyal/ /byis pa dar ma lang tsho dang / /rgas pas be+er yang byis par 'gyur/ /tshe ni mi rtag shin tu g.yo ba ste/ /yud tsam sdod pa'i mthu yang yod ma yin/ /bdag ni 26—1656

nges par 'chi 'gyur mi sems pa/ /grogs dag skyes bu de ni ngo mtshar che/ /'khor ba'i skyon dang nyes dmigs mi shes pas/ /phyin ci log pa bzhi la gnas nas su/ /bdag ni nges par 'chi 'gyur mi sems par/ /yul la mngon zhen nyin mtshan don med 'das/ /'dzam bu'i gling pa dus min 'chi bas te/ /nges pa can yang zad par 'gyur bas na/ /yang dang yang du nges par 'chi'o zhes—/ /bsam par rigs so kwa'i bzhin bzang dag /so ga me tog rgyas pa'i dus 'di byung bar gyuralha/ /zla ba gsal bas mtshon pa'i ston dus 'di 'byung zhes/ /skye bo thams cad dga' 'gyur bdag gi tshe 'di ni/ /zad par 'gyur zhes shin tu mi dgar 'gyur ba med/ /de ring 'di bya 5sang ni 'di bya de nas 'di dang 'di bye bya zhes/ /srid pa g.yo ba'i rang bzhin ma shes don med yid brtan tshol byed pa'i/ /skye dgu 'chi bdag gi ni chu srin khar ni gru ni zhugs pa ltar/ /bya ba mthar ma phyin par yul gyi chu yi dba' klong nang du lhang //'di ni sang bya 'di ni thang cig 'og tu bya/ /'di ni de'u re bya zhes skye bo sems pa na/ /gshin rje be con lag thogs zur gyis lta byed cing / /mig rtsa dmar khros ma rungs gad mos re snyam 'debs/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos ④thams cad dang / /sbyor ba du ma rab shes kyang / /deng bya sang bya zhes smra zhing / /bsam dang ldan pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /tshe 'di gnod mang thurlung gis btab pa 6/yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sang khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /kye kye kwa'i gogs po dag /tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa 26—1657

—dang la blang bar gyis/ /kye kye kwa'i gogs po dag /'jig rten spyod pa dag la phar bltas ༄1na/ /byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /ci la bsams 2kyang phan par mi 'gyur bas/ /rang gi sems la lta ba goms par gyis / /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /tshad ma bdun dang brda sprod 5rnam pa bzhi / /mngon pa dang ni yo ga tsar+ya'i sa/ /mdo sde dang ni 'dul ba mngon pa dang / /gzhung du bkod pa ma lus thams cad kun/ /ma mthong ma mnyan ma bshad ma bris zhes/ /de la gdung ba ma bskyed bzhin bzangs dag /bla ma'i man ngag ces bya bdud rtsi'i ro/ /gang gis sems mnyam 'jog pa de tsam zhig /yongs su btsal gyis 4gzhung mangs ci zhig dgos/ /thams cad yid ni 'khrul par byed pa'i rgyu/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di nges pa med pas na/ /pha ma la sogs pha mar ma 5nges pas/ /nye du 'byel pa dag la chags pa spangs 6//dgra yang ma nges de la sdang ba spangs7/ /nad med lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dang / /'dod yon lnga la rang bzhin gyis chags spangs / /rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti 9grags pa dang / /rigs dang rus dang tshigs su bcad pa spangs/ / slob ma yang slob chos kyi 'byel pa spangs/ /rkakye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /'jig rten stag 1sbrul rnge dang dug 'dra bar/ /bsams nas spangs te dben par gnas par bya/ /bud med mtshan nyid skyes pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /sman dang glang chen brtags pa'am gza' skar rtsis/ /mtshon cha brtags pa'am rta dpyad rang bzo 'am/ /bstan bcos sangan pa slob dang klog pa spangs//yul la mngon dga'i sems ni byung ba dang / /rnam rtog de dag rnams ni byung ba nas/ /bdag ni nges par 'chi ba dran byas la/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i 26—/658

gnyen po rnams kyis bzlog /rnam rtog mang ba dbugs bgrang pa yis gzhil//'dod chags sems byung rnam par rtog pa de/ /rang bzhin mi gtsang keng rus blta bas bzlog /zhe sdang la ni byams pa'i chu yis btab1/ /gti mug la ni rten 'byel lam gyis so/ /mi gtsang ba dang byams pa rten 'byel gyi/ /man ngag bla ma'i zhal 2nas 'byung bzhin bya/ /'khor ba la yid ches par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu/ /slob dpon 4dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng ges bi ka ma 5la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o/ /slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gtan la phab pa6// //ba1ra mchan/1655 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa/ ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉thakhor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed nga/ ches bya ba'i glu bzhusas so// 2〈〈pe 〉'a sa ra mā na ni ya/ 〈〈snar 〉〉pa da ra mā na ni ya/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra gu/1656 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazung nas mi skyob pa/ 2〈〈snar 〉༄sungs / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yodas 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉mas/1657 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thagyur / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7sa / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈be+er 〉ridang 'di/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉chos—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dze+e sanod ma/ / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kudra/ba658 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltas/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rda' spro/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rim spre 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈sna ra 〉〉spang/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ste/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ṅkaslob ma yang slob chos kyi 'brel pa spangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtas 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabasam —〈〈pe〉〉26dod1659

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dhadz+re dhā tu sa ra gī ta/ bod skad du/ chos kyi dbyings lta ba'i glu/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig kun du ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal nas/ /chos dbyings lta zhing gzhan min pa/ /de dag rim bzhin brjod par bya/ /zab zhi spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa gang / /ma skyes ma 'gags gzod nas dag /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yis/ /chos dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa/ /blo mig zhib mo rtog bral ba/ /bying 2rgod rab rib med pas blta/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid bya —ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de ni mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /ji ltar 'o ma dang 'dres pas/ /mar gyi snying po mi snang ba/ /de bzhin nyon 26—1661

mongs dang 'dres pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar 'o ma rnam sbyangs pas/ /mar gyi snying po dri med 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyon mongs rnam sbyangs pas/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar me bum nang gnas / /cung zhig snang bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin nyon mongs bum nang gnas / /chos kyi dbyengs kyang mi snang ngo / /phyogs ni gang dang gang dag gnas / /bum pa bu ga btod 1gyur pa/ /de dang de yi phyogs nyid nas/ /'od kyi rang bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe ting 'dzin rdo rje yis/ /bum pa de nyid bcag gyur pa/ /de tshe de yi nam mkha' yi/ /mthar thug bar du snang bar byed/ /chos kyi dbyings ni skye ma yin/ /nam yang 'gag par 'gyur ba med/ /dus rnams kun du nyon mongs med/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri ma bral//ji ltar rin chen be+e ḍūr+ya/ /dus rnams kun du 'od gsal yang / /rdo yi nang na gnas gyur na/ /de yi 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis bsgribs pa'i/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med pas/ /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /ji ltar sbun pas g.yogs gyur pa/ /so ba 'bras nyid mi 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pas/ /de ni sangs rgyas zhes mi rtag /ji ltar sbun pa las grol na/ /'bras nyid snang bar 'gyur ba ltar / /de bzhin nyon mongs las grol na/ /chos kyi sku nyid rab tu gsal/ /ji ltar sbrum ma'i lto na bu/ /yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pas/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mthong ma yin/ /chos dbyings gang phyir bdag ma yin/ /bud med ma yin skyes pa min/ /gzung ba kun las rnam grol bas/ /ji ltar 'dzin par brtag par bya/ /mi gtsang mi 26—/662

rtag sbug bsngal zhes/ /bya ba gsum pos sems spyod byed/ /stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji skad gsungs pa ste/ /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs ldog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /mchog tu sems ni sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ /ji ltar ri bong mgo yi rwa/ /brtags pa nyid de med pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyang / /brtags pa nyid de yod ma yin/ /phra rab rdul gyi ngo bo nyid/ /glang gi rwa yang dmigs ma yin/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /de la ji zhig brtag 3 par bya/ /brten 2nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / /brten nas 'gag par 'gyur ba dang / /gnas pa dag kyang yod min na/ /byes pa ji ltar rtog par byed / /chos dbyings rang bzhin nam mkha' yin/ /khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ /skye dang rga dang gnas pa dang / /'jig pa med pa 'dus ma byas/ /sangs rgyas chos dbyer med pa dang / /de rigs de bzhin thob pa dang / /brdzun sked slu med 'tshe med pas/ /gdod nas rang bzhin zhi nyid do/ /gang phyir de ni rgya mtsho ltar/ /sgra dang dpe dang blo rnams kyis/ /gting dang pha rol mi rnyed pa/ /de phyir rab tu zab pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings la dbyer sked phyir/ /lta ba tha dad rung ma yin/ /'on kyang blo yi bye brag gis/ /lta ba bye dad cung zad brjod/ /dbu ma 4nyid du smra ba rnams/ /de don bden pa gnyis su 'dod/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam mo/ /bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te/ /de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid/ /bdag dang bdag gi rtag chad dang / /nyon mongs rnam 5byang rgyu 'bras dang / /gzung dang 'dzin 26—/663

par gang spros pa/ /'di ni kun rdzob bden pa'o/ /stong nyid bdag med zhi ba gang / /spros pa rnams kyis ma gos pa/ /tha dad don min rnam 1mi rtog /'di ni don dam bden pa'o/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin dang / /rnam grangs rnam grangs ma yin pas/ /de gnyis so sor dbye ba byas/ /rtags 2tsam snang grags dngos po dang / /tha snyad 'khrul pa sgyu ma dang / /kun rdzob nyid ni rnam grangs so/ /stong pa nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyengs ni rnam grangs so/ /gang phyir sgrib pas kun rdzob ste/ /'gyur ba med phyir don dam mo/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /shes pa gnyis phyir bden pa gnyis/ /yang dag shes pa med ce na//bden te tha snyad tsam du yod/ /de nyid tshol la thog mar ni/ /thams cad yod ces brjod par bya/ /don rnams rtogs shing chags med la/ /phyis ni rnam par dbye rdodon nyid/ /bden gnyis gcig dang tha dad min/ /nyes pa bzhi bzhi gsungs phyir ro/ /gcig dang tha dad gang rtogs pa/ /de ni tshul min zhugs pa yin/ /dngos por khas len yod na ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mi zad 'byung / /lta ba ma rungs yongs su 'dzin/ /de las byung ba'i rtsod par 'gyur/ /dmigs pa'i 'du shes can la ni/ /thob pa med cing mngon rtogs rnged/ /rjes mthun bzod pa'ang choyod min na/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang smos ci dgos/ /stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ /shes rab chung ldan phung bar 'gyur / /ji ltar sbrul la bzung nyes dang / /rig sngags log par 5bsgrubs pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyis stong nyid ni/ /lta kun nges par 'byen par gsungs / /gang dag stong pa nyid lta ba/ /de dag bsgrub tu med par 26—/664

gsungs—/ /gang dag rang dngos gzhan dngos kyis/ /dngos dang dngos med nyid mthong ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /yang dag mthong ba ma yin no/ /med pa yod pa'i zlas grangs te/ /yod pa'ang med pa'i zlas grangs pa/ /de phyir med par brjod mi bya/ /yod pa nyid du 'ang mi brtag go//yod pa pa ni bde 'gror 'gro/ /med pa pa ni ngan 'gror 'gyur/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes phyir/ /gnyis la mi brten thar par 'gyur/ /tshul gnyis shing rta zhon nas su/ /rig tshopa'i srab skyogs 'ju rdo snabyed pa/ /de dag de phyir ji bzhin don/ /theg pa chen po pa nyid 'thob/ /gzugs sogs ji ltar snang ba nas/ /bde gshegs bar gyi chos rnams kun/ /ri bong ba lang rwa yi dpes/ /dbu ma nyid du goms par bya/ /yod min med min yod med min / /gnyis min bdag nyid du yang med/ /mtha' bzhi las ni nges grol ba/ /de nyid dbu mar mkhas rnams bzhed/ /dbu ma mtha' las rnam grol na/ /mtha' dang bral phyir dbu ma'ang med/ /mtha' dbus med par gang lta ba/ /de ni yang dag lta ba ste/ /bla na med pa'i lta ba yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rtag tu bsgoms/ /gang zhig lta ba 'dir zhugs pa/ /des ni thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /rnam rig tsam du smra ba rnams/ /ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub bo/ /brtags dang rgyu las skyes pa dang / /mi 'gyur phyir na go rims bzhin/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang gang rnam brtags pa/ /de nyid kun du brtags pa yisaje/ /ngo bo nyid de de med do/ /gzhan kyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid/ /rnam rtog yin te rkyen las byung / /grub ni de la snga ma po/ /rtag tu med par 26—1665

gyur pa gang / /yod dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis kyis/ /de phyir de nyid gzhan dbang las/ /gzhan min gzhan pa yin nga/'ang min/ /mi rtag la sogs bzhin du brjod/ /chu shel bai ḍūr+ya yi dpes/ /ngo bo nyid gsum shes par bya/ /bdag dang chos su brtags pa dang / /rnam par dag dang ma dag dang / /'gyur rnged phyin ci ma log pa/ /rim bzhin re re'ang gnyis gnyis so//blo gros bzang po thams cad ni/ /nang sems pa la brtson pa yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa las gol ba'i/ /rnam shes dam pa'i don du yod/ /chos rnams 'ga' yang skye ba dang / /'gag pa cung zad yod min te/ /skyes pa 'ba' zhig kho na ni/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag par 'gyur/ /yod min chos rnams de dag snang / /be+ems po las min gzhan las min/ /med pa las min nyes gnyis phyir/ /de phyir shes pa'i bdag nyid yod/ /rnam shes bems po'i rang bzhin las/ /bzlog par rab tu skye bar gsungs/ /bems min rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de 'dir bdag nyid rig par 'dod/ /nam mkha' sa rlung nyi ma dang / /rgya mtsho phyogs dang 'dab 1chu ni/ /nang gi shes pa yang dag gi2/ /cha yin phyi rol ltar snang ngo / /gsal ba'i rang bzhin du snang bas/ /de dag 'byel pa gog gyur min/ d+ngha/gang dang 'brel pas gang rig pa/ /de yis rig bya de rig 'gyur/ /ral gri'i so dang so rtse bzhin/ /blo yis rang 'dzin dor zhe na/ /rang nyid snang ba dor min par/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel las gsungs / /de'i phyir blo yi mtshan nyid ni/ /rang rig par ni grub pa yin/ /de nyid rtogs par dka' ba 4na/ /'di yi ngo bo dpyad mi nus/ /rang rig de yang phra ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis phra bar gzigs/ /rang la 36——/666

gnas kyang bdag 'dra bas/ /rmongs pa'i phyir na mthong ba med/ /gsal dang blo ni bdag nyid kyis/ /'byel pa yod phyir don tsam yin/ /shes pa'i rang bzhin bden pa ste/ /rnam pa brdzun zhing 'khrul pa yin/ /sems ni rnam par bslad pa'i phyir/ /gcig gnyis gnyis su snang ba yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dbye ba las/ /shin tu mkhas pa cis ma yin/ /gzung ba'i rnam pa mi g.yo'i phyir/ /phyi rol lta bur snang ba yin/ /'dzin pa'i rnam pa rab g.yo bas/ /nang lta bur ni snang ba nyid/ /mtshan ma de ni spangs nas su/ /ye shes nam mkha' lta bur bsgom/ /sems kyi snarang bzhin zag pa med/ /zag bcas sa bon ma zad par/ /kun gzhi gnas skabs de dag nyid/ /zad nas zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /rnam par grol ba'i sku dang ni/ /rtag tu nyi zer nyi ma bzhin/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams gnas yin pas/ /skyob pa rnams kyi chos sku'o/ /nyan thos theg par zhugs pa rnams/ /bdag dang bdag gis dben pa yi/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /bzhi lnga'am dus ni gsum yang rung / /yod pa thams cad gzung bya yin/ /dmigs dang bcas pas 'dzin par byed/ /de gnyis dam pa'i don du 'dod/ /bden pa mthong dang goms pa las/ /nyon mongs spangs pa zhes bshad pa/ /bden pa bdag ni rnam bzhi ste/ /sdug bsngal de bzhin kun 'byung dang / /'gog pa lam ste de lta na/ /de dag ji ltar gdon 4rtogs rim/ /sdug bsngal nyer len phung po'o/ /kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs te/ /'gog pa mya ngan 'das pa gnyis / /lam ni phyogs mthun sum cu bdun/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu spyor/ /dge spyong tshul ni dri med lam/ /26—/667

'bras bu 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /de dag brgyad cu rtsa dgu'o/ /grol lam/ zad pa rnams dang bcas/ /'bras bu bzhi rnam gzhag pa ni/ /rgyu lnga dag ni srid phyir ro/ /nyan thos rnam bzhi sprul pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'gyur ba dang / /zhi bgrod grub mtha' 'dzin pa'o/ /de ni gnyis bzhi bco brgyad de/ /gnyis ni bye brag smra ba dang / /de bzhin mdo sde smra ba'o/ /rnam pa rnged pa'i shes pa yis/ /gzugs la sogs pa don rig 'dod/ /de ni bye brag smra ba yin/ /gang zhig don gyis phan btags pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan rnams la nyams myongs pas1/ /don rig 'dod pa mdo sde pa'o/ /bzhi ni dge 'dun phal chen dang / /thams cad yod smra gnas brtan pa/ /mang pos bkur ba bco brgyad ni/ /shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba'i sde/ /rtag par smra ba'i sde pa dang / /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /gzhi kun yod smra 'od srungs 'esde/ /sa ston sde dang 'od srungs sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan pa/ /sa sgogs ris dang srung 4ba pa/ /gnas ma bu yi sde pa ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /yul don slob dpon bye brag gi /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad do/ /rang rgyal byang chub don gnyer bas/ /gzung ba'i rtog pa spangs phyir dang / /'dzin pa ma spangs phyir na ste/ /rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam/ /bskal pa brgya yi mthar thug bar/ /bsgoms pas byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /de ni rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /yan lag bcu gnyis chags 5gsum mo/ /sngon dang phyi mthar 26she/668

gnyis gnyis dang / /bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan la/ /ma rig nyon mongs sngon gnas skabs/ /'du byed dag ni sngon 'das kyi1/ /rnam shes mtshams spyor phung po yin/ /ming dang gzugs ni de phan chad/ /skye mched drug dod tshun chad do/ /de ni gsum 'dus tshun chad do/ /reg pa bde sdug la sogs kyi2/ /rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad do/ /chor 'khrig tshun chad sred pa ni / /longs spyod 'khrig pa chags bcas kyi/ /nye bar len pa longs spyod rnams / /thob par bya phyir yongs rgyug pa'o/ /de srid 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /las de nyid ni srid pa yin/ /nying mtshams spyor ba skye ba yin/ /tshor ba'i bar ni rga shi yin/ /'di ni gnas skabs bar 'dod lo/ /gtso bo'i phyir na yan lag bsgrags/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' bar dag la/ /rmongs pa rnam par bzlog phyir ro/ /nyon mongs gsum mo las gnyis so/ /bzhi bdun de bzhin 'bras bu yin/ /gnyis kyi rgyu 'bras mdor bsnyus pa/ /bar ma'i rjes su dpag pa las/ /'dir ni 'byung ba rgyu yin te/ /byung ba 'bras bu nyid du 'dod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis de dag las/ /rgyu ni rnam lnga 'bras bu bdun / /'phen par byed dang 'phangs pa dang / /mngon par 'grub byed grub pa dang / /nyes dmigs kyi 4ni yan lag ste/ /gsum bzhi gsum gcig gcig rim bzhin/ /'du byed snyug bsngal 'gyur ba yi/ /sbug bsngal nyid ni rim bzhin du/ / ldang dang bzhi 5dang lnga yin no/ /khams gsum na ni rim bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu yis 'jug /rdzus 6skyes yan lag bcu gcig gis/ /mngal dang sgong skyes bcu gnyis kyis/ /drod gsher las skyes ci rigs 'jug /de bzhin 'gro ba lnga la sbyar/ /gsum po 26—/669

dag las gnyis 'byung ste/ /gnyis las bdun 'byung bdun las kyang / /gsum 'byung srid pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /nyid ni yid dang yid 1du 'khor/ /'khor ba'i ngo bo rnam pa dang / /gang zhig gang du gang gis dang / /ji ltar ji srid nyes dmigs ni/ /mtha' yas tshogs kyis rab tu 'jug /brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim na glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /mya ngan gang las 'da' ba dang / /gang zhig gang gis gang gi tshe/ /gang gis gang phyir ji lta bur / /ji srid ngo bo rnam pa dang / /thob bya dbye ba phrin las dang / /yon tan tshogs kyis ldog pa'o/ /mu stegs pa ni rnam pa gnyis/ /sprul pa pa dang rang rgyud pa/ /de yang skyes thob spyor 'byung ngo / /skyes thob rigs chad log sred can/ /sbyor byung bsam gtan rtog ge ba/ /bsam gtan pa ni mngon shes mthus/ /lta ba drug cu gnyis su rtogs/ /rtag par smra ba rnam bzhi dang / /kha cig rtag par smra ba bzhi/ /mtha' yod sogs bzhi mi spong bzhi / /rgyud med gnyis ni sngon mthar rtog /'du shes yod smra bcu drug dang / /med smra brgyad dang de bzhin du/ /yod min med min smra ba brgyad/ /chad smra bdun dang tshe 'di la/ /mya ngan 'da' bar smra ba lnga/ /phyi ma'i mthar rtog lta ba'o/ /rtog ge pa ni grangs can sogs/ /tshad mas grub mtha' 'dzin pa'o/ /grangs can yon tan gsum du brjod/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa'o/ /rangs dang mgu dang kun dga' dang / /bde bzhi pa yi sems 26——— /670

nyid dag /res 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag snying stobs yon tan no / /mi dga' ba dang yongs gdud dang / /mya ngan 'dod dang mi bzod dag /gang du snang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /de dag rdul gyi 1rtags su 'dod / /rmongs pa de bzhin gti mug dang / /bag med gnyid dang gsal 2 ba dag / len 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ / de dag mun pa'i yon tan no// yon tan gsum gyi rang bzhin mchog /mthong ba'i lam du 'gyur ma yin/ /mthong ba'i lam du gang gyur pa/ /sgyu ma bzhin du shin tu gsog /rang bzhin las ni chen po ste/ /de las nga rgyal rnam gsum 4'byung / /de las dbang po bcu gcig dang / /de tsam lnga'o de lnga las/ /'byung ba lnga ste nyi shu bzhi/ /gtso bo nyid dang rnam 'gyur ro/ /de dag sems pa yod ma yin/ /skyes bu kun rig 5sems pa can/ /de dag nyi shu lngas shes na/ /ral pa 6spyi bo gtsug phud kyis/ /bste gnas gang du dga' ba der/ /grol 'gyur 'di la je tshom sked/ /bye brag pa ni don drug 'dod/ /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi / /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /rdzas dgu yon tan nyi shu bzhi/ /las lnga spyi gnyis bye brag gnyis/ /de bzhin 'du ba'ang rnam gnyis te/ /de nyid drug shes rig pa'i mchog /rig byed kun gyi pha rol phyin/ /gcer bu ba rnams don dgu smra/ /srog dang zag pa sdom pa dang / /nges par dga' dang 'chi ba dang / /las dang sdig dang bsod nams dang / /thar pa zhes bya don dgu po/ /gang gis mthong ste rnam par dag /rigs pa can don bcu drug 'dod/ /tshad ma gzhal bya the tshom dang / /dgos pa dpe dang grub mtha' dang / /cha shas rtog ge gtan la dbab/ /rtsod dang brjod dang rgol ba dang / /26—/67/

rgyu ltar snang ba 1tshig dor dang / /ltag chod chad pa'i gnas rnams te/ /bcu drug gis ni nges par 'byung / /dpyod pa pa ni don bzhir brjod/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /de dag 'dus ma byas pa ste/ /rtag tu skye 'gag med par gnas/ /de bas las 'bras yod ma yin/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' de bzhin med/ /gang zhig de ltar rnam dpyod pa/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rnam grol 'gyur / /khyab 'jug byed rgyur smra ba rnams/ /nyi ma'i nang na khyab bdag 'jug /skar nang 'od gnas zla ba yin/ /rlung nang nga ni 'od zer can/ /snang ba can na 2nyi ma yin/ /rig byed nang na snyan tshig dang / /lha nang nga ni brgya byin te/ /dbang po'i nang na yid yin no/ /'byung ba'i nang na sa yin zhing / /nga ni bde byed drag po'ang yin/ /srin po gnod sbyin nang rol bdag /nor lha'i nang na me lha nga / /ri bo'i nang na nga ri rab nga ni yi ge'i nang na a/ /nya dang rus sbal phag dang ni/ /mi yi seng ge mi thung dang / /dga' byed ra ma ṇa nag po/ /sangs rgyas tsar ti ka dang bcu/ /gang gis khyab 'jug yon tan rnams/ /rtag tu bsgoms na bde thob 'gyur/ /dbang phyug byed rgyur 'dod pa rnams/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /byed pa po ni dbang phyug yin/ /de ni yon tan brgya 4dang ldan/ /rab phra yang ba mchod par 'os/ /bdag por gyur dang dbang du gyur/ /gar yang phyin dang 'dod dgur ldan/ /de bzhin dga' mgur gnas pa'o/ /lag pa dag dang rkang pa dang / /mig dang gdong dang lus rnams kyi/ /mang po bskyed cing 'jig byed pas/ /des na phra bar brjod pa yin/ /mkha' dang rlung dang sa dang ni/ /chu dang me dag gnas byed cing / /sdud pa dang ni rgyas 26—/672

byed pas/ /des na yang par brjod pa yin/ /'jig rten gsum na mchod gyur cing / /gnas pa bdag 3dang rgyu ba dang / /'byung po kun gyis brjed pas na/ /des ni 2mchod par 'os pa yin/ /'byung po kun la dbang byed cing / /gnas pa bdag ga dang rgyu ba dang / /gang dang gang 'dod de byed pas/ /des na bdag por gyur zhes bya/ /bdag la rag las rang dbang can/ /'ga' la'ang 'jigs pa yod min te/ /thams cad dbang du 4gyur zhes bya/ /mtho ris ngan song kun khyab pas/ /des na gar yang phyin zhes bya/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa gsum/ /de dag gang la gnas gyur pa/ /mig 'byed tsam gyis byed gyur pas/ /des na 'dod dgur ldan zhes bya/ /thar pa'ang yang na lha yi lus/ /gang du dag nyid ye'adod pa dag /thams cad 'dod pas thob gyur pas — / /des na dga' mgur gnas zhes bya/ /gang zhig phra gyur gcig pu skyes nas 'dug /de yi 7'di kun skyes shing 'jig par byed/ /de ni dbang dag 8mchog sbyin lha mchog bya/ /yon tan byed po shin tu zhi ba thob/ /skyes pa 9po 'di shes pa yod min te/ /bdag gi bde sdug bdag la rang dbang med/ /dbang phyug gis btang yang na mtho ris sam/ /g.yang sa dag tu 'gro ba kho nar 'gyur/ /dbang phyug rdza mkhan lta bur sna tshogs 'di sprul byed por ma gyur na/ /ri rab 'di mi grub cing sa gzhi 'di min rgya mtsho'ang ma yin te / /nyi zla skar ldan 'di ltar bkod pa 'di dag mig yul du med 'gyur/ /yod pa'i phyir ni dbang phyug 'gro ba'i byed bo yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra/ /phra zhing bsam gyis mi khyab rab srab byed pa kun rig kun byed pa/ /rnal 'byor goms pas thob pa blo can bsam gtan pa yi bsam gtan yul/ /nyi ma zla ba sa chu me 26—/673

rlung phyogs dang nam mkha'i lus can te/ /zhi ba'i bde dga' 'dod pa rnams kyis dbang phyug rtag tu bsgoms/ /dus la ltos 1par smra ba rnams/ /dngos kun dus kyis bsgyur ba ste/ /gang gi zhang po nor lha dang / /gang pha nor rgyas yin pa yi/ /'jigs rnged khro bo'ang bsad gyur pas/ /dus ni 'da' bar dka' ba yin/ /'byung ba rnams ni dus kyis 'byin/ /skye dgu rnams sdud dus kyis byed/ /dus kyis gnyid log sad 4par byed/ /dus ni 'da' bar dka' ba yin/ / srung ba sum brtsegs 5'obs ni rgya mtsho dang / /dmag mi srin po nor ni nor sbyin spyor/ /gang zhig 6bstan bcos pa sangs tshad mnyam pa'i/ /sgra sgrogs bu de'ang dus kyi 7dbang gis nyams/ /ngo bo nyid rgyur smra ba ni/ /dngos rnams ngo bo nyid kyis 'grub/ /me yi dmar ba nyid dang ni/ /dam pa gzhan don byed nyid dang 8/ / dam pa min pa'i brtse med nyid/ /9gsum po ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /tsher ma rno bar gyur pa su yis byas/ /ri dwags bya yi ri mo su yis byas/ /bu ram shing mngar nim pa kha ba dag /'di dag thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /nyi ma tsha zhing zla ba 7rab bsil dang / /skye bo chags shing thub pa de min la/ /bde ba rab bsil sbug bsngal rab gdung ba/ /drug po 'di dag ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /gang dag rgyu rnged smra ba ni/ /thams cad rgyu la ltos rnged par/ /dngos po rnams kyis 12skye ba ste/ /nyi ma pad+ma'i ge sar sogs/ /sna tshogs gang gis byas pa yin/ /rma bya'i mdongs la sogs pa yang / /sna tshogs gang gis sprul pa yin/ /ji ltar char rlung la sogs pa/ /glo bur 'byung phyir rgyu med ltar/ /sdug bsngal la sogs rgyu sked nyid/ /shin tu rgya chen rab zab la/ /sgyid lug shin tu ma rdzo6—/67

sbyangs la/ /bdag bzhin sgra dag gti mug gis/ /da 1ltar jeg pa che la smod/ /tshul khrims las ni nyams bla yi/ /lta las cis kyang ma yin te/ /tshul khrims kyis ni mtho ris 'gro/ /lta bas go 'phang mchog tu 'gyur/ /gti mug dbang gis bsgribs gyur te/ /gang zhig yang dag gegs 2byed pa/ /de la dge ba'i 'gro ba'ang med/ /thar pa rnged pa smos ci dgos/ /gnod pa'i sa bon gyur pa yi/ /mu stegs byed mang mthong nas ni/ /thar 'dod skye bo 'dod rnams la / /snying rjer mi 'gyur su zhig yod/ /de phyir thar pa don gnyer rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings su lta bar gyis/ /chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i glu/ /slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā 4ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //26—1675

1217༄༅/ /man ngag ma'i sgon ma jes bya ba/sgosna༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ u pa de sha kā ya pra dī 2pa nā ma/ bod skad du / man ngag sgu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni gcig nyid la/ /gdul bya'i mos pa'i dbang gis ni / /phyi nang gsang ba gsum du snang / /bde gshegs sprul pa sna tshogs ston / /yab ni thabs kyi 4rang bzhin la/ /yum ni shes rab rang bzhin te/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /thar pa'i lam gyi gtso bo yin/ /las dang thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /la la zhi zhing la la khro/ /zhi bas phan par ma gyur na/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /gdod nas dag pa'i snying po la / /gzugs sgu mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /rang rgyud dngos po ma yin par / /rang dbang can gyi sgu nyid do/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i cho 'phrul rnams/ /sems can lta bu ma yin te/ /skye rga na 'chi rang gis shes/ /zhen pa rnams 26—/678

—las 'da' tshul ston/ /skye dang 'chi ba mi dmigs pas/ /bag chags lus las grol gyur nas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i sku yin pas/ /bltas pa tsam gyis dri ma 'dag /mtshan gzhi dri med me long la/ /mtshan bcas 'dzin med gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zung 'jug blo gros ngo bor rtogs/ /gnyug ma dar ldan me 'o/nga la/ /bcud dang rtsal sbyong gzugs brnyan 'char/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor rtogs1/ /'khor 'das gzhi med me long la/ /'gro ba drug gi 2gzugs brnyan 'char/ /bsgom du rnged pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ /shes rab gsum gyi me long la/ /yon tan mtha' dag gzugs brnyan 'char/ /yongs su rnged pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ /bcu gcig ldan pa'i dam pa la/ /brgyad dang lda na pa'i slob ma yis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar rab btud nas/ /ma nyams gsum gyis mchod pa dbul/ /nges pa'i shes pa skyes gyur nas/ /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /ma 'dres gcig tu rtogs pa yis/ /dus 'di nyid la sdogs sangs rgyas/ /man ngag sgu'i sgron ma rdzogs so// //26—/679

1218༄༅/ /rjag pa gsung gi sgon ma jes bya ba/shesngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ yā na wāka pra dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/theg pa gsung gi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo / /khams gsum sems can ma lus kun/ /ma rig mun pas 'thibs pa la / /ston pa bcom ldan shāka thub kyis/ /gsung gi sgon ma 'di bstan pas/ /dam chos rim pa gsum du gsungs/ /rgyas par gsungs 2dang 'azing du bshad/ /bsdus pa'i don du bstan pa'o/ /de la rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ /dug gsum nyon mongs cha mnyam pa'i/ /gnyen po brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ /jeg pa sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /'bring ni gsung rab bcu gnyis dang / /mdo dang dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de byung skyes pa'i rabs/ /rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ /bsdus pas sde snod gsum dag ste/ /mdo sde 'dus pa 1chos mngon no/ /lta 26—1681

ba gtsor ston mngon pa ste/ /bsgom pa gtsor ston mdo sde yin/ /spyod pa gtsor ston 'dul ba'o/ /de yang rnam pa gsum yin te/ /che dang chung dang khyab par ro/ /dang po lnga ni mdo yin te/ /de rjes drug ni 'dul ba yin/ /nangs kyi 1 tha ma mngon pa'o/ /de ni jeg pa chung ngu'i gzhung / /rgyas dang rmad byung mdo yin te/ /mdo sogs dgu ni 'dul ba la/ /gtan la dbab pa mngon pa'i sde/ /de ni jeg pa chen po'i gzhung / /mdo sogs rim lnga mang yin te/ /de rjes rnam bzhi 'dul ba la/ /tha ma gsum ni mngon pa'o/ /de ni khyad par bla med gzhung / /de bzhin spyor ba shes par bya/ /khyad par dbang du byas nas ni/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi zeg pa dang / /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /de gnyis rgyu 'bras khyad par yang / /don gcig la yang ma rmongs te/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa yis/ /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas te/ /pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa pas/ /sngags kyi jeg pa khyad par 'phags//sngags la rgyud sde bzhi ru gsungs / /bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med pa'o/ /dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /rab la rnal 'byor bla med do/ /yang na mi rigs bzhi las ni/ /bram ze'i rigs la bya ba'i rgyud/ /dmangs rigs la ni spyod pa yi/ /de bzhin rje'u rigs rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rgyal rigs rnal 'byor bla med do/ /'di ni bla med rgyud du grags/ /rgyud dang thabs dang 'bras bu las//'di ni thabs kyi rgyud du gsungs/ /zab byung rgya che'i zhi byed 'di/ / brgyud pa rnam 4pa bzhi ru bshad/ / rigs kyi 5rgyud dang don gyi rgyud tsho/ /byin rlabs brgyud dang brda yi brgyud/ /ma zhugs rnam bzhi shes par bya/ /theg nga/ 26—/682

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ dar+sha pra dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/yang dag lta ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo / /lhan skyes ye shes ster mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /mtshon tshod lta ba ma 'gags pas/ /grub mtha' kun dang phyogs gcig mthun/ /yin lugs lta ba mtha' dang bral/ /grub mtha' kun gyi blo ma shog /lta ba rgya che mtha' bral ni/ /mtha' bzhi'i skyon dang bral bas na/ /grub mtha' kun la mi gnas pas/ /yang dag lta bar yid ches bya/ /blta bya lta byed gnyis dang bral/ /lta ba med pa'i lta ba ni/ /lta ba'i dam pa kho na yin/ /dngos 'dzin lta ba kun las grol/ /ma rig pa yi mig phye nas/ /ye shes mig gis bltas pas ni/ /rig pa dri ma med pa lta/ /dri med mthong zhes lta ba yin/ /mthong bya mthong byed gnyis bral nas/ /zung 'jug lta ba gza' gtad med/ /26—/684

—phyag rgya chen po lta mchog yin/ /de nyid rtogs 1pa'i yon tan ni/ /mtshan nyid bzhi ru shes par bya/ /rig pa dri ma rnged pa la/ /rnam dag sgrib g.yogs med pas ni/ /gzung 'dzin g.ya' yis ma gos pa'o/ /gcig gi sangs rgyas e ma ho/ /rig pa gcer bur gnas pa la/ /mtshan ma'i gos kyis ma g.yogs pa / /rang byung 2ye shes drod po che/ /chags sdang mtshan ma me bzhin sreg /kun shes rig pa rten med pa'o/ /bag chags sbubs su ma zhugs par/ /snyug bsngal 'khor ba 4gzugs mi dgos/ /'dod yon sun ma 5rang sar grol/ /'dzin med rig pa brlings pa ni/ /dngos 'dzin yu ba bud pas na/ /snang grags 'dzin pa nus pa yin/ /phyogs cha med pa'i lta 6 ba'o / /yang dag lta ba'i sgon ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //26—1685

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na pra 2dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/ rin po che sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /dang po zin par bya ba dang / /bar du brtan par bya ba gces/ /tha ma bogs kyis dbyung thabs so/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni rjes thob dang / /ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid dang / /rtags dang nyams myong yon tan dang / /tshad dang skyon dang bcos thabs so/ /ma zin zin par byed pa la/ /lus kyi gnad dang dmigs pa'i gnad4/ /rlung gi gnad ni shes par bya/ /zin pa brtan par byed 'dod na/ /rtsal sbyong gsum la mkhas par bya/ /brtan pa gong du bogs 'byin na/ /bogs 'byin gsum la goms par bya/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni rjes thob la/ /ngo sprod bzhi bzhir shes par bya/ /dang po 26—1687

mnyam gzhag ngo sprod ni/ /rig pa mtha' rkyang ngar dang chas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /rig pa thang sha gcad pa ni/ /gzhu bzangs bdungs pa'i dpe yis mtshon/ /de nas rig pa rtsal sbyang ni/ /dar chen rlung gis bskyod 2pas mtshon/ /rig pa rjen par gzhag pa ni/ /gnyug ma lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /rjes thob la yang ngo sprod bzhi/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par sprad/ /rkyen la drag zhan med par sprod / /dbang po thogs rdugs med par sprad/ /rang bzhin gsal ba dri med yin/ /mtshan nyid nyams su myong ba'o / /rtags la rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /btang na 'gro la bzhag 4na sdod / /dgos pa'i dus su snyeg 5pa dang / /shes bzhin gnad du tshud pa'o/ /nyams myong la yang de bzhin te/ /bde ba dang ni gsal ba dang / /mi rtog pa dang mi g.yo ba'o/ /yon tan mngon par shes pa 'char/ /tshad ni rtsa ba brtan pa dang / /de bzhin rtse mo rno ba nyid/ /bar ni gsal ba ngar dang chas/ /dmigs pa sna tshogs sgyur shes pa'o/ /skyon ni bying dang rmugs pa dang / /de bzhin rgod dang g.yeng ba'o/ /bcos pa la yang rnam gsum ste/ /rin chen gser ltar bcos pa dang / /'tsho mdzad sman pa lta bu dang / /bi shwa karma'i bzo bzhin no/ /man ngag bsgom pa'i sgon ma rdzogs so// //26—1688

bsdur mchan/1687 17mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄na rin po che sgom pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sgom pa'i/ tshoge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉gabha ba/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stand/1688 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gdungs/ ni 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyod/ dzod 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sprad/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gzhag 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stegs/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1147)26wa 1689

༄/ /mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgon ma jes bya ba/ rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma tā wastu pra dī pa 2snanā ma/ bod skad du / mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang snang me long ston mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /gzhi la rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /spyi yi gzhi dang bye brag gzhi / /spyi ni gnyis su lung ma bstan/ /gzhi nyid ming 'dogs bral ba yin / /dper na ga pur sman bzhin no/ /ma bcos khas len bral ba yin/ /nus pa sna tshogs 'char bas na/ /gzhi nyid shes pa'i nus pa yin/ /sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes 'byung / /de ma rtogs pa'i sems can ni/ /lus dang bag chags gnyis su snang / /bye brag gzhi la gnyis yin te/ /'khor ba'i gzhi dang 'das pa'o/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'dus byas pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pas na/ /snod dang bcud ni mi rtag ste/ /dus bzhi la sogs 26—/690

'gyur bas na/ /de ma shes pas yang yang 'khor/ /'das pa'i gzhi la gnyis yin te/ /dran pa bzhi yis ngos gzung 1la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab po/ /thabs shes gnyis kyis gtan la dbab/ /ā li thabs kyi 3rang bzhin la/ /kā li shes rab rang bzhin no/ /skye med mtshon pas a zhes bya/ /'gag gred mtshon pas ka yin no/ /ṛ dṛ '-i shā zung 'jug go/ /zla ba dang ni nyi ma gnyis/ /g.yas dang g.yon par shes par bya'o/ /de nas dus tshod 'pho ba dang / /chu tshod dbyu gu skad byug dang / /lte ba dang ni snying ga dang / /mgrin pa dang ni spyi bo dang / /'khor lo bzhi ru shes par bya/ /'byung ba lnga dang phyi nang gnyis/ /ro snyoms ma zhu shes par bya/ /phyi nang gnyis su gnas pa la/ /rten 'brel chos rnams ma shes na/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams mi shes so//lte bar a gnas gsang bar spro/ /snying gar re gnas 'bar ba ni/ /mgrin par tri las gsal ba ni/ /spyi bor re 4du bsgom par bya/ /bde stong gnyis su gsal bas ni/ /mtshon pas 5phyag rgya chen po yin/ /spong dang spyor dang sgyur dang grol/ /zad dang 'phen dang tshig 6dang don/ /sde snod gsum gyi don yang ston/ /dus tshod 'byung ba bzhi yis mtshon/ /ma nor ba ru shes par bya/ /sde tshan lnga yis nang rnams 'joms/ /ā li kā li mgrin par gnas/ /nam mkha'i yi ges chang rgyal 'joms/ /rtsa 8yi sde tshan rkan las 'byung / /me yi yi ges zhe sdang 'joms/ /ṭa yi sde tshan lce las 'byung / /rlung gi yi ges phrag dog 'joms/ /ta yi sde tshan so nas 'byung / /sa yi yi ges gti mug 'joms / /pa yi sde tshan mchu nas 'byung / /chu yi ⑩yi ges 'dod chags 'joms / / hūṃ gis 'og gi rlung rnams basbus / /a yis steng gi bde 26—1691

—ba gsal/ /ha yis bde ba 'phel bar byed/ /hika gis bde ba gnas nas 'dren / /phyi nas 'byung ba'i dgra gshed dang / /nang nas 'byung ba'i ro snyoms dang / /phyi yi dus tshod g.yon nas gzung 2/ /nang gi dus tshod g.yas nas gzung / /lo yi mgo bo byi ba yin/ /zla ba'i mgo bo stag yin pas/ /lho dang byang dang shar dang nub/ /'byung ba bzhi ru shes par bya / /shes na thams cad 'grub par nges/ /tshig gcig bstan — bhepas sangs rgyas dang / /rdzas gcig rnyed pas don yod 'grub/ /sngags zigacig bzlas pas nus pa 'byung / /mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/169༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du khros pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ mnyam nyid ga'i'i sgon ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/1691 tsho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅ lo t+pa/ ༄〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉〉gas/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉go/ 8—〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byung / — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(yis/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉 gi 'og gis/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdus/1692 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7zung / 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skadan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngag26—1692

༄/ /mthar thug 'azas bu'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ko ṭi niṣ+ṭha pha la pra 2dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i chu las sgol mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /sgrub pa'i chos la don yod pas/ /dam pas gsungs la yid ches gyis/ /mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya/ /gnas skabs rgyu yi 'bras bu dang / /mthar thug rtogs —pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rab ster ltabs/ /byas pa'i chos la nan tan skyed/ /nam mkha' rdo rje grong 'jug gsum/ /las su rung ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /rtogs 6pa'i 'bras bu sku lnga ste/ /ngo bo stong pa chos skra la / /rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku yin/ /mtshan nyid nyams myong sprul pa'i sgu/ /zung 'jug ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /rang gol rang dag bde chen sku/ /26dod1694
