༄ga /byang chub spyod pa'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/①༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo sa7dhi tsar+ya pra dī pa kyenā ma/ bod skad du/byang chub spyod pa'i sgon ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud / /'gro ba sdug bsngal gdungs pa la/ /zhi byed bsel ldan dri med bshad / /'jig rten khams 'di mi rtag ste/ /dper na 'ja' tshon yal dang 'dra/ /lo zla tshes grangs 'chi dang nye/ /bu tsha la sogs gogs rnams dang / /bor nas gcig pu 'go dgos na/ /bar do bzhi las 'chi ba'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal ri bos mnan pas sdug /bdun tsho bdun du bar do ru/ /gshed pos 'tshe zhing sdug re bsngal/ /ma rig 'khrul pas lus blangs te/ /nyon mongs lnga yis sems kyang dkrugs/ /dper na shing rta'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /'gro ba drug gi chosdug bsngal myong / /sdug bsngal bzhi sogs sdug bsngal bas/ /26dod1696

de phyir byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /le lo g.yeng ba rab spangs te/ /shes rab gsum la blo sbyangs la/ /rtag tu dur khrod gnas su 'dug /dran pa bzhi dang ldan pa yis/ /tho rangs langs te khrus byas la/ /dad dang mos gus sngon btang ste/ /byang chub sems dang rab ldan pas/ /'gro ba bu bzhin gdung bar bya/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro ma nyams bya/ /bden pa'i chos la the tshom spang / /'dod pa spel phyir chu sbyin gtang / /mchod bshags shel sogs kha ton 3bya/ /gru yi tshul du lus kyang btsal/ /bag yod spyod lam blo gros zab/ /lha dang mi 'bral bsam pa bzang / /dang po byung bas dkon mchog mchod/ /kha zas kun las she rnal 'byor bya/ /lhag ma 'byung bo rnams la bsngo/ /bshang gci rnams kyang sbyin par gtang / /smon lam rgya chen gdab pa'o/ /chos su 'akro ba'i tshig kyang brjod/ /sāts+tsha byegadab cing srog kyang gdon/ /bsod nams tshogs ni ci nus bsags/ /ye shes tshogs kyang de bzhin te/ /sdom pa gsum dang ldan par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa drug spyad de/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /bskor ba bya zhing lus kyang bcag /'byung ba bzhi ni ro snyoms snyete/ /mtshan mo nang gi spyad hūṃpa bya/ /srod la gtor tshogs chen po gtang / /nam phyed tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /phyi bcud nang bcud rang sor gzhag /nam smad dge ba'i gnyid kyang log /spyod lam rnam bzhi'i chos la bsdu/ /ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun ltar spyad/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal bsre ba yang / /sum cu rtsa bzhi'i gdams pa'i don/ /sems nyid las su rung bas ni/ /rang dbang rgyal po sems la thob/ /de phyir rnal 'byor brtson par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba rje btsun ka ma la shī las dz+wa26—1697

༄ / /rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 1༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ pā da yo ga pra dī paṃ na 3ma/ bod skad du/rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi sgon ma 'di/ /bstan ri pas log pa'i lam mi 'jug /snyug bsngal thams cad zhi mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog de la 'dud—/ /ā li kā li'i jesgra don rtogs/ /sde snod gsum gyi don yang shes/ /bdag dang skye 'gro'i sems can rnams/ /ye nas skye med 'od gsal yang / /ma rig pa yi rlung gis 'khrul/ /'khor ba'i sbug bsngal nyams su myong / /de las grol bar byed pa'i saphyir/ /rnal 'byor lam pas 'di ltar bya/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rab spangs te/ /dge ba'i chos la brtson par bya/ /bka' 6la som nyi mi za zhing / /rtag tu skyabs 'gro ma nyams bya/ /byams pa'i sems dang rab ldan zhing / /'gro la snying rje ci nus bya/ /'dod yon dngos po mi 26—1699

rtag pas/ /gzung 'dzin chags sems rnam par spangs/ /gzhan la smad par mi bya zhing / /'gro ba'i bla ma spyi bor bkur/ /log pa'i lam du mi 'jug cing / /mthu dang ngan sngags spel mi bya/ /longs spyod 'du 'dzi rnam spangs te//gcig pu nags su 'dug la bsgom1/ /'jig rten 'chal tshig mi brjod par/ /sngags dang snying po mdo yang brjod/ /yang na lkugs pa'i tshul du bsdad/ /rang byung dri ma med pa'i brda/ /lus la gru yi blo bzhag la/ /bcud len gyis ni zungs kyang bskyed/ /gtum mo yis ni ro bsnyams te/ /'byung ba bsnyams zhing nad rnams dbyung / /gnod spyin bar chad byed pa la/ /brtul zhugs gdams pa'i spyad pa bya/ /mi ngal gsum dang 'du ba gsum/ /'khor lo gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ /'bar ba gsum dang chud mi za/ /thim pa gsum dang rgyas gdab po/ /mdor na thams cad sems yin te/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan med/ /sems su 'dzin pa 'khrul pa'i blo/ /blo las grol na gnyis su med/ /gnyug ma'i ngang las ma yengs chopar/ /dngos por snang ba 5sgyu mar blta/ /sgyu ma brdzun pa rmi lam tshul/ /rmi lam tshul sogs rab shes nas/ /dpe brgyad bzhin du shes par bya/ /rnal ma'i chos la rab gnas na/ /gang ltar spyad kyang bde ba thob/ /des na rnal 'byor brtson par bya/ / sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa 76rnal 'byor lam gyi sgon ma zhes bya ba rje btsun ka ma la shī las 7mdzad pa rdzogs so// //26—1700

—bsdur mchan/1699 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra rnal 'byor lam gyi sgon ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnyi paṃ nā/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ltan/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngala'i/ sa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skrubya ba'i/ rtse 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodaka'/17༷ ༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgom/ 2 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rabazhan/ ‘snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyod/ ri 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagayengs/5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thar/ dzi 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gisdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa/ tshoshe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉spyos/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (11 51)/26dod1 701

༄ / /gsang ba thugs kyi sgon ma zhes bya ba/ 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ /tsit+ta gu hra pra dī paṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/gsang ba 2 thugs kyi sgon ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa lnga bcu rtsa lnga yis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar rab btud nas/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad par lnga yis gdams pa bstan/ /kye ma rnam shes rlung gis 'khrugs / /rlung ni las su rung ba dang / /gtum mo rlung gis sbar bar bya4/ /'du ba'i nad kyang rlung gis bcos/ /'byung ba ro ni mnyam pa dang / /brtul 5zhugs spyod pas bar chod sel/ /'tsho ba'i bcud ni len pa dang / /e waṃ bde ba'i rlung gis bskyed/ /rten 'byel shes pa 'char ba dang / /rdo rje rkang mgyogs grub par 'gyur/ /dhū tīr tshud de phyag rgya che/ /'dab ldan pad+ma ge sar dbus/ /rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems / /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /chags dang 'bri ba bcu gnyis 26—1702

—brgya / /la la ra sa dhū tīr bsnyu/ /rlung dang byang chub sems kyang de/ /'khor lo bzhi la srog shing tshul/ /mi 'dra sbar bas haṃ las 'dzag /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le ni/ /dkyil 1dang bzlog dang dgram zhing bstem/ /dga' bzhi'i khyad par phyag rgya che/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag pa'o/ /shes pa kho na 'ba' zhig yin/ /sems ni kun gyi sa bon te/ /rang sems rtogs na sangs rgyas la/ /bde ba gzhan du mi btsal lo/ /sems nyid las su rung ba dang / /rnam par mi rtog yang dag don/ /gnyis rnged gnyis su med pa las/ /gnyis su byar sked spros bral mkha'/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das las grol/ /don gyis dbu ma phyag rgya che/ /snying po'i don las ma yengs par/ /gnyug ma'i yid ni gcig tu gtad/ /rnal ma'i don la rab gnas nas/ /yid la mi dmigs 2 bde ba che/ /lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro/ /mtshon du yod pa ma yin te/ /ston ka'i zla ltar dri sked 'od/ /bde gsal stong pa'i ye shes can/ /rang la spras pa mig ltar dbye/ /bde ba che las gzhan med pas/ /phyag rgya'i mchog de phyag rgya che/ /snyug bsngal zhi bar bya ba dang / /lus sems 'phyan cedu gzhug pa dang / /'bras bu blo yis ma grub pa/ /shes rgyud nam mkhar 'phang ba dang / /dmigs pa sna tshogs bsgyur shes so/ /chos dang chos min sel ba dang / /rig pa dngas snyigs dbye ba dang / /rnam shes rlung yang bstem ༄pa'o/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal bsre bar bya/ /bag chags sbubs su grol ba dang / /phyag rgya chen po dus 'dir thob/ /des na rnal 'byor brtson par bya/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa gsang ba thugs kyi sgon ma zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ka ma la shī las 6mdzad pa rdzogs so// //26—1703

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gu khya dang / bod kyi lo tsā khyeb lo btsun chung gis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/17༷2 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du sgos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sngasang ba'i thugs kyi sgon ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (kye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ga ④〈〈pe 〉〉byer bar bya/〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar bar byas/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatul/17༷3 ༄4〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thabashad/ 37〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉khyed/ rju〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉rdzas/ ngu 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thaphan/lha〈〈snar 〉ra stems/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈sa/17༷4 te 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1152)26—1704

1226sngag /maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/she༄spro/ /rgya gar skad du/ maṇ+ḍal bi bye 37nā ma/ bod skad du/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mnyes par byed pa yi/ /maṇ+ḍal cho ga bshad par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal la ni rnam lnga ste//ngo bo nges tshig dbul thabs dang / /dbye ba dang ni phan yon no/ /ngo bo dbul bar 'os pa la/ /sngags dang rdzas su bcas pa'o/ /maṇa ni bskyed gapa'i sa bon te/ /bsod nams 'phel bas ḍal zhes bya/ /dbul thabs dad gus mos pa yis/ /gong ma mnyes par byed pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal dbye na 4rnam gnyis te/ /dngos dang yid kyis bsam pa'o/ /yid ni las su rung ba ste/ /dran pa tsam gyis gsol pa'o/ /dngos la rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /dbul ba dang ni sgrub pa dang / /mchod pa dang ni mi phya7mdzes pa'o/ /sa yang rung ste gzhi la ni/ /gang yang tshad dang ldan pa la/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes pa de 26—1705

yis byug par bya/ /rnam pa nyi shu dgram bya ste/ /haṃ las 'og gi ri rab bsams1 / /rang gi ngos kyi shar byas pa'i/ /ya las shar gyi lus 'phags bsam2 / /ra las byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /la las lho yi 'dzam bu'i gling / /sha las nub kyi ba lang spyod/ /ya las byang shar mtshams su bsam/ /gling g.yog nyi shu byed na yang / /g.yas g.yon sngags kyang de bzhin no/ /ri las nub byang gling phran bsam/ /shaṃ las lho nub mtshams yin no/ /lo las lho shar gling phran bsam/ /tsa las btsun mo rin po che/ /tsha las blon po rin po che / /dza las dmag dpon rin po che/ /wa las glang po rin po che/ /rtsa las rta mchog rin po che/ /tsho las 'khor lo rin po che/ /dze+e las nor bu rin po che/ /waṃ 4las gter chen rin po che/ /saṃ las nyi ma shar du bsam/ /a las zla ba nub tu'o/ /oṃ las stong 5gi ri rab po/ /gling bzhi gling phran bcas pa dang / /rin chen bdun dang gter dang brgyad/ /ri rab nyi zlar bcas pa rnams/ /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog gsum/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i 'os/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis 'bul lags kyis/ /bla ma dkon mchog bzhes su gsol/ /maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i yon tan ni/ /maṇ+ḍal gcig phul drug dang ldan/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsam mi khyab/ /des na de la brtson par bya/ /gcig phul yon tan drug dang ldan/ /gling bzhi phul ba'i yon tan gyis / /bdud bzhi ma lus zhi bar 'gyur/ /gling phran phul ba'i yon tan gyis / /tshad med bzhi dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rin chen sna bdun phul ba yis / /'phags pa'i nor bdun thob par 'gyur/ /gter chen phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /mi zad longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nyi zla phul ba'i yon 26—1706

1227༄/ /de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra taṭ+wā 2nāk+ṣa ro pa de sha /bod skad du/ de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub thob dam pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi las/ /skyes bu khyad par rig 'dzin lnga yi gzhung / /mchog gyur rnams kyi zhabs kyi rdul la reg /de phyir dpe bral phyag rgya chen po bshad/ /rnam gcod dang ni yongs gcod dang / /phung po gsum po sel ba dang / /don dam mjal ba'i tshad ma yis / /yang dag yid la lta ba bya/ /yang dag don la yi ge med/ /gang gis yi ge med shes pa/ /de yis yi ge thams cad shes/ /yi ge a nas k+ṣa la rdzogs / /sde tshan brgyad kyi sgra spyor ni/ /ā li kā lir shes par bya /ma skyes pa dang ma 'gag 4pa/ /zung 'jug mtha' bzhi bral ba yi/ /bde ba chen po rgyun chags su/ /bla ma'i brda yis mtshon par bya/ /kha dog 5mar me me 26—1708

long rgya/ /me shel sa bon sgyur dang sgra/ /brgyad pa 'di ru don bsdus pa/ /go ba cig shos skye bar 'gyur/ /in+d+ra byu—1ti bdag med ma/ /lhan cig skyes spyor 'dod yon grol/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /bden don rtogs pa 'phags pa lha/ /srog dang rtsol ba nā ga pa/ /phyi nang rlung gsum tshangs par 'dren/ /kha spyor thig le pad+mar 'byung / /bde bas rgyas pa'i za ma tog/sku gsum mnyam gzhag mda' bsnun na/ /dran med skye med blo las 'das/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni rjes thob dang / /rmi lam dang ni bar do la/ /zin dang brtan dang bogs 'byin pa/ /rgyas gdab pa dang rnam pa bzhi/ /dang po dus bzhi mnyam sbyar la/ /gnad gsum gzer 4bzhi gdab par bya/ /lus kyi gnad dang dmigs pa'i gnad/ /rlung gi gnad ni shes par bya/ /rig pa gcur 5la gdab pa dang / /shes pa srang du gzhug pa dang / /sems ni rung 6dmigs 'dren pa dang / /rten dang dbral zhing bsgom pa gces/ /e waṃ brgyan pa'i bde ba la/ /bde bas byang chub lam du kyer/ /snang srid brda ru slong 8ba dang / /gang mthong phyag rgya chen por shar/ /thams cad ro mnyam de bzhin nyid/ /gabyug zos pa yis gzhan kun grol/ /ji ltar chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor ma yengs rgyun du bsgom/ /gzung ba dang ni sbyang ba dang / /sgyu ma dang ni kho na nyid/ /nyal dang log pa'i khyad par las/ /rmi lam man ngag shes par bya/ /da lta 'chi kha bar do la/ /rten dang 'ong dang thig le sems/ /grong 'pho'i man ngag shes pa yis/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o//don mthong pa yis sgo 'dogs chod/ /nyams su blangs na byin rlabs 'byung / /drod rtags nus pa tshod zin pas/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'o/ /rlung mkhris 26—/709

—bad kan 'dus pa'i nad/ /mtshon dang mche 1ba 'byung ba 'khrugs/ /dal yams 'brum po chu ser la/ /ting 'dzin me btsa' skyugs kyis zhi/ /bdud dang mu stegs cho 'phrul gtong / /gdon dang 'byung po bshugs pa 'dren/ /gnod sbyin 'khu 2ldog byed pa'i tshe/ /mi g.yo rgya mtsho lta bu gzhag /me dang chu dang dug sbrul dang / /bse dang chom rkun rgyal po'i chad/ /stag dang dred mo gcan gzan khro/ /de tsho nga yis 'dod pa yin/ /dgod dang rtsed mo/ byed pa dang / /dal dang drag dang shin tu drag /zang zing longs spyod mang po la/ /sbyor ba 'di yis khyab na bde/ /ro snyoms gtum mo mkha' spyod dang //sman dang bcud len bdud rtsi bsten4/ /ro langs mkha' 'gro dngos grub ster/ /blang dor med pa'i sems kyis 'bad/ /mtha' rgyas gnyis kyis shan phye la/ /khar phog car phog thog 5babs su/ /thun dang bcud kyis rtsal sbyangs te/ /snang gsum spyor ba bskyed 6pa'i phyir/ /dbang po gsum gyis dam mi 'da'/ /ma 'khrul gsum gyis so thub ste/ /srog 'dzin gsum gyis brtan pa thob7 / /gol lugs gsum gyis tshad bstan no/ /lo zla gsum gyis zad sar bskyal/ /'gro ba sbug bsngal 'khor bar bying ba la/ /ma rig mig 'byed zhi byed 8'di bkod pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid rtogs te/ /kun gyis phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ka ma la shī las 9mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gu khya dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bla ma lo btsun chung gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa 1

༄/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/1༄yo/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yum kyi sgrub pa bshad par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'byung ba'i/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam kyis ni/ /rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod pa/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /sku mdog dkar zhing yid 'ong ma / /skra bcings pa la cung zhig 'phyang / /chu skyes dkar la legs gnas pa/ /phyag g.yas su ni pad+ma ste/ /kha dog dmar ba'i rnam par bsgom / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa g.yon/ /rdo rje skyil krung legs par bcas/ /rgyan kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgom/ /a yig yi ge la zhugs shing / /mchog tu dga' bar byed pa'o/ /dam tshig sems dpa' rnam bskyed la/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /zla ba drug gi spyor 26—1712

ba yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma bdun gyi sbyor ba yis//bstan bcos kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /zla ba shar ba'i rim gyis ni/ /zla ba phyed ni bsgom par bya/ /bzlas pa 'bum byas sbyor ba yis/ /nyin re bzhin du tshigs bcad brgya/ /'bad pa med par sbyor ba 'byung / /gzhung yang brgya tsam 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā bsgo ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha bsgo ni/ bye ri bye ri bubye 1snabasgo ni swā hā/bya rog gi skad ma 2grag par sngags 'di lan bdun du mngon par bsngags par byas nas/ ma brlangs pa'i sgyur 4po'i khu ba 'thungs na zla ba drug tu gang 'thung bar byed pa/ de shes rab chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun ka ma la shī las 5mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //26—1713

bsdur mchan/1712 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/1713 —lte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mthurnyi/ tshosnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ — — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sngags/ ce 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phosangs pa'i bskyur/ tshosnye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈sa/bsdur 'bras re'u migabyud/ (1155)dpe gaji/26—1 714

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ bhaṭ+wā ra kār+ya tā rā 2sā dha 8/ bod skad du/rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgol ma'i sgrub thabs/ smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes dri med sgol ma gsal ba'i thugs/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab phar phyin gsungs/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rdo rje 4phag mo'i sgu/ / rje btsun 5sgol ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ /sgol ma gsum dang tshul mthun rnal 'byor pas/ /rtag tu lha mo 'di bsgom bya phyir bshad/ /dang po rten gyi gang zag gis/ /gdong la sogs pa khrus byas nas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas de ru/ /maṇ+ḍal byi dor legs byas la/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /snying gar zla dkyil yi ge ṭ+wāṃ/ /lcags kyu 'dra ba'i 'od 'phros pas/ /bla ma lha mo spyan drangs la/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags/ /rjes su yi rang bsgul zhing gsol/ /dge ba cung zad ci bsags pa/ /byang chub thob phyir 26—/715

bdab gis bsngo/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /sngags 'di bzlas pas stong par bsgom/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā 1dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma 2kophohaṃ/paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng / /hūṃ las rje btsun sgrol ma ni/ /zhal gcis phyag gnyis sgu mdog ljang / /g.yas na mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/ /g.yon na ut+pal sngon po 'dzin/ /rin chen rgyan rnams mdzes pa'i tshul/ /smra ba'i seng ges dbu brgyan pa/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed par bzhugs/ /dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs byas/ /de ltar dam tshig bskyed byas la/ /thugs/ ka'i ṭ+wāṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis phyag byas te/ /de nas mchod pa sngags 'dis dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gabye pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra nai bi bye pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ gī ti 4pū dza hūṃ/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgom/ /skyo na bzlas pa 'di ltar bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re swā hā / sngags phreng snying ga nas phyung ste/ /ye shes thugs la mnyes 5pas mchod//byen rlabs /tshotshur 'dus zhal nas 'thon7/ /bdag la thim zhing 'od 'phros pas / /bar chad sel dang sgrib sbyangs bsam8/ /des skyo gtor ma gtang bya ste / /mi rtog oṃ las rin chen snod/ /āḥlas bdud rtsi sna tshogs bsam/ /hūṃ las thim zhing sna tshogs gsol/ /sngags 'dir snying po btags te dbul/ /ba bo ta pū dza ar+ghaṃ pū dza ba bo i rda kṛt+na kha kha khā hi khā hi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza khā hi swā hā/ dad pa'i stobs kyis bstod par bya/ /oṃ stong nyid snying rje phag mo che/ /sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin/ /sgrol ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dri med ye shes gsal ba'i thugs/ /sgrol 26—/716

ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zla 'od srid pa'i mun sel ba/ /'joms byed nyi ma'i dkyil dang mtshungs/ /thabs dang shes rab yon tan ldan/ /sgol ma la ni rtag tu 'dud/ /'gro la bu bzhin rtag tu 'dun1/ /srid gsum rnam thar gsum la 'god/ /seng sdeng nags la rab gnas shing / /'jigs pa/ brgyad las shin tu skyob/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i skur ston cing / /skye shi med nga/'i chos kyang ston/ /sgol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i thing khams su/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sgur ston cing / /'go ba'i sdug bsngal nad rnams sel/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde ba can gyi jing khams na/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i sgur ston cing / /bde ba chen po'i ngang la gnas/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod2/ /rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sgur ston cing / /phrin las bzhi yi don yang sgrub/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod4/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i zhing khams na/ /pha rol phyin ma'i sgur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas tshogs dang bcas/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod5/ /de nas nyal ba'i dus na ni/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ /las dang spyod lam ci spyod pa/ /lha mo'i nga rgyal du ni bsgom6/ /'di brtsams pa yi dge ba gang / /rje btsun sgol ma'i thugs rje dang / /dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs 7kyis/ /rje btsun sgol ma 'grub 8par shog /rje btsun ka ma la shī las 9mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //26—1717

༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bā rā tī sā 2dha rna/ bod skad du/rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /'khor lo'i gtso la rab btud nas/ /de yi zab mo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dra ba sdom pa'i tshul bzhin bshad/ /de la rdo rje phag mo sgrub par 'dod pas dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug la/ kha nub tu bltas te dang por sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas dad pas gzhi bzung bsod nams kyis tshogs bsag go/ /de nas rim —gyis snang ba 'byung ba la bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la/ yi ge gsum gyi sngags kyis chobyin gyes brlab cing / oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ hri oṃ/ hri trī5/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ces pas lag pa byin kyis brlabs la go bgo ste bgegs thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ hri gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba dubye thuphaṭa swā hā/26—1719

de nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung bas lus ngag yid gsum gyis thabs la mkhas par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudhe ཿsarba dharmāḥ1swa bhā wa shurnyolhahaṃ zhes brjod pas lus rnam par dag pa lha'i 2gzhal yas khang chos 'byung gi dkyil du bsam / oṃ badz+ra shudhe ཿsarba dharmā badz+ra shusgolhahaṃ zhes brjod pas ngag rnam par dag pa sngags kyi 'khor lo la oṃ oṃ 4oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki m+bi ye/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa byā ye/oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā5/ zhes bzlas so/ /oṃ yo ga shubyeḥsarba dharmā 6yo ga shusgophohaṃ zhes brjod 7yid rnam par dag pa lha'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ gi 8'dzin pa/ sgu mdog dmar ba la dur khrod 9 chas kyis brgyan pa zhabs g.yas bskum pa/g.yon brkyang bas 7dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i gsang gnas su chu'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyag rgya bzhis ye shes kyi lha mo dgug gzhug la sogs pa bya'o 1/ /de yang rang nyid lta bu gcig spyan drangs la phyag 'tshal mchod pa dbul/ sdig pa bshags/rjes su yi rang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /gsol ba gdab/dge ba bsngo/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur/ bdag la mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bstod/ sngags 'dis gtor ma gtang 2ste/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi bhā kā ma ru pa yo gi nī/ dz+wa la mu khi ni kha kha khā hi rkikhā hi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod cing rkang pa brgyad kyis bstod/ de nas thabs bla na med pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pas yod med gnyis su med pa'i gdams ngag bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o / /mar gyur thugs kyi sadapal be+e'u las/ /zab mo bcud kyi sathigs pa byung / /skal ldan rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje phag mo 'grub par shog /rdo 26—1720

༄7/ /'jam dpal khro bor sgrub pa/lha ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ mañdzu shrī kro dha sā dha rna/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal khro bor 2 sgrub pa/ smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khro bo gshin rje gshed/ /khro rgyal gtso la rab 'dud nas/ /de yi zab mo sgrub pa'i thabs / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshul du bri/ /de la 'jam dpal gshin rje sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom / de'i dbus su hūṃ mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros pas bar chad thams cad srung 4zhing bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi 5thugs dam bskul te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' la 6spyan drangs la/ yan lag bdun pa bya zhing tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te de nidz+wabasod nams kyi tshogs bsag go/ /de nas oṃ sarba 26—1722

—be+ermā 1bhā ba swa bhā wa shusgolhahaṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur bsgom / de'i ngang las rang gi rig pa hūṃ mthing nag rab tu 'bar bar bsgom/de gyur pa las rdo rje khro bo hūṃ gis mtshan par 2bsam/ de las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mthing nag zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/bro gnyer dpral bar bsnyus pa/ mche ba gcigs shing skra gyen du badze+es pa/phyag g.yas kyis ral gri rdo rje'i yu ba can bzung ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub ut+pa las mtshan pa/ gcer bu dur khrod kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang rol zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ ma he gdan du bting nas las kyi gshin rje 'dul bar bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas de lta bu'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la phyag dang mchod pa dbul 4te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ dhū pe hūṃ/ dī pe hūṃ/ gabye hūṃ/ ni ri te hūṃ/ ne+e bi bye zhe hūṃ / shaja hūṃ/ zhes mchod pa dbul 6gtor ma gtang ngo / /gtor snod mi dmigs pa las rin po che'i snod du 7bsam/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug la sogs pa bya zhing / yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs9 / dbang bskur/ mi skyo bar du bsgom/ de nas bzlas pa'i sngags 'di yin te7/ ā+oṃ dhīḥ byeḥbi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nam mkha'i dkyil nas thog sababs pa ltar shin tu drag par bzlas so/ /de nas sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ zung du 'jug pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa sems de la gtad pa'o/ /nag po thugs kyi dpal be'u nas/ /zab mo bdud rtsi'i bcud thigs pas/ /skal ldan rin chen lta bu yi / /'jam 26—1723

༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣa ṭa dharma 2 u pa de sha nā mad/ bod skad du / chos drug gi man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dal 'byor rgyu 'bras las rnams las/ /rnal 4'byor don gyi snying po btsal5/ /rnal 'byor lus kyi rtsa yi tshogs/ /phra rags rlung dang ldan pa ni6/ /dbang du byed thabs 'khrul 'khor gyes/ /dbyung rngub dgang dang gzhil ba ste/ /la la nā dang ra sa nā / /a wa dhū tī 8 'khor lo bzhi/ /lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lbo yi 9me/ /phra rab las 'phel hūṃ las ni/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /rgyu mthun la sogs 'bras bu bzhi/ /'khrul 'khor drug gis rgyas par bya/ /tsār+ya pa'i u 1 pa de sha'o // //sasgod bcud khams gsum ma lus pa/ /sgyu ma rmi lam la sogs dpes/ /26—1725

—'gro 'dug spyod lam kun du sbyang / /lha tshogs sgyu ma me long gzugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs dz+res pa/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs/ /de nyid sgyu ma'i gzugs bzhin du/ /sgyu dpe bcu gnyis ltar mthong ba/ /rna'/ 'byor sgyu ma'i don mthong ba'o/ /nā gārdzu na'i u )pa de sha'o // //2rmi lam rmi lam don shes shing / /rgyun du zab mo'i don bsgom pa/ /nā da thig le la sogs pa / /rigs lnga'i sa bon la dmigs nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing dang sangs rgyas blta/ /gnyid padus bde chen sgrub depa'i thabs la ba 6pa'i u pa de sha'o // //7 rnal 'byor a wa dhū tī pa/ /a wa dhū tīr 9 sems gnas patso/ /snying gi thig ler sems brtan 1pas/ /'od dang 'od zer 'ja' ris dang / /skya rings nyi 'od zla 'od dang / /nyi ma zla ba shar 'dra dang / /lha dang sku yi snang ba sogs/ /sna tshogs zhing khams dag par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lam chen te / /nā gārdzu na'i u pa r+ṣade sha'o // //ma rnal 'byor 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /dbang po rnams dang 'byung ba sdud7/ /zla nyi rlung rnams snying gar 'dus/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin sna tshogs 'char/ /rnam shes phyi rol yul song na/ /rmi lam yul bzhin sna tshogs snang / /bdun bdun dus tshe 7'chi snang dang / /de nas skye bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /de tshe lha yi rnal 'byor sgom1 / /yang na de nyid ngang la gzhag /de rjes 26dod1726

khye la phyogs pa'i tshe/ /mnga' bdag lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /snang srid lha yi rnal 'byor sgom1/ /des ni bar do khegs par 'gyur/ / su kha si bye'i u pa de sham // // de las rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i tshe/ /grong 'jug lha dang sa bon gyis—/ /'go 'ong ring dang thung ba dang / /lha la bslab zhecing 'phar ba'i dus/ /gang 'dod grong du 'jug par bya/ /gong du 'bo 6na stong ra lha/ /yi sprod ti ka hūṃ dang hūṃ/ /lha dang bla ma'i thugs kar 'phang / /des ni 'dod pa'i gnas su 'phro / /su kha si bye'i )u pa de sha'o // //8 grub pa'i rnal 'byor 9dbang phyug tikhra pa'i zhabs kyi 1 zhal snga nas mdzad nga/ sdogs so// //rgya gar kyi mkhas pa 11nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta dang / 5mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo sdos kyis kha che'i gnas pusgo ha rir bsgyur ba'o // //26—1727

— ——bsdur mchan/1725 —rtesgyumatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ra / /chos drus si man ngag zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tshobye‘〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṣa ḍa dharmā/ ༷ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rin maḥ/ 4 〈〈nge 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zodal/ rdoshe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsal/ hūṃ〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan/ ⑦ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na dang dā pa/ na sdo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhu ti'i/ kye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'i/ rngu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7 satum mo'i—/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉//1726 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sgyu lus kyi/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas 5 〈〈pe 〉sngaganyis sdo 〈〈pe 〉〉bsgrub/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 zomi lam gyi/ 5 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu 9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dhu tir/ te 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ rke1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brten/ 8〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'angs — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ṣe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 'od gsal gyi/ tre〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈smi ra 〉)bsdud—/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshes/ () 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ 1 — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag1727 hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabasgom/ khye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mas ka 5bar do'i/ she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// 4 (〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ rgya〈〈pe 〈〈snar 〉〉mab/ gye)〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorapho/ ma 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉'pho/ pu ka sirnyi'i/ 'pho ba'i/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// she/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gyi/ 6 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mnabs kyi/ — 〈〈nge/ 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mkhan po/ skye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 bod kyi lots+tsha ba/ rkerte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉zhing btan la phab pa'o/26dod1 728
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1159)26wa 1729

༄/ /bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngagashesna༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā ha pra ma ṇa saṃ myaghā ma ḍā ki rgyu pa de sha /bod skad du/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag blo yi khyad par kyis/ /rim gyis pa dang cig car ba/ /rim gyis pa yi sman chen 'di/ /cig car ba yi dug chen yin/ /cig car ba yi sman chen 'di/ /rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur / /des na sbyangs pa'i 'phro can la/ /cig car ba ni bstan par bya/ /sems can dang po'i las can la/ /rim gyis pa 'di bstan par bya/ /dang po nyon mongs gdul ba ni/ /khams kyi rab tu dbye ba bya/ /phung po zhig grol bsgom pa ra bya/ /bla mas bstan pa'i lam gyi ni/ /slob ma yongs su smin bya zhing / /bskyed rim gzhung las shes par bya/ /ngag dbe+en pa dang rlung sgom pa//bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /sems la dmigs pa'i man ngag ni/ /bde 26—1730

ba chen po'i man ngag go/ /byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni/ /man ngag tshig bsdus dag las shes/ /gtum mo 'od gsal sbyangs pa la/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i lus bsgom pa/ /slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis/ /slob pa la yang gnyis yin te/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dang / /rang nyid lhag par gnas pa'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa la/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu/ /me long dri ma med pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris te/ /de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs/ /zhes bya ba nas sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas rtogs par bya'o/ /rang nyid lhag par gnas pa la/ /'pho dang grong du 'jug pa dang / /rmi lam bar do rnam pa bzhi/ /gong du 'pho ba rnam gsum ste/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul dang ni/ /sgyu ma dngos dang 'od gsal lo/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul la ni/ /hūṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge yis/ /bu ga dag kyang dgag bya ste/ /rang gi sems ni lha yi sku/ /'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom pa'o/ /yang na hūṃ la bsdu bya ste/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga dag tu gdon/ /'og min gnas su yang dang yang / /rgyun mi chad par gnas par bya/ /de ltar sgom pa brtan gyur nas/ /dus dang rtags rnams shes bya ste/ /'pho khar shes pa gnas su bskyal / /de ltar byas pas 'pho bar 'gyur/ /sgyu ma dngos kyi 'pho ba ni/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i rmi lam la/ /goms par bya ste sum cu ni/ /rtsa gsum gnas su 'pho bya ste/ /de ru sngar ni gang bsgoms pa'i/ /goms pa khrid de bsgoms gyur na/ /bde ba skye ba'i gnas yin pas/ /mi rtog ye shes thob nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /26—1731

—sngags pa'i 'go sa mchog yin te/ /mtshan nyid pa ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /'od gsal ba yi 'pho ba ni/ /'chi ba'i dus ni shes bya ste/ /mi rtog pa la sems gnas nas/ /lus kyi rtsol ba dag gis ni/ /'od gsal bar ni gzhug bya ste/ /bar dor mya ngan 'da' ba yin/ /babe+ebs nas 'pho ba de rnams yin/ /'od gsal ba la sems gnas na/ /slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che/ /ma bslabs par yang 'pho ba yod/ /zung 'jug ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob po/ /gdams pa gser 'gyur rtsi 'di yis/ /'chi tshe gang la phog gyur pa/ /dngos de mya ngan 'das gser 'gyur/ /de phyir bla ma thabs la mkhas/ /de la grong du 'jug pa ni/ /mdun du dmigs pa gsal byas la/ /dbugs dang sems ni ma yengs par/ /gtad nas yun du goms gyur na/ /des ni shes lus bya ba dang / /dmigs pa je gsal je gsal 'gyur/ /de la yun du goms byas nas/ /bsod nams can gyi lus blangs te/ /rang gi phung po dor byas nas/ /sems can don ni ma lus bya'o/ /rmi lam la yang rnam lnga ste / /dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang / /sbyangs dang goms pa khrid pa dang / /gong du 'pho bar shes par bya/ /dran pa shes bya sgom pa ni/ /gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang / /'dun pa dag ni sngon btang ste/ /log ka ma yi shes pa ni//dran pas yang dang yang bsgug la/ /bsgugs pas log pa lan re bzhin/ /rab 'bring sad dus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dran pa brtan gyur nas/ /sgyu ma dag tu shes bya ste/ /ma log pa yi dus su yang / /snang srid sgyu mar shes bya ste/ /sgyu ma dngos ni rmi lam yin/ /'di nyid sgyu mar ma shes pas/ /bar do sgyu mar ma shes na/ /bar do'i srid pa mi khegs pas/ /skye ba yang nas yang 26—/732

blangs te/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ /de ltar rmi lam dngos dag la/ /blo ni 'jug tu ma btub na/ /sngon du 'gro ba dag bya ste/ /ma/ log pa yi dus su yang / /snang srid sgyu mar shes bya ste/ /bskyed pa'i rim nga/'i rtags dag dang / /'du 'dzi shin tu nyung ba dang / /sngar gyi goms pas khrid pa dang / /mos pa shin tu drag pa dang / /'gugs pa'i dus dag shes nga/'o / /gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang / /dran pas de nyid sgyu ma ru/ /shes bya bsam pa sngon btang la/ /nan tan du ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar du ni goms pa dang / /phan tshun dag tu byin pa dang / /ngal dub dag ni 'ong ba dang / /'grangs tsholtogs dag ni 'ong ba dang / /cho 'phrul dag ni ston pa dang / /de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /gnyid log pa yi dus su yang / /goms par byas pa'i bag chags kyis/ /log ka ma yi dus su yang / /mtshan ma'i dran pa de nyid la/ /bag mi tsha bar spyad par bya/ /des na sgyu ma'i bsre ba 'grub/ /de ltar sgyu mar yang dang yang / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bsams nas su/ /sgyu mar shes pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /ya mi nga dang bag mi tsha/ /dam dum kam kem 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar goms pa brtan par bya/ /de ltar brtan par gyur nas ni/ /'pho ba dag ni bya bar bshad/ /gnyid ma log kyipa'i dus su yang / /sems ni gang dgar gtang bar bya/ /'gro sar sems ni btang byas nas/ /log ka ma yi dus su yang / /de ring bag chags dran byas te / /de ltar rang gi rig pa yis/ /dpyad cing gang ltar bde bar 'pho/ /'pho ba brtan par gyur pa na/ /sgyu ma sbyangs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /sngon gyi bsam pa khrid par bya/ /de ltar snga ma ji bzhin bsgom/ /log kar yang dang 26—1733

—yang du sgom/ /de ltar rmi lam dus su yang / /dam dum bag re 'byung bar 'gyur / /de nas rmi lam spyong ba la/ /gang yang bzang ngan mi lta ste/ /rtags ma byung bar zin pa'ang yod/ /rang gi rig pas rtogs bya ba/ /ma rtogs pa na 'bad cing brtag /rtsol ba dag gis bskyed byas la/ /shes nga/ tshar ni gcad par bya/ /gong gi bstan pa'i gdams pa ltar/ /de ltar yang dang yang byas pas/ /mod du zin pa dag kyang yod/ /longs spyod la sogs rgyud sbyangs pas/ /lo yis zin pa dag kyang yod/ /ye ma zin pa dag kyang yod / /de ltar yang dang yang goms pas/ /rmi lam byin gyis rlob pa yin/ /de yis bar do zlobs par 'gyur/ /gong ma'i rmi lam goms pa yis 'chi ka'i shes pa gsal byas te/ /'chi ka'i rtags rnams tshang ba dang / /sngar goms pa la sems bzhag ste/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par bya/ /'chi khar gnyid ni log pa ni/ /dran pa dag na sngon btang nas/ /'od gsal ngang la gnas par bya/ /sa bon skye gnas rim khyab pa/ /gzhi dang khang pa nyid dang ni / /las dang spyor ba rang nus la/ /rang gi ngo bo thig ler bcas/ /bcu gnyis mtha' yi tshig gi don/ /gang gis rtag tu goms gyur nas/ /des ni dngos grub bde ba yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid 'gyur/ /snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim/ /rags pa thim dang phra ba thim/ /thim pa'i rjes la goms pa dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'byung / /de yi rjes la zung 'jug sku//slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis/ /mi slob pa ru gyur pa na/ /'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin/ /sngon byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /bar do de yi mig snga ru/ /thabs dang shes rab mthong ba la/ /26—1734

bla ma dag tu dmigs byas te/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni dran byas nas/ /mig ser zhe sdang kun spangs te/ /bde ba'am mi rtog pa bsgoms pa'am yang na sngar dus gang bsgoms pa'i/ /sbyangs pa sngon du dran par bya/ /dus su dran nga/ra gyur nas ni/ /dang po'i srid pa khegs par 'gyur/ /de nas bdun phrag bdun gyi bar/ /gong ma bzhin du goms byas na/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu 'das pa dang / /'khor ba'i srid pa khegs pa dang / /de ltar sgyu mar gnas pa la/ /'od gsal ba yis sbyang bya ste/ /'od gsal bar be+e 'jug par 'gyur/ /rtsigs kyi rgya bdun dang bcas pa'o// //bsdur mchan/173spyo 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉deng dpe bsdur byas yod/1733 1〈〈co 〉skoragrangs/ 2 〈〈co 〉〉logs/26—1735
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (116༷)26wa 1736

༄༅/ /bka' dpe phyi ma bzhugs so// 1sngal/ /bla ma chen po nā ro pas/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yis/ /sa ni g.yo zhing lung bstan thob / /shar phyogs ngogs kyi te lo pa'i/ /zhal sngar gdams pa mnos pa ni/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /de la dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ /lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang / /rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni/ /mi gtsang rdzas dang rnam rtog gis/ /lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin/ /de la sems kyi gnas thabs ni/ /lus gnas ye shes chen po ste/ /skye 'gag bral ba'i ngo bo yin/ /lam la bskyed rīdang rdzogs pa'o/ /de la gnad 1ni rnam gsum ste/ /lus dang dus dang yul dang gsum/ /de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa/ /chu shing bzhin du bsrang bar bya/ /re mig bzhin du bsdol bar bya/ /nor bu rin chen drang por rtsar/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i 26—1737

phyag rgya ni/ /lte ba'i 'og tu babyur bar bya/ /mgul pa bsrang la nor bu sba/ /'phel ka nam mkha' ltar yangs bya/ /yul gyi gnad ni gnyis yin te/ /phyi yi dkar dmar rnam pa can/ /nang du 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi/ /de la thabs/ lam bgrang mi lang / /de la dus kyi gnad bshad pa/ /g.yas g.yon 'pho dus zer ba yod/ /gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug dang / /tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi/ /de la dus bzhi'i nyams len ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes/ par bya/ /rlung gi gnad la bzhi yin te/ /rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang / /mda' ltar gyen du 'phangs pa ste/ /srog rtsol gyi 1ni spyor ba yis/ /lte ba'i a las me sbar te/ /'khor lo bzhi bsregs rtsa kha dbye/ /me lce haṃ 'a/ reg pa yis/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa rnams dgang / /a las babs shing thigs pa chad/ /bde stong dbyer med don la gzung / /sbyor ba bzhi ldan cha/ shes na/ /yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyen/ /'byung bzhi ro snyoms ma shes na//bsgoms kyang bogs ni mi 'byung ste/ /bcos thabs bgrang ni mi lang gis/ /gtum mo'i go cha gcigs su che/ /de las 'bras bu 'char ba ni/ /dang po dro ba lta bu 'byung / /gnyis pa du ba lta bu 'byung / /gsum pa srin bu me khyer dang / /bzhi pa mar me lta bu ste/ /lnga pa nam mkha' lta bur 'char/ /de nas bde ba 'char ba dang / /rnam par rtog pa shugs kyis 'gag /smig rgyu srin bu me khyer dang / /skya rengs shar ba lta bu 'byung / /'byung bzhi gcig la gcig thim nas/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni shugs kyis 'bar/ /shu kra nges par 'bab par nges/ /nang gi tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags/ /nam mkha' sprin dag lta bu rnams / /rim pas grangs kyis 'byung bar gsungs/ /seng ge dkar mo'i'o 26—/738

ma de/ /gser skyogs dngul skyogs ma yin pa/ /snod ngan phal du mi drugs 'tshal / /brgya la gal te blugs pa na/ /snod kyang chag la 'o ma 'bo /bla ma grub thob man ngag 'di/ /slob ma skal ldan ma gtogs pa/ /sgod ngan rnams la byin gyur na/ /dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /des na sbyangs pa'i las can gces/ /bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba gtum mo'i tshig sbram/brtson 'grus can tshe 'di la sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa'o// //sgyu lus lam du bya ba ni/ /snang ba 'di dang 'gro ba kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad de/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong / /phyi dang nang du rnam phye ba/ /thams cad sgyu ma las gzhan min/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus 'di shes par bya/ /kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ /khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /me long dri ma med pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor pas ni gang gang dmigs/ /de de sgyu ma bzhin du brtags/ /rnge long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang / /rmi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang / /mig 'phrul mtshungs par gang gis mthong / /smig rgyu rmi lam lta bu dang / /dri za'i grong khyer dag dang mtshungs/ /sgyu mar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin te/ /dmigs med kun rdzob dag tu ni / /sgyu ma lta bur rab tu bshad/ /dag pa lha yi sgyu lus dang / /rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus te/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya nyid dag la/ /mig la sogs pa la 'jug pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu nye bar brtags/ /26—1739

rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid du/ /mang du bshad pas ci zhig bya/ /bag chags das pas sangs rgya ba sgyu lus kyi tshig sbram// //rmi lam lam khyer gdams pa ni/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing / /rang bzhin dag pa de nyid la/ /'khrul pa log par rab tu gsungs/ /rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i/ /rmi lam dri ma med mthong na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur//'di la don lnga rgyas par bshad/ /don bzhis lam du slong ba'o/ /dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang / /sbyangs dang goms pa khrid pa rnams/ /sngar ni gong du rgyas par bstan/ /don bzhis nyams su blang ba ni/ /dang por rmi lam bzung ba dang / /de nas sbyang zhing sgyu mar bslab/ /de nas ya nga spang ba dang / /kho na nyid don bsgom pa'o/ /chos rnams rmi lam ltar shes nas/ /sems can don du rab tu 'jug /sgyu ma lta bur lam khyer bas/ /sgyu ma lta bur sangs kyang rgya/ /bag chags can rmi lam la brten nas sangs rgya ba'i tshig sbram// //'od gsal lam du bya ba ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pa/ /snang ba gsum gyi rgyu can te/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas nikhye/ /'od gsal bar ni zhugs par 'gyur/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /ji ltar dang ba'i chu klung las/ /nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar/ /de 26—1740

—bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung zhing 'gag /'od sasal 'di ni rnam lnga ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal dang / /shes rab 'od gsal 'char ba dang / /nying nge 'dzin gyi 'od gsal dang / /de bzhin nyid kyi 'od gsal dang / /rtogs pa'i 'od gsal bstan pa'o/ /de la dus ni lnga yin te/ /'chi ba'i dus dang dbu mar gnas/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni log pa'i tshe/ /mnyam rjes ro gcig gyur pa dang / /lhag mthong rtogs pa'i dus yin no/ /'od gsal mngon du gyur pa las/ /de las zung du 'jug nga/ra 'char/ /gnyid 'thug pos sangs rgya ba 'od gsal gyi tshig sbram// //'pho ba'i bye brag shin tu mang / /sbyangs te 'pho dang ting 'dzin dang / /srog dang rtsol bas 'pho ba dang / /lus kyi rtsol bas 'pho ba dang / /rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba dang / /btsan thabs dag tu 'pho ba dang / /spros med chos sku'i 'pho ba dang / /spros bcas gzugs sku'i 'pho ba dang / /longs spyod sdogs sku'i 'pho ba dang / /yid 'ong mkha' 'gro'i 'pho ba'o/ /de dag thams cad ro gcig par/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ /pus mo bskor zhing se gol gdab/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa zin pa'i tshad/ /snying gar zin nas gog mar bzung / /dbugs ni ngal bar gyur pa na/ /sna sgor cha mnyam ngal bso bya/ /rang 'dod dbu mar zin gyur na/ /bde ba'i 'khor lor drang bya ste/ /shes pa bde ba can du gtad/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nas 'pho bar bya/ /rims la sogs pas ma phog par/ /'pho ba'i sbyor ba mchog yin no/ /dus la babs na 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 26—174/

—'dam pa'i lus dag las/ /ye shes sku ni rang dgar 'byung / /ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba 'pho ba'i tshig sbram// //bar do lam du slong ba ni/ /dang po snang ba gsum gyis ni/ /thim pas 'od gsal ngos bzung ba/ /gnyis pa dag dang ma dag pas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas ni/ /bar ma dor ni sangs rgya thabs/ /gsum pa mngal sgo dgag nga/ dang / /bzhi pa mngal sgo bsdam pa'o/ /de la skye shi'i bar do ru/ /bsgoms te sangs rgya gtum mo dang / /sgyu ma'i sku la bslab par bya/ /de la goms par gyur pa dang / /rmi lam sgyu lus gnyis bsres la/ /rmi lam bar do sbyang bar bya/ /rmi lam sgyu lus 'byongs pa dang / /'chi ka'i dus kyi bar do ru/ /'od gsa' ba dang 'dres pa las/ /sgyu lus ril 'dzin rjes zhig gis/ /bag chags thams cad bsregs pa na/ /'od gsal me yis sbyangs nas ni/ /zung du 'jug pa'i sgur sangs rgya/ /rim gyis 'jug pa'i gang zag gis/ /shes pa skye lugs 'di lta ste/ /snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim/ /rags pa thim dang phra ba thim / /thim pa'i rjes su goms pa yis/ /rang bzhin kyis ni 'od gsal 'byung / /de yi rjes la zung 'jug 'char/ /sku ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste/ /slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis/ /mi slob pa ru gyur tsa na/ /'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin/ /gong du bstan pa de dag ni/ /rgyas par bshad na 'di lta ste//dang po lung rigs man ngag gis/ /rgyud la rtogs pa shar tsam na/ /snang ba 'gag lugs bstan pa ni/ /gzugs ni sgra la thim gyur zhing / /sgra yang dri la dri yang ro/ /reg bya'i bar du rim gyis thim/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /76—1742

de rnams rim gyis rnam shes la/ /rnam shes snang ba la thim che/ /phyi rtags zla shar lta bur blta/ /nang rtags du ba lta bu 'byung / /snang ba de nyid mched pa la / /thim tshe phyi rtags nyi shar 'dra/ /shes pa mar me lta bu 1'byung / /mched pa thob pa la thim pas/ /phyi rtags mun pa lta bu 'byung / /shes rab mar me lta bur 'char/ /thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas/ /phyi rtags tho rangs dus tshod kyi/ /skya rengs shar ba lta bu 'byung / /nang gi shes pa nam mkha' ni/ /sprin dag lta bur 'char ba'o/ /'od gsal de las ldang ba yi/ /zung 'jug ngos ni gzung bya ste/ /mngon par byang chub 'od gsal mes/ /bag chags thams cad sbyong dus su/ /slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /sbyang gzhi spyong byed rnged tsam na/ /goms pa mthar phyin gyur pa ste/ /mi slob zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /'bras bu thob par gyur pa yin/ /de las srid pa'i bar ma do/ /sgyu lus zung 'jug skur gyur te/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgu thob bo/ /de la goms pas mngal sgo khegs/ /gal te zung 'jug ma shes na/ /srid pa'i skye ba mi khegs pas/ /chags sdang snang ba kun spangs la/ /dran pa'i spyan mas mtshams sbyar te/ /mngal bdam pa yi spyor ba bya/ /mngon dga'i 'pho ba byas pa yis / /gar 'dod gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /'chi ba stong pa chos sku la/ /bar ma do ni longs spyod rdzogs/ /srid par skye ba sprul pa yi/ /skye ba'i cha ni thabs yin la/ /'gag pa shes rab srid mthar byed/ /srid pa bar dor sangs rgya ba bar do rnam pa gsum gyi lam dang bsre ba bar do'i tshig sbram// //grong du 'jug pa'i 'pho ba ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i 'pho ba las/ /bye 26—/743

brag gsal bar bstan pa ste/ /dang por sngon 'gro sbyangs pa dang / /dngos/ gzhi dmigs pa gsal ba yin/ /las la sbyar ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du thod pa ni/ /mtshan ldan cig la hūṃ bris te/ /de la shes pa gtad pa dang / /gsal zhing dang la yang ba yi/ /rig pa bde ba skye bar 'gyur/ /rlung dang rnam par shes pa yang / /phyi rol lha dang rang nyid bsre/ /dang po khru gang bar khru gsum/ /tha mar khru bdun pa yi ni/ /dmigs pa rno la ngar ldan pas/ /steng 'og spo bar nus pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub par gsungs/ /sems can rma med dag la yang / /rlung sems rtsal ni sbyang bar bya /de nas lus kyi rten brje bas/ /las la sbyar ba'i dus tshod du/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i grogs mchog gces/ /lus brjes sems can don bya'o/ /grong 'jug gi tshig sbram bstan pa lji// //thabs lam byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ /gling bzhi bsdus la rgya mtsho brag la gtad/ /dar chen phyar la chu mig gyen du bzlog /'og rlung drangs la snying gar phyin par bya/ /stag mo khye mo wa bzhad skad/ /steng 'og rlung ni bsdams par bshad/ /de ni bzung ba'i man ngag go/ /rtsa mig gang ba'i man ngag ni/ /chu snod g.yas g.yon gsum gcu ste/ /yi ge'i rgyug tshul lan gsum bya/ /lus la khyab par bya ba ni/ /dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng dag tu / /sgog ma lan gsum gcu zhing gzhag /g.yas pa la yang de ltar bya/ /seng ge rnam rol phyag rgya yis/ /lus kun la ni khyab par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po'i man ngag go/ /srog rtsol gnas su bsdams bya ste/ /rtsa rlung thig le 26—1744

mtshan ldan dang / /'od gsal rjes su gnang ba sgom/ /srog rtsol dag la dbang thob na/ /rlung ni g.yas g.yon spo nus dang / /kha dog bye brag tshor ba med / /bsdams gnod med cing phyi nang bsre/ /tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags byung na/ /rlung lnga 'od gsal thim pa na/ /dgos dgu thams cad 'byung ba dang / /dngos grub thob par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams blangs na/ /dam tshig de yis skong bar gsungs / /rmi lam mngon sum gang la yang / /cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba la / /sgyu mar shes na lam du 'gyur/ /bden par bzung na bar chod yin / /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa na/ /bar chad lam gyi grogs su 'char / /gsang sngags thabs kyi lam mchog gi/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bcud bsdus pa/ /snying po 'di ni bla na med/ /skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul lo/ /'di ni thabs lam bka' dpe kun la ma gnang ba yin no/ /bka' rgya lan gsum du yod do// //26—1745

༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ pañtsa kra ma saṃ gra ha pra bha wa/ bod skad du/rim pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che/ /rim pa lnga la gnas pa po/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te/ /sems dang lus kyi gnas thabs las/ /rags dang phra dang shin tu phra/ /thun mong dbyer med rim zhes bya/ /gnyid dang rmi lam stoms 'jug pa/ /tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid kyis/ /rtsa 7dang thig le sems shes pa/ /lus dang dus dang yul gyi ni/ /gnad ni bzhi ru shes par bya/ /dran pa sna tshogs rnam rtog rnams/ /sems las yang dag 'byung bas na/ /rnam shes srog ni 'du ba'i rten/ /snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom/ /gzhi 4lam 'bras bu rab shes pas/ /lus 26—1747

—dben sngags dang sems gsum gyi/ /sgyu ma mngon par byang chub pa/ /zung 'jug rim pa shes par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi 1yi ge'i 'khor lo ni/ /dang por chu skyes 'dab brgyad pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /rim pa ldan par bsam gtan bya/ /phyi rim shes rab dbyangs yig mtshan/ /bar ma gsal byed thabs bcas pa/ /gnyis su med par nang mar gnas/ /phyosas/ mtshams rim par ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum rang bzhin/ /dbus su mig gi thig le ste/ /a dang bcas pa srog gyur gang / /kun gyi snying po spro zhing sdud/ /'byung ba bzhi yi rlung rnams nyid/ /rlung dang sngags su rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje bzlas pa sbyang bar bya/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa nyi shu bshad / /tha mal rnam rtog bag chags rnams/ /sngags nyid sems su dmigs pas so/ /lus dag pas ni rtog pa dag /rlung dag pas ni dri med 'gyur / /rlung dag pas ni ye shes kyi/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma mngon du byed/ /de nyid mngon par byang chub pas/ /zung 'jug ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /las rnams bya ba phrin las tshogs/ /rnam shes ye shes spyor bas 'grub/ /rtags rnams rim par 'char ba'i dngos/ /ye shes lnga yi rgyu mthun nyams/ /gsal snang 'bar ba'i ngang du'o/ /yan lag rlung las mngon shes 'thob4 / /rtog pa'i tshogs ni mar 'grib cing / /gnyen po ye shes yal 'phel du/ /ye shes rim pa rang las rnyed/ /gcig dang du mar dmigs mi phyed/ /dang po smig rgyu lta bu'i nyams/ /'od zer lnga dang bcas pa 'char/ /gnyis pazlab lta bu dang / /gsum pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'khrigs5/ /mtshams snang lasani thob pa ste/ /mtshams bral dus kyi ye shes che/ /mngon par byang chub tshul 26—1748

—gnas pas/ /dri med ye shes mngon par rdzogs/ /rtags dang rtags can 'char tshul ni/ /ye shes 'bar dang rdzogs pa'i dus/ /rlung sems tsam las 'byung ba yi1/ /sgyu ma'i lus ni snang bar bcas/ /'od gsal rgyun gyi bsam gtan gyis/ /las dang sgrib pa bag chags sbyangs/ /sa lam rtags kyi rim pa'i tshogs/ /'di nyid thob pas 2myur du 'char/ /nam mkha'i ༄ dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /'dab ma brgyad pa'i sa bon la/ /dbus su srog gi 4sa bon te/ /yi ge ka nas ha yig bar/ /k+ṣa ni spangs pa'i gzhi 5bcas pa/ /dbyangs ni phyi rim snang ba ste/ /gsal byed bar ma mched pa nyid/ /ma ning snang ba thob par brjod/ /bcu gnyis yi ge 5thig ler bcas/ /phreng ba lta bur gnas pa ni/ /rim pa lnga ldan bsam par bya/ /'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /e waṃ thabs dang shes rab las/ /sdud cing spro bar mdzad pa yi/ /a zhes dbus su gnas par mdzad/ /mnyam pa nyid du sems bsdam ste/ /mnyam gzhag 7'khor lo'i lte ba yis/ /ye shes mnyam par mthong gyur pa8/ /nye bar thob pa stong pa che/ /'od gsal ba yi gnas thob pa/ /'khor ba las ni brgal bar 'gyur/ /thun gcig yang ni nyin gcig gam/ /zla phyed zla ba lo yi dus/ /bskal pa'am bskal pa stong du yang / /skad cig re rer gnas pa ni/ /ye shes sbyor ba rtag tu 'byung / /rim pa gnyis pa la gnyis pa/ /mnyam par zung 'brel nyid bsgom pa/ /bskyed pa'i rim 'di lha yi sku/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /rnam pa mngon du byed pa gang / /legs par bslabs pas mthar phyin 'gyur/ /lus dngen snang ba sems dang lus/ /rgyu 26—1749

—dang mi rgyu 'jig rten bcas/ /rim pas lha yi bdag nyid sbyor/ /rdo rje 'chang chen lam du byed/ /mos pa las byung ting nge 'dzin/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'o/ /rlung gi 'byung 'jug gnas pa gsum/ /sku gsung thugs/ kyi rdo rje las/ /rlung sngags mnyam par rab sbyor gang / /rdo rje bzlas pa'i rim pa'o/ /gsang sngags las byung rnam par shes/ /snang ba gsum gyi bdas nyid ni/ /ye shes 'jug ldog nges pa gang / /sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa'o//rmi lam lus ni rnam sbyangs phyir/ /sgyu mar mtshon pa'i dus gang las/ /yul snang kun rdzob gang byung ba/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rim pa'o/ /rang 1bzhin shes pa bsam gtan las/ /thabs las ma bskyed ting nge 'dzin/ /rang gsal ngo bo mi rtog pa/ /'od gsal don dam rim pa'o/ /bsam gtan mes sbyangs lha yi sku/ /rang byung ye shes dag pa'i lus/ / sbyang gzhi sbyong rnyibyed bral bar gnas / /zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o/ /byang chub sems ldan bla ma dang / /lhag pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor dang / /shin tu rnal 'byor rnal 'byor che/ /rjes su rnal 'byor bcas pa dag /ting 'dzin rim pa ldan pa yis/ /bsnyen nga/ nyer sgrub sgrub 4pa che/ /sgrub pa'i ngo bo khyad par du/ /so sor sdud 5dang bsam gtan dang / /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /yan lag drug ldan khyad par ro/ /rim pa bzhi ldan phyag rgyar bcas/ /dbang bzhi sku bzhi rang 'byung bas/ /mngon par byang chub tshul lnga las/ /bskyed dang bskyed cing gnas pa dang / /lam gyur rim pa lnga ldan pas6/ /byang chub phyogs chos mdo don dang / /spras dz+wapa rnam gsum mthar thug bcas/ /sna tshogs sgra ni mtshon pa'o/ /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor 26—1750

rlung gis te/ /bde chen sems la dmigs pa'o/ /rmi lam sgyu ma gcig tu sbya/ngas / /bar do rnam gsum bsre ba nyid/ /nyon mongs ye shes lam du 'gyur / /lam myur gcod par 1'pho ba ste/ /grong du 'jug pa yan lag go//'od gsal gnas thob mngon nasangs rgyas/ /brtson 'grus can ni tshe 'di nyid/ /le lo can ni 'chi kha ste/ /tha ma srid pa'i bar ma dor/ /mchog thob skus ni gzhan don byed/ /ngo bo rgyu tshul 'byung ba khams/ /las dang ngo bo dbye ba de nyid rlung / /'byung 'jug gnas pa rnam par brtags/ /'bru gsum sngags kyi ngo bo nyid/ /ā li kā li sbyor dbus las/ /brtags pa grangs ldan bzlas pa nyid/ /spyor dang khyad par thabs ldan pas / /ngag dbe+en rlung gi rnal 'byor bstan/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu spyor ba gang / /snang ba gsum gyi 'char tshul te/ /dus dang 'byung 'gyur thabs khyad par/ /dbyer med ye shes gnas thob pa/ /spyod pa ye shes mngon du byed/ /slob dang mi slob der spyod pa'o/ /rang bzhin shes pa'i lam gyur pa/ /rnam shes sgyu mar mtshon pa'i chos/ /khyad par las dang spyod pa gang / /dngos grub thob phyir bdag byen rlabs4/ /phyi nang mngon par byang chub tshul/ /rnal 'byor thob pas bsam gtan gnas/ /'byung dang 'jug pa ma brtags 5par/ /spyod tshul ye shes de thob po/ /lta dang nyams myong lus dang ngag /bsam gtan mnyam rjes spyod pa dang / /slob dang mi slob gnyis med cing / /rab tu mi gnas zung du 'jug /yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don/ /sbas dang mthar thug 9nyid yin te / /theg pa sna tshogs pha rol phyin/ /srid par skye dang gnas la sogs/ /dus kyi dbye ba'i khyad par gyi/ /stan gabyug steng du bsgom par bya/ /'di nyid yang 26—1751

dag rtogs pa 'dir/ /lam mchog rim pa lnga po nyid/ /pha rol phyin dang jeg sna tshogs/ /srid pa skye dang nyin zhag gcig /stan gcig snasteng du sbyar te bshad / /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas te/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dam pa ste/ /sku lnga rab rdzogs gyur pa'o/ /rim pa lnga'i don bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba dpal ldan nā 3snaro pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i zhal las rtogs par bya ba rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā 1ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa / 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ //bsdur mchan/1747 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉rem pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〉 ro pas mdzad pa'i rim pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi 'gyur/2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabangs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〉/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/1748 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nyid du/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ste sa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thob 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi 'khrig1749 she7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉jang ba yis/ —sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'i/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zokha'/ bye〈〈pe〉sko〈snar〉〉gis / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gos/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhag 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'gyur ba/175༷ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngar/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sted/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉sbyang gzhi sbyongs/ 〈〈snar 〉〉sbyangs gzhi sbyongs/zi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/ thu〈〈snar 〉thasdud/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngalas/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'i sa/1751 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyur gcod pa/ 2〈〈snar 〉〉pon/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngalas/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar〉tharlabs 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thartag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thugs/26—1752
1752 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cig /stan cig cige〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉na/ 37〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1162)26wa 1753

1236༄/ /go bar byed pa sgong po brgya pa/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ /pra ti pasti sā ra sha ta shaṃ/ bod skad du/go bar byed pa snying po brgya pa/ dpal rdo rje te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig shin tu phul byung chos kun mnyam nyid rang bzhin yang / /rdo rje rnam par sgeg mo rnams kyis dgyes par gyur pa rgyal/ /sprul pa'i gzugs ni rnam pa mang mdzad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dpal/ /te ru ka dpal mnyam med de yi zhabs la brten 2par bgyi/ /gang gis dmigs pa rnams kyis khengs pas rlom pa lta'i/ /mang po'i rtog 'di 'bras bu las ni spangs gyur kyang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i dga' bar yongs bsgyur ched du ji lta'i don/ /go bar byed pa'i snying po ston pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun du rtog med ma 'dres pa / /byeb med cing thogs pa med/ /dor dang bsags pa spangs pa yi/ /sems ni kye yi rdo rje nyid/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gzugs rnams su/ /sna tshogs mos pa 26—1754

—rnam rtog pa/ /rang gis tshorang bzhin rtogs pa yis/ /rang gi ngo bo mos med nyid / /'di ni rang bzhin dkyil 'khor te/ /rnam pa ma lus 'od gsal ba//dag pa ye shes lnga rang bzhin/ /bla med dba' rlabs med pa'o/ /spros pa pred pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'di ltar lha yi gzugs su ste/ /ma lus dga' ba yang dag rdzogs/ /nyon mongs ma lus 'jig byed pa/ /gzugs la sogs 'di de bzhin nyid/ /ji lta'i rnam par rnam gnas pa/ /gzung bya min par rab rtogs bya/ /rtogs pa de 'di mtshan nyid bral/ /chos rnams kun gyi snying bo ni—/ /stong nyid gcig pu de min pas/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid yang dag rig /rnam pa kun du mtshan nyid bral/ /rtsa rnams thams cad mkha' 'gro ma/ /phung po lnga yang dkyil 'khor dang / /dngos po thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /bsam sked rdo rje can gyi thugs/ /thams cad du yang sku rnams dang / /de bzhin rigs rnams kun kyang de/ /phyag rgya mtshan ma la sogs sasnarnams/ /de ni de lta de ltar rol/ /thams cad du ni snyoms 'jug de/ /bde ba chen po'i dga' ston ro/ /rdo rje can gzugs phun tshogs pa/ /mtha' yas 'di tsam nyid kyi ci/ /phung po rnams de khams rnams de/ /skye mched rnams kyang de rnams nyid/ /thams cad ro gcig snyoms 'jug pa/ /rdo rje can gyi rnam 'phrul lo/ /rdo rje can 'di de rnams dang / /de dag rnams kyang rdor can las / /tha dad ma yin zung 'jug 'di/ /gsal zhing rnyog med rten med pa'o / /gang du sems la rnam pa mtha' dag snang zhing gsal bar 'phro ba mnyam pa nyid gyur dang / /sems dang sems las byung ba'i dbye ba rnam par nyams shing thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyur pa/ /der ni mchog gi bde ba chen 26—1755

po'i ro yis dbang bskur ba las bdag nyid rab dang zhing / /dkyil 'khor dang ni dkyil 'khor pa yi mdzes pa chen po ci yang 'phro ba nyid du mthong / /rnam dag rtog pa'i rdul gyis mnyes pa las/ /kun nas dang zhing shin tu 'od gsal ba/ /mtha' yas pa yi gzugs dang gzugs brnyan tshogs/ /sems kyi me long de la ci yang mdzes/ /ji ltar sin+tu ra yi rdul gyis gos pa yi7 / /me long la ni gzugs brnyan tshogs snang mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin rtog pa'i khyad par gyis ni sun phyung ba'i/ /yid 'di la ni rab tu gsal ba ring ba nyid/ /rang gzhan nyid du mngon par zhen pas rgyug par ni/ /kun du byas nas yid ni phyi rol yang dag 'phel/ /nang dang phyi rol du yang mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ /rang gis byas pas dub pa'i 2'gro ba kye ma'o mtshar/ /gnyis kyi rnam pa bral bas mdzes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i spyod pa dga' ba'i ro yi char / /rnams kyi sgeg pa chen pos mtha' dag brten gyur kyang / /de lta nyid kyis dga' zhing 'ching bar mi 'gyur mtshar/ /gnyis kyi rnam pa dor thing rab tu gsal/ /mkhas pas yang dag reg bya skal bzang la/ /stug po'i dga' bas khyab pa stobs chen ro yis yongs gang nam mkha'i mthil du ni/ /rnam pa sna tshogs 'phro ba nye bar bsags pa mtha' dag nang du son gyur pa'i/ /yid la 'jig rten gsum po snang ba 'di de thim pa lta bur gnas pa'o/ /rang gi bdag po nyid kyis gang gyur pa/ /de 'di rang byen rlabs sngupa'i rim pa ste/ /gnyis nyid dag las nges pa rnam grol ba/ /rang gi sgra yis mngon par brjodang/ yin / /sngags dang yang dag dbab pa dang / /sgeg dang bzhad pa sogs rim med/ /sngags min yid la byed pa dang / /'du byed skye ba 'byung ba med//26—/736

gang du dngos rnams rang bzhin ni/ /rang bzhin nyid kyi rinyekhong du chud/ /log pa'i rang bzhin zad pa yis/ /dga' ba rang byung 'di 'char byed/ /bde sdug ces bya gnyis dbye ba'i/ /dbye ba sbyin byed rnam rtog ste/ /rnam par mi rtog mi dmigs pa'i/ /dmigs med bde ba chen po'o/ /snang ba med cing gsal ba med/ /'jug pa med cing bsam pa med/ /'go ba'i rnam pa'i tshogs rnams ni/ /yang dag bsags pa shel lta bu/ /'gro ba rmi lam sgyu ma dang / /smig rgyu sogs mtshungs nges par blta2/ /gzung ba thams cad yongs dor las/ /dpyad du med pa lhan gyis grub/ /dngos dang dngos po med nyid kyis/ /stong par mthong ba kun rdzob rgyu'o/ /kun rdzob 'di ni don dam ste/ /srid pa shes pas mya ngan 'das/ /mtha' gsum las ni rnam grol ba'i—/ /rtog pa'i ngo bo gzhi 4med pa/ /dor dang bsags pa spangs pa dang / /zhi ba bla na med pa'o/ /dngos po kun la dbang phyug ni/ /dngos po kun la dbang phyug min/ /dngos kun rang bzhin nyid las ni/ /dngos po kun la rtag tu gnas/ /gnas la sogs pa gsum dbye bas/ /rnam pa gcig nyid gyur pa dang / /chags pa med las rnam 'gyur dang / /bral bas blo ni legs par gnas/ /ji ltar mar me kun du snang / /rnam pa thams cad la 'dra ba/ /'dir ni gcig dang sna tshogs pa'i/ /don gyi blo ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin sems nyid kyis ni sems/ /de yi gzugs brnyan bdag nyid kyi/ /gcig dang sna tshogs rtog 5pa'i blo/ /rnam pa snang ba'ang de dang 'dra/ /rnam pa de yang rnam pa med/ /rnam pa nyid kyis ma gzung bas/ /rang gi rnam rtog dor las gzhan/ /yod min rnam pa med pa'ang mtshon/ /rnam pa bcas dang rnam 26—1757

med ces/ /'di ni rnam rtog 'phel ba ste/ /snam bu med na 'o na ni/ /dkar sogs yon tan gang du gnas/ /rnam bcas ma yin rnam med yin/ /blo ldan sna tshogs nyid spangs pa/ /ji lta de bzhin nyid du gyur/ /de yang ci r+shag rtogs par byed/ /kye ma ji ltar rnam rtog pa/ /de ltar 'di dag 'ching bar 'gyur/ /rang gi sems kyi kun du rtog /spangs pa tsam ni thar zhes bya/ /kasko lar ni ga bur zhu ba dri med bzang po'i ro dang 'dra min zhing / /bo la yi ni rtse dga'i longs spyod rab tu gsal ba'i skal ba bzangs te 'dra yang min/ /ci yang gsal 2bya min pa 'di ni mtha' dag kun du rtog pa'i tshogs zad pa/ /dmigs pa med pa'i dga' ba chen po yis ni nam mkha' rab tu gang bar 'gyur//rnam par mi rtog bde ba che/ /'dod pa'i mtshan nyid bdag nyid kyi/ /dga' 'di bde ba'i khyem gyis ni/ /sgo yi them skas lta bu yin/ /e ma'o bde ba e ma'o bde chen nyid/ /e ma ji lta ji ltar longs spyod bgyi'o/ /zhes byar 'dod pa rtsol ba'i sems kyi ni/ /dga' de don 4du 'gro ba lta bu yin/ /dngos po rnams la ngo bo nyid brtags pa/ /stong pa nyid kyis rnam par 'joms par byed/ /rang bzhin med pa nyid du spyor ba las/ /mchog tu dga' ba yi ni rang bzhin can/ /e ma'o ye shes e ye shes/ /ye shes gsal ba 'di ngo mtshar / /zhes byar longs spyod rtsol ba'i sems/ /mchog tu dga' ba tsam nyid do/ /gang du dngos dang dngos po gred pa 'ba' zhig nyid dang rnam bral rang nyid mdzes pa ste/ /stug por gyur pa'i dga' ba'i 5rang bzhin rab tu rtog pa chen po nam mkha'i gnas khyab cing / /rgya che'i rnam pa sna tshogs can dang dri med nyid kyis me long dkyil 'khor 'phro 'dra ba/ /bde ba kun gyi 26—/758

gnas gyur lhan cig byes pa'i dga' ba de ni bzhi pa yin par brjod/ /e ma'o bde chen rol pa yis 1/ /srid pa gsum po gang ba na/ /gang gis rang gzhan dbye ba 'di/ /skad cig gis ni dbyer med 'gro/ /rang gzhan tshul du mngon gsal bar/ /srid pa'i bar du bsgrags pa ni/ /kye ho bde chen char bab pas/ /rgyas pa'i 'gro ba dbyer med nyid/ /dngos rnams yod dang med nyid na/ /slar yang dbye bas kun du gnas/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i//stong nyid phyir na bde ba che/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dbye ba 'di/ /lus can thams cad rnams kyi ste/ /dbyer med 'di dag ye shes kyi/ /snang ba rnal 'byor can rnams kyi'o/ /shes rab ma la rlung gis bsgul bas gtum mo 'bar ba rab tu gsal zhing rgya che ba/ /sgrib pa nyid kyi dri ma dang bral dngos po tshogs pa rnam par gcod pas 'phel ba byed/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs pa na ni bdud rtsi de ni dmigs pa med/ /yang dag rig byed nam mkha' khyab pa dang yang dngos po mtha' dag mnyam nyid yang dag rdzogs/ /rang bzhin gyi 2ni rtsa rnams ni/ /de kho na las lha rnams min/ /'di rnams kyi ni shin tu dag /rang bzhin med 'di rang ngo bo/ /shes rab thabs dag gcig nyid gang / /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /a wa dhū 1tī rnam gsal bdag /de ni dbu ma'i rtog par 'dod/ /thog ma dbus mtha' yang dag 4phung po skye mched khams rnams ni/ /dag pa'i shel ltar rab gsal ba/ /de ni a wa dhū 5tī nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad mngon sum du/ /rnam pa mnyam pa mtshan nyid bral/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed kun spangs pa/ /gcig pu a wa dhū 6tī nyid/ / rab tu dga' ba yang dag rtogs shing dag 26—/759

—pa'i dpa' bo nam mkha' che/ /rnam kun nye bar bsags pa mtha' dag rdzogs par rtogs bya longs spyod rdzogs/ /dngos po'i tshogs rnams ro mnyam nyid kyis rmi lam sprul pa lta bu ste/ /sgrib pa zhi ba'i ye shes yul de rnam dag a wa dhū snetī'o//chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /bde ba chen po zhes bya'i rim/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'khor lo bzhi po mnyam pa nyid/ /grangs kyang rtogs 2pa'i rang bzhin te/ /bgrang grubyar byas pa min pa las/ /gnyis nyid dang ni bral ba'i bdag /mnyam nyid nam mkha' 'dra ba'o/ /mkha' dang nye bar len pa yi/ /dbye bas rnam par 'gyur ba'ang med/ /sna tshogs rtswa dang shing bsregs na/ /nags su dbye ba'i mtshan nyid ci/ /rang bzhin de nyid las dbyer med/ /kun sdob tu ni dbye ba lta/ /gang du kun rdzob nyid rnged pa/ /der ni don dam nyid kyi ci/ /dngos rnams rang bzhin nyid kyis ni//rang bzhin rnged pa blo gcig pu/ /mo gsham bu la sogs rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin rnam par dpyod pa med/ /gzhan yang gang 'dir bshad par bya ste phra mo'i rang bzhin ni/ /nges par de kho na nyid ma yin 'dir ni bshad pa tsam/ /mchog gi bde ba ro gcig dang ba yi ni rgyun snang ba/ /gsal bar nyams su myong ba'i snying po de nyid dmigs pas stong / /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin kyis / /dngos rnams rtog pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rang bzhin med nyid gang 'di ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /rang gi 'dod pas bcug pa las / /bag chags stobs kyis g.yos gyur pas/ /rnam par rtog pa skyes gyur pa/ /phyi rol don 'bras nyid lta bu'o/ /kye ho rnam bkra'i yul 4nyid la/ /rnam rtog rjes su song gyur pa/ /ka dam pa yi ro sgra ltar/ /rnam pa du ma 26—1760

—dod dod—dus gcig la'o/ /gcig gi dngos po nyid la yang / /rnam pa sna tshogs don du rtog /de dang de yi bdag nyid med/ /'dod pas nye bar brtags tsam nyid/ /dngos po med kyang 'khrul pa yi/ /sems kyi 'dod pa'ang skyes gyur pa/ /snga ma snga ma yid byed pa'i/ /'du byed kyi ni 'bras bu'i bdag /rang gis tshosnarang bzhin ma rtogs pas/ /sems ni phyi rol rgyug gyur pa/ /byes pas reg bya ngan pa la/ /reg pas rang nyid sdug bsngal bzhin/ /sems de rtog pa'i rnam pa ste/ /phyi rol don du'ang brtags pa nyid/ /rtog pa 'di dag spangs pa na/ /gcig pu nam mkha'i bdag nyid do/ /mi shes pas ni dngos rnams kyi/ /rang bzhin rang bzhin bcas pa nyid/ /dngos po rnams ni yongs shes pas/ /rang bzhin rang bzhin med pa'o/ /rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams la/ /rang dbang gis ni thams cad byed/ /de yi bya ba zhig pa dang / /byed pa po yang de bzhin no/ /bya ba dang ni byed pa yi/ /'byel pa rtog pa'i dbang gis te/ /rang bzhin khong du chud pa las/ /bya gred byed pa po yang med/ /bya ba cung zad yod min zhing / /byed pa po yang de bzhin no/ /brda tsam thob pa 'di dag ni/ /byed do zhes bya byed po med/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med nyid na/ /blang dang dor bya nyid ga la/ /rmi lam nang gi chos kun la/ /blang dor bya ba ji bzhin no/ /pha rol phyin pa thams cad rnams/ /de la 3kun nas bsten bya ste/ /pha rol phyin kun ye shes ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin min nam/ /de nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i sems/ /lhag ma med cing gos pa med/ /dbang po med cing gzhi med la/ /spyod pa med cing 'khrugs pa med/ /pha rol phyin pa lnga 'di rnams/ /dga' ba ro gcig 26—1761

bdag nyid can/ /dga' ba yongs su shes pa ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin nga/ mchog /'di rnams 'bras bu dga' ba ste/ /'di rtogs rang bzhin sked pa nyid/ /gnyis po shin tu dbyer med pa'i/ /dga' ba nyid ni bde ba che/ /shes rab snying rje gcig pa nyid/ /sgron ma dang ni snang ba bzhin/ /shes rab snying rje'i dbye ba yang / /sgron ma snang ba ji bzhin no/ /gnyis po 'di ni dbyer rnged bdag /sems gcig pu ni snango bo nyid/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid des/ /sems ni kye yi rdo rje'i gzugs/ /dga' ba yang ni rang bzhin rnged/ /de rtogs pa yang de dang 'dra/ /'di ltar kye'i rdor rang bzhin gyis / /ma lus rnam par dbyer med pa'o/ /rnam rtog rnal 'byor ma rnams te / /srid pa gsum po dkyil 'khor ro/ /bde ba chen po'i dga' ston gyis / /der ni kye yi rdo rje rol/ /bza' dang nyal dang rtse ba dang / /dgod bzhin du yang de dang de/ /rnal 'byor spyor las rnal 'byor pa/ /kye yi rdo rje'i 2mchod pa po'o/ /thams cad dus su dngos kun la/ /rnal 'byor pa yis dogs med spyad/ /'khor ba'i 'dam gyi nang du yang / /gos pa med pa mya ngan 'da'/ /ji ltar sgyu ma shes pas sgyu ma brgya phrag ston pa na/ /skyo dang rab tu dga' ba mnyam pa nyid kyis ci dgar spyod/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor kho na rjes rtogs rang bzhin can/ /'jigs pa brgyad 4dang bde ba 'char la'ang 'jigs dang chags pa med/ /'dir ni so sor bsgom bya med/ /sgom pa po ni su yang med/ /gnyis po med phyir sgom 5/pa'ang rnged/ /mnyam nyid 'ba' zhig rtogs pa'o/ /gnyis kyi rnam pa yongs dor bas/ /dbye ba dbyer med rnam par bral/ /yod nyid tsam du yongs shes pas/ /bsgom pa 26—/762

—yang ni skyon med pa'o/ /sngags bzlas la sogs 'di rnams kyang / /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can/ /'gro kun lhan cig skyes ngo bo/ /'di las de yang bkag pa med/ /lus dang ngag dang yid ces 3pa/ /gsum gyi bdag nyid yi ge hūṃ/ /dogs med te ru ka lta bur/ /kun rtog kun du rmongs pa sel/ /rtog pa'i sgrib pa kun spangs nas/ /ma brtags par ni gang mthong ba'i /gsang ba de nyid sngags de rnams/ /dngos grub thams cad sbyin byed pa'o/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bu la'ang / /2de bzhin zhi la sogs pa yi/ /spyor la sngags kyis bde bar byed/ /dngos po'i nus pa'i rang bzhin 'di/ /kun sgob tu yang mthong ba yin/ /kun rdzob rnam par spangs na ni/ /don dam zhes bya ba nyid ci/ /shing la sogs las byung nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dor mi bya/ /de yi rang bzhin rtogs pa des/ /phyag byas pa la skyon yod min/ /sa sogs las byung sku gzugs la sogs la/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag pos phyag mi bya/ /lhan cig skyes pa rtogs par gyur pa nyid/ /bla na med pa'i phyag ni de yin no/ /de bzhin du yang gtor ma'i rim pa 'di/ /rmi lam dang ni sprul pa lta bu ste/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin nyid du ni/ /de yi 'khor gsum po rnams mnyam pa nyid/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin dbyer med par/ /khams gsum po ni gcig tu yang dag rig /rnal 'byor rnams kyi rgyun mi 'chad pa yi/ /dga' ba 'di de gtor ma chen po'o/ /ji srid du ni byang chub bar gyi tshogs/ /de srid der ni dri ma rnams med pa/ /bla na med pa'i 'bras bu thob pa las/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa rnam par dag /rab gnas sbyin sreg mchod pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad kyang ni dri ma 26—/763

—med / /shes rab thabs dag yang dag spyor ba las/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par byas pa yin/ /de bzhin mtha' dag sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /rab tu gnas pa bla na med pa'ang de/ /gang du rnam dbyer med pa'i rnam pa ni/ /yang dag rig la rdo rje sems dpa' gnas/ /rol pa'i tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa'i / /bde ba'i tshogs rnams ci tsam pa/ /de tsam nyams su myong ba nyid/ /rnal 'byor tshogs ni rdzogs byed pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sbyor ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rnam par sgeg pa'i sbrang rtsi'i tshogs rnams dang / / ge sar mdzes pa 'bar ba'i pad+ma yis/ /rdo rje'i dbang phyug la ni mchod par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa lngar btags pa/ /za ba dam tshig chen po yin/ /de ni rnam dag dag pa'i bdag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub byed pa'o/ /rnam par rtog pa spangs pa yis/ /lhag par mos pa mi 'byung ba/ /gsal bar snang ba 'di de ni/ /rang rig dzobade ba chen po'o/ /'ga' zhig bdud rtsi zhes bya ba'i/ /gtam nyid kyis ni tshim mod kyang / /rang gi mngon sum nyams myong ni/ /rol —brtson pa yi rnam smin no/ /su zhig gzugs kyi tshogs bsdus pa/ /dmigs dang bcas la chags med dang / /dmigs pa med par rtse gcig pa'i/ /mchog de rnams ni dkon pa nyid/ /kha cig stong pa nyid dang ni/ /la la sbyor ba'i rim par rmongs/ /su zhig bde ba cher spro ba'i/ /rang bzhin can 'dir rnal 'byor pa'o / /rigo bar byed pa'i snying po phyerab tu dang bas gsal byas las6/ /bsod nams phung po dri ma med pa bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten rnam par rtog pa'i dra ba yongs bsal )nas//rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs mchog snying po go bar byed gyur cig /dpe la 26—/76/

—k+shin tu rmongs pa ro gcig gyur pa'i yid can rnams kyi dper bya rab gsal ba/ /sasal bar rig pa bla ma'i bla mar gyur la gal te shes rab rang bzhin can yin yang / /gzhan las rtogs pa'i 'bras min rdo rje can gyi bka' lung thob pa rgyud dang rjes mthun pa/ /de rig pa las go byed snying po brgya pa dpal ldan 'phags pa lha yis brjod pa yin/ /dngos po'i yid kyi rol pa mang po'i tshogs kyis phal cher rtse ba'i ro yis ni/ /bsnyems pa'i rtsom pas rnam par bsgyings pa'am gus las 'jug pa ci yang rung ba spros1/ /rnam pa thams cad don ni ji lta'i nyams kyi kun du rtog pas gzung —ba las/ /bdag la sngon med pa zhes smra bar bya ba'am ji ltar dad pa de bzhin gyis/ /go bar byed pa snying po brgya pa zhes bya ba/slob dpon chen po ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //'di ni shar phyogs sabe+e —/ga ra'i gnas brtan theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa la dngos grub kyis brgyan pa dpal nags kyi rin po che'i zhal snga nas man ngag gi bshad pas yang dag par gsungs pa'i sgra don ji lta ba bzhin du dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde zhes bya bas legs par bsgyur ba'o// //26—1765
