bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1164)

༄ / /tshe sgrub pa'i thabs/2 1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā yuḥsādha rna/ bod skad du/ tshe sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig skyil krung gdan ldan lus kyi rgal tshigs dbyug pa rengs par ni/ /byas nas 'byung 'jug rlung dag yang dang yang du zung gi las bya ste/ /bshang ba'i gnas yongs btsum las gyen du grangs zhing o ṭi yā gnas bsdam/ /srog rnams steng du bkug nas mgrin pa'i dril chung bu gar rnal 'byor bya/ /'di ltar rlung ni sbyangs pa'i cho gas bkug pa na ni rang dbang nyid/ /thob pa rab tu byung ba gang tshe rlung ni glog dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de las de ltar dri med bde ster zla ba lce'u chung las 'bab pas/ /skams pa'i rtsa tshogs nyin dang mtshan du tshim bya de bzhin bza' bas so/ /yo gī bi budha ka ra'i man ngag ste/ rgya gar shar phyogasasad+ma ga ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen bo dpal nags kyi rin po che'i spyan sngar dge slong chos smrab 26—1812

bsod nams rgya mcho1re sdes btā/ra ba'o// //bsdur mchan/1812 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1165)26wa 1813

1239༄7/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/41 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra salba ro pa de sha mu kha kaṇ+ḍa pa rasba ra cis ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas/ snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgu gsum bdag nyid dgos 'byung bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad ze 'bru dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ /gsang sngags mthar thug snying po'i bcud phyung yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin rtogs pas 'dir gsal bkod/ /bde gshegs thugs la snang ba dri med pañtsa pa nas rtogs pas ke ri li ru gsang bdag mnyes/ /spyod pas zil mnan lus kyi bkod pasarnal 'byor rjes bzung mdzad pa tha mas 'gro rnams stong par byas/ /bslab pa gsum dang brgyud par ldan pa nyams su myong bas 'jug tshul shes pas bla ma dam par shes/ /sen dha ba dang rigs chad bran ltar rus sbal sru ste mo gsham bu 26dod1814

ltar slob ma skyon lnga bral/ /mchog gi don 'dod gang gi de brten thog mar dbang bzhis rgyud smin thabs dang shes rab 'byel pa nyid/ /'di don rim par brgyud pa rna bar 'pho byed de tshe sangs rgyas bstan gnas gus pas mnyan par gyis/ /sa yi cho ga lhag par gnas pa rig byed slob dpon rig sbyor sogs kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur bya/ /bslab pas rgyud mdzes thos bsam nor ldan bla mar 'os pa phul ba bla mas gsal stong la sogs bskur/ /nyer lnga lhag spangs rigs ldan rgyan spras zag bcas bskul sogs gsum pa byin nas brtul zhugs brtan par bya/ /dga' ba gsum son lhan cig skyes pa rnyog pa dang bral yul du bya sogs 'bras bur shes par gyis/ /dbang bzhi dang 'byel brda yis mtshon pa shes rab bdag nyid sin+dhu ra la mnyes sogs ston mos brgyan/ /slob dpon bzhi la dbang bzhi dus bzhi byed pa bcu gnyis chos nyid dbang la mtshon du med par byos/ /dbang gis smin nas rim pa gnyis shes rnal 'byor dbang phyug zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i sku sgrub phyir/ /dbang bo'i rim pas dbye dang bsnyu ba'i rim pa shes nas 'du 'dzi med par rgyun du 'bad pas spyad/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi gsol dang khams sogs bslab pa 'khor lo tshogs brten rgyu 'bras nyid dang phra mor brjod/ /go cha ye shes rgyas btab sgu gsung mchod dang bzlas pa sgogs rim phrin las phyogs dang thub pa nyid/ /bsdus pa'i spyor ba tshad med bzhi ldan rdzus te skyes pa skad cig rnal 'byor bzlas par bcas pa nyid/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po lhan byug skyes pa snang sems dbyer med rnon po'i spyod yul zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /kun la khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid ston gsal rig mtshan nyid thub pa'i dbang po bde gshegs kun gyi gtso/ /gsum gsal bdag gis 26—1815

mngon sum nyid du legs par rtogs nas bsgom dang bzlas pa gsal por rab tu phye1/ /chos dbyings skye med rgyal ba yum gcig rgyal dang rgyal ba nyid de nam mkha'i ri mo lta/ /brtan dang g.yo ba rten dang brten pa lha yi rang bzhin rang la bcug nas sna yi rtse mor rdo rje bzlas/ /gtor ma byin nas dbang po 'bring pos 'od gsal bsgoms tsote dbang sogs lam dang dam tshig 'bras bur bsre/ /bdag 'jug dbang dang bla ma mchod byed nyams chags bskang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' brtan pa'i cho ga bzlas/ /rgyal po blon po dmangs kyi byed pas mtshams kyi kun spyod za nyal 'go dang khrus sogs rnal 'byor bya/ /rnam rtog dang bral zla ba drug tu nges par bsams nas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas rol par gnas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad dngos grub mthar phyin zab dang rgya che ba dang gnyis med dam tshig kun gyi gzhi/ /bag yod bsgom zhing rten dang gsal ba mi bsag mi 'bral bza' bsrung mchog gyur thub pas rab tu gsungs/ /bslab pa gsum dang rgyu 'bras zhen med dbang sogs 'bras bu rgyud gzhan las gsungs rang sems brtan pas bsrungs/ /sku gsum la brten ting 'dzin gsum gyis rgya cher rab gsal gzhi lam 'bras bus lta ba mtshon par gyis/ /rnal 'byor srorga rtsol sangs rgyas mnga' bdag g.yon dang g.yas su rim pa ji bzhin rgyu ba nges pa ste / /mnyam par bzhag pas 'jug pa'i rlung nyid bum pa can du byas nas bstan pa'i go 'phang so sor thob/ /rlung gi sbyor ba 'di nyid mi shes las dang las min mi grub rlung rig pas ni 'bras bu ster/ /gdams pas tshe dang bzlas pa'i rim pa goms pas dge dang mi dge 'chi bzlog rlung rig pas ni shes/ /bya dang byed las chos mtshungs rgyu mtshan gdams pa'i spyor ba bskyed rim gomasapas 26—1816

mthun pa'i rkyen dang ldan/ /gsang spyod la gnas sdug bsngal bzod pas lus gnad gsum ldan dmigs pa bzhi las spyor ba'i skyon bsal te/ /steng 'og bar du 'bugs pa'i sbyor ba li ri'i tshul du sgo gsum sbyang bar bya phyir nges par rol / /rdo rje bzlas pa yig 'bru gsum la goms shing sangs rgyas lnga la kha dog so sor bslab par bya/ /'byung ba lnga yi rlung zin pas ni du ba smig rgyu me khyer mar me sprin sked nam mkha' 'byung / /brtan pa'i rtags su zla zer nyi zer glog gi zer dang 'ja' tshon nyi zlar bsres pa dngos su mthong / /spyod lam dang ni spyor ba mkhas pas dug sogs gzhom dang 'chi ba rtag pa la sogs sna tshogs rgyur//rtsa dang rlung dang thig le 'dres pas bde gsal mi rtog rgyun mi 'chad par rgyal por 'gyur ro kye/ /rim pa 'di nyid 'phel bar bya phyir snang dmigs dngos po sgyu mar bsams la dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs brnyan la ni rab tu dmigs la dngos po chu zla ltar/ /bcu gnyis sgyu ma'i dpe yis mtshon te mnyam rjes la ni chos brgyad las 'das mkha' bzhin snyoms par 'jug /de ltar shes pas mi bya ba med sngags zlos bsrung sogs mi dgos dge slong sogs la phyag mi bya/ /'di dang mtshan dus bsre zhing sbyang dang goms pas gyen du 'phangs te bde gshegs bltas la chos sogs mnyan//rmi lam med dus gnad dang ldan pas 'dod chags la sogs brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'od gsal chen pos sa bcur gyur pa lam ma bgrod na rnam shes gong du 'pho/ /sna tshogs don chen mthong nas shes pa spong ste rim pa gnyis ldan 'jug phyir gzhan gyi mi 'gyur ro/ /chags dang chags bral 'di ma shes par gzhan ni don med dus gsum sangs 26—1817

rgyas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /ri bong rgyug dang zla ba chu 'dzin dus dang 'brel pa bslab bcas sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes phyir/ /sgo gsum gnad kyis sbyang bar bya zhing ngal na sna rtser bltas la nges shes skyes nas chen por blta/ /dang po'i las kyi yid 'ong la brten goms pas sngags las zhing dang lhan cig skyes sogs rtsa bsnyen bya/ /cig car mgon po bsgoms nas mthar gnas rdo rje'i bzlas pa rtsa la mkhas pas pad+ma'i skyon bzhi bsal/ /bde ba'i lam drangs ye shes mtshon pa mar la 'du bar rgyu 'bras shes nas zhes bya'i dkyil 'khor blta//thur sel gcud nas glang chen seng ge rma bya'i 'dren dang bya rgod stag mos snang dmigs bde bar 'char/ /spyor bar dngas ma rlung dang mnyam zhing rig mas bde ba lus la spros nas rtsa mdud dgrol bar bya/ /bde ba'i nyams skyes tshogs drug kun la ro mnyam lugs las 'byung dang bzlog pas dga' bzhi mtshon par bya/ /dga' ba gsum dang dpe don bsres nas rgyu tshogs gzung 'dzin chos nyid goms nas rtsol med 'bras bu 'char/ /ye shes gsal byed dbang gi 'bras bur rdo rje'i lus la 'khor lor mdud pa spyi bor grol ba'i gnas/ /sgo dgu 'gags nas sgo bzhi thim pa gnyis kyi rnam grol ye shes lus can sgra brnyan lta bur 'bral/ /mig sogs stong dang bdud bzhi grol ba chos nyid la mkhas gsum po gcig gyur ye shes rgyun chad med/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gcig gyur bde chen dngos po ro mnyam yi ge bzhi don 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /mthar ma skyol na nye bar spyod pa lus ldan bzhi dang nges shes brtags te ngo sprod shes par bya/ /skye shi b.rado shes pa snga phyi gnyid du dran mtshams 'chi ba'i dus su phra rags thim nas ni/ /'od gsal chen po de ma rtogs na bla ma sogs kyi skyel bsu nying mtshams rlung 26—18/8

gsum bcing ba'i phyir/ /yon tan rdzogs pa bar dor longs sku yon tan bdun ldan de ma brtan na dug gsum las gyur pa'i/ /rtogs par bcas la dbang dus nyams dang lha sogs sgyu ma zung du 'jug pa slob dang mi slob pa/ /bdun phrag re la brgyal bar gyur pa de ma khegs na skye ba sna tshogs sprul sku nying mtshams spyor/ /bar do gsum la 'dod chags la sogs dug gsum shes pa zag med 'od gsal sgyu mar bsres la sgom/ /'di don rim pa 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das las rgyal ba gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por 'gyur/ /dbang dang dam tshig 'byel par 1shes pa gdod nas dag pa rkyen gyis bskur tshul nyams su blang dang rtogs/ /bum sogs dam tshig mnyam gzhag rjes spyod mi 'bral bza' bsrungs spros bcas spros med yan lag bshags bya nyid/ /dbang dus lta sogs mtshon par byas la bdud rigs ngos bzung zil gyis mnan nas sgom dang rtags su 'byel/ /tha ma 'bring dang rab dang mchog gyur 'jug sgo shes pas bsgoms la sbyar te gang dang gang la sogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'dod pa dus dang 'brel par spyod pa byas nas gol sa bcad par bya/ /bya dang spyod sogs tshogs su bsgyur la phrin las byed par rab gnas sbyin sreg rnam bzhis 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /'khor lo bzhi la sgu bzhir yan lag bdun ldan rdo je sems dpa' sgo gsum ngo sprod mtshan dpes spras/ /rgyud rnams snying phyung man ngag bcud bsdus lam gyi rim pa bde gshegs kun thugs yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar bya phyir 'jug pa'i tshul dang zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gsal ba'i thabs nyid do/ /lus la go gyon ngag gis g.yul sprad sems kyis mtshon bsnun sku gsung khrus bcud rlung dang 'khor lo 26—1819

bskor / /rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgus nad la sman dpyad bar chad srung 'khor gnad bral gegs bsal te/ /sa la sogs pa'i ro bzhi ngos bzung 'khor lo bzhi yis ro bzhi mnyam la zhi gnas phyogs la ni/ /thabs dang ldan pa pi wang sgra sogs rtsa rlung la ni shes rab sku gsum mthun sbyor rdzas sogs lnga/ /zin dang ma zin legs par shes nas lus kyi gnad la nyi ma zla sogs brjis nas rdul sprugs byed/ /'byung bzhi rlung la lte ba la sogs stong ra bcas nas na tsha bogs 'don 'gags 'khyil la sogs bsal/ /bcu pa'i rlung shes ting 'dzin rang grol sman pa lta bus brgyad po bsal nas dngul chu ltar sprad bya/ /dngas ma bsrubs nas skyon rnams sel phyir bdag tu lta ba'i bud shing bsregs nas 'od gsal chos skur bsgral/ /'di don rim brgyud bla ma la bsten gus pas blang phyir byin rlabs lam khyer snyan nas snyan du brgyud/ /mchog gi bla can brtse ba chen pos theg gzhan spangs pa smin dang grol ba rim pa gnyis la 'bad/ /sdod bcud la sogs gzhal yas khang dang phung po khams sogs lha ru dag pas rgyal ba thams cad bsdu'o/ /rdo rje'i lus la bde chen gnas pas pho nya la sogs spros dang spros med 'khor lo zung du 'jug /rim pa 'di la mos pa brtan pas sprul pa mthong zhing skyon yon dang bcas chung ngu yin phyir tshogs/ /skad cig bzhi yis dga' ba gsum son 'bring po'i drod de lhan cig skyes pa dhū tī'i lam zhugs nas / /'jig rten las 'das brgya phrag bdun bo yon tan gyis spras gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs/ /dngas ma yas byon pūdze+e sogs khyab rgyu ba mas brtan bde chen brtol nas ma chags pad+ma'i sa/ /rab bkram chen po phrag bdun yon tan ye shes gsal byed chos sku bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /26—1820

༄ga /snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang jes bya ba/ 2༄ ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ kar+ha tan+t+ra badz+ra pa da nā ma/ bod skad du/snyan brgyud —rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba'i mchog / ye shes 5rgyal po thig le mchog gi lam/ /tshig tu brjod pa kun dang bral ba'i don/ /jeg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos— / /rdo rje 'chang ngas skal ldan don du bshad/ /gus 7btud nas ni ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon/ /bslab gsum rgyan 8ldan nyams myong bla ma'i shemachog /dad brtson ṣ+ṭhashes rab snying rje slob ma'o11/ /nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btang / /thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la brten nas1 / /drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi bskur/ / lha mo bco lnga dbang bzhi brda yis mtshon/ /smin par byas nas thabs shes zung du sbrel/ /rgyal po blon sogs sarnal 'byor bdun la 'bad//26—1822

bsre ba ro snyoms dam tshig gsum la sbyar/ /gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung / /lus gnad bdun ldan lha sku'i ༄1stong ra gnad/ / dhū tī 3la la ra sa 'khor lo bzhi/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag srog rtsol thur sel gcud /— / /rdo rje bzlas ④pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom/ /zin dang brtan pa shes rab 5snyoms par 'jug /dga' bzhi goms pas rtsa rlung thig le 'dres/ / dhū tīr 5rlung sems tshud 3pas mi rtog pa/ /nyon mongs rang zhi bde gsal rgyun mi 'chad / /ngo bo mthong nas chos sku'i ngang du gnas/ /bogs 'don sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la/ /'khor 'das thams cad sgyu mar shes byas te // /sgyu ma'ang 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'o/ /da ltar snang ba 9—dngos po'i chos rnams ni/ /bden cing rtag na 'gyur bar ga la rigs/ /'khrul gzugs yin phyir don la grub pa med/ /gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams brag car ltos/ /gnyis 'dzin zhig pas chags sdang kun dang bral/ /de ltar shes pas sna tshogs zhen med spyod/ /'ja' lus chos sku thob par 'gyur ro kye/ /mtshan dus rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs la/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung / /'dzin sbyangs spel bsgyur —sprul cing gegs rnams selahūṃ1/ /nyi zla zhon dang zhing khams mtha' dag bgrod/ /bzang ngan sgyu ma cir snang rang grol ltos/ /mthar phyin sa bcu non nas don chen thob/ /khyad par 'od gsal ma rig mun bral la/ /lus gnad thabs ldan ting 'dzin bzhi la spyoran/ /thig le gus ldan dug rngig gsum 'dzin med ltos/ /gnyid dang rmi lam rnam rtog bar nas bzung / /rim ṣepa bzhi dang nyin mtshan bsre zhing goms/ /'igasal stong 'dzin bral lhan skyes ye shes de/ /brjod du med pa 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ /26—/823

ma rtogs sbyang zhing phyag rgya chen por blta/ / rmye'apho ba gser 'gyur ma bsgoms sangs rgyas ni/ /'chi ltas shar tshe dga' zhing zhen pa btang / /sgo dgu bkag la rdzas dang smon lam rgyan( ka/ /hūṃ dang rlung sems dbyer med dhū tīr 7 drang / /k+ṣa yig gsal jel tshangs pa'i lam nas 'phang / /chos sku bla ma rgyal ba'i zhing du 'pho/ /lhag par grong 'jug sbrul be+egs 'dor len yeni/ /rlung sems dbang thob bskyed rdzogs brtan pa yis/ /skyon med ro la rnam shes yig 'bru 'phang / /dus yul rdzas dang gnad shes ⑥ mngon du gyur/ /the tshom bral ba'i skyes bu gzhan don spyod/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba dzabade ba chen po ni/ /bcu drug nyer lnga'i bar gyi rig ma nire / /pad+ma ri dwags dung can la sogs pa/ /phyag rgya mtshan ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /skal ldan skyes bu he ru ka lta bu4 / /gnyis med 'khril spyor zag bcas zag med rol/ /thig le dbab bzung bzlog dgram skyoganas su spel11/ /bya rgod gcud 6 la seng ge glang chen dang / /rma bya stag mo rus sbal la sogs bya/ /dga' ba bzhi gsum bcu gnyis don la blta1 —/ /lhan skyes ye shes rang bzhin dbyer rnged ston/ /snang srid thams cad zag med bde bar 'char/ /gsang dbang phyag rgya bdud rtsi ril bu'i phyir/ /thig le bcu drug phyed phyed bzhi cha sbyin/ /bzhi gsum 'khor lo dag la dgram par bya/ /bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos/ /don la ⑫ nyams shing slar yang ngan song ltung / /des na rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med/ /phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed ni / /sgo gsum g.yo med sgo lnga ha dngas gzhag /bltas mupas mthong med sems kyi mtshan nyid ltos/ /dmigs su med pas ma bcos rang sor gzhag⑫ /26—/82

gzhan du ma tshol ngo bo rtogs par gyis/ /gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhan grub la/ /tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na/ /'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i 7klong yangs su/ /skye shi med pa chos sku'i lus mthong 2'gyur/ /phyi rol yul sems rngo chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /rang sems yin phyir gzhan na grub pa med/ /'khrul rtog gnyis 'dzin sna tshogs gang shar rnams/ /cir snang gzhi med rang byung rang brlag ltasaje/ /sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku/ /'gag med gsal dngas gang shar sprul pa'i sku/ /gnas med bde chen zung 'jug 7longs spyod rdzogs/ /phyag ni gnyis rnged ye shes ngo yis zin6/ /rgya ni 'khor ba'i mdud pa dral bas bde3/ /chen po zung 'jug sgron me bltams 3pa las /gzhan gyis ma yin rang grol chos sku'o/ /sgrib gnyis rang dag gzung 9'dzin mtha' dang bye bral/ /'du shes blo dang 'khor 'das chos rnams zad/ /mkhyen tshad tsolhayon tan ji snyed rang la rdzogs/ /bsam brjod blo 'das sangs rgyas rang 'khrungs yin/ /bar do ngo sprod yang dag zab don bstan/ /skye shi rmi lam srid pa'i 6bar do gcod/ / bltar med bltas 1 pas mthong med mthong ba'i mchog /rang rig gsal stong mi rtog sgrib g.yogs bral/ /bde chen chos dbyengs ye shes rnam par dag /rang bzhin dbyer med sku gsum rang shar ltos / /ma rtogs lus ldan bar do rnam gsum la/ /bskyed rim sgyu lus 'od gsal chos sku 'dre—/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rim snyegyis thim/ /brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te/ /dkar dmar sems gsum chu skyes nang du 'dzom/ /'od gsal ngos 'dzin 7ma bu dbyer med 'dre1 / /chos sgu sangs rgyas dbang po yang rab bo/ /de ma zin na rlung gsum rkyen gyis 'ching /26—— /82 ༄

'bring po chu la nya ltar longs skur 'gyur/ /rtsal hūṃlnga zer lnga dug sdegasum las kyi dbang / /chags sdang gnyis kyis mngal du 'jug 'gyur bas/ /bsre ba lnga ldan lam khyer phyag rgya bzhi/ /sngar sbyangs ldan pas bar do byerang grol 'gyur/ /tha mas chags sdang grol nas sprul sku thob/ /gdams pa spyi la gegs bsal bdud dngos bzung / /rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgu yi/ /rdo rje lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gnad du bsnun/ /bya spyod thams cad tshogs su bsgyur bar bya /go rims ma nor nyams su blangs gyur na/ /skad cig bzhi la dga' gyeb gsum ston khute/ /dngas ma yas byon 'gyu ba mas brten pahūṃ/ /rtsa mdud rim pas byegrol nas dhū tīratshosna'agyur/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtsa ba lnga/ /rlung dang nyon mongs 'gags nas ye shes 'gyur/ /gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs / / pūkhra ma ru yar chad gang bar 'gyur/ /sprul sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rkazhal ston cing 1 / /mngon shes yon tan brgya dang 1)ther 'bum thob—/ /dus 'dir sa lam rim pa sgod byed dekhu/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /bcu gsum bar du tshig rgyud rgya yis gdab7 / /mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po 'di yin pas/ /skal ldan grol phyir gsang tshaba'i nges don mdzod1 / /ces ye shes 1 mkha' 'gro ma la gdams pa/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang rdzogs so// // mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal snga dang / lo tsā 1ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis pusgo ha ri'i 2 gnas chen du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o /26dod/826

༄/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor jes bya ba/nyu ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ āt+ma yo ga nā ma/ bod skad du/ bdag gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor spyod la mkhas pa yis/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dngos grub ched du las sgrub thabs/ /de nas de la khyeyang dag bshad/ /'jig rten thar la brten phyir yang / /'khor lo drug gi cho ga dang / /de bzhin las sbyor cho ga yis/ /las kyi sgrub thabs mchog bya'o/ /gang zhig rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni nges 'thob pa/ /bdag nyid kyi ni sgrub thabs mchog /de phyir de las bshad par bya/ /dang por re zhig bshang lam nas / /sum mdo ru ni dgug bya ste/ /sgo bzhi 'dab 5ma bzhi pa la/ /ge sar rgyan gyis 'udage byas pa/ / de yi tsodabus na nges phyung ba'i/ /ban+d+ra ka mtshungs sa bon dmar/ /de nas 'khor lo la gnas lnga / /nag po 'jigs 26 /829

su rung ba'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed ces byar bsgrags pa ni/ /'jigs pa 'joms pas 'jigs byed do/ /gnyis pa lte ba'i dbus gnas shing / /lag 'gro'i rnam par rab nyal ba/ /de la 'khyel par bsgrags pa ste/ /'char dang nub pa'i rgyu yin no/ /me yi sa bon re phas 1kyang / /gru gsum pa can me yi lha/ /kha dog dmar zhing lus che ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'od 'khrigs pa'o/ /gsum pa snying ga'i 'khor lo ni/ /sum cu rtsa drug 'dab snyemar khyab/ /pad+ma'i snal ma dang 'dra zhing / /nyi ma dang mnyam gzi brjid can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi/ /lte ba'i ze'u 'bru la gnas pa/ /nā da thig ler yang dag ldan / /sems kyi rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /bzhi pa mgrin pa la gnas pa'i//rtsa yi tshogs kyi rispyod yul ni/ /rtsa rnams thams cad tshogs pa ste/ /rdzu 'phrul la sogs spyod yul lo/ /bcu drug 'dab ma'i 7ze'u 'bru la/ /gsung gi rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /rkan dang mgrin pa rnam dag che6/ /kha dog dmar po dpal ldan che/ /lnga pa tshangs pa'i bug par ni/ /dus gsum nam mkha'i spyod yul te/ /nam mkha' las 'das mchog tu phra/ /thig le'i gzugs can dbyangs dbang phyug /'khor lo'i nges pa drug pa rkan/ /lha rnams kyis kyang rnyed dka' bkla/ /zla ba chu shel dang mtshungs pa/ /'dzag pa zhes bya bsam par bya/ /so gnyis bdud rtsi'i cha shas rigs kyi ni/ /'khor lor gnas pa sku yi rdo rje ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kha dog dkar po che/ /ral pa'i cod pan la brgyan dpal ldan no/ /de bzhin spyi bo'i rtsa bar ni/ /'khor lo zla ba zlum pos 8brgyan/ /chos kyi dbyings dang de bzhin lha/ /thig le yi ni gzugs rang bzhin/ /ye shes rnam shes sbyor ba dang / /sum cu'i 26—/830

sngag /thams cad grub par byed pa zhes bya ba/1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba sid+dhi ka ro nā ma/ bod skad du/thams cad grub 4par byed pa zhes bya ba/ grub pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis la sogs rim pas kyang / /rnal 'byor ltad mo rab brjod bya/ /dang po 4gza' bkra shis shar ba'i dus su/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig /sa chu tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis so zhe/ /mtshan mo'i dang po me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu 'utshod gnyis/chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' lhag pa shar ba'i dus su/ sa thun tshod gcig /rlung chu tshod gnyis / me thun 7tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gshig go/ /mtshan mo chu chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me chu tshod gnyis so/ /26—/832

lha'i bla ma la/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis / sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu ༄1tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis so—/ /mtshan mo me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig 2dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' pa sangs da la/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ sa chu tshod gnyis so / /mtshan mo sa thun tshod gcig dang / chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis / ske thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' spen pa shar ba na/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ zu chu tshod gnyis so//mtshan mo rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' nyi ma shar ba na/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis so/ /mtshan mo rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me+e thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis / sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' zla ba shar ba na/ me thun tshod gabyug /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me chu tshod gnyis so/5 /mtshan mo sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig6 /sa thun tshod gcig go/ /rnal 'byor pas 'di ltar bya ste/ rlung dang me gnyis spang bar bya'o/ /26—1833

me 'phel ba'i bdag nyid dang / rlung gi blabya ba thams cad rmongs par 'gyur zhing / chu dang sa'i las brgyad po mtha' dag shes ༷bya ste/ de ltar shes nas me dang rlung spang bar bya'o/ /rgyal po dbang bskur ba dang / khron pa bru )ba dang / bag ma bya ba dang rab tu gnas pa'i las rnams las gtso bo'o/ /mig sman dang ril bu dang mchil ④lham gnyis dang / ral gri dang mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dang gtsug phud dang ⑤g.yul dang gsad ⑥pa dang zas dang mdzod dang dgon pa bya ba rnams la sa gtso bo'o/ /dka' thub kyi las dang / slong ba mel me gtso bo'o/ /bskrad pa la rlung gtso bo'o/ /rengs pa dang dgug zupa la chu spugatso bo ste/ zhi ba'i las dang rgyas pa las gtso bo'o/ /ltad rkyemo dang bstan bcos sgom pa dang gtsang bar byed pa yang ngo las thams cad grub nyunyepar byed pa rdzogs so// //tsarba ṭi'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o/ /dge slong rgya mtshos ⑫bsgyur ba'o// //⑫26—1834

gyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po krisna paṇ+ḍi ta dang /lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing nus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(68) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(44)112da thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa/ 75dang po/ shes rab dang thabs rnam par spros pa'i rim par bye ba/ 75gnyis pa/ rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen bkur nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/78gsuka1 pa/ byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba nges par bstan pa'i rim par bye ba/ ༷༷༷ ༷ ༷ 81bzhi pa/ de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i rim par bye ba/ ༷ 85lnga pa/ de kho na nyid kyi spyod pa nges par bstan pa'i rim par phye ba/ 88slob dpon chen po yan lag med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shārnyi lha dra dang / nu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur cing nus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/((5) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(‘che)1124 ye shes grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs ༷ ‘8dang po/ phyag rgya chen po bstan pa'i le'u/ ༷ ༷ (8gnyis pa/ gzugs su bsgom pa dgag pa'i le'u/ ༷ ༷107gsum pa/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i ye shes dgag pa'i le'u/ 111bzhi pa/ rnam pa med pa dgag pa'i le'u/ ༷ ༷ ༷114lnga pa/ rmongs pa bsgom pa dgag pa'i le'u/ ༷ 117

drug pa/ dbugs grub pa dang 'byung ba'i de kho na nyid dgag pa'i le'u/ 118bdun pa/ bde ba chen po smra ba dgag pa'i le'u/ 11(brgyad pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs rab tu 'phel ba chenas bya ba'i le'u/ 11(dgu pa/ bsod nams dang sdig pa skye ba dang 'jig pa yongs su shes pa'i le'u—/ 12dbacu pa/ gtsang ba dang mi gtsang bar rtog pa las grol ba'i le'u/ 126bcu gcig pa/ bgrod pa dang bgrod pa ma yin pa dang bral ba'i le'u/ 127bcu gnyis pa/ de nyid gnas pa gzhag pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 128bcu gsum pa/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ 1daXbacu bzhi pa/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyi le'u/ ༷ 131bco lnga pa/ gsungs pa'i de kho na nyid kyi yi ge'i tshogs nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 1da2bcu drug pa/ thabs nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 144bcu bdun pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 146bco brgyad pa/ mthu nges par bstan pa dang dbang po mchog rnams legs par spyod pa'i le'u/ 15 bcu dgu pa/ dbang po 'bring po bstan pa'i le'u/ ༷ ༷ 152nyi shu pa/ dbang po tha ma pa bstan pa'i le'u/ ༷ ༷15daslob dpon yin stu nyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po shurtse ka ra kaza dang /zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang ngos bsgyur/ slad kyi nags tshos kyang brtsos/bsdur mchan/(155) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(16༷)3

1125 gnyis su med par grub pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 161ba/sna lda/na 'das ma lasgyu'i zhal snga nas bsdur mchan/(165) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(165)1126 dpal u rgyan nas byung ba gsang ba'i gsang ba chen po de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ༷ 166slob dpon chen po da ri ka pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(169) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(169)1127 dngos po gsal ba'i rjes su 'gro ba'i de kho na nyid grub pa/ 17༷lhadī dīshaṃ /skyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma tsi tos paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhi ba bzang po dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba 'gos lhas btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(18da) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(185)1128 dpal lhan cig skyes pa grub pa zhes bya ba/ 186dang po/ lhan cig skyes pa bstan pa'i le'u/ ༷ 186gnyis pa/ dam tshig gi de kho na nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 188gsum pa/ spyod pa'i de kho na nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 18‘slob dngon chen po dpal rngo ji te ru ka'i zhal snga nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1(1) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1zhe2)112( do ha mdzod kyi gru/ ༷ 11da

rnal 'artsor gyi dbang tsu ga chen po dpalas ra ha chen po'i zhal snga nas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(208) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(21༷)11daX phyag rgya bzhi gtan la dbab pa/ 211dang po/ las kyi phyag rgya'i dbang nges par bstan pa/ 211gnyis pa/ chos kyi phyag rgya rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu nges par bstan pa/ 214gsum pa/ phyag rgya chen po dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu nges par bstan pa/ 215bzhi pa/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu nges par bstan pa/ 216slob dpon chen po klu rdzub snying pos mdzad/bla ma rnyi ri sgyu 4 na'i 'bas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba za ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(217) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(218)11da1 shes rab ye shes gsal ba/ 219mkhas pa chen po de ba tsan+d+ra'i zhal snga nas mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta badz+ra sna ḍi dang / lo tsā ba karma tīrtes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(2bsgyu) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(252)11da2 gnas pa bsdus pa/ ༷ ༷ 25dbye brag spru ba'i gnas pa bsdus pa/ ༷༷༷༷ 25dmado sde pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa/ 254rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa/ 256rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lam rnam pa med pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa/ 256rnal 'byor spyod pa'i las rnam pa dang bcas pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa/ 25bye

shing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(165() bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1660)1216 chos kyi dbyings lha ba'i gru/ ༷ 1661slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1676) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(16che7)1217 man ngag sku'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/༷ ༷ 1678bsdur mchan/(168༷) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(168༷)1218 theg pa gsung gi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 1681bsdur mchan/(168da) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(168da)121zhe yang dag lta ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 1684bsdur mchan/(1686) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1686)122༷ rin po che sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 1687bsdur mchan/(168() bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1681)1221 mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ ༷ 16(༷bsdur mchan/(16(2) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(16(da)1222 mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ ༷ ༷ 1614rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad/37

1222 mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 16(4rje btsun ka ma la sgyu las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(16(5) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(16(5)1223 byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 16(6rje batshun ka ma la shī las mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta kha che tsā na gu gya dang / yong po lo tsā bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1698) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(16(8)1224 rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ ༷ 16((rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(17༷1) bsdura'abras re'u mig(14༷1)1225 gsang ba thugs kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 17༷2rnal 'asgyur gyi dbang phyug chen po ka ma la sgyu las mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po tsā na gu sgyu dang /1dī tram̐/ lo tsā ba lo btsun zung gis bsdur mchan/(17༷4) bsdura'abras re'u mig(17༷4)1226 maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ 14༷5rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1707) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(17༷7)1227 de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag 17༷838

rnal 'artsor gyi dbang rgyug chen po ka ma la ṭī las mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po tsā na gu gya dang / nu chen gyi lo tsā ba bla ma lo btsun chung gis bsgyur cing nus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1che11) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1711)1228 shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ 1712rje btsun kam la shīlas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1714) bsdura'abras re'u mig(1714)1229 rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ ༷ ༷༷༷༷1715rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1rngo18) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1418)12daX rdo rje phag mo'i skrub thabs/ 141(rje btsun ka ma la bhā las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1721) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1721)12ka1 'jam pa khro bor sgrub pa/ 1722rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad/bsdur mchan/(1724) bsdur 'bras re'u mib(1724)12da2 chos drug gi man ngag ces bya ba/ ༷ ༷ 1725tsār+ya pa'i gtum mo'i man ngag 1725tsā gārdzu na'i lus kyi man ngag 1725la ba pa'i mi lam gyi man ngag 172639

tsā grardzu na'i 'od gsal gyi man ngag ༷ 1726su kha sirnyi'i bar do'i man ngag ༷ 1726su kha sirnyi'i 'pho ba'i man ngag 1724grub pa'i rnal 'byor dbang zug nyilbi pa'i zhabs kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhas pa tsā ro paṇ+ḍi ta dang / mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1428) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(172()12dka bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag ༷ ༷ 17daXbasdur mchan/(17da5) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1726)12da4 bka' dpe phyi ma ba(1gas so// 17da7bsgom pas sangs rgya ba gtum mo'i tshig spram/ 17da7bag chags dag pas sangs rgya ba sgyu lus kyi tshig sbram/ 17daḍabag chags can rmi lam la ngarten nas sangs rgya ba'i tshig spram/ ༷༷ 174༷gnyid 'thug pos sangs rgya ba 'od gsal gyi tshig spram/ ༷༷ 174༷ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba 'pho ba'i tshig spram/ 1741srid pa bar dor sangs rgya ba bar do rnam pa gsum gyi lam dang bsre ba bar do'i tshig spram/ ༷ ༷ 1742grong 'jug gi tshig sbram/ ༷ ༷ 174kathabs lam byang chub sems kyi man ngag 1744bsdur mchan/(1746) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1746)0

12da5 dpem pa lnga bsdus pa gsa' ba/ 17bzadapal ldan tsā ro pas mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing nus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1452) bsdura'abras re'u mig(175da)12da6 go ba byed pa snying po brgya pa/ ༷ 1754slo1 dīrdon/ chen po ār+ya de ba'i zhal snga nas shar phyogs sad ga ra'i gnas brtan dpal nargas kyi rin po che'i zhal snga nas man ngag gi bshad pas yang dag par gsungs pa'i sgra don ji lha ba bzhin du dge slong chos sru ba bsod nams dam par rgyal ba dbang po'i sde zhes bya bas legs par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1466) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1767)12ka7 go bar byed pa'i snying po brgya pa rna par bshad pa zhes dra/ nga / ༷ ༷ 1768dpal te ru ka de ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs sad ga ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ṭī ba na rasna'i zhal sngar/ dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mchos sde zhes bya bas mnyan ming bsgyur ba las/ phyis ༵dīdī pa/ ra brtags shing zhus te gtan bsdur mchan/(18༷8) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1811)41

12da8 tshesgrub pa'i thabs ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 1812rgya gar shar phyogs saji ga ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal nags kyi rin po che'i spyan sngar dge slong chos snab bsod nams rgya mchos rdos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(181ka) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(181da)12kaḍa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ 1814nyikhri pas bkod/tsā ro paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(1821) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1821)124༷ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ ༷༷ ༷ 1822mkhas pa tsā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal ji dang /lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(1827) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1828)1241 bdag gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ ༷ ༷ 1829tog rtse pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs sad ga ra'i mkhas pa chen po nags kyi rin chen gyi spyan jir/dge slong chos spu ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(18da1) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(18ka1)12
mi

tshog /rgyud ma lus pa'i don res par skul bar byed pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/1ra / /rgya gar skad du/ sa ka la tan+d+ra sa bha ba salho da ni shrī gu gya sirnyi tsā ma4/ bod skad du/ rgyud ma lus pa'i don nges par skul bar byed pa/dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po med cing khyab pa mchog tu zhi ba'i go 'phang 'jig rten spyod pa dag las rnam grol ba5/ /gang zhig rtag 'byung zhe la rgyal ba dam pa khyu mchog rnams kyis phyag byas bsam gtan dang bral ba/ /ci yang rung ba'i gnas gyur dpal ldan rgyal ba'i sku yi dam pa rnam dag nang gi bdag nyid kyis 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang rtogs par bya ba min zhing dri ma rnams dang bral ba'i de nyid de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /go 'phang mchog tu 'gro ba tshol byed pho nya mchog gyur sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cing / /spyod pa sna tshogs dang 'brel rtsod pa'i dri ma'i bgegs kyis byas pa'i 26—3

g.yeng ba spong byed pa'i/ /dngos grub rnams kyi skye sa rgyal ba rnams kyi yon tan brgya phrag mang po'i gnas gyur ma lta bu/ /mchog tu legs spyod thar pa ster byed rin chen gyur pa dpal ldan gsang ba grub pa bshad/ /yon tan dpag med gzhir gyur pa/ /mi byed rdo rje gsum gyi sku/ /gang gi spyod yul las 'das pa//dang por bde chen phyag byas nas/ /gsang ba grub pa bla med pa/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /sems ni snying rje'i dbang gyur pas/ /pad+ma rdo rje bdag gis bshad/ /rgyud gzhan du ma nyid du yang / /sangs rgyas mgon pos gang snyegasungs pa/ /nges pa'i man ngag dang ldan pas/ /de ni da ltar bdag gis bshad/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'bad pa thams cad spang bar bya/ /bskyed pa mang zhing ring ba dang / /dang po'i sa can bsgom pa'i phyir/ /rgyud kyi dam pa'i dngos brten nas/ /dngos grub bsdu ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /bsgom pa yi ni bar chad can/ /rgyas pa thams cad rnams ( t+pangs la/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub legs ster ba/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis| /gsang ba grub pa bla med pa/ /bzang pos mdor bsdus bshad par bya / /dge 'byung nyon mongs med pa dang / /bgegs rnams thams cad 'jig mdzad cing / /dngos grub kun gyi gter ④gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchog lta bu/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed byed cing / /g.yeng ba'i sgra ⑤rnams 'joms byed pa/ /don rnams thams cad grub byed pa/ /mngon par byang chub mtshan nyid do/ /gang dang gang der gnas na yang / /thangs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis/ /bsgom pa dag la rab gnas na/ /sgrub po gang de dngos grub 'gyur/ /sbas pa'i brtul zhugs dang ldan pas/ /chos rnams 26—4

dang yang 'gal med par/ /rdor gsum dbye ru med gzugs can/ /byang chub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /dus kyi shenges pa yongs spangs nas/ /bla med gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /srog chags gsod cing khro ba dang / /gang yang khro ba'i las dga' zhing / /brdzun —gyi tshig ni spros pa yis/ /mi gang rmongs pas 'tsho ba yi/ /mi de dag lhong myur bar 'dir/ /spyod pa 'dis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi chung ma spyod pa dang / /gzhan gyi nor la rku ba dang / /dman pa'i las can smad pa dag② /rtag tu spyod par byed pa dang / /gang la spyod pas 'dod khams kyi/ /steng gi pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sbas pa'i brtul ④zhugs ngo bo nyid/ /sgrub pa po la bdag gis brjod/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa mchog bzang po/ /dngos grub kun ster thabs bcas pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas gang yin/ /tshe 'di nyid la 1thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rtogs pa'i gnas/ /thob par 'dod pas mchog zhi ba/ /gsang ba grub pas bsgrub par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor nyid/ /de nyid ldan pas bsgom par bya/ /gzhan du de nyid dman pas ni/ /dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid brtag — pa rnams las gzhan/ /khyad par thams cad rnams 3spangs shing / /mtshan ma med cing snang ba med/ /gnyis med mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /lung dang bstan bcos lugs rim pas/ /ji srid rtog pa dang bcas pas/ /de srid bar du rgyas 'gyur te/ /chu la 'bru mar thim pa bzhin/ /re zhig rtog 4des dgos med mchogaka /rnam rtog sna tshogs byed pa yisanya/ /bstan bcos de nyid tshol mi dgos/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dang por de nyid 26—6

shes byas la/ /de nyid bsgrub phyir nyer 1gnas bya/ /de nas bsgom la 'bad pa yis/ /nyams su myong ba bskyed par bya/ /de nyid gsal bar gyur sems kyis / /phyi nas spyod pa yang dag spyad/ /rig pa dang ldan brtul zhugs kyang //de yi rjes la spyad par bya/ /gcig pa —brtan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa spyad nas ni/ /de ni mthar thug skyes gyur nas/ /phyi nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /gzhan du de nyid dman pa yis 'tsho ba'i rgyu can nyid gyur pa/ /dmyal ba 'thob par byed pa'i rgyu/ /brtul zhugs kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /sgrub po de nyid la gnas pas/ /brtul zhugs med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs brgya phrag la spyad kyang / /de nyid dman na 'grub mi 'akyur/ /de nyid ldan na thams cad kyis/ /dri med de ni 'grub par 'gyur//sgrub po sgom pa dang ldan zhing / /sdig pa kun las rnam grol bas/ /brtul zhugs kyis ni chags med thob/ /dngos grub rgyal bas thob ma gsungs/ /dngos grub de nyid shes gyur nas/ /'thob kyi brtul zhugs kyis ni min/ /chags pa kun las log gyur cing / /slong mo gtso bor bya ba ste/ /de tsam brtul zhugs kyis khyab 'gyur/ /de nyid spangs nas dngos grub med/ /'bab stegs lha rten sbyin pa'ang min/ /khrus dang dka' thub de bzhin te/ /'di kun bden pa ma yin gyi/ /'di nyid gcig pu bden pa nyid/ /gnod pa skyed par byed pa yi/ /ngan pa'i las dag sngon byas pas/ /de nyid dman pa'i lus can gyis/ /brtul zhugs ngo bo ma lus myong / /mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang / /srid par ngal bar byas pas kyang / /de nyid ldan na 'grub 'gyur te/ / dri med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /— nor rnams phun tshogs 26—6

bdag nyid kyi/ /de nyid rin chen sgom byed na/ /brtul zhugs med kyang de nyid ni/ /nges par bla na med par 'gro/ /lung gi spyod pa las gsungs pa'i/ /brtul zhugs gang zhig 'dir gnas pa/ /nor rnams sgrub par mi nus pas/ /'tsho ba'i phyir ni rtag sgyu7pa nyid/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gzugs/ /rnam par shes pa'i gzhir gyur ltar/ /de ltar de nyid ldan brtul zhugs/ /de nyid las ni 'jug par bstan4 / /'dul ba'i thabs kyi rgyu phyir dang / /nor la sogs pa spub 1phyir dang / /sems can don du de nyid bcas/ /brtul zhugs zhal gyis bzhes pa yin/ /'tsho ba yi ni thabs tsam du/ /so so'i skye bos gtsor byed pas/ /ji ltar mtshan ma'i che ba nyid/ /de nyid bral na dngos grub med/ /nor gyi 'byor pa ldan pa'i bdag /rtag tu bsgoms pas ku ngal byas pa'i/ /smyon pa'i gzugs nyid la brten cing / /gsang ba grub par rnam gnas nas/ /de nyid rdo rje 'chang bla ma/ /bsgom dang ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan du de nyid ldan gyur kyang / /dngos grub 'bras bu'i sdod mi 'gyur/ /de ltar phyi rol yongs bcad la/ /de nyid bla med shes byas nas—/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges bya ste/ /blo ldan gsang ba grub par spyod/ /rnam par g.yeng ba kun gyi gzhi/ /brtul zhugs spangs shing de nyid shes/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ /go 'phang mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nyid de yang rgyud gnas pas/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus par gsal/ /spros pa du ma rgyas gyur pas/ /gzhan du sbas nas bstan pa yin/ /bya ba spyod pa'i dbye ba dang / /mdo sde'i sde snod la sokas su/ /mchog tu dag pa gcig pu nyid—/ /rnam pa du mar rnam par gnas/ /phung po rin chen snod nyid du/ /26—7

sems can bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /de nyid 'bad pas sba mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas mgon pos rnam par gzhag3 /byang chub sems mchog rnam par dag /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /rang gi lus la rab gnas pa/ /de ni 'bad pas rig par bya/ /de nas spyod pa bya ba 'am/ /khyim du gnas te bsgom par bya/ /de nyid rin chen rnam dag bdag /rtsod pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /thabs bzang po ni rnam spangs nas/ /'gal ba'i dam tshig la sogs la/ /gzhan du gang zhig grub ༅gyur pa/ /de ni ngu 'bod sogs par 'tshed—/ /ji ltar me ni 'bar gyur pa/ /de ni rtswa ༅shing phung po dag /bcug nas thal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /myu gu sogs pa'ang 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin de nyid med bzhin du/ /ngo mtshar che ba ltar byed pa/ /ji srid nam mkha' gnas bar du/ /shi ba'i 'og tu dmyal bar 'gro/ /ji ltar 'ga' zhig sprul gdug la/ /sman dang sngags sogs mi ldan par/ /rmongs pa'i ku bdag nyid gang rtse ba/ /gshin rje'i gnas 'gro 'dod pa yin/ /ji ltar mtha' med rgya mtsho la/ /gru med gzhan zhig 'jug 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang rten med gyur nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin dza yi mtha' can rgyud//yang dag rab sbyin spangs gyur pa/ /smad cing dman pa'i las rnams ni/ /byas na mnar med 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rnyed dka' bla med go 'phang mchog /de nyid ces byar mngon brjod pa/ /gang gis dag pa de thob pa/ /de yi thabs ni bdag gis brjod/ /bla ma dang ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /gang gis gnyis su med par mthong / /dngos grub bsdus pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /de nyid de ni 'dir 'thob 5'gyur/ /gang yang khro zhing nga rgyal can/ /bslus pa byis 26—8

dang spros la dga'/ /'dod cing chags pa'i sems can gang / /gang las rnyed cing gang las min/ /g.yo sgyus bla ma 3phyag byed cing / /skyon rtog pa la ched du byed/ /brdzun pas nga rgyal gdug pa can/ /tshig gi ༅rtsod la rtag tu gnas—/ /rdo rje spun dang bla ma la/ /slu ba'i bsam pa brtan pa can/ /sems can des ni dngos grub kun/ /ster ba'i go 'phang de mi thob/ /'dir ni 'di 'dra gzhan yang mthong / /ji srid 'dod pa thob bar du/ /phyag 'tshal mchod dang bsnyen bkur gyis/ /brtan par bla ma mnyes byas nas/ /go 'phang mchog ni thob nas ni/ /mdun nyid na ni gnas na yang / /su zhig gang nas ji ltar 'ong ④/ /rang bzhin ngan pas mi shes so/ /gcig pu mthong nas ring po nas/ /gus par phyag ni 'tshal byed cing / /de yang mang po'i nang du ni/ /bde bar byon nas rtsal 3gyis phongs/ /de lta bu yi sems can gang / /mya ngan 'das mchog go 'phang mchog /yang dag gsung bas gang gsungs pa/ /de yis — thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sems can 'di lta bu/ /bla ma smod pa dag kyang mthong / /ngo tsha spangs shing spyod pa ring / /yang dag rim pa sun 'byin pa/ /rgyud ni bsdu ba tsam nyid kyis/ /de yi dngos la kha phyir balhasache / /dbang bskur rjes gnang med par yang / /slob ma dag ni sdud par byed/ /glegs bam mthong bas dga' gyur nas/ /gsang sngags rang nyid len par byed/ /slob dpon las ni shes min pa/ /dam tshig spyod pa rnam par spangs/ /sems can rnams ni sdud pa ni4 / /glegs bam bka' yis kyibyed pa yin/ /de nyid shes pa ma yin par/ /gang phyir yang dag gsungs pas bstan༅/ /de lta bu dang de dag nyid/ /kun kyang sdig pa'i las 26—9

can de/ /dam pa min pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /dmyal ba dag tu 'gro bar gcig /sdug bsngal phongs rjedang nyon mongs dang / /sna tshogs nad kyis gtses pa'i mthar/ /shi nas dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /skye gnas ngan par skye bar 'gyur/ /bde gshegs dngos grub 'dod na ni/ /dam tshig spyod pa spangs pa yis/ /'grub ⑤dka' de dang lhan cig tu/ /gnas pa nyid du 'ang mi bya'o/ /dngos po kun gyis pya slob dpon la/ /ji srid mnyes par gyur bar du/ /lus ngag yid kyis brtan pa ru/ /dus ni ring por mnyes byed pa'i—/ /slob ma shin tu dri med pa'i/ /de nyid yang dag rab sbyin gnas/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /de nas bgegs med 'thob ( 3'gyur ba/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i dngos/ /de nyid rgyal po yangs pa ste/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsgoms pa yis/ /dngos grub myur du nges 'thob 'gyur/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rgyas gyur pa'i/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i dbang po la/ /rgyud rnams du mar gsungs pa yi/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg brtul zhugs sogs/ /thun mtshams bzhi yi cho ga yis / /yul dang dkyil 'khor bri la sogs/ /kha dog gzugs sogs dbye ba yis/ /rigs rnams su ni rnam brtags dang / /khrus dang lha mchod smyung ba dang / /phyag rgya 'ching ba'i rigs de bzhin/ /sku gzugs la sogs cho ga dang / /mchod rten las ni rgyas pa dang / /de ltar rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /rnam rtog sna tshogs byed pa yisashārngo/ /grub pa sems can bsam rim bzhin/ /dpal 'byung ba yi mgon pos gsungs/ /de ltar rnam rtog 'bum phrag gis tsa/ /yang dag gsung pas chogrub gsungs pa/ /der ni dngos grub gang 'grub chopa'am/ /'on kyang 'dir ni de mi 'grub/ /lo 26—10

gcig la sogs bskal pa dang / /gcig dang gnyis su srid pa'i mthar /skrub po gang gis 'grub 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi rnam grangs rgyas gyur pa/ /skye ba grangs med du ma ru/ /bsgom la brtan zhing chags med pas/ /'grub sna pa'i dbang po grub pa ru/ /'gyur bar gang zhing sngar gsungs pa/ /de ni re zhig 'dir mi dgos/ /thob par 'gyur ba dgos ma yin/ /grub pa'i bde ba las lhag pa'i/ /lus gdung 1sdug bsngal gyis mi 'thob/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa zhes bya 'dir/ /spros pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan 'dus las mchog gzhan med/ /'jig rten gsum gyi rin chen 'gyur— —/ /snying po las kyang snying po mchog /rgyud kun gyi ni bla ma'i bla/ /bstan dang bshad pa'i dzirnam gnas pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor rim pa nyid/ /'dus pa gang gis mi shes pa/ /de yis dngos grub ji ltar 'grub/ /the tshom thams cad gcod byed cing / /mi shes rab rib sel byed pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /dpal ldan 'dus pa yongs spangs nas/ /rnam rtog du mas brtags pa yis/ /rmongs pa dngos grub 'dod gyur pa/ /mkha' la khu tshur deg pa dang / /smika rgyu'i chu la 'thung ba bzhin/ /dang po'i las can bsgom pa yi/ /spros pa'i rgyud rnams spangs byas shing / /thabs dang shes rab shes byas nas/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnam par mnos/ /de phyir des byas sems gcig pa/ /blo dang ldan pas bsgom par bya /nyin dang mtshan du bsgom byas na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /tshes grangs med cing rgyu skar med/ /'di la sgyung ba bshad pa med/ /26—11

gnyis med ye shes dang ldan na/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i dngos grub 'gyur/ /yon tan gter gyur rdo rje 'chang la dri med rdo rje gsum gyis rtag tu gus byas la//skye ba'i rgya mtsho sdig pa'i rlabs drag 43mang ldan pa la grub gyur gcig pu mchog /gsang ba'i yon tan 'byung 'gyur dri ma bral zhing don kun 'grub — cing rab tu sbyin par byed pa yi/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i lam dang ldan pa'i sgrub po blo dang ldan pas deng nas brtsam par bya/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi dam pa'i don nges par bsdus pa — dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba dang brtul zhugs dang de kho na nyid nges par bstan ༅pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //rgyud gzhan rim pa ma yin pa'i/ /cung zad bsdus ⑪pa'i lam nyid las/ /gsang ba las byung spub pa'i thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /phyi rol de nyid bya ba'i lam/ /shin tu ring bas — —kun spangs la/ /lugs bcas rnal 'byor rim pa yis/ /ji lta ba bzhin bdag gis brjod/ /slob dpon phal cher 'di skad brjod/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa mdangs chen gyi/ /rgyud kyi sdud par byed pa po/ /dpa' bo 'jig rten dbang phyug zer/ /bla ma'i — —zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i sdud pa po/ /gzhan dag yod pa ma yin zhes/ /bdag nyid 'ba' zhig smra bar byed/ /rgyud mdzad pa ni thugs rje che/ /gsung ba po de brjod pa'ang de/ /de las gzhan dag yod min pas/ /bde chen las gzhan gsung ba med/ /'di skad thos pa'i tshig gang dang / /bzhugs zhes bya ba'i tshig gnas pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje bdag 26—12

nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas kun la bstan pa yin/ /dpal ldan bde chen mgon po yis/ /bzhugs zhes bya ba'i tshig bzang posasmo/ /ji ltar bzang po gang bstan pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis cung zhig brjod/ /dus gcig mchog tu mdor bstan pa/ /gang tshe gtso bos gsungs pa na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyud bden don/ /bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid yin/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad kyis/ /rgyud don bden pa de thos nas/ /'dar zhing 'jigs pa dang ldan pas/ /dbang phyug mchog la de nyid zhus/ /dpa' bo chos nyid 'di lta du/ /gtso bo'i ②gsung rab dka' ba gsung / /sangs rgyas kun kyang thams cad du/ /shin tu 'jigs pa skyed byed pa/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med/ /shin tu gsang ba 'byed par byed/ /chos kun mnyam nyid gcig pa nyid/ /gang yin gtso bo khyed kyis gsungs/ /'di skad brjod par gyur pa na/ /sangs rgyas grags chen thams cad kyang / /'dar zhing brgyal bar gyur nas kyang / /byang chub sems ni thugs la gzhag /e ma ho 5gsang ba las gsang ba/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bshad pa 'dis / /ngo bo med cing dag gyur la/ /gang la 3dpe yang yod min pas/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rgyur — gyur pa/ /rdo rje sems dpas de gzigs nas/ /bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid kyang / /ting 'dzin bzang po la gnas nas/ /de nas sangs rgyas rdo rje dang / /pad+ma'i snyoms 'jug sbyor ba mdzad/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can gyis— 7//'jam po'i gsung gis gsung bar mdzad/ /kye kye rgyal ba thams cad gzigs/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ /gang du lus ngag sems med pa/ /der ni gzugs su rab tu mthong / /byang chub sems kyi sbyor ba yis/ /ji srid 26—13

'bad pas rtogs gyur snapa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas zhes — pa/ /chos 'byung mi 'gyur zhi ba nyid/ /shes rab rang gi dngos de srid/ /kun du bzang po'i ye shes kyis/ /spros pa med cing dag pa las/ /'di dag thams cad rnam par 'phrul/ /mchog tu shes 1shing rnam dag gang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /brjod min kun la khyab par gnas/ /thams cad de yi rnam 'phrul yin/ /bzang po de nyid gnas pa yang / /mkha' dbyings zhes bya'i sgrib bral la/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can gyis/ /sems can kun gyi bde 'byung byed/ /rnam dag shes rab lus las byung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas zhi ba/ /lha rdzas chos 'byung mi 'gyur ba/ /blo yis de ni bdag gis bsten / /e yi cha byad bzang ba la/ /dbus su waṃ ‘༅gis rnam par brgyan/ /bde ba kun gyi gnas gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /rgyud kyi —dang por gang gnas pa/ /de phyir de ni bshad par bya/ /dpa' bo bde chen 'di skad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun la gsungs/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /sku gsung thugs kyi tshul dag gis/ /gnas shing dngos grub bzang ster ba/ /shes rab ces bya'i ming gi gnas/ /de la gnas pa gang yin pa/ /bha ga zhes bya'i yi ge gnyis/ /dag pa'i de nyid ces bya ste/ /don dam pa de bdag gis bstan 7/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bcas pa'i sku gsung rdo rje nyid/ /dag pa de la nga gnas nas/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du spyod/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas spangs pa yis/ /chos gnas dag pa gzhan dag med/ /gang la sangs rgyas kun 'byung zhing / /sangs rgyas byang chub rab gnas pa'o/ /dag pa de nyid gnas 26—14

med pas/ /'jigs 1pa nyid du ma byed cig /chos 'byung mi 'gyur zhi ba nyid—/ /rdo rje btsun mo nyid la gnas/ /dud 'gro la sogs 'gro ba kun/ /de las thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /brgyal da 7bar ci yi phyir na yang / /khyod ni 'jigs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas snying po las byung ba/ /de ni de yi chos nyid mchog /snying po'i ye shes mtha' gcig pu/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid 'di skad thos gyur ༅ te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub la gnas nas/ /bye ba kun gyis stod ④byed cing / /phyag 'tshal gzugs kyis ⑪'byung bar 'gyur/ /sems can kun la phan ston pa'i/ /snyan pa'i tshig rnams smra byed pa/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po ni/ /'gro ba'i mgon gyis bshad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gtso yang ḍa dag pa/ /rdo rje theg pa skor mdzad cing / /'gyur ba med cing snang ba med/ /gnas med de nyid bshad du gsol/ /dpa' bo nyon mongs mtsho chen las/ /rgyal bas ji ltar nges sgrol ( ba'i / /de nyid mchog tu ⑤bshad du gsol/ /de nyid kun gyi mchog gi mchog/bzhugs zhes bya ba'i tshig gi mgor13/ /e waṃ tshig gis rnam brgyan pa/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /bde gshegs dngos grub 'byung 'gyur ba'o/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje 'chang / /de ltar gsol 'debs gnas 3gyur nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /go 'phang mchog ni gsung bar mdzad/ /'di lhar sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rdo rje snying po kun bsdus pa/ /shin tu gsang ba phye ⑫mdzad nas/ /rdo rje thugs kyis ⑫bstan pa ltar/ /'di ltar rnam par gnas pa bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag gis bshad par bya/ /bla ma'i muzhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /gsal por thams cad shes byas nas/ /dngos 26—16

grub thams cad kun bsdus pa/ /bzang po de nas bshad par bya/ /rgyud kyi dang por rnam gnas pa/ /snying po las ni snying po mchog /de nyid bde chen mgon po yis/ /gsang ba de nyid ces byar gsungs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sems can kun gyi bde 'byung ba/ /gsang ba 0rtog pa'i dbang rgyal po/ /dpal ldan 'dus par rnam par gnas/ /me waṃ rnam dag yi ge la/ /khams gsum po kun gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang de dpal ldan 'gro mgon gyi3 / /phyag rgya'i mchog gyur brtag ⑤pa nyid/ /de ni shes rab ces byar grags/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri ma med/ /ye shes rdo rje gsum 'byung ba/ /kun rdzob gzugs su rnam par gnas/ /sems can rjes su gzung rtseba'i phyir/ /las kyi phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /mi mo'i lus la brten nas ni/ /sems can kun la phan par mdzad/ /kun khyab dag pa thams cad pa / /shes rab lha mo bla na med/ /gcig pu bzang po 'byung 'gyur ba/ /sems can mgon gyis bsten pa yin/ /mkha' dbyings pho brang nyams dga' na//sna tshogs thugs rje can gnas pa/ /de la bha ga zhes brjod dang / /e waṃ bya ba'i snyeyig gnyis la/ /lus ngag yid kyis ༅sbyor ba yinapa / /sangs rgyas kun gyi de nyid gnas/ /de phyir de nyid mdor bstan dang / /rgyas par bstan pa'i tshul gyis gnas/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rje btsun gyi nang na gnas pa yang / de'i gzhung lugs ma pyanyams pa sbas pa las shin tu sbas pa'i don dam pa'i bdag nyid can gyi rgyud kyi ngo bo nyid dbang du byas nas brjod par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i brtan pa dang / g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi ngo bo de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gyis ④rjes su 26—16

byed pa'i gzugs can/ thugs rdo rje'i skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis snabargyan pa'i skur gyur nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa e waṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas don dam pa'i de kho na nyid sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la don dam pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis ‘ 3nges par ston to/ /don dam pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lha'i gzugs de nyid rgyud kyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du/byang chub sems dpa' bcu bdun gyi go rims kyis nyanges par rdzogs par gyur nas de rab tu ston par mdzad de/ dang po gleng gzhi'i le'u las/ byang chub sems dpa' bcu bdun gyi ming brjod pa'i mtha' na/ ji lhar chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo mngon par bsgoms pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dbang du byas nas brjod de/'di ni re zhig dang po lha'i 7rnal 'byor yin te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid dngos po med pa'i gzugs can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi bdag nyid can du gyur nas/ dam tshig dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /bzlas pa'i cho ga'i lugs sngon du 'gro bas/ sa la sogs pa'i mi mo bzhi'i rigs dang lhan cig nam mkha'i khams su rnam par gnas nas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i longs spyod kyi sgo nas brjod du med pa'i yang brngod du med pa dud 'gro la sogs pa'i sems can gyi rim pa ma lus pa 4 byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi sku mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can/ bde ba mchog gi gtso bo kyidapal pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi don dam pa'i chos nyid kyi dam tshig gi de kho na nyid sgra thos pa na brgyal bar gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bslang bar bya ba'i phyir/ e 26—17

waṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas don dam pa'i de kho na nyid gang yin pa de 'dir brjod par bya'o/ /rgyud kyi dang por gang gnas pa/ /sbas pa de phyir bshad par bya/ /rdo rje btsun mo las byung ba/ /e waṃ rnam dag yi ge nyid/ /e waṃ nam mkha'i khams su brjod/ /ma yā snaphyag rgyar rjes su thob/ /gang zhig de ni ston byed pa/ /thos pa zhes bya 'dir brjod do/ /rtog med kun mkhyen ye shes nyid/ /dus gcig pa yang de yin no/ /bha ga'i gzugs can gang yin te / /nam mkha'i khams zhes bya bar brjod/ /dus gcig na zhes gang bstan pa/ /de mdor bstan pa zhes brjod do/ /nam mkha'i khams zhes bde 'byung ba/ /gang yin bdag gis der brten te1/ /sna tshogs dril bu rnga yab phreng / /dril bu rin chen gyis nyer brgyan/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin kun bzang po/ /gnas kyi mchog der mchod par byed/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes nyer bstan pa/ /gtso bo bdag po thugs nyid do/ /rdo rje btsun mo zhes brjod pa/ /shes rab rgyal ba kun dngos te/ /thams cad ces bya sgra brjod pa//mi bskyod la sogs de bzhin gshegs/ /de yi sku gsung thugs gang yin/ /thugs nyid du ni rnam par gnas/ /rnam dag btsun mo'i bha ga der/ /bde ba chen po rnam par bzhugs/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bo yi / /mchog tu dga' ba'i 1rnam rol cing / /e yi cha byad bzang po la/ /dbus su waṃ gis rnam par brgyan/ /der ni rdo rje 'dzin mchog gnas/ /shes rab las byung zhi ba nyid—/ /der ni sangs rgyas kun 'byung zhing / /de nyid du ni rnam par gnas//ri rab rdul phran grangs snyed kyi/ /mtha' med bskal pa bye ba ru/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /bcas pa'i pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor derapa 3/ /26—18

dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje 'chang / /dpal dang ldan de de na bzhugs/ /nam mkha'i khams zhes bya ba der/ /til gyi gang bu gang zhing mthong / /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pas yongs gang ba/ /yi ge de yis de kho na/ /bstan 3par byas pa'i thabs nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bla med go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar bzhugs zhes bya ba'i tshig /don dam nyid du rnam par gnas/ /gzhan du de nyid rnal 'byor pa'i/ /nyams su myong ba de — mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje thugs sam gzhan yang rung / /dpal ldan bde chen rgyal po ni/ /'dus pa zhes bya byed po gang / /de ni e waṃ 'di rab gnas/ /e waṃ zhes sogs rnam dag dang / /shu ta zhes bya'i yi ge gnyis/ /gsang ba'i tshig gnas nges pa choyang / /rgyud kyi dang por brngod par bya/ /'di dang 'chad par 'gyur ba yis/ /de ni byed pa por 'dod do/ /'dir ni yi ge gnyis po ni/ /rgyud kyi dang por med mi 'dod/ /mchog tu dri med go 'phang ni/ /de ltar rnam dag shes gyur nas—/ /dpal ldan 'dus par gang gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gnas zhi ba/ /dngos grub mchog gyur der shes nas/ /rgyud las khyad par brjod par bya/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzhin gsungs pa/ /dam tshig spyod pa ston pa po/ /dag cing brjod du med pa yi/ /byang chub sems ni thams cad du/ /rab tu rgyas pa'i rgyud thams cad/ /lam nyer ston par rnam par gnas/ /chos 'byung yi ge zhi nyid du/ /brjod du med par rnam par gnas/ /de yi dbye ba mtha' med pa— / /sna tshogs khyab nas rnam par gnas/ /'di ni spun pa 'dra ba yi/ /de yi dbye ba kun spangs la/ /de nyid rnam dag ngo bo nyid/ /26—19

sgrub pa'i thabs ni bdag gis brjod/ /dngos po med pa de nyid ni/ /thabs bcas pad+ma rdo rje skyes/ /dga' bral mchog dga'i bar nyid du/ /mtshon nas gang zhig rnam gnas par/ /rtag tu der gtad yid gnyis 1kyis/ /gang zhig der gnas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sgrub po bsgom — pa ldan pa yis/ /lha yi ye shes nyams myong 'gyur/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi dam pa'i don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las bzhugs pa'i tshig nges par bstan pa'i dule'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gsang ba bshad par bya/ /shes rab thabs ni rnam bsgoms pas//thugs kyi 6rdo rje dran pa nyid/ /gsang ba las kyang gsang ba mchog /rang gi lus la gnas pa yi/ /dag pa gang zhig shes gyur nas/ /gnas bzang por ni gnas par 'gyur/ /de ni bdag gis —yang dag bshad/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rjes 'brang ba'i/ /dngos grub bzang po sgrub pa'i phyir/ /mkha' dbyings lha yi gzhal yas na/ /ji lta ba bzhin yang dag gnas/ /bzang po rang gi skyed byed pa/ /thog ma dbus mthar dri ma med/ /dang po'i las can sems can rnams/ /mtshon cing yid ches byed pa'o/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje kun sbyor ba'i/ /reg las ngo mtshar chen po nyid/ /bde ba gang zhig 'byung 'gyur te/ /mchog tu dga' ba — byed pa'o/ /de zad nas ni dga' bral te/ /gang gi mtha' na dga' bral can/ /rang gi ngo bo bstan med pa'i/ /bdag nyid cung zhig 'byung bar 'gyur / /dbang po kun las rnam grol zhing / /26—20

gnyis med mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /khyab cing rang bzhin med pa yi/ /rtogs pa de ni go 'phang mchog /lha rdzas kun bzang zhes bya ba/ /dga' bral mtha' na rnam par gnas/ /mchog 'di sgrub po rnams kyi ni/ /grol ba'i gnas su rab tu grags/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa de nyid gang / /bde gshegs dam pas gang gsungs pa/ /dngos med mchog tu rnam par dag /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /rang bzhin dag pa de 3nyid ni/ /bdag gis rgyas par bstan par bya/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstan par bya'o/ /gang zhig mkha' dbyings steng du rin chen 'gyur/ /bde ba kun gyi rang bzhin rnam par gnas//dbus su yon tan gyis brgyan sems gyur pa/ /de 'dir skyes bu'i sna rtse zhes byas bstan/ /rtog pa dang bcas sems zhes bya ba der/ /zla ba'i gzugs dang sangs rgyas sku yis khyab/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 1bde ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems zhes de la brjod/ /kun rdzob byang chub sems ni nub gyur cing / /der ni dga' bral zhes bya 'byung 'gyur nas/ /mnyam med sprul pa'i sku yis rdzubargyan gyur cing / /sangs rgyas sna tshogs du mar spro bar byed—/ /gnas skabs gang la dga' bral zhes bya ba'i/ /skad cig bha ga'i dbus su 'byung 'gyur te/ /yungs kar zhes bya'i ming gis ḍa rnam gnas pa/ /de la sprul pa'i sku zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /bde ba'i dngos 'dir longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / /sprul pa'i sbu yang 'gags shing bzhugs gyur pa/ /bdag med rdo rje rim gyis cho ga bzhin/ /kun rtog rnam par rtog pa nges par spangs/ /bdag med rdo rje shin tu dri ma med/ /de nas dga' bral bde ba rnam par spang 4 //26—21

mar la mar bzhag bzhin du skad cig gis/ /byang chub gnas dang lhan cig gcig tu byas/ /der ni dga' zal bde bar snason gyur nas/ /bdag med rdo rje shin tu brtan par bzhugs/ /der ni brjod med zhes byar gang gnas pa//rnam dag byang chub go 'phang kun 'gro ba/ /shes bya'i bdag nyid dpag med mdangs ldan pa'i/ /de nyid bdag nyid lhan cig gzugs bsgom bya/ /dga' bral zhes bya gang gis brjod min pa/ /de yi mtshan —rdzogs bsam mi khyab pa'i gzugs/ /kun du dri ma med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang zhes pa/ /so so rang rig lugs bzhin rig gyur pas/ /don dam rnam dag rgyal ba rnams kyi sku/ /byang chub dam pa mchog gtso de nas bsgom / /bzang po bde ba'i sar gyur kun 'gro ba/ /gsang gsum dri med rin chen de nyid bcas/ /rtag tu sems can don du lung rigs dpas/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor mchog tu rab brtags nas/ /'od zer du ma de nas spro bar bya/ /gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo khams gsum 'di/ /dngos po rang bzhin med par rnam par dpyad/ /de nyid de ni gzung ba la/ /'bad pa'i thabs bzhin spyod min pas/ /bla ma'i 1zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /shes nas blo dang ldan pas bsgom/ /bdag nyid dri med zhi ba yis ——/ /de nyid de dang ldan gyur pas/ /las kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa yang / /'dir ni 'grub 'gyur the chos med—/ /las kyi phyag rgya mnyam ldan pas/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas/ / bde ba gsungs pas mngon sum du/ /'di 'dra'i bsgom pa gang gsungs pa//dang po'i las can sems can la/ /las kyi phyag rgya gang spangs nas/ /byang chub sems ni rab bstan pa/ /gzhan gyi mtshon pas mi 'thob ste/ /dang po'i 26—22

las pas rig bya ba/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri med pa/ /gnas te gzhan du nus ma yin/ /de lha'i de nyid mchog zhi ba/ /mkha' dbyings zhes byar gnas pa ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor dang / /yang dag rang bzhin gyis thob 'gyur/ /kun du 'gro ba de nyid ni/ /dang po'i las pas gzung ba'i phyir/ /mkha' dbyings pho brang bzang po ru/ /spub po mchog gis thob par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das mchog gang yin te/ /bde ba'i ngo bo dngos med pa/ /de ni phyag rgya la brten nas/ /rang gi rig pa'i ngo bor gnas/ /shes rab thabs dag rnam bsgoms pas/ /de ltar de nyid shes byas la/ /chos 'byung mi 'gyur zhi ba nyid//ji lha ba bzhin rnam par gnas/ /ngo mtshar mchog gyur rdo rje can/ /de yi tshe na bskrub 7par bya/ /rang lus thabs dang ldan pa'am/ /yang na las kyi phyag rgyas so/ /las kyi phyag rgya'i 4 pad+mar gnas/ /mtshon du med par gang gnas pa—/ /gong dang nyagong du bsgom bapa yis/ /zhi dpal rdo rje 'dzin par mtshan⑤//de ni bdag gis thams cad bstan/ /gzhan yang bdag gis bstan par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ /de nyid ldan pas bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya med par lha rdzas nyid/ /de bzhin sgrub pos 'thob par 'gyur/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya khro rgyu can/ /ye shes phyag rgya yang de bzhin/ /rnam rtog mang ba spang 3byas la/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam bsgom bya/ /rnam par g.yeng ba kun 'byung ba'i—/ /bud med phyag rgya rnam spangs la/ /rang lus thabs dang ldan pa yis //phyag rgya chen po bsten par bya/ /rang gi rigs —pa'i lha rdzas de/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog tu dag tshe /tha mal lus la brten nas gnas/ /shes rab chung 26—23

bas mthong mi 'gyur/ /mi 'gyur ba yi rang lus de/ /mchog gcig gis ni shes par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i bka' drin shāganang ba la/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnam par gnas/ /rtswa shing 'khri shing la sogs la/ /kun du gnas par 'gyur ༅ba yang / /mi ni thabs dang bral ba yis/ /me ni mthong bar 'gyur ma yin/ /thabs dang bral na nam du yang / /lha rdzas yon tan kun 'byung ba/ /gnyug ma'i lus la gnas na yang / /shes rab de bzhin mthong mi 'gyur/ /ji ltar bur 4 shing khu ba dang / /til la til mar ji bzhin pa/ /de bzhin lus la thams cad du/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gnas/ /lha rdzas mchog de thams cad la/ /rnam par gnas par shes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis skyed byed pa / /shes rab lha mo bla na med/ /khams gsum ma lus pa 'di dag /gang gis thams cad gsal byed pa/ /mya ngan 'das pa gnas dngos kyi/ /thog ma bar mtha' dam par mdzadakyi/ /de ltar shes nas 'bad pa yis— / /shes rab pha rol phyin zhi ba/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi 7/ /dbang phyug mchog gis khyab par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sems la 'dod gyur pa/ /de ni de nas bsgom par bya/ /thabs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub rab tu sprul/ /de dang lhan cig tshol byed pas/ /de nyid bdag gis rtag tu rig /nyin dang mtshan du bsgom 'gyur na/ /'di ni thob 'gyur the tshom med/ /sbyon pa'i gzugs la brten nas ni/ /gsal por skye bos 7smod byed cing / /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis/ /byang chub yangs pa bsgom par bya/ /mchog tu mya ngan 'das gsungs pa/ /dag cing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rang lus de nyid blo ldan gyis/ /de dang ldan pa bsgom par bya/ /26—24

dngos grub kun sbyin grub ①pa'i thabs/ /phung po lnga yi bdag lus nyid/ /ji ltar gsang ba gnas gyur pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po rtogs byas pas/ /dpa' bo ji lhar rdzogs 'gyur ba/ /mchog tu gyur pa ②rang gi lus/ /shin tu gsang ba dag 1gis bshad/ /blo ldan dngos po mi bsgom zhing /dngos med pha rol ring du spangs/ /gcig gis rtag par 'dzin gyur cing / /gzhan dag gis ni stong nyid du'o/ /rtag dang chad pa'i sbyor ba las/ /mchog tu 'dzin pa zag pa gang / /ye shes ci zhig 'byung 'gyur ba/ /thog ma dbus mtha' dri ma med/ /gtso bo rtag pa mchog tu zhi/ /rgyu dang dpe ni rnam spangs pa/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /rtag tu 'byung zhing 'gyur ba med/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /der gnas sgom 5dang ldan gyur pas /sangs rgyas kyi yang ⑦spyod yul min/ /der 7mi bgrod dang bgrod bya med/ /bgrod par 'gyur ba 'ga' yang med/ /sgom dang sgom bya sgom pa po/ /don dam par na yod ma yin/ /dpe las 'das shing brjod du med/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /mtshan ma med cing rdul dang bral/ /mya ngan 'das zhes de la bshad/ /gang la mchog ces brjod bya ste/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon par gnas/ /lha rdzas longs spyod grol ster ba/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog /bzang po'i gnas de sems can la/ /skal ba ji bzhin rab tu bstan/ /gcig nyid gnyis su rnam par 'gyur1/ /bsam pa'i dbye bas mchog nyid de/ /lha rdzas mya ngan 'das pa'i gzugs/ /dag cing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /bud med skye bo rtsasogs gzugs kyis/ /thams cad du ni rnam 26—26

par gnas/ /dbang po las 'das zhi ba gang / /brjod snamed kun du 'gro ba mchog /'phel zhing 'grib las rnam grol ba/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhes brjod pa/ /cung zad rdzas su 'du shes gang / /thams cad de las kun du 'byung / /khams gsum pa yi lam bzang po/ /kun du de ni rnam par gnas/ /de ni dngos grub sa bon te/ /dngos grub rnams kyi go 'phang mchog /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas mchog ste/ /bde ba can zhes mngon par brjod/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /thams cad 'di las nges par 'byung / /khams gsum ma lus pa 'di dag /thams cad bde ba nyid du gnas/ /gang gis gzugs ni shes min zhing / /gang zhig tshig dang blo spangs la/ /za dang dri dang ro las 'das/ /blo yi yul las gang 'das pa/ /de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa/ /mchog tu bde ba'i gzugs gang zhig /rang gi ②dbang gis 'jug 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur④/ /gsang sngags bye ba grangs med kyang / /de las ku nges par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bden pa gsung ba'i lung gis 'ga'/ /bden par gyur pa'i rim ston pa'i/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /de ltar de des shes byas la/ /thabs gang gis ni de yi dngos/ /mchog tu brjod med gang thob pa/ /blo ldan de nyid rang lus la/ /sngags pa'i ༅de nyid bsgrub — par bya/ /dngos po med pa dang bsres la/ /rtse gcig sems dang ldan pa yis྾ / /thabs bzang po dang ldan byas nas/ /yang dang yang du ngal bar bya/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam spangs pas / /dus mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /shin tu sbas pa'i rab sbyin dang / /rig pa yi rtsani gang shes dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pa'i/ /26—26

dag pa'i bdag nyid gang bsgom snabya/ /gsang ba grub pa la gnas pa'i/ /dngos grub des ni gdon mi za/ /las kyi phyag rgya ldan pa 'am/ /yang na phyag rgya chen po yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs gyur pa/ /'di ni chos nyid mchog yin no/ /snying po'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag med gnas 'di ma gtogs pa'i/ /rnam dag dngos grub gzhan dag med/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs med pa/ /gang las sangs rgyas 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /shes rab lha mo bla na med/ /'di ni pha rol zhes byar brjod—/ /gal te shes nas bsgoms ba gyur na/ /sems can kun gyi grol ster 'gyur| /sngar bstan cho ga'i rim pa yis/ /dag pa'i de nyid gang bsgoms pa—/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam dag pas/ /bdag nyid rdo rje kun las skyes—/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /tha mal pa yi lus spangs nas/ /lha rdzas nga rgyal ldan yid kyis/ /thabs dang yang dag ldan pa dang / /ting 'dzin mchog la rnam gnas nas/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i 1tshig bzhin du/ /de ni 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /gang zhig phyag rgya che ldan pas/ /bde ba chen po myong gyur pa/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog bzang po/ /de ni brjod par nus pa yin/ /rang gi rig pa'i de nyid de/ /gzhan gyis brjod par nus mi 'gyur/ /gus dang bsgom pas rtogs 'gyur gyi/ /de ni gzhan du rtogs mi nus/ /de nyid shes nas nyin mtshan du/ /gus pas bsgom par bya ba yin/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i go 'phang mchog /bde ba zhi ba bla med der/ /der ni gus pa'i stobs nyid dang / /bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis gang sprul pa/ /der ni 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i gzugs/ /kun dga' 26—27

las byung ci yang mchog /spro zhing sdud par byed pa can/ /gsal por yud kyis byung gyur pa/ /sa 'og sa bla sa steng tsa3'di/ /rgyu dang rgyu min snang bar byed—/ /de nyid bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis ni kyi/ /thabs dang shes rab dngos zhi ba/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam grol zhing / /mtshan rnams kun gyis rnam brgyan pa/ /stong nyid ye shes las byung zhes/ /gnyis med mchog tu zhi ba nyid//rnam pa kun du mchog ldan zhing / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /rnam dag ye shes sgyu ma'i dngos/ /gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /sgra dang dri dang ro las 'das/ /de bzhin reg pa rnam par spangs/ /ting 'dzin ye shes mig gnyis kyis/ /mchog gcig pu de mthong bar 'gyur/ /bzang po grib ma'i sgyu 'dra nga / /'du byed bzang po dang ldan pa/ /me yis thag pa bsregs pa bzhin/ /nyon mongs 'ching ba las grol ba/ /rnam pa sna tshogs lus rnams dang — / /ye shes rlabs kyis phring las sprome / /dbang po'i gzhu dang 'dra ba'i sku/ /de nyid bsgoms — pas thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i nus pa dang / /dam tshig rnams ni bskyang byas pas/ /rgyal ba yis kyang brjod med pa'i/ /de 'dra'i kazugs ni thob par 'gyur/ /gang du lus ngag sems med pa'i/ /gnas gang kun 'gro mchog gyur pa 4/ /der ni yang dag bsten dbang gis/ /rang bzhin bsgom par gyur la ltos/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar byed pa'o/ /e ma ho zhi ba dbang po las/ /e ma ho skumachog tu zhi ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ /lha yi rnal 'byor mchog nyid kyimu / /rim gyis 'di 'dra thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /de nas spyod pa spyad par bya/ /nyon mongs kun nas chobral ba'i 26—28

gnas—/ /rngod 1dang brjod bya rnam spangs la/ /'bad pa nyid kyis ༅ mngon sum du/ /spub pa pos ni yang dang yang / /brtan pa'i sems kyis nges par yang / /gsang ba'i spyod pa spyad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis—/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs la/ /lha rdzas gar dang dgod sogs kyis / /ji ltar skyo ba mi skye bar/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa la mos pas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gsang ba spyad/ /brtul zhugs dang ldan der gnas nas//der gtad bsgom pa dang ldan pas/ /nyon mongs thams cad mthar byas la/ /go 'phang mchog ni baspub kyipar bya/ /rgyun du mchog tu gsang ba ste/ /bla ma'i zhal ④la rab gnas pas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub bzang ster ba/ /de ni thams cad bdag gis bshad/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi dam pa'i don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba 3dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las mngon par byang chub par rje bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //dang po'i las can 3sems can gyis/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa nyid—/ /cung zhig rgyas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /de nas da ni bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan 'dus par yongs gsal bar/ /'gro ba'i mgon pos gang gsungs pa—/ /gong ma gong ma'i lam nyid kyis/ /bsgom par bya ba bzhi po nyid/ /dang po yi ge dgod par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas pache/ /spub po'i dbang pos bsgom bya ba/ /gnyis pa rang gi rang bzhin nyid/ /gsum pa bzang po mchog gyur pa/ /ye shes phyag rgya rnam par bsgom/ /bzhi pa gong 26—29

mar gang gsungs pa/ /phyag rgya chen por dam par bsgom/ /de ltar de nyid bzhi po ni/ /'di dag la ni yang dag gnas/ /bsgom pa dag gis gang bstan pa/ /de dag bdag gis so sor bshad/ /yi ge dgod pa'i sbyor ba yis//bsgom par bya ba gang gsungs pa/ /sems can dang po'i las can rnams/ /gzhug par bya phyir gang gsungs pa/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnam gnas parngo/ /dang po re zhig bstan par bya/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam nyid du/ /gcig nyid rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yi/ /ye shes mchog tu dge ba nyid/ /ji ltar bstan par shes gyur nas/ /rtag tu gnas de 'dir bshad bya/ /gong ma gong ma'i rim nyid kyis/ /thugs kyi rdo rje gang gsungs pa//yi ge dgod pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid pakyi / /bzang po nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs pa yi/ /kun 'gro'i ye shes rnam dag pa/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri ma med/ /chos rnams kyi ⑤ni ngo bo gang / /so so'i gzugs su gang gnas pa/ /bdag med gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'bad pa nyid kyis so sor brtag /spros pa thams cad las grol ba'i/ /gzugs gang mchog ni zhi ba nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo shes/ /ye shes 'di la 'di rab grags/ /gnas bzang po der gnas nas ni / /nyon mongs thams cad rnam spangs la/ /sems can rnams kyi don bya gang / /gzugs kyi mchog nyid dmigs par bya/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis5/ /shes rab dang ni bcas par gzugs/ /gsal po'i rnam par 'byung 'gyur ba — / /mtshan rnams kun gyis dam par brgyan/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /gzugs kamed mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /26—30

dang zhing skyon bral dri ma med/ /phyag rgya chen por rjes rig bya/ /gzugs de las ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /de yi gzugs brnyan ltar byed pa/ /sgyu ma'i rjes spub ༅bzang po gang / /rnal 'byor phyag rgya gzugs ldan pa'i/ /dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /gzugs brnyan yid kyi rang bzhin nyid/ /yon tan mtha' med 'byung 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi mkhyen pa'i/ /dpal ldan me long ming can du/ /ye shes de la brjod par bya/ /dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin du/ /der ni 'gog pa'i ye shes gang / /de yi rang bzhin rnal 'byor ldan/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes brjod do/ /rgyas pa can 3zhes bya ba gang / /lha rdzas bud med dkyil 'khor ro/ /'bad pas so sor rtogs gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ༅kun gyi gnas/ /bdag med gnas kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /lha rdzas nam mkha'i khams kyi gnas ༅/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi pho brang mchog /phra mo'i rnal 'byor sbyor gcig pas/ /ji srid de la rtogs gyur — 3pas/ /rtogs pa cung zhig bskul gyur pa/ /de srid de ni mthong bar gyur / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /srid gsum gnas na gang gnas pa/ /gang zhig gnas pa de dag kun/ /til gyi gong ༅bu bzhin 'dir mthong / /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pas yongs gang ba/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni 'od chen po/ /bzang po de ni mthong gyur nas/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi gnas bzang por/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni brtag par bya/ /der ni de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /da lhar bzhugs dang gang 'das dang / /gang dag 'byung bar 'gyur ④ba dag /de dag kun gyi sgyu7gnas mchog ni/ /dag cing dang ba 26—31

dri med de/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis tsamachod/ /ye shes de ni mdor bsdus na/ /so sor rtog pa zhes byar brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i pho brang du—/ /'bad pas so sor rtogs ④pa nyid/ /de yi phyir na ②nyams len pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i nom 'phrul pas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor kun 'gengs shing / /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can gyi — 7/ /sa la sogs pa'i rim pa yis/ /byang chub sems ni yang dag spro/ /gang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /der ni nges par bsgrub (1par bya/ /rtag dang mi bskyod rin chen cherngo / /rigs la sogs par gang gnas pa/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rig ma'i skyes bu bsgom par bya/ /bzang po'i rgyan dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya chen po rjes rig pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ༅ bas/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can gyis / /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs ldan pa'i/ /ye shes rlabs kyi phreng ba spros//bya ba nan tan ye shes zhes/ /mchog tu gyur pa de la brjod/ /gang la rgyal ba rnams 'byung bad/ /gang du phyag rgya byin brlabs — pas/ /ting 'dzin lnga po 'dir gnas pas/ /gang zhig yang dag 'byung 'gyur bas/ /mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yisarkya/ /ye shes zhes ni 'di rab grags/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas par/ /de yi khyad par brjod pa yin/ /lha dgod rnal 'byor ldan pa yis tsa/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnam par gnas/ /khams drug pa dag mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ /rim gyis 4yum gyur bzhi po dang / /khro bo sems dpa' de dang mtshungs/ /'khor bcas pa yi byang chub sems/ /bcu drug dag dang mnyam ldan pa'i/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /de bzhin dpe byad brgyado cur 6ldan/ /mngon par byang chub 26—32
