rnam lnga zhes/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa yin/ /rtag dang mi bskyod 1 rin chen gyi②/ /rigs la sogs pa yang dag gnas/ /de ltar rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /rnam par rtog pas ༅rgyas gang laji/ /dang po'i las can sems can gyis‘ / /bsgom par bya ba rtsigasungs pa yin/ /'khor lo'i rim par bsgom bcas pa/ /'di ni phyi rol zhes bshad de/ /yi ge dgod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dang po nyid du gang gnas pa'o/ /sems can dang po'i las can la/ /las kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa yi4 / /rnam par gnas pa'i sar — gnas gang / /gong ma mchog gi go 'phang yin/ /byin kyis brlabs pa'i gnas bsgoms te/ /de nyid mchod pa rab tu brtag /de nyid dpal ldan 'dus par ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas mchog tu gsungs/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa nyung ldan pas/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor bas/ /'di ni bsgom pa gnyis pa ste/ /rang gi ngo bo yin zhes grags/ /gsum pa de ni bstan pa ste/ /nang gi go 'phang bsgom pa yin/ /rnam pa kun ni mchog ldan pa'i/ /ye shes phyag rgya rab brtags sgyupa'o/ /bzhi pa gong na med pa'i rgyu/ /mngon par byang chub byed pa po/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam bsgom pa/ /de yi gong na gzhan med pa'o/ /dbang po kun las rnam grol zhing / /'byung ba'i spyod pa sbas gyur pa/ /zhi zhing grub pa myur ster la/ /bla ma'i zhal las rab gnas pa'o/ /gcig min du ma ma yin zhing / /rlabs med snang ba med pa dang / /thams cad kyi 8ni bde gnas pa/ /mchog tu dga' ba byed pa po/ /rang sems tsam du shes par bya/ /nyon mongs tshogs ni 'gag 'gyur zhing / /dam pa'i shes rab 'gyur ba'i ༅lus/ /de ltar rgyud kyi rim shes nas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor mchog 26—33

nyid dang / /gong ma gong ma'i lam nyid kyis/ /drag 3po min pas gang mos ༅pa / /de dag thams cad nges btang la/ /rim pa bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /phyag rgya chen por 'bad pa yis/ /sngags pas rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /grub pa thams cad rab sbyin zhing / /thabs kyi mchog dang bcas par ni/ /de dag bsgom pa dang ldan na/ /tshe 'di nyid la ⑤grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sems ni bla med pas/ /skye ba med pa ④gang rtokas pa/ /de yi dngos med shes rab ste/ /thabs nyid ⑤rab tu bskul ba nyid/ /de ltar de nyid shes pa la//phyag rgya chen po rnam par bsgom/ /de nas thabs dang bcas gyur pas/ /gang 'dod pa yi brtul zhugs bya/ /sangs rgyas gos med zhi ba 'am/ /de bzhin nor gyi bdag po 'am/ /yang na brtul zhugs chen po 'am/ /yang na sems la 'dod pa'o/ /bshad par gyur pa shes byas la/ /brtul zhugs ma yin shes pa nyid/ /blo dang ldan pas shes bya ba/ /rgyud ༷ las gzhan dag bshad pa yi/ /dor ba'i brtul zhugs kun mi bya/ /mchog tu gyur pa yin par 'dod/ /de las yid la gang 'dod pa/ /spyad pa med par spyad par bya/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rjes su 'brangs 4 gyur pa/ /lam mchog dpe med 'bad pas shes byas la/ /brtan pa'i blo yis kudag pa de nyid gcig /phyi rol dri ma ma lus spangs byas nas/ /bde ba'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan gnyug ma'i gzugs/ /'du 'dzi dri ma spangs la bsgom par bya/ /ye shes rang bzhin rjes 'brel nyin mtshan du / /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur bstan pa nyid/ /dga' ba'i dbang phyug dang ldan dga' ba'i sems/ /rtag tu byang chub la bzhugs bsgom pa'i sems 'brel ba/ /dri ma ma lus zad par gyur pa yis/ /'khor ba'i 'ching 26—34

ba rnams ni spang bar bya/ /bde ba'i go 'phang mchog gyur brtan pa'i sems kyis bsgom/ /rtag tu goms par byas pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /bdag nyid de nyid rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /dri ma'i rab rib spangs dag mthong ba bzang /gcig tu gsang ba'i sa phyogs yon tan brgya yi gzhir gyur ri 'am khyim stong ngam//skyed tshal nyid tsadadang brag phug dur khrod dag gam sa phug nyams dga' 'am/ /de ltar dri med byas pa'i sa phyogs dag tu bzang po mtshon cing bzung / /yul gyi bde ba skyed byed de nyid rin chen rdo rje can gyis 'du 'dzi spangs la bsgom/ /rnal 'byor pa ni thams cad kyang / /de nyid lam la rab chags pas/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /de ni 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ②lam gyis ni/ /gzhan dag tu yang 'gyur ba yin/ /skye ba du ma dag gis kyang / /'dir ni gcig gis 'byung bar 'gyuracho/ /de ltar the chos med shes nas/ /shes rab thabs kyis zhebasgom pa yis/ /phyi rol rnam pa sna tshogs kyi/ /bya ba'i bye brag yongs spangs la/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam 'bras bcas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub rab ster ba/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis④ / /blo ldan gsang ba spub 3par spyad/ /yul dang dus dang gza' rnams dang / /rgyu skar phyi rol dkyil 'khor rnams/ /med pa'i 1gsang ba rdo rje can/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di bshad par bya/ /nges par brtul zhugs gso sbyong sogs/ /yi ge brjod pas bsgom pa yin rme/ /'di ltar dngos grub gang brtags pa/ /spyod pa dka' bas brtags pa yin/ /yi ge brtags pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /kha dog dbye bas mtshon bya ba/ /sems can kun gyi bsam ⑫dbang gis/ /dpal ldan gsang bar gang gsungs pa/ /26—36

dkyil 'khor dag ni gang gsungs pa/ /rigs nyid so sor ༅so so dang / /phyag rgya'i dbye ba sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin sngags kyi dbye ba rnams/ /mchod dang bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / /rigs kyi dbye ba du ma nyid/ /ting 'dzin dbye ba bye ba yis1/ /lha rnams su ni brtags pa dang / /dus nges pa yi bye brag rnams/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yi/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu ba dang / /sbyor ba du ma nyid dag ④ni/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma rnams/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis tsagang gnas pa/ /'khor bar rab tu 'ching byed pa'i/ /khams gsum pa yis 4 bstan pa'i lam/ /de kun dngos po med gyur pa'i/ /ye shes mchog gi rnam 'phrul yin/ /rtog med rnam par dag pa ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu kun du song / /'dod chags zhe sdang gti nug dang / /de bzhin gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /dang po'i rnal 'byor ngo bo yis/ /ji srid kun la rnam par spyod/ /chos dang chos min mtshan nyid kyis / /thams cad mngon du brtags pa can/ /bdag med gnas kyi sbyor ba yis/ /ji srid brtan par ma brtags pa'o/ /rnam par mi rtog gnas pa med/ /dag cing rang bzhin dri ma med—/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i mthar thug pa/ /khams gsum 'di dag thams cad nyid/ /lam gyis 1so sor brtags byas nas/ /phung po'i bden pa yod ma yin/ /su zhig gis ni so sor rtogasapa / /'dir ni gang la brtag par bya/ /'bad pas de nyid de kho na/ /ji srid rab tu rtsabartag byas pa/ /de srid thams cad 'od gsal te/ /rnam dag rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol zhing / /spros pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang rtogs min na/ /skye bo gzhan gyis smos ci dgos/ /rtag dang chad pa 26—36

las grol zhing / /kun 'gro mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /dngos med snang ba med pa yi—/ /byang chub sems dpas phyag byas pa'o/ /yon tan med cing nga rgyal med—/ /mtshan ma med cing sgrib pa med/ /'grib dang 'phel las rnam grol ba—/ /ngag gi spyod yul dag las 'das/ /de las 1'gro dang 'ong ba dang / /'dir ni 'gro ba po 'ga' med/ /bsgom dang sgom pa bsgom —bya dag /don dam par na yod ma yin/ /de nyid mchog gyur gcig pu nyid/ /byang chub sems zhes rab tu brjod/ /dbye ba sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /bye ba snyed du rab rgyas pa/ /bzang po kun 'gro rnam dag ste/ /ming gcig nyid kyis gnas pa min/ /sems can bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /khams gsum kun du rab tu khyab/ /zhi ba rnams kyis 3de nyid mchog /rig byed smra ba tshangs pa zer—/ /sangs rgyas pa rnams byang chub mchog /gos med pa rnams srog ces zer—/ /grangs can rig pa rnams la sogs/ /dbye ba gang zhig rnam brtags pa/ /de dag brjod par ga la nus/ /sna tshogs nyid la khyab gnas nas / /rnam pa sna tshogs ngo bo rnams/ /des ni smra bar nus ma yin/ /bzang po'i dbye bas gang gnas pa/ /yang dag mtha' nyid du mar bstan/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mi rtogs pa/ /rdo rje can mchog gang yin te/ /khams gsum ma lus 'di dag ni/ /thams cad 'di las kun du 'byung / /zhi zhing dag pa'i gnas gang de/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /brjod med kun 'gro'i gnas yin te/ /'di kun de yi rnam 'phrul yin/ /cung zad dngos grub mtshan nyid gang / /thams cad de la rnam par gnas/ /spros pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo nyid/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rnam par bskor—/ /khams gsum 26—37

rnam dag 'di thams cad/ /sa bon shes rab las byung kun/ /mtshan ma med cing mchog tu zhi/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i rjes 'jug pa/ /mang po dag ni gcig pa nyid / /ji srid yod pa'i bud shing kun/ /stong pa'i me yis ༅ma bsregs pya par / /sgrub pa po yis — ji ltar mthong / /lha ba'i bud shing phung po rnams/ /stong nyid me yis bsreg byas nas/ /'dir ni mnyam nyid la gnas na/ /de bzhin yid kyi me yang 'gag /bsam gtan shes rab mig sman gyis/ /ji srid bsku bar 5ma byas pa/ /de 4 srid lta ngan rab rib rnams/ /dri ma med par ji ltar 'byur/ /dngo po brtan dang g.yo ba kun/ /'bad pas de ltar rnam sbyangs nas/ /bdag med go 'phang la gnas la/ /de nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya/ /bdag gis gong du gang smras pa'i/ /lha yi dal 'byor shes byas la/ /de ni 'bad pas bsgom byas na/ /'di ni 'grub 'gyur the chos med//sangs rgyas nges par sgrub par byed pa yi/ /cho ga rkang gnyis mchog gis nges par gang bstan pa/ /spyod pa du mas mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur mi pa'i rgyud du gsal/ /de srid de ni ma bsten yon tan ldan pa'i dngos grub 'gyur ma bar mi 'gyur btsa/ /shes nas mkhas pa rnams kyis spyod pa dang ldan cho ga bzhin du bsgrub pa brtsamakyi/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa 6zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las mngon par byang chub pa lnga skubastan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dpal ldan gsang ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sgrub pa'i thabs//26—38

yang dag spyod pa sbas gyur pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnam par g.yeng ba'i dgra gsod cing / /dge bzang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyis/ /rol mo'i las kyis baspub 4par bya/ /dbang basbur ba ni mchog bzang po/ /dpal ldan 'dus par rjes 'gro bas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ༄ dbang bskur nas/ /bzang po dngos grub rab tu baspub/ /de bzhin 'dod chags rab gnas nas/ /lha'i rnal 'byor der gnas pas/ /gsang ba grub par rab gnas na/ /sgrub po gang phyir 'grub par 'gyur/ /bzang po ye shes goms byas shing / /spyod pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /gnyis pa thams cad las grol bas/ /gang du 'dod pa de ru gnas/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /gsang ba grub pa mdor bsdus nas/ /dngos grub rnams kyi go 'phang mchog /de ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ /gang zhig skye ba du ma yis / /dngos grub thob par 'dod 'gyur ba/ /des ni gsang ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /gnyis pa thams cad spang bar bya/ /dge ba thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyud/ /'dus pa zhes bya'i dbang bskur bas/ /bzang po dngos grub sbyin byed pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ /de nas rang 'dod la gnas shing / /dang po'i rnal 'byor gcig katad pas/ /bla ma'i zhal las byung ba yi⑤/ /rnal 'byor rin chen goms par bya/ /dpal ldan bde ba'i mgon po yis/ /mchog tu gsang zhing sbas pa yi / /shin tu sbas pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /gzugs bzang yon tan 'byung 'gyur ba/ /phyag rgya 'bad pas rnyed gyur nas/ /rgyud kyi spyod pa dang ldan pas/ /slob dpon la ni dbul bar bya/ /phyag rgyar 26—39

bcas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /gus pas 1'o ma mar me dang / /dri dang phreng rgyan chen gyis/ /de nas blo dang ldan pas mchod/ /de la gus par ka mchod bya zhing / /blo dang ldan pas cho ga bzhin/ /bla ma phyag rgyar ldan mthong nas/ /rtog pa'i cho ga'i rim pa bzhin/ /pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga ni/ /sa la rab tu btsugs byas la/ /bstod pa'i rgyal pos dardo rje can/ /cho ga bzhin du brjod par bya/ /kun mkhyen sa kun dbang phyug pa/ /kun gyi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i bdag /thugs kyi bdag po dpa' bo che/ /dpa' bo gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod—/ /'byung po kun bdag bdag nyid gnas/ /rdo rje ye shes gsum 'byung ba/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad hūṃ mdzad pa/ /nyon mongs mthar mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i sku/ /chos bdag med pa las byung ba/ /ye shes bdud rtsi phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /dpal chen ye shes chen po pa/ /gzi bajid chen po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag chen dpa' bo chen po ste/ /stobs chen mchod pa chen po pa / /bdud mthar byed pa dpa' chen po/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skye dang gnas dang sdud pa yi/ /byed pa por 'gyur 'gro ba'i gtso—/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin nyid/ /ngo mtshar mchog gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes rnam shes zhes bya ba'i/ /lam du 'jug 'gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma las byung phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /cho ga bzhin du gsol btab nas/ /sems can kun la phan 'dod pas/ /snyan pa'i tshig ni brjod 26——40

par bya/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /ye shes bla med bya ba shes/ /de ltar dbang bskur kyirin chen gyis/ /mgon pos bdag ni dbang bskur — —mdzod—/ /dpal ldan bde ba'i mgon po yis/ /dpal ldan chos kyi rdo rje la//gsang ba'i 1de nyid bstan pa ltar/ /mgon pos de bzhin bka' drin gsol/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa/ /dmyal ba nas ni gtso bos drongs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad mthar — mdzad pa/ /mgon med bdag la thugs rje mdzod/ /khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /de phyir sangs rgyas mchog gnang mdzod/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ka mchog /bzang po de ltar thos — gyur nas/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed de/ /bla ma dpal ldan yon tan mtshos/ /bzhin ni rab tu dad gyur pa / /rjes su brtse miphyir rab dga' bas/ /gsang zhing mchog tu gsang gyur pas/ /dam tshig de nas thob par bya/ /bu yis srog chags gsad par bya/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang blang bar bya/ /gzhan gyi chung ma bsten par bya/ /'di ni cho ga mdor bsdus pa'i—/ /phyag rgya chen po nges bsten 6pas/ /'di ni rtag tu bya ba yin/ /dam tshig bzhi po 'di nyid ni/ /bzang po khyod kyis rtag tu bsten1 —/ /de ltar dam tshika thos gyur nas/ /bzang po dngos grub kun ster ba/ /phyag rgya dang ni ldan gyur pa'i/ /slob dpon thugs rje ldan pa yisaka/ /rdo rje pad+ma snyoms 'jug cing / /yang dag rab sbyin la gnas nas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bskyed 0gyur pas/ /ji lta ba bzhin rnam par gnas/ /'bad pas gsung gi rdo rje yisatshi/ /pad+ma las byung blang bar bya/ /khrag dang khu ba rnams bsres la/ /26—41

slob dpon mchog gis mchod pa'i phyir/ /mi yi thod par blugs nas ni/ /bshang gci rdo rje chur ldan pas/ /de nas slob ma bkug byas la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 3byin brlabs nas/ /gnyug ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ /dam tshig de ni sbyin par bya/ /dngos grub kun gyi gnas gyur cing / /sangs rgyas byin brlabs lam gyur pas/ /rdo rje slob ma de nyid rig /cho gas de ltar gtad byas pas/ /rang gi phyag rgya dam tshig ni/ /bzang ldan rgyud nas gsungs pa nyid/ /shin tu bzhin bzang ‘1 mig yangs ma/ /rtag tu byang chub sems la dga'/ /mā ma tī ltar yang dag pa/ /rab dga' gos ni rnam spangs ma/ /'di ni yang dag mchod byas nas/ /phyag rgya'i pad+ma rnam gnas pa//sngon bzhin spyod pa'i slob ma ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis pa la/ /bkra shis brjod pa'i tshig gis ni/ /dbyangs ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /rnga yab rgyal mtshan gdugs la sogs 1/ /phreng ba tsan+dan la sogs mchod/ /phyag rgya'i dbang bskur rin chen gyis/ /dam tshig la gnas brtan par gzhag /khams gsum pa yi dbang bskur nas/ /slob mas thal mo sbyar byas la de la rjes gnang sbyin bya ste/ /rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /chos kyi rdo rje gang 'dod par/ /chos kyi 5'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /rdo rje sems dpas gsungs gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog gis bshad par gyis/ /de ltar bstan pas slob ma la/ /yang dag par sbyin rab sbas dang / /phyag rgya rin chen dbang bskur dang / /rjes su gnang ba'i khyad par gyis/ /rgyud kyi don la des byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rim 'byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' 26—42

rnams kyis bstan/ /sems can mchog gis bshad par byis/ /'di lta bu yi dbang bskur bas/ /sgrub pa'i nges pa byas gyur nyid/ /de nyid bsgoms tsapas ngal gyur pas/ /nges par mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges byas nas/ /lugs bcas rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam spangs la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya bsgrub( / /lugs bcas rim pa de nyid nges pa'i blo ldan bsgom 1gyur rdo rje can/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bzang po rab dga'i yid can dngos grub don kun sgrub/ /mi yi ④ tshe 'di nyid la 'grub 'gyur dpal ldan gsang grub la gnas nas/ /thabs bzang kadag dang ldan pas brjod med mchog gyur go 'phang dam par 'gro/ /de ltar thams cad shes byas la/ /rim pa ji bzhin gnas byas te/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rim pa yis/ /ji ltar yang dag bstan pa ltar/ /de nas rang 'dod la rab gnas ྾ / /gsang ba grub pa la gnas pa'i/ /dngos grub bzang po la 'bad pas/ /rigs kun la ni kun du spyod/ /yang na phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pas/ /rgod dang phreng la sogs bzang po/ /sems ni spro bar byed pa can/ /chags med gsang ba grub pa yis/go 'phang mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam spangs la/ /mchog tu dga' ba spel bar byed/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par sdud par byed pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las sgrub pa phyag rgya chen po mngon par bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //26—43

gsang ba'i spyod pa dge 'byung zhing / /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed byed la / /g.yeng ba'i sgra rnams zad byed pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /rkang pa brkyang 3ba spangs nas ni/ /'khor ba'i mngag gzhug dor nas su ⑤/ /rtag tu brtson dang ldan yid kyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rtag tu bsnyub1/ /rgod dang 'gyod dang gnyid la sogs/ /'bad pas rab tu spang bar bya/ /gzhan du bskal pa bye ba ni/ /brgyar yang dngos grub 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mgon po rdo rje slob dpon la/ /dngos po kun gyis ༅phyag byas nas/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i gzugs/ /gsang ba'i dngos grub yang dag spyad/ /mtshan ma med cing snang ba med/ /rang gi lus kyis 3thabs ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /'bad pas rab tu bsgom par bya/ /'bad pas de ltar shes byas nas/ /rdo rje'i rang bzhin kun dbang po/ /sngags pas rang lus de nyid dang / /rdo rje can dngos dbyer med pa'i/ /sna tshogs spyod pa gsal gyur pa'i/ /gsang ba'i brtul zhugs bzang po spyod/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis/ /mchog tu dga' bas yongs su dag /rnam rtog yid las byung ba yi/ /'jig rten pa yis gang smad pa'i/ /de de gzugs su gnas byas la/ /gsang ba brtul zhugs brtul zhugs can/ /ji ltar dpal ldan 'dus spyod pa'i/ /gsang ba zhes byar rab gnas pa/ /bshang gci zas su byas gyur na/ /sgrub pa'i snod du nges par 'gyur/ /dam tshig bzang po gzhan dag kyang / /gsal byed la sogs khyad par dang / /phyag rgya'i 'ching ba byin brlabs nas/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bzang po kun/ /rdo rje'i tshig ni bzang po 'di/ /rdo rje thugs kyis gsungs pa yi / /gsang 26—14

ba'i spyod pa bla med pa/ /de ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ /rdo rje thugs kyis gang smras kapa/ /de ni bdag gis bshad par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis 0/ /spub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /mnyam gzhag mi smra gyur pa yis—/ /smon ⑤pa'i gzugs su gzhag —par bya/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /sha za bzhin du kun du 'khyams — / /yang dang yang du ngal byas pa—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya bsgom/ /rtag tu bsgom dang ldan gyur pa'i//rigs )pas rang gis rtogs byas la/ /grong dang yul 'khor grong khyer dang / /tshal la sogs par 'khyam par bya/ /bzhi mdo dag dang dur khrod dang / /lha rten pho brang khyad par du/ /dor ba rnying pas mgo bcings la/ /tshogs bcas gnas su 'jug na yang / /mchog tu bde ba bsgom par bya/ /'bad med rol mo brdung ba der/ /gar dang gru yis g.yeng bar bya/ /'o ma sgron mar ldan pa des②/ /rgyal mtshan can gyi gnas 'jug bya/ /la lar dgod cing la lar smra/ /la lar gru yang blang bar bya/ /la lar gar bya la lar brdab/ /la lar sna tshogs brngod bya ba/ /ji ltar skyo bar mi 'gyur ba/ /thams cad rim gyis rim gyis bya/ /skyo bar gyur nas sangs rgyas nyid/ /nam yang 'grub —par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten spyod pa rnam spangs pa/ /rigs rnams kun la kun du spyad/ /'dus shing tshogs pa thams cad du/ /gcig tu 'o ma goms byed par/ /ro la sogs pa'i dam tshig la/ /shin tu sred par mi bya'o/ /nga rgyal spang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang goms par bya/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i sems nyid ni/ /ji ltar myong bar mi 'gyur rotsho/ /dam tshig thams cad sngon 'gro ba/ /sngags pas de ltar bya ba nyid/ /glu dang gar gyis 826—46

dga' ba ni/ /ji ltar yid ni mi nyams par/ /ji srid mngon sum gyur gyi bar / /de ltar de nyid la sems bzhag /bdud rtsi lnga la gcig gus pas/ /de nyid nges par byas nas ni/ /dam par snang mdzad blang byas nas/ /ston pa'i brtul zhugs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /smyon pa'i mtshan ma gang yin pa/ /de ni rtag tu bsten kyipar bya/ /sngags pas gsang ba'i spyod pa ni/ /cho ga bzhin du spyad par bya/ /srog chags kun lus las byung ba'i/ /sgron ma rtag tu cho ga bzhin / /lha yi dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /'bad pas bza' bar bya ba nyid / /sbrang ma'i skyugs pa 'dres pa dang / /bshang dang gci ba bsres byas nas/ /sgron ma lnga dang bsres pa yis1/ /rtag tu bdag nyid mchod par bya / /dngos med mchog tu zhi ba yi/ /dpal ldan bde chen rdo rje can/ /rang rig tsam zhig skyed 5byas la/ /go 'phang mchog de bsgom par bya/ /sngags pas 'di ltar bsgom byas la/ /rang gi lus mchog bsgom par bya/ /smad par gyur pa ma lus pa/ /dpyad pa med par bya ba nyid/ /btsun mo'i rang byung me tog ni/ /byang chub sems dang bcas gyur pa/ /blangs la gsung gi rdo rje can/ /bde ba chen po yang dag mchog— /glang po khyi rta rnga mo yi / /sgron ma mi las byung ba dag /sngags pas rtag tu bza' bya zhing / /gzhan du bza' bar mi bya'o/ /de nyid rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig rtag tu goms byed pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i ting nge 'dzin/ /de ni 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /slang mo spyod par bya ba'i phyir/ /brtul zhugs can gyis snod mi gzung / /grong pas zos shing bor ba yi/ /gyo dum la sogs der bza' zhing //gong du bor zhing byin pa skyabaza'/ /des ni gong 8du zos gyur nas/ /tshim 26—46

par gyur nas de nga dor/ /de yi smad g.yogs dum bu yang / /rnying zhing dum bur gyur pas bya/ /yang na mchog rkyakyi gos can gyis/ / gang du 'dod par 'gro bar ⑤bya/ /til 'bru tsam gyi dngo po yang / /yongs su gzung bar mi bya'o/ /yongs su 'dzin las sdug bsngal 'byung / /sdug bsngal byis ni sems 'khor 'gyur/ /'khor bas sems ni zhum gyur ②te/ /zhum pas dngos grub nyams par 'gyur/ /dngos grub med na 'khor ba ste/ /'khor bas dmyal ba sgrub par byed/ /dmyal bar nyon mongs sdug bsngal gyis/ /grangs med bskal par gnod par 'gyur/ /bzhin skams sdug bsngal gyur pa dang / /gzhan byi bran la sogs par skye/ /rnam dag legs par 'dod pa yi/ /skye ba slar yang thob mi 'gyur/ /de ltar bdag gis bdag nyid kyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa rnam bsgoms nas/ /khams gsum rnam pa gcig gyur pa/ /rnam dag thabs bzang ⑤la gnas pas/ /rnam dag legs par 'dod pa yi( / /skye ba sgar yang thob par 'gyur/ /gsang ba grub pa la gnas nas/ /de nas seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /smyon pa'i gzugs 'dzin gyur pa yis/ /kun spyod thams cad rnam spangs la/ /gsang gsum dri med rnal 'byor gyis/ /bza' ba kun la spyad par bya/ /shing rdo sa yi rang bzhin byicho sna/ /lha rnams la yang phyag mi bya//lus nyid la ni mchod pa dang / /bla mar —gus pas phyag bya'o/ /sa rdo'i rang bzhin mchod rten dang / /glegs bam la sogs mi bya zhing / /rmi lam du yang dkyil 'khor sogs/ /lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bya'o/ /theg pa gsum la zhugs rnams la/ /phyag la sogs pa mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dam par mi 'dzin na/ /rnal 'byor pa gzhan smos ci dgos/ /bsgom ka la chags gyur sems kyis ni/ /26—47

ngag gi rtsod pa mi bya'o/ /dam tshig dag ni nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams pas sna yid ni g.yeng 'gyur bas/ /sbyor ba la sogs 'bad pa yis/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu spang / /rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal nyid/ /spang ④nas gzhan du mi bya'o/ /dag pa de nyid la gnas pas/ /sbyor ba rnams kyang mi bya ste/ /dam tshig dag ni nyams par 'gyur/ /nyams pas yid ni sdug bsngal 'thob/ /bdag med dal 'byor ldan pa yis྾ / /ji srid de la rtog ④ gyur pas/ /dngos med go 'phang la gnas nas/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis ༅/ /rtog las gang zhig 'byung ba rnams/ /ma brtags — par ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bsgom pa'i 4 sbyor ba'i stobs kyis ni/ /dngos grub mtshan nyid gang ci'ang rung //de kun skad cig tsam la ni/ /rang nyid gnas par 'gyur ba yin/ /dgon 6pa 'di ni bar chad can/ /sngags pas gsang sngags mi bzla zhing / /dkyil 'khor dag kyang mi bya la/ /phyag rgya mi bcing phyag mi bya/ /lus nyid dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs te/ /shes rab phyag rgya zhes byar grags/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dag bsngagasashā/ /de bsten pa ni phyag yin no/ /nang gi bdag nyid de byas nas/ /mkhas pas phyi rol thams cad spang ⑫/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa dang ldan pas/ /de nyid rig pas rtag tu spyad/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag /rnam par rtog med sngags pa yis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa dang ldan pas/ /de ltar 'gyur med 'grub par 'gyur/ / spros shing kyide la rab sbyor bas/ /dam tshig dag ni skyong ba dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa yis/ /shes rab thabs dag rnam par bsgom/ /gar dang gru sogs sbyor ba yisacho / /pad+ma rdo rje rnam rol zhing / /bur chang sgron ma gus pa dang / /dri 26—48

dang phreng sogs rgya chen dang / /gling du rnga klum sgra dag dang / /rdza rnga'i sgra la sogs pa dang / /lha rdzas lus ldangs dri bzang 1ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu bsgrub/ /lha rdzas bzang po mchog 'di dang / /nang gi bdag nyid bsgom pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub 'gyur ba/ /spyad par bya ba ma yin no/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can gyis//byang chub sems ni rab spros pas/ /chu skyes khyad par bza' bar bya/ /rtag tu chags pa dang ldan zhing / /mchog tu dga' ba la sred pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur/ /mang du smras pa ci zhig dgos/ /rtag tu ngo tsha spangs gyur pas/ /dam tshig spyod la ci bzhin par②/ /spyon pa'i gzugs kyis mi smra ba/ /dur khrod la sogs gar gnas nas/ /mā ma tī dang spyan la sogs—/ /rgyan rnams la sogs kyis brgyan pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya bsgom/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i khams sbyor bas—/ /der ni thams cad bsgom par bya/ /zhal gsum pa yi rnal 'byor gyis1 /ye shes rgya chen rlabs spro bya/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /rang dngos rim — —pa bskul byas na tsa/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gzugs can rnams//rab tu bsdu 3ba dag kyang bya/ /phyogs bcu dag tu rgyug byed pa'i/ /rang sems gal te 'dzin par 'dod gyur na/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur rang gi sems/ /de tshe yang dag sbyor ba mchog tu bya/ /gong du nyams myong phyag rgya rjes bsams la/ /brtse 3ldan rjes 'gro bzang dga' chags kyi pa can/ /chags khyapas thob gyur de la kyisems gtad nas/ /slar yang rim pa'i khyad par gsal bar baspub/ /bsam gtan 'di la sbyor ba yis — 1/ /rin chen sems 26—49

ni brtan gyur nasna/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab gnas te1/ /byin gyis brlab pa mdzad par 'gyur/ /de lha de nyid shes gyur nas/ /der gtad nas ni bsgom par bya/ /ji srid yid ni mi skyo bar/ /blo bzang sems ni mnyam gzhag pas/ /skyo na ji ltar 'dod pa yi/ /sems kyis kun du khyab par bya/ /cung zad mig ni rgyas gyur chepas/ /byang chub rin chen bsgom par bya/ /la la dgod dang smra ba dang / /la lar gar dag byed pa na/ /ji ltar skyo bar mi 'gyur bas/ /bsgom pa la chags sems kyis so/ /rnam par rtog med sngags pa yis/ /de lta'i ting 'dzin dang ldan pas/ /dus kyi nges pa yongs spangs nas / /bla med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /bzang po'i rikas lnga las byung ba'i / /dam tshig rtag tu bza' bar bya/ /khyad par gzhan dang ldan pa yi/ /dam tshig bsten pas mchod par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs bsam ldan pas//spyan ni rgyas par gyur nas su/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom pas/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /spyod pa rin chen la gnas shing / /rdo rje ye shes la mos pas/ /bde gshegs go 'phang 'dod na ni/ /mi dge'i sems su mi bya'o / /khams gsum du ni 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /btsun mo kun la 'dod par bya/ /dman las skyes dang 'gyur ba can/ /de nyid dal 'byor pas mchod bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad las byung dang / /srog chags kun lus las byung ba'i/ /srog chags rnams ni rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos grub 'dod na bza' bar bya/ /bshang gci sa bon la sogs pa/ /sna yi nang nas byung ba yis / /rang lus rdo rjer ༄ bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags pas rtag tu mchod par bya / /khams gsum pa las byung ba yi/ /rtag tu dam tshig la mchod pas/ /26—60

de nyid rin chen la rab sbyar/ /gzhan du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir ni mang du spru ci dgos/ /gang dang gang zhig dmigs 'gyur ba/ /de kun de nyid rnal 'byor du/ / rigs pas brtags rtashing blta bar bya/ /rdo rje grub 1par gang gsungs pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi cho ga yis/ / dam tshig bzang po bsten byas pas/ /thams cad bya ba kho na'o/ /de ltar byas na sngags pa ni/ /shin tu de nyid gsang spyod pas/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di la spyad par mi bya'o/ /bdag gi de nyid la gtad pas/ / dam tshig bzang po dang ldan pa'i/ /de nyid gsum dbyer med pa'i sku/ /sngags pas rtag tu mchod par bya/ /kun kyang rtog pa sngon 'gro bas/ /khams gsum 'di dag rnam par dag /ma rig dra bas yang dag bsgribs/ /rmi lam rtsed mo'i 3rjes su 'gro/ /phung po khams sogs mtshan nyid rnams/ /de ltar 'bad pas spyad ⑤na ni/ /mtshan ma med cing snang med pa'o/ /thabs dang bcas pa rnam par bsgom/ /de ltar cho ga ldan shes pas/ /sems ni de nyid byin brlabs nas—/ /ji ltar thos pas 'tsho byed cing / /dam tshig ma lus la rab sbyor/ /tshong dpon bram ze rje'u rigs dang / /shi ba sogs kyis mgron bos nas / /zos shing tshims — nas bor gyur pa'i/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i dman ma rnams//khyi dang wa yis ⑨smad pa dag /blangs nas de ni bza' bar bya/ /de nyid bsgoms tsopa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /cung zhig sbyon pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /rigs rnams kun du tshomanyam par sbyor/ /bzang po'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i gar/ /rdo rje gar gyis goms bapar gnas/ /glu rnams len par byed pa yi/ /rdo rje'i loglu ni mi gsal bar/ /khams gsum 26—61

dag tu grags pa yi/ /gzhan dag gsal po 3nyid du len/ /sna tshogs skad bsres gru len cing / /sha za bzhin du kun du 'khyamasasnye/ /las dag gang gis skye bo rnams/ /gang dang gang du 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching las grol bar 'gyur/ /khyad par thams cad spangs pa yisab/ /de nyid zhi ba thob gyur nas/ /thabs bzang dag dang ldan pa yis / /go 'phang mchog ni baspub par bya/ /'byung po kun gyi de nyid gang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spang — ba/ /'gro kun mchog tu zhi ba nyid/ /khyad par gnas pa'i bzang po gang / /rang lus thabs dang bcas pa yis 3 de nyid rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /bus pa kun la thal mo'i sgra/ /rim gyis ⑧gar ni bzang po bya/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs pa yis— 7/ /byang chub mchog tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bzang po'i dzigo 'phang der gnas nas/ /gang dang gang du gnas na yang / /byang chub mchog tu nges byas pas/ /spyod ngan can yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /snyon pa'i brtul zhugs la brten nas/ /yid ni de nyid byin brlabs nas/ /gsang spyod mchog gi rol pa yis skya/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /gal te rgya chen khyim rnams ni/ /spong bar nus pa ma yin yang / /dpal ldan gsang grub las brtan pa rta/ /byang chub 'byung ba'i spyod pa rnams/ /khyim de nyid du gnas byas nas/ /'jig rten spyod pa la gnas pasa'i/ /ji lhar rig par lami 'gyur bar/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig spyad par bya/ /mtshan mo gsal por byas nas ni/ /'o ma gcig tu goms byas pas//phyag rgyar bcas pas bya ba ste/ /yid ches pas yin gzhan gyis min/ /dri chu la sogs dam tshig rnams/ /rtag tu spyad par bya ba nyid/ /gcig tu dam 26—62

tshig goms byed na/ /de nyid bla med 'grub par 'gyur/ /shin tu gsang ba'i grogs dag nyid/ /de nyid shes shing mchog gyur pa/ /de dang lhan cig dam tshig ’rnams/ /rgyud las gsungs pa spyad par bya/ /bud med bzang dang longs spyod bzang / /de bzhin gnas mal bzang sogs kyis/ /de nyid bsgom pas ngal gyur pa'i/ /ye shes ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig spyod pa der gtad pas 1/ /khyim nyid du yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig spyod pa dman gyur na/ /spyod pa min zhing khyim du'ang min/ /de ltar dam tshig mngon ldan zhing / /ye shes bzang po la dga' ba/ /cho ga 'di — ni bskul byas nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyams su blang 1bya thams cad ni/ /'gal ba'i dam tshig la sogs pa/ /smad par gyur pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /ma lus pa dag gang bstan pa/ /dngos grub bzang po'i rgyu yi phyir/ /de dag thams cad bya ba nyid/ /'di kun mngon sum nyid du ni/ /byed pa'i char ni dbye bya ste/ /gsang ba spyod pa ldan pa yis / /de nyid shes yin gzhan ma yin/ /'gal ba'i dam tshig la sogs pas / /gsang ba grub pa zhes byar brjod/ /rtag can gzugs la gnas gyur nas/ /'jig rten spyod las 'das gyur te/ /smad pa rnams la gsal po ru/ /nyams su len par byed gyur cing / /nus pa dag ni ma skyes par/ /kun rdzob nyid du 'jug 'gyur ba'i/ /dman pa'i rigs la sogs pa la/ /rtag tu dam tshig sogs spyod cing / /'dod dang bcas pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /thab khung dkyil 'khor sogs byed pa/ /rtag dang chad pa smra ba yi/ /gang zhig cho ga 'dir gnas pa / /de ni bstan pa 'jig byed gsungs/ /gal te rtag —dang ldan 26—63

gyur pas/ /sgrub pa 'di ni byed 'gyur na/ /de ni mtshan mo dam tshig spyad/ /nyin mo shin tu gsang bar bya/ /dman pa'i 'gro ba nyan thos sogs/ /ji ltar gzhan gyis mi rigs rngopa/ /de lhar sngags pa'i — bya ba ste/ /bdag nyid bsgrub 1phyir shin tu gsang — 3/ /'jig rten kun 3gyis mi gnod cing / /'jig rten kun la mi gnod par/ /de bzhin sngags pas 'dir bya'o/ /bde gshegs dngos grub 'dod gyur na/ /gsang ba grub pa la gnas shing / /sgrub pa po la nus pa zhig /ji srid 'byung bar ma gyur pa/ /de srid brtul zhugs rtags mi gzung / /nus pa zhig ni skyes 'gyur ba/ /de nas gsang ba — spyod pa spangs/ /de rjes rig pa'i brtul zhugs gzung — / /de dag rtag tu blang bar bya/ /go 'phang nyams dga' der gnas pas/ /dal 'byor der gtad bsgom par bya/ /'du 'dzi thams cad dang da7bral nas/ /go 'phang mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /'du 'dzi ring du spangs shing rang bzhin g.yo ba'i sems nyid rab sbyar nas/ /dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin bde ba'i mchog ldan de nyid la gnas bsgom par bya/ /nyon mongs pa yi dgra tshogs mang po las rgyal mi nyams bzang por gyur pa yi/ /sems can don ldan sems kyis rtag tu rnal 'byor pa rnams 'jig rten gsum na spyod/ /spyan ni cung zhig bye nas srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i sems dang ldan pa yi/ /cho ga shes par gyur pas sna tshogs ma lus brdzun pa'i blo dang sgra spangs la/ /mchog tu legs par spyod pa'i sems can don ldan 'jig rten gsum na grags par byed/ /dngos rnams dpag med byang chub go 'phang mchog gyur mnyam med sems can mchog gyur rol pa gang / /khyim gyi 'dzin pa rtswa bzhin ma lus spangs nas ma lus 'isgyu ma 26—54

bzhin blta 1ba/ /spre'u dang rlung dang glog bzhin g.yo ba'i sems zhes bya la dbang du gyur pas gzhag /dngos po'i de nyid bsgom pa'i lus can dam pa'i bde ba de nyid mchog /sems can don la spro ba'i de nyid sems la nges par rnal 'byor dbang phyug rol par byed/ don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las sgrub pa'i thabs kyis 1mnyam pa nyid kyi sems dri ma med par byed pa'i gsang ba'i spyod pa'i rim pa ma lus par bstan pa'i zule'u ste drug pa'o// //dag cing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /sna tshogs gzugs rnams phun sum tshogs/ /'chi dang mya ngan rnam spangs pa/ /lha yi phyag rgya mchog rnyed nas/ /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /de bzhin lha min bu mo'ang rung / /dri za'i bu mo gzugs ldan pa'i/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma yang rung / /'di lta'i du mo rnal 'byor ma'am/ /de nyid rnal 'byor ldan pa dang / /zhags pa lcags kyu'i sbyor ba yis/ /bkug nas longs spyod nyid du bya/ /lha rdzas grub pa gang yin de / /dam tshig sbyor bar rab tu brjod/ /bsgrubs nas mngag gzhug par 'gyur zhing / /gang 'dod pa de byed par 'gyur/ /des ni sems ni rnam g.yeng bar/ /nam yang byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi yis bu mo mthu chen gyis//dam tshig bzang po 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i rdzu 'phrul che ldan zhing / /chu dang rdul dag rnam par spangs/ /sna tshogs gzugs dag rab ston pa'i/ /lha rdzas btsun mo bsten par bya/ /de dang lhan cig mnyam ldan pas / /skye bo 26nga 65

med pa'i tshal song la/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /seng ge bzhin du rnam par spyad/ /lha rdzas btsun mo 'gugs pa yi/ /nus pa gal te med gyur na/ /'dod pas gnod pa nyid gyur la/ /des nanyami yi bu mo bsten/ /longs spyod bzang po dang ldan pa'i/ /g.yeng ba'i sbos pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /de phyir sgrub pa'i dbang po la/ /mi las byung ba'i bu mo bsten/ /rnam g.yeng khro ba mang ba dang / /skyon rnams thams cad 'byung 'gyur zhing / / rga shi mya ngan gyis non pa'i/ /mi yi bu mo shin tu spangs( / /de lha'i lha rdzas med gyur na / /dngos grub bzang po'i rgyu yi phyir/ /rgyud kyi bya ba'i rim pa yis/ /mi yi bu mo bsten par bya/ /de ltar tha mal byang chub nyid/ /sngags kyis 5cho ga bzhin byas nas/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i yid can gyis/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgrub par bya/ /tha mal pa yi rim pa yi/ /phyag rgya de nyid bshad par bya/ /mthar skyes dang por byas nas 1 ni/ /gang gis dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'o/ /mthar skyes ma 7sring bu mo dang / /de bzhin tshos ma'i bu mo dang / /smad pa'i rigs las byung gyur dang / /gang yang bde ba rnyed pa dang / /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rigs ‘ byas pa'i/ /khyad par du ni bu mo nyid/ /dam tshig spyod pa thams cad la/ /byis pa nyid nas rim gyis bslab ba/ /byang chub sems la dga' zhing mkhas/ /chos nyid la ni bzod byas pasatsho/ /mkhas pas cho ga ji bzhin du/ /rdo rje gsum dbyer med par bsgru / /rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa yi/ /mchod pa de la gnas nas brtsam/ /gus pas 'o ma sgron ma dang / /phreng ba la sogs rgyan rnams dang / /thal ba bzang po bsku bya zhing / /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan par/ /sngags pas rang gi gzugs nyid dang / /de 26—56

yi gzugs kyang bya ba nyid/ /stag gi snapags pas gos byas shing / /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rdo rje kha ṭī ga blang zhing / /dril bu cang te'us rnam par brgyan/ /de bzhin rna ba mgrin dpung pa/ /rus pa'i dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /mi yi thod pa g.yon pa ste/ /de bzhin g.yas par ḍa — ma ru/ /bdag dang phyag rgya de bzhin du/ /mā ma tī 'am spyan dag gam/ /bdag nyid rdo rje mchog 'dzin pas/ /'di 'dra'i gzugs su byas nas ni/ /rgyud las byung ba'i cho ga yis/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bzang po spyad/ /gnyis med nges par byas nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las rig pa'i brtul zhugs nges par bstan pa'i le'u ste ༄ bdun pa'o// //mthar skyes ngo mtshar chen po las/ /rgyud las sgrub thabs gang gsungs pa//ji ltar nges par de thob pa/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ / skyo ba'i nges pa yongs sgongs la/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug gzugs byas nas/ /gang du sus kyang mi shes par/ /mthar skyes nang du 'jug par bya/ /tshogs kyi mtshan ma blangs nas ni/ /mgo bo'i skra ni bregs nas kyang / /ral pa sbom po gcig bzhag nas/ /gtsug phud gcig ni gzung bar bya/ /ru drwak+ṣa 3dang shel bzang po/ /tshan tshan dag tu spel byas pa'i/ /phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang ba dag /mgul pa'i rgyan du gzung bar bya/ /dpung rgyan gdu bu bzang po dag /'od zer 'phro zhing 'khrug 'gyur dang / /'bad pas tshan 0gsum 26—67

byas nas ni/ /mdzub mo la ni zangs ma'i rgya/ /mdun gyi phyogs su 'phyang gyur pa'i/ /smad g.yogs dum bu'ang tsade nas gzung / /lcags mdung la btags me tog snod/ /phrag pa dag la bkal 4bar bya/ /yan lag thams cad rnam brgyan nas/ /tshogs kyi dbang phyug gzugs su bya/ /phrag pa gnyis ni dgab byas nas/ /mthar skyes khyim du 'jug par bya/ /bzang po de ltar gsang byas nas/ /de nas bsgrub par bya phyir spyadatsu/ /gang zhig sus kyang mi shes par/ /bzang po'i yul du 'khyam par bya/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs nye ba'i mthar/ /mthar skyes nang du 'jug par bya/ /yang dag tu ni lha gzhan nyid —/ /des ni shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu khrus dang lha mchod cing / /rtag tu rang gi grub mtha' rngo bsgom/ /yi ge las ni cung zhig gis/ /rang 'byung she lha la chags gyur pas/ /gdol pa'i gzugs kyis ⑦tshogs nyid kyi/ /de ltar de yi nang zhugs la/ /byang chub mchog ni bsgom par bya/ /chos dang grub mtha' sngon 'gro bas/ /de nas de la ston par byed/ /dus kyi phyi ma la sogs pa'am/ /yang na dbugs kyi sgom pa ston/ /de nas rgyud nas gsungs kun gyis/ /yid brtan pa nyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /dbang dang dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bas/ /bdag nyid kyi — 3ni slob mar bya༄ / /de yi byin pa'i rdzas rnams dang / /snga na yod pa dang bcas pas/ /de ni de la gtad byas la//de yi bla ma mchod phyir byin/ /de yis 0bkas gnang blang bya ste/ /shin tu bzhin bzangs zhemig yangs ma/ /de ni rgyud don bden pa la/ /mkhas shing dam tshig 'dod byas nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges byas la/ /blo ldan rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /nges par rgyud gsungs dam tshig gis/ /tshe 'di 26—68

nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /ri 'am rgya mtsho'i 'gram dag gam/ /skyon sna rnams spangs pa'i yul 'khor dang / /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs sam/ /phug dang grong khyer rnying pa dag /dri med chu yis gang ba dang / /me tog 'bras bu sogs pas brgyan/ /ljon shing 'khri shing gis brgyan pa/ /khyad par du ni dben gyur pa/ /der ni phyag rgya dang bcas par/ /sgrub po brtan zhing nges pa yis/ /sgom pa'i sbyor ba der gtad pas / /rtag tu nags su bsod snyoms blang / /byang chub sems la dga' zhing mkhas/ /lus ni nus pa can byas nas/ /yang dag rim pas der gnas nas/ /yang dang yang du goms par bya/ /ljon shing rgyal po de dag kun/ /sgrub pa —dbang po dang ldan pas//de nyid sbyor bas bkug byas nas/ /zhal zas bzang po ster bar 'gyur/ /blo bzang rtag tu 'dod med cing / /blo yis rtag tu goms par byadzi/ /rdo rje theg pa la dga' zhing / /rtag tu bde gshegs sems 6pa can/ /bstan 'ubacos ma lus la goms shing / /de bzhin gtong ldan dpa' zhing gsal/ /phongs par gyur pa'i tshe na yang / /mnyam pa'i sems nyid gcig tu bsgom/ /phyag rgya'ang de 'drar shes bya ste/ /chags med zhen pa med pa dang / /zab mo'i chos dang ldan pa dang / /sgrub po 'dod bzhin rjes su 'brang / /bzhin bzangs 3mig ni dkyus ring ma/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan/ /byang chub sems la dga' zhing gsal/ /rdo rje spub pa shin tu gsal/ /ci ltar du bzhin brtse ba dang / /de bzhin spun dang pha ma ltar/ /rtag tu spub po mthong ba na/ /brtse bas shin tu goms byed na/ /dud med sgyu bral yid du 'ong / /skal ba bzang zhing snyan par smra/ /phrag dog spangs shing rjes su mthun//26—69

sgrub pa po yi bka' bzhin byed/ /dmar ser lus phra gzugs bzang ma/ /tshul khrims yon tan gyis brgyan pa/ /mdog snum cho ga shes pa dang / /ring min thung ba'ang shem yin pa/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis lon pa 'am/ /yang na de bzhin bcu drug gam/ /de nyid rig pa dang ldan pa / /nur gong mtha' ni rnam par mdzes/ /yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ /skra yi rtse kun cung zhig 'khyil/ /skad snyan shin tu dga' ba can/ /lta ba bzang pos rnam brgyan pa—/ /'bad pas bu mo 'di 'dra ba/ /dngos grub don gnyer gyur nas su/ /rtog las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /de nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs brtsam/ /'bad pas de ni gzung byas nas/ /go 'phang 3mchog ni bathub ④ par bya/ /rang gi rdo rje mchod nas ni/ /byang chub sems ni gtang ( 3bar bya/ /de nas sku yi rdo rje bsgom/ /ngag gi rdo rje bkug nas gzung —/ /de yi bha gar byung ba'i khus/ /sems kyi rdo rje rab tu mchod/ /de la gus pas mchod na ba ni/ /cho ga bzhin du sbyor ba la / /de nyid sbyor la bsgom par bya/ /tsurdo 'am ni mā ma skru / /dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam bsgoms nas/ /thams cad bya ba kho na yin / /dam tshig gi ni khyad par dang / /bud med mchog ni bsnyen par bya//bha gar liṅga gzhag munas ni/ /byang chub sems ni gtang rngomi bya/ /der bskyed pa yi dga' ba yis/ /sems ni bkang nas pabasgom par bya/ /ji srid rnal 'byor byang chub sems/ /gtong bar byed pa ma yin pa/ /de srid kun dga' las byung bde/ /ci yang rgyun mi 'chad par 'thob/ /bde ba de yi ngo bo dang / /yang dag ldan pa'i byang chub mchog /bdag nyid rtag tu bsgom na tsheni / /'grub 'gyur 'di la the chos med/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa//26—60

byang chub sems ni der lhung bas/ /phung po rnam shes brgyal gyur nas/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la yod/ /phyag rgya ma la dam 'khyud nas/ /yang dang yang du 'o byas la/ /gnas de ru ni bskyod pa yis/ /byang chub sems mang rab 'bab pas/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam bsgoms la/ /lha mo de la 'o yang bya/ /mig gnyis dag ni rgyas gyur nas/ /bde ba chen po'i ros gang ba/ /ma mchu cung zhig rgyas pa yis/ /nu ma cung zhig dam par 'dzin/ /brla gnyis dri ma med pa mchog /mig kyang cung zhig rgyas pa dang / /rdo rje theg pa ngal byas pas1 /der gtad pa yi bsgom dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu der gtad bsam pa can/ /'o ma byin nas yang dang yang / /khyad par du ni rab tu mchog /rdo rje can gyi phyag rgya bzhin/ /de nyid sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /yid 'ong bcos ma'i zas dang ni/ /dri dang me tog sogs bsnyen bskur— 3/ /nya dang sha dang bur chang sogs/ /sems ni spro ba pebyed pa can/ /'bad pas de lta bus mchod nas/ /de nyid ched du bsgom par bya/ /cho ga 'di yis bskul nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag 'grub 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dang ldan pa yis / /bdud rtsi me tog myang bar bya/ /mkha' dbyings rdo rje dbus gnas pa/ /de ni rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /bsgom dang dam tshig nyams len pas/ /de lta'i dngos grub myur du thob/ /sems kyi dam tshig sdang ba la/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dngos grub med/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / /dam tshig bsrung bar bya ba ni/ /shes pas 'bad pas bsgom byas na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad na ni/ /sdig pa ma 26—61

lus sbyangs nas ni/ /rig ma dang bcas grol bar 'gyur/ /grong dang grong khyer dag tu 'am/ /sems ni gang du ⑫dga' ba der/ /der ni rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad( / /dgag pa dang ni spub lupa med/ /dpal ldan 'dus rab yongs gsal ba'i/ /sgrub thabs rgyud las gang gsungs pa/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs ldan pa yi/ /gsang ba ④spyod pas rnam brgyan pa/ /des ༄ni dngos grub myur thob pakyi / /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas gsungs/ /dam tshig spyod pa dang ldan pa༅/ /rtag tu goms par bya ba yin/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba ⑤las tshogs kyi brtul zhugs nges par bstan kapa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o // // kyeme dang chu dang dug sogs la/ /thabs ni gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni tshig dang nub pa dang / /'chi bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /de bzhin gsang 'dus rgyud kyis ni/ /shes rab thabs ni spangs gyur pa/ /'gal ba dag ni spyod byed pa'i/ /bsam ngan de ni brlag par 'gyur/ /gang gis de yi de nyid shes/ /yang dag rab sbyin la gnas nas/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa la dga' ba'i/ /sems can de ni steng du 'gro/ /gsang ba'i spyod dang brtul zhugs dang / /phyag rgya rgyas par ༅gang gsungs pa/ /'di dag thams cad rtog don yin/ /bsgom pa 'ba' zhig tsam yin te/ /gang yang rgyas pa'i bdag nyid can/ /kun kyang sems can bsams pas gsungs/ /bsgom pa la ni rab gnas pa'i/ /ye shes ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnam rtog du 26—62

ma rgyas gyur pa'ikya/ /'di ni thams cad spang — byas nas/ /phyag rgya chen po la 'bad pas/ /shes rab ldan pas rtag tu bsgom/ /'du 'dzi thams cad spangs nas ni/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /yang dang yang du goms par byas⑤/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i tshig bzhin du/ /dus mi ring bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig dag ni thams cad las/ /bla ma mchod pa mchog yin te—/ /sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog /dpal ldan 'dus pa'am gzhan du bstan / /gzugs ༅min brjod pa ma yin pa/ /sems can kun la yang dag gnas| /lus ngag yid gsum ⑤bde ba yin/ /rnam rtog med cing gnas med pa/ /dag cing ngo bo nyid med pa/ /byang chub sems zhes dran par bya/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /de ni myur du thob par 'gyur/ /khams gsum rin po cher gyur pa/ /slob dpon las ni mchog gzhan med/ /gang las bka' drin thob pa yi/ /mkhas pas dngos grub du ma thob / /yang dag gsungs pas spyod pa gang / /dpal ldan mnyam nyid gnyis med gsungs/ /des ni slob dpon bya ba ste/ /gzhan gyis 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /gos dang rgyan dang longs spyod dang / /rang gi phyag rgyas brgyan byas nas/ /bla ma mchod cing phul byas pas/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur/ /rang gi phyag rgya phul nas ni/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dngos grub 'grub/ /gzhan dag phyi rol dam tshig gis/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni rgyud kyi bden don gyi3/ /dam tshig gtso bo mchog yin no/ /sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mgon gsungs pa'i/ /dam tshig dag ni thams cad las/ /gnyug ma'i phyag rgya dbul ba mchog /gzhan du phyi 26—63

rol tshul dag gis1/ /dam tshig 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /gus par ②bla ma mchod par bya/ /rang gi phyag rgya pad+ma yi/ /mchod mchog mgrin pa'i dbyangs dag dang / /brla brdab pa yi rol mo dang / /rdo rje 'jug pa'i bskyodabyupa dang / /rig ma'i ④mchu yi ro myong 3dang / /cung zhig 'khyud par spro ba yis / /bza' ba mchod — pa sna tshogs gang / / nya dang khu ba la sogs dang / /sha dang bur chang — —bzang po dag /rgyud nas gsungs pa sna tshogs dang / /phyag rgya gnyug ma phul byas nas/ /de nas dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /'di lta'i gzugs su ma byas na/ /gzhan du dngos grub 'byung mi 'akyur/ /rdo rje ston la gang gus pa za/ /'di lta'i tshul du byed 'gyur ba/ /de nyid rig pas lam 1 —nyid kyis/ /dri med rdo rje gsum dbyer med/ /yang dag rab sbyin gsung ka'agyur ba/ /sems can des 'dir 'thob par 'gyur/ /bla ma rdo rje mnyes 'gyur bas/ /dngos grub bzang po kun sbyin byed/ /rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig bzang / /de lhar rtag par rab bsgrubs chopas/ /rdo rje slob dpon thugs rje mchog /man ngag myur du thob par 'gyur/ /'di lha'i tshul pyis 'ongs gyur pa'i/ /de nyid gsal por yongs shes nas/ /gus pa'i dngos po 'phel 'gyur ba'id/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mchod pa'i dus su 'bab pa yis/ /gus pas bla mar tshophyag byas nas/ /phyi nas sangs rgyas dngos grub gtso/ /rab sbyin rtse gcig sems kyis bsgom/ /slob dpon mchog la dmod pa dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' khyad par du/ /dkon mchog gsum la smod ⑫pa dang / /'di dag 'bad pas spang sgyu bar bya/ /gang gis sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /nam 26—64

mkha' lta bu mi shes pas/ /theg pa mchog 'di thos gyur nas/ /sems can de ni skrag 'gyur na/ /rdo rje theg pa smod pa denya/ /ngan 'gro dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur—/ /dman la mos pa'i sems can rnams/ /bskal pa brgya yi bar du yang / /ngan 'gro dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /ngan 'gro dag nas byung na yang //de ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /gang zhig gus par mi byed pa/ /sdug bsngal phongs 1pa kun 'byung bar/ /sdig pa'i las kyis ④'gro 'gyur te/ /bde gshegs mtshan ma la brten nas/ /mnar med par ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig gus pa dang ldan pas/ /chos nyid sgom ⑤par byed gyur pa'u/ /de ni sdig pa kun spangs nas/ /gtso bo'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'jigs pa las /sems can rnams ni nges grol 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi gnas/ /bla na med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /'jig rten kun la ston pa por/ /dus mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur/ /mi shes sgrib pas ldongs gyur pa'i/ /sems can rnams la don dam kyi — / /ye shes snang bar byed 'gyur te/ /nun pa la ni mar me bzhin/ /bde chen mgon po gcig pu nyid/ /gang zhig rtag tu dran byed cing / /zhabs kyi pad+ma gnyis gus pas / /sdig pa thams cad zad gyur nas—/ /sems can de nyid de yi mthus/ /pad bsnams 'jig rten mgon po ltar/ /dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /dus mi ring bar 'gyur ba nyid//gang zhig dag pas — de nyid sems/ /gus pas lcags kyus brtan bkug nas//dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /gsang ba'i sgrub thabs gang byed 1 pa/ /26—66

gal te de ni bzang gyur na/ 1bzang zhes ci phyir rjod par byed/ /gal te dman dang 'dres gyur na/ /slob dpon rnams kyis 17de bzod mdzod/ /gang zhig rgyud kyi jis 'brang she nas/ /brjod pa bdag shegis ma shes pa / /rang gi bu bzhin 'phags pa rnams/ /ma lus pa dag bzod par mdzod/ /dpal ldan mgon po bde chen gyi— / /zhabs kyi pad+mos — nyer 'tsho ba/ /pad+ma rdo rje kyisems can kun/ /rjes su gzung phyir byas pa yi/ /gsang ba spub ༅ pa zhes bya ba / /dngos grub kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /grol bar 'dod pa'i sgrub pa po/ /'bad pa nyid kyis bstan ⑨par bya/ /blo bzang rtog ⑩pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /gsang ba spub rte1par gang spyod pa/ /mi yis 6tshe 'di nyid la ni/ /dngos grub ma lus 'thob par 'gyur/ /sems can kun dang dus gcig tu/ /gsang ba tsaspyod pa gang grub pa'i/ /legs pa ma lus gang yod pas/ /dpal ldan slob dpon zhabs grub shog /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur pas/ /yul gzhan la ni sems zhes —pas/ /sgrub dka'i dayul dang lhan cig tu/ /kun rtog thams cad spang bar bya/ /gnas skabs lnga ni gnod gyur na/ /skad cig gis ni 'khor bar lhung / /snyom rdzudang gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang / /rgod dang the tshom zhes bya ba'i/ /sgrib pa lnga po sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' mi bzhed do/ /lnga po de ni yongs spangs nas/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges byas pasatsho / /spyon pa'i brtul zhugs kyis rol na/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur / /gsang ba de nyid mchog de nyid/ /grub pa gang zhig der tsabarten pa/ /der ni rgyal ba kun 'byung ba/ /gsang ba grub pa zhes byar brjod/ /ces bya'o//dgu bcu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa'i/ /tshigs su bcad pa lnga brgyar ni/ /dngos 26—66

grub thams cad bsdu 1ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba grub pa zhes byar brjod/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i dga' bas thob gyur bsod nams gang yin pas/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i sar gyur 'jig rten gyur pa yon tan rgyan gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur gsang ba grub pa gtan du nyin dang mtshan du sbyor gyur cig /sems can 'di kun ma lus byang chub snying po'i bar du legs par spyod gyur cig/gang zhig rgya mtsho dang bcas sa gzhi ri dang ljon shing sogs pas brgyan pa rnams//de dag de nyid gzugs brnyan bzhin du chen por gyur pa'i khong du chud par snang gyur pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dri med zla ba'i 'od zer dpal ldan gsang ba grub pa mchog /mdzad pa thugs rjes gzhan gyi dbang grur dpal ldan pad+ma rdo rje gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don dam pa'i yi ge gsum dang ldan pa'i rgyud kyi don nges par bsdus pa dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mnyes par bya ba las/ don dam pa'i slob dpon gyi mchod pa nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //lha dang lha min la sogs pa ma lus pas/ zhabs kyi pad+ma zung la me tog gi phreng bas mchod pa dpal mgon po bde ba chen po pad+ma badz+ra gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po kṛsna —paṇ+ḍi ta dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa 26—67

tshog /thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa/3ba / /rgya gar skad du/ prasto pā — ya bi nilca ya sirnyi/ bod skad du / thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo rang bzhin dri ma med cing thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin sems gang las ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog mtha' dag dri mas ma gos chos sku dang ni mtshungs med pa'i/ /dam chos char gyi gzhir byur longs spyod dang ni sna tshogs pa yi gzugs dang spyod ldan pa'i/ /yang dag sprul pa skye 'gyur de la gus par phyag byas nas ni de nyid bshad par ④bya/ /de yi rang bzhin ma shes pa'i/ /skye bo ma lus la phan phyir/ /dpal ldan yan lag med rdo rje/ /bdag gis — de nyid mdor bsdu bya/ /byis pas 'khrul pa'i bden min pa'i/ /kun du rtog pa las byung dngos/ /kun du rtog — pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de ni srid par 26—75

mkhas pas bshad/ /de la 3bzod dka' rgyun chags pa'i/ /nyon mongs ma lus tshogs rnams dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs rgya che ba'i/ /las kyi tshogs ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de gnyis las ni skye ba dang / /'chi ba la sogs rab rgyas pa/ /mi bden la zhen sems ldan pa'i/ /shin tu sdug bsngal khor —mor 'byung / /shes rab nyam 4chung de dag ni/ /ji srid dngos 'dzin chen po yod/ /de srid srid pa'i btson rar gnas/ /bdag dang gzhan phan ga la yod/ /de phyir 'gro ba gsum po dag /dga' bar byed 'dod rang gi ni/ /'khrul pa bsal bar 'dod pa yi/ / shes rab can gyis 5dngos 'dzin spang / /gal te ming tsam tha dad kyang / /rtog pa nyid du dbyer med phyir/ /mkhas pas dngos 'dzin yongs gtang sgyuste/ /dngos med par yang mi rtag go/ /mar me 'bar ba bsad rung gi/ /shi na ci yang byar med par/ /dngos por 'dzin pa nyid rung gi/ /dngos med 'dzin pa de lta ⑫min/ /yang dag dngos po mi ⑩rtog pa//de yis dngos po mtshon 'gyur te/ /gang phyir nam mkha' zhig pa ni/ /med pas dang po bral ba min/ /thabs dang bral bar gyur pa yis⑫/ /dngos med tsam zhig bsgrubs 2gyur kyang / /med phyir nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /bdag gzhan don ni nus ma yin/ /mig 'phrul lta bur 'khrul pa'i phyir/ /de lhar dngos po yongs su btang / /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis⑫/ /med phyir dngos med de bzhin no/ /de gnyis ji lhar yongs tang dang / /btang nas gang du gnas pa ni/ /'khor min mya ngan 'das min pa/ /de ni mkhas pas mnyan par gyis/ /shes dang shes bya rab bye ste/ /sbyor bas yongs su brtags nas ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /shes rab de nyid 26—76

du ni brjod/ /ma lus sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang / /sdug bsngal las 'don gang yin pa/ /snying rje sems can la chags pas/ /'dod chags zhes ni bya bar grags/ /rtag tu rjes mthun sbyor ba yisasna/ /skye bo mngon par 'dod pa yis —/ /'bras bu gang yin nyer sbyin pas/ /de nyid thabs zhes bya bar bsgrags / /chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin/ /gnyis med rnam par sbyor ba yis / /gnyis po 'dus pa gang yin pa/ /shes rab thabs zhes bya bar brjod—/ /de ltar gang la gzhag ②pa dang / /gsal bar nus pa ma yin zhing // gzhag dang gsal 3 ba spangs pa ni/ /chos rnams de bzhin nyid ces brjod/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs spangs shing / /mtshan gzhi dang ni mtshan nyid grol/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med/ /gnyis dang gnyis med zhi ba dang / /thams cad la gnas dge ba ste/ /so so rang rig mi g.yo zhing / /thabs dang shes rab mi 'khrugs pas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar gyur pa'i gnas/ /legs dang lha yi phun tshogs byed/ /chos kyi dbyings su rab tu grags/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis bsten pa'i/ /mi gnas skya ngan 'das pa ste/ /yid 'ong bdag byin brlabs pa'i gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dge ba/ /theg pa gsum dang sku gsum dang / /bye ba grangs med sngags dang ni/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / /'jig rten pa dang de las 'das/ /lha dang lha min mi dang ni / /yi dwags la sogs de bzhin gzhan/ /de nyid las ni byung nas su/ /de nyid du ni thim par 'gyur/ /ma lus pa yi 'gro rnams la/ /yid bzhin nor ltar kun du gnas/ /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /spyod dang 26—77

grol ba yang dag rtsol / /de nyid yang dag rtogs nas su/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs sangs rgyas la/ /thams cad du ni sangs rgyas zhing / /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /dpag med bde ba'i rang bzhin phyir/ /dpal ldan bde chen zhes bya la/ /kun du bzang po mchog nyid dang / /mngon par byang chub byed pa po/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i thugs rjes 'gro ba gsum gyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /'joms par byed pa gcig pu rab 'jug dang ni dpag med sna tshogs pa'i/ /tshogs la chags pa las ni rnam par grol ba'i ‘ blo mchog mnyam 'dus pa/ /bdag gzhan phan dang bde rgyu 1de nyid du ni thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs/ /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa las/ shes rab dang thabs rnam par spros pa'i rim par bye ba ste dang po'o// //srid pa gzhom dka' 'khrul pa yi/ /nad kyis gzhom bdag la phan pa⑤/ /de nyid rin chen thob bya'i phyir/ /de nas 'di cung zad bshad/ /dpal ldan yan lag med rdo rje/ /snying rjer zhugs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i/ /thabs ni ji bzhin mdor bsdu bya/ /de 'di yin zhes rgyal bas kyang / /de ni brjod par nus ma yin/ /so so rang rig rang bzhin phyir/ /ngag gi lam gyis 'ugazung bya min/ /de lta na yang dus gsum gyi/ /sangs rgyas 'gro rnams dga' mdzad pas/ /mdo sde du ma gsang sngags kyi/ /spyod pa la sogs rim gyis bshad/ /dgra ༷dang don dag 'brel med phyir/ /thos pa la sogs shes pa yis/ /yul du nam yang 'gyur 26—78

ma yin/ /bstan bcos mtshan nyid ston pa yin/ /de phyir skyes bu dam pa yisami / /bla ma dam pa bsten par rigs/ /de ma gtogs par de nyid ni/ /bskal pa bye bas thob mi 'gyur/ /zhing bzang shin tu sbyangs pa las/ /sa bon med pa'i myu gu bzhin/ /de nyid rin chen ma rnyed par/ /nam yang dngos grub 'gyur ma yin/ /rnam par mi rtog lam la gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab don ston pa'i/ /man ngag ldan pa 'ga' tsam ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /sa steng gi ni slob dpon te/ /nges par yongs su shes byas la/ /dngos grub mchog ni bdag sgrub phyir/ /de ni 'bad pas bsnyen bkur bya/ /gang zhig gi 1ni gzi brjid kyis/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bcas pa'i/ /'byung po kun gyis —dge legs dang / /dpag med byang chub bde mchog thob/ /ltos pa med par thugs brtse ba'i/ /thugs rje'i sku can de la ni/ /bsam ngan rgyu yi dri bcas pas / /sems kyis ci phyir 'dud par byed/ /ji srid 'dod pa rnyed bar du/ /kun du phyag dang bkur ste dang / /'bad de chang la sogs pas mchod shā/ /bsnyen bkur sri zhu bla mar byed/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gnas/ /rin chen de nyid thob gyur nas/ /sdang la 4skyon rnams rtog byed cing / /'dris med tsam yang byed mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan yang ngan pa'i bdag /bla ma rdo rje can bsten nas/ /co 'dri bar ni byed pa'i bdag /bsam ngan rang la co 'dri 'am/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor ‘dang ni/ /bla ma'i phyag rgya 'phrog par byed/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dam chos la/ /ma spyad par ni smod kapar byed/ /dam tshig ngo mtshar che gyur la/ /rtag tu smod byed blo ldan paskyo/ /nga yang shin tu skrag byed ces/ /dpal ldan 26—79

rdo rje mgon pos gsungs/ /bsnyen bkur med par myur ba ru/ /bdag ni rjes su gzung 'tshal brjod/ /sdang ba'i sems kyis gzhan bstan tsute/ /kha cig nyes pa sgrogs la brtson/ /sangs rgyas don du mi gnyer zhing / /rnal 'byor pa dang slob dpon zhes/ /bdag ni ci nas shes 'gyur ba/ /de tsam la ni zhugs pa yin/ /brgya la ye shes rnyed 'gyur na/ /khengs pas shebla ma la ⑤sdang bar/ /sngags kyi rim pa las 'ongs pa/ /'di ni bdag gis shes zhes brjod—/ /sbar la 'bul gyis — yas rang bzung / /de nas brtsams te yas kyi ni/ /slob ma nga min slob dpon min/ /khro bcas smra ba gzhan dag yod/ /bla ma slu ba'i bsam pa yis4 / /co 'dri byed cing 'khyal byed pa/ /tshe 'di bde ba yod min na/ /de dag ji ltar 'grub par 'gyur/ /de lta bu yi sems can gang / /rang gi don la rgyab phyogs yin/ /de ni ngan 'gro kun snod du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mgon pos gsungs/ /bdag nyid sun 'byin byed pa de/ /dazul las 'gro ba gzhan yod min/ /shin tu mi bzad pa las rnams kyis/ /sdug bsngal rnam pa mang pos 'tshed/ /de bas dam pa don gnyer ba'i/ /skyes bu sgyudangos po thams cad kyis/ /dpag med 'bras bu rab ster ba'i/ /slob dpon kun du bsten par bya/ /byang chub tu ni nges byas pas/ /phrag dog nga rgyal ser sna dang / /de bzhin g.yo dang sgyu dang ni/ /skyo dub 'du shes yongs spangs te/ /rtag tu ngu yi spyod pa bzhin/ /mi g.yo ba yi sems kyis ni/ /dngos grub kun don ster ba'i bla/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bsnyen bkur bya/ /shin tu gus pas dus gsum du/ /zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas shing / /rang gi lus la'ang ltos med par/ /maṇ+ḍal sngon 'gro mchod par rkyabya/ /de nas bla 26—80

ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa / /de nyid dam pa gegs med par/ /slob ma yis ni thob par 'gyur/ /rtag tu 'od gsal dag pa ste/ /rgyal ba'i gnas 'gyur byang chub sems/ /gsal ba chos kyi dbyings kyi dngos/ /phun tshogs ma lus byed par 'gyur/ /nun pa'i tshogs ni 'joms byed pa'i/ /nyi ma dang ni nye ba yi/ /me shel gyi ni nor bu las—/ /rab 'bar me lce 'byung ba bzhin/ /slob ma'i sems ni nor bu la/ /'gro ba gzigs pa nyer 'gyur na/ /dri ma 'joms byed rnal 'byor gyi/ /me lce no 'bar de bzhin no/ /dpal ldan de nyid rin chen ni/ /rab tu rtogs pas 'bar rjes la/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs sangs rgyas rnams/ /thugs rjes thugs ni 'phangs nas su/ /myur du byin nas slob ma ni/ /sangs rgyas byin brlabs 1gdon mi za/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs bapas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /brtan pas g.yo dang zol dang nga rgyal sgrib pa thams cad yongs su spangs nas ni/ /man ngag ldan pa'i bla ma mtshungs pa med pa dad pas 'dir ni bsten par bya/ /des de nges par rgyal ba'i yon tan gter 'gyur de nyid rin chen rnyed gyur nas/ /bde gshegs kun gyis brtes pa'i byang chub mchog ni thob 6par 'gyur/ /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa ༅spub pa las rdo rje slob dpon bsnyen bkur nges par bstan — pa'i rim par phye ba ste gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /spub pa po la phan gdags phyir//dbang bskur srid gsum phun tshogs gnas/ /de ni — 'di la yang dag bshad/ /26—81

bde gshegs gnas kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rgyud ni 1lam gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /mkhas pas gang tshe dbang bskur na/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum yin/ /dpag med 'jig rten khams dbang phyug /bdag byin brlab pa'i dbang thob pa / /dam tshig nyams kyi 'jigs pas na/ /blo ldan de dag gis kyang 'dzin//sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam du/ /sngags kyi lam las de bzhin gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'i/ /sngags kyi lam du —de bzhin gsungs/ /de bas don kun la 'bad pas/ /dbang bskur don gnyer rgyal dag chosras/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ /ji ltar rigs 5pas bsnyen par bya/ /gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /mig bzang phyag rgya rnyed nas ni/ /gos dang tsan+dan phreng sogs kyis/ /rab tu brgyan te dadul bar bya/ /dri dang phreng sogs bsnyen bkur dang / /chang dang ston mo rgya chen dang / /phyag rgyar bcas pa'i gtso bo bani/ /gus pas 'bad de yang dag mchod/ /slob ma dad pas pus lha nga / /sa la legs par btsugs nas ni/ /thal sbyar bcas pa'i bstod pa 'dis/ /ston pa la ni gsol gdab bya/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa yi/ /stong nyid snying po bstod phyag 'tshal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa po/ /bdag don de nyid ston mdzad pa//chos bdag med las yang dag byung / /rdo rje sems khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin yon tan/ /rtag tu mgon po khyod las 'byung / /byang chub sems khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /dkon mchog gsum dang theg chen gyi/ /de nyid brtan dang g.yo bcas pa/ /26 82

khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /'gro ba'i sa bon khyod la 'dud/ /'gro don sna tshogs grub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /dpal ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras po khyod la 'dud—/ /yon tan rgya mtsho bka' drin gyis1/ /de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal—/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba/ /de ltar bka' drin mdzad du gsol/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje yis / /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang chen po/ /rdo rje chos la bstan pa bzhin/ /de ring mgon pos bka' drin stsol— / /khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /bdag la gzhan ni skyabs ma mchis / /'khor ba'i dgra las rab rgyal ba'i/ /mgon pos de phyir brtse bar mdzod/ /de nas dpal ldan slob dpon ni/ /phan pa'i bsam pas rjes brtse bas/ /snying rje slob ma la bskyed de/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas gang ba'i//dril bu sil snyan sgra dang bcas/ /bla re 'bar ba bres pa ru/ /me tog bdug pa nyams dga' 'khrigs/ /phreng dang dri zhim mchog tu bde/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lam gyi lha/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnal 'byor ldan/ /mchog tu rmad byung gnas gyur pa'i/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lor bkug nas ni/ /de nas slob dpon skal bzang gis1 / /phyag rgya dang ni sbyar byas te/ /rgyal ba'i gnas gyur byang chub sems/ /pad+ma'i snod du bzhag nas ni/ /bkra shis glu yi tshigs bcad dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab rgyal mtshan bcas/ /phyag rgyar ldan pas slob ma ni/ /'gro ba'i gtso bor dbang bskur bya/ /slob dpon dbang phyug mchog gis ni/ /dbang bskur rin chen byin nas su/ /rang bzhin gsal zhing mngon sbyangs pa/ /dam tshig nyams dga' sbyin par bya/ /rin chen chen po 26—83

ga pur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar po sbyar ba dang / /rdo rje yi ni chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa dag las yang dag byung / /'di ni bu khyod dam tshig ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /bzang pos rtag tu bskyang bar byos/ /de ni sdom 3pa mnyan par gyis/ /srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing / /bud med rin chen spang mi bya/ /khyod kyis slob dpon yang mi spang / /sdom pa shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur bas/ /slob ma sdig dang bral bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sras mchog de la ni/ /rjes su gnang ba de nas sbyin/ /byang chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo kun du ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /sems can mchog gis bskor bar 1gyis / /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor ltar rgya che ba//chags dang bral zhing mi skyo bas/ /da ni sems can rnams don gyis/ /rjes gnang bcas pa'i dbang bskur thob/ /bya ba byas shing rab dga' bas/ /'gro kun dga' bar byed pa yi/ /'jam pa'i tshig ni brjod par bya/ /de ring bdag gson 'bras bu yod/ /de ring skye ba 'bras bu yod/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /de ring sangs rgyas sras por gyur/ /skye la sogs pa'i rba rlabs dang / /nyon mongs 'dam ni rgal dka' ba'i/ /rtog pa'i rgya mtsho 'jigs chen las/ /mgon pos de ring bdag bsgral to/ /khyod zhabs bka' drin shes nas su/ /byang chub gang gi 3bdag 'tshal bas bag chags thams cad spangs nas su/ /rdzogs pa'i bzhin du bdag gyur to⑦/ /mig mdangs 'dzum dang bcas pa yis / /gus pas zhabs la btud nas su/ /'dzin pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rdzas ni gang dang gang bzhed pa/ /de 26—84

dang de ni dbul bar bya/ /bla ma thugs rje can gyis kyang / /slob ma'i 'dzin pa spang ba'i phyir/ /de la phan phyir blang bar bya/ /bla ma'i yon ni phul nas su//de nas mchod de phyag byas la/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas thob nas/ /slar yang 'di yis mimakhyen par gsol/ /de ring sangs rgyas mchog khyod kyi / /bka' drin bdag gis thob par 'gyur/ /de mthus bla med byang chub ni/ /ji bzhin bdag gis baspub 1par bgyi/ /mchog kun gyis ni mchod pa'i gnas/ /bla med byang chub thob nas ni/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i sems can rnams / /de nyid la ni dgod par bgyi/ /cho ga 'di dag nyid kyis ludabang bskur byin nas ni/ /slob ma tsalhag par mos pa'i yid kyis brtag byas la/ /zab cing rgya che ba la lhag par mos nas bani/ /tshig gis snyerin chen dbang bskur sbyin par bya / /dbang bskur mchog ni ma lus thob par 'gyur ba ste 3/ /rdo rje mchog 'dzin rnyed dka' mtshungs pa med pa'i gnas/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa dang ni dpal gyi zhing gyur pa/ /byang chub sems can dbang bskur de dag 1 blang bar bya/ / rjes su gnang ba thob nas 'jig rten gsum po yi/ /bya byed ngan pa'i dgra las rgyal ba'i blo ldan pas/ /dri ma med pa'i de nyid grub pa'i gnas der ni/ /'jug pa'i sems kyis rgyal ba de nyid rnal 'byor bya'o/ / thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa sgrub pa las/ byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur ba nges par bstan pa'i chorim par phye ba ste gsum pa'o// //gzhan don la phan brtson 'grus can/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /shes rab thabs kyi bsgom pa mchog /de nas 'di la chogasal bshad bya/ /26—85

gang zhig bsgoms 1pas 'khor ba yi/ /'jigs rung rgal dka'i rgya mtshor min / /rang don tsam gyis mya ngan 'das/ /der yang rnal 'byor pa mi gnas / /gang zhig rab kyis 1mthar phyin pas/ /dri med rmad byung sangs rgyas nyid/ /'phel dang 'grib las rnam grol ba'i/ /bla med byang chub skye 'gyur ba'o/ /phung po lnga la sogs chos rnams/ /gang yang dor bar bya min zhing / /nam yang gzung bar bya ba'ang min/ /chos kun mi mnyam mnyam pa nyid / /stong nyid bsgom par bya min la/ /stong nyid min pa'ang mi bsgom da mo / /stong nyid rnal 'byor pas mi gtang / /stong nyid min pa yang mi gtang 6/ /stong nyid stong min nyid 'dzin pa/ /rtog pa rab rgyas skye bar 'gyur / /yongs su btang ba'ang rtog pa ste/ /de bas de gnyis yongs su spangs—/ /'dzin pa gnyis ka yongs btang na/ /chags bral rnam par grol ba'i gnas/ /de dang 'brel bdag ces par yang / /kun rtog de phyir de gnyis spang / /chags pa med cing 'gyur ba med/ /sdig pa dang bral mngon zhen med/ /thog ma tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /mkhas pas nam mkha' lta bur bsgom / /snying rjer ldan pa'i dasems can la/ /rgyab kyis phyogs par mi bya'o//sems can yod dang med ces par/ /rnam rtog nyid ni mi bya'o/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin gang / /shes rab ces byar rab tu grags/ /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin du/ /ma lus 'gro don byed snying rje/ /mi dmigs gnas kyi shes rab dang / /mi dmigs snying rje chen po ste/ /nam mkha' la ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /blo ldan lhan cig gnyis su med/ /gang na'ang sgom mepa po med cing / /rnam par sgom pa'ang ci yang med/ /bsgom bya nyid kyang yod 26—86

min la7/ /de ni de nyid bsgom par bshad/ /bya ba'ang cung zad yod min la//dpyad par bya ba nyid kyang med/ /byed po dpyod pa las grol ba/ /don dam rnam par bsgom pa yin/ /gtong bar byed pa'ang yod min zhing / /'gog par byed pa'ang ci yang med/ /des na dor bar bya med cing / /'di blang bya gang yang med/ /gzugs rnams kun du blta ba dang / /de bzhin sgra rnams nyan pa dang / /dgod dang rtsed mo byed pa dang / /ro rnams sna tshogs myang ba dang / /las rnams thams cad byed pa ni/ /sems ni mi g.yo gnas byas nas/ /de nyid rig pa'i dal 'byor pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rgyun du skye bar 'gyur—/ /de nyid gnyis med bstan — pa ste/ /byang chub sems mchog 'di yin no/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi byang chub nyid/ /pha rol phyin pa kun dngos kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'di nyid/ /'di ni mnyam nyid brjod pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bsgom pa'i mchog /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos sogs—/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag nyid kyis / /'gro ba thams cad 'di las skyes/ /dngos dang dngos med dang bral ba'i/ /rnal 'byor pas ni de nyid bsgom/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba/ /bsgoms ༄ pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyes pa ma lus dang bral zhing / /nges par sdug bsngal ldog 'gyur na/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs yon tan ni/ /mtha' yas de las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog nun pa sdug bsngal ba/ /stug pos mngon par zil gnon cing / /'dod chags la sogs bzlog dka'i 5)dri mas g.yogs gyur pa'i / /rab tu 'thor rlung gis bskyod glog miltar g.yo ba yi/ /sems ni 26—87

'khor ba yin par rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /rtog pa las ni rnam par grol zhing 'od gsal ba/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma'i sgrib g.yogs rab tu spang 1 / /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa med na de nyid ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i don du sems can mchog gis gsungs/ /de bas sdug bsngal mang po'i —tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa/ /'di las gzhan pa gang yang yod ba ma yin la/ /thar 'dod 'phags pa khyod kyi bde ba dpag med pa/ /skye ba'i rgyur yang 'di las gzhan pa gang yang med/ /sdug bsngal ma lus zad bya'i go cha bgos nas ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde mchog thob par 'dod pa yis 4/ /sems ni brtan byas de la 'bad de dpyad byas la/ /de yis rang bzhin bdag gi rang bzhin nyid du bya/ /skye ldan rnams kyi yid 'di ji srid rtog pa'i mun pa snam bu mthug pos dkris gyur pa/ /de srid sdug bsngal dpag tu med yin de nas de ni ji srid bshus par gyur pa ni / /de srid bde ba rgya chen mtshungs med yin pas 'phags mchog de la nan tan gyis shig dang / /de zad nas ni de nyid la gnas yon tan rgyas pa rang nyid kyis ni snang bar 'gyur/ /de dag ni thabs dang shes rab rnam par gtan la dbab pa'i sgrub pa las/ de kho na nyid bsgom pa'i rim par bye ba ste bzhi pa'o// //chos kun mnyam nyid rmad byung ba/ /de nyid spyod pa bla na med/ /rnam rtog dgra rnams gsod byed pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gzhan/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gnas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sras la phan bya'i phyir/ /de nyid yan lag med rdo rjes/ /de nas 'di las gsal bshad bya/ /rga ba la 26—88

sogs rba rlabs 'khrigs/ /skye ba'i rgya mtsho 3cher 'jigs las/ /'byung po thams cad sgrol ba'i gru/ /nyes med par ni 'gro ba'i gru/ /yid 'ong yon tan kun gyi gnas/ /myur du dngos grub bzang po byed/ /'dod pa'i don kun rab sgrub pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /ma lus pa yi sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan rgyur 'gyur bar ni/ / rdo rje 'dzin pas rab tu bsngags pa ste/ /'di ma gtogs par dngos grub skye bar 'gyur 1min de phyir thar pa 'dod pas spyod pa mnyam med 'di spyad bya/ /lha min dgra — dang brgya byin grong khyer gsum dgra nor sbyin tshangs sogs rnams kyis zhabs kyi pad+mar mchod byas pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang mchog ni myur du thob byed sdig pa zad byed 'di ni mkhas pas spyad par bya/ /dpal ldan tsa rdo rje sems dpas 'gro la phan phyir yang dag spyod pa 'di gsungs te/ /sna tshogs gzhan dag ma lus gdul bya'i skye bo du ma'i dbang du byas nas ni/ /ji skad gsungs pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs bla med dngos grub ma lus rab bsgrub min/ /kun bzang mtshungs med spyod pa 'di las 'grub 'gyur bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs—/ /dpal ldan slob dpon rdo rje can/ /mgon la kun nas phyag byas la/ /bya ba byas pa'i blo can gyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa bstan sgyu par bya/ /de nas rang 'dod nges byas la/ /'du 'dzi kun la rgyab phyogs te/ /seng ge'i bdag nyid kun rgyu ba/ /de nyid ldan pas spyad par bya/ /'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa yis/ /ji bzhin yang dag don rig pas/ /yang dag ldan pas 'jug pa bdag /gnas med sems ni bstan par bya/ /khams gsum 'di dag de nyid de/ /phung po khams la sogs mtshan nyid/ /thams cad sgyu ma mi 26—89

lam bzhin/ /mdor bsdus 'di ltar shes byas lanya/ /'gyod dang rmugs dang gnyid la sogs/ /longs spyod rgya chen 'du 'dzin dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten chos ngargyad po/ /shin tu thag ring spang bar bya/ /gnyis med nges par byas nas ni/ /rtag tu g.yo ba med pa yis/ /pha rol phyin drug sbyor ba ni/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub bsgrub 1par bya/ /sems can rnam par mi rtog bzhin/ /sems can don la shin tu chags/ /sems ni byang chub nges byas la/ /de nyid spyod pa la brten bya/ /shes rab thabs su ldan pa yis/ /chags pa kun la rgyab bstan te/ /de nyid goms pa la 'bad pas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bdag byin brlab par rab gsal bas/ /sems ni ji lhar rjes mthun zhepar/ /sngags kyi lam las rab bshad pa'i/ /dam tshig dag ni kun spyad bya/ /bgegs dang bdud tshogs zhi bya'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi lnga po byin gyis brlabs/ /bshang gci la sogs rnams gnas pa/ /'di ni srung mib bla med yin/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang gdon gyi tshogs / /bdud dang log 'dren nyid dag ni/ /'di yis rjerab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /mi dang rnga mo las byung dang / /rta dang glang po las byung ba/ /lnga pa khyi las byung ba ste/ /sgron ma shes rab can gyis bza' sems ni dga' bar byed pa yis / /dam tshig chen po gzhan dag kyang / /rlung ni 'khrugs pa zhi bya'i phyir/ /thugs kyi rdo rje can mnyes bya/ /thams cad du ni thar 'dod pas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bsten bya/ /dam pa'i don du gang gnas pa/ /kun rdzob dag pa'i lus bzung nas/ /bud med mdzes pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /thams cad rtswa ni kun du gnas/ /de bas phyi rol don 26—90

las byung / /rdo rje mgon pos don de gsungs/ /bram ze'i rigs sogs las byung dang / /mtha' yas 1skyes dang phyag rgya dang / /gzhan gyi chung ma tshul nyams dang / /dman dang cha lugs mi sdug dang / /skyed ma dang ni sgyug mo dang / /rang gi bu mo sring mo dang / /de nyid sbyor bas 'dod spyod na/ /spub po myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems ni tshim par byed pa yi/ /gling bu sogs las byung ba mnyan/ /phyi rol phyag rgya ka ra na/ /ro ni sna tshogs tshig byed bya/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /'dod pa'i yon tan mchog rnams kyis//sems ni rin chen dag bya'i phyir/ /rtag tu bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /chu skyes rdo rje chu dang ni/ /sgron ma'i 'o ma rab rgyas mchod/ /phreng dang tsan+dan gos bzang sogs/ /sems ni skyo ba med par bya/ /bgrod dang bgrod min sogs pa ni/ /'dir ni nam yang bya ba min/ /sgyu ma lta du sogs sbyor bas/ /thams cad la ni longs spyod bya/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung bas na/ /mi mthun phyogs ni gang yang med/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin rab spyad bya/ /spub pa po la phan gdags phyir/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus pa/ /'di dag thams cad longs spyad phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sprul pa yin/ /ye shes mtha' yas rnyed pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs la'ang phyag min na/ /rtag tu bsgom la 'grub pa yis/ /lugs ma la sogs smos ci dgos/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin te/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /de bas bdag nyid lha yin no/ /sgyung ba dang ni dkyil 'khor bri‘5/ /phyag rgya bcing dang mchod rten las/ /sbyin sreg dang ni gsang sngags zlos / /po ti klog pa la sogs pa/ /dpal 26—91

ldan rdo rje mgon po yis/ /mos pa'i dbang du mdzad nas ni/ /gzhan dag la ni bstan pa ste/ /de nyid rig pa'i sems kyis min/ /mar sar 'dod pa'i snasnying po ni/ /blangs te dar ba 'dor bar byed/ /de lhar chos kyi snying thob pas/ /rtog pa ma lus spang bar bya/ /rnam par mi rtog gnas blo can/ /gnas min dogs pa spangs byas nas / /thugs kyi rdo rje'i ༅bka' bzhin du/ /de nas 'grub 'gyur the chos med/ /phyag rgya sbyor bas kun du 'khu / /rdo rje bcug ste bskyod pa dang / /ma mchu'i sbrang mchog btung bya zhing / /de yis 'dren pa'i sgra gsal bas/ /blangs shing dul ba'i 3longs spyad na/ /nges par dga' ba rgya chen gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /ring por mi thogs 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar yid 'khrugs mi 'gyur ba rje3/ /de lha de ltar spyad par bya/ /sems kyi rang bzhin 'khrugs byur na/ /nam yang dngos grub 'gyur ma yin/ /de bas dngos grub mchog 'dod pa'i/ /sgrub ‘ pa pos ni 'dzin pa spang / /sems dang rjes mthun sbyor ba yis/ / mchog gi go 'phang bsgrub par bya/ /1 dngul chu bzung bas bsgrubs ji bzhin/ /thabs kyi gzhi yi sbyor ba yis/ /de bzhin sems kyi dngul chu bzung / /sbyor ba dag ni gang yin pa/ /de ru de yis ༅gnas par bya/ /dus dang grangs ni yongs spangs nas/ /de nyid rig pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gnyis med mtshungs pa med pa gang yin nyin re zhing / /de nyid mchog ni rgyun du rjes su bsten par bya//'di yis badri ma med cing rdo rje lta bu dang / /grib ma lta bu'i skyasku ni mtshungs med thob par 'gyur/ /blo dang ldan pas shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kun/ /chorang bzhin gyis ni dri ma med par rnam 'byed de/ /'jig rten gsum gyi sdug 26—92
