po nyid/ /yon tan rnams dang skyon rnams ni/ /sems kyi rnam par brjod pa ste—/ /de la dmigs pa ye shes mchog /khrem gnyer med pa'i rang bzhin can//ye shes rang las skye bar 'gyur/ /cung zad kyang ni bsgom pa med/ /gang phyir bsam med chos 'di nyid/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas/ /shin tu dri med ches dag cing / /sgom pa po dang bsgom bya spangs/ /dpal ldan bde ba'i 'byung gnas kun/ /rnam rtog med pas nges mthong 'gyur/ /lha yi gzugs ni du ma dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs sku/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor pa ①yi dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad dang / /de bzhin rig pa'i lha mo nyid/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bzang po ru/ /snang ba'i rnam pa dri med nyid/ /de bzhin mdo sde'i ②sde snod dang / /gzhan yang pha rol phyin rim dang / /sngags dang phyag rgya rig pa dang / /de bzhin snying nyid bskul ba dang / /sngags kyi smra ba ma lus pa/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni sbyin sreg dang / /bzlas dang mchod pa'i cho ga rnams/ /gnyis med las ni rang nyid skyes/ /zhi ba nyi ma ②lta ba dang ④//de bzhin mchod 'os khyab 'jug pa/ /rig byed tshad mar smra ba dang / /gzhad yang rang bzhin ⑤skye bar 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen gnas kyi sbyor ba 'di/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mi rtog ④pa/ /kun du bzang po zhes bya'i lha/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung / /sa 'og ral gri ril du dang / /shing lham bum pa gnod sbyin mo/ /bcud dang mig sman bzang po yang / /rang nyid 'grub ste gzhan du min/ /sngags pas dngos po bsgom bya min/ /dngos med nyid kyang bsgom bya min/ /rnam par mi rtog mos pa yis/ /thams cad rang nyid skye 26—277

bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid chekyang 'grub 'gyur na/ /zhi ba khyab 'jug sogs ci smos/ /de la tha snyad yod ma yin/ /gzugs dang kha dog mtshan nyid med/ /sgyu ma'i rnam 'dzin bzang mo nyid/ /dang po'i rang bzhin dri ma med—/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam dag ste/ /rtag tu dga' bde'i 'byung gnas nyid/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dang bral/ /me long me lce 'bar 'dra / /mchog dga'i bde ba dam pa ste/ /rtag tu bde chen 'byung ba'o/ /yi ge dang ni ming brjod pa/ /sbyor ba'i ②tshig tu rab tu bstan/ /gzhan du ngag gi lam 'das phyir/ /smra ba nyid de mi nus so/ /bya ba'i tshul la zhugs pa yin—/ /'dod pa'i don la rol pa yi/ /mchod pa ②mchog gi dus su ni/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan/ /shes rab gnyis su med pas ni/ /gcig pu'i rnam pa'i rang bzhin las/ /bag chags zad par gyur pas na④/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni nges par 'thob/ /sna tshogs rigs kyi mthu yis ni/ /lta ba sna tshogs sbyor ba las/ /bag chags dri ma bsags pas ni/ /gnyis med nyid ni rtogs pa min/ /thog mtha' dbus dang mtha' ma zal/ /bskyed pa dang ni rdzogs pa spangs/ /bsam dang sems pa dang bral ba/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /gnyis med ces bya sangs rgyas su/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs/ /de phyir sangs rgyas rtogs pa las/ /spub po dam pa sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /tshig gi sbyor ba bstan pas ⑤na/ /sangs rgyas dang ni gnyis med brtags4 / /don dam tha dad med tshul gyis/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas gnyis su med/ /bstan pa'i ye shes 'char bas na/ / rtogs pa'i ④rtog pa ring spangs te/ /dngos po la sogs rtog pa kun/ /de nyid las ni lkog tu 26—278

gyur| /bzang po'i ⑫zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ / nyams pa gso ba'i 0sbyor ba las/ /gnyis med ming du gzung ba la/ /bdag ma 'byor ba ②bzod par mdzod3 / /mkhas pas rab tu 'bad pas kyang / /bag chags rnams ni zad par byas/ /gzhan du bskal pa grangs med du/ /bye ba sangs rgyas nyid ma yin//ye shes gnyis med mgon pos ni/ /bag chags rnams ni zad par byed/ /bag chags zad par gyur pa na/ /gnyis su med pa'i sangs rgyas brjod/ /bag chags bral ba'i gnas skabs na/ /skyes bu tha ma 'bring po dag /gang gi zhuphyogs ni yod min pas/ /de ni sangs rgyas brjod par bya/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /shes rab cha ni yang dag gnas/ /thabs ni dngos po bskyed ④ pa po/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis bstan/ /de dag 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can/ /ro gcig rnam par sbyor ba las/ /'di ni gnyis su med pa'i mchog /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs/ /bsam dang sgom ④pa por bstan med/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs can ma/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob bya'i phyir/ /bzang pos bzang po kasungs pa nyid/ /dpe ni chos rnams thams cad la/ /bzhag 0pa nyid du de mi nus/ /mig sogs yid kyi rnam shes kyi⑫/ /dpe yi dngos po rnam par spangs/ /gcig nyid thog ma med pa dang / /mtha' med rnam par yang dag gnas/ /bla ma'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las/ /mchog gcig ⑩gis ni shes par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor skyes bur bshad pa ste/ /rjes su rnal 'byor rig pa'i mchog /gnyis 'das shin tu rnal 'byor te/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor che/ /rnal 'byor pa nyid sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /nyi zla gza' yis ⑪zin pa na/ /shes rab rdo rje'i sbyor ba 26—279

las—/ /zhu bas gnyis med ye shes kyis/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /don dam dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /grub pa'i gzugs su the tshom med/ /snying rje gnyis su med pa'i mchog /①gzugs kyi thog ma 'bring po ni/ /gang yang mig gis mthong gyur pa②/ /don dam don gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /gnyis med dam par blta ②bar bya/ /gang yang rna bas thos 'gyur ba'i/ /sgra dang sgra ngan rnam phye ba/ /sgra las 'das pa ④ ye shes gtso/ /thos pa gnyis su med pa'i mchog /gang yang lce yis ⑤myong 'gyur 'i/ /ro mchog ro ni ngan pa yi/ /ro drug gcig tu gyur pa yi/ /gnyis med mchog ni rtogs par bya/ /sna yis ④ dri ni snam shes pa'i/ /ri dwags lte ba la sogs dri/ /gcig tu gyur pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /gnyis med mchog ni shes par bya/ /lus kyi reg bya'i rang bzhin rnams/ /rigs bzang rigs ngan rnam bye ba/ /thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis/ /snyoms 'jug gnyis su med pa'i mchog /mtha' med thams cad khyab pa po⑦/ /ye shes snang ba'i 'od zer las/ / rang byung ②mchog tu dga' ba nyid/ /gnyis med sangs rgyas dam pa ste/ /'du byed tshor ba 'du shes dang / /gzugs dang rnam par shes pa nyid/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin sku/ /lnga med gnyis su med pa'i bdag /rtag pa mi bskyod ⑫rin chen dang / /tshe dpag med dang don yod bdag /lnga bdag gyur pa'i ril po ⑫ni/ /drug pa bde ba chen po nyid/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha'i nyid deng ⑪ni/ /'byung lnga lhan cig skyes pa ni/ /byang chub gnyis su med par 'gyur/ /me long mnyam nyid bya nan tan/ /so sor rtog pa chos dbyings rnams/ /rnam par rtog pa ⑫26—280

rkyen gyis brtags/ /rang byung ⑫gcig pu gnyis su med/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis ni/ /lta ba la sogs rnam par bye/ /zhi sogs khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /kun mkhyen gcig pu gnyis su med/ /mig las byung sogs ma lus dang / /yid kyi spyod yul las 'das pa/ /don dam gnyis med ces bya ba/ /ngag gi spros pa kun rdzob kyi②/ /gnyis su med la kun du brtags/ /don dam gnas skabs dbyer med pa/ /gnyis su med la sangs rgyas med/ /rtog pas nam mkhar sbyor ba ②ni/ /ngag gis ④spros pa bstan pa yin/ /bstan bcos rim pas tshig tu ni/ /rnam par bye ste bshad pa yin/ /gnyis med las gzhan sangs rgyas ni/ /smra ba nyid du mi nus so/ /stong pa bcu drug bshad pa dang / /shes rab bcur ni brtags pa dang / /sangs rgyas lngar yang bshad pa dang / /rnam rig dag ⑤ni gnyis su med/ /me long snang ba'i gzugs rnyan ni/ /ji ltar kun du snang 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin gnyis med ye shes 'dir/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam mi khyab/ /khams gsum dag ni thams cad du/ /skye dang gnas pa'i rgyu rnams kyi ④/ /de kun gnyis med ye shes las/ /skye bo thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho ri dang shing dang ni//rtswa lhug gel ba la sogs pa/ /gnyis med ye shes las byung ④ba/ /'di la the chos yod ma yin/ /pha dang ma yang gcig pa ste/ /'di la gnyis yod ma yin no| /gnyis med ye shes rang bzhin las/ /gzhan yang thams cad skye bar 'gyur / /'di lhar thabs dang sbyor ba yis/ /shes rab gnyis med rang bzhin las/ /skye ba 'dir ni rnal 'byor pas/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'phral du rnyed| /ye shes dag gi rang bzhin mchog /bla ma brgyud pa ༅rim pa'i 26—281

gzhung / /snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal/ /bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyis gsungs / /bzang po'i zhal snga'i bka' drin las/ /bsam med sgom ⑫pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor 'di yis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni nges par 'thob②/ /rta mchog pa yi ②zhal snga nas/ /in+d+ra spyo ti legs smrar kyi bcas / /sgeg pa'i rdo rje gun ⑤di ri/ /slob dpon pad+ma snying rje che/ /chos kyi zhal snga'i rim pa las/ /bzang po'i zhal sngar phrad pa nyid/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog /thams cad kyi ni dgongs pa gcig /sngags kyi smra ba ma lus dang / /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /mdo sde sde snod la sogs pa/ /'dir gcig gnyis med bde chen pos/ /mchod 'os zhi ba nyi ma sogs / /so so'i ④ grub pa'i mtha' nyid dang / /khyab 'jug dang ni shes bu'i chos/ /gnyis su med par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis med phyi rol yod min pas / /lha dang lha min tha ma ni/ /thams cad gnyis med ye shes las/ /so sor snang ba gsal bar 'gyur/ /stong pa'i bye brag tu bye ba/ /snying rje dang ni gnyis med 'dres/ /thabs dang shes rab mnyam par ldan/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin kun bla ma/ /'di ni bzang po'i zhal snga'i gzhung / /ye shes rgya mtsho dam pa nyid/ /'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ /dam pa thams cad skye 'gyur zhing / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug che/ /gang yang sangs rgyas sogs grags dang / /nyi zla gza' skar bcas pa yang / /ye shes rgya mtsho las byung zhing / /legs smin dang ni dbyangs can nyid/ /ro yi mchog ni myang ba dang / /tshangs bcas lha min mi rnams ni/ /bdud rtsi las ni thams cad long ༄ / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum̐m du yang dam bshad pa/ /26—282

gru gsum dam par 'byung ba ni/ /nya)'di ni chos kyi 'byung gnas brjod/ /nyi zla chu yis gang ba yis/ /shes rab gzugs ni cher 'bar ba/ /bde las bde ba chen po kun/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob ( byed ma/ /pad chen 'dab ma bye ba nyid/ /de yi dadus na rnam par gnas/ /rtag tu ge sar bcas pa'i nang / /ā li ka li yang dag ldan/ /zla ba nyi ma'i gos kyis bkab/ /shes rab dgu dang yang dag ldan/ /'dzag cing 'bar ba'i rnam pa nyid/ /thig le zla ba 'char ba'i mchog /dga' ba skyed byed bzang mo ste/ /ma lus don gyi 'bras ster ma/ /dang ba'i bdud rtsi shin tu gang / /nor du rin chen mnyam par ldan/ /yon tan mtha' yas sa ②yi gzhi/ /bde dpal rdo rje can gyi gnas| /thams cad tshim par byed pa mo/ /'byin byed skyed par byed pa mo//lha yi gzugs ni du ma dag /gnyis med rgya mtsho las ni 'byung / /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs gzugs dang / /sprul pa yi ni sku nyid kyis/ /sems can du ma kun gyi don/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams kyi/ /mtha' yas mthar thug thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba po/ /stobs bcu yi ni ye shes ldan/ /shes rab gtso bo dam pa nyid/ /mkha' 'gro pad+ma nges par rig /lam mchog bzang po'i rim las 'ongs/ /snying ga lte ba'i pad+ma dang / /de bzhin lkog ma'i pad+ma nyid/ /dril can skye —gnas pad+ma yi/ /dngos su 'dzag pas rnam par gnas/ /bshang gci khu ba 'pho ba dang / /lha dang sdom dang nyan pa dang / /ro mchog rnams ni rig par 'gyur/ /sgo dgu dag nas rgyu ba yi/ /sa bon pad bsnol rnam pa mtshungs/ /'og dang steng du rnam par gnas| /'di ni shes rab ces bshad pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yul nyid do//26—283

de yi dbus na gnas pa'i lha/ /mchoka gi dbang phyug gnyis med pa/ /pad+ma gsum du rol par 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde chen po/ /me dang chu dang dbang chen dang / /rlung gis ②rnam par brgyan ②pa nyid/ /dal bus 'khor ba'i ②sbyor ba yis/ /bye brag gsum du 'dren par byed/ /dril can du ga'i lam gyis ni/ /sna yi rtse mor sbyor ba las/ /srol gong rdo rje'i bu ga ru/ /sangs rgyas phreng ④ba gnyis su med/ /'khor bas yongs su nyon mongs na/ /dril can rtse mor ngal so nas/ /rdo rje lce yis ⑤rab sbyor bas/ /bdud rtsi btung bar bya ba nyid/ /de nas lus ni rnam dag pa/ /rang bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /shes rab bzang zhing yid gzhungs pa/ /rga 0dang 'chi ba nyams par byas/ /bzang po'i zhal snga'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag la rnam par rol par gsungs/ /nying 'dzin bdud rtsi zhes bya ba/ /bde ba'i mchog de bzhin du min/ /sna nas rngub pa'i bye brag gis/ /haṃ gi rnam pa ⑦mi shigs pa—/ /dril ②can du ga'i lam du ni/ /rtsa dmas sum cu rtsa gnyis gnas/ /so ni sum cu rtsa gnyis brjod/ /cha dang cha min gnyis su med/ /sna yis klurngub pa'i bye brag gis/ /haṃ gi rnam pa mi shigs pa/ /dril can bu ga'i lam gyis ni/ /nges par 'dren pa lam gyi mchog /⑫de la sgo ru ngal so zhing / /dag pa'i rnam pa ⑫'od gsal ba/ /thog ma med nyid ces bya ba/ /bde dpal rnam par yang dag gnas/ /de nas rlung gis phul ba dang / /dbang chen yang ni gsal bar 'gyur/ /nges pa'i lam yang gsal 'gyur ba/ /mchog gi dbang phyug mi shigs pa/ /sa ni bcu gsum dbang phyug mchog /thog ma med par grub pa'i gzugs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas so/ /bzang po'i zhal 26—284

snga'i man ngag ste/ /snying po brgyud pa'i rim pa yi/ /gang yang thos pa kun bzung nas/ /de thos bsam pas bsgom pa yin/ /bzang po'i zhal snga'i bka' drin gyis/ /nyan pa goms pa'i sbyor ba las 3rngo/ /dge can tog rtse zhes bya bas/ /gzhung 'di dag ni yang dag bsdus/ /bdag ni bzang po'i zhal snga dang / /slob dpon gzhan dang rnal 'byor pa/ /sems can rnams ni ma lus pa'i—/ /bran du skye dang skye gyur cig /bsam pa 'di yi sgo nas ni/ /gal te bdag ni sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /'on te dmyal bar 'gro srid na/ /dmyal nyid bde ba can du shog /bsam med gnyis med rdzogs pa yi/ /rim pa'i man ngag mkhyen pa bla/ /lha yi rang bzhin ma lus sngags gzhung rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor rgyas pa mtha' yas bla ma las byung —dri med 'di/ /glen pa blo zhan bdag nyid dran pa tsam phyir bris pa yin/ /bsam ②gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i slob dpon tog rtse zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so — 0bde ba'i myu gu dang 'gos kyis bsgyur ba'o⑫// // da 26—286

༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragun/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉staba'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pangs/283 ༷/tram̐ ༵rdoswā/ra 〉ṅka'adi ni chos kyi 'byung ba ni// me 〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉thob/ ②〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉mi/ ④〈〈pe〉〉284 nyu〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾tsho ra 〉〉brgyad/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stab/ du〈〈be 〉྾'dir 〉snaraphreng /⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stago ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉to/sa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉4ra/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stadron/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉stab/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sku/ // ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉mir/285 ①〈〈pe 〉྾mu ra 〉stanas/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngarabyung / ③〈〈pe 〉〉waphyir bris pa yin/ /bsam/ 〈po ra 〉7)sa bris pa yin/ /bsam/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sku/ // sri〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉kyi 'gyur ro/ du〈〈pe 〉mi bkra shis/bsdur 'bras re'u migasgro/da/ (1༷6༷)26wa 287

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ku dṛsne nirgo ta tsā ma ④/ bod skad du/lta ba ngan pa sel ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig 'di la gnas gyur na/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob 'gyur ba/ /dang po las pa'i cho ga nyid/ /lta ngan sel ba bshad par bya/ /'dir ni sems can ni rnam pa gnyis te/ slob pa dang / mi slob pa'o/ /de la lhag pa'i bsam ⑤pas mos pa'i sbyor ba dang /sa la zhugs pa'i sbyor ba dang / lnga la dbang thob par mthar thug pa'i bar du rgyu'i gnas skabs la gnas pa'i slob pa rnams shin tu rnam par dag pa'i las dang po'i cho gas tshogs gnyis bsags nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par 'thob bo/ /mi slob pa yang de kho na nyid dang / 'bras bu rnam par rtog pa ni gnyen po'i phyogs kyis gsal pal/ shākya thub pa lhar sngon gyi 26—288

smon lam gyi shugs kyi nus pas zung du 'jug pa nyid du 'bad pa med par ⑫sems can gyi don byed pa ni/ mtshan nyid rgyun mi 'chad par dang po'i las la 'jug go zhes bya bar gnas so/ /de yang / mgon po sems dpa' ④mi mnga' zhing / /rnam rtog g.yo ba mi mnga' yang / /khyod nyid ngang gis 'jig rten la/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa 'jug par 'gyur/ /gzhan don phun tshogs sangs rgyas kyi②/ /'bras bu gtso bo gzhan ma yin/ /des na sangs rgyas 'bras bur brjod/ /kun rtog rlung dmar thams cad kyis/ /dpag bsam shing lhar mi bskyod pa/ /de ltar sems can thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa ma lus yongs rdzogs byed/ /'ams bu de nyid mi mthun phyogs/ /blang dang dor ba rnam spangs nas/ /blo ldan rdzogs pa'i byang chub rtogs/ /dang po las pa 'bad pas sam④/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /'on te las dang po pas ni slob pa'i cho ga nyid rigs na'ang mi slob ⑤rang bzhin med pa bsgom par gyur pa dmas la las dang po pa'i rtsom pa yod pa ji lta bu/ dper na 'dir yang gser gyi sgrog gis bcings pa lta bu nyid do zhe na bden te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs pa dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /shes ra kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 0 lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /de lta bas na rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid do zhes bstan pa yin no/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa lngas ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming mi thob ⑦po zhes gsungs pa dang / 'phags pa dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las kyang / shes rab dang zal ba'i thabs ni 'ching ba'o/ /thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyang 'ching ba'o /26—289

shes rab dang bcas pa'i thabs ni thar pa'o/ /thabs dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyang thar pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag ni 'di'i bdag nyid kyibla ma dam pa'i man ngag nyid las sgron ma dang snang ba bzhin du lhan cig skyes pa grub — pa bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /de lta bas na/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa//sangs rgyas ye shes 'dod pa gang / /rnal 'byor pa kun bya ba nyid/ /dang po'i las can bstan pa gang / /pha rol phyin lngar gang bstan pa/ /dang po'i las can zhes bya ba/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa yi / /ngo bo nyid ni dpyad mi bya / /de bzhin du/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab la gus pas/ /rtag tu blo ldan gyis bsten na/ /bde bar shes rab 'byung bar 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa gsum/ /bsam gtan shes rab chos kyi'o/ /brtson 'grus gnyis kar 'dod pa yin/ /zhes bstan pas na/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pas/ shin tu dam par dag pas gnas par bya'o/ /zlog — pa ni med par smra bar zal bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang / dge dang mi dge mgang phyir dngos med kyang / /de ltar dge ba nyid bya mi dge min/ /'jig rten kun rdzob chu yi zla 'dra yang / /de las yid 'ong sdug bsngal yid mi bde—/ /zhes bstan pa yin na/ de ltar na slob pas smyon pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas nas/ rnam par mi rtog pa myong bar 'dod pas las dang po pa la 'jug pa ji lta bu zhe na/ ( lus sbyin par gtong ba dang ldan pa'i spyod pa ste/lus ni sbyin par btang byas la/ /phyin kyi nas spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /lus gtong ba'i sbyin pa dang lus dang ngag dang yid kyis 26—290

sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa'i tshul khrims dang / grang ba dang kyi/tsha ba dang / sog les gshag bye pa la bzod pa'i zod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad kyi gnod pa las mnyam pa nyid kyi brtson 'grus dang / dngos po thams cad kyi rjes su zhugs pa'i 'bad pa med pa'i rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba'i bsam gtan dang / chos thams cad mi dmigs par rjes su brtag pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab ste/ 'bad pa med par — 7ro gcig pa'i ngang gis thams cad du ro gcig par 'dod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi mchog go/ /de lha bas na/ snyon pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa yang dang po las la 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /tshu rol mthong bar ④grags pa nyams pa 'jig rten pha rol slu tsab thams cad du rigs pa tsam ma yin pa smra ba ltar ni ma yin no/ /de la slob ma brtul zhugs can byang chub sems dpa' la ni༄ / dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya—/ /phyin 0 nas bslab pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes dgyes pa'i rdo rje las gsungs so/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin pa ni/ /btsun pa'am slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ /bdag dge bsnyen ming 'di zhes bya ba/ byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o—/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du bya'o/ /bdag gsum la skyabs su song bar btsun pas gzung du gsol/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol—/ bdag dge bsnyen ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas nye bar bzung nas nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du srog chags gsod pa dang / gzhan gyi nor rku dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / de bzhin du myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba 'thung ba dang / dus ma yin par za ba dang /26—291

phreng dang / kha dog dang / gru dang gar dang / rtse 'jo dang / khri stan dang / khri stan chen po las ldog par bgyi'o/ /bdag yon tan brgyad kyis dgra bcom pa'i tshul du gnas par gyi'o ①zhes bya ba ni gso sbyong sbyin pa'i tshig ste/byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bas/ srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa la spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / rang bzhin gyi ②kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pas 0myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba chang 'thung ba dang lnga las log par bgyi'o—/ /mos pa dang spyod pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i ④mi dge bcu yongs su shes par byas la/ yang mi bya bar yongs su bsdam par bya zhing / dge ba'i las rnams ni bya'o/ /tho rangs kyi thun la langs la gdong bkru ba la sogs byas nas/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pas/ oṃ lha'ihūṃ phyo zhes pas/ bdag dang / gnas dang / rnal 'byor srung bar 0byas la/rtog ④pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsam gtan dang bzlas pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa bya ba'oḍa 3/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa yang lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de yi rjes la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ④ye swā hā/ zhes pa ⑫brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dpal gnod gnas la dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas na maḥs marnya busgyu dzā ⑪sarba ta dzā ga ⑫ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ sasna ra sam+bha ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i gtor ma'i sngags lan bdun bzlas shing /lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga brkyang ba las/ bdud rtsi lngas sgo drung na 'dug pa'i gtor ma'i zas chu dang bcas pa zan 'bru gcig gi ⑫kyang yul ma ga dha'i bre bo che re re 'byung bar gyur par bsams la/ yi dwags kyi tshogs ma lus pa la 26—292

se gol lan gsum gtogs pas sbyin par bya'o/ /da ni sems can thams cad la du gcig pa'i rnam pa ltar balha ba'i byams pa dang / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las 'byin par skyabasam pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi ༅snying rje'i bsam pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba spros ②par 'gyur ④ba'i yid las byung ba'i dga' ba dang / mi bden pa la chags ⑤pa yongs su spong ba'i mtshan nyid kyi ④btang snyoms bsgom ④la/ sems can thams cad kyi don la spro ba'i sems kyis ba'i lci ba gtsang ma blangs la chu gtsang ma dang bsres la/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs la / sa'i cha gru bzhi pa la sogs pa gang yang rung bar 'dod pa'i ⑤maṇ+ḍal byas la/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 4zla ba dang /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ sngon po ⑫yongs su rdzogs pa'i mi bskyod pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa sku mdog sngon po'o/ /de'i rjes la shar phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/⑪ yi ge oṃ dkar po las rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i rnam par snang mdzad dang / de nas lho phyogs kyi 'dab ma la yi ge hūṃ ⑫ser po las yang dag par byung ba'i sku mdog ser po mchog ⑫sbyin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /de nas nub phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ yi ge hri dmar po las yang dag par byung ba'i nying nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar ba'o⑫/ /de nas byang phyogs kyi 'dab ma la yi ge khaṃ lngang gu las byung ba'i ⑫mdog lngang gu mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa'i don yod grub pa bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ zhes pa la sogs pa mngon par zhen pa'i sngags pas ⑫'dod pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa dbul bar bya'o/ /26—293

de bzhin gshegs pa lnga po 'di dag ni/ na bza' ngur smrig bsnams ⑫pa/gtsug tor dang bcas pa'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa ste rnam par snang mdzad ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ /de la bzhi po ni mi bskyod pa la phyogs pa'o/ /mi bskyod pa ni spub pa po la phyogs pa'o/ /de dag gi mdun na gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa — rtogs pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du mngon du byas nas gdon par bya'o/ /de la gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni 1skyabs su mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /sems can 'di dag thams cad mgron — gnyer nas/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang / /gso sbyong 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad/ /bsnyung ༅bar bya ba spyad par bya/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas/ tshul khrims tsardon lus la byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ྾ ni gos kyis g.yogs/ /byang chub yan lag me tog brgyan/ /ji ltar bde ba nyid du gnas/ /zhes brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal hūṃ nuḥzhes bya bas gshegs su gsol lo/ /de bzhin du 'jam dpal sogs pa yang man ngag ji lha ba bzhin 26—294

mchod par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ka'o/ /lho ba chu dang bcas pa sbyin pa ste / /legs par byugs pa tshul khrims bzod pa ni/ /srog chags phra mo sel bar byed pa yin/ /brtson 'grus bya ba dag la 'jug pa'o/ /bsam gtan de dus rtse gcig byed pa'i sems/ /shes rab tshogs ⑫sogs legs par mdzes pa yin—/ /thub pa rnams kyi ②dkyil 'khor byas pa yis/ /pha rol pyin pa drug ni des thob shog /nad kun las grol gser gyi mdog tu 'gyur/ /lha dang mi'i chos mizla ba bzhin par ④mdangs/ /nor dang gser phyug rgyal po'i rgyud skye bar—/ /bde gshegs gnas mchog lus kyis byas par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni/dkyil 'khor gyi phan yon gyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /lci ba chu dang me tog gis/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ /cung zad phul nas bla ma la/ /dus gsum du ni gus phyag bya/ /gzhan dag gi ( 3ni sems mgu zhing / /rang gi sems kyang 'phel bar byed/ /bde zhing tshad med nor dang ldan/ /bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur/ /pha rol phyin drug rdzogs par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu byed pa portse / /dpag med yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa phan yon rgyas par 'byung ba yin no/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs cho ga yis/ /yang dag shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rtag tu mchod cing bklag par bya/ /de yi don yang rtogs par bya/ /tshigs bcad gcig dang tshigs bcad bzhi/ /tshigs bcad gnyis dang sgo drug pa'i/ /gzungs dang bzang po spyod pa dang / /phung po gsum pa dus gsum du/ /yi ge gcig nas nyer bzung nas/ /gsum gyi bar du mnyam gzhag pas/ /yi dam nyams pa med pa yis0 / /blo ldan ji ltar rnyed pa bklag/26—296

na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs te/ gzungs 'di ni phan yon dpag tu med do—/ /ye dhaṅgā ho tu pra bha bā he tudhe ṣārnya thā ga to rgya ba data/ te ṣālha ①yo ni ro dha me baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥtshigs su bcad pas rab gnas byas la/ na mo bha ga ba te rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ku yārnya te samyahūṃ dutsā ②ya/ tar+ya shā/oṃ rasne rasne ma hā rasne rasna bo rnyi swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i gzungs la sogs pa 'di brjod cing mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba ④la sogs pa byas nas/ mchod rten gcig la phyag byas pas/ mchod rten bye ba la phyag la sogs pa byas par 'gyur ro—/ 'jim pa la sogs pa la mchod rten bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /'di dag thams cad khyad par can du yongs su bsngo ba las ni khyad par can gyi 'bras bu skye zhing 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gsungs pa'i yongs su bsngo ba chen pos yongs su bsngo bar bya'o/ /de yang 'di lhar bya ste/ji lhar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis ④ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis rigs gang yin pa dang / sde gang yin pa dang / mtshan nyid ji lta ba dang / rang bzhin gang yin pa dang / chos nyid gang yin pas yang dag par gnas pa de dag gis ji lha ba ༅mkhyen pa de ltar bdag kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /de dag gis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o zhes brjod do/ /gzhan yang / dge ba'i las 'di bdag gis byas pa yis/ /ring por mi thogs 'jig rten sangs rgyas nas/ /26—297

'gro la phan phyir chos ni ston byed cing / /sdug bsngal mang pos mnar ba'i sems can grol gyur cig /bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / yongs su bsngo ba'i cho ga'o/ /gang dang gang gis gang 'tsho ba/ /'tsho ba dag pa de rgyal ba/ /bkros dang skom sogs zhi bya'i phyir/ /snan bzhin du ni bsam par bya—/ /zhes bya ba'i ⑫de'i rjes la ji ltar rnyed pa'i zas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā hūṃ ādu ②nut+pan na tāta②/ oṃ lha'ihūṃ phaṭa ṭ+wā hā/ zhes bya bas gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ oṃ tshosarba burtse bo rnyi satwa bh+yo badz+ra ne+e ji byi hūṃ zhes bya bas bshos gtsang dbul lo/ /oṃ ha ri ti ma hā yakhri ni ha ra ha ra sarba pā paṃ na k+ṣa na 6swā hā/ zhes brjod la zan chang bu gnyis sbyin par bya'o/ /oṃ a gra pa ṇi ṭā si bh+yaḥsru hā/ zhes bya bas ni zan gyi chang bu gsum pa sbyin par bya'o—/ /de'i rjes la/ oṃ tshokhyahūṃ zhes bya bas/ rang gi sdod kyi zan byin gyis brlab cing dug la sogs pa rnams zhi bar gyur gyi bar du dang po mthe bong dang srin lag gis bza' bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la ji lhar bde bar bzod 3 pa'i zas lhag ma la/ oṃ u: ṭa me bsdi a si bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhes bya bas lhag ma'i chang du sbyin par bya'o/ /lhag ma 1gzhan byin gyis ma brlabs pa ni yongs su dor bar bya'o/ /de yang / gtor ma btang zhing bshos gtsang dbul/ 'phrog ma dang po chang bu dang / /lnga po lhag ma gtang ⑫ba ste/ /'bras bu longs spyod chen por 'gyur/ /zhes bstan pas so/ /de'i rjes la/ 'thor 'thung la sogs pa byas la/ /blo bde ba ⑪yongs su dag cing khyad par can gyi bde ba dang ldan pas/ sems can khrims cad la phan pa dang bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ lan gsum gyi bar du 'di brngod par bya ste/ rgyal po dang ni yon 26—298

bdag dang / /sems can phung po gzhan dag kyang / /tshe dang nad med phun sum tshogs/ /rtag tu bde ba thob gyur cig /ces bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/yongs su dag pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las ji ltar 'dod pas nyuganas par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas lhan cig spyod pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs sam/ gtam rgyud dam/ gleng gzhi'am/rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam gyis nyin dang mtshan du yid shin tu gnas pas gnas par bya'o/ /de nas phyi dro'i dus su yang bzlas pa dang ‘ ༷bstod pa la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du skyo ba med pa'i yid kyis byas la/ yi ge a la sogs pas gtor ma byin 0la rnal 'byor gyi gnyid kyis nyal bar bya'o/ /spu sangs rgyas chos ④la rtag tu 'jug /nye bar zhi ba'i nadage bsnyen te/ /sems can rnams la nye bar phan/ /thams cad nye bar phan gyur pas/ /rtag tu sdig pa spong bar byed/ /sdig pa can dang 'grogs pa spang / /skyes bu sdig pa spong bar byed/ /kun du sdig pa bshags byed pa'o/ / sgro btags thams cad 0 rnam par grol/ /ting nge 'dzin la legs mnyam 'jog /kun du mchog tu dga' ba yis/ /mkhas pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub/ /dus kun du ni 'bad med pas/ /snying rjes yongs su skyong ba nyid/ /sdug bsngal gyur kyang mi 'dod min/ /phan pa mchog ni byed par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba'i tshig gis yi ge bzhi pa'i don rngo dang ldan pa'i tshig gis —bsnyen no/ /dge ba'i las ni yongs su byas/ /bsod nams tshogs ni nye bar bsags/ /goms pa'i dbang gis sad skyopa bzhin/ /dge ba mi lam nyid na'ang byed/ /'gro ba thams cad dri med pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan gzhan mirngodu mthong 'gyur na/ /26—299

thams cad smra ba'i skyes bu ltar/ /rjes su mi dmigs bzhin du byed/ /de lha bas na phyir mi ldog⑫ /zhes brjod do/ /de ltar nyin dang mtshan du rgyud mi 'chad par bsod nams kyi tshogs nye bar bsags pa byang chub kyi snying po'i bar du sems can la phan pa dang / bde bas yang dag par gnas so zhes bya ba yin no/ /dbu ma'i don la mchog gzhol ba/ /nam mkha' ②snying po zhes bya bas—/ /dang po las la mnyam 'jog cing / /yi dam nyid du 'di byed pa/ /rdo rje gdan nas 'ongs 'gyur te/ /bram ze'i rigs la zhi ba'i sems shunam mkha'i snying por 4gsol btab bdag gis dang po'i las / /cho ga'i tshig 'ga' tsam zhig bstan par byas pa 'dis༅ / /byang chub goms par byas nas myur du nyon mongs pa'i/ /sdig pa'i blo yi ⑦dri ma'i rab rib 'dis sel shog/dang po las pa'i cho ga 'dis/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /dang po'i las can de dag dang / /'gro ba ⑧gnyis med thob par shog /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po nges par sbyangs pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa lta ba ngan pa sel ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // rgya gar gyi 4 mkhan po bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mtshur ston ye shes 'byung gnas kyis bsgyur ba'o// //26—300

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ma rgyo ma sha ta— / bod skad du/ dbu ma drug pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshang lo/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /shes pa skad cig ma yod de/ /rtog pas stong zhing dmigs pa med/ /rnam bcas smra bar shes par bya/ /chad pa ma yin rang rig ni/ /sngon po la sogs par snang ba/ /de ni mtshan nyid kyis ma skyes/ /dbu ma pa yi lam du 'dod/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /gsal ba brdzun pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /de ni sgyu ma ②lhar gnyis med/ /tshad mar ldan pa'i grub mtha'o/ /dngos po stong par rig pa gang / /snang ba med cing sgrib g.yogs med/ /de nyid dadu ma pa yi lam/ /rjes thob dag pa'i kun rdzob yin/ /gsal ba 'am ni mi gsal ba/ /de nyid la ni dmigs su med/ /rnam kun ma skyes pa rang bzhin/ /gzhan dag dbu ma pa ru 'dod/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /gsal ba lha 26—303

yi bdag nyid can/ /gnyis med mchog tu bde ba'i dngos/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung tsam bdag nyid/ /dbu ma drug pa zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon mkhas pa mi 3)tris mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi dang/ nags ༅tshos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/3 3 /—mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉skar ṭa/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sgor/2 4 ①〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉ṭha/ kye 〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉ragab kā 'bra~X /shā )mig26wa 304

mtsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ku dṛṣ+ṭi nirga ta ṭī shābye / bod skad du/lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dka' 'grel1/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la gnas skabs ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rgyu'i gnas skabs dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang / sems can gyi ④don byed pa'i gnas skabs so/ /de la slob pa ni rgyu'i gnas skabs so/ /'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i gnas skabs ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de la yang rgyu'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa nas bzung nas byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar ro/ /'bras bu'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi ye shes bskyed pa dang rngo / nyon mongs pa thams cad spang ba )yon tan thob pa'i gnas skabs so/ /sems can gyi don byed pa'i gnas skabs zhes bya ba ni/ dang po chos kyi 'khor lo 26—306

bskor ba nas bzung ste/ /bstan pa ma nub kyi bar ro/ /de la rgyu'i gnas skabs ni gsum ste/ bsam pa'i gnas skabs dang / sbyor ba'i gnas skabs dang / dbang gi gnas skabs so/ /de la bsam pa'i gnas skabs ni/sems can thams cad —rngo nges par thar pa'i smon lam mo/ /de'i nye ba'i dka' ba bzhi ni 'di lta ste/ gzhan gyi 1sdug bsngal nye bar bsal ba la 1so sor rtog pa dang / dgos pa la 3 so sor rtog ( pa dang / grogs la ⑫so sor rtog pa dang / longs spyod la 3 so sor rtog ⑫pa'o/ /de la thabs su 'gro ba byang chub tu smon pa ste/ de'i rjes su tshol ba bzhi ni 'di lta ste/ rigs dang bshes gnyen dam pa dang snying rje dang sdug bsngal la ji mi rngo zhesnyam pa'i bzod pa dang / rkyen bzhi bzhi rnams las byang chub kyi sems skye bar 'gyur te zhes bya ba'i tshig bcu po 'di dag gis ston te/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i gnas skabs so//lhag par mos pa ⑫sbyor bas sbyor lam pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang / sa thob pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bdun no/ /de la lhag par mos pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ni/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang / smon lam dang / stobs dang / ye shes te/ de dag ⑫ni pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'o//sa thob pa'i phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ni/ bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dang /yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa ste/ sbyin pa dang /tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / thabs te/ de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa bdun no/ /lhag par mos pa'i sbyor bas pha rol tu phyin pa dag bye brag tu 'gyur ro/ /rnam 26—306

pa gnyis po 'di dag ni sbyor ba'i gnas skabs so/ /de la dbang lnga ni/'di lta ste/ nyon mongs pa dang / skye ba dang / las dang / thabs dang /sems can yongs su smin pa la dbang ba rnams so/ / de la kyirgyu'i gnas skabs la 1 gnas pa las dang po pa rnams kyis thams cad bya'o/ /de la 'bras bu'i gnas skabs dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i gnas skabs la gnas pa rnams kyis/ shākya thub pa ltar 'bad pa med par (0las dang po pa la rab tu 'jug go/ / 'di dag gis ༅ni lta ba ngan pa sel ba rgyas par shes par bya'o/ /lta ba ngan pa sel ba'i dka' 'grel ⑤dpal ldan nges par sbyangs pa gnyis su med pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //badz+ra pā ṇi dang mtshur gyis bsgyur ba yin no// //bsdur ma na/kaX5 ②mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa lhar bkod cing / dz+wa〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉〉tshog /lha ba ngan pa sel ba'i dran zhes bya ba gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa banugs/ 〈‘pe 〉ྈ‘snar 〉〉ti ba/ kyadz+wa〈pe 〉〉2shar 〉 na pa/ ④‘‘pe〉 〈snar 〉〉mi cho(8pe〉 tsār 〉〉snyes pa/ phyo82pe 〉 〈snar 〉7ngas pa/ka 6 ②dz+wa pe 〉 〈snar 〉〉thams cad/ ④(dz+wape 〉〉‘dz+wasnar 〉〉gzhan gyi/ 〈dz+wape 〉 sar 〉 sal ba las ④dz+wa pe 〉〉(shar 〉shags/ ⑤ pe 〉 'ar 〉༅sa/ rngo dz+wadz+wape 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉shags/ 3dz+wa〈pe 〉 shar 〉༅sa/ kadz+wadz+wape 〉〉‘'ar 〉skogs/ zu(‘pe 〉 ‘snar 〉༅sa/ bya‘‘pe 〉 dz+wasnar 〉chogs/ 78‘pe 〉 'ar 〉〉mi ⑫‘2pe〉〉〈'ar 〉༅'i/ ⑫ pe 〉 2snar 〉〉dgaka shā ⑨〈‘pe 〉 shar 〉lda'i/ ④dz+wadz+wape 〉 sar 〉〉la/ 0(dz+wape 〉 shar 〉7/ — —dz+wa‘pe 〉 ‘snar 〉 dis/⑤2 pe 〉 ‘snar 〉〉la dranapa/26nga 307
bsdur 'bras re'u mig ci da/ (1 6 )

ma / /rgya gar skad du/ sa ha dza ṣa ṭa ka /bod skad du/ lhan cig skyes pa drug pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag dang chad las nges grol ba/ /de nyid bde gshegs rnams kyis bzhed/ /rang bzhin las skyes chos rnams la/ /sgrub dang sel bar phyag bye ni brjod/ /yod par smra ba khul brjod pa④/ /thams cad rnam par dpyad na med/ /med par smra ba la brjod pa/ /rnam par dpyad na thams cad yod/ /ji lta ji ltar sgro tags pa//de nyid rnal 'byor pa rnams skye/ /de lta de ltar sgro btags pa/ /rnal 'byor de nyid kyis ni 'joms/ /gang phyir lhan cig skyes ma bcos/ /de phyir dogs med lhan cig skyes/ /bde bas lhan cig skyes gzhan min/ /bde ba dogs pa med mtshan nyid/ /shes phyir dogs pa med pa'i bdag /dbyer med rtogs pa dam pa bde/ /sna tshogs rang rig rtogs byas pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i 26—309

rgya mtshor nub/ /sngags kyi de nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /dogs med don la rab tu gnas/ /srid pa yang 'di bla mar byas/ /dogs pa med pa'i yul gyis ston//lhan cig skyes pa drug pa bla ma mi tri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi dang / mtshur gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/3 9 rmyematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉ston cig skyes pa drug pa/du 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉thāgs/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉ṅkarnams/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉bopa/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1༷64) 26—310

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ susna nir de sha /bod skad du/ mi lam nges par bstan pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dul ba dang ni chos mngon dang / /mdo las rgyal ba skyes mchog gis/ /mi lam lta bur chos gsungs pa/ /gsal bar 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /rmi lam bden nam brdzun pa'am—/ /sna tshogs sems sam rnam med sems/ /sgyu ma'am yang na mi gnas las/ /dam pa ltar ni gang zhig 'dod/ /ma rtogs pa ni rmi lam bden//rtogs na de ni brdzun 'gyur te/ /dang por rtag par shes bya ste/ /gnyis pa chad par gyur pa yin/ /rab tu sad pas rtog pa sel/ /nyams su myong ba sel ma yin/ /sems bcas sna tshogs sel bdag nyid/ /gang zhig nyams su cher myong ba/ /skad cig 'jug pa kun gzhig — rtsa/ /sna tshogs snang ba 'jug pa rnams/ /de dang der ni rna par gnas1/ /se sa 'di nyid ni de ltar 26—311

'dod—/ /gal te mi lam mi lam nyid/ /sems dngos sna tshogs de tshe brdzun//yod dang med pa 'jug med pa/ /gsal ba la ni chad pa med/ /ci ste ming med la ming btags/ /ming ni sgyu ma nyid du dogs/ /ming la ming ni rigs ma yin/ /ming ni mi gnas pa yin no/ /'dir ni drug las gnyis der byos/ /gzhi 1 ni rtogs par bya ba'o/ /sna tshogs 'di dag rmi lam mtshungs/ /de ltar rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs/ /mi gnas gzhung ni rtogs bya ste/ /sangs rgyas pa kun nor yin pas/ /rang rig dang ni bla ma'i bka'/ /lung gi khyad par gyis shes so/ /rmi lam nges par bstan pa/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi dang / dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ mā yā ni rut+ta tsā ma/ bod skad du/sgyu ma nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams sgyu ma ji bzhin du/ /dngos med tshe na dngos 0sangs rgyas / /mkhas pas bde ba'i bsam pa yis/ /'gro 'di ci phyir grol ma byas//sgyu ma mkhan byas sgyu ma ni/ /khyim ni rab tu 'bar ba la/ /kha cig la ni bden par snang / /sgyu ma mkhan bzhin mkhas pas rig /sgyu mar mthong bas 'bad med par/ /'dod pa gang de rang 'ong 'gyur/ /'di la thams cad sgyu ma spyod/ /gang kun sgyu mar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /khyod kyis brdzun par ma rtog par—/ /sgyu ma rtag par smra bar gyis/ /chos dbyings ma skyes pa yi phyir/ /chad par thal bar mi 'gyur ro/ /chos rnams ma skyes mi 'gag 1phyir/ /bems por gyur pa ma yin no/ /chos rnams stong nyid la bskyed 37pa'i/ /stong 26—314

las chos nyid gzhan ma yin/ /de yi phyir na kun mkhyen gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyams par mi mdzad do/ /'bad med dbang gis thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'ang 'jug /rkang pa brkyang ba spangs nas ni/ /nga rgyal la sogs btang nas kyang / /gnas med gnas la legs gnas te/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ②chos la spyod/ /bza' dang btung ba'i ro rnyed nas/ /dag pa nyid kyi gtam smra zhing / /gang zhig spyad pa mi spyod pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub spyod 'di min/ /skye bo de nyid gtam smra zhing / /spyod pa 'di la yi rang byed/ /rigs ④pa baspub pa nyams len pa'i/ /'byor pa'i skye bo rnyed par dka'/ /sa yi lam 4la phyogs kyi gos/ /slong 4mo'i zas ni za ba dang / /skye med chos la bzod pa dang / /'bad med rtse ba 'jug pa'o/ /chos gang skye bo las rgyal ba/ /de la ༅rgyal ba de spyod pa/ /de yi 'bras bu tshe 'dir ltos/ /bla med 'bras bu smos ci dgos/ /sgyu ma bstan pa'i bsod nams gang / /dge ba'i sems kyis gang thob des/ /gnyis med 'jig rten las 'das pa/ /go 'phang 'jig rten rmis thob shog /sgyu ma nges par bstan pa slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas — bsgyur ba'o// //26—316

bsdur ma na/214 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈be 〉sko'adir 〉〉dut+ta ti/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉stabangon/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉྾〈co 〉mnyags/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragog du〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉tsho sa skyes/ 15 ①〈〈pe 〉dze' ra 〉stago ②〈〈bo 〉྾'a ra 〉stardog ③〈〈be 〉྾mu ra 〉skabad ④〈〈pe 〉྾tsa ra 〉mchog gyi〈〈be 〉〈'dir 〉stabartse/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉mi bas/bskur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1066)ci 26—316

ston pa zhes bya ba/tun /rgya gar skad du/ sa pra sa ha pra ka sa tsā ma/ bod skad du/rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar ston pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur byur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes pa rab tu mi gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas pha nor thams cad 'dod/ /'on kyang 'bad med sbyor ba yis/ /gang tshe sems can don byed na'o/ /gang phyir gzhan sel spub las skyes/ /de ni rtag dang chad la gnas/ /rtag tu ma skyes mi 'gag nyid/ /skye dang 'gag pa byol song tshig /gal te rang rig tshad ma ni②/ /rig de sems can 'dod ma yin/ /snang ba thams cad spang ba'i 'a3phyir/ /sems can bden pa ma yin no/ /rjes la sems can 'dod ce na/ /de tshe sems can rdzas yod min/ /dam bcas gcod pa ༅gnod pa'i don/ /rjes su rtag pa zhes brjod do/ /dngos gzhi la yang rig pa yod/ /rjes la de ltar snang ba'i phyir/ /dang po mi rtog par 26—317

'gyur gyis1/ /de las 'dzin pa'i shes pa'o ④/ /'das dang ma 'ongs la sogs pa'o/ /sems ni gnas pa yod ma yin/ /des na de dag med par ni/ /'gro la 'gro ba'i mgon pos bstan/ /chos rnams kyi ⑤ni skye ba nyid/ /rang nyid gnyug ma bsam mi khyab/ /de nyid stong pa nyid ces brjod/ /chad pa'i rjes 'gro ma yin no/ /rab tu mi gnas sa bon las/ /'bras bu rab tu mi gnas 'byung / /skyob pa ④de nyid dam pa ste/ /bcos ma'i bcos ma de bzhin no / /de bzhin bsam gtan yod med ces/ /chags med spyod la brjod du med / /gang phyir rten 5nas 'byung ba rnams/ /nyams myong ji rngo bzhin rtag tu skye/ /rten 3nas 'byung ba gang dang gang / /de de gnyis med sna tshogs sems—/ /stong dang sna tshogs sems dbye bas/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa nyid/ /bdag gis mi gnas brjod pa las/ /bde ༄ ba bsags pa gang yod des/ /nye bar spyod pa thams cad dang / /'gro rnams mi gnas thob par shog /rab tu mi gnas pa gsal bar bstan pa/ slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //badz+ra pā ṇi dang / nags 6tshos bsgyur ba'o// //26—318

brtsar ma na/217 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pa/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ton/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈be 〉྾〈snar 〉gsangs pa'i/ 0 〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉(mu ra 〉〉btags/218 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanang / ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉ba por/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉〉pa'i/sdu/shā dro ༷sna/ 〉tharten/ 0〈〈pe 〉posnar 〉8/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉tharten/ ②〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉rage/bsdukā 'bra~X /sta) mig26wa 319

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ taka ②da sha ka tsā ma/ bod skad du/de kho na nyid bcu pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo—/ /yod dang med pa'i sbyor bas kyang / /spangs pa gang zhig dri med pa/ /byang chub rang bzhin rtogs pa gang / /de bzhin nyid de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /de bzhin nyid ni shes 'dod pas/ /rnam bcas ma yin rnam med min/ /bla ma'i ngag gis ma brgyan pa'i/ /dbu ma'ang 'bring po tsam nyid do/ /dngos po 'di ni byang chub 'gyur/ /chags pa spangs pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /'khrul pa las ni chags med 'gyur/ /'khrul pa'ang gnas pa med par 'dod/ /de nyid ci na dngos rang bzhin/ /dngos po dngos med gang yin pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'ang dngos por 'gyur/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin gyis/ /de ltar chos rnams ro gcig ste/ / thog ma 1med cing gnas med par/ /ji lha 26—320

ba yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /'di dag thams cad 'od gsal te/ /ji lta ba yi ting 'dzin yang / /rab tu 'jug pa'i sems nyid kyis/ /gang phyir de yang sna3gnas rig pas/ /de nyid rgyun mi 'chad las skyes/ /shes dang shes bya rnam bral ba'i/ /'gro ba nyid ni gnyis med 'dod/ /gnyis dang bral bar rlob — —pa yang / /de ltar 'od gsal ba nyid do/ /de lta'i de nyid nges rtogs na/ /ji lta de ltar gang de na/ /rnal 'byor mig ni rgyas 'gyur bas/ /kun du seng ge ji bzhin no/ /'jig rten chos la rnam log 'dis/ /smyon pa'i spyod pa la brten nas/ /bdag byin brlab pas rnam brgyan nas/ /dmigs pa med par thams cad byed/ /dri med de nyid gang bstan cing / /gnyis su med pa 1gang smras pa/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam 'di spangs nas/ /blo chen rnams kyis rtogs bya'i rigs/ /de kho na nyid bcu pa/ slob dpon gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma phyag na dang / mtshur byis bsgyur ba'o/ /phyis lo tsā rgyab tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ro// //26—321

32 /snamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈po ra 〉〉tatwa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thogs pa/321 ①〈〈be mi'i〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉stab rlob/ 〈'bar 〉〉ba rlom/ ②〈〈pe 〉skosha ra 〉〉bar/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾0 ra 〉〉tsa/bsdushā 'bra~X /shā )migazug 26wa 322

ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/1ra /rgya gar skad du/ yu ga na da pra ka ka sa nā ma/ bod skad du/zung du 'jug pa rab tu gsal ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang dang gang snang de dag par/ /rtogs par gyur na mi 'gyur nyid/ /rkyen las skyes pa de 'gyur ba/ /de yang rkyen las de ma skyes/ /gzugs las gzugs ni yod ma yin/ /mig la yang ni yod ma yin/ /de skyes rnam shes la yang min/ /ji ltar gtsub shing mi bsten —bzhin—/ /gtsub shing dang ni gtsub gtan dang / /skyes bu'i lag pa ma bsten par/ /mngon du me ni grub pa med/ /de ni 'di dag bsten nanas 'byung / /bdag gis bu bas sngar rmongs sam/ /'on te bu las rmongs par 'gyur—/ /bu nyid la ni sngar zhen pa/ /de ni rdzas su yod ma yin/ /de ltar rkyen nyid 'ba' zhig phyir/ /chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /de la 26—323

gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bde mchog las ni nyams mi 'gyur/ /thams cad blang dang dor med kyang / /tha snyad du ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di dag sgyu ma bzhin dngos med/ /rkyen las byung bar rtogs pa'i phyir/ /ma skyes phyir na rang bzhin med/ /rkyen las byung ba mi 'gag nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med nyams pas na/ /zung du 'jug pa snang bar 'gyur/ /stong pa snying rje gcig gyur pa/ /rang gi rtog pas byas pa min/ /stong pa nyid dang rab gsal ba/ /rang bzhin zung du 'jug pa nyid/ /rnam pa kun mchog rgyas ldan pa'i / /zab mo gnyug ma'i snying po nyid/ /mngon sum rig pa sangs rgyas kyis—/ /mchod pa legs sbyor byed pa yin/ /lus dang ngag dang sems kyi kyini/ /rtag tu blo bzang rab gnas na/ /spyod pa byed dang mi byed kyang / /de la spyod pa byed ces brjod/ /zung du 'jug pa rab tu gsal ba bstan pa zhes bya ba/slob dpon a ba sgro tīs mdzad pa rdzogs so// //badz+ra pā ṇi dang / nags khyatshos bsgyur ba'o// //26—324

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ pre ṇa palca pya ka /bod skad du/dga' kacugs 1lnga pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang ba mchog tu gcugs bapa ni/ /rten cing 'asbol 'byung tsam nyid de/ /med par gyur 5na stong pa nyid/ /'dod pa mo dngos 'ching bar 'gyur/ /stong nyid shin tu mchog gyur pa'i/ /mdza' bo dpe med gzugs ldan gang / /de dang brgya la byed na ni/ /dga' bde'i gtso bo brlag par 'gyur/ /de phyir dogs pas khyo shug gnyis/ /bla ma dam pa'i spyan sngar gnas/ de yis de dag sngon bzhin du / /dga' bas lhan cig gcugs par mdzod —/ /e ma'o bla ma mchog mkhas ni/ /'di lta du la mkhas pa mtshar/ /rang bzhin gnyis med dmigs pa med/ /bla na med par gnyis ka skyes/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs / /mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs pa ste/ /dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid//26—326

rang bzhin med par rtag tu shar/ /dga' gcugs ༅lnga pa slob dpon mi tri pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma phyag na'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ②ba rma ban gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/326 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉raga' bcugs lnga pa/ 0〈〈pe 〉mirdzo/ ②④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉micugs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sngazhar 〉tshogyur/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉d+ku/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉('ar 〉lke yi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉micugs par mdzad/327 7〈〈pe 〉྾sha ra 〉〉bcugs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tsa/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1 7༷)26wa 327

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ nir snye da ⑤palca ka /bod skad du/mi phyed pa lnga pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas rtogs na 'gro ba dag /sangs rgyas rtogs pa can rtsa lag /e ma'o sangs rgyas gzod ②nas dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa ji ltar rtogs/ /'dis ni gnyen po dang de kho na nyid —dang / 'bras bu la rnam par rtog pa bzlog pa ni/ rang bzhin gyis dbyer med pa can te/ ngo bo nyid bstan pa'o/ /ye shes rnyog med stong pa ste/ /lhun grub snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /de yang rkyen las skyes pa ste/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /'dir ni dbyer med rtogs pa'i rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /chos rnams stong pa ya mtshan che/ /snying rje shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i nus pa mtshar/ /kun rdzob dag pa shin tu mtshar/ /'dis 26—328

ni shin tu dbyer med pa ⑫lhan cig skyes pa'i mthu bshad pa'o/ /ha ci brjod pa ji ltar bshad/ / shad na skye bo su yis — go/ /rtogs par gyur na mi 'gyur nyid/ /lhun gyis grub pa nyid du snang / /'dis ni snying rjes rab tu mi gnas pa'i chos zab mo'i tshul la mos pa'i skyes bu rnyed pa ②dka' bar bstan pa nyid do/ /rang gi las kyi sa bon sku/ /gnad gcod pa yi 'bras bu gang / /bdag gis gzhan la mi gtse ste/ /e ma'o de nyid kyis ni bzod/ /'dis ni rang gi las kyi skud pa'i mdud pas dkris ④pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' yongs su 'dzin par byed cing thugs la dgongs pa'o//mi byed pa lnga pa slob dpon mi tri ⑤pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / lo tsā ba rma ban gyis bsgyur ba'o ⑦26—329

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā su kha pra ka sa/ bod skad du/bde ba chen po gsal ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs shes ngo bo nyid can gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la btud nas/ /dngos po de nyid mdor bsdus pa/ /bde ba chen po bdag gis bshad/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa gcig yin te/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim bsgom pa'o/ /de phyir gnyi ga bsgom pa ni/ /de ni ngadag gis 'dir brjod bya/ /chos rnams rkyen med pa ru ni/ /6 skye ba med par nges pa ste/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung rang zhin phyir/ / hūṃ skyes mi ( skyes des ci min/ /stong nyid byang chub las sa bon/ /sa bon las ni gzugs skyes 'gyur/ /gzugs la'ang dgod dang de dgod bya/ /de phyir thams cad rkyen las skyes/ /phyi rol gnyis ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /thub pa yis ni nyer bstan gang / /de ni nang gi rtogs don du/ /rgyud du gsal bar shes 26—331

par bya/ /bde ba ngo bo nyid 'dod gang / /bde ba med na byang chub min/ /yod na'ang chags pa chen po ste/ /'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu ①nyid do/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung bde ba gang / / gzod nas zhi rngo ba'i bde bar rtogs/ /de phyir dngos po med par brjod/ /bde ba yod min med pa'ang min/ /re zhig de ni ma 1skyes pa/ /chos rnams kyi bye ni don dam nyid/ /bde ba brdzun par gsal ba ni/ /dag pa'i kun rdzob tu shes pas/ /bden pa nyid ni rngo 3rnam par dag /kun rdzob stong nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /gnyis po gnyis med bsgrub bya ste//don dam rnam bye par spangs byas so/ /sngags dang dbyibs kyi sbyor bdag nyid/ /blo ldan bde ba der song nas/ /de nas sna tshogs sgyu ma bzhin/ /gnyis su med par de lhar mthong / /de nas yang dag mthar 'jug cing / /zung 'jug go 'phang rtogs par 'gyur/ /zung 'jug la gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /sems can don la gcig tu brtson/ /bde sems lha yi rnal 'byor pa/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo thabs yin te/ /shes rab stong pa nyid du brjod/ /de ni bdag nyid baspub byar 'dod/ /phyi nang dag pa de nyid ni/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid de/ /ngade ba gnas med rnal 'byor pas/ /mdor bsdus 'di ltar shes par bya/ /rten cing 'asbol 'byung tsam nyid phyir/ /yod pa ma yin stong nyid min/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /snang ba lha yi rnal 'byor yin/ /ji lta ji ltar snang gyur pa/ /de lta de ni stong nyid bdag /gnyis dang gnyis med shes pa gang / /de ni de yi bag chags bral/ /rnal 'byor te ru'i nga rgyal byed/ /ho ru ka don la rab gnas/ /kyidangos 'di bla mar byas nas su/ /seng ge lta dur sa steng rgyu/ /gang zhig rgyal ba rnams kyi 26—332

dag pa kasna tshogs 'di dag kun nas rtag tu snang / /gzod nas ma skyes mi 'jig ④bskal pa bye bar rang dang gzhan du rtog pa spangs pa yi/ / bden pa ④brdzun par snang ba srid dang zhi b.ratsamanyam pa nyid du gnyis med rang bzhin phyir//'di ni 'khor lo'i bdag po rgyal ba'i yon tan ⑤thu da nga rdo rje mkha' 'gro nges par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po gsal ba slob dpon a wa byu tī ④pa dpal gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bla ma badz+ra pā ṇi dang / rma ban gyis bsgyur ba'o// //brtsar ma na/ka31 kyimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa lhar bkod cing / 〈(pe 〉༅de ba chen po gsal ba zhes bya/ ②8dz+wape 〉 'dir 〉ma gsang jigs kyi zeg pa zhes bya'o// — 'bring po ni sangs rgyas nyid du 'artser ba'o1/ (zhes pa'i yi ge rnams deb 'di'i ldeb kad6nga1nga dad8nga‘bar dpe bsgyur byas yod/) 1dz+wa〈pe 〉〉hūṃ snyes me/ dz+wa〈snar 〉 ‘rtso 〉〉zhe snyes me/kaka2 ②8dz+wape 〉 〈snar 〉'o/da/ dā ‘dz+wape 〉 zod nas zhing / dz+wadz+wasnar 〉 zod nas mi/ — (‘pe 〉〉ma 88dz+wape〉〉(dz+wasnar 〉8sa/ ⑤‘2pe〉 dz+wasnar 〉 di/ ༅ 2dz+wape〉〉dz+wa8snar 〉〉rnam/ ༅〈'ar 〉 phangs — 8‘pe 〉〉‘〈snar 〉ma bras/ /te ru ka yi rnam byed pas/ /gnas/sna3ka nyadz+wa〈pe 〉 8snar 〉〉rnam pa/ pya (‘pe 〉 'ar 〉ma jigs/ — 2dz+wape 〉〉〈 snar 〉 de ba badz+wadz+wape 〉 dz+wasnar 〉 /⑤(dz+wape〉 dz+wasnar 〉〉du gur/ me (dz+wape 〉 shar 〉〉sgro te/26nga 333
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1 72)

phreng ba zhes bya ba/kyimatsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ tastu rat+na sa ba li nā ma/ bod skad du/de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston ka'i zla ba dri med 'od/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs gnyis kyi( 3/ /chu skyes la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid rin chen brjod par bya//brgyud pa'i gzhung lugs las nyams shing / /rab rib kyis ni mig bkab pa'i//skyes bu rnams la yang dag pa'i/ /de nyid rin chen rnam bshad bya/ /de la theg pa ni gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/ /gnas pa ni bzhi dag ste/ bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma pa'i dbye bas so/ /de la bye brag tu smra ba'i gnas pa ni/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/ /theg pa chen po yang rnam pa gnyis te/26—336

pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / gsang sngags kyi theg pa zhes bya'o/ /de la pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la yang hūṃ gsum ste/ mdo sde pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma la gnas par ④spyad par bya'o/ /gsang sngags kyi tshul la yang gnyis te/ rnal 'byor pa dang / dbu ma la gnas pa'o/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa la yang rnam pa gnyis te/ rnam pa dang bcas pa dang /rnam pa med pa'i dbye bas so/ /de bzhin du dbu ma ⑫yang rnam pa gnyis te/sgyu ma lta bur gnyis su med par smra ba dang / chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i dbye bas so/ /de la nyan thos kyang rnam pa gsum ste/ tha ma dang / 'bring dang /mchog gi dbye bas so/ /de la tha ma dang 'bring ni bye brag tu smra ba'i phyi ma'o/ /mchog ni kha che bye brag tu smra ba'o/ /de la nyan thos tha ma'i dpyad par bya ba ni/sngon po dang / ser po la sogs pa'i phyi'i don khas len pa sngon du 'gro bas/gang zag ni rtag pa dang / mi rtag pa nyid dang bral ba'o zhes dam par dpyad pa'o—/ /de yang sngon po la sogs yod par ni/ /dngos 'dzin gdon gyis zin pa rnams/ /zab mo'i lus zukyi 'jigs pa yis2/ /'gro ba shin tu rmongs pa la'o/ /zhes bya ba dang / khur khur ba'i gang zag kyang yod de④ rtag pa zhes kyang mi brjod de / /mi rtag zhes kyang mi brjod do/ /gang zag 'dod chags dang bcas pa ni 'khor bar 'gyur bas/ 'dod chags rab tu spang ba'i phyir/ /mi sdug pa'i bsam gtan bsgom par bya'o/ /mi sdug pa bsgom pa yang lus kyi bshang ba dang / gci ba dang khu ba dang / khrag dang /ngar snabs dang / rgyu ma dang / zhag dang / glo ba dang / snying dang /26—336

mkhal ma dang / mcher pa dang / pho ba la sogs pa tshogs pa la nges par dpyod mido/ /de yang gsungs pa/ re zhig pags pa'i kha sbyor 'di/ /rang gi blo yis kyi tha dad dbye/ /sha dang rus pa'i ②dra ba las/ /shes rab mtshon gyis dbye bar bya/ /rus pa rnams kyang dbye byas nas/ /rkang gi bar du dbye ④byas na/ /'di la snying po ci yod ces/ /bdag nyid kyis ni brtag par bgyi/ /zhes bstan pa'o⑤/ /gang zag gis 0 rtag par lta 2ba sngon du song ba ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sangs rgyas dang chos dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa dang / rgan po gnyis la phyag bgyi'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bsags pas 4/ bdag nyid gcig pu dul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid gcig pu zhi bar bgyi'o zhes bya ba ni lta ba'o/ /'bring po'i lta ba dang / dpyod pa ni —snga ma bzhin no/ /'di ni gzhan gyi don cung zad byed par 'dod pa'o ba/ /dbugs dbyung ba dang / dbugs rngub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ rtag pa dang mi rtag pa skyonyid dang bral ba'i gang zag la lta ba'i bsam gtan dang / rlung gi bum pa'i ⑫sems med pa'i rang bzhin ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /bems por gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /mchog ni phyi'i don khas len cing / /lus la bdag med pa nyid du rnam par 'jig ⑫cing dpyad pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su shes pas/ stong pa nyid du lta ⑫ba ni bsam gtan no/ /'dir sdug bsngal ni phung po lnga'i rang bzhin te shes par bya'o/ /kun 'byung ni rnam par rtog pa ste spang ra bya'o/ /'gog pa ni lhag mthong ste mngon du'o/ /lam ni stong pa nyid de bsgom par bya'o//stong pa nyid kyang rtag tu zhi ba'i rnam pa nyid du sgro btags pa ni bsam gtan byi 26—337

dri ma'o/ /yang 'di'i lta ba ni gzhan gyi 1don byed pa'i khyad par ro/ /yang 'dir nyan thos tha ma ni rigs nges pa nyid kyi phyir dang / snying rje dang bral ba'i phyir nyan thos kyi byang chub nyid du 'gyur ro zhes kha cig 'dod do/ /gzhan dag ni/ thams cad sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /'di na skal med 'ga' yang med/ /ces bya bas/ bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la skyid lug par ༅mi bya'o snyam sems shing / nyan thos tha ma yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /rigs nges pa yang sangs rgyas 'ga' zhig la brten nas 'gyur ro snyam sems so/ /'bring po ni rang sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ / mchog ni bskal pa grangs med pa bzhis sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes zer ro/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams 0 dpyad pa ni/ nyan thos mchog rnams kyi bzhin no—/ /'di la zhugs pa'i gang zag ni stong pa nyid dang / bsam du med pa'i mtshan nyid dang / slob dpon med pa dang / rang byung gi ye shes dang /lhag mthong dang / zhi gnas so/ /de la lhag mthong ni dbang po rnams 'gog pa dang / gang zag mi dmigs pa'o/ /zhi gnas ni lus dang ngag dang yid yang dag par sdom pa ste/ 'di ni 'di'i bsam gtan no/ /'di la gnyis kyis sems bsdus pa'i bde ba'i gnas skabs kyi sems kyi bsam gtan dang /sems las byung ba shin tu 'gags pa'i gnas skabs ni bsam gtan gyi dri ma'o//de la snga ma ni nyi ma'i gzhung la rjes su ༅zhugs pa rnams kyis te/ de'ang 'ongs 4par 'byur ba'i gnyid dag ni/ phyi yi spyod yul nyams pa na/ /yid 26—338

kyi spyod yul gang gyur pa/ /de ni 'bad la ②bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba dang /gzhan yang bye brag pa'i gzhung gi ②rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyis kyang ②/ klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ shes pa med pa'i ye shes gang / /gnyid kyi dpe yis bsgrub ④pa ni/ /dbang po 'gag ⑤pa'i shes pa ste/ /bye brag pa yi 'dod pa yin—/ / zhes bstan pa yin no/ /༅ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab las kyang / rgyal byed tshal ni mnyam dga' bar/ /bdag nyid wa ru gyur lhong bla'i//bye brag pa yi thar pa ni/ /nam yang go tam ma 'tshang lo/ /zhes bstan pa yin no—/ /'di yang bskal pa grangs med pa bzhi 'das nas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'o—/ /nyan thos dang / rkyen rtogs 'di dag gi snying rje yang sems can ⑦la dmigs pa ste/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid dang / 'byur ba'i sdug bsngal dag la nyin re zhing / sems can la dmigs nas snying rje gang skye ba de ni/sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje'o/ /nyan thos ni ngag gis kuston pa'o/ /rkyen rtogs ni lus kyis ༄ston pa'o/ /de yang / rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams mi 'byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni—/ /rtog pa med par rab tu 'byung / /zhes bstan pa'o/ /da ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa dam kyi brjod par bya'o/ /de la chung ngu ni mdo sde pa'o/ /yang 'di'i don du rdul phra rab bsags pa'i ngo bo rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa skyes⑩par byed pa'i ngo bo'o/ /de yang 'di'i ngo bo nyid ni/ gang gi phyir rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa skyes ⑪pa nyid ces bya'o//de yang tha dad dus su ji lhar gzung zhe na/ mkhas pas gzung bar bya ba nyid/ /26—339

rig pa'i shes par gtan tshigs nyid/ /shes pa rnam pa len bzod pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni brtags 1pa'o/ /dbang po yul gyi grong las yongs su ldog pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni kyibasam gtan no/ /de'ang 'di ni goms par bya ba'i dus yin gyi/ mngon sum du bya ba'i dus ni ma yin no zhes gsungs pas/ de'i phyir goms par bya ba kho na'o/ /goms par bya ba'ang / sems kyi sems med rtog pa yis / /gang tshe goms par byed pa na/ /gang nas gang du song gyur pa//de tshe sems mthong mi 'gyur ro/ /skad cig skad cig la bsten 0nas/ /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /sna rtser g.yo ba'i yid gtad la/ /khyim par gyur kyang bsgom par bya/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di'i dri ma ni snga ma bzhin no/ /'khor gsum mi dmigs pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lnga la kun du spyod cing 'bras bu la re ba med par sems can yongs su smin par byed pa ni lta ba'o/ /'bring po ni ༄ rnal 'byor spyod pa'o/ /de la rnam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa dang — smra ba ni/ drug gis 3cig car sbyar ba na/ /phra rab cha shas drug tu 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rigs 'u3pas/ rdul phra rab kyang dmigs par mi 'gyur gyis 1/ 'di dag thams cad ni sems tsam ste/ sems nyid gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa'i rnam pa'i ngo bo dang bral ba/ gsal ba nyid gsal ba rab tu ston pa'o zhes rab tu rtogs pa'o/ /'di yang kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du chos kyi grags pa'i zhal snga nas kyang / sngo sogs ngo bo blo nyid na/ /phyi yi don gyi rgyu ci zhig /blo nyid sngo sogs ma yin na'ang / /phyi yi don gyi rgyu 26—340

ci zhig /ces bstan pa yin no/ /gzhan dag nas kyang / dbang po'i don gyi ngo bo nyid/ /sems las gzhan yod ma yin te/ /gzugs la sogs par ②snang ba ni/ /sems nyid rab tu snang ba'o/ /zhes bstan pas/ de'i phyir sems kho na sna tshogs kyi rnam par gzhag pa gzhan la mi ltos pas rab tu gsal ba nyid do ༅zhes bya ba ni/ dam pa dang bcas pa'i shes pa spru ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnam par brtags pa yin no/ /rnam pa med pa'i gyasmra ba'i rnal 'byor spyod pa ni yang / 'di dag thams cad sems nyid de/ /dam pa med pa'i rang rig pa'i ngo bo nyid du )sems zhes bya'o—/ /de yang / ji lhar byis pas ༄ 3rnam brtags pa'i/ /phyi rol don ni yod ma yin/ /bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /gang zhig ji srid snang gyur pa'i/ /de srid sgyu ma bzhin du snang / /snang ba med pa'i de nyid ni/ /nam mkha' mtha' med dag pa bzhin/ /thub pa chen po chos sku ni/ /spros pa med cing snang ba med/ /de la byung ba'i gzugs kyi sku/ /rjes la sgyu ma bzhin du gnas/ /zhes bstan pa ni rnam par brtags pa'o/ /rnam pa dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan ni/ rnam par rtog pa ma lus 4 spangs shing / sna tshogs dang bcas pa gnyis su med par mngon sum du byed pa'o/ /de yang / shes bya gang dang gang dag la/ /yid kyis (7'gro ba der sbyar na/ /gang du 'gro zhing g.yo bar 'gyur/ /thams cad de yi rang bzhin no/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /rnam pa med par smra ba'i bsam gtan ni/bden pa gnyis su med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ spros pa med pa/ snang ba med pa'i ye shes ni mngon sum du byed pa'o/ /de yang / 'di yi ngo bo gsal 26—341

bar 'dod/ /rnam pa med cing ma gos pa/ /'di ni mkhas pa ma yin pas/ /nam yang shes par mi nus so/ /'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes/ /'di snyam 2du yang dmigs nas su/ /ci yang rung ste mdun 'jog na/ /de nyid tsam la mi gnas so/ /gang tshe shes pas dmigs pa rnams/ /nye bar mi dmigs pa yi tshe/ /sems tsam la ni gnas pa ste/ /gzung ba med pas der 'dzin med/ /ces bstan pas so/ /rnam pa dang bcas pa smra ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma ni don dam par rtogs 1par 'dod pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gzhung la gnas nas rig byed pa'i rjes su 'a jug pa ste/ de yang don dam par rtag zhupa rang gi sems kyi ngo bo la/ tshangs pa ༅las gzhan ma yin pa yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bor 'gro ba rnams 'dod do/ /de yang / cung zhig gang dang gang mthong ba/ /de dang de ni tshangs par brtag⑤ /sems ni de las gzhan pa med/ /tshangs pa nyid la nges par gnas/ /zhes bya ba ni/ rnam pa bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /de bzhin du rnam pa med par smra ba'i bsgom pa yang rtags nyapa snang ba med pa'i spros pa rang rig pa'i shes pa ste/ nyi ma'i gzhung gi rjes su zhugs par thal bar 'gyur te/ de yang ming dang gzugs ma lus pa dang bral ba/ spros pa'i 'khrul pa ma lus pa rnam par dag pa rab tu gsal ba mtha' med pa/ bar mtshams med pa/ rtag pa'i tshangs par khas len par byed do/ /de yang bdag rtog shergya mtsho dngas pa la/ /sna tshogs chu bur gsog 'di 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'char ba dang ni nub par 'gyur ba yang / /rnam par rtog pas kun tu ma rtog ( —pa'o/ /zhes bya ba ni rnam pa med par smra ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /'di'i lta ba yang snga ma bzhin no/ /26—342

pa ni/ yod min med min yod med min/ /gnyis kyi min pa'ang ma yin pa/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba/ /de gnyis dbu ma pa yi rigs⑤/ /'di'i don ni 'di yin te/ yod pa ma yin pa ni sbyor bas gnod pas so/ /med pa ma yin pa yang bag chags kyi dbang gis mi bden par snang ba'o/ /gnyi ga la yang skyon gnyis yod pas ma yin no/ /gzhan yang sngon dang da ltar dpyad pa med par sna tshogs su ②ji lhar snang ba de lhar rjes pa su bden pa ci zhig gang du thal bar 'gyur/ /de ni sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med pa'o zhes brtags ⑤pa'o/ /'di nyid ni sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med pa'i bsam gtan no/ /'di la'ang chad pa la mngon par zhen pa ni bsam gtan gyi dri ma'o/ /sgyu ma lha bu gnyis su med par lhag par mos pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ni lta ba'o/ /chos thams cad rab tu mi gnas par smra ba'i rtag pa ni 'di yin te/ sna tshogs brtags ④ pa ma yin te/ /chad par yang ni khas mi len/ /rtag dang chad pa gnyi ga dang ⑦/ /gnyi ga min pa'ang ma yin no/ /'di ni thams cad mi gnas pas/ /dngos po'i de nyid mkhas pas rig /des na/ 'di lta bu yi rnam rtog gis/ /sems ni sems kyis rig ma yin/ /ji srid sgro btags thams cad ni/ /de kun thams cad du med pas/ /dbu ma'i don la sgro btags med/ /des na dgag dang sgrub pa med/ /shes pa gang zhig ⑤lhun grub pa/ /de la bsam mi khyab ces brjod/ /bsam ḍabazhin du ni mi sems pa//26—343

de la bsam mi khyab mi brjod/ /bdag gis 'gro ba ma skyes zhes/ /blo ni dag pas 4 rtogs pa nyid/ /'gro ba'i gnyug ma bden pa nyid/ /blo dang ldan pas 'bad pa med/ /de yang / sgro btags kun las nges grol ba/ /bdag gis de nyid du brjod do/ /stong pa la sogs mngon brjod dang / /de la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'o/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /btags pa 'di'i don ni/sgro ma btags pa'i don gyi rang bzhin la/ /mngon par zhen pa med par mngon du byed pa med pa ni bsam gtad no/ /don thams cad chad par lta ba dang /bems po'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba ⑤ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dri ma'o/ /sgro 'dogs pa med par pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ni lta ba'o/ /'dir dman pa dang 'bring po'i snying rje ni chos la dmigs pa ste/ chos rnams kyi mi rtag pa nyid kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i chos thams cad la dmigs nas skye bar 'gyur bar rtogs par bya'o/ /rab ni dmigs pa med pa ste/ rang bzhin med pa'i chos yid la byed pas mngon par rtogs pa ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'o—/ /'dir sku gsum rnam par gzhag ④pa ni mgon po byams pas gsungs so—/ /de yang / gang gis srid pa ji srid par/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam nyid mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad④/ /mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / /dpe byad brgyad cu'i bdag ④ nyid 'di/ /theg chen nye bar longs spyod phyir/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur 'dod/ /zag med chos dmas rnam kun du/ /rnam par dag gyur ⑦gang dag yin/ /'di dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku yin/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ / 26—344

'dir kho bos gsang sngags kyi gzhung ni tsa ma bshad do/ /shin tu zab pa'i phyir dang / zab mo'i theg pa lhag par mos pa'i skyes bu'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir dang / phyag rgya bzhi la sogs pa'i sgrub pa rab tu bstan pa rgyas pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / don gcig ④da 'ang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon pos dbang byas pasad / /sngags kyi bstan bcos khyad par 'phags/ /zhes bstan pas so/ /de'ang kho bos dbang nges par bstan pa zhes bya ba nas ④bstan to/ /gal te theg pa chen po nas don 'di nges par bstan na don dam pa la goms par bya ba'i phyir/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ci'i phyir bstad zhe na/ de blo dman pa yin te/ thob par bya ba'i theg pa chen po rtogs ⑤par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di dag skas kyi rim pa lta bur bstan pa yin no/ /de yang / sems can dang po'i las can rnams/ /dam pa'i don la 'jug pa la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur ༷ gsungs/ /zhes bstan pa dang / dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po las kyang / theg pa gcig cing lugs kyang gcig /gtso bos bstan pa 'di yang gcig /gang yang theg pa gsum bstan pa/ /nga yis thabs la mkhas pa'i dngos/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang / chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /gtso bos theg dbyer ༅ma mchis kyang / /khyod kyis theg pa gsum gsungs pa/ /sems can gzhug pa'i ched du lags/ /zhes bstan pa dang / gzhan dag nas kyang / stong pa nyid kyis grol bar 'gyur//26—345

de ma shes pas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /bsgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ /zhes bstan pa yin no/ /de lha bu'i theg pa gsum rab tu bstan pa yang bcom ldan 'das kyis spyi dang bye zag gi rtog pa'i khyad par gyis sems can gyi don du 3 rtogs par 'gyur ⑤ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang / gtso bo 4khyod kyi 'ga' 4zhig tu//yi ge gcig kyang ma gsungs so/ /gdul bya'i 'gro ba ma lus la/ /chos kyi char gyis tshim par mdzad⑤/ /ces pa dang / kun du rtog pa ma lus pas/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma g.yos kyang / /de ltar sems can thams cad kyi྾ / /bsam pa ma lus yongs rdzogs byed/ /'khor lo bskor ba'i sbyor ba yis mi rtogs 5 bzhin du skyob pa ni/ /tshogs kyi dbye ba nus pa yis/ /bstan pa rab tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /ji srid sems ni 'jug bar du/ /theg pa 4mtha' la thug pa med/ /sems nyid yongs su gyur pa na/ /theg pa med cing 'gro ba med / /dam chos las grub rin po che/ /dri med ngag gi skud pas brgyus/ /dga' ba skyed byed rin chen phreng / /bstan pas snying gar gdags par bgyi/ /bdag ni snying po la mos pas/ /rgyas par bstan pa ma lags pa/ /rgyas la dgyes pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /bdag la thams cad bzod par mdzod/ /skal ldan gyis ni gsol btab bdag gis ni/ /'bad pas bla med don ldan 'di brtsams pas/ /bdag gis bsod nams thob par gyur pa des/ /ma 'ongs sems can de bzhin gshegs par shog /de kho na nyid rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ slob dpon a wa sgro tī bapa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// // nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //26—346

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ taka pra ka sa tsā ma/ bod skad du/ de kho na nyid rab tu bstan pa zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum ngo bo can/ /gang gi mthu las skyes gyur pa/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa mchog /shes rab thabs bdag la )phyag 'tshal ②/ /skye bo rab rib can dag la/ /mkha' la skra shad snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin ma rig nun bsgribs ④pa'i/ /byis pa rnams ni 'gro snyam sems/ /'khrul pas mkha' la mtshon pa yi⑤/ /skra la dag pa'i mig gis lha/ /mthong ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /srid pa thams cad de lhar rtogs/ /kye lags nam mkha'i dkyil ltos dang / /skra shad 'dzings pa bdag gis mthong / /dag pa'i mig can des smras pa/ /yod min khyod kyi blo gros 'khrul/ /rab rib kyis 'khrul bsal ba'i phyir/ /phyi nas yod min zhes brjod kyi/ /gsal dang mi gsal 26—349

stong pa'i phyir/ /de nyid du ni dgag grub smomed/ /de bzhin zag pa med chos rnams—/ /longs spyod sprul pa'i sku dag gi / /rten 'brel smon lam dag gis ni / /sems can don du rab tu 'jug /de dag de las tha dad min/ /de dag de yi rang bzhin phyir/ /de dag rang bzhin ma bcos grub/ /de dbyes sems kyi dogs pa sel/ /gal te skye med mi kyi'adod na/ /ldog pas dngos la tha dad pas/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung las gzhan pa'i/ /dbu ma'i don du ji ltar 'gyur/ /gal te mtha' bzhi rnam spangs pas/ /dbu ma'i don ni khyad 'phags na/ /rnam rig la yang thal bar 'gyur/ /de yang 'di dag rnam spang phyir / /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba'i/ /shes pa gnyis med rdzas bden pa—/ /brtags pas stong zhing gnyis su med/ /rnam rig smra ba'i mkhas pas rig /yang dag mtha' las sna tshogs 'di/ /rten cing 'brel las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ni ma skyes rdzas kyis stong / /ma 'dres ming tsam pa nyid do/ /bdag byin brlab —dang 'od gsal ba'i/ /dbye ba kun mkhyen gyis gsungs pa//gang tshe de dag gcig bstan pa/ /des ni chad par lta ba spangs/ /'bras bu de nyid mi mthun phyogs/ /gang la chags pa yod min pa/ /'bad med sbyor ba de yis ni/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang des rdzogs byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa'i/ /'phags pa klu spub kyis bzhed pa/ /sangs rgyas chos kyi rjes 'brangs nyid/ /chos kyi de nyid ma skyes pa'o/ /de nyid rab tu bstan byas las/ /bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /zung du 'jug pa'i snod gyur cig /de kho na nyid rab tu ngastan pa zhes bya ba/ /slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //— 26—360

rgya rnam par bshad pa/⑫༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ta thā ga ta palca nu drwa ji pa ra/ bod skad du / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i phyag rgya rnam par bshad pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkyen las skyes pa kun rtag ②stong pa ste/ /rang bzhin stong pas dngos po yod ma yin/ /chad min sna tshogs gcig pa'i sems rang bzhin/ /gzugs sogs rgyal ba lnga ru rgyal gyur cig /phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'o/ /de la gzhi ni rnam par shes pa tsam du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa'o/ /de ltar na phyi rol gyi rnam pa ni sems tsam yin pas/ gzung ba'i dngos po med la/ 'dzin pa yang stong pa ste—/ gzung ba dang ni ge'adzin pa spangs pa'i don dam pa yod pa mchog tu nyams su myong ba tsam gyis rnam par rig par gnas so/ /de nyid ston ka'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lhar rnam pa med par smra bas dngos gzhi rnam 26—362

par shes par smra bar grub bo/ /de yang ⑫gsungs pa/ rtag 0pas stong pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /snang ba med cing rnam pa med/ /bden pa rang rig bde ba tsam1 /rjes thob rnam pa'i tshogs 'khrul pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa dang /khu de yang phyi nas gzugs kyi sku gnyis thob bo zhes gsungs pa dang / 'di ltar/spros pa med cing snang ba med/ /thub pa chen po chos kyi sku/ /de las gzugs sbu gnyis 'byung ba/ /rjes thob sgyu ma bzhin du gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ci ste mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya nyid kyis kyigrub pa yin na/ 'o na ci'i phyir mi bskyod pa la rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgyas rje btab bo zhes gsungs pa'i lung ni ji srid du rtogs pa'i rnam pas stong par khyabyed do zhe na/ ma yin te dang po phyag rgya nyid kyis ⑧grub pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na mi bskyod pa'i phyag rgya ye shes kyi dngos gzhi rang rig las rjes thob gzhan yin la/ de bzhin du rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya rnam par shes pa ni ༅rjes thob ste/ rdo rje ni dngos gzhir 'gyur ro—/ /rdo rje rtse mo las kyang gsungs pa⑩/ snying po brtan zhing khong stong med//mi chod mi byed mtshan nyid de/ /mi shigs pa dang mi nyams dang / /stong nyid rdo rje zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dngos gzhi ye shes mi bskyod rgyas/ /gzugs sogs rjes thob yin na ni/ /de ni rdo rje'i phyag rgya yis/ /rjes thob sems dpa' cis mi 'thob/ /'o na snying rje dngos med pa'i/ /chad par smra ba thal bar 'gyur/ /zhe na de yang 'dod de/ rdo rje stong pa nyid du brjod/ /sems dpa' ye shes tsam nyid de/ /de dag bdag nyid grub pa 'dis/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin no/ /stong nyid snying rje dbye ba ni/ /mar me dang ni snang ba bzhin/ /stong nyid snying rje gcig pa yang / /mar me snang ba ji 26—363

bzhin no/ /dngos nyid stong nyid gzhan med de/ /de dang bral na dngos yod min—/ /mi phyed dngos po nges pa ste/ /byas pa mi rtag pa bzhin no/ /med na mi 'byung nges phyir ro/ /ji lhar de nyid ston pa la/ /ma chad pa nyid kun rdzob ste/ /kun rdzob dang ni bral ba la/ /de kho na nyid dmigs med smo'agyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ༅rgyas par gsungs so/ /de lhar na mi bskyod pa dang /rdo rje sems dpa' gcig par 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'o na ni rnam par shes pas gzugs la sogs pa yongs su ma btang bas/ sna tshogs gnyis su med pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de gsungs pa/ sna tshogs dang bcas sems tsam ma lus rtogs pa yis/ /stong pa'i dngos po rnam bcas pa yi gzhung gis 'dod/ /'gro tshe rtswa 1la reg pa bzhin du mnyam pa ste/ /dbu ma'i don du skyes bus rab tu smra ba'o④/ /sna tshogs gnyis su med par smra ba yang / /don dam pa yi bden pa zhes zer te/ /rnam par shes pa yod par 'dod pas mdzes pa ma yin noka/ /gzung ba dang 'dzin pas stong pa sna tshogs gnyis su med pa nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi dzirang rig pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab pas dngos po'i bden pa gsal to/ /de gsungs pa/ gzugs sogs rtogs pas stong pa yi/ /ye shes mi bskyod phyag rgya la/ /der ni rdor sems rgyas btab pas/ /dngos po yod pa bkag pa yin/ /rnam par rig pa tsam gyis ni//rdo rje sems dpa' mi bya ste/ /dang po nyid nas mi gnas pas/ /rtag ②pa thams cad stong pa nyid/ /de ltar na don dam pa yod pa'i zug zu spangs pa ste/thams cad du mi gnas pa'i rang bzhin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i zung du 'jug pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyu rjerang rig par grub pa ni/ dbu ma'i grub pa'i mtha' 26—354

phul du byung ba'o/ /'di yang bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas kyi bka' drin las rtogs par kyibya'i/ /ci ste zhes rang rig pas grub na ni sgyu ma lta bu gnyis su med par smra bar thal bar 'gyur te/ thams cad du rab tu mi gnas pas ni ma yin no zhe na/ 'di ni ma yin te/ ji ltar rten cing 'brel 'byung ba/ /de yi rang bzhin ma skyes pas/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 0 ma skyes gang / /de la skye zhes ji ltar bya/ /zhes pas so/ /⑤nyams su myong ba yang / rkyen las skyes pa ste/de'i phyir/ nyams su myong ba mi gnas pas/ /ma skyes pa yi go 'phang ngo /de lhar yang / nyams su myong ba ma skyes pa/ /dngos po yod pa'ang de zhin no—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du/ /'gro ba nyid ni thub pas gsungs//yang 'di ltar 'jam dpal la de bzhin gshegs pas dris pa/ 'di bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings gang yin/ 'jam dpal gyis gsol pa/ khams gang bsam du med pa'i sems de brjod —du med pa dang / sems kyi gzhal bya ma yin pa dang / sems kyis 0sems pa med pa/ rab tu bsam par bya ste/'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na bcom ldan 'das sems nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings so/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings la sems — yod pa ma yin te/ gang gi phyir 3sems ni bsam du med la②/ don ji lha ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i sems so /'on kyang bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings so//gzhan du yang gsungs pa/ kun du rtog pas ma brtags pa/ /rab tu mi gnas pa yi yid/ /dran pa med cing yid byed med/ /dmigs pa med la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces so/ /zla ba sgon ma las kyang / gang zhig rkyen 26—365
