ni kho na nyid shes nas/ /rang 'byung ji bzhin bsam bral ngang la gnas/ /dran pa rang gsal dngos por grub pa med/ / cos med dgongs pa skye med bde chen 'di/ /mngon sum snang bas ngos gzung gang yang med/ /dran med yul du cir yang mthong ba med/ /rten dang zal bas slob pa gang yang med/ /gang la yid la byar med phyag rgya che/ /mtshan ma'i dran rig sna tshogs ji snyed pa//de nyid phyag rgya che la dbye ba med/ / rtogs dang mi rtogs ②gnyi ga so so min/ /rtag chad mtha' la mi gnas skyon dang bral/ /rang gi de nyid rtogs na gzhan las min/ /rten 'asbol mya ngan 'das lam bstan pa dang / /skye ba med par rtogs na phyag rgya che/ /de nyid mi shes las kyi phyag rgya dang / /dam tshig chos la sogs pa rtsol 'dod pa/ /de nyid mtshon pa'i dpe tsam don mi nus/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i phyag rgya che brten pa/ /shes pa rang lugs so ma nyid la byung 0/ /'dod med rang gzhan ②gnyug ma'i ngo bor gnas/ /tha mal snang ba'i shes pa 'di nyid blo/ /yin min dran pa'i sems la rang gzhag yin/ /yid ches rin chen gdams ngag yid bzhin gter/ /yid la bya dang mi bya med par gzhagaX /rang rig phyag rgya chen po nyid yin pas/ /phyag rgya chen po nyid la nyid kyis bstan/ /dran pa sna tshogs don la sems ma 'jug /phyi nang bral bas rtsod med phyag rgya dang / /phyag rgya chen po srog ldan 'dod pa med//'dod pa byung na de yang dran pa'i rgyu/ /rang sems phyag rgya chen po la/ /dran dang khyem dran tha dad skye ba med/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul blo yi yul las 'das/ /dran pa'i zhen rtog brtas pas 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po gnyug ma'i ngo bo nyid/ /gang yang 'gyur med byang chub sems su gcig /kho 26—1231

na nyid la gzung 'dzin ngo bo bral/ /snang ba don ldan ye shes nyid du mthong / /bsam pas brtags pas dran pa'i tshogs su rgyus/ /snang ba skye ba log pa'i stobs kyis mthong / /dran pa dran med ngang la shes 'jug pa/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'bad kyang dran rgyu med/ /gnyis su med na 'khor ba'i rang bzhin med1 /dran pa sna tshogs 'gyu ba'i rang bzhin 'di/ /sna rtse'i phyag rgya dag la ye nas med/ /des na phyag rgya chen po bsam med blang dor gzhag② /kye ho phyi nang zab dang mi zab bskyed rim ②dang / /yongs grub ngo bo nyid dang dadugs dbyung dang / /rgyas gdab las dang chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ /rnal 'byor yongs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen po ngo bo nyid kyi rim/ /dam tshig phyag rgya yongs su grub pa'i rim/ /kun brtags yongs su grub pa'i rgya/ /las kyi phyag rgya dbang gi ngo bo dang / /dga' ba bzhi ldan thabs kyi rang bzhin can—/ /chos kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs snang ba ste/ /dga' ②bzhi'i lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa la/ /gzung 'dzin dran bral ngo bo blo las 'das/ /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu mngon sangs rgyas/ /dam tshig phyag rgya mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor te/ /'bras du lha yi dkyil 'khor 'gro ba'i don/ /rje btsun pha ma thabs dang shes rab mtshon/ /dga' ba bzhi ldan dam tshig phyag rgya che—/ /de ltar thabs kyi sbyor ba kun 'dul yang / /zab mo chos kyi phyag rgyas gtan la dbab/ /sems nyid phyag rgya chen po rang la bstan/ /dga' bas gzung ba'i dran pa bkar 0 ba dang / /mchog dgas 'dzin pa'i dran byed gtang 3ba dang / /lhan cig skyes dgas dran pa bkar ④ bas dang / /dga' bral snang ba skye med dran pa gsal/ /de bzhin zab mo'i chos kyi phyag rgya bstan/ /26—1232

dga' bzhi ye shes gang du skyes pa dang / /tha mi dad cing yongs su thim par gnas—/ /rtog ②pa'i nyams myong dag la gnas pa dang / /yid la ma dran rtog pa tha mi dad/ /dpe dang lam ste tha snyad 'dul bar bstan/ /sems nyid phyag rgya chen po 'char ba ni/ /skye med skye ba'i cho 'phrul cir yang 'char/ /blo las 'das pas ma skyes ngo bor bstan/ /ma skyes pa dang skyes pa'i dngos po gnyis—/ /tha dad med de gnyug ma'i ngo bor gzhag ༅ /dran pa sna tshogs gang la rgyu ba 'di/ /dran med 'jug pas rtog pa mi 'gag pa/ /shes pa rang lugs bzhag ②na gnas par 'gyur/ /snang dang stong dang gnyis 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu| /tha mi dad par go na bde ba che/ /nyams myong shar bas mi mthun 'dzin pa bral/ /dran pa med de 'di 'dra'i yul med pa/ /dran pa med dang snang stong tha mi dad/ /ma skyes mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thong med de rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la/ /snang dang skye ba dran pa gang skyes kyang / /de nyid stong pa dran pa med gnas pas/ /dran pa yid la byar med snang stong dbyer mi byed/ /de nyid thug phrad skye med nyams myong la/ /snang ba'i ngo bo stong pa bde chen shar/ /chab rom chur bzhu btung du btub bzhin du/ /gang snang skye med bde ba chen por tshor/ /btang snyoms dran pa med de rtog pa ma bkag kyang / /blo las 'das pas rmongs pa sgom 4 dang zal/ /'di la gnas na bde chen nyams 'byung ste/ /dang por snang ba stong pa'i ༅nyams myong 'byung / /chab rom snang yang chu ngo shes bzhin du/ gnyis pa 3 dran pa'i snang ba ma 'gag ༅par/ /stong pa bde dang tha mi dad par 'byung / /chab rom chu ru bzhu ba'i gnas skabs bzhin/ /dran pa dran med skye ba med la 26—1233

thim / /thams cad tha mi dad pas bde ba chen por gcig /de nyid chab rom chu ru bzhu ba bzhin/ /thams cad rang bzhin thug phrad shes gyur na/ /bcing bkrol snadag gis ma bzung 0dran pa'i rje ma 'brang / /'jur bus bcings pa bzhin du sems mi sgrib1/ /'jur bu klod na grol zhing sems nyid gar dgar btang / / ldog pas gzings la 'phur ba'i bya rog bzhin/ /de nyid shes na snang ba longs spyod yin/ /lcags kyus btab pas glang chen thim pa bzhin/ /bya bral bzhag pas glang chen lom pa bzhin/ /dran pa dran med ngo shes gnod pa med/ /snang dang stong pa shes pas rtog dang bral/ /skye bar gnas pas dbyer med dran mi rgyu/ /de nyid khyab bdag dgra kun 0 ngo shes bzhin—/ /snang ba stong par thim pas lan tshwa chur thim bzhin/ /dran pa dran med thim pa de kho na/ /skye ba rnam pa gnyis la skye rgyu ②med/ /thug phrad skye med ye shes shar bas na/ /dran pa blo yi yul med phyogs med ye shes 'char/ /spra ba me mched rang 1 'bar me bzhin du/ /nyams myong smrar mi 0btub pa gzhon nu'i bde ba bzhi na/ /sna tshogs snang yang dran par mi 'gyur ba/ /dal ba'i 'bab bachus dba' rlabs mi 'gyur bas/ /rang gi ngo bo gsal bas mar me dran / /de ltar phyag rgya chen po gang la mi bstan pas/ /bya sar ko ne ⑫mkha' la gnas bzhin du/ /rtogs pa'i spyod pas blang dor mi byed pa/ /srog chags pa ta ri bzhin zhen chags med/ /blo 'das 'bras bu 'dod na ⑫med grub pa/ /sman mchog nang na pe skyata ji bzhin nyid/ /kye ho de ltar mkhas pa thabs zin dag gis ni/ /dran pa med la skye med rgyas btab ste/ /dran pa med pas dran med rgya yis btab/ /snang bas stong pa la rgyas gdab/ /stong 8 26—1234

pas snang ba la rgyas gdab/ /dran dang snang ba bde ba'i ror shar na/ /stong dang dran med rgya yis tsu3thebs pa yin/ /snang dang dran pa stong pa'i rgya dang ni/ /dran med gnas pa dag gis 0rgyas gdab na/ /snang dang dran pa bde ba'i ror shar nas/ /mtshan ma'i bsgom pas ma dpyad mtshan ma'i blo las 'das/ /dran dang snang ba dag la skye med rgyas btab ②pa/ /skye med dag la blo 'das rgya yis thebs/ /dran pas dran med bde ba'i rgyas thebs pas/ /stong par ma song chad pa'i mthar ma lhung / /gnas pa skye ba dag la rgyas thebs pas/ /dngos por ma song rtag pa'i mthar ma lhung / /thams cad blo las 'das shing skye ba med/ /thams cad bde ba chen po'i rgyu dang ldan/ 1de ltar shes pas btang stoms mthar ma lhung / /dran pa 'khor ba'i dngos po dang / /dran pa med pa'i rtogs ④pa la/ /btang snyoms lam du khyer bar byed pa dang / /rig pas gzhigs nas stong pa btang snyoms dang / /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig btang snyoms pas/ /bden pa gnyis bral gnyis med btang snyoms bsgom3 //gang du ma dran bsam gtan btang snyoms mchog /lung du ma bstan btang snyoms sgom ma yin/ /shes pa sor gzhag dran med nyams 'phro 3ba/ /dran pa'i mtshan ma dran med lam du khyer/ /bde ba lam khyer blo 'das ma dmigs pa//gnyis la mi rtog bde ba rgyun ma (snye'achad/ /kye ho nyams dang bral bas gzung 'dzin gnyis las grol/ /de nyid phyaka rgya chen po'i don mthong 'gyur/ /'bras bu mthar thug rin chen gter chen la/ /phyag rgya che la gnas 'dod gang //dri med 'bras bu rtogs par shog /sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa/ /sku'i mdzod 'chi med rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //26—1236

1220 7〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stan/ me 〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stegyis/ pya 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stadang / ④〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉de nyid sbas gyis/5〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉torathun/ po〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brtags shing / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉phyir/ — sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/1221 nga/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtog dang mi rtog ci )〈〈pe 〉〉〈0mir 〉torabyung / gu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngagazhag sa〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ngang bzhin bzhag 'u〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉the/1232 〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag du 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanams/ 3〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 ba/ gi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagar/ 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉btang / 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dkur/1233 3)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtogs/ du 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabazhag du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas rang lugs gzhag ④〈〈pe〉〉////misgoms/ ge 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉mir myong ba'i/ ⑥〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉waganyisapa/ ci 〈〈pe〉dze05ra 〉〉1234 ①〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉dgros/ 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanazung / pya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgri/ ci〈〈pe〉྾po ra 〉〉waldog pas/ thu〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bul/ sgo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rkun/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ཿna/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rab/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stab/ te〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bab/ hwa〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wagang la mi bstan pas/ /bya sar ko de/ 8〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉pa/ 8〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bre/ co〈〈pe 〉྾'a ra 〉snostongs/1235 rmi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ju mo〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stan/ pya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉gdab/ dū〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rtog ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ 5〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skaratsho/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/brtsar 'bras lde'u mig da/ (11 4)26wa 1237

ma / /rgya gar skad du/ bā ka ko ṣa shrī ri pa ra badz+ra shī ti ④/ bod skad du/ gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i gru/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ho ting 'dzin rtse gcig ro snyoms spyod pa —7khyad par can/ /dngos dang dngos med yid rtogs 'khor bar rgyu bas btang bar bya//snang dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa dbyer med de kho na/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin thams cad 'byung zhing thim par gnas/ /bdag dang gzhan don gnyis med dran med gsal ba'i ngang / /phyag rgya chen po'i rnam grangs dpag med brjod las 'das/ /dngos dang dngos med yongs su btang na 'khor 'das med/ /rdzing bu gla 5gab med na phyogs bzhir 'khor lo spangs— / /byis pa ma shes rten 'brel 'khor bar 'jug pa'i rgyu/ /shes rab zhan pas dngos 'dzin bdag gzhan don mi 'grub/ /mar me sbar yang dmus long dag la snang mi srid/ /bdag gzhan 26—1238

don 'dod dngos 'dzin rang gis rang la 'dzin/ /rtog pa yin phyir btang mi btang la brtag par bya/ /snang med rang rig rtog pa'i nga snyad kun dang bral/ /thabs dang bral phyir bdag don mi 'grub mtshan mar 'gyur/ /dbyer med don la gnas pas de nyid ston pa dang / /chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /bla ma las 4 bstan lung 'brel gdams ngag rjes su ston/ /lung dang rigs pas rang gi mtshan nyid rtogs 'dod pa/ /bla ma la brten ༄ gdams ngag ldan pa dag las rnyed/ /bsnyen bkur byas na lhan cig ②bde ba mchog thob 'gyur—/ /dri ma dang bral bya phyir bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mchod na byin rlabs ( 3chen po 'byung bar rgyal bas bshad/ /kye ho grong khyer tsam o ngan kus phyanam mkhar song bzhin du/ /thar pas 'bad na rgyal ba'i sa la gdon mi za/ /brjod bya rjod byed dbang bskur byin rlabs 0 skye zhing 'phel ba'i gnas/ /sngon du slob mas bya dang slob dpon bya ba'i rim pa dang / /rjes su slob mas bya dang zab mo dbang bskur ba/ /phyag rgya mchod dang bstod pa dag gis gsol ba gdab/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis gsol gdab rig pa rtsal dpang dang / /phyag rgya la brten gsang ba'i dbang bskur sdom sbyin dang / /gnang ba sbyin dang rjes su spro ba bstan ⑦pa ste//slob mas rdzas dbul zab mo'i dbang bskur dam bca' dang / /bskyed pa'i rim pa la sogs bstan pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyi rim pa bstan pa dang / /nyams sbong bsgom par bya ba'i brjod bya la sogs kun/ /gang la mi gnas bya sar ko ne gang la rten mi 'cha'/ /'dod pa med pa'i bde ba dag la mi gnas te/ /ya zung med phyir gang la rten dang rten byed bral/ /gnyis med rnal 'byor rang la 'char ba'i nyams myong bde/ /bdag tu rtog pa'i dngos po gtang na nam mkha'i mtha' ltar 26—1239

yangs—/ /zu ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer dag tu 'jug 'dod na/ /tshogs drug thug phrad char pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor che/ /snang ba stong pa skye med thug phrad rkyen la rag ma lus/ /gnyis med goms pas lam myur zung du 'jug mi ldog /sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin yin par shes na rtsol ba med/ /gang gi ro snyoms spyod pa dag la brten nas 'bras bu thob/ /spyod pa byas na 'gro ba 'khor ba dag las thar bar the tshom med/ /bdud dang mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur—/ /mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor mi bya btang snyoms rnal 'byor min/ /mkhas pa'i ye shes myur du thob cing sgrib pa zad/ /mtshan ma'i spyod pas drang don mkhas kyang rmongs rnams 'ching / /ro snyoms phyag rgya chen po la brten nam mkhar 'gro/ /gnyis med spyod lam rgyun du bstan 1na tshe 'dir thob/ /snang ba sgyu ma'i yul la mi gnas rtog yul med/ /'jig rten chos brgyad 'ching bar mi nus brtul rdozhugs mchog /snying rje thabs zin spyod pa chags med mkha' ltar yangs/ /phyag rgya chen po yan lag bzhi ldan thabs kyi mchog /bzhir ldan phyag rgya gcig gi cho 'phrul gcig gi ngang / /gnyis med ngang la phyag rgya chen po glod de gzhag /byang chub sems ldan btang gzhag med na glang chen 'dra/ /rtog pa'i ngo bos ba mo rta ltar snang 'dod na/ /rtog med snang med don la 'bad de rnal 'byor bya/ /sbu bzhi mthar phyin 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i ngang / /skye bar snang ba lam gyi 5lus rnams ni/ /sku gsum mthur ldan rtog pa rnam par bral/ /shes dang shes bya rang rgyud dag pa'i yul/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin skye ba'i rkyen snang yang / /ma skyes pa yi yul las 'das ma — myong / /dngos po dngos med btang snyoms la sogs kun//'byed pa med de dran med skye med yul/ /phyag rgya che la rtag tu mtshan nyid bral/ /26— 240

phung po dag pas gsang ba'i yul las 'das/ /dga' ba bzhi yi mtshan nyid phyag rgya'i yul/ /rang rgyud ma yin shes rab thabs dang bral/ /sna rtse la sogs de nyid ma zin na/ /de nyid dag la sbyor yang don dam min/ /rang rig rdo rje gnas te sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ②ngo bo 'di 'drar med/ /rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs brag ca'i ngo bor mtshungs/ /grangs 1tsam nyid na gang du'ang sleb pa med/ /dam tshig baspub dang 'bras bu rnam sbyar ba/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed tshig gi tha snyad lam/ /dam tshig nyams na thabs sogs nyams gang na//blo las 'das pa'i yul du slob pa med/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas phyi dang nang 'gyur ba/ /kho na nyid dang ldan na khyad par can/ /de nyid mi ldan dud 'gro dag dang mtshungs/ /de nyid sbas pas lhan cig skyes bsgoms pa/ /thabs bral dam tshig 'gal yang nyes pa med/ /'di dang pha rol grangs la mi ltos par/ /da lta nyid du mngon gyur phyag rgya che/ /de nyid spangs na nam yang phrad mi 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po skad cig thos pas kyang / /snod dang ldan mi ldan la mi ltos par/ /bstan pa tsam gyis rtse gcig 'di yis thob/ /gang zhig dran pa dag la ma yengs pa'i / /lhan cig skyes don bsgom dang ldan pas thob/ /de nyid rang yin gzhan byi chos mi tshol/ /dur khrod wa sogs tshol phyir 'brangs te phung / /kye ho bram ze rigs ngan khyim 'dres 'tshol slong bzhin/ /bzang ngan 'dres pa gcig la gcig gnod de/ /mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor mtshan med don mi rig /mtshan ma med la bltas pa nam yang med/ /mtshan ma dus dang grangs la ltos 1par 'gyur/ /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa khyad par bsam mi bya/ /gnyis med 'dus pa dal 'byor mchog ldan gang / /gang yang ma shes dran med yengs pa'i yul/ /dran 26—1241

pa'i rgyud spangs de la goms par bya/ /thun mong ma yin gsang sngags khyad par can—/ /thog ma nyid nas bden pa'i ngo bor gnas/ /dngos grub bsdus pas lhan cig skyes la thug /de nyid khyad par rang rig yul las 'das/ /de nyid bde ba'i gnas dang dngos po stong / /chos rnams dag pas rang bzhin bde ba'i don/ /gang la mi gnas blo yi yul las 'das/ /yul med gnas med rten dang bral bas stong / /e waṃ ⑫dngos grub ngo bo nyid kyi rgyu/ /rdo rje 'chang dang rang rig bla ma'i bka'/ /'dus pa'i rgyud du dri med phyag rgya che/ /kun rdzob las kyi phyag rgya la sogs kun/ /'khor los sgyur rgyal dmangs kyi 'khor dang mtshungs/ / phyi nang zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa kun/ /②rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya nyi zla'i skar phran bzhin/ /dga' bral dga' ba mchog tu dga' la sogs / /lhan cig skyes dga' 'khor lo'i rtsa ba nyid/ /dri ma med par dag byed de yi dgongs par gsal/ /de nyid ldan pas rtag tu ye shes myong / /dbyer med thugs kyi stong nyid go 'phang ②yongs/ /lus ngag thabs ldan thabs la brten bsgom pa/ /dran pa skyed byed rgyu rkyen 'bras du smin/ /las can drang phyir grol ba'i thabs su sbyor/ /las kyi phyag rgya nyams myong brod pa skyed/ /de nyid ldan goms nyams sbong grol ba'i lam/ /pad+ma rdo rjer sbyor ba mthong 'dod dang / /chags can lam gyis de nyid grol mi 'gyur/ /gzhan yang las kyi phyag rgya nyams myong dag brten 0la/ /tha mal rang lus ⑤phyag rgya chen po sbar/ /phyag rgya chen po kun du khyab pa'i dpe/ /rin po che dang nam mkha' lta bur mtshungs—/ /phung po lnga sogs gsang ba mchog tu 'byur/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa lhan cig gnas/ /kho na nyid ni bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /26—1242

mtshon cing baspub mi dgos par rang la rnyed/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog nyid dri ma bral—/ /go 'phang thob par bya phyir spyad par bya/ /rtag chad gnyid med mnyam sbyor gcig nyid gzhag she /lung dang man ngag b.rig pas shes par bya/ /kho na nyid ni bsgrubs 4na gdon mi za/ /phyag rgya chen po gsal te shes goms ④na / /kho na nyid ni rtogs par the tshom med/ /de nyid shes na goms pa'i stobs kyis spyod/ /de nyid ma shes steng sgo 'og sgo dang / /rig ma la brten ka gsum po gtsor byed dang / /chu bya la sogs nya dang dud 'gror mtshungs/ /rang rig rgyud la tha snyad 'jal byed dang / /phyi nang gzhigs ④ nas rang bzhin med 'dod na/ /'jig rten ca co yin mod khyad med mtshungs/ / den dang rten 'brel sgo nas thar 'dod dang / /dbang po bsdams ⑦pas thar lam 'dren 'dod dang / /byis pa chang pa stong pas 'brid —dga' ste/ /des na bya ba byed 'dod thar med brdzun gyis bslus/ /grangs can rigs sogs gcer bu bye brag 'dod/ /byed dang rgyur lta la sogs gyi na 'khyam/ /kye ho de nas sgyu 'khor ba ji lhar gtang ⑫bar 'gyur/ /rgyu rkyen med pas rtogs ⑪yul ma yin pa'i—/ /sems kyi de nyid phyag rgya che la gnas/ /de nyid stobs kyi tshematshan ma dang bral zhing / /tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur/ /kye ho ngo mtshar gsang ba'i spyod yul 'di/ /sman pa'i rgyal po rtogs ⑫las skye med 'char/ /ye shes lnga sogs mtshan nyid rang la ldan/ /dang po'i 'ilas can rigs kyis kho na mthong / /mtshan ma la brten kyidran pas g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /kho na nyid la phyi rol ma dmigs na/ /mtshan ma'i spyod yul dran med ngang la thim/ /mtshan ma'i rnal 'byor khams gsum 'khor ba'i lam/ /mtshan ma'i dngos po bag med 26—1243

sa bon bcas/ /dran med rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs/ /so sor med na ngo bo ma skyes phyir/ /skye bo gzhan gyi blo yi spyod yul min/ /de nyid lta la mkhas pas spyad byar 'byung / /dran pa rnam rtog gzugs su gnas pa dang / /dran med khams gsum dag pa'i gnas su spangs/ /de nyid ma skyes dngos grub kun gyi gnas/ /phyi dang nang rol ma dmigs thams cad 'grub/ /kye ho phyag rgya chen po yon tan mchog ldan gang / /bla ma mnyes par bya phyir dngos grub kun gyi gzhi/ /bla ma dkon mchog mi spong ⑫yon tan 'byung / /gang zhig dad pa'i sems ldan brgya lam na/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis ④gzhung 'di rtogs par shog /gsung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i gru sa ra has gsungs pa rdzogs so// //baspyar ma na/1238 3mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / ‘‘pe 〉rasung gi mdzod 'jam dbyangs rdo rje'i gru bzhugs/ — ‘pe 〉〉8'ar 〉༅ ta/ 3dz+wadz+wape 〉〉(8snar 〉〉spyodapa/ du 88pe 〉 ‘snar 〉〉rgyu— 5〈〈pe 〉〉dz+wa〈snar 〉rab mi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma ngas/123‘ rngo(‘pe 〉〉dz+wa‘snar 〉༅/ — 7dz+wa〈pe 〉 〈snar 〉 sten/ 1(‘pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉〉lhan cig —〈‘pe 〉 ‘snar 〉〉brlabs— me22pe 〉 ‘snar 〉ram kus su/ pa —dz+wa2pe 〉〉dz+wa snar 〉 rlabs/ tsa‘ pe 〉 dz+wasnar 〉 rtan/ dz+wa2pe〉〉dz+wa8snar 〉 tang /124༷ 1 (pe 〉〉dz+wa〈snar 〉 rten/ 〈 pe 〉 ‘snar 〉༄ba btul/ snye‘‘pe 〉 8snar 〉 zhag — ‘‘pe 〉 〈snar 〉〉sab— 3dz+wa〈pe 〉 dz+wasnar 〉41sa/ — ‘pe 〉 snar 〉ma da' mi/1241 3(〈pe 〉〉(dz+wasnar 〉7/ 8dz+wape 〉 snar 〉zadabs bral ba'i/ — —‘〈pe 〉〉‘dz+wasnar 〉rag — (dz+wape 〉〉8‘snar〉'ashes— dz+wadz+wape 〉〉dz+wa〈snar 〉 ltos/ (‘pe 〉〉〈‘snar 〉 phung / (2pe 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉 ra/ dz+wa〈pe 〉〉8〈snar 〉rabaltos/26—1244

ra / /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta ko ṣa a badz+ra shī ti྾ / bod skad du/thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / skye bo '-ilhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ /rang gi nyams su sbong ba de kho na/ /rig dang ma rig rang rig gsal ba de kho na/ /mar me nun gsal rang gi ④rang gsal rang la sad/ /'dam gyi ④pad+ma 'dam la ma zhin kha dog legs/ /gzung 'dzin dri ma ma spangs snying po gsal④/ /nags khrod gnas pa'i ri dwags gcig pur rgyu/ /rgyu la ma zhen 'bras bu de kho na/ /snang dang mi snang yul med zhen med ༄ 3gsal/ /dngos stong ma dran dran med brjed pa med/ /lhan cig skyes pa rnam ⑫gsum nyams su bde/ /zhen pa med phyir rtog ge'i yul las 'das/ /sna tshogs dran phyir rjes su 'brang ba med/ /gsal dang mi mnyam 1shāye shes snying po nyid/ /mun sel nyi ma sgron me'i kha dog 26—1246

ltar—/ /rang rig rang la 'bar na 'dzin rtog zad/ /sgrib pa zad phyir dran med yengs pa med/ /gnyis dang yod med 1tha snyad ma skyed cig /phyag rgya chen po bsam med blo las 'das/ /rang rig rdo rje 'dzin pa rnal 'byor pa/ /'da' dka' lhan cig skyes pa'i mar me ni/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i don/ /skye med stong pa 'od gsal ⑤ris dang bral/ /khyad par can gyi ye shes kho na nyid/ /gnyis la mi ltos ②bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /rang 'byung rtog med bag chags rtsad ⑦ nas gcod/ /sems can sangs rgyas khyad par bsam yas kyang / /spyod lam dag na rgyun gyi rnal 'byor che/ /dran pa'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /gdod nas dag pas dran med dbyings la thim/ /rang don skye med gnyis bral rtogs pa'i don/ /'bras bu dag pas blo 'das yul med bral/ /rtogs 'upa'i thabs rgyun rang bzhin kun la khyab/ /thabs kyi 'gro don snying rje bsam yas kyang / /ye shes rang bzhin skye 'gag med par rtogs/ /thabs kyi bde ba skyes kyang de med ma zin 'ching / /grol ba'i ye shes rang la lhan cig 'byung / /bsgom bya sgom ( 3byed dmigs pa'i blo las 'das—/ /sangs rgyas sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /skye med rtogs pa'i yul na blor mi snang / /de nyid sad pas bde ba stong pas mtshon/ /bsgom bya'i ngo bo snang ba'i rkyen las byung / /mi rtog rtogs pas kun rdzob tha snyad 'grub/ /gnyis su med pa'i snang ba rkyen med la/ /rang bzhin dag pa skye ba'i rnam 'phrul shar/ /bral dang ma bral mi rtog blo las 'das/ /gnyis med rtogs byar skye med yul du 'gyur/ /stong par smra bas de nyid rtogs mi 'gyur—/ /blo las 'das pas mno bsam yul ma yin/ /mtha' gsum rtag 26—1247

'dod dag gis rnyed par dka'/ /dga' bzhi dag la dmigs kyang de nyid dka'—/ /tshogs drug rang chas ye shes mchog ldan pas/ /gnyis med bcud kyi snang ba rang la 'chad1pe/ /kye ho phyag rgya chen po rtogs bral kun gyi gzhi/ /dngos grub 'byung bas ngo mtshar rmad du che/ /gnyis med bag chags sad nas rang rig bral/ /gzung 'dzin bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po ni/ /mtshan nyid bstan pas nyan thos la sogs skrag /rtse gcig bltas na yon tan mthar thug ldan—/ /rtse gcig byas kyang cung zad bsgom du med/ /rnam rtog rang 'bar dran med gsos su zhi/ /dran — med snang med 1me long gzugs brnyan 'dra/tha snyad bral bas skye med blo 'das lam/ /mtshan ma'i dran pa dri med bag chags bstan—/ /thog mtha' bral zhing snga phyi'i dus mi dmigs/ /kye ho de phyir dngos med ye shes rtogs pa'i lam/ /ji ltar bag chags bral ba'i tshul zhe na/ /gnyis su ma gzung gdod mtha' bral bas zhi/ /bag chags bral bas phyogs med rgyu ba stong / /zung du 'jug pa sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ /shes rab rnam gsum yul dang thabs su gsungs/ /dpe dang bral bas mtshon pa'i yul las 'das—/ /skye ba 'di la dam pa'i snying po min/ /thabs kyi sbyor bas tshogs drug rang sar zhi/ /phung po lnga sogs yon tan dag pa'i zhing / /kun mkhyen gnyis med snang yul zhen dang bral/ /don dam smra med kun rdzob rtog ge 3tsam//mya ngan 'das lam 'khor ba'i snang ba nyid/ /bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa thug phrad du/ /rnyed nas 'khor ba'i lam las grol bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor dgongs pa'i nyams rnyed rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ma nor lam du lhan cig kho na yin —/ /kye ho gnyis med don du gsang sngags brda yis bkrol/ /yon tan 26—1248

mi zad rgya mtsho nor bu mtshungs/ /thabs mchog zin na bcu bzhi'i rngos la gnas / /gang du gnas kyang ye shes rang las rnyed/ /gter rnyed bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don la rmongs/ /snying gi ga'u pad+ma'i me tog dkyil/ /thabs dang ldan pa sbyor ba de nas 'gyed/ /'khor lo'i phyogs kyi rtsa gnas gang du yang / /'dod dang bral bas chags med nam mkha' la/ /gyen thur 'dren dang 'khor lo bskor ba 1yang / /thabs kyi 'dren tshul don gyi gting mi rnyed/ / gzung dang 'phang dang sbyar dang spar ba yang / /blun po dadugs mi bde dang khyad med mtshungs/ /rtogs par 'dod pas de nyid rtag tu blta/ /gus dang dang bas bla ma dkon mchog brten/ /gsang ba'i yon tan bla ma mchog las 'byung sna/ /don ldan mtshan nyid nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal/ /gsang ba'i don nyid don dang rab ldan pa'i/ /bla ma slob dpon lung dang rab ldan nas/ /mi gnyis sgo nas 'gro ba grol 'gyur shog /thugs kyi mdzod skye med rdo rje'i glu snying po gsang ba'i don/ dpal sa ra ha pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //26—1249

pa zhes bya ba/1 ma / /rgya gar skad du/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta a ma na si ka ra tsā ma/bod skad du/ sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa zhes bya ba/ mtshan ma rab tu mi gnas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshang lo/ /gang zhig sku yi khyad par bdud bzhi rab tu 'joms mdzad cing / /rnal 'byor rnam par grol bas mdzad pa gang gis ni/ /'dod pa'i don ni yang dag sbyin par gang 'gyur ba/ /'gro la byams pa'i cha lugs mchog gi don ston pa/ /don dam rab tu mi gnas dgongs pa rgyal ba'i thugs/ /gang gi ②sems la 'di kun bsam du med do kye/ /khyod ni phrin las yan lag mang po ston mdzad cing //dgyes shing nam mkha'i khams kun thams cad 'gengs par byed/ /gsung mchog yan lag drug cus sgra skad sna tshogs sgrogs/ /thugs kyi khyad par dgongs pa dbyings las mi bskyod kyang / /thams cad tshig zhing mgu nas rab 26—1251

tu bstod par byed/ /byams dang snying rje'i gdugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsa' bar ston/ /ma hā de ba lha ma de ba rab tu 'joms par byed/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid de/ /thar pa'i sgo ni rnal 'byor rnams kyi lam 'di nyid/ /gang yang gtso mchog ldan pa'i sbyor ba dag gis rab tu mi dbye bar/ /rnal 'byor chen po tha mi dad pa yin/ /gang gis de ni mi shes pa'i/ /dri ma'i tshul gyis gang yang mthong ba med/ /gang gis de kun 'chang bar byed pa de yis ni/ /gzi mdangs gnyis las brten te las kun ston par byed/ /bdag med ro gcig khyab par byed pa'i gzugs ldan ni/ /'di na mi gnas kun kyang 'gro bar byed/ /sngags dang mdo sde kun gyi rgyal por dbang bskur bas/ /'di dag kun gyi rtsa ba yid la mi byed par/ /khyed kyis gcig dang gnyis la ma sems kye/ /kun rdzob dran pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs par ston pa/ /don dam mi dmigs pa yi dbyings su ro gcig nyid/ /dug lnga la sogs nad kyis nyen pa'i mun pa sel/ /thog ma'i mtha' dang tha ma'i dngos gzhi ma mthong bar/ /'dus ma byas la yid kyi dmigs su med do kye/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi bar na ming dang bral 'dug pa/ /yan lag log na gcig gi ngo bo nyid/ /shes par bya dang bya'o cog gi tha snyad kun/ /'di las gzhan du lta ba mtshan mas myong bar 'gyur/ /sgra gcan zin gyis zla ba zos pa ji bzhin te/ /ma mthong ba nyid byis dang bar nas shor bar 'gyur/ /yengs dang gnas pa'i bar na ngo bo 'di zhes med/ /rgyu med rkyen bral skye ba med pa gnyis par na/ /log par lta ba'i tshogs kyis 'di la gzhol du med/ /gi wang gur gum tsan+dan thig le bris pa bzhin/ /zla ba bzang po rgyu skar 'od kyis 26—1262

'gebs pa nyid/ /snying po'i 'od kyis yan lag zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /'di nas 'di ru zad ces 'di byung brtag ⑫dka' nyid/ /gang gis nam mkha' dag la longs spyod pa'i/ /'dod pa'i yon tan 'di la 'phel 'grib med par 'byung / /gang zhig nor bu dri ma med pa 'chang ba yi sems kyi yon tan gter chen 'di las 'byung 'gyur te/ /mthong ba med pa'i tshul gyis rtag tu blta ba nyid/ /chos nyid mtshon pa'i ngo bo 'di zhes 'das 'gyur ba/ /blo mchog rnams kyis kyang ni phigs par nus ma yin/ /gnyis med tshul gyis de bzhin gshegs gang nyid/ /'di nas song ba gang yang med par shes pa de/ /'di ni mi gnas gang na'ang gnas pa med/ /yul med 'di la rtag tu lta ba dang bral nyid/ /'di nas gang du 'gro ba'i phyogs mtshams de kun na/ /'jigs par byed pa'i sgra yis ma khyer bar/ /ci bde ba dang lhan cig dag tu byos—/ / kye ho ②grogs dag 'di la sems gnyis yod de med kyi brtag pa kun//nom rtog rlung gis bskyod de smyon pa'i tshig tu 'gyur/ /spyo bar gyur nas rgya mtshor lhung ba nyid/ /tshangs pa rdul dang mtshan ma'i nun pa dag dang ma zal ba//de nyid gnyis bral rtogs par 'dod pa dang / /rgya mtsho sa dang gshag mar nor bu 'gyur mthong nyid/ /brtul zhugs mya ngan 'da' ba'i spyod pa gang byed pa/ /'di ni mi shes de 'drar ston par byed/ /bden pa gnyis bral sgro skur med pa'i gnyug ma gang / /gang du mthong ba med pa de yin te/ /nges par grub cing 'di la rang bzhin med par 'gyur/ /gang gis ma mthong ba las de ni rgyal bar 'gyur—/ /theg pa gsum gyis mya ngan 'das ston pa/ /'di ru ma shes de nyid mthong ba med/ /rnam grol lam ston bye brag gang du'ang bye ba med pa de/ /26—1263

byis pa rnams kyis shes par 'gyur ma yin/ /gang zhig 'dod chags rkyabral ba rtogs par 'dod pa de/ /sdug bsngal gsum mam brgyad la sogs pa kun spangs nyid/ /bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' thabs yu la sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad 'od zer g.yas g.yon rab tu 'gyed/ /bum ril kha spub ma dag pa nyid dag ston pa/ /tshang tshing 'brel pa'i yul drug la sogs rab tu 'joms—/ /thams cad mkhyen ldan sus kyang mthong ba med pa de/ /grags pa la sogs kun gyis bstod dang bskyod pa med/ /kye ho 'di lhar gnas na kun gyis shes 'gyur te/ /thog mtha' med nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho g.yengs 'gyur ba//sdug bsngal nyid kyi rtsa ba 'di ru byas/ /'di la shes dang nyon mongs la sogs pa'i / /dri mas ma gos 'dam gyi pad+ma bzhin/ /kha dog ma 'dres yul la so sor snang / /sgyu mar rtogs tsam gar mkhan mig 'phrul bzhin/ /'du byed sna tshogs gang la bsags pa de/ /glo bur rten 'brel dag las goms pa'i stobs//'di goms gang yang shes par mi 'gyur te/ /ma goms pas na thams cad shes par 'gyur/ /'dres pa'i chos ni gang yang gnas par mi byed do/ /sku gsung thugs dang phyag rgya la sogs rim pa kun/ /'di la skad cig tsam du rtogs par ma byed cig /'jig rten bstan bcos dag dang glegs bam gyis/ /gsung gi bdag nyid brjod par bya ba min/ /nyi ma zla ba gnyis su gnas 'gyur ba— / /de dang gcig tu 'dres par gyur nas ni/ /gang gis gang spyod de yis rab tu brgyan / /skye ba med pa'i dam par nges brjod pa'i/ /dbus su brjod pas mtha' rnams rab tu spangs/ /ji ltar bstan pas go bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /'jig rten khams su gtan 'khyabs rigs chad de/ /bag chags las kyis 26—1264

mnar ba ma tshor bas/ /chos nyid dri ma med pa'i don mi mthong / /gang yang 'di dang bral ba med pa de/ /dran 'dzin lus las myur du skad cig grol/ /rdo rje'i sems ni yongs su brtag dka' ba/ /sems la sems su ma mthong ro lhoms 1nas/ /phyi nang bsam gtan rtse mos brtags pas stong / /rnal ma'i don la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /ye shes shes rab gsang ba'i dbyings la rdzogs—/ /rang gis ma mthong mtshan nyid kun ldan pa ④/ /zhes ni bsngags pa brjod 'gyur ba'i/ /dran med mnyam pa'i dbyings la skur gsal mos pa med par spyod/ /thugs rjes mi gzigs sku gsung thugs kyis ma gos pa/ /gnyis su ma mthong gsum gyi dri ma bral/ /sna tshogs bar snang gang la ngos gzung med pa ste/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa'i rtsol bas gdung bar dum byed cig /ngas ni rdo rje'i glu dang long gtam rgyob sod ④dang / /'gro ba kun gyis shes pa dag dang gar bder spyod/ / mi sgrim mi lha khyami spyod 'di dang 'bral ma stsong / /ye nas ma bcos thams cad 'byung 'jug go 'phang yang kyi/ /kye ho sna tshogs gang yang rung ba 'di la bsam pa'i sems bral bas/ /yid kyi rtog pa sna tshogs 'di ni dran pa'i sems yin te/ /gang yang gzugs dang rtsa ba med pa dag las skyes pa yin/ /tha mal shes pa ma bzung bde chen rgyal po nyid/ /mtshan nyid cir yang ma mthong phyogs cha kun dang bral/ /'khrul pas brtags pa'i bsam brjod 'di ni glo bur te/ /blo las byung phyir blo yis ⑦bsgom du ga la yod/ /gang la yan lag med pa de nyid kun gyi khyim du lhung bar 'gyur/ /go ba'i tshe na ci yang med pa ste/ /dngos kun ci yang gsal ba mthong ba med/ /gang la mya ngan 'das dang srid pa kha sbyor ②ba/ /gnyis su snang ba khyod la rten ḍadang 26—1266

'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal ba la sogs kun du sprul pa sna tshogs ston mdzad pa/ /dag pa'i rigs rnams kun la khyod kyis spyod/ /mi bsam thugs rje rang 'byung sprul pa ni/ /nor bu rin chen lta bur 'phel 'grib med par 'byung / /dngos po med pas nams kyang rtogs min pas/ /btang gzhag med cing rang bzhin rnam par grol/ /'dzin med yid la bya med rnal 'byor bsam gtan nyid/ /gang la mi bsgom gang du'ang 3btsal ba med pa de/ /bsam du med pas yid la mi byed ro snyoms kye/ /ye shes mkha' 'dra bsam bral ma bcos snying po'i don/ /'di la blo yis bsam zhing brjod du med do kye/ /ye btang rang yan tshogs drug lhug pa'i spyod pa 'di/ /tshogs drug rjes su sbyor ba'i mkhas pas btang gzhag med/ /kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor lhag pa'i bsam bral bas/ /de bzhin nyid la mi gnas gang la rang bzhin med par grol/ /'od gsal rdzogs dang thim dang 'gags par 'gyur ba gang / /ji ltar bsgoms dang chags par 'gyur ba mtshan ma ste/ /phung po khams dang skye mched yan lag thams cad kun/ /gcig gi dbyings na mi mngon phra ba'i tshul du gnas / /rgya mtsho'i dbyings nas nor bu rin chen rnyed 'gyur ba/ /chu srin dung dang gdug pa can gyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /phrag dog srid pa'i nyon mongs la sogs pa'i/ /mtshan ma'i dbyings nas ngos 6bzung med par mthong / /gsum la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'jug par byed pa ni/ /rnam rig bden pa gnyis kyi sgo nas rtsol bar byed/ /ji ltar snang bzhin 'jig rten tha snyad lam/ /rnam thar sgo gsum bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /mtshan ma'i yid la byed pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'di la gnas mi byed/ /gang zhig shel sgong 26—1266

dag pa lta bur ni/ /dri ma gnyis zal srid dang 'das grol te/ /rin po che ltar dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung / /yongs su zad pa zad phyir mtshan nyid med / /dngos med bden pa gnyis bral gcig gi dngos po stong / /mtshan ma thams cad ye nas med pa'i phyir/ /mthong thos la sogs mtha' yi rtog pa med—/ /med la med par 'dzin pa tha snyad de/ /'di ni tshor bar nus pa ma yin no/ /'di ni rtsa ba kun gyi rjes su rtog par ma byed cig /'di la gang tshe rtog par byed pa dang / /bskal par bgrangs ⑫kyang de nyid rnyed pa min/ /mgal me gtsub ②shing lta bur me mched 'bar ba bzhin/ /'di kun mched nas thams cad sreg par byed/ /kye ho grogs dag rgya mtsho nor bu lta bu'i sems ni 'di nyid yin te kye/ /ma te rwa rur ②seng ge'i 'o ma gang blugs pa/ /nor bu rin chen 'bar ba de yis thob par 'gyur/ /nyon mongs pa rnams nyi mas rab tu skams pa'i 'od zer 'di/ /ngan 'gro la sogs log par lta bas 'jigs pa med pa de/ /gang dag rnyed pa de dag gzhal gyis mi lang ngo ji ltar chos kyi dbyings su snang ba de srid du/ /zag pa med gang thakas cad de yis spyad pa yin/ /dug sprul phag rgod glang chen seng ges zos pa bzhin/ /de bzhin srid dang skya ngan 'das pa khyur mi 'das④/ /bskal pa brjod du med pa brgya stong du ma ru/ /nyon mongs la sogs bsags pa'i sa bon ni/ /sems gcig snang bar 'gyur bas 'bras bu gcig tu log par 'gyur/ /sgron me khang bur nor du gnas gyur pa'i/ /'od kyis thams cad zil gyis mnan par 'gyur/ /dman pa'i lha spyod nyan thos la sogs pa'i/ /sems de yang dag blangs nas 'jug par 'gyur/ /'di la gang na byang chub sems dpar 26—1267

gyur pa de/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dka' bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /sems kyi skad cig 'di la mtha' yas mu med de/ /yan lag thams cad skad cig 'di la log par 'gyur/ /chos rnams thams cad kho na nyid la rdzogs par 'gyur ba yi / /gzhan med gang zhig gang nas 'ongs par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zla ba'i snying po nun pa'i g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ba nyugang / /'jig rten rmi lam lta bu 'di la yang dag rnyed par 'gyur/ /brdzun pa gang yin 'di la yang dag sus mthong ba/ /bltar med de la gzugs su mthong bar ga la 'gyur/ /don dam par ni gang yang yod par 'gyur ba ma yin na/ /pha rol gzhan du mthong nas 'gro bar bye 'dod pa'i gang zag de/ /'di las gzhan du 'gro ba'i khyad par bse dri can bzhin no/ /'di ni pha rol brtol rgyabs gang du ma bor bar / /gcig kyang phyin pa med par 'dis brtol ⑤lo/ /kye ho gang 'di tha snyad lam 'dis btsal ma yin/ /thar pa rtag tu byi la lta bu'i mchongs pas nags su lhung bar 'gyur/ /gal te stag dang wa mo lta bu'i stobs ni go bzlog na//de nyid yod pas de la ci zhig phan par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid shes na mi bsam mi rtog par/ /gzugs mthong cir yang snang ba'i yul ni de ru stong par 'gyur//'di la yengs nas de la gnas par 'gyur ba ma tshor ro/ /dran dang shes bzhin gnyis ni bar gyi de la gang yang ma mthong ste/ /chos kun stor na 'di yi khong nas 5gnas par 'gyur ba yin/ /'di la dngos po med cing bsam du med pa de—/ /khyod kyis rtswa mchog tsam du gnyis ka med par byos/ /kye ho sangs rgyas kun gyi yan lag bzhi pa 'di kun gsum du ston par ni/ /khyod kyis yang nas yang du bsams pas mthong ba gang yang med mod kye/ /'khor ba'i dran 26—1258

pas rten 'brel dag las 'byung ba ni/ /sna tshogs bar snang rang gi ngo bo ma skyes phyir/ /mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dag dang lhan cig skyes/ /sems kyi don dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i yon tan nyid/ /chos rnams thams cad gnyis su gdod nas ma byung ste / /gnyis dang gcig gi dran pas du ma dag dang 'azal bar 'gyur/ /gang yang brjod par bya ba'i ⑫dngos po gang zhig rang gis stong pa ste/ /blo las 'das phyir mtshan ma rab tu 'joms/ /de med pa de gang yin gang na ④gnas par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bsam gtan gang tshe thob par 'gyur ba la—/ /bral bas 'di las gzhan du song bas ma mthong ngo / /gsang sngags 'di kun rtsa ba de las bskyed par ni/ /de med pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ba gang yang yod pa ma yin kye/ /su zhig 'di la rtog par byed pa'i blun po de/ /bskal pa brgyar yang mchog gi don mi mthong / /gang zhig yid la byed pa'i mtshan mas brgyal ba kun/ /btang gzhag bral dang thob par mi 'gyur rgyal srid bzhin/ /cung zad drod thob byang chub sems dpa' dag /gang du g.yos pa med pa ma tshor ro/ /rnam par rtog can lam du zhugs pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems kyi thig le rlung la gang bskyon pa/ /sa bon des ni 'khor ba 'di ru zags par 'gyur/ /yang dag pa yi de nyid thob par mi 'gyur zhing / /tshang tshing dra ba'i gseb tu 'brel bar 'gyur/ /shes rab mig gis log par tshar bcad na/ /gzhan gyi log par lta ba rang gi de ru grol/ /dka' thub la sogs gzhan du 'bad pa med/ /bdag med par ni rang byung gang yang rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /rgyu rkyen la sogs 'brel pa 'di ru stong par byos/ /rnal 26—1269

'byor 'di la bdag gi gan su 'dug pa ma mthong ngo / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa'i long ba gang 'cha 'dis/ /srid pa'i dra ba khur nas ②rgya mtshor mchong bar byed/ /de la gru med rgya mtsho'i zabs su zag ②par 'gyur/ /thog mtha' med pa'i phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das grol nyon mongs rgya mtsho skoms par 'gyur/ /de la sems rgyun 'chad do snyam du sems shing stong par yid la ma byed cig /gang la don gyi brtul zhugs chen po 'di nyid ma thob par—/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang gis de la ma reg kye/ /byin gyis brlabs chedang brlab bya med pas ngo mtshar che ba nyid/ /gnyis med sgro skur bral ba 'di la khyaganas pa gang / /rten dang bral ba'i tshul gyis gnas par 'gyur—/ /'gro ba kun gyis de lhar shes par 'gyur gang ni/ /srid dang skya ngan 'das pa kun gyi don shes 'gyur/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams rang gi sems yin par/ /gzhan du blta ba med par thag chod bsam med blo 'das nyid/ /de la bsgoms dang ma bsgoms rnam par rtog pa dang / /mtshan ma dgag dang spang bar bya ba mi dgos te/ /de la ci bya gang yang ma byas de nyid gsal bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar rnam rtog ma bkag ma spangs par/ /gzhan du ma mthong de nyid gsal 'gyur na/ /de ni gang la gnas kyang gzhan du mthong bar 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /ma bsgoms ched du ma byas 'bral ba med pa'i rang bzhin te/ /dus rnams kun du 'di don shes pa'i mtshan ma 'di la rtog par ma byed cig /rang la lhan cig gsal ba'i snang srid 'di la rtog med cing //de las gzhan du rtogs 0 pa'i blo can 'dis ni rgya mtsho nang gi nor bu rnyed mi 'gyur / /gang nas byung zhing gang du gnas pa'i 'dzin pa 'di ni skye ba med 26—1260

'gyur na/ /rgyun du 'gag pa med pas gzung 'dzin de ma skyes pas ye shes nyid//ngo bo de la dri ma ma spangs de nyid ma bsgoms par/ /nags khrod dag na gnas pa'i glang po yan par khye /mtshan ma'i yul gyi rnam g.yeng rtog pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /gnod cing de la g.yeng bar mi 'gyur te/ /mtshon cha bral ba'i chom rkun dag gis gsad ②bcad ma yin no/ /mtshan ma de nyid snying po med 'gyur ba/ /sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad lha dur rang bzhin med par byos/ /gang mthong sems yin de la dngos po med 'gyur bas/ /dran med blo la mi gnas chos rnams thams cad ni/ /de las byung zhing de ru snang nas de nyid 'das ②'gyur bas/ /'di la gzhan du g.yo ba gang yang med pa nyid/ /de la de nyid tsam du mkhyen gyis yid la ma byed kye/ /kye ho grogs dag blo la ci skyes sems de ni—/ /dus rnams kun du gsal ba ma yin no/ /de la gsal rgyu ci yang med pa ste/ /brtsad pa kun dang bral bar ni/ /rang gnas pas ni grol bar 'gyur//ji ltar tshul 'chos byas pa'i sangs rgyas 'di kun ni/ /dge slong ma yin rgya mtsho'i nang du ltung ④/ /'di nyid las ni gzhan dag tu/ /gcig kyang lta bar mi byed pa/ /des ni thams cad mthong ba'i dge slong yin/ /gang zhig brdzun la goms pa'i gnas brtan des/ /srid pa nyam thag 'di las 'byung bar nus ma yin/ /gang gis srid pa'i chu bo 'di brdzun par/ /shes pa de ni gnas brtan mchog thob 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor de yi spyod yul ni/ /lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya'i yan lag kun/ /'di kun shes na dbab tu yod pa ma yin no/ /de nyid shes pa de la de kun mthong ba med/ /de ltar 'di las ma gtogs pa'i//'du shes yul gzhan dag las ni/ /skye bar 'gyur ba yod ma yin/ /yul 26—1261

can gang gi phyogs dag tu/ /gnyis su mthong ba med par 'gyur ba de/ /rnam pa sna tshogs de nyid grol ba yin/ /gang zhig phyogs su lha bar gyur pa de/ /mtshan ma'i dran rig phra rags ⑫goms pa yin/ /gang zhig 'di las goms 'gyur bas/ /spyod pa ji ltar byas pa kun/ /don dang ldan par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ /nyam thag mtshan mas myur du 'ching bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di dang phyogs su ni/ /gtad la goms su yod ma⑫yin/ /bsam med yid la goms su med/ /kye ho grogs dag rig pa'i ye shes gnyis su med pa ni/ /ye shes bla na med pa'i dbang bskur chen po ste/ /rdzogs ldan dpal ldan bla ma dag gis ni/ /bskur du med pa'i tshul gyis thob par byed pa ni/ /mchog gi rnal 'byor rnams kyis ② dbang bskur te/ /thob bya med pa'i tshul gyis thams cad rdzogs—/ /de nyid ma shes log sred can gyi dbang rnams ni/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa dag gis gsum du zag ④ par 'akyur/ /'di la nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa las bsags kun/ /shes rab ting 'dzin mi dgos rnam par grol bar 'gyur—/ /khro gnyer med pas zug rngu thams cad 'joms par ni/ /ma skyes pa yi tshul gyis 'dzin par mi byed do/ /snang ba 'gag pa 'di la gsal ba'i rtog pas yid la ma byed cig /phyin ci log dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad ni—/ /nyon mongs lnga yi gnas su thams cad zags par 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhan dag 'di nyid shes pas 'khor ba'i dra ba dag gis stong pa nyid/ /spu dum wā 5ra lta dur dkon 'gyur ba'i/ /rmongs pa'i nun sel snying po gsang ba'i don—/ /sus kyang shes pa med par kun la gsal 'gyur ba/ /snying gar gnas pa'i don la dri ma med 'gyur te/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas gang de mthong 26—1262

ba ma yin no/ /'di rnams rdzogs la sbyor bar nus pa de/ /yan lag thim nas stong pa nyid du gnas/ /kye ho snagrogs dag gyad dang rje rigs ji bzhin du//gang gis khengs par myur du thob par 'gyur/ /rim par sbyang ba gang yang yod pa ma yin no/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig dang / /khyod kyis rdzogs par 'gyur bas thob pa ma yin no/ /gang tshe 'di la rtsa ba med par rtogs pa ni/ /da lta nyid du gnyis med nges par 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar srin bu spyod pas bcings par gang 'gyur ba/ /'di rnams ro la chags pas 'ching bar 'gyur ba ste/ /tshang tshing 'di la za bar nus pa gang gis ni/ /'khor lo thams cad rgyun du bskor bar 'gyur ba yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs gsal ba/ /'di kun gang gis yid la ma byas par/ /ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud/ /sku gsung thugs yid la mi byed pa'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha pa'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //bla ma nag pos rang 'gyur du gnang ba'o/ /gu ya sa ma pa ta mi thi che // //26—1263
bskur 'bras re'u migaskud/ (11༷7)

chen po'i man ngaganyu ra / /rgya gar skad du/ do ha ko ṣa tsā ma ma hā nu dra u ba de sha /bod skad du/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar dngos dang dngos med snang stong dang / /rgyu dang mi rgyu g.yo dang mi g.yo ba/ /thams cad ma lus nam mkha'i rang bzhin las / /dus rnams kun du nam yang g.yo ba med/ /nam mkha' nam mkha' zhes ni rab brjod kyang / /nam mkha'i ngo bo cir yang grub pa med/ /yod dang med dang yod min med min dang / /de las gzhan du'ang mtshan pa'i yul las 'das/ /de ltar nam mkha' sems dang chos nyid la/ /tha dad cung zad yod pa ma yin te/ /tha dad ming ni glo bur btags pa tsam/ /de la don med brdzun gyi tshig tu zad/ /chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ /26—1266

sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med/ /gang gis gdod nas sems med rtogs pa yis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dam pa rnyed/ /chos kyi za ma tog ces yongs su gdags/ /de yang log pa'i chos gzhan ma yin te/ /sazod nas lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin no/ /de yi de nyid bstan du yod min te—/ /brjod du med pas sus kyang go ba med/ /gal te bdag po yod na nor yod de/ /ye nas bdag med de la ci zhig yod/ /sems yod gyur na chos kun yod rigs te/ /sems med pa la chos zhig su yis rtogs/ /sems dang chos su snang ba thams cad ni/ /btsal na mi rnyed tshol mkhan gong nas med//med pa dus gsum ma skyes mi 'gag pas/ /de nyid gzhan du 'gyur ba med pa ni//rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gnas lugs yin/ /de phyir snang ba thams cad chos kyi sku/ /'gro ba sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'du byed las kun ye nas chos kyi dbyings/ /btags pa'i chos rnams ri bong rwa dang 'dra/ /kye ma nyi ma sprin bral 'od zer kun khyab kyang / /mig med rnams la nun pa rnams su snang / /lhan cig skyes pas kun la khyab gyur kyang / /rmongs pa dag la de nyid shin tu ring / /'gro ba rnams kyis sems med ma rtogs pas/ /btags pa'i sems kyis sems nyid rab tu bcings/ /ji ltar gdon gyis brlabs khyapa'i smyon pa dag /dbang med don med sdug bsngal byed pa lhar/ /dngos 'dzin rnam rtog gdon chen zin pa yi/ /skye bo don med sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig byed/ /kha cig blo yi dbye bas rmongs rnams bcings/ /bdag po khyim du bzhag nas gzhan du tshol/ /kha cig gzugs brnyan dag la gdon ②du 'dzid—/ /kha cig rtsa ba bor nas lo 'dab 'breg /ji ltar byas kyang 26—1267

bskrus pa ma tshor ro/ /kye ho bus pa rnams kyis de nyid ma rig kyang / /de nyid ngang las g.yos med nga yis rtogs/ /nga yis nga yir thog mtha' shes gyur pas—/ /nga yis nga mthong rang nyid gcig pur lus/ /gcig po nyid la bltas pas gcig ma mthong / /mthong bya mthong byed bral bas brjod du med/ 1brjod du med pa su yis go bar 'gyur/ /gnyug ma'i yid la gang tshe sbyangs gyur pa/ /de tshe ri khrod nga yi rtogs par 'jug /seng ge'i 'o ma snod ngan phal par min/ /ji ltar nags na seng ge'i nga ro yis/ /ri dwags phra mo thams cad skrag gyur kyang / /seng phrug rnams ni dga' bas brgyug ②pa ltar/ /gdod nas ma skyes bde chen 'di bstan pas/ /rmongs pa log rtog can rnams skrag gyur kyang / /skal ldan rab tu dga' bas spu zing byed/ /kye ho ma yengs sems kyi zhurang gis rang la ltos/ /rang gi de nyid rang gis rtogs gyur na/ /yengs pa'i sems kyang phyag rgya chen por 'char/ /mtshan ma rang grol bde ba chen po'i ngang / /mi lam dag gi bde dang sdug bsngal kun/ /sad pa'i dus na rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ /re dang dogs pa'i bsam pas kun bablang0nas//dgag dang sgrub pa'i bsam pa su zhig byed/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun/ /de nyid mthong bas rang bzhin med pa'i byir/ /re dang dogs pa'i blo ni zad gyur pas/ /spang dang blang ba'i 'bad rtsol ci byar yod/ /snang grags thams cad sgyu ma smig rgyu dang / /gzugs brnyan ( )dang mtshungs dngos po mtshan ma med/ /sgyu mar snang mkhan sems nyid nam mkha'i ste/ /mtha' bral dbus mar ④sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /gang gā la sogs chu klung sna tshogs pa/ /ba tsha can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar/ /btags pa'i sems dang 26—1268

sems byung sna tshogs kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par byos/ /gang zhig nam mkha'i khams ni yongs btsal kyang / /mtha' dang dbus med mthong ba yongs su 'gag /de bzhin sems dang chos ni yongs btsal bas/ /snying po rdul tsam rnyed par ma gyur te/ /yongs su tshol ba'i sems kyang mi dmigs pas/ /ci yang ma mthong ba nyid de mthong yin/ /ji lhar gzings la 'phur ba'i bya rog ni/ /phyogs rnams bskor zhing slar yang de ru 'bab/ /'dod pa'i sems kyis bstan pa'i rjes bcad kyang / /dang po'i sems nyid gnyug ma nyid du 'bab/ /rkyen gyis mi 'gul re ba'i yi zad pa/ /dogs pa'i skugs sa zhigs ⑨pas rdo rje sems/ /rtsa ba chod pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' 'dra/ /sgom du med pas yid la mi bya ste/ /tha mal shes pa rang lugs gnyug ma la/ /bcos ma'i dmigs pa dag gis mi basbad ༅de/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems la bcos mi dgos/ /ma bzung ma btang rang dga' nyid du zhog /gal te ma rtogs blo la sgom rgyu med/ /rtogs pa can la bsgom bya sgom byed med/ /ji ltar nam mkhas nam mkha' dmigs su med/ /de ltar stong pas stong pa sgom du med/ /gnyis med shes pas chu dang 'o ma ltar/ /sna tshogs ro gcig bde chen rgyun chad med/ /'di ltar dus gsum rnam pa thams cad du/ /yid la bya ba med cing ma bral gnyug ma'i ngang / /de nyid skyong la sgom zhes tha snyad gdags/ /rlung ni mi bzung yid ni mi ngacing bar② ma bcos shes pa bu chung lta dur zhog /dran rtog byung na de nyid rang la ltos/ /chu dang rlabs gnyis tha dad ma rtogs shig /yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po la//sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pas mi bsgom ste/ /sgom med don dang 'bral med sgom 26—1269

pa'i mchog /gnyis med lhan cig kyibade ba chen po'i ro/ /ji lhar chu la chu gzhag ro gcig ltar/ /ji bzhin ngang du de bzhin gnas pa'i tshe/ /dmigs 'dzin zhen pa'i yid ni rab tu zhi/ /kye ho/ gnyis med gnyug ma'i rnal 'byor gang de la/ /spang dang blang ba'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ /ngas ni chos kun ma btang bas/ /bu khyod 'di gyis bya ba mi smra'o/ /ji ltar nor bu de dngos med pa ltar/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa de dngos med pa ste/ /'du byed sna tshogs cal col gang smras kyang / /rnal 'byor blo ni gcig las mi 'da'o/ /gcig nyid na ni gcig kyang yod min pas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rtsa ba bral gyur te//smyon pa bzhin du rtsis med yan pa la/ /byar med spyod pa du chung bzhin du gnas//e ma/ srid pa'i 'dam skyes pad+ma lta bu'i sems/ /nyes pa gang gi ② gang la gos pa med/ /za zhing 'thung la gnyis sprod bde ba dang / /gal te lus sems rab tu gdungs gyur dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs gang la spyod gyur pa/ /gang gis ma bcings ma grol gos pa med/ /rtogs pa'i rang spyod rtsis med dang de nas/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro ba nyam thag mngon gyur tshe/ /mi bzod snying rje'i shugs kyis mchi ma 'byung / /bdag gzhan bzlog nas phan pa nyid la 'jug /don la brtags na dmigs pa gsum bral bas/ /yang dag ma yin mi lam sgyu 'dra ste/ /chags thogs bral bas dka' zhing skye med pa/ /sgyu ma mkhas pa sgyu ma'i don byed mtshungs/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /spangs dang thob pa'i dngos po 'ga' yang med/ /yid la byar med phyag rgya chen po ni/ /'bras du gang du'ang re ba ma byed cig /re ba'i sems ni gdod nas ma skyes pas/ /spangs dang thob pa'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ / gal te 26—1270

kang gis thob pa'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ / kyigal te gang gis thob pa'i dngos yod na/ /bstan pa'i phyag rgya rnam bzhis ci zhig byed/ /ji ltar ri dwags 'khrul pas gdungs pa yis/ /smig rgyu'i chu la rab tu brgyug — pa ltar/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'dod pas rab gdungs pas/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang sbar ni ring bar 'gyur/ /ye nas ma skyes rang bzhin rnam dag pas/ /de las khyad par cung zad yod min te/ /btags pa'i yid ni dbyings su dka gyur pa/ /nge la rdo rje 'chang zhes btags pa tsam/ /ji ltar e thang skam po'i smig rgyu dag /ster snang chu ni gnyis su med pa lhar/ /bzod ③nas dag btags pa'i yid sangs pa/ /de la rtag chad gnyis su brjod du med/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /smon lam dbang gis re ba yongs skong ba/ /de yang 'jig rten tha snyad kun rdzob ste/ /dam pa'i don du 'ga' yang don byem yin—/ /do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dpal ri khrod pa chen po sa ra ha'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi tas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //26—1271

bsdur ma na/1266 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉ga /do ha mdzod ces bya ba phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag dpal ri khrod zhabs kyis mdzad pa bzhugs/1267 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stedon/1268 9①〈〈pe 〉po pa/〈〈snar 〉gsang / du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉 ga ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾snar 〉〉bslangs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉ston/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈sha ra 〉༅da/1269 ①〈〈pe 〉྾'a ra 〉stanag ②〈〈pe 〉stab slad/〈'dir 〉stab bslad ③2po ra 〉stabacings par/127 ñdza〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyes/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/1271 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi gal te gang gis thob pa'i dngos po ci zhig yod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉 ga ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stanathod/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabad/brtsakā 'bra~X /shi) mig26wa 1272

pa bcu gnyis ba/3 rab/ /rgya gar skad du/ dwa da sha ku pa de sha gā dzā/ bod skad du/man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems ni zhi ba ste/ /de la gnas pa gang yin pa/ /nam mkha' bzhin du zhi bar 'gyur/ /lus ngag yid las byung ba yi/ /de la cung zad 'gyur ba med/ /yang dag ye shes las 'das pa/ /rnam par mi rtog zhi bar 'gyur/ /rtog pa zhi ba sangs rgyas nyid/ /de nyid rnam pa mkhyen nyid do/ /dngos po dngos po mthong nas ni/ /de lhar rnam rtog gang byung ba/ /de ni rtog med ye shes yin/ /'gro ba tha dad 'dzin phyir ro/ /dngos po kud gyi rang bzhin no/ /thams cad du ni so sor gnas/ /de dag la ni khyad par du—/ /nga rgyal med cing rmongs pa med/ /de phyogs phyogs gcig dngos po la//bdag tu 'dzin pa ji ltar yin/ /dud 'gro la sogs rang bzhin no/ /phyogs 26—1273

gcig tsam las gang byung ba/ /de yi ngo bor bshad par bya/ /yang dag sems kyis gzung bar byos/ /stag ni phug na gnas pa dang / /sbal pa stong pa chen po dang / /byi la ba spu ldang ba dang / /ba lang la sogs lus po sprug /sbrul la bza' ba med pa dang / /bya rnams mkha' la 'gro ba dang / /srin bu me khyer 'od 'phro dang / /rnga mos sprul rnams 'gugs pa dang / /rma bya skom las rgyal ba dang / /bung bas dug rnams zos pa dang / /chu byas dbang po bsdams pa dang / /seng ge 'jigs pa med pa dang / /'ug pas mtshan mo mthong ba dang / /bya rgod rin chen rtogs pa dang / /sprul gyi dug ni byed pa dang / /rma byas dug rnams za ba dang / /ngur pas ma 'ongs shes pa dang / /ne tsho tshig la mkhas pa dang / /sbrang dus rjes rnams sdud pa dang / /dud 'gro la sogs rang rig 'gro/ /ngang pas chu dang 'o ma 'byed/ /bung ba'i skad ni shin du snyan/ /chu skyar mchil ( mas sems can 'dzin/ /rdzul gyi mig gis thos pa dang / /ri dwags las ni gla rtsi 'byung / /gu ②na sa ni mig gis snomazu / /chu yi nang na gnas pa'i nya/ /srog dang rtsol bas 'gog par byed/ /tshul ngan bzlas pa bram ze yis/ /ye shes mchog ⑤tu thal bar 'gyur/ /stag la sogs pa'i srog chags kun/ /snga ma'i bag chags las byung ba'i/ /rang bzhin yon tan 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de dag 'jig rten ye shes can/ /dka' thub ma yin grol ba min/ /snga ma'i bag chags las byung ba'i/ /de dag so sor gnas pa yin/ /de tsam ye shes yin na ni/ /dud 'gro rnams kyang grol bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes te zhen spangs nas/ /yang dag ye shes spyad par bya/ /gang gis byang chub dam pa dag /dngos grub dam pa 'byung 26—1274

bar 'gyur/ /man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal nas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //bsdur ma na/1272 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉min ngag tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa banugs/1274 ༷/tram̐ sdubyeswā/ 〉za'i/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉༅/ ③〈〈pe〉5〈snar 〉zogu/ pya〈〈pe〉〉〈snar 〉skas/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉bsdushā 'bra~X /shā )mig26—1275

ma / /rgya gar skad du/ su a rnyibyu na kra ma/ bod skad du/rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo//bdag la byin gyis brlab pa'i cha'i khyad par bstan pas sprul pa sgyu ma'i bdag /dpal ldan rdo rje sgeg mo nyid la lhag par rol pa'i ro gang ci yang rung / /rdo rje bdud rtsi dpal ldan gang la gang gis bstod pa de lha'ang 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin na / /ji ltar brjod pa 'di las gzhan su bcom ldan de la kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang yang mngon dga'i rgyal ba'i sku mdzes gcig pu nyid/ /su yang mkhas rnams snying gar gnyid sad mi 'gyur ba/ /gang zhig shar bas mnyam pa'i dus na dbang po dang / /yul rnams bcas pa nub pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la spros pa dpal ldan bde ba'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i mtshon 'dzin cing / /gang zhig cha byad spros bral dri med shes rab rang bzhin kun du 26—1276

'gro—/ /dpag bsam lhug mas mngon mtshungs gnas gsum nyon mongs dra ba gcod pa gang / /dpal ldan rdo rje tshig mtshan btsun mo de la kun nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rdo rje yan lag ma zhes kun nas dran pas kyang / /nyon mongs bral ba'i bde ba 'ba' zhig sar ni bde 'gro ba/ /de la mi phyed gus pa'i khur gyi lcid kyis mgrin smad nas/ /de yi zhabs kyi pad+ma'i rdul la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bka' drin zer gyis spros pa bdag gis de nyid ni/ /rin chen 'od kyis bskor bas mun pa'i tshogs ni rab bcom zhing / /rnyog med mig gis rang gi rnam par rol pa ring mthong ba'i/ /bla ma rnam par snang byed de la yang dag 'dud/ /gang zhig srid pa dang ni zhi gnas 'gram du dga' ba rgyu mthun 'bab/ /ye shes nam mkha'i chu bos yid rgyas dpal ldan bla ma gsum pa nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sgeg mo btsun mo'i tshogs rnams shes rab pha rol phyin rang bzhin/ /gang zhig gnas gsum ston pa gcig pu dam pa'i dbang phyug dam pa'i sems la bdag skyabs mchi/ /gang gi ①sems ni mnyam pa nyid kyi yul du 'jog cing dug 'dra ba'i/ /'khor ba bcud kyis len gyi mirnam par mdzad pa rang dbang sngags 'dra ba/ /gang gi ②sa ste dbang po'i blo yi sa min 'gro gsum khang chung gi/ /dri ma 'khrud nas gcig pu bla ma dam pa'i ngag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gang dran par yang dag gnas pas snying ga pad+ma'i mdud pa ni/ /dbugs 'byin grol bar sbyor ba'i bla ma'i bka' lung de des ni/ /nyi byed 'od 'dra'i tshogs kyis gnas gsum khang bu'i nun 'joms shing / /rmongs dang 'gal la bdag ni dul bar bcas pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul 'di cung zad dran pa yi/ /yon tan spros pa yongs su gyur pas 26—1277

dpal ldan pa/ /mi bde ba yi bdag nyid kyang ni mchog bde bar/ /gal te grub na 'di las bsgrub 43bya gzhan med do/ /bdag ni bla ma'i zhabs kyi rdul la gus dang ldan pas rga shi dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs mda' 'dra'i zug rngu'i tshogs 'dis ngal ba med/ /lus can rnams la ye shes bdud rtsi skal ba ma bgos mi nus pas/ /gang zhig bdag gis spyad pa de ni ②yongs su gdung ba che/ /blo yi yul min des na gang gi spyod yul min/ /gzhi yi gtam gyi rim pa bla mas gsungs pa ring / /de yi rim pas snying rje la sogs yon tan dag /dad ldan rnams la snying gi gnas su rang nyid skye/ /dngos po 'di kun gcig pa dang / /du ma'i rang bzhin cha zal te/ /'di ni zhen pa'i sbyor bral bas/ /rtsol ba'i rnal 'byor rnam par 4 'gyur/ /spu langs myu gu'i tshogs kyis rab dga' yi/ /mchi mas mig gang ༅rdzi ma bkrus nas su/ /ches bstan bgus pa'i khur gyis mgo 'dzin ni/ /dpag bsam bla ma dam pa la 'dud do/ /gsal bar byi bor lag sngar cung zad byed/ /rab dga' bcas pas 0 nor 'dzin yan lag 'khyud/ /yang dag gus pa'i skud pas yid kyi me tog ni/ /mdud par brgyus ḍa pa'i bdag gi phreng ba 'di bzhes shig /mgon po khyod kyi bka' gnad nyung 'dus shes rab ni/ /rgyal po'i du mo cha las ⑤mkhas 'dra dbang du byed/ /'gro ba rnams kyi rang bzhid rol pa'i ro yi bde ba ni/ /'ba' zhig rjes su stsong ba de ni yid gcig ⑨bsod nams can/ /lang tsho'i snying rjes brlan pas khrod kyis sngon med lam gsungs pa/ /'gro ba ⑫bgrod bya med dang 'gro med ces bya ngo mtshar che/ /gang du gom pa bor ba tsam gyis mnyam med bde ba'i rgyun bcas pa/ /gang tshe srid dang zhi ba cung zad tha dad 26—1278

ma mthong ngo / /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa ra ha chen pos mdzad pa bdag byin gyis baḥseb lkupa grub pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po pa shi shān+ta bha dra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1276 snamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉〉༄ga /rang byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bzhugs so//1277 sna 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ nye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)sa/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/1278 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stabasgrubs/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sko'adi ni/ 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skanal 'byor/ 4〈〈pe〉〉〈po ra 〉rang / n+tu ske〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉thartan/ 6〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉7/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉skosnar 〉〉rgyus/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉)ga la〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stab/1279 )〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ kwa 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapa/brtsard 'a dhi 1bye'u mig26wa /279

do ha'i glu zhes bya ba/⑫ma / /rgya gar skad du/ tata twa ②u pa de sha shi kha ra do ha gri ha ②tsā ma/bod skad du/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rtse mo do ha'i glu zhes bya ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma g.yos sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la//rdo rje rtse mo cig car gru blangs don/ /gang tshe lhan cig skyes pa dag /go ba dgu yis rtogs par bya/ /rgyu mtshan gzhal bya la sogs med/ /dngos po rnams kyi kho na nyid/ /dgag dang spub pa med pa ste/ /dbye ba la sogs med par bshad/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams ④gnyen po med/ /'chal ba'i tshul khrims ser sna dang / /le lo khong khro rnam par g.yeng / /ma rig spang bya la sogs dang / /spong byed pha rol phyin pa med/ /dngos kun med par bshad pa ste/ /rtog med snyam sems kun dang bral/ /'khor ba las gzhan phyag rgya che//gcig kyang phog par ma bshad gang / /de nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lam/ /26—1280

'dod yon la sogs ma smad pas/ /'bras bu re ba med pa ste/ /sku gsum lam gyi ngo bo gang / /ci phyir zhe na mi rtog ste/ /kho na nyid ni ji ltar rtogs/ /gzhan la mi re gang gis phar/ /rin chen gter dang rgyal po'i dkor/ /phal pa yi ni bang mdzod bzhin/ /mchog tu gces pa rang la gnas/ /sems las ma gtogs phyi rol don/ /gcig kyang yod par ma bshad de/ /sems nyid kun du 'od gsal ba'o/ /de bas sems las gzhan pa'i chos/ /yang dag par ni brtags na med/ /dngos kun zung 'jug rang bzhin la/ /skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /ngo bo ma skyes stong pa gang / /gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ /gnyis dang yod med tha snyad bral/ /gcig dang du ma la sogs kyis//brtags na med pa ma yin te/ /yod pa ma yin med ma yin/ /rigs ①pas 'grub pa ma yin no/ /dngos por snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /ngo bo nyid las ma 'das te/ /rgya mtsho gzugs brnyan me long bzhin/ /dran med dbyings nas kun 'byung bas/ /rang bzhin nyid du dus der rig /gnyis med gnyis su med min pas/ /ma 'das dbyer med ro gcig la/ /gcig tu gzhag par bya ba'ang med/ /dngas ma de nyid ma bslad pa'i②/ /kho na nyid kyis gar ma g.yos/ /kho na nyid kyi ②shes pa la/ /'dzin pa med de ngo bo bral//cir yang mi 'dzin chos kyi sku/ /ngo bo nyid la dbye med/ /'dzin pa'i cha nas brtags pa gang / /skye med dbyings kyi rang bzhin la/ /zung du 'jug pas tha mi dad/ /sgro skur bral bas gnyug mar bshad/ /gzhal yas khang dang mtshan dpe dang / /sna tshogs sprul sku gang ston pa/ /gdul bya lam la zhugs pa'i stobs/ /mda' bsnun dag gis gang smras pa/ /'di la dmigs su rdul 26—1281

tsam med/ /phyin ci log gi skye bo la/ /nyon mongs yul gyi dug 'gyur te/ /ji lhar snang ba'i rim pa yis/ /dbyer med tshul du gnas pa ste/ /'od gsal ba nyid rnam par bshad/ /rang bzhin med pa'i ngo bo bral/ /tha dad ma yin gnyis su med/ /khams gsum blo 'das ye shes la/ /'di zhes bya ba'i ming ngam brda/ /mda' bsnun dag gis gzung shādu med/ /dbyer med ro gcig ma rtogs na/ /gnyis su snang ba'i chos rnams kyis/ /gal te bskal par rnyed mi 'gyur/ /mchog gi go 'phang mi 'thob ste/ /kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin la/ /dgag dang sgrub pa ngang gis bral/ /gnyis med ngang las ma g.yos pas/ /gang 'dir yid kyi ye shes ni/ /gcig kyang bral ba ma yin no/ /lhan cig skyes gang bde ba'i ro/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bdag nyid de/ /chu bo'i rgyun dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur dus rnams kun du gnas/ /rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs mtshan ma'i blos/ /nam yang shes pa ma yin no/ /bsam med yul la brtag tu med/ /yul med bsgom par ga las ④'gyur/ /bsgom med nyid kyang yod ma yin/ /dpe yi don la gang dris pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la'ang tsamanyam/ /bro gar glu dang rol mo yis/ /phyogs rnams kun du sgra sgrogs shing / /rnal 'byor mas ni g.yon nas bskor/ /dmigs gtad 5bral ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'bad pa med par kun du spyad/ /gnyis su snang ba'i rtog pa thams cad bcom gyur nas/ /brjod med rnam med 'bras bu thob 'gyur shog/ //dal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal sa ra ha'i zhal rngo )nas gsungs pa/phyag rgya chen po de kho na nyid rtse mo do ha'i gru zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //26—1282

kṛṇ+ḍa paṇ+ḍi tas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //37bsdur ma na/128༷ 37mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉༄ /man ngag rtse mo dota'i glu bzhugs go/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉spro/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ti/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang /1281 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rig ②〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉pas/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stekyis/1282 1〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung / 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thob/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang /⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stabatang / 'u〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉ngasnga/1283 ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉mi tha paṇ+ḍi tas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o// //brgyar 'azas zegazu mig da/ (1111)26wa 1283

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ bha ②ba salcar tsā ma/ bod skad du/dngos po spyong ba ②zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dngos po med la dngos por shes/ /dngos med skye ba yod ma yin/ /rtag tu skye ba dngos po nyid—/ /dngos 'khrul nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos rnams ni/ /skye ba mkha' dang mnyam nyid mchog /thams cad rang bzhin gyis mkha' mnyam/ /des na srid pa dam pa'i dngos/ /rgyu med 'bras bu med pa ste/ /las kyi rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /'jig rten pa med 'jig rten med/ /'di dag thams cad bden ma yin/ /ma skyes pas ni dngos po gang / /ji ltar gzhan las shes par 'gyur/ /mo gsham gyi ni bu nyid kyang / /de tshe skye bar 'gyur ④ma yin/ /'jig rten gzod nas ma skyes te/ /gang gis kyang ni sprul ma yin/ /don med 'khrul pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /zla ba bzang 26—1284

ngo'i grong khyer bzhin/ /'jig rten rnam par rtog las kyi'abyung / /rnam rtog sems las byung ba ste/ /gang phyir lus las sems byung bas/ /de phyir lus la rnam par brtag /gzugs stong tshor ba rang bzhin med/ /'du shes med cing 'du byed med/ /sems byung med cing du dngos po med/ /de phyir mi rtog rang bzhin no/ /des na sems min chos kyang min/ /lus min khams la sogs pa min/ /gnyis su med pa'i lam 'di ni/ /de nyid rig pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /dmigs pa med pa'i chos 'di kun/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu bstan/ /dmigs pa med pa'i blo byas na/ /dmigs pa med par 'byur ba yin/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan las byung bsten par bya/ /dus mi ring ba nyid na ni/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs la gnas gyur pas/ /sems can kun la brtse bar bya/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang mchog /lha nyid dus mi ring bar 'thob/ /'di dag thams cad ming tsam ste/ /tha snyad tsam du rab tu kajug /dngos po med la tha dad pa'i/ /brjod bya yod pa ma yin te/ /bdag nyid gang dang gang gis ni/ /chos dmas gang dang gang brtags pa/ /de ni de la yod min te/ /chos rnams kyi ni chos nyid de/ /ming gis ming nyid stong pas na/ /ming la ming ni yod ma yin/ /chos rnams thams cad ming med pas/ /ming ni btags ④pa tsam nyid do/ /mi bden par gyur chos 'di dag /brtags pa nyid du rab tu 'jug /gang la brtags pa de med na/ /stong pa nyid du brtags pa gang / /mig gis mthong ba'i gzugs dmas ni/ /de nyid rig pa zhes de bshad/ /'jig rten log pa'i nga rgyal can/ /kun 26—1286

rdzob bden pa zhes 'dir 'jog /gang du tshogs pa'i rkyed mthong ba/'dren pa gsal bar gyur pa yin/ /blo dang ldan pas don dam la/ /brtags te grags pa nges par mthong / /gzugs ni mig gis mi mthong zhing / /yid kyis chos rnams mi rig pa/ /'di ni mchog tu bden pa ste/ /'jig rten gang gis kyang mi shes/ /dngos po sbyong ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phargas pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ⑤

bsdur ma na/1284 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /dngos po spyong zhes bya ba banugag ②‘〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ma / ②〈〈pe 〉〈mu ra 〉〉wab/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ska/ra/1285 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ro / ②〈〈pe 〉྾sha ra 〉〉do/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtags/1286 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snothats+tsha/ ②〈pe 〉྾sha ra 〉〉〉dge'o//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1112)26wa 1287

zhes bya ba/ ༅ra / /slob dpon klu sgrub snying po'i zhal snga nas/ /re ba'i dpe ni ser skya 'dra/ /dog rngo pa rgyal bu gzhon nu ste/ /gzhan du 'dzin pa smig rgyu chu/ /bdag 'dzin phung byed nyi zer gzugs/ /snang ba gnyis ldan no lha'i bya/ /dor ba thur 1ma 'khrul pa'i gzugs/ /lta bas nga rgyal chos kyi wa/ /sgom la der 'dzin sa nu lta/ /spyod pas nga rgyal 'dzin na pa/ /dka' sa rlom sems bzang skyong bu/ /dbang gi bu grol 'dod kos la/ /rtogs pas chog zer dpal gyi bu/ /bla ma bla bral bla med gaṅgā ④mo/ /bka' la skur 'debs kṛsna she pa/ /bde bas grub 'dod thangs bzangs glu④ / /stong pas de bzhin gdol pa dza④/ /de rnams bral ba'i shes pa ni/ /nor bu rin chen thob pa 'dra/ /sngon yul wā rā ṇa sīr ④khyim bdag pra mo ha dang / ser skya mo gru spyan mo gnyis//chu bo ne+e 3 rañdza na'i 'gram ne'u sing pos ⑫ngad can du dus byas pa las mos 26nga 1288

nyin mtshan lnga zhig tu bsdad kyang 'ongs par ma gyur to/ /de nas yi mug ste ma'i drung du phyin pa dang / mas smras pa/ kye bu mo mdangs rab tu zhum par byur pa ci'i phyir zhes pa dang / bu mos smras pa/ kye mtshan mo gnyis dang gnyis gsum bar/ /khyim bdag gzhon nu la bsdad pas/ /yid gdungs pas ni yi chad gyur/ /zas dang bral ba lto ba ltogs/ /zhes zer ba la/mas 'bras chan pa na li gang byin pas/ myur du zos pas glo ba'i sul du song nas mgo 'khrugs so/ /de nas sman pa bshes gnyen chen po la bltas pa dang /'di dag ni tshul ji lha bu yin zhes pa dang / gong gi tshul bshad do/ /sman pas smras pa/ gang gis gang la re ba ni/ /zhi bar mi 'gyur bder mi 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'phel ba ste/ /re ba med pas bde ba'i mchog /'di dag ni re bas phung ①bar 'gyur ba bstan pa ste/ re ba med par bya ba'i man ngag ste dang po'o//② //sngon gyi dus na rgyal du mgron bzangs zhes bya ba zhig la/ yab thu bo'i stobs kyi ②rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur te/ kye rgyal bu sgo srung ④la nan tan gyis shig khri gzhan la ma shor bar bya ba la brtson par gyis shig ces smras das tshe'i dus byas par gyur to/ /de nas chos sbyin byed pa'i dus su bram ze mdun na 'gro rgyal po'i pho brang du byung ba la khri phrogs kyis dogs te langs nas sgor ⑤bya ba la phyin pa dang / nu bo 'gro bas rten pas khri phrogs so/ /de nas ser skya mas/ khyod 'o na 'bad par 'gyur ba ci'i phyir zhes pa dang / rgyal po nas ④babs kyis smras pa/ bdag la yab kyis gdams pa bzhin/ /khri 26—1289

stan shor gyis dogs pa na/ /sgo yi bya ba la phyin pas/ /nu bos bdag gis bde ba phrogs/ /zhes pa dang bram zes smras pa/ dogs pa dang bcas sems kyis bde mi rnyed/ /nyam nga dang bcas rtag tu bde mi 'gyur/ /gang la dogs yod de 'jig ⑫yod pa'i phyir/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dogs pa spang par bya/ /dog ( dpa dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste gnyis pa'o//② //sngon ri bya rkang la/ dge slong sog ma med kyis ④phyin pa dang / rab tu skom gyis gdungs par gyur pa la/ smig rgyu zhig chu ru 'khrul te/ 'thung du phyin pa dang / rab tu ngal bar gyur nas sngo'i lhum bu za zhing 'dug pa la/drang srong rkang mig 3gis smras pa/ bgrod dka' 'khor ba'i thang chen la/ /gzhan du btsal 'dod mi dag ni/ /nyon mongs tho bas gdungs 'gyur te/ /skom pa smig rgyu'i chu 'tshol 'dra/ /zhes so/ /de dag ni bsgom ⑦bya spang bar bya ba'i man ngag ste gsum pa'o//⑤ //sngon rgyal po brla skyes la/ btsun mo lnga brgya la bu stong yod de/ sras nam ga ru drang srong dpal dga' mo bslangs te/ de gcig bu med pas rab tu gces par byas/ rgyal bu yang bdag ④la ni gces pa med de/ bdag la ni sdug bsngal zug rngu cung zad tsam yang byung bar phangs pas/ bdag che'i dus byas na 'khor thams cad phung bar 'gyur ro snyam sems so/ /de nas nang par zhig khrus byas te/ khang bzangs kyi ⑩rtse mor kha shar phyogs su balhas te/ nyi zer la mig cung zad btsums nas ngasdad pa dang / nyi zer gyi gya gyu la dur khrod 26—1290

byung bar mthong nas/ bdag la dri mas gos par 'gyur snyam nas bros pa dang /khrang bzangs kyi rtse mo nas rtsang ste/ che'i dus byas so/ /de nas dge bsnyen blo gros bzang pos sprus pa/ bdag tu 'dzin pa ches pas sdug bsngal 'byung ba ste/ /bdag bde 'dod pas gzhan gyis gnod pa byung / /bdag tu 'dzin pa yongs su dor byas nas/ /sems can kun kyang sman pa bzhin du bya/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste bzhi pa'o//⑫ //sngon dze ta'i tshal du rgyal bu don thams cad grub pa dang / bdud nag po lha sbyin gnyis bya ne za' lus gcig las/ mgo bo gnyis su gyes pa cig tu skyes par gyur to/ /de nas lha sbyin ④mgo bo gnyid log pa'i dus su/ don grub kyis shing gi rtsa ba srog ②pa dang / sman yang ④spru dang / dug ha la gnyis rnyed pa la/ bcud ni mnyam por phan ro ni bdag rang myang ngo / /zhes nas sman zos pa dang / bdud lha sbyin sman gyi sgregs pa byung ngo / /de nas rab tu khros pas lha sbyin gyis dug zos pas gnyis ka phung 0bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis smras pa/ de nyid mthong ba'i mkhas pa yis/ /sman lha'i bsod nams mi bslang zhing / /dug lta mi mthun dor mi bya/ /blang dang dor bas phung 0 bar 'gyur/ /blang dor dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste lnga pa'o—/ //sngon grong khyer ser skyar bram ze nyi ma sbyin zhes bya ba la/ rims nad sel bar nus pa'i/ nor bu chen po mu sa ra ga 0la nga zhes bya ba yod de/ khyim 26—1291

bdag de la khyem thab gnyis yod pa las/ gnyis ka la bu med par gyur nas/grong khyer bde ba can du khyim bdag mo sa marnya zhes bya ba dang / 'dod pa'i dus btab nas phyin pa dang / sngar gyi khyim bdag mo gnyis phyi bzhin du byung bar gyur to/ /de nas shing sdong po rul pa cig ①gi khong du gab bo/ /de nas khyim thab gnyis phyir log pa dang / khyim thab mo sa marnya dang sprad ②nas nyal ngo byas pa dang / khyim bdag gi mgo'i cod pan la gser gyi thur ma gnyis gyen du 'greng ba la/ mig yor gyi mi gnyis su 'khrul te bram ze la smras pa/ kye bzhin bzangs ②'o skol ni mi gnyis kyis nye ba nyid du non nas gda'o zhes pa dang / bram zes smras pa/ de ni nga'i khyim bdag mo gnyis lags te/ 'o skol gyi spyod lam rgyal po la smras na/ nges par chad pa gcod par gyur pas 7sa phyogs gzhan zhig tu bros la gshegs so zhes na/ na dpe'i tshal du phyin pa dang /thur ma yin par 0ngo shes te sa marnya rab tu 'khrul pa la 'alhod pas smras pa dang /khyim bdag mo sa marnyas gru blangs pa/ 'o skol mi yis skrag nas bros pa dang / /'khor ba dor bar 'dod na skrub pa 'dis/ /dang po gzhi stong pa nyid nas sdug bsngal byung ste/ gnyis med la gnyis su brtags pas gdungs par 'gyur—/ blang dor dang bral bar bya ba'i man ngag ste drug pa'o//④ //sngon mi yul ma ga dha na ⑦tshos ma ko'u ④ri ma zhes bya ba grong khyer gyi mtha'i spyil po cig na/ ngur smrig gi tshos blugs ⑫pa'i bur sdod cig gi nang du kha shing los bcad cede/ mo rang gi me tog thur phyin pa dang / dur khrod kyi wa cika gis tshos kyi steng du phyin pas sdib ste/ lus tshos kyi mdog gis sbangs so/ /26—1292

dur khrod du phyin pa dang / spyang ki dang phrad nas/ kye che zhe mchog tu gyur pa khyed su yin zhes pa la/ mo na re bdag ni lha'i ri dwags sha ra na zhes bya ba yin te/ lus dri dang mdog tu ldan pa'o/ /de nas dom dang stag dang spre'u dang / seng ge rnams la spyang kis ched du brjod pas ⑫kun kyang 'khor 0gyur to//de nas zla ba rgyas pa nya'i dus su ma'i drung du phyin te/ nga ni mchog go/ /bla na med pa'o/ /phul lo/ /ri dwags kyi rje mor gyur pa'o/ /zhes pa las/mas smras pa/ kye bu mo/ tshad ma'i ⑤chu las khrus byas nas/ /dman ④ pa'i sa la gnas na bde/ /rgyud ngan lhags ④pas nga rgyal ba/ /yun du 'grogs na phung ④ bar nges/ /zhes brjod pa la/ pags pa'i nga rgyal gtong ⑦du ma btub pa'o⑤/ /de nas log ste gcan gzan 43gyi tshogs su phyin pa dang /rang gis skad btang bas ⑫war gyur cing / seng ge'i skad btang bas ⑪brgyal lo—/ /de nas ri dwags gcan gzan thams cad kyi spu tshog pa re btogs te rtug pa dang bsres so/ /de nas lha'i bu rnams kyis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/sems kyis stobs kyis mi 'gro zhing / /pags pas nga rgyal 'gro byed pa/ /rgyun du bde bar ma gyur te/ /spu dang bra bas nyid phung / /bde bas 'bras du bsgrubs⑫pa la/ /zhe 'dod med pas mi 'gro zhing / /grub mtha' nga rgyal 'gro byed pa/ /wa bzhin thal bar brlag par 'gyur/ /rang gi lha ba nga rgyal ba dang bral bar bya ba ste bdun pa'o//⑫ //sngon ko sa la'i yul du/ dge slong ya shu ha zhes bya ba cig gis/tshogs drug 'gegs pa'i bsam gtan byas pa las rlung 'byung 'jug 'pho ba dang 26—1293

bral bas lo lnga brgya rnyed thub po/ /de nas 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dga' sbyangs mdangs kyis smras pa/ dge slong khyod ①kyis sems la ltos/ /shes rab pha rol phyin drug ma/ /tsam du mi gnas 'di sgoms la/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa thong / /zhes pa la don la slar skur pa ②btab nas sngar gyi 'du shes med pa la zhen pas/ lha tshe ring por skyes so/ / de nas ②mtha' 'khob rgyal por skyes so/ /de nas yang ④skye ba dran pas bstan pa la skur pa btab nas/sngar gyi 'du shes med pa la zhen pas/ lha tshe ring por skyes so/ /de nas yang skye ba dran pas bstan pa la skur ⑤pa btab pa dang / dngos su sas thongs bye nas—/ mnar med pa'i dmyal bar song / de dag ni sgom pa dmigs pa dang bral bar bya ba ste brgyad pa'o//④ //sngon bram ze 'dzin na ⑦pa zhes bya ba bsil khang na nyal ba'i mi lam na/rigs kyi bu gtsang ma'i spyod pa long cig /②las byang chub mchog tu bskyed du nas—/ shes rab dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa lnga ni mchog ma yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i ming tsam yang mi thob po/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos thams cad ni brjod du med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes brjod ⑫kyang mngon pa'i zhen pa dang ma bral lo/ /de bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs nas / srid pa'i rtse mo'i bde ba thob ste/ blar ngan song du lhung ngo / /spyod pa'i zhen pa dang bral bar bya ba ste dgu pa'o//⑪ //sngon rgyal po bzang skyong bya ba'i bu mos/ dge slong ma skye dgu'i bdag mo 26—1294

zhes bya ba la/ lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod kyi sgo nas/ lo drug tu bsnyen bkur byas so/ /tshogs kyi lam rtags bcu gsum dang ldan pa'i spyod pa bcu phrag gnyis su byas so/ /dus ji snyed du thos pa yang de snyed du sbyangs pa las/dge slong ma dpal mo zhes bya bas smras pa/ kye bdag gis 'khor ba thams cad kyi snying po/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i de kho na nyid khyod la sbyin gyi/ khyod 'khor ba'i dogs pa las yongs su grol bar 'gyur ro nyuzhes pa dang / du mos smras pa/ kye dge slong ma snga ma'i dga' ba de rnams kyi 'bras bu mchog go/ /de las mchog tu gyur pa'i 'bras du ni mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ kho mo mi 'dod do rmes pa dang / dpal mos smras pa/ chos kyi gsung nyid mi shes par/ / 'bras bu 'dod pa'i dka' thub dag /rgyal po dag ②gi pho nya bzhin/ /dka' bas mang yang don chung 'gyur/ /dka' bas mang po byas pas ②chog par 'dzin par ④bya ba ste bcu pa'o//ku //dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud las/ dpal mchog dang po dbang las 'byung / /lus ngag yid kyi tha ba dag /dbang gis rab tu smin byas na/ /dpal mchog dang po thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la rgyal po ko sa las mthong das / rgyal po in+d+ra ku ti 0 la/ dbang lan bcu bdun du byas so/ /de nas rgyal po in+d+ra skru ti⑦/ kye rgyal po dam pa ni sa bon lha bu'o/ /rgyun du goms pa ni chu lud kyis myu gu skyed pa lta bu'o/ /spyod pa ni lo tog 'os su rung bar byed palta bu'o/ /des na rgyal po chen po sgom pa goms par bya bar rigs so zhes brjod kyang / sngar gyi lung gis nges par kha lo sgyur du ma btub po/ /der 26—1296
