mkha' 'gro mas tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ dbang gis ye shes mchod byas shing / /'os su rung bar byar 'dod kyang / /goms bra chu shing 'bras bu ltar—/ /lan cig skyed da zad 'gyur nyid/ /zhes pa'i phyir na goms par bya'o—/ /dbang kho nas chog par 'dzin pa dang bral bar bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o— ② //dpal ḍi ji ④ho ru ka'i slob ma shrī sing nga ②zhes bya ba zhig gis/ mkha' 'gro ma dang / rnal 'byor pa pho mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshogs pa'i dus su smras pa/chos rnams stong par rtogs ④pa yis/ /de yi mtha' la sgom du med/ /gal te sgom na dman 'gyur te/ /dper na rgyal po rgyal por ni/ /slar yang 'dod pa med pa bzhin/ /dudha thams cad stong pa ④nyid du gcig par rtogs nas sgom mi dgos/ sgom sogs sbyin sreg thal ba 'dra/ /zhes pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis/ kye burtse'i gsang ba ⑦yongs su 'phrogs par byed pa'i log sred can khrod nyon cig /tshes gcig gi zla ba mthong bas/ nya gang ba yin nam byis pa btsas thog ④nas stobs rdzogs pa nyid dam/ sa bon btab pa nyid nas 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa nyid dam/ rgya mtsho nang gi nor bu mthong bas lag tu yong ba ⑨nyid dam/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis sems can gyi don nus pa nyid dam/ zas mthong ba tsam gyis bkres pa sos ⑫pa nyid dam/ ma rig sgyu rmepa'i phyir/ rtogs pa'i gtso bo la gags goms pa'i 'khor gyis mnyes par bya na/ zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /rtogs pas chog par 'dzin pa ni srun pa'o/ /phyi rol pa'o/ /bdud kyis mngon sum du 26—1296

byin gyis brlabs ①pa'o/ /rang nyid phung ༅bar byas pa'o/ /zhes nas bsad de mkha' 'gro ma'i longs spyod du byas so/ /rtogs pas chog par 'dzin pa dang bral bar bya ba ste ⑤bcu gnyis pa'o//④ //rgyal po dharma ⑫pā la'i bu mo gaṅgā mo zhes 'u bya ba zhig gis/ de bzhin kashegs pa'i mdo rgyud thams cad bltas pa las/ rtogs pa ji lta ba skyes te bsgoms so/ /de nas byang chub chen po la srin pos ⑫mchod pa'i nub mo/kal 'byor pa thams cad tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed pa'i sar gaṅgās phyin pa dang /nol 'byor pa thams cad mkha' 'gro mas byin gyis brlabs nas/ lus 'degs so/ /ngag gis spro ba byas so/ /yid kyis kun du zhe sdang bar byas so/ /de nas gaṅgā mo'i sngar kyi rtogs pa med par gyur nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la smras pa/ kye bdag gis 'os su ma rung ba ci byas pa/ khyed kyis bshad du gsol zhes pa dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis gsung mgrin sacig tu spus pa/ bla ma las ni dngos grub rnyed/ /rig ma las ni bde ba 'byung / /bla ma bral ba'i dngos grub ni/ /khri phrag 'bad kyang thob mi 'gyur| /gzhan gyis dngos grub 'byung byed pa/ /dug dang bcas pa'i zas bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro kun gyis ④'tshe ba dang / /bar chad sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya bas dad par byas so/ /bla ma la ma ltos 1pa spang bar bya ba ste bcu gsum pa'o// ⑩ //ka rna'i rgyal po'i bu kṛsna ⑪zhes bya bas/ dbu ma mchog tu byas te/ bka' 26—1297

dang bstan bcos thams cad la tsaskur pa btab pa dang / byang phyogs kyi gnod byin — gyis bzung nas/ sbyo bar gyur te/ de nas yab rgyal pos sngags mkhan rnams la zhu ba byas te/ bgegs bskrad pa'i sbyor ba byas pa dang / dpal na ro pa'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas dgongs pa dpag bsam shing lta bu'i gsung das la—/ /sems can blo'i —theg pa sna tshogs byas/ /phyogs med phyogs su 'dzinapa'i bdud chen gyis/ /'di dang ma 'ongs gnyis kar slu 'ubar 'gyur/'gro ba'i blo la thams cad bden pa nyid/ /don dam yul du gang yang yod ma yin / /de nyid rnal 'byor sems su dbyer mi byed/ /bka' la skur pa 'debs pa dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /de'i phyir bka' mtha' dag la skur pa mi bya ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o//rngo //rgyal po thang bzangs bgru zhes bya ba zhig /dpal kaspa la la dbang blang ste su na ༅gyi dur khrod na/ bde ba bsgom zhing 'dug pa las/ dur khrod kyi yi dwags thams cad kyis/ bar du gcod cing sems rab tu g.yengs 0so/ /de rnal 'byor ma legs dzin ka ra la zhus pa dang / des smras pa/ las kyi phyag rgya bde ba'i gru/ /stong pa'i skam sa rnyed nas ci byar yod/ /bcos ma'i bde la bcos ma'i yid zhen na/ /'khor ba'i mtsho chen rgal bar nus ma yin/ /zhes pa/ lha lcam la rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyis ched du brjod pa ⑫byas so/ /bde ba la zhen pa spang bar bya ba ste bco lnga pa'o//⑪ //gdol pa dza zhes bya ba zhig gis/ slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pa la brten 26—1298

te / don dam sems la dmigs pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa phyogs gcig pa bsgoms ②pa las/ chos thams cad brten med du zhen par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yul dzā lan dha ⑫rar/ rims nad kyis mi phal cher che'i dus byas so/ /lo tog thams cad ser bas bcom mo④/ /lo lngar char ma bab nas/ bram ze gsang tshig mkhan la dris pa dang / sa phyogs 'di ni mi nang pa sangs rgyas pa chosanas nas/ phyi rol gyi grub mtha' gsang bar smra ba la phyogs te gnas pas/bkra mi shis pa sna tshogs byung ste/ 'jig rten 'di la gzhan phung zhing / /ma 'ongs pa la rang phung bar byed do zhes pa dang / dpal ku ku ri pas thos te/gdol pa dza'i drung du byon nas smras pa/ dang po dngos po'i chos rnams ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis bablog par bya/ /stong pa nyid la zhen ches nas/ /dngos 'dzin pas kyang phung ⑤bar gyur/ /dug sprul shi na dar ya kan/ /dug la sngags btab sman gyi mchog /gang la rgyas btab bde 'gyur phyir/ /zhen pa thong ⑨ la gnyis med sgoms / /zhen nas dbang gsum pa mdzad do/ /de ltar slob dpon klu spub kyis 'das pa'i dpe bcu brjod pas/ mdo rgyud dang mthun pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas su ④rig par bya'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dpe drug brjod pas grub pa thob pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen par rig par bya'o/ /rkyen ⑨bcu drug dang bral ba'i shes pa ni/sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ nor bu rin po che dang 'dra'o/ /slob dpon klu sgrub snying po'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa byed dang lnga zhes bya ba ⑩rdzogs so// //dpal gyi ri la mnga' bdag chen pos/ rje btsun ri khrod kyis gnang 26—1299

1296 ༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉11 0〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉7ste/ rmi〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉gi ri si / ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉rimags/'u〈〈pe〉྾'dir 〉〉wapa/ 'u〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉rin/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staba'i/ du〈〈pe 〉stanas pa btsas ma thogabyeX/dri ༷/rdo/rdo sna /sa tsas ma thogs/ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉thangs pa/ 7〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉stanasos/ 1 〉〈〈pe 〉〉1297 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉brlab/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toragung / 1〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabs te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉12⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dharmā/ ni〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nga sa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po'i/ ci 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bstos/ ⑩〈〈spre 〉྾〈snar 〉〉13 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stond sna/1298 ①〈〈pe〉྾po ra 〉mi la/ sno〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉me na/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉ton/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉blo yis/3〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉baspu/ 'u〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉14 ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabazang / da 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sungs te/sku rgyan/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanangs/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉par/ rtso〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉151299 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾sha ra 〉〉pajo/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bcams so/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar〉〉khyil/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngarasung / zhu 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabathong / ( sna〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wasu—/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉〉skyon/ tshun〈〈bai 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 /de'i 'grel pa/13 〉〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rna/bsdukā 'bra~X ༵shā) mig26wa 1301

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ni ra ji ḍa kalpa pra ka ra ṇa/ bod skad du/rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang dang gang brtags pa/ /yongs su brtags pa 'di nyid dag /rang bzhin yod min pa kho na/ /slob dpon klu sgrub zhal snga yi/ /lam las phyi rol song gyur cing / /legs par mngon pa'i thabs med pa'i/ /kun rdzob de nyid bden pa las/ /nyams pas thar pa'i dngos grub ni/ /yod pa ma yin de dag nyams/ /gang zhig las las byung ba yi/ /rnam par rtoka pa gang ci'ang rung / /de dag spangs pa'i rang bzhin las/ /mya ngan 'das pa gzhan na ni/ /yod min yul ni gang du yang / /rnam par mi sems bdag nyid do/ /gang yang dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis / /sems la bde ba 'byung gyur cing / /nyams su myong ba'i sar phyin pa//26—1302

de yang kun du rtog pa tsam/ /gang de 'dod chakas bral ba yi/ /rang gi ngo bo de dag dang / /gnyis po gang yin ba de ni/ /srid pa'i rgyu yi mchog yin no/ /dngos po dngos po las mi skye /dngos po dngos med las kyang min/ /dngos ngo skye ba rtag tu spangs②/ /dngos 'khrul nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos rnams kun/ /skye ba mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid/ /rkyen ni mkhra' dang mnyam kun nges/ /srid par gyur pa bden pa yin/ /rgyu med 'bras bu med gyur cing / /las kyi rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /'jig rten pa med 'jig rten med/ /mi brtan ④ par gyur chos 'di kun/ /ma skyes pas ni dngos po gang / /ji ltar gzhan las shes par gyur/ /mo gsham du yi bzhin ②yang ni/ /de ltar shes par mi nus so/ /'jig rten gzod nas ma skyes te/ /sang gis kyang ni sprul pa med/ /don med 'khrul pa'i 'jig rten 'di/ /dri za'i grong khyer ji bzhin no/ /dam rtog las gang 'jig rten 'byung / /rnam rtog sems las byung ba ste/ /gang phyir lus las sems byung bas/ /de phyir lus la rnam par brtag /gzugs stong tshor ba rang bzhin med/ /'du shes med cing 'du byed kyis⑤/ /dngos po yod pa ma yin te/ /rang rig gsal ba'i bdag nyid do/ /de la shes dang shes bya med/ /sems dang sems las byung ba med/ /'byung ba kyi med de de yi phyir/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin no/ /de ni sems min lus kyang min/ /khams rnams ma yin chos kyang min/ /gnyis su med pa'i lam mchog 'di/ /de nyid rig pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /dmigs pa med pa'i chos 'di kun/ /dmigs pa med las rab tu grol/ /dmigs med blo yi ngang byas na/ /dmigs pa med par 'gyur ba yin/ /26—1303

rnam par mi rtog pa'i rab tu byed pa slob dpon chen po ār+ya de wa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ma hā kā ru ṇa dang / bod kyi lo tsā ①ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //brtsar mchan/1 2 /mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing/ 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉ga /rnam par mi rtog pa rab tu byed pa ār+ya de bas mdzad pa bzhugs/ ③〈〈pe 〉mas/13 3 )〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉lhung / du 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉thaden/ 7〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉sngag/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉thazod/༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ ༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉91/13 4 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈0mir 〉〉sots+tsha/ba kā 'bra~X /shi) mig26—1304

༄ /rgya gar skad du/ do ha ko ṣa tsā ma/ bod skad du/ do ha mdzod ces bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ srid dang zhi ba phyag rgya chen po ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis mkha' ltar rnam par dag /mtshon bya'i gnas lugs med pas tha snyad tshig lam chad/ /rang bzhin spros med ngo bo ltos chos kun dang zal/ /brtag dang dpyad du med cing mtshon pa'i dpe dang bral/ /dpe bral nyid la'ang mi gnas blo yi yul las 'das/ /rtag min chad min 'khor dang skya ngan 'das pa min/ /snang min stong min dngos dang dngo med skye med min/ /chos nyid gnyug ma ma yin blo las 'das pa'ang min/ /min pa'ang min zhing yin min blo yis brjod med phyir/ /gnyis chos gang dang 'brel med gzod nas mnyam pa nyid/ /ngo bo nges tshig byed pa'i las rnams 26—1306

bshad pa yang / /ri bong rwa brdzun de yi no rtul brdzun dang mtshungs/ /chos rnams thams cad mtshan nyid de dang khyad par med/ /ji ltar snang zhing srid pa'i kun rdzob chos can rnams/ /ngo bo nyid med ming tsam sgra tsam btags pa tsam—/ /ming dang don la khyad par bye brag cung zad med/ /gdod nas lhan cig skyes pas gzhan nas btsal du med/ /sems nyid ming stong spros bral phyag rgya chen po ste/ /nam mkha' tsurang bzhin gdod nas ming stong yin dang mtshungs//ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes mtshan ma'i spros dang bral/ /mkha' lhar kun la khyab cing 'pho dang 'gyur ba med/ /dus rnams kun du stong zhing ye nas bdag med de/ /dran rtog mtshan ma med de smig rgyu'i chu bo ltar/ /ma bcing 1 ma grol gnyug ma'i ngang las ma g.yos so/ /sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i sprul pa la/ /sprul pa'i ngo bo ye nas skye med chos kyi dbyings/ /bde sdug la sogs gnyis snang mtshan ma thams cad kyang / /chos nyid gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa'o/ /rol pa nyid la bden med mi brtan 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /gnas lugs stong pa'i rgya las nam yang ma 'das so/ /kha cig dbang bskur ba yis yongs su gdung bar byed/ /kha cig hūṃ phaṭa zer zhing phreng ba yongs su bgrang / /kha cig bshang gci khrag dang khu ba sha rnams za/ /kha cig rtsa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom ste yongs su 'khrul/ /e ma ho/ bla ma dam pas zin pas cig shos 'di ltar rtogs/ /gang yang 'khrul pa yin phyir yang dag rtogs pa med/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed med pas phyogs ris mtha' dang bral/ /bral dang ma bral med pas mnyam nyid gnyug ma'i ngang / /'di ltar rtogs na 'unges par gzhan du dri sa med/ /sna tshogs chos skur gsal bas spong len sems mi 'byung / /26—1306

bsgom dang mi bsgom med cing mtshan mas gos pa med/ /snang dang mi snang yul la nam yang brten mi byed/ /bya dang byed pa'i sems med dmigs pa kun dang bral— /re dang dog rkyapa'i sems med kun la zhen pa log /bla mas bstan pas gnyug ma'i gnas lugs rtogs gyur na/ /dran rig sna tshogs chos kyi dbyings su rang rlag ste/ /rnam shes yul la mi gnas chags zhen kun bral bas / /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du chos kun grol bar 'gyur/ /kun la ma chags nga rgyal la sogs dri ma bral/ /gus par ldan zhing dam pas yongs su zin pa dang / /gang yang yid byed bral na dri med the tshom med/ /shes dang shes bya dag pas chos nyid mngon sum 'char/ /gnyug ma phyag rgya chen po rtogs par ma gyur na/ /rtag tu gnyis 'dzin dbang gis kun la zhen gyur pas/ /bsam rig rab rib sna tshogs rgyun du skye 'gyur zhing / /ma nor don la mi gnas srid par 'khor zhing 'khyam/ /snyan grags bsnyen bkur kun la chags zhing zhen pa dang / /thos bsam go rtogs che dang nyams myong bzang po dang / / dngos grub byin rlabs ②nus pa'i rtags byung bcos ma'i pa lam/ /don gyis 5dri ma yin phyir mkhas pas yid mi gtad/ /de nyid yid la byed cing gnyis mtha'i phyogs lhung na/ /'khor bar 'khor zhing srid pa'i rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ /kun gyi gzhi rtsa yid kyi ri bo gang yin ltos/ /bltas pas ma mthong yid dang bral na nges par grol/ /sems kyis ④ chos kyi dbyings la 'di zhes med pas na/ /de la sgom dang bsgom par bya ba gnyis su med/ /yod med cir yang mi rtog ma yengs ngang la zhog⑦ /stong pa nyid dang skye med blo las 'das pa dang / /mtha' bral la sogs gang yang yid la byed pa na/ /gnas lugs don la mi 26—1307

gnas shin tu yengs pa'o/ /stong dang mi stong rtsis med lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /gzhag dang mi gzhag med par rang dga' yan par thong / /btang dang bzung ba'i sems med ro langs ji bzhin gyis/ /de nyid gnas lugs rig nas de yi ngang gnas na/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma'i bag chags myur du 'jig par 'gyur/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la mi gnas mtshan mas g.yengs gyur na/ /gnyis snang mtshan ma'i bag chags ldog par mi 'gyur te/ /rab rib can gyi mig gi nang du shes gyur kyang / /mig gi nad ma byang bar rab rib snang mi ldog /gnas lugs yid la byed cing nyams la rjezhen pa dang / /de nyid don la goms 0 shing bsgoms na gol ba'i rgyu/ /mthun 'jug rnams la chags sdang skye phyir 'ching ba'o//mi mthun rkyen ngan thams cad dngos grub dam pa ste/ /mi mthun rkyen gyis rnal 'byor nyams kyi gsal 'debs phyir/ /rkyen ngan mi spang de nyid shes pas de 'a sbyang / /de ltar skyong zhing nyams rtogs mthar 'byin spyod pa ste/ /gyi ②ling drag la lcag gis bskul ba ji bzhin no/ /gal te rtogs ldan nyams bzang spyod pa'i grogs med na/ /ji ltar mi ldan skyes bu dag ni rkang pa med dang mtshungs/ /don dam rnal ma chags med don la spyad bya ste/ /mi spang mi spub mi zhen mi spyod mi 'gog par/ /rang lus ༄ —ci bder spyod pa rab mchog dam pa'o/ /kun rdzob sangs rgyas mi ro'i gdeng chen ldan gyur kyang / /sems can tshogs chen mi spang ci nus 'bad par bya/ /'khor ba dag la dog 0pa'i sems med 'jigs bral yang / /sdig pa'i las rnams phra mo dag nas 'dzem par bya/ /chos rnams stong pa mkha' ltar rtsa bral rtogs gyur kyang / /chags sdang 'dzin chags mtha' dag rtsad nas spang bar bya/ /chos nyid mtha' bral zang thal chen po'i 26—1308

don rtogs kyang / /brtan pa ma thob bar du nyams rtogs gzhan la gsang / /don dam bdag gzhan gnyis su med pa 4rtogs gyur kyang / /kun rdzob 'gro la phan pa'i don chen dag la bsam/ /'dren pa gzhan la mi ltos gdeng ( dang ldan gyur kyang / /bka' drin can gyi bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur/ /chags shing zhen par bcas pas kun la dgag sgrub byed/ /rgyud kyidang mi 'tsham 'gal ba'i spyod pa gol ba'o/ /mthong bya mthong byed med pas tha dad rang sar grol — /nyams su myong mkhan stor bas rtsol sgrub kun dang bral/ /thob bya'i 'bras bu stor bas re dog 4 kun las grol/ /nga bdag rtsad nas thon pas bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal/ /dngos 'dzin rang sar zhig pas 'khor 'das kun la grol/ /rig pa gzhi cho 3la dag pas rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes brjod/ /chos blo zad sar zad pas mya ngan 'das zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ /ma bcos ma bsgyur spangs thob kun las yongs su grol/ /e ma ho/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya zab mo'i sgra chen de/ /gdags gzhi gang yin stong pa zhes bya'ang btags pa tsam—/ /skad cig ngo bos stong par bdag med su yis rtogs/ /rtog mkhan nyid med ming tsam sgra tsam bye btags pa tsam/ /de nyid yang dag ma yin gdul bya'i snang ba'o/ /gdul bya nyid la'ang bdag med sgyu ma sprul pa 'dra/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes bya byis pa'i blos brtags zaso/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul zhes bya ming tsam btags pa tsam/ /'khrul par tshor zhing rig pa'i skyes bu su zhig yin//'bras du myang 'das rdul tsam med cing mi dmigs na/ /grol dang ma grol zhes bya glo bur sgro btags te/ /nam mkha' zhi zhing dag la med pa grol lam ci/ /kun rdzob don dam zhes bya'ang nan gyis btags pa ste/ /chos kyi dbyings la 26—1309
bsdur 'azas re'u mig da/ (1115)

༄ /rgya gar skad du/ do ha ko ṣa/ bod skad du/ do ha mdzod/dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dbang po rnams/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ma lus de las byung zhing de ru thim/ /lhan skyes dngos dang dngos med gtam mi 'dri/ /stong pa snying rje de ru ro mnyam 'dod/ /yid la ma byed gnyug ma'i rang bzhin la/ /brdzun pa rnams kyis skur pa ma 'debs shig /rang dbang yod pas rang nyid 'ching ma byed/ /sems la mya ngan 'das pa rgyob kyil sod/ /khams gsum stong pa gos pa med la 'jug /sems ni mkha' 'dra mnyam pa'i bde bar zhugs//dbang po yul dmas skad cig tsam ni der mi mthong / /thog ma spangs shing 'di ru tha ma spangs/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs kyis gnyis med bstan/ /sems ni gang du zhi gyur pa/ /der ni rlung yang thim par 'gyur/ /rang rig pa yi de 26—1312

nyid 'bras bu ni/ /su zhig la ni gang gis ji ltar bstan/ /rmongs pa'i 'jig rten 'gro ba rnams kyis spyod yul min/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis de nyid bgrod bya min/ /gang la bla ma'i zhabs kyi ⑫mnyes pa yi/ /kye ho gang zag de yi spyod yul yin⑤/ /rang rig de nyid 'bras bur ni/ /te lo pa yis de skad bstan pa yin1 /yid kyi spyod yul du ni gang gyur pa/ /de ni don dam nyid ni 1ma yin no/ /de nyid bla ma'i gsung gis bstan par bya ba min/ /des na slob mas go ba ma ④yin no/ /lhan skyes 'bras bu bdud rtsi'i ro/ /de nyid su zhig la ni ci zhig bstan/ /gang du yid ni zhi ba dang / /yid dang rlung gnyis mnyam par zhu/ /der ni rnam kun spangs pa la/ /khams gsum de ru gnas pa yin/ /rmongs pa gnyug ma'i rang bzhin shes par gyis/ /de tshe gti mug dra ba ma lus chad par 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sems ni legs par sbyongs//tshe 'dir dngos grub thar pa lus 'dis rnyed/ /gang du sems ni 'gro ba der/ /der ni sems med par ni ltos/ /dbye ba med par ro mnyam gnas par kyis/ /sems dang sems med de ni legs par tshol/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub legs par gsal por rnyed/ /sems ni gang du zhi gyur pa/ /khams gsum po ni de ru thim/ /rang gzhan mnyam pas sangs rgyas rje btsun 'gyur/ /sems ni nam mkha'i ngang du zhugs nas thim/ /de yi tshe na dbang po lnga dang yul rnams dang / /phung po khams rnams ⑤nang du zhugs nas song / /gang zhig brtan dang g.yo ba'i rnam pa kun/ /stong pa gos pa med pa ste/ /'di la dpyad par mi bya'o/ /'di ni bdag go 'di ni 'gro ba'o/ /gang zhig dbye ba yongs shes pa/ /dri med sems kyi rang bzhin la/ /gang zhig rang rig shes 26—1313

par bya/ /bdag nyid 'gro ba bdag nyid sangs rgyas te/ /bdag nyid dri ma med cing bdag nyid yid la mi byed pa/ /de la 'gro ba med cing gos pa med/ /yid ni rje btsun nam mkha' rje btsun ma/ /nyin mtshan du ni gar byed lhan cig skyes la rol/ /skye dang 'chi ba dag las grol bar 'gyur/ /gnyug ma'i yid la rgyun du gnas par gyis/ /'bab stegs dka' thub nags la ma brten cig /khrus dang gtsang sbras bde ba mi rnyed do/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug lha/ /byang chub rang la sheyod bzhin gsum la bkur mi bya/ /lha rnams ma mchod 'bab stegs ma 'gro zhig /lha rnams mchod kyang thar pa thob mi 'gyur/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis sangs rgyas mchod par gyis/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das la gnas par ma byed cig /shes rab thabs kyi ting 'dzin zhugs/ /gang tshe g.yo bar 'ubartan par byed nus na/ /de yi tshe na nyams myong 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar dug ni zos par gyur pa las/ /dug gis kyang ni 'chi bar mi 'grur ba/ /de ltar srid pa zos kyang rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod yon gyis ni 'ching bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kye ho rnal 'byor pas ni las la skur ma — 'debs—/ /skad cig bzhi dang dga' ba bzhi ru de ru song / /skad cig dga' ba de yi bye brag shes par gyis/ /mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid spangs pa shes par gyis/ /kye ho mchog dang dga' bral 'di ni dpyad par bya/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs la gus par gyis la legs par long / /gang zhig dga' ba mchog dang dga' bral gyi — 3/ /kye ho skad cig der ni lhan skyes rtogs par bya/ /yon tan rin chen dpral ba'i klad rgyas gzhag bya ste/ /'dod pa mo'i ze'u 'bru las ni 'di nyid shes par bya/ /skad cig bye brag de ru lhan skyes gang shes pa/ /26—1314

de ni tshe 'di nyid la rnal 'byor par brjod do/ /thog ma tha ma gzung ba 'dzin pa spangs/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs kyis gnyis med bstan/ /mi g.yo dri med rnam par rtog pa med/ /shar ba nub pa spangs pa 'di ni snying po yin/ /'di ni mya ngan 'das par rab tu brngod/ /yid kyi nga rgyal gang du chad gyur pa/ /skyon dang yon tan spangs pa 'di ni don dam mo/ /rang rig la ni gang yang med//sems dang sems med rtag tu sgongs/ /kye ho lhan cig skyes ༅pa'i rang bzhin du ni gnas par bya/ /skye ba med cing 'chi ba med/ /rtsa ba med cing rtse mo med//'ong ba med cing 'gro ba med/ /gang du yang ni mi gnas so/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis ni snying la chud/ /kha dog spangs shing rig — —med pa/ /snang ba thams cad de la rdzogs/ /yid ni sod ②la sems ni rtsa ba med par gyis/ /sems kyi lhag ma zug rngu thong / /'di ru sku bzhi phyag rgya bzhi/ /khams gsum ma lus de tshe dag /bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum stong / /dri ma med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa la/ /dge dang mi dge gang yang med/ /yid ni gang du 'gro 'dod pa/ /de la 'khrul par mi bya'o/ /mig ni mi 'dzum pa dag gi / /bsam gtan gyis ni gnas par bya/ /slob dpon chen po te lo pas mdzad pa do ha mdzod ces bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar lho phyogs ko sa 'ular sku 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po mkhas pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje'i zhal snga nas rang 'gyur du gsungs pa'o / / //26—1315

bldur mchan/1212 snamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ze /do ha mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// ri 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sa ba/1 12 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stani/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉rkun/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi nyid ni/ ④〈〈be 〉྾05ra 〉lta/1314 ༷༷༷/ /༷/mi/ ༷rngo/rang la/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉༅ g.yo bar ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉༅/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉1315 ༷/kā /༷/trī/ra 〉〉waskyes/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rigs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nasod/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉'dzums pa dag gis/ tshos〈〈bai 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sna/bsdu/da 'bra~X ༵sta) mig26wa 1316

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ palca gā shā tsā ma/ bod skad du/ tshigs spu bcad pa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chu zad pas ni 'dam gyi pad+ma skams/ /sprang rtsi bros pas gar song cha yang med/ /rtsa ba lo ma sdong po me yi sbyor bas zad/ /nag po na re dbang po'i bzhad gad ༅la ni ltos/ /za zhing 'thung dang gnas nas yal ga bcag nas song / /kye ho — 'di ni bdag gi las ni gtum mo lta bu yin/ /rgyun gyi du mo lta bus pad+ma bsregs—/ /yon tan brgya ni skyon gcig gis ni zad par byas/ /rgya mtsho zad pas pad+ma rnams kyang skams/ /de tshe sgo bcu las ni du ba byung / /'jig rten pa ni nag po med ces zer/ /nag po theg chen zab mo'i nags na gnas/ /sems ni stong zhing gnyug ma'i ngang du rdzogs/ /phung po bzhad 3gad gyur kyang 'gyod pa med/ /'o ma'i nang na mar yod pa ni mi mthong bzhin/ /'dod pa 26—1317

yod de 'jig rten pas ni ma mthong ngo / /'jig rten 'tsho ba 'am ni 'chi ba gang yang med/ /'di lta'i longs spyod nag po rnal 'byor pa/ /pad+ma bzhin du lus cha skams gyur kyang / /nag po ci yi phyir na shi zhes bya/ /brtul zhugs spyad pa'i slob dpon chen po nag pos mdzad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lnga pa rdzogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug shrī be+e ro tsa na badz+ras bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/1217 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho /tshigs su bcadapa lnga pa bzhugs/ py-i 7〈〈pe mi'i〈snar 〉tshog ②〈〈pe mi'i'ar 〉rad/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉ṅkaho/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanazhad/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1117)26wa 1318

brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa/1༄ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī bi rū pa pa dā tsa tur shī ti༄ / bod skad du/ dpal birlu pa'i tshig brkang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bla ma mchog gi zhabs la 'dud/ /gzhung 'di lhan cig skyes pas 'phros nas byung / /des ni rga shi rnams la bzhad gad byas / /sems ni mi g.yo brtan par rtse gcig bya/ /des na bsam bya bsam satan dkyil 'khor phyag rgya med/ /de rnams bsgoms pas rnam par dag mi 'gyur—/ /lta stangs 'ching kadang las rnams byed pa dang / /sgo rnams dgag par bya ba ma yin no/ /des ni lhan cig skyes pa'i lam mi shes/ /gang zhig srog dang rtsol ba gang ba can dang ni/ /bum pa can gyi rlung la bstod byed pa/ / gang gis lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du ni/ /gtum mo sbar ba bar byed cing dan tan gyis/ /sgo bcu la ni sgo lcags 'jug par byed/ /gang zhig spyi bor 26—1319

pad+ma dkar po bsgom/ /rmongs pa des ni dang po'i thar pa mi rnyed do/ /dri' can rkan dang sna rtser bsam byed dang / /steng dang 'og dang bsdoms nas shing btsugs dang / /mgren pa'i phugs su 'od zer 'bar byed dang / /dpra' bar zla ba rtag tu sgom byed dang 1/ /nam mkha'i rtse mor mi g.yo'i sna rtser bsgom//la la 'og tu pad+ma rdo rje lta/ /la la spu 3rgyan 'ching zhing 'degs par byed/ /la la tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi — sgom par byed/ /la la rang grib stong par byas nas chas la lha/ /la la dkyil 'khor til gyi 'bru tsam bsgom/ /la la bar snang sku gzugs sgom byed pa'i/ /byol song dmas ni rang nyid chos rnams shes par smra/ /de rnams kyis ni skye ba 'bras bu med/ /blo rnams zad cing sdig pa rnams la spyod/ /des ni lhan cig skyes pa'i cha 5yang ma mthong ngo / /de ni nam mkha' dang ni sa 'og dang / /sa steng —dang ni tshangs pa'i gnas su'ang med—/ /dman pa'i slob dpon bsten par ma byed cig /des ni sdig pa'i las rnams ma spangs par/ /kha ni 'gul zhing 'gul zhing re la gnas/ /rang gis stong pa snying rje byed par rtsom/ /des ni srid pa spong — thabs mi shes so/ /stong pa snying rje rtogs zhes zer zhing gnas/ /dpal ldan bde chen gtam yang mi 'dri'o/ /la la dbang phyug u ma re la gnas/ /bdag nyid srid pa'i 'ching ba'i zhags pas bcings/ /la la khu ba khrag dang rnam snang za/ /bya rog bya rgod bzhin du bdag nyid 'khol/ /la la gnas gsum skad cig gsum du bsgom/ /la la snying ga'i pad+ma 'khor lo 'chang / /la la hūṃ phaṭa zer zhing phreng ba bgrang / /byol song rnams ni 'khrul pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /dbang dang dbang bskur mang po gsungs pa rnams/ /bla ma rnams la slob mas len par 26—1320

byed / /de nas brtsams shing snaslob ma rnams la 'chad/ /dbang bskur gyi ni phyogs kyang ma mthong ngo / /la las gser 'gyur rtsi ni lta byed pas/ /des ni khyim pa rnams ni dbul por byas/ /lha rnams kyis kyang mi bde ba la sbyar/ /nags la skyes pa'i rtswa dang shing rnams dang / /shing lo me tog rnams kyis skyid ma bstan/ /dus su bsam gtan 'jig rten pa rnams byed/ /des ni mchog be+e thar pa mi shes so/ /cal col mang po smras pas ci zhig bya/ /ji ltar smras pa de dag thams cad brdzun/ /gdams ngag pa rnams gsal po'i gnas lugs nyon—/ /gang gis gsal por thar pa grol ba rnyed/ /sems ni g.yo zhing smyon pa lta bur thong — 7/ /skye dang gnas dang 'jig pa gsum po rtogs par gyis/ /mgul rgyan dang ni phyag rgya ma lus thong r+ṣa/ /des ni mgon po ji ltar mthong bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten pa ni yi ge rnams la gtod/ /yi ge med pa de ni snying la ma chud do/ /gdams ngag pa rnams nyon cig ngas ni bshad par bya/ /bams gsum bor nas dpal ldan theg pa che/ /dang po'i mgon po la ni dge dang mi dge med/ /ma lus khyab cing bde chen stong pa nyid/ /byed pa 'phrog pa rang nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /zad pa med cing gzhan du song ba med/ /de ni mchog gi dbang phyug dam pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyis ni ting 'dzin skyes byas kyang / /dang po'i mgon po de ni ma mthong ngo / /de lta'i sems ni snying la ma chud do/ /de la lus dang ngag dang yid med de/ /dpa' bo dri med de ni nam mkhar thim/ /birlu pa yis sems can don du byas/ /don dam 'di ni gdams ngag pa rnams nyon/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ji rū pas mdzad pa'i tshig rkang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa rdzogs so// //26—1321

yul lho phyogs ko sa kūlar sku 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī bai ro tsa na badz+ra'i zhal snga nas rang 'gyur du mdzad nas gsungs pa'o// //bsdur mchan/1319 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa /tshig rkang brgyadacu rtsa bzhi pa bca pas mdzad pa bzhugs/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gli tha ru pa tsa sku ra si/ ③〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉〉tshigs/ ④〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉pachings/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉migashes ni bdag nyid nges par spu bar byed/rgya〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉m+war/132 ①〈〈snar 〉mi/ du 7〈〈pe 〉tsho'adir 〉rabu/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉stanazhi/ ④〈〈pe 〉sta sa/ 〈'a ra 〉༅sa/(7〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉stabatshad/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉stu〈snar 〉thostengs/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snosgo/1321 /dro/ 〉〉〈snar 〉mi brtsams shing / ri tre②〈〈snar 〉sgothong / bya〈〈pe mi'i〈snar 〉rku/ ⑤〈〈pe〉'i〈snar 〉zi1322 ①〈〈pe 〉dzesha ra 〉〉sna/bsdur+sha 'bra~X ༵shā )mig26wa 1322

༄ / /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de/ /lam 'azas gsung mdo bri bar bya/ /sems can la nyon mongs pa'i snang ba la ma dag pa'i snang ba 7/rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku rgasung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba'o/ /kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud sogs la gdan sogs gsum pa bzhi yis rgyu'i dbang / lam du bskyed 1rim la sogs lnga pa bzhis bstan—/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig sogs bsrung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs kyi ④nyams chags bskang / 'dod yon sogs lnga yis mnyes pa sogs bya/lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'dag micing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras du'i rgyud ni/ 'azas bu'i dbang bzhis thams cad mkhyen to/ /tshad ma 26—1323

bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab nas/ 'gal 'dus skyon med sogs gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / zas spyod lam/ rlung thig le/ phyag rgya ma bsten / dngas ma lnga'i bde ba dang / dbang po lnga nyams dang ma bral bas bdud rtsi bsten/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dang / 'khor lo dmas dang 1/gzhan rnams dang / sa thog mtha' la re re/ gsum pa bcus bar gyi rtsa mdud dral bas la dor/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgoms pas lta ba'i dug dbyung / rnam shes lngas yul lnga ma spangs pas /bdud rtsi bstan1/ dag pa'i chos rnams gdod nas stong par shar bas la dor/gsang sngags snyan brgyud — la sogs bzhi ma chad pas/ lus khyad par can la brten nas dngos 5po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'aprel byang chub chen po'i lam/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lo rgyus kyis tshad ma'o/ /kun gzhi rnam shes dag pa'i byang chub chen po—/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lnga yis lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i nol 'byor pa'i lam gyi bar chad ni/ dad pa brtan pos srung ba'i 'khor lo/ sngags zlos/ sngags mdud/ chos rnams sems nyid snang ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'brel/ gzugs brnyan yin phyir/de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i don dang ma bral bas bsrung / shes rab la phyi'i bdud lam gnyis/ lta grub brgyad rgyur ༅ba'o/ /nang gi bdud lam la sogs bcu dang brda ma shes na 'od brda shes pas bsrung / grib dang sgrib pa thig le 'dzag pa bsrung / /tshogs lam nas tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid dang bral bas bral ba'i 'bras bu bzhi thabs — nas/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyis phyogs med rnams 26—1324

dang / rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs nas/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun ltar lam bgrod na/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ las kyi rlung pho mo/ ma ning gi rlung / thod rgol gyi ye shes kyi me 'bar bas/ khams 'dus pa dang po/ rgyun gyi rlung po lag ca can gyis rtsa dral/ sems gnas/ rta mi/ rtsa rlung gi zug 'byung /sna tshogs 'dud la sogs bzhi ①rtsa ba'i rlung la sogs zin pa'i bye brag bdun gyis yan lag gi rlung rim gyis ②nang du 'gag /de tsa na thig le mang du kha 'bu—/ rten mnyam du 'dre de la brten ②nas sems nang du gnas/ rnam shes lnga nang du 'dus/ phung po lnga dul/ ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed/ bsgom ༄ pa mi 'chor ba'i mthong snang mi lam nyams gsum gsum ni rnam rtog sngon du song ba ltar khams gsum kun du snang ngo / /sa chu la thim na smig rgyu/ chu me la thim na du ba/ me rlung la thim na srin du me khyer/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim na mar me 'bar ba/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim na nam mkha' sprin med lta bu/ sa chu me rlung dang rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na khams rgasum kun du me 'bar ba lta dur snang / chu rlung dang spu lus grang / rlung gi rlung 'du 'phro dang rang 'phur bya 'byung / 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang lha mo sna tshogs kyis gar mchod dang dri ro⑤/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang lha mo sna tshogs ⑥nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang spu lus bde/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bzhin gshegs sku sogs/ sih+la dang nyi ma/ ga pur dang zla ba/ rtsa bran rnams su thig phran dang skar ma/ rtsa 'dzin la sogs su shing sdong la sogs/chags sdang rnam pa lnga dang / nyam nga zu ngan 'dre'i rtsa/ mchi ma'i rtsar g.yal 26—1326

dang mchi ma/ lte bar dang po chags pa'i rigs drug gi yi ger rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na/ rigs drug gi gar sngags der khrid pa/ mi lam nyams lta bu khams gsum kun du snang ngo / /oṃ las bsam gtan sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin yum gyi mkha'/ a 3las yang dag par thim na khams gsum nam mkha' yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la sogs kyi pho brang du thim na chos sku nyams su myong zhing gzung ྾ 'dzin grol/ hūṃ las gsal zhing yang la rang 'byung gi ye shes nam mkha' shin du dri ma med/ khams 'dus pa bar pa rlung po lag ca bri bas rtsa dral/ thig le'i gzugs dang mthong snang brten no/mdor na rak+ṣa ②la sogs su srin po sogs dri 4 can gyi sgra lha'i mig rnam par das pa bzhin/ srid pa'i rtse mo man cad nying nge 'dzin kyi nyams su 'byung ba snyam byed pa/ bshad kyis mi lang ba mtshon cing lnga bcu la gsang / sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i phyi'i rten 'brel rlung log sogs gsum gsum ni/ nang gi mkha' 'gro ma lnga de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lnga/ byang chub chen po'i rten 'brel mdzad pas/dngos grub rnams rang la 'byung bar shes shing re zhing sprul ba'i blo sel to/ /bdud dang gol sa rnams rang gi lam dang rten 'asbol du shes pas skyon yon tan du bslang zhing rim pa yin min du skye ba'i dod byung rgyal du gtang / shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i lam la/ lha'i bu'i bdud 'ong bas ༅ sad pa bzhis bsrung / sgom pa mi 'tsher ba'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ni/ yul 'gags pas rang yi dam gyi lha dang / gug skyes kyi dgos pa bsam zhing ting nge 'dzin cha bsnyams pas/ khams 'dus pa tha ma rlung po lag ca dral 6bas rtsa bral —/ skye mched drug gi nang du thig le 'dus pas rjes su dran pa drug yang 26—1326

dag par shes/ sprul sku 'ga' mthong / sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i yang dag par spong ba bzhi ni/ sprul sku las dbang gsum gyi rjes las byung ba'i shes pa bsam 'ing / dgyes sogs bang can bcu gnyis ma'i rtsa btsal sna7zhing / snying po'i ma kun 'dar ⑤gyi sna rtser dal rgyu la sogs rig pa yid 'jug pas/ lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje skyil ༅krung bcas/ thig le rlung non pas rnga sgra la sogs mi thos pas/ chog shes pa sogs kyi bdud chosas pa'o/ /nang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam srid pa'i rtse mor phyin cing ma skyes pa'i chos la bzod dka' ba stong pa nyid kyi bzod pa'o/ /dadu mar sems rtog med log sems 'phos na bzod pa 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing / mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos noms rdzogs pas chos rnams kyi nang na mchog go/ /de ltar nyams skyon can skyon med dang / phyi dbyibs kyi a nas yar rlung sems mnyam par 'dus nas lam du 'byung ba rnams ngo bo rang mtshan nyid do / /( 3'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ phyi nang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i lam gyis sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ spyod pa'i rim pa'i lam nas shālus dag par byed pa bum pa'i dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rtsa rin po che'i pho brang bzhi—/ gtso bo gsum ste lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong bas rtog pa'i 'gro ldog byed / sprul sku'i zhing khams brgya bsgul zhing nyan 3/ sbyin brgya/ 'od brgya 'gyed/ mar brgya 'chad/ ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba brgya la snyoms par 'jug nus/ rigs drug gi rtsar khyad par du mi'i rten mthong nas dga' la g.yang za/ ngo tsha la sgyug bro/ sngon bla mas rgyu dus na bstan pa'i 'khor 26—1327

'das dbyer med de tsa na rtogasna /snying rje skye/ mchi ma lhang / gzhan gyi sems sna tshogs shes/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas dgod bro/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs skad cig mas 'byung ba rnams nang gi zhing khams mthong bas so//nang ma mthong ra phyi mi mthong / de tsa na ling ga rtan/ rdo rje rtser lhan cig skyes pa'i sar thig le gnas pa ltar/ lus bde bas myos shing brgyal/rang gzhan ngo mi shes/ nang rtags rlung sor gcig 'gags/ phyi rtags gsang gnas byed thig les brtan khyas dang po'o / /②yang sprul sku las dbang bzhi sgom lam sa gnyis pa nas sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams stong la sogs pa bsgul ba la sogs pa nus/ yon tan la sogs 'phel/ 'gro ldog la sogs 'gags/nang rtags rlung sor drug 'gags/ phyi rtags gsang gnas te— )/ snying thirga les brtan/ longs sku 'ga' mthong / sgom lam sa drug go / /⑦yang longs sku las dbang bzhi bzhi bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa'i lam nas/longs sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ ngag dag pa gsang ba'i dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags dbang po lnga dang dngas ma'i rlung lnga la mnga' brnyes/ nus pa lnga dang lta stangs rnams la thogs pa med/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du rigs drug gi sa bon mthong / sa bon drug la mnga' brnyes/sems can rnams kyi skad du chos ston cing chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la thogs pa med/ lte bar yi ge'i phyi mo brgyad/ ā li kā li mthong nas/ mdo sde'i chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la thogs pa med/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ro drug la longs spyod nus 7/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa rnams a ni yig 'bru ces pa drug gis gsal lo/ /sa bdun yan chad longs sku'i zhing khams 26——1328

'khor bzhi'i brgya dung phyur la sogs bsgul nyab la sogs pa nus/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu 'gags/ phyi rtags mgrin smin thig les brtan/ sgom lam sa bcu'o —/ / ④yang dbang bzhi bzhi/ sems dag la 1dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thabs kyi lam nas chos sku rang bzhin gyi 3lhun grub thob par byed pa/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags/ stobs lnga ni/byang chub kyi sems kyi rlung lnga bskyod pa'i dngas ma'i dngas ma/ rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas rtags bstan pa/ sku gsum ye shes lnga la sogs dbang thob nas/ bdud rtsi lnga gar 'du mthong nas sangs rgyas rnams rgazhan don mdzad pa mthong / sprul pa bde chen thig le 'du ba mthong na— /sangs rgyas rnams 'og min gyi gnas na zab mo la bzhugs pa mthong / lte ba sprul par bdud rtsi lnga dang rlung lnga 'dus pa mthong na/ longs sku'i rigs lnga yu ma gyi bha ga na bzhugs nas skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' la gsang ba sgrogs pa mthong / phyag rgya ma'i dngas ma'i dngas ma mthong na mngon shes la thogs pa med—/ rtsa yig rnams su dngas ma 'drongs na rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med/ de nyid slar spos na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu gnyis 'gags—/ phyi rtags byi gtsug hri la thig les brtan/ sa bcu gnyis so / /nga 3yang dbang bzhi bzhi mthar phyin gyi lam nas mthar thug rten 'brel mthar thug 'da' ba/ rdo rje'i dba' rlabs kyi lam gyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rig ma'i skyes bu/ srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin gyi ⑤lhun grub thob par byed pa/ bzhi pa lus ngag yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ni/26—1329

rnam shes brgyad 'dag kar 'bras bu gnyis thob 7ste/ sa chen dga' zhing rangs la mgu/ /de rnam pa drug tu g.yo/ bdud gnas su sgra grag /phyag rgya ma'i gnas su khams gsum mthong / mkha' 'gro ma rnams ring nas 'du/ /ha ri ma la sogs pa dbang phyug gi don brgyad 'char/ nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhū datīr 'jug /phyi rtags gtsug tor byed thig les brtan/ sa byed dang bcu gsum mo / / 1bzhi pa yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu'i phyogs gcig 'thob ste/ 'jigs byed gzhon nu'i grong khyer chos kyi dbyings/ /byang chub sems kyis ni 'bigs/ 'bras bu longs sku'i zhing khams rab bkram la sogs pa bsgul — ba la sokas pa nus/ sa bcu gsum thob kar sa bcu ma la sogs pa yid kyis bkug ste/ slob dpon dus gsum bde gshegs bcud 'dus yin/ yi dam lha dang bla ma dbyer med la/ /bha gar dngos grub len pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa rang bzhin gyi —lhun grub thob par byed pa/'bras bu mthar phyin de kho na nyid kyi rtags longs sku'i zhing khams ma lus pa la sogs pa bsgul ba la sogs pa nus/ nang rtags srog rtsol a wa d+ma tī'i 'gags—/ phyi rtags gtsug tor tri la thig les brtan/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyis sgom nyams kyis 1skyon yod med phyed pa sa bcu gsum pa'o / / kathams cad mkhyen tetsha/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin sar rten 'brel 'grig pa ltar snang / 'tshang rgya kar 'khor tshom bu cig dang bcas te 'tshang rgya'o/ /gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa ni/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i dbang / /rtogs pas brtags pas rtog med rtogs/ /ye shes snang ba de bzhin no//26— 330
bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1119)

ra / /rgya gar skad du/ a mṛ ta sirnyi rū la tsā ma/ bod skad du/bdud rtsi grub pa'i rtsa ba zhes bya ba/ dpal te ru ka la phyag 'tshang lo/ /spyan rgasum rab ldan dbu bcad sku mdog dmar/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs sel rnal 'byor pho mo yi/ /phyag rgya 'dzin cing jirlu ku ting 'dzin gyis/ /skyob mdzad phyag rgya'i zhabs la bdag 'dud do/ /4phyag rgya chen po dmas ④bshad bya/ /mi ni gang gis thos pa la/ /lha rnams kun gyis bkur ste mdzad/ /skye ba bye ba stong dag tu/ /legs las rgya chen rnams 'u3byas pas/ /de thob 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la④/ /pha rol tu ni rnal 'byor 'gro/ /g.yon pa'i rteng pas bshang lam dgag /g.yas pa cung zad brkyang byas la/ /mtheb ⑫chen bol gong lag pas gzung / /snying ga skog mas mnan pa ni/ /sgo dgu dgag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /de yi rtsa gsum dag la ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bsnun par bya/ /'di ni las kyi 26—1333

phyag rgya'o/ /rkang pa gcig pa 3sems bsdu zhing / /rlung rnams gcig tu bsdus bya ste/ /rlung gis — bsdam pa brtsam par bya/ /nyi zla gnyis ni gcig par bya/ /de ltar byas na rlung ni 'gag /'di ni dam tshig phyag rgya'o/ /bshang lam 'khor lo gyen du bzlog /thig le sgra bcas gyen du basbang / /rtsa rnams thams cad rab tu g.yo/ /mchog gi rtsa ni gyen du 'ong / /lus ngag yid gsum sbyor ba yis/ /sku gsum thugs ni bsgrub ②par bya/ /goms pa brtan par gyur pa yis/ /rang gi me ni gsal ba'o/ /phyag rgya 'di yis thams cad du/ /rnal 'byor pa ni nges par 'gro/ /'di ni kha sbyor sbyor ba ste/ /rtsa ba'i gdams par 'dod pa'o/ /'di ni rlung gi sbyor ba yin/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis 'di bsgrub po/ /phyag rgya gnyis su shes par bya/ /ji bzhin bsdam pa'i cho ga shes/ /dzo ni lha mo'i phyag rgya yin/ /liṅga'i phyag rgya lha yin no/ /pho dang mo yi sbyor ba las/ /phyi rol du ni skyes pa ④'byung / /ji bzhin sbyor ba 'di gnyis kyis/ /skye ba nang du gsang bar ༅ bya/ /rtsa ni bud med gzugs can te/ /skyes pa med na 'bras bu med/ /phyag rgya che dang bsdams pa che/ /dbye ba med na 'bras bu med/ /rlung ni 'khor lo gcig tu bsdu/ /ji srid bsdams pa bzhin du bya/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bshig pa 7par bya/ /rang gi rlung sems bshig par bya/ /sbyor ba'i rim pas bshig (par bya/ /rlung ni stobs dang ldan byas la/ /dbu ma'i sgo ru gzhug bya ste/ /'khor lo bzhi po rlung gis dbug /lag gnyis liṅga'i phyag rgya bca'/ /de ni sa la gzhag nas su/ /rkang pa'i rtse mo sa la gzugs/ /brla ni brdab par bya ba yis / /rlung gis rlung ni bshig par bya/ /rlung gis rlung la bteg par bya/ /26—1334

rlung gis rlung ni gsad nyapar bya/ /rlung gis yongs la khyab pa yis/ /rlung this dngos grub thams cad sbyin/ /rlung gis 'chi ba med par 'gyur/ /des ni bdud rtsi grub par ni/ /jirlu nga yis yang dag bshad/ /legs par bsdams pa lus kyi las/ /rdo rje rlung rtse bye ba yis/ /lhun po yi ni bar dag tu//dgug pa'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /tshangs sogs mdud pa bshig par bya/ /lhun po'i steng du lha rnams 'gro/ /lhun po dag ni g.yo 'gyur te/ /des ni thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams bsad/ /dang po yi ni sbyor ba yis/ /tshangs pa'i mdud pa bshig par bya/ /de nas dbang phyug mdud pa bshig /de bshig nas ni birgyu bshig /de nas gti nug la sogs spangs/ /gtsug tor sgo ni sbas pa la/ /rlung gis sgo ni rnam par dbye/ /de ni 'jigs pa chen po'o/ /bsdam pa che dang 'jigs pa che/ /phyag rgya che ni sasum pa yin/ /'di ni gsang dbang gsum yin no/ /'di dag gis na sbyor grub grags/ /de nyid gsum ni gang rig pas/ /de ni 'jig rten gsum rig go / /gang gis 'di la goms byas na/ /thams cad kyi 4ni mnga' bdag 'gyur / /gsang ba lha yi lha rnams dang / /mi yi bdag po'i bdag por 'gyur—/ /dbang bskur kun la dbang ba yin/ /thams cad ma lus lhag par 'gyur/ /des na lha rnams kun gyi dbang ④/ /chos kyi phyag rgyar 'dod pa'o / /phyag rgya che la goms par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di las thams cad 'byung / /grub pa chen po 'byung ba yin/ /phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa/ /rnam gnyis de ni dam pa dang / /'chi du ba las ni grol ba dang / /lus sems dag la bde ba 'byung / /sems la gnas pa tsam gyis kyang / /mngal du skye bar mi 'gyur ro//26—1336

dang po'i ming ni yi ge yin/ /sbyor ba ldan pa bshad par bya/ /dad dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba yin/ /rnal 'byor pa ni nges par ni/ /phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa/ yin / /phyag rgya chen po bshad par bya/ /rkang pa lag pa bsdam bya ste/ /rlung ni lan gsum 'thungs byas la/ /rtsa rnams thams cad 'then par bya/ /langs pas rtsa rnams gyen du phyogs/ /nad rnams thams cad bcom nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i don yang rdzogs/ /ji ltar nam mkha' bar snang la/ /sprin tshogs 'bar ba 'khrigs pa de/ /rlung gi shugs kyis gtor ba ltar/ /de ltar lus 'di dag la ni/ /nad kyis yongs su bsgos gyur kyang / /thabs kyi rlung gis gzhom par bya/ /'di ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /dz+wa ye dha yi karma yi/ /lag pas 'byung ba lnga dag kyang / /las kyi bya bas mnye bya zhing / /bsdams pa chen pos gnas pa yi/ /stobs kyi ⑫'khor lo 'di yis ni/ /steng du lha yi 'jig rten skrag /lag pa brkyang bskum 'di yis ni/ /phyogs bzhi dag kyang g.yo bar byed/ /rkang pa 'og tu brkyang ba yis/ /klu rnams thams cad skrag par byed/ /dbang po ngal zhing dub pa'i tshe/ /rtse gcig 0sems kyi ngang la gzhag /bsdam pa'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /rlung gis lus ni 'dzin par 'grur—/ /bsdam pa gnyis ni shes bya ste/ /ji lhar thig le gnas pa dang / /dzo ni bha dha'i lha mo yin/ /mgrin pa bsdams pa lha yin no/ /dgang ba can dang bum pa can/ /phyag rgya gzung ba rnam par bya/ /lha dang lha min kun la ga nga / /dal 'byor bsdam par bya ba yis/ /dbu ma'i sgo ru gtad par bya/ /lam gsum rnam par bkag byas la/ /rlung ni nang du gzung bar bya/ /srog ni rlung yang rlan rkupar bya/ /de lhar byas pas 'og tu 'bab/ /skad cig nyid 26—1336

la bsdam par bya/ /steng 'og rlung gi sbyor ba yis/ /mnyam pa'i rlung dang bsreg par rjebya/ /des ni gyen du bskyod par bya/ /bshang lam bsdams pa dang ldan pas/ /rlung ni rnam par bskum pa dang / /gyen du blang 1ba byas pa yin / /'khrul 'khor dang ni rlung sbyor gyis/ /dgram dang rab tu bsdam ④par bya/ /zung 'jug lam gsum bsgom par bya/ /'di ltar mi yi lus la ni/ /grub pa'i lam ni rab gsal ba/ /nyams myong skye zhing lus rgyas 'gyur/ /rgas par yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /rtsa rnams rgyun gyis ⑤'bab pa dang / /rtag par 'og tu 'gro ba de/ /bsdams pa chen po 'di yis ni/ /rnam par ldog par 0 'gyur ba yin/ /gshis ⑦ni thur du 'gro ba yin/ /yur ba'i nang du chu 'bab pa— /de ni bsdams pas ldog par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nang gi lus la yang / /'us kyi phyi rol 'gro ba de/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu shes par bya/ /lus kyi rtsa ni ma lus pa/ /'dis ni bsdams par rab tu grags/ /bsdams pa 'di yi mthu yis ni/ /lha rnams kun kyang gsal bar 'gyur/ /de ltar phyag rgya bzhi yis ni//lam gsum rnam par bkag pa'o/ /lam gcig ②pa ni gsal ba'o/ /grub pa lha yi lam du 'gro/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i lam gnyis po/ /'og ni lam du bshad pa yin/ /bsod nams dang ni sdig rgyu yi/ /de phyir skyon gnyis rnam par spangs—/ /rlung gi de nyid bum pa can/ /de ni rab tu mnyam par bya/ /steng gi lam du rnam byas la/ /rlung dang lhan cig sbyor ba yis/ /bsdams pas chu rgyun 'gag pa ltar/ /'gro ba thams cad rnam par 'gog /des na de yi bka' drin gyis/ /dzo ni gdams pa zhes grags so/ /grub pa'i lam dang yang dag ldan/ /mi ni 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /phyag rgya 'di ni shes pa yis//26—1337
brtsa/da 'bra~X 1/stan mig ri — 26wa 1339

du brgyud pa gdung ba bcad pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba/kya༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ḍā ki ni u pa ya shrī dha ra mi sa ra rnyi ra tsā ma/bod skad du/ mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa gdung ba bcad —pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma rje btsun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rje btsun mchog dang byin rlabs 1'byung ba'i gnas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams la//gus pa mchog gis rab tu rtse gcig 'dud par byas nas kyang / /skal ldan gdung ba gang zag gdung ba gcad jipa'i phyir/ /bla ma rnams kyi brgyud pa'i man ngag bri/ /de la rten gyi gang zag skal ba dang ldan zhing tshogs chen po bsags pa des/ bla ma dam pa rnams yun ring bar bsten 1 cing gdams pas rgyud yongs su bsgos par gyur kyang / gdams ngag gis goms par ma gyur cing / yid gdung ba ma chad pa dag la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis/26—1340

slo ba dpon chen po ḍom+bi 6te ru ka la sogs pa rnams la brdar gsungs pa de dag bdag gis bstan par bya'o/ /de'ang mkha' 'gro ma ro mas/ slob dpon (m+bi 3 te ru ka la lha ba'i gnas lugs brdar gsungs pa/ til 'bru dang ni sgro na mas phyogs kun gsal bar byed/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i dug ni sman gyi mchog tu gyur pa ste/ /rma bya'i zas ni gzhan du gyur pa yod ma yin/ /tsardon dri dang ri dwags gla ci'i dri bzhin no/ /chu zla dang ni rgya mtsho'i rlabs ni tha dad cung zad med/ /sol ba'i rang bzhin gang gi kha dog nag po dag dang mtshungs—/ /ri bo ②chen po gang gis bskyod par mi nus pas/ /gangs ri'i chu ni gzhan du gyur pa yod min no/ /dper na dri dang sgog skya tha dad gyur pa med/ /nyi ma zla ba'i yon tan gsal ba yin/ /mkha' la bya 'phur rjes ni tshul bas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rtog ge'i spyod yu la ma yin no/ /maṇ+ḍal dag ni phyogs las thams cad rab tu snyoms/ /dper na ro langs dang ni sa pra ko ne bzhin/ /dpa' bo ngo mtshar nor bu shel bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ de dag ni gnas lugs kyi gdung ba bcad ④ pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ste dang po'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma sirnya ⑤ dha ras/ slob dpon ḍom+bi ༅he ru ka la bsgom pa'i don brdar gsungs pa ni/ gnas ni tshang tshing dag gam dur khrod du/ /bdag med pa ⑦yi mdza' mo dag dang phrad byas la/ /yid ni rab dga'i bsam pa yis/ /dper na las zin pa yi skyes bu bzhin/ /dman pa'i don stor dam mkhar khyer bar bya/ /chu bo chen po rgyun du bab pa bzhin/ /drang srong ku 26—1341

sha gtsang ma'i steng du gzhag② /mar me'i rtse mo rlung gis mi bskyod dang / /me long g.ya' med bzhin du gsal bar phyi/ /bu ni yid 'ong bral ba'i ma bzhin du—/ /rus sbal dang ni mkhar gzhong nyi ma la/ /rtsal dang ldan pa'i 'phong slob brtson pa ste/ /bsdams pa'i brtson ④ni nges par grol bar 'gyur/ /sa le sbram las byas pa'i rgyan bzhin du/ /bu ram dag gi ro la zung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni bsgom pa'i gnas lugs kyi gdung ba gcad pa'i gdams pa zhes bya ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma lnga mas slob dpon te ru ka la spyod pa'i don brdar gsungs pa ni/ bag ma dang ni snyon ma'i tshul bzhin te/ /glang po btsongs la phaka rgod gsad ⑤par bya/ /nya ni rgya mtsho chen por yangs pa che/ /nags rnams ma yi phung por rab tu bsreg /spyan gzigs zas la rtag tu longs spyod bya/ /res 'ga' mgyogs pa'i rta la bzhon pa bya/ /gri gug non po'i mtshon cha dag gis ni/ /ce spyang dur khrod dag tu rnam par rol/ /'dab chags khra yi rtsal ni shin du drag /wa ni dur khrod nyid du shin du gzhol/ /chang 'thungs pa dang yul rnams gzhol ba 'dra/ /me tog dag la bung ba rgyu ba bzhin—/ /bu chung dang ni seng ge me long mtshungs/ /stag ni 'jigs pa med par kun du rgyu/ /lkugs pa dag ni kha las khyod ma 'da'/ /zhes gsungs pa ste—/ de dag ni spyod pa'i gnas lugs 0 gdung ba gcad ⑫pa'i gdams pa ste gsum pa'o// //26—1342

de nas mkha' 'gro ma ke ka ro ma has/ slob dpon ḍom+bi ༅te ru ka la nyams su myong ba'i don bdar gsungs pa ni/ dkar po tshes ni zla ba'i rim pa ste /gzha' tshon dag ni nam mkha' dag la mdzes/ /gzhon nu ma yis ma sprus ci ste go/ /'khur ba chus bkang pa ni smra mi byed/ /khug rna lta bu sdi ②ba'i rnam pa yin/ /dadul po'i rang bzhin gter ldan shin tu ngo mtshar che lan tshwa chu nyid la ni rab tu thim/ /nam mkha'i nyams las 'da' bar mi byed do/ /bslus pa'i chos rnams la ni re bar mi byed cing / /ral gri'i ngar ni sgrum gyis nyams par 'byur/ /rgyal po dag ni rkun pos 'jigs mi byed/ /wa yis seng rgo skrag par 'gyur ma yin/ /mkha' lding rnams ni mkha' las dpangs mi dma'//'di nyid yin dang ma yin gang yang min/ /sus byas gang yin go ba su zhig yin//'is gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni nyams su myong ba'i gnas lugs kyi gdung ba sacad pa'i gdams pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma ma tre yis slob dpon ḍom+bi bte ru ka la 'bras bu'i sanas lugs kyi gdung ba gcad ⑤pa'i brdar gsungs pa ni/ yi ge bzhi pa dag gis zla ba rgyas/ /nye ru ka yi nam mkha'i ngang nyid de/ /rdo rje dang ni pad+ma yi ge bral/ /kha ṭī ga ni nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin/ /rdo rje dang ni ljon thing 'bras du ste/ /bya ni ngang pa chu na rtag tu gnas/ /pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dab ma rab tu rgyas/ /ḍa ma ru ni bung ba'i rtsi dang mtshungs/ /bdud rtsi skal ldan noms la chu shel te/ /rin chen bdun la rgyal pos mnga' yang mdzad/ /rnam grangs rnams ni ras kyis shes la bkab/ /kun 'dar ma la bye brag gang yang 26—1343

med—/ /rtsal chen tsurdzogs pa'i seng ge gangs la gnas/ /shel ni phyi nang med par shin du dag /btso ma'i gser ni dri ma'i g.ya' dang bral/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ de dag 'bras du'i gnas lugs kyi gdung ba gcad pa'i gdams ( )pa ste lnga pa'o// //mkha' 'gro ma ma ha las/ slob dpon ḍom+bi ②te ru ka la/ gang khyodu gsungs pa de dag kyang / gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor du bya ba'i brdar gsungs pa ni/ rgyal po rnams ni rin chen skal bar ldan/ /sman pa bzang dang phrad par gyur pa las/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mun pa sel ba lhar/ /rus sbal rgya mtsho dag tu 'gro mi 'gyur/ /stobs ldan gyad kyis pha rol 'joms par byed/ /ri bo 'gyel na chu rnams 'brub par byed/ /nags khrod dag na rngon pa klu rnams len / /me shel ras bal 'dus pas me 'byung 'byur/ /gser 'gyur rtsi ni shin tu ngo mtshar che/ /chu dang bcas pa'i skye shing lo 'dab rgyas/ /spur len nor bu dag ni spur rnams sdud/ /shes pa rnams ni gzhan gyi lus la 'jug /spre'u rnams ni dran par ldan pa ste/ /mnyan pas 'gro ba dag ni sgrol bar byed/ga bur sbyor bas tshad pa'i nad rnams se / /dge slong bag dang ldan pa gso sbyong byed/ /rigs ngan rgyal po'i khab tu mi gnas te/ /bcad par gyur na tā la'i lo 'dab med/ /sgyu ma mkhan po sgyu ma'i longs spyod mkhas/ /rgyal po'i bu mo rgyan dang rab tu ldan/ /gar mkhan rnams ni gar gyi rnam pa byed/ /sprang ma dmas ni ngan skyugs nang du rgyug /ces gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas lugs kyi gdung ba gcad pa'i gdams 26—1344

pa ste drug pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma be tos/ bla ma zangs gling pa la kaspru ⑫ra la zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor gyi brda gsungs pa ni/ khri snyan sa le snying rje ldan pa ste/ /ma ni bu la rab tu chags pa'o/ /bu ram shing las du ram 'byung ba ltar/ /rgya mtshor phyid pas nor bu rnyed par 'gyur/ /chu yi nang gi zla ba sel mi byed/ /nor bu me shel rtsol sgrub dag dang bral/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo rgyal po nyid kyang yin—/ /tshong pa tshong 'dus dka tu kanas par byed/ /rdza mkhan dag ni so btang rdza la spyod/ /sprin dang zal ba'i nam mkha' rab tu dngas/ /dmu rgod mi srun banul bas zhon par byed/ /mdza' bo dag gis gsungs ②pas re ba med—/ /mi lam sad pas dgra dang yongs su bral/ /khyim bdag mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rab tu rdo/ /chom rkun rab tu mang bas mel tshe mkhas/ /chu rnams ma lus rgya mtsho ro gcig 'gyur/ /pha lam rdo rjes dngos po thams cad 'jigs//smig rgyu'i chu yis gdung bar mi byed do/ /gzha' tshon yal ba dag la sdug bsngal med—/ /mi lam mis pa'i nor la ster mi byed/ /brag ca'i sgra la rang nyid dga' ba ste/ /bram ze chang 'thung ba ni shid tu gsang / /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor rnal 'byor shin tu che/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor gyi gnas lugs kyi gdung ba gcad ②pa'i gdams pa ste bdun pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma khaṇ+ḍa ro has/ slob dpon ḍom+bi ④te ru ka la/ pasmo kha 'byed pa'i gdams pa brdar gsungs pa ni/ dbul po rnams ni nor med 26—1345

sdug bsngal de/ /nang zhwazud mtshan mo dag gi dus su ni/ /rgyal po'i bang mdzod bdag nyid brku bar bya/ /ma skyes dpe med mdzes pa'i grogs brkus la//shin tu mgar ba mkhas pa'i lde mig gis/ /gze ma bzhi bsten sgo lcags dbye bar bya/ /slar yang sgo de dam du gcad kyi par bya/ /ked gtan ⑤gzhug cing rked gzer bsdam par bya/ /sgo ba po de yongs su gsad ⑤bya zhing / /'bru mar 'bab pa stegs 0byas la/ /btsa' med lcags las ⑦byas pa dag gi gris/rgyal po'i btsun mo dam pa mgo bcad de/ /dmag dpon chen po dug gis gsad —par bya/ /mel tse ba dang blon po rnams kyang bsad/ /de nas rgyal po'i bang mdzod kha bye la/ /gos bzang dag gis yongs su dril ba yi/ /gser dang dngul gyi ga'u kha bye la/ /phyogs med pa yi nor bu rin chen balha/ /mar me dang ni nam mkha'i du mo'i tshul/ /nyi ma dang ni zla bas bdud rtsi 'thigs / /che bas che ba'i rab tu che ba nyid/ /rma bya khyi dang phag dang spyon pa nyid/ /sha za bung ba shin du rol par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ste / de dag ni pad+mo kha dbye ba'i man ngag gi gnas lugs brdar gsungs pa'i gdams pa ste brgyad pa'o // //3 de nas rnal 'byor pa te rkya lo pas dpal tsā ro pa la/ bla ma'i chos bcu drug pa zhes bya ba'i gdams pa brdar gsungs pa ni/ sa gzhi bzang po dag gi thun mong la/ /blo dman rnams kyis las la ma zhugs shing / /sdug bsngal nad kyis gzir ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /ded dpon lta bu dag gis sems bskyed la / /mu tig 'phyang ba chen po gzung byas la/ /'byung ba sa chu me rlung 26—1346

dbang du bsdus/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhi nas rin chen btsal/ /sbrang rtsi'i bcud ni mar gyi ②snying por ldan/ /goms par bya zhing bzo la byang bar bya/ /bye ma leb dang ri dwags bung ba dang / /nya dang glang chen dag las rab tu grol//dug mdas ma phog ②phog kyang slar la gso/ /tha rgod chu yis rab tu bangs par bya / /rab tu nor mang phyug cing shin du phyug /zhing pa'i las la rab tu gus par 'gyur/ /ma yis bu ni rab tu smin par byed/ /'joms byed seng ge'i bla ma de dag la/ /lus ngag yid gus yo byad ci dgos dbul/ /gus par ldan pas de 'dra yang dang yang / / rtsal med rten ②cing bsnyen bkur rab tu 'bad/ /ces gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni bla ma chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i sdig pa'i grogs po spang ba ste dgu pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor pa te ④lo pas/ dpal na ⑤ro pa la slob ma'i chos bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba'i brdar gsungs pa ni/ gcan gzan 0 mche ba dag gis ma rungs rma med pa/ /sdug bsngal btson ra 'di na yun ring nad kyis thebs/ /khang bzangs ⑦dam pa nad med bde ba yon tan ldan/ /klu yi rgyal po 'gro la char rgyun rtag tu 'bebs/ /dug sdong lo 'dab rgyas pa'i lo 'dab 'bras bu chags pa med/ /spu gri'i sor chags sbrang rtsi'i ro rnams rtag tu spong bar byed/ /bde ba'i chos kun gsod par ldan pa'i skyes bu sems stobs ldan/ /rma yod bag yod gnas mi byed/ /mi bzad⑪nad kyis gzir ba sman pa dag la rab tu gus—/ /skom pas rab gdungs nges par btung ba 'ba' zhig sgrub par byed/ /rlan bral rus sbal rgya mtsho chen po mthong na rab tu dga'/ /mgo la me lces 26—1347

zin pa myur du sel bar byed/ /rin chen sdod mchog de dag tu/ /ro mchog bcud kyis nges par 'gengs/ /mun pa dag la sgron me bzhin/ /skal ldan bya ba gsal bar byed/ /slob ma chos de rnams dang ldan pa bsten/ /de las bzlog pa spang bar bya'o/ /slob ma bsten pa'i gdung ba gcad ⑫pa'i gdams pa ste bcu pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma ke ka ro ma has/ bla ma zangs gling pa na kaspru — ra la 'khrul pa'i shes pa gcad pa'i brda brgyad gsungs pa ni/ byis pa chung ngur gyur pa rnams kyis ni/ /me long bzhin la tha dad dag tu rtogs/ /shin du blo gros dman pa'i ri mo mkhan/ /rang gis bris pa'i ri mo dag la skrag /mkhris pa'i nad kyis btab pa'i mig can dag /mthong ba'i yul rnams dag la chags sdang skye/ /ji lhar dar gyi srin bu dag gis ni/ /rang gi kha chu'i rnam pas 'ching bar byed/ /mi mkhas dman pa'i gang zag la de ni/ /sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyi rnam pas bslus pa yin/ /rgya dang rnyi ②la sogs pas ri dwags ni/ /rang dbang med par rab tu bsdams par 'gyur/ /mi mthun dgra yis zin par gyur pa'i btson/ /lcags sgrog 4 dam pa dag gis bcings gyur la/ /rmi lam na ni khri mon ⑤dong bcug pa/ /de tshe sdug bsngal mi bzod skye ba yin/ /bla ma bsten cing nges shes bskyed/ /gnyug ma goms par bsten par bya/ /'khrul pa yi ni shes pa nyid/ /rig pa nyid de ye shes nyid/ /'khrul pa'i shes pa spangs byas la/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes goms par bya'o/ /'khrul pa'i shes pa ngo shes par bya ba'i gdung ba gcad ②pa'i gdams pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// //26—1348

lho phyogs kyi grong khyer du mkha' 'gro ma ji la de wis/ rnal 'byor pa'i smyon pa'i brtul zhugs la ri ta pa la la/ de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor nyi shu brdar yosungs pa ni/ zhing pa rnams ni rim gyis las la 'jug /shing rta dag ni 'khor lo gnyis dang ldan/ /dpe med nam mkha' nyid du gnas/ /rig pa'i mdangs ⑫ni thams cad 'jigs par byed/ /chu yi nang du ut+pal shin tu mdzes//rtog pa bral ba rgya mtsho chen po nyid/ /nun nag rab tu spangs pa nam mkha' ste//drang srong ②gnas pa shing lo'i gos/ /rtsal rdzogs seng ge gangs la da rung ④ kanas / /'dab ldan bya ni mkha' la mthon por gcod/ /sman mchog be ta'i 'bras bu gdod nas grub/ /'bru mar snod khyer skad cig tsam mi yengs//dka' thub can ni shin du bag dang ldan/ /ri yi khrod na ljon shing rab tu rgyas//bram ze 'jug ngogs dag na dri ma 'khru/ /thag pa'i 'jur pa lhod par lhod/ /rgaṅgā'i — chu ni rgya mtsho chen por 'bab/ /gdol pa dag ni rab rtsatu slong mos 'tsho—/ /mdzes pa rtag tu me long lha bar byed/ /ri rgyal ri bo mchog rab rtag tu brtan/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor nyi shu brdar gsungs pa'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor shes par bya ba'i gdung ba gcad ba pa'i gdams pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ci to mas/ /rje btsun ri khrod pa la zag bcas kyi bde ba las su rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gdams pa brdar gsungs pa/ rten cing 'brel pa dag gi las rnams ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'grub 26—1349

par byed/ /dus rnams kun+da snazla ba rgyas pa yin/ /mun pa'i tshogs rnams nges par sel byed na/ /tsha sgo med pa'i zhing pa dag gis ni/ /'bras bu'i nus pa yongs su skyed par byed/ /'khor lo gnyis dang rab tu ldan pa yis/shing rta malhogs pa'i shugs kyis pha rol 'gro/ /rten thabs mkhas pa rnams kyi chu lud kyis/ /zhing pa'i myu gu rab tu rgyas par byed/ /ji srid 'dab ma ma rdzogs pa yi bya/ /de srid 'jam pa'i tshang na rten par byed/ /tshad pas gdungs pa'i dug gi sprul rnams ni/ /bya ba gzhan dag btang nas tsardon snyegs—/ /zo chu rgyud mo mkhan po she'adod par ni/ /chu rnams ji ltar bsring par byed/ /'di ni thun mong ma yin gdams pa ste/ /rtag tu bla ma mchog la gus pa dang / /tshogs bsags rgyud sbyangs pa yi spyod yul te/ /skal ba dang ni ldan pas 'bad par bya/ /zhes gsungs te'u/ de dag ni ting nge 'dzin kyi grogs stobs yan lag brdar gsungs pa ste bcu gsum pa'o// //dur khrod chen po ha har sgrogs pa zhes bya bar slob dpon chen po ḍom+bi te ru kas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i dus su/ 'du bar 'os pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa rnams kyis bab col du bdud rtsi chu bo lta bu'i gdams ngag mi bya bar/ gdamasam pa bran ltar rang dbang med pa'i mi rnams la/ rje bo bzhin du bde ba'i dus skabs med/ /g.ya' ma phyis pa'i me long ngos dag la/ /bzhin ni gzugs brnyan gsal bar gyur pa — med/ /rgyu 1dang bral ba'i gzhung dang 'phong mamakhan dang / /rtsal dang ldan yang srid mi byed/ /snod nang ma bkrus shin tu 26—1360

btsog pa'i nang / /ro mchog zas bzang dag gis 'gengs pa med/ /tshad lda na zhing pa mkhas pa dag rnams kyis/ /dus min sa bon 'debs pa yongs su spo nga 1/ /rkun po blo gros gzhan la gtams pas na/ /brkus par gyur kyang snyus bsngal rtag tu skyes/ /gtsub shing yan lag rdzogs par ma gyur pa/ /me mi 'byung bar rung ba nam yang med/ /bag yod blo ldan mkhas pa gang zhig gis//'bas med snod du bcud rnams blugs mi byed/ /'bru mar 'bar bar 1mi 'dod skyes bu ni/ /rtag tu rlung rnams g.yo bar byed cing gnas/ /dug can spru' ni mkhas pa dag rnams kyis/ /mthong bar mi 'dod thag ring yongs su spong / /zhes gsungs pa ste/ de dag ni slob dpon ḍom+bi he ru kas rdo rje slob dpon du gyur pa rnams la bdud rtsi lta du'i man ngag snod ma brtags pa noms la mi bstan 'apa ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //rje btsun tsā ro pas bla ma gangs gseng pa la/ nor bu rin po che ngos sazung ba'i gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ nang gi spun pa'i rgya mtsho chen po ru/ /rin thang med pa'i nor bu rab stor bas/ /ze ma lnga dang rab tu ldan pa yis/ /mche ba gnyis gtsigs phag pa zos par 'gyur/ /lcags sna gsum las 6brdungs pa'i ral gri yis/ /phag pa'i sha dang rus pa so sor dbye/ /de nas nor bu rin chen btsal bar bya/ /rnyed par gyur na chu yis bkru/ /de nas rgyal mtshan rtse la phyar bar bya/ /'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pas 'byung //dri ma med pa'i nor bu rin chen de/ /nges par nam mkha'i dkyil du sba bar bya//nor bu lhun po ri yi rtse la gzhag /nor bu me dang chu yis rab tu btul / /26—1361

nor bu bya yi 'dab ma gdags par bya/ /nor bu chu bo chen po'i gzhung la bskur//nor bu mar me'i ngos la bstan par bya/ /nor bu smyon pa'i lag tu gtad la gzhag /nor bu me long ngos la bstan la gzhag⑫ /nor bu ras bal phung po'i steng du gzhag /nor bu rin chen dri za'i grong du bcol/ /nor bu rin chen rgyal po'i gter du sba bar bya/ /nor bu rin chen me dpung dkyil du sba/ /nor bu rin chen rkun po'i nor nyid yin/ /nor bu rin chen shel gyi steng du gzhag༄ /nor khu nor can bstan pa'i nor/ /nor bu'i nor ni btsal zhes gsungs pa ste/ /de dag ni ye shes kyi nor bu ngos gzung ②ba'i thabs brdar gsungs pa'o/ /rang gi gnyug ma'i de kho na nyid kyi ye shes ngos gzung ba'i gdung ba gcad 4pa'i gdams pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //slob ma skal ldan tshogs bsags rin chen lha bu'i gang zag 'di/ /dpaka tu med pa'i gdams ngag rnams kyis rgyud dag yongs su sbyangs gyur kyang / /gdung ba chad par ma gyur bla ma rnams kyis yongs su gdungs gyur pa/ /gdams ngag rnams dang bla ma'i gdung ba gcad phyir brgyud pa'i man ngag bkod/ /rje btsun mchog dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams bzod mdzod la/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba zla ba lta bu'i dri ma med pa des/ /'gro ba ma lus yid kyi gdung ba yongs su gcad par gyur nas kyang / /phyag rgya chen po'i dri med sa la ma lus yongs su rdzogs gyur cig /mkha' 'gro ma'i gdams ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdung ba gcad pa'i gdams pa zhes bya'o/ /sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pas gzhung du bkod pa rdzogs so// //26—1352

gnu dang 'phongs/1251 ①〈〈snar 〉skosgongs/ ci 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyed//btsub/ ③〈05ra 〉mi bar/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉〉 snyi/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brtan/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanadul/1352 zhu②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag ③〈〈snar skabazung / ④⑤⑥⑦〈〈pe 〉྾mu ra 〉〉bcad/ba kā 'bra~X /shā) mig26wa 1354

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu drwa badz+ra shī ti nā ma/ bod skad du/phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i gru zhes bya ba/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo dharma kā ya/ ma hā su kha ye/ kye ho gnyis med rdo rje 'di ltar nyon—/ /gang zhig mig med pa yis lam mkhan bsten/ /du chung dpa' bo ma la rag lus te/ /me long bstan pas bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal/ /ngang pa'i mchu yis chu dang 'o ma 'byed/ /bskal pa'i mun pa sel byed sgron me ste/ /gter gyi bang mdzod 'byed pa'i lde mig mchog /mi zad gter chen 'byin pa'i rgyal po bsten/ /dadul po bsten pas bdag nyid dadul por 'gyur/ /dam mkha' rgya mtsho nyi zla gsum ldan bsten/ /ne lha'i kha thon snyan pas ci zhig phan—/ /'dab chags bu ni mkha' la 'phur na bde/ /dud 'gro g.yang la bskyur na gson mi rung / /nyi zla gza' bral sprin rlung btab na gsal/ /26—1366

sprin sangs gyur kyang gzas zin snang ba med/ /chu skyes pad+ma'i bcud ni bung bas len/ / sha sbrang rngodrung na gnas kyang de lhar ④min/ /chu shel chu ni rkyen dang 'dzom pa gces1/ /seng ge'i 'o ma snod ngan phal par min/ /oṃ uhūṃ e ma ho/ snang srid thams cad nam mkha' nyid las byung / /nam mkha' yod med phyogs rgyu kha dog bral/ /thog ma bar dang tha ma 'gro 'ong med/ /'byung bzhi rab tu 'khrugs kyang 'gyur mi srid/ /rkyen gyis dkar nag snang yang dkar nag med/ /rgya mtsho gting zab rgya che sna tshogs 'char/ /dba' rlabs ri bo 'dra yang rgya mtsho'i ngang / /chab 2rom brag 'dra chu las yong 1 ma 'das/ /sa la sna tshogs 'khrungs kyang zad pa med/ /bsregs bcad bdar yang gser gyi ngo mi 'gyur/ /me ni tsha zhing chu ni rlan mi 'bral/ /sprul pa drug ni rab tu rtogs par gyis/ /nam mkha' stong las stong pa 'byung ba ste/ /rkyen gyis me chu 'byung yang shel gyi ngo mi 'gyur/ /bka' rtags phyag rgya gnyug ma zhes brjod do—/ /sa 'og gser dang gyad kyi nor bu dang / /dbul po'i gter dang bum pa'i mar me ltos/ /nor du rin chen mi gtsang 'dam du bying / /sgyu mar ma shes rgyal po a thang chad/ /thag pa sprul du mthong bas brgyal nas shi/ /mar me nyi ma danus long nun par snang / /mi gtsang dri za tsan+dan dri la 'bros/ /mig skyon can gyis zla ba gnyis su mthong / /glang po bzhag nas glang po'i rjes tshol ba/ /bu chung me long gzugs brnyan mthong bas dga'/ /ri dwags 'khrul pa smig rgyu chu la snyeg /gser ma shes pa ra gan bye ma 'chang / /ko dzichu glang rjes chu ni myur du skam/ /rkyal med pa dag rgya mtshor zhugs na 'bying / /lam mkhan med par danun long lam 'gro dang / /'dab gshog med pa'i bya 26—1366

dag rje'aphur na lhung / /dug lo bregs nas bsgyur kyang ci zhig phan/ /nun khrung dag tu sgron me bteg pas gsal②/ /thag pa gcig chod mdud pa brgya grol te/ /thag pa mes tshig dag gis 'ching mi nus/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yis zangs lcags gser du 'gyur/ /rma byas btsan dug zos pas spu thog rgyas/ /mig dang ldan pas rkang pa gar gzhag ②phyin/ /dbang gi rgyal po gcig la 'dod dgu rdzogs/ /khyung phrug ji3gshog rdzogs mkha' la 'phur kun bde/ /mar me bteg pas mun pa'i lam gsal zhing / /cang shes sgrog tu bcug pa bye bas grol/ /ngang pa chu la 'o ma len pa ltos/ /dgra skugs btsal bas 'jigs pa sangs nas 'gro/ /nam mkha' ma mthong nam mkha' mthong ba ste/ /rgya dang rgya yi 'bur ni log par 'byung / /mar me bsad pas lus dang grib ma med—/ /sgyu ma bshig pas 'du shes rnam lnga spangs/ /chu la chu bzhag de nyid dbyer med 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i me tog ri bong rwa zhes bya/ /gzings la 'phur ba'i bya ni slar la ldog /gang zhig chab — rom spangs nas chu tshol ba/ /rgyu rkyen rtsol bas byas pa rang 'byung min/ /dbul po mi nor rgya yis 'debs pa dang / /sa bon 'bras bu tha dad 'dzin pa 'khrul/ /rkun ma ngos ma zin par rab mda' zen / /kye ma 'di ni sbrul dang rig sngags mtshon cha 'dra/ /rta rngas sprul la mdud pa brgyab pa grol/ /mkha' la mdung bskor las zin skyes bu bde/ /khyung chen mkha' lding nyam nga 'jigs pa med/ /ri mtho'i kha na yul khams sna tshogs gsal/ /bu yi sdug bsngal ma yis mthong mi bzod/ /ral gri ngar mas dngos po ma lus gcod/ /smyon par gyur kyang dug la reg mi byed—/ /bu chung yin yang gtsug gi nor mi 'bral/ /tsho.oṃ hūṃ/ e ma ho/26—1367

me don gnyer bas du ba shugs kyis 'byung / /nor bu rnyed na so nam 'bad mi dgos—/ /mi gcig skyes pas shing la 'dod lnga 'byung / /skyur po zos na mthong bas nyams su myong / /sngar 'dris mi dang phrad na the tshom med/ /skyes bu nam mkhas bzung ba thar mi srid/ /mi lam sgyu ma'i mtshon gyis gnod pa med//dngul rdo 'o ma bur shing til mar ltos/ /chu ni mthong dang thos pas skom mi sel//sman pa'i ngag mi nyan pa'i nad pa de/ /zas nor byin pas rang nyid bkros nas shi/ /gter mdzod bgrangs pas rang gis 7thob pa med/ /'on pa sil snyan long ba ri mo mkhan/ /byis pa mna' gtam dmus long yul khams ston/ /sgo nga ma yis gab na bye'u 1phrug smin/ /rdo la bzhu btul byas na rin chen nor/sbang ma mnan nas bsings pas gar chang 'byung / /bu chung gsos pas dpa' bo'i las rnams nus/ /rgyal du tshar nas yul khams dbang thob ste/ /mkha' la sprin dengs 'khyags pa chur thim 'gyur/ /mkha' lding 7rgyal po spro bsdu med par gnas/ /chu ni ma rnyogs rang dngas nyid du zhog /ji ltar mkhas pas ba lang skyong ba bzhin/ /brtan gsal rdo ba mar me'i snying po ltos/sgyu ma'i skyes bu chags zhen rtsis gdab med/ /bya ni nam mkhar rten med gnas par byed/ /tshos ma rnams kyis ras gos dag par bkru/ /mkhar spe rtsig na 'gram gzhi legs par thing rngo/ /ma yi sdug bsngal bu yis mthong bar gyis/ /yid bzhin nor bu spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag /nam mkha' lta na 'ja' tshon lus su bsgyur/ /danu rgod rta ni thabs kyis zung la 'tshosab/ /ri gzar 'bab chu yang yang brdabs na drungs/ /spre'u zin na kun la yang rtsal sbyang ka/ /bsags pa'i yo byad chags med kun la sbyin/ /bying zhing rmugs na 'dab 26—1358

chags mkha' la spur/ /yang na bum pa kha sbyor rlung gis khong / /rgod na khong stong rkun ma sprin la ltos/ /rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs chu zlar shes par bya/ /rkun ma mthong zhing tshor na ldog par nges/ /rtsa ba sman na thams cad sman zhes bya//nor bu rin chen sa yi gter du sba/ /yang na ri dwags gar song deng la gsod//rdo gas na dug 1la sngags kyis btab la bza'/ /snyoms las byis pa'i nyam nga sayang sa ltos/ /snying la gces pa dur khrod gnas su skyol/ /na tsha byung na rkyal pa stong par gyis/ /de la bu ga thod la mes tshig me la gdungs/ /sman ma zhu na slar yang nad du 'gyur/ /rtsa dang gser gnyis 'ching byed khyad par med//thes pa 'thums na yul khams skor zhing blta/ /rkang 'gros dul na 'og rta rol la sgos/ /dpa' rtsal zhen na dpa' rtsal kun la sbyang / /me don gnyer bas gtsub shing drag tu gtsubs / /ri bo mi bskyod chu bo rgyun chad med/ /gser gling phyin nas sa rdo btsal mi rnyed/ /shing bral da'adab ma shin du yang la sogs//yid bzhin nor bu yod na dgos 'dod 'byung / /ā ཿoṃ hūṃ/ e ma ho/bya 'phur nam mkha' dag las mi 'da' ste/ /sna tshogs nor bu tshon gyi kha dog sna nga / /gser dang gser gyi rgyan la 'gyur ba med/ /'dam skyes pad+ma 'dam gyis mi gos so/ /gang dag 'jigs sar skyel ma sangs nas 'gro/ /rgyal po gang zhig rgyal srid bor nas 'khyam/ /sum cu rtsa gsum thos pa ne tsho'i chos/ /chu la mar khu blugs pas 'dres pa min/ /bya rgod rnyis zin glang chen 'dam du bying / /nor bu rin chen lung khung dag tu bor/ /rgyal blon 'dzom na rgyal srid mnga' thang 'phel/ /mig dang rkang par ldan pas don sar phyin/ /dpa' bo'i go mtshon blon po bka' rtags khyer/ /rtsis med snyon pa zhen med bu 26— 369

chung dang / /rtog med phrag 13dang glang chen chur 'jug ltos/ /phrag kyirgod rnams ni dug sprul mi gtong za/ /dbul po rin chen rgyal po'i mkhar du sba/ /gso sbyong spyad rnams rig pa mda' yis bsnun/ /yul khams kun gyi dgra rnams srid du gcad / /dpa' bo gang yin de yis dgra rnams 'dul/ /mkha' lding rgyal po bye leb spyod yul min/ /rigs ngan rgyal po wa yis seng lhags 8lhon/ /nags la me mched gdong du gar bab sreg /me 'bar ba la rlung gis bskyod na 'bar/ /rin chen snod sbyar mi gtsang ⑤phyis pa sangs smyon pa bu chung khyi phag seng ge bzhin/ /uzaḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ e ma ho/ chu rnams thams cad rgya mtsho chen por gcig /gang zhig ltogs pa'i dus su zas ster ba//nad rnams gso ba sman pa'i rgyal po ste/ /chu bo chen po sgrol ba'i mnyen — pa mchog /gnod pa'i dgra rnams 'dul ba'i dpa' bo ste/ /dge bshes rgyal po phyogs med kun la snyoms/ /mkhas pa dag gis 'ja' tshon blta sgyu bar bya/ /gnad du bsnun pa'i tshor ba spangs bapa med/ /bung ba me tog dag la chags zhen bral/ /nya ni rtag tu chu las yong mi 'da'/ /rtsi sman yod kyang dug la reg mi byed/ /ji ltar phyug po so nam byed pa ltos/ /seng ge'i 'o ma lkugs pa'i kha bzhin bsdamashā / /skyon pas tsarang gi snying la mtshon bsnun dang /gshed mas zin pa'i chad pas bcad pa'i mi/ /sa bon rul pa myu gu yong mi skye//tshe lo sum cu nyi shu bcu pa bzhin/ /gang zhig ye shes nyi ma shar nas nub/ /dbul pos nor du rin chen rnyed nas bor/ /gang dag cang shes rta la zhon nas 'bab / /ji ltar dadul po'i nor bu rgyal pos phrogs/ /yid bzhin nor bu mchod na dgos 'dod 'byung / /dngul dkar me long yang yang phyis na gsal//26—1360

brgya byin lha yi longs spyod 'bad pa med/ /me tog pad+ma bung ba'i tshogs rnams 'du / /lha'i3oṃ hūṃ/ e ma ho/ po ta la la nam langs nyi shar mnyam/ /'jim pa'i logs la btab pa'i bde gshegs sku/ /myu gu me tog 'bras bu rim gyis smin/ /dbang po skyon dang bral na gzugs rnams mthong / /shel gong dri ma med pa'i phyi nang gsal/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis mkhas pa pasna tshogs ston//rdo rje pha lam gang gis gzhom par min/ /yid bzhin nor bus mi mthun gnod pa sel/ /seng ge mngal rgya khyung phrug gong rgya bral/ /mkha' la nyi shar 'od zer phyogs bcur khyab/ /srin bu bung ba kanas gyur mkha' la 'phyo/ /yid bzhin nor bu rtog med dgos 'dod 'byung / /rang gis grib ma mthong bas 'bros pa dang / /ri dwags smig rgyu rnyeg pa nor ba ste/ /dgra la zin du mthong na nges par gsod/ /'khyag pa'i rang bzhin chu ru shes par byos/ /nyi zla'i ngos la 'char nub gsal 'grib med/ /rin chen byi dor byas na dgos 'dod 'byung / /e ma ho/ de ltar bstan pa'i don de thams cad kyang / /rang bzhin las dang 'bras bu gsum du gnas/ /gzhi la chos sbu lhun gyis grub pa na / /de phyir sku gsum lhun gyis grub par gnas/ /rang bzhin stong pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo/ /lam ni mtshan med rnam par thar pa'i sgo/ /'bras bu smon med rnam par thar pa'i sgo/ /sgo gsum byed pas sku gsum zhal mthong 'byur—/ /'on kyang thams cad brdzun pa'i rang bzhin la/ /don la ched du bya ba ci yang med/ /shin tu gsang ba rdo rje'i tshig 'di dag /khyod kyis ye shes rig pas rtogs par gyis/ /dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug dang / mkha' 'gro ma ye shes kyi spyan ma dang / pad+ma'i spyan gyi zhal snga nas snying po'i don 26—1361
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (1122)

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra gri ti/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i glu/bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rtog pa'i gdon chen pos/ /zin par gyur pa'i smyon pa dag /rdo shing sogs la gser du mthong / /de la rin chen gser yod min/ /rnam rtog gdon gyi rjes 'brangs nas—/ /skad cig skad cig bcings par 'gyur/ /shes rab snying brtser bcas pa yi / /de gzhom pa la 'bad par gyis/ /slob dpon chen po tsā ro pa'i rdo rje'i glu rdzogs so// //26nga 1364

bsdur ma na/1 kyi64 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga /rdo rje glu zhes bya ba banugs so// 〈〈be 〉྾〈snar 〉stanan/brtsashā 'bra~X ༵shā 〉mig26wa 1365

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra gri ti/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i glu/bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam rtog sprul gdug g.yo can gyis/ /zin par gyur to rang gi sems/ /ji lta ji ltar rnam rtog pa//de lta de ltar rnam par bcings/ /don med sdug bsngal mang po myong / /'khrul pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa yis/ /'khrul pa spangs par mi 'gyur te/ /dpa' bo snying rjer ldan pa yis/ /de bzhin nyid la goms par gyis/ /ji lta ji ltar rnam dpyad na/ /de lta de ltar rnam par 'bral1/ /shes rab spru gdug mgo mang gis / /bdag nyid la ni za bar byed/ /shes rab sprul gdug mgo mang ni/ /ting 'dzin 'o mas rtag tu gsos/ /rnam rtog rte'u le gsod par byed/ /shes rab sprul mgo brgya pa yis/ /tsā ro pa la rtag tu za/ /de ni su yis shes pa yin/ /tsā ro pa ni nyid kyis shes/ /tsā ro pa ni nyid la 26—1366

dris / /ma hā yo ga nā ro pa'i rdo rje'i glu rdzogs so// //brtsar ma na/1366 17mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ zhu 〈〈pe 〉sngapo ra 〉snosgongs/du〈〈pe 〉྾05ra 〉〉bul/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pangs kyis/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stabangs/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tha/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1124)26wa 1367

ba / /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra gri ti/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i glu/thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar na nga / de ltar na khrod/ tha dad par byed pa rnam par rtog pa/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las sbrul 'ongs/ chom rnam par rtog pa/ rdo rje'i gru rdzogs so// //26——1368
bzur ma na/1368 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/brtsar 'bras re'u mig da/ (1125)26wa 1369

༄ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra shī ti/ bod skad du/ rdo rje'i glu/dpal rdo rje gdan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /smra'o/ /nag po pa'i yid gang du yang mi gnas par thams cad ca le col ler snang ngo / /slob dpon nag po zhabs kyis nyardo rje'i gru rdzogs so// //
137 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/baspur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1126)26wa 1371
