g.yo ba ni/ nag pos gsungs zhes bya ba smos mite/ slob dpon nag po na re yid ni byang chub sems de mi g.yo ba ni gang du yang phyir mi 'byung ba ste steng dang 'og tu 'byung ba spangs pas/ dus kyi rtsa khams gsum du byas pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i dgongs pa ni ri bong can gyi thig le ma lhung bar 'ba' zhig nga'i bsgrub tsa par bya ba ma yin te/ 'on kyang steng 'og gnyis su 'gro ba'i ngo bo'o/ /'di lta bu'i 'byung ba med pa'i ngo bo gang du gnas she na/ mi g.yo rlung gi khyim bdag mo ni khyim na gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mi g.yo ba'i rlung ni 'bar ba'i rlung ngo / /khyim bdag mo ni de nyid ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro//khyim ni de'i bde ba'i nam mkha'i khams sa zhehaṃ gi rang bzhin gong du gsungs pa ste / a 6wa sgru tī'o/ /de la gnas pa ni khyim der gnas pa'o/ /'di'i dgongs pa ni rlung gi 'gro ba'i chos can te/ nam mkha'i khams la brten pa/'gro ba dang 'ong ba las grol ba'i nam mkha'i khams la khyen zhing / sems kyi bzhon pa snang ba dang bcas pa ye shes gsum dang ldan pa'i thim par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir de'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po la zhugs pa zhes brjod do/ /de skad du yang / dgongs pa bla na med pa las/ /snang ba snang ba mched pa dang / /sna tshogs 'dus pa 'di dag ni/ /sems ni rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /rlung ni phra ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /ye shes dang ni 'dres par 'gyur / /dbang po lam nas phyung nas ni/ /yul rnams la ni 'jug par byed / /snang ba dang ni mi ldan zhing / /rlung gi bzhon pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de la 'di ni rang bzhin kun/ /rim dang rim pa mun par 'jug /rlung ni gang dang gang gnas pa/ /de dang der nide bzhin rgyu/ /ji srid rlung ni mi rgyu 26— 602

ba / /snang ba brtan par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ ri bo mchog rab dag gi sgyuphug zab mor / /zhes gsungs te/ mchog ni phul du byung ba'i ngo bo'i ri bo ste/ rab ni sgal tshigs kyi bdag nyid do/ /de ltar yang dpal kha sbyor thig le las/ rkang pa'i mthil du rlung gnas pa/ /rlung ni gzhu yi dbyibs can no/ /mdoms kyi sum mdor gnas pa ni/ /de bzhin gru gsum dmar po'o/ /klum po'i gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /chu ni lte bar gnas pa'o/ /snying ga ru ni sa nyid kyang //kun du gru bzhir gnas pa'o/ /sgal tshigs dbyug pa'i ngo bo ni/ /de bzhin ri rgyal lhun po'o/ /de yi phug ni ri phug go/ /de lus dang — ngag dang yid kyi — spyod yul ma yin pas zab pa'o/ /des cir 'gyur zhe na/ 'gro ba ma lus pa ni 'ching bar 'gyur te/ 'gro ba ma lus pa — stenyid 'ching bar 'gyur ba ni nyams pa ste/ de la steng du spyi bo'i bar du dbang po gnyis kyis sbyor ba'i bde ba'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi byang chub sems med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on te 'gro ba thams cad 'di yis bcing bar cis shes she na/ dri ma med pa'i chu ni skams gyur te/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ dri ma med pa'i — don dam pa'i rang bzhin no—/ /zhu ba ni kun rdzob kurdo ( lta bu ste/ dri ma med pa'i chu bden pa gnyis zhes bya ba byang chub kyi sems gang yin pa skams par 'gyur te 'og tu lhung ba'o/ /gang gi phyir byang chub kyi sems 'gro ba'i ngo bo nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe 'og tu ltung ba de'i tshe nyams par 'gyur 'o/ /de ltar yang dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ lus can thams cad 'chi dus su/ /'og tu zla ba bdud rtsi 'dzag /rnam shes rang bzhin mtshan nyid dang / /nyi khrag rā hu steng du 26—1603

'gro / /des cis 'gyur zhe na/ dus kyi me ni rab tu zhu gyur na/ /zhes gsungs te/ dus kyi me ni byang chub kyi sems kyi phyir 'byung ba'i gnas skabs te—/ nag po'i phyogs kyi mtshan nyid de/ /'chi ba'i dus kyis zhe sa bya'o/ /de lhar yang dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ lhung na chags dang bral gyur te//chags bral las ni sdug bsngal bskyed/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni khams zad de/ /khams zad pas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'chi ba las ni yang srid 'byung / /de ltar 'dod chags bral bas byung / /gzhan du sems can mi srid do/ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /sems byung 'dod chags spang bar bya/ /dal ma 'byung med bde ba yis/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ji lhar na byang chub kyi sems 'byung bar 'gyur zhe na/ sa 'dzin dag las 'di ni gzung dka' ste/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzung dka' ba ni sbyor ba'i yan lag drug gis rlung gzung zhing byang chub sems gzung dgos pa ste/ de la 'dir gzung dka' ba'o/ /sa 'dzin ri rab dang 'dra ste mi g.yo ba'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa ste zhes smos te/ sdud pa dang 'byung ba'o/ /de la mnyam pa'i 'pho ba'i rim pas rgyu ba ni nyi ma rgyu ba g.yas pa'i sna dug go/ /mi mnyam pa'i 'pho ba ni rim pa ma yin pas rgyu bas na/mi mnyam pa ste zla ba rlung rgyu bas na sna bug g.yon pa'o/ /mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i yid kyis sems kyi khams la lta ba ni yongs su sgrol ba ste/ de lta bu'i shes pa'i don to/ /de ltar gyur pa'i yid kyis gal te mi shes na zla ba dang nyi ma mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par kyirgyu ba ni/ sems can gyi rnam par shes pa'i khams ni grol bar mi nus pa de spyi gtsug bar du 'gro bar mi 26—1604

nus pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ nag po dag gis gsungs zhes smos te/ nag po rdo rjes 'dod chags dang bral ba'i gnas skabs spangs pa'i bde bas ye shes kyi mig gis mtshon par byas pas na mtshon par dka' ba ste/thams cad stong pa nyid kyi phyir dang / rnam pa thams cad kyis mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /bde ba nye bar rtogs shing nyams su myong ba de'i phyir rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /de la 'di lha bur gyur pa cis rtogs she na/ gang gis yid kyi rin chen rtogs3/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba las yid kyi nye bar dmigs shing ji lta ba bzhin du 'gyur ba'i bdag nyid dga' ba ste/ bla na med pa'i bde ba 'phel bar byed pa'i phyir/ rin chen ni yid kyi rin po che ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan no/ /de ltar yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bha gar liṅga bcug nas ni/ /byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya/ /khams gsum ma lus pa rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dag tu bsgom/ /stong nyid gzugs brnyan rgyu yin pas/ /'bras bu mi 'gyur bde ba'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir lhan cig skyes pa spro zhes gsungs te/ nyi ma re re skyes pa ni ‘ )thams cad stong pa'o/ /'pho chob ni nam mkha' dang 'pho ( 3zhing snang ba'o/ /de ltar yang mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che/ /zhes gsungs te/de ltar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ bsnyen pa'i dus su gtsug tor che/ /'bad pas gzugs brnyan bsgom par bya/ /nye bar bsnyen pa'i dus su ni/ /gzugs brnyan bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i dus su lha yi gzugs / /bsgom zhing mi dmigs par bya ste/ /spub pa chen po'i dus su ni//26—1606

gzugs brnyan sangs rgyas gtso bo'i sems/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid bstan pa'i phyir rigs kyildan las kyang / dgongs pa bstan pa 'di skad gzhan gyi gtsug tor 1gzugs brnyan ni khams gsum ma lus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan 4nam mkha'i chos kyi 'byung gnas la sems kyi rdo rje rab tu gzhag pa ste/bsnyen pa'i dus su so sor sdud pa bsgom par bya ste/ bsam gtan gyis ni brtan par bya'o/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyi sgyudam bca' ba ni/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /nyi ma gcig tu yongs su brtag /gal te yid ches ma gyur na/ /de'i ( 3tshe nga yis brdzun smras so/ /zhes gsungs te/de yang yid ches pa'i du ba la sogs pa'i rtags so/ /de ltar yid du 'ong ba'i rin po che sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan rtogs pa 'byung ba de ni/ chos kyi rang bzhin dag ni de yis zhes gsungs te/ rang bzhin dag ni de yis shes pa ni //de gcig pu chos kyi rang bzhin mngon par rtogs pa'o/ /gzhan la bzlas su zin kyang ci la go/ /zhes pa ni/ gzhan ni dbang po'i bde ba la mngon par zhen pa'o/ /ci la go ni pya smras kyang mi go zhes pa'i don to/ /de nyid rnam pa gzhan gyis bstan pa ni/ rlung ni bzhon sgyupa'i rgyur gyur pas snang ba gsum gyi ngo bo nyid kyi rang bzhin brgya drug cu'i ngo bo nyid —dbang po'i sgo nas 'byung ba ste/yul rnams la nye bar dmigs par 'gyur ro/ /lam 'gro rang nyid bcings par byas pa gang / /zhes gsungs te/ rnam par shes pa'i khams 'khor ba'i lam du 'gro ba'o/ /yid ni lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs so/ /bcing bar bya ba ni gang gis yan lag drug gi bsroka brtan par byed pa ni bcings pa'o de rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gis byed pa de ni/ khams gsum ma lus spro zhing yang 26—1606

der bsdu/ /zhes gsungs te/ khams gsum ni sku dang / gsung dang /thugs kyi 'khor lo'o/ /ma lus pa ni so so'i ba spu'i bu ga'i bar du gnyid sad pa'i gnas skabs su dga' ba la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi byang chub kyi sems rnam par spros nas yang der sdud pa ste/ steng du song nas bzhi pa zad cing rgyu mthun pa la sogs pa'i bye brag gis/ a wa d+ma tīr sdud pa ste/ cha dang thig le phra mo las 'das shing thams cad stong pa nyid kyi khams la zhugs te/ des rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po mngon du byed ces bya ba'i don to/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ bde gshegs lha mo khro bo'i tshogs/ /srid pa ci phyir byed ces gsungs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / lha mo dang / khro bo'i tshogs la sred pa ci'i phyir byed ces bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dag spangs la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dus su gnas so zhes dgongs so zhes bya ba la dgongs pa 'di yin te/phung po dang skye mched la sogs pa dang / lus dang ngag dang yid dang /dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gdams ngag gis bde ba chen po ro gcig par gyur pa de ltar na'o/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor chen por gyur pa las/ /de la ①gzhan du gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor med do zhes bya'o/ /de lhar yang gsang ba'i rgyud las/yan lag kun bsgoms las 'das shing / /rtogs ༅dang rtog byed rnam par spangs—/ /cha dang thig le yang dag 'das/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ / zhes gsungs so②/ /de nyid gzhan gyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor du bstan pa ni/ gang gis lhan cig skyes pa brtan byas te/ /zhes pa lhan cig skyes pa ni lhan cig 'byung ④ba'i shes rab ste/ brtan pa ni phyir 'byung ba med par bya'o/ /mnyam par ro gcig pa ni dga' ba bzhi po gcig pas rang gi yid 26—1607

kyi rgyal po ni yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'o/ /de'i dus4nyid du ni 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /grub pa ni phyag rgya chen po grub pa ④ ste/ rdo rje 'chang chen po thob bo/ /de'i dus nyid du dus ma yin pa rgyud la gcig ces bya'o/ /de skad du yang dpal bde mchog las/ mtho ris mi yul sa 'og gi/ /skad cig gis ni sku gcig 'gyur/ /rang dang gzhan du rtog 1pa yis/ /skad cig tu ni gnod mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ rga dang 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dag ni med/ /ces gsungs so/ /phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo nyid bstan pa ni/ mi g.yo zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ mi g.yo ba ni byang chub kyi sems phyir mi 'byung ba'o/ /mi rtog pa ni nyams su sbong ba ro gcig pas/ de dang 'di ni rnam par rtog pa spangs pa'i phyir ro/ /'gyur ba med pa ni 'dod chags dang 'dod chags dang bral ba dag gis ci bya zhe na/de dag las grol ba'i phyir ro/ /skye 'jig spangs pa ni/ zla ba dang nyi ma bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /mdzes pa ni shin tu mdzes pa ste/ bde ba chen po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /snying po ni 'od gsal ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /deng 'dir zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni 'di nyid kyi phyir mya ngan las 'das par brjod de/ mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes sgras smras pa la/ yang dag pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yin te / mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de ji lta bu'i khyad par dang ldan zhe na/ gang la sems dang sems las byung ba med/ /ces gsungs te/ gang la ji srid sems ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sems las byung ba ni sems kyi rang bzhin brgya drug cu dang / thig les kyang ci'ang mi byed ⑫de lta bu'i rnam par rtog pa cung zad kyang mi 'byung ngo zhes pa'i don to/ /de 26—1608

nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ gang gis e waṃ rnam par shes gyur pa/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ de yang ji skad du/ lha'i dbang pos yongs su zhus pa las/ e ni stong pa'i rang bzhin te/ /waṃ ni thugs rje chen por brjod/ /thig le gnyis med sbyor ba'o/ /'di yi zung 'jug dran par bya/ /e ni ma ru brjod pa ste/ /waṃ ni pha ru shes par bya/ /thig le gnyis med sbyor bar 'gyur/ /de yi sbyor ba ngo mtshar te/ /e ni pad+ma nyid du gsungs—/ /waṃ ni rdo rje'i rang bzhin no/ /de las thig le'i sa bon 'gyur/ /de las srid gsum yang dag 'byung / /e ni shes rab nyid du 'gyur/ /waṃ ni thabs su yang dag brngod/ /thig le de nyid mi shigs pa'o/ /de las yi ge ma lus byung / /gang gis chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ /yi ge gnyis ni de nyid shes/ /de yis sems can thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 'gyur ro/ /'gro ba gang gis yi ge gnyis/ /de nyid mi shes rtag tu 'don/ /sangs rgyas chos la phyir 'byung ste/ /phyug po longs spyod spangs bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'dir de lta bu'i e waṃ yi ge shes pa ni rtogs pa ste/ gang gis shes pa de ni sangs rgyas rtogs pa'o/ /ma lus ni e waṃ gyi 13yi ge sna tshogs lus pa med pa ste/de nyid ྾ sna tshogs gcig gi ngo bo nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de ji lta bur gyur pa zhe na/de nyid chos kyi za ma tog yin te/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos rnams kyi 1phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams te dga' ba la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi za ma tog ni gnas so/ /de nyid bod pa'i tshig go/ /de ni rang gi bdag po'i cha lugs so/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang gi bdag po ni thugs kyi rdo rje'o/ /cha lugs ni rgyan no/ /de nyid kyis 'khyud par skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /yang de nyid 26—1609

kyis sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bstan pa ni/ rlung ni 'gro ba'i sgo rnams la'ang / /zhes gsungs te/ rlung 'gro ba'i sgo ni steng dang 'og go/ / dmar por ⑫ni de la brtan zhing mi byed pa'o/ /lcags ni sgo drug gi rlung kha sbyor du bya ba ste/zla ba dang nyi ma'i lam bkag pas dus kyi me yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di'i lus kyi 'ching ba'o/ /gal te nang gi mun pa nag po la/ /zhes gsungs te/gal te de la mi zad pa ni du mun pa ste mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin rlung bum pa lha bu'i ngo bo nyid gzhom du med pa'i sgra/ chos kyi dbang phyug yid kyi byang chub kyi sems kyis ②de'i tshe nyid bde ba chen po gsal bar byed pa'i phyir mar me'o/ /byed gyur na ni du ba la sogs pa'i rtags kyis gsal bar byed pa'o/ /de skad du yang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sems kyi rdo rje 'gog pa las/ /mtshan ma la sogs mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dis ni ngag bcing ba'obyu—/ /rgyal ba'i ④ rin chen steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyal ba'i rin chen ni gzhom du med pa'i sgra de nyid do/ /steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa ni gang gi 1 tshe rten du gyur pa drug pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi thig le la reg pa ste/ de la 'khyud pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar yang / /mkha' 'gro rdo rje nor bu ste/ sangs rgyas rnams ni spyi bor gnas/ /zhes gsungs te—/ 'dis ni sems kyi bcing ba'o/ /de ltar yang dpal kha sbyor thig le las—/ rlung dang me yi dkyil 'khor las/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i sa bon bskul/ /thig le sgra yis yang dag mnan/ /char rgyun 'bab pa dag tu dran/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar yang / thig le'i sgra dang yang dag ldan/ /gang tshe rnam 3kun 'gyur ba na —/ /de tshe 'bras bu zhes brjod par/ /mchog gi 26—1610

nol 'byor pa yis bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /des cir 'gyur zhe na/ji srid longs spyod pas thar sgrub ⑫nag pos gsungs te nag po rdo rje srid pa la spyod pa ste/ shes rab ni bde ba nyams su myong zhing 'dod chags bral ba thams cad las log pa'i phyir/ thar pa ni phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang thob pa ste mngon du byed pa'o/ /de ltar dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ srog ni dbus su bcug rgyaste zla ba nyi ma 'gro ba g.yas dang g.yon bcing ba/ /byang sems phyag rgya 'grogs pas mchog tu dga' bar 'grogs shing rdo rje bablang bar bya/ /chu skyes rdo rje sgra yi rang lag pad+ma'i rol pas bde ba phyir gsor pa'am/ /sa bon 'chor ba bde bcas 'jig ②pa spong byed de ni dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal/ /zhes gsungs so—/ /sems kyi bcing pa nyid kyis ④thams cad 'grub par bsams nas sems brtan pa nyid gsal bar ston te/ brtan ( 3pa'i yid kyis sbyor bas na/zhes gsungs te/ rdo rje pad+ma sbyor ba'i sgo nas byang chub sems brtan pa'i sbyor ba byed pa'o/ /de gang du zhe na/ chos kyi yi ge'i nang du ni/ /zhes gsungs te—/ chos kyi yi ge ni gzhom du med pa ste/ bdag med pa'i sa bon te/de'i nang du ni de la zhes pa'i don to/ /des cir 'gyur zhe na/ skad cig de las rlung ni 'gags 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs ༅ te/ rlung ni srog gi rlung ste skad cig de la 'gag pa'o/ /gzhan yang ci zhe na/ yul rnams la yang chags pa med par 'gro/ /zhes gsungs te/ yul rnams ni gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams so/ /nye bar longs spyod pa ni mngon par zhen pa med par 'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'on te chos kyi yi ge gang du shes par bya zhe na/ gang la mchog dang dga' bral dag thob na/ /zhes gsungs 26—1611

te / mchog dang dga' bral ni zla ba dang nyi ma'o/ /de gnyis kyi dbus su tsamathong ba ni de la chos kyi yi ge ste/ sngon bstan pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dbus su mtshon par bya'o/ /gang la 'di lta bu yi gdams ngag gsal grub na/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ 'di lta bu'i gsang sngags ni tshul gyis gdams ngag gis gsal bar grub ste/ yongs su rdzogs pa grub pa de'i tshe khyim bdag mo rlung mi g.yo bar bcings zhes gsungs te/ khyim bdag mo rlung gi sngon du bstan pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i che mi g.yo zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gal te 'di de la rtsol rlung bcings pas chos kyi yi ge bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje lha bu'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa gang la gnas par 'gyur zhe na/ ri bo mchog gi rtse thang spangs pa la /zhes gsungs te/ ri bo mchog ni rin po che'i ri bo ste/ de nyid sngon du bstan pa'i ri bo'o/ /de'i ②rtse mo ste/ ma lus pa'i rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba'i bde ba chen po nyid gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /thang spangs pa ni yan lag mchog gi thang ste spyi gtsug ste/ ri khrod ma yi sa der gnas bcas la/ /zhes pa ni ri khrod ma de lta bu'i bdag nyid grub pa'i chos kyi ḍa yi ge/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang gnas byas pa de de ni gnas byas pa'o/ /khyad par ji lha bu zhe na/ seng ge yis kyang mchong bar mi nus na0 / /zhes gsungs te/mchong mi nus pa ni gzhom par mi nus pa'o/ /gang gis she na/ seng ge dzini gdong pa lnga pa ste/ de nyid dkyil 'khor lnga'i bdag nyid kyi srog gi rlung seng ges gnon par mi nus te/ drug pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /glang po che yis smos ci dgoso/ /zhes gsungs te/ glang po che ni phyugs te/ nyi ma dang zla ba ste/ de dag gis thag ring por 'gom pa 26—1612

dang gsal bar ga la nus zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de ltar zla ba nyi ma phyugs chen po / /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir dgos pa ni zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du rgyu ba'i rlung la zhon pa'i rnam par shes pa'i khams nyid kyis thams cad las thams cad du thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid kyis gnas pa dang bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po rdo rje gnas kyang mi rtogs pa'o/ /de ltar yang lus skyes pa'i lus la nges par gang du gnas she na/ 'di yi rigs mchog dag tu 'di yi sa bon bstan/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshigs bcad byed dang gnyis ni rtogs par bla bas 'dir ma smos so/ /gong du ji skad bstan pa'i las kyi phyag rgya gang du mthong ba'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po rdzogs pas/ de bstan pa'i phyir/ sngags dang rgyud ni gcig kyang mi bya stegye/ /zhes gsungs te/gcig kyang bya 3mi bya ste/ gang mi bya zhe na/ sngags kyi bzlas pa ni gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa'o/ /rgyud ni rgyud klog pa'o/ /ci'i phyir de ltar yin zhe na/rang khyim bdag mo zhes gsungs te/ rang khyim bdag mo ni lhan cig rang snang ba'i ye shes lhong phyag rgya ste/ bzung ba ni bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis so//grol 'gyur ni yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyag rgya dang lhan cig skyes pa rnams kyis byed do zhes bya ba'o/ /de ltar yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las sems kyi snang ba tsam du yid las skyes pa'i me long gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bsten bya ma lus sangs rgyas lnga dang gras bcas rnams kyis sten de'i ye shes 'od zer bskyed/ /rang gi lus dang cas pa'i bdud rnams sgrib pa ma lus bsreg kyi /'dod chags la sogs bsreg cing lo gcig sbyor bas lus la ro mnyam bde ba ster/ /zhes gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das ma ri26—1613

de nyid la mngon du zhen pa'i rnal 'byor pa des/ sngags dang rgyud la 'dzin cing zhen par mi bya'o/ /'di'i don ni 'di yin te de nyid gang ste/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yid yin par bsngags ⑫so/ /de nyid du 'tshogs pa'i ka rgyu yin pas na skad kyi dbyings kyi rgyal po nye bar 'khor 'dzin pa'i phyir rgyud do/ /de la mngon par dga' bas thams cad byas pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /de ltar yang dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ sngags bzlas dka' thub med cing dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg med/ /de nyid sngags bzlas dka' thub sbyin sreg de nyid yin/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor pa dang dkyil 'khor nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /de nyid kyi don gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ de srid khyim bdag mo ni rang ②khyim gnas ma 'gyur / /zhes gsungs so/ /rang gi khyim ni thams cad stong pa nyid—/ sdig spangs kyi gnas ni rang gi — khrim mo/ /phyag rgya chen po ni khyim bdag mo ste/ ji srid du gnas par ma gyur pa ni thim par ma gyur pa'o/ /de srid 'dod yon lnga ste/ re zhig mngon par byang chub pa lngas sems can mang pos bsam pa'i bye brag gis zhal dang / phyag rgya dang kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa sna tshogs kyis 'ude ltar ji ltar gnas te mi gnas so zhes bya'o/ /de yang dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud las/ las kyi phyag rgya mnyam sbyor zhing / /ye shes phyag rgya sogs dmigs nas/ /phyag rgya chen po gcig sbyor bas/ /'byung med bde ba bde — 'phel 'gyur/ /kun du zhal dang phyag la sogs/ /kun du dbu dang spyan dang gdong / /kun du 'jig rten thos par ldan/ /thams cad khyab nas gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid lha rdzas kyi phyag rgya de nyid kyi 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i gdams ngag nges par bstan 26nga 614

cing yang de nyid bstan pa ni/ bzlas dang sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor las 'di yin//zhes gsungs te/ phyi rol du gyur pa'i bzlas pa dang / dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg gi las 'dis ni nyi ma re re zhing ci'i phyir gnas zhes bya ba ste/steng du kha bltas shing ci'i phyir ku re'i ngo bo nyid 'bras bu med ces bya ba'i don to—/ /'di rnams ci'i phyir don med pa yin zhe na/ de lta bu'i gzhon nu ma dang rtag tu ma mjal na zhes gsungs te/ de nyid rtaka tu gzhon nu ma la 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin yin pas/ de nyid lha rdzas kyi phyag rgya ste/ de la dba' rlabs med pa'i rtag tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i rim pa gang gis ②rjes su chags pa skye ba de dba' rlabs med pa'i mdza' bas so/ /lus 'di yin te byang chub ji ltar 'grub/ /ces bya ba ni/ byang chub kyi phyag rgya chen po ste/ de ji lhar 'grub ce na/ sngon du bstan pa'i e waṃ gyi yi ge'i lus med na mi 'grub ces pa'i don to/ /gang gis rtag tu lhan skyes bde rtogs na/ /zhes gsungs pa ni —go sla'o/ /gang gis rin chen sems ni brtan byas pa/ /zhes gsungs te/rab tu gtum pa'i gtum mo mes zhu bar byas nas⑤/ bskyod par mi nus pa'i phyir gang gis brtan par byas pa'i sems rin po che byang chub kyi sems so/ /ci byas nas zhes pa la/ rang gi khrim bdag mo blangs nas 'di zhes bya ba gsungs te / rang gi khyim bdag mo ni lha rdzas kyi phyag rgya de nyid de/ de la e waṃ gyi yi ge de la bde ba chen po'i gzugs bzung nas de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' mgon po ste—/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gtso bo ste/ de nyid — bod pa'i tshig go/ /mchog gi don ni bdag gis rab brjod na/ /bdag nag po rdo rjes mchog gi 3don ma bcos pa 'di brjod do zhes pa ste/ don 'di las gzhan med do zhes bya 26nga 1615

ba'i don to/ /de nyid dpes bstan pa'i phyir/ tshwa ni chu la zhugs pa ②bzhin du ni/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshwa chu la zhugs pa de bzhin du khrim gyi ༅bdag mo ye shes kyi ༅phyag rgya'i rang bzhin blangs pa'o/ /sems ni byang chub kyi sems te ro gcig par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje las/ khu ba'i rnam pa bcom ldan 'das/ /de yis bde ba 'dod mar brjod/ /ces gsungs te/khu ba dang bde ba de nyid kyang rten dang brten pa ngo bo nyid de dag thams cad stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du brngod pa bde ba mnyam zhing ro gcig pa de'i skad cig las 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ ji srid rten dang brten pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /de srid 'byung med bar du'o/ /sems ni 'gog pa nyid gyur ྾ nas/ /rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid med⑤/ /ces gsungs te/ de ltar yang kha sbyor thig le las/ sna yi bu ga rngo 3gnyis nas ni / /'jug pa bde ba dus zhes brjod/ /'byung ba bde ba dus yin te/ /de gnyis nyid ni gcig par grags/ /grogs med dag ni gcig pu ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dus nyid 'gro/ /srog dang thur sel mnyam gnas dang / /'byung dang 'jug pa rnam par spang / /'gro dang 'ong ba rnam grol ba/ /dus gcig tu ni de brjod do/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags ma yin chags bral lam/ /gnyis po 'dres pa gzhom du med/ /mar ni mar du zhu gyur pa/ /'dres par gyur pa rnyog med ltar/ /de zhin 'dod chakakhu bral ba lhar༅/ /skad cig la ni ro gcig 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gang gi 1de dang rtag tu gnas na ni / /zhes gsungs te/ gal te de gnyis phan tshun du'o/ /rtag tu gnas 26—1616

pa ni rgyun mi 'chad par de'i tshe yang 'di lhar 'gyur zhes pa'o/ /'di'i don ni de ltar bstan pa'i khams kyi khu ba dang ngo bo dag phan tshun rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o//gal te gzhan du 'gyur na/ khu ba'i ngo bo nyid zla ba'i rang bzhin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs ④pa'i sku'o/ /khrag gi rang bzhin nyi mar snang bas sprul pa'i sku nus par gnas pa'o/ /bde ba'i ngo bo nyid du gnas pa'i khyim bdag mo dang lhan cig tu byang chub kyi sems 'di gnyis ka'i sbyor bas gong bur gyur nas skye ba dang 'jig pa'i 'khor ba'i lam nas 'das nas/ ro gcig pa rgyun 'byung ba'i dpal te ru kar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang dpal kha sbyor thig le las/gang tshe mgron gnas chags chen po/ /zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas gyur pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku mchog yin/ /gang tshe rdo rje rtse gnas pa'i/ /de tshe longs ⑤spyod rdzogs pa yi/ /sku yang nus par 'gyur ba yin/ /pad+ma'i nang du gnas gyur 'dod/ /nyungs 1kar du ni rnam par grags/ /nyi ma'i gzugs su yang dag grags/ /sprul pa'i sku ru brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /de la spro zhing skye ba yi/ /pad+ma gar dbang rgyal po ni/ /pad+ma'i gtso bo ru ni 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpal nag po rdo rje'i do ha mdzod kyi 'grel pa paṇ+ḍi ta 'od dpag med kyis ④mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //26—1617

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra u pa de shaṃ/ bod skad du/phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag /dpal lhan cig skyes pa la phyag 'tshal lo /phyag rgya chen po bstan du med gyur kyang / /dka' ba spyod cing bla ma la gus pa'i//sdug bsngal bzod ldan blo ldan tsā ro pa/ /skal ldan khyod kyi snying la 'di ltar byos//kye ho 'jig rten chos la legs ltos dang / /rtag mi thub ste mi lam sgyu ma 'dra/ /rmi lam sgyu ma don la yod ma yin/ /des na skyo bskyed 'jig rten bya ba thong / /'khor g.yog chags sdang nye 'brel kun spongs la/ /gcig pu nags 'dab ri khrod dgon par bsgoms/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngang la gnas par gyis/ /thob med thob na phyag rgya chen po thob/ /'khor ba'i chos 'dis ②don med chags sdang rgyu/ /byas chos snying po med pas don dam snying po ltos/ /blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong / /byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rnyed/ /26—1621

blo 'das byar med don de thob 'dod na/ /rang sems rtsad chod rig pa gcer bur zhog /rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dngas su chug /snang ba dgag sgrub kyimi bya rang sor zhog /spong len med na phyag rgya chen por grol/ /dper na ljon shing yal ga lo 'dab rgyas/ /rtsa bcad yal ga lo 'dab khri 'bum skams / /dper na bskal stong bsags pa'i mun pa yang / /sgron me gcig gis nun pa'i tshogs rnams sel/ /de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal skad cig gis/ /bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus sel/ /blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na/ /rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud ༅la bor/ /lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis/ /rig pa dang la mi gnas bar du gcun ④/ /dper na nam mkha'i dkyil ni brtag byas na/ /mtha' dang dbus su 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems kyis sems la brtag byas na/ /rnam rtog tshor 'gag rtog med gnas gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub ⑤sems kyi rang bzhin mthong / /dper na sa rlangs sprin ni nam mkhar dengs/ /gar yang song med gar yang gnas pa med/ /de bzhin sems las byung ba'i rtog ④tshogs kyang / /rang sems mthong bas rtog pa'i dba' rlabs dengs/ /dper na nam mkha' kha dog dbyibs las 'das/ /dkar nag dag gis gos med 'gyur ba med/ /de bzhin rang sems sgyu kha dog dbyibs las 'das/ /dge sdig dkar gnag chos kyis gos mi 'gyur/ /dper na gsal dag nyi ma'i snying po de/ /bskal pa stong gi nun pas bsgribs pa mi nus/ /de bzhin rang sems snying po 'od gsal de/ /bskal pa'i 'khor bas bsgribs par mi nus so/ /dper na nam mkha' stong par kyirab brtags kyang / /nam mkha' la ni 'di 'dra brjod 26—1622

du med/ /de bzhin rang sems 'od gsal brjod gyur kyang / /brjod par 'di 'dra grub ces brtag 2gzhi med/ /dper na nam mkha' gang la gang gis brten—/ /de bzhin rang sems phyag chen rten yul med/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du glod la ( )zhog /bcings pa glod gyur grol bar the tshom med/ /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /chos rnams ma lus de ru ma 'dus med/ /lus kyi bya ba yo thong rnal mar zhog /ngag gi smra brjod ma mang brag ca 'dra/ /yid la mi sems la bzla'i ②chos la ltos/ /lus la snying po med pas sgyug ④sdong 'dra/ /sems ni nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsam yul 'das / /de dang btang gzhag med par glod la ④zhog /sems la gtad so med na phyag chen yin/ /de la goms pas bla med byang chub 'thob/ /dmigs pa'i yul med sems kyi rang bzhin gsal/ /bgrod pa'i lam med sangs rgyas lam sna zin/ /bsgom med goms pas bla med byang chub 'thob/ /gzung 0 'dzin kun 'das lha ba'i rgyal po yin/ / yengs pa med na bsgom pa'i rgyal po yin/ /⑦bya brtsal 0med na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin/ /re dogs med na 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /kun gzhi skye med bag chags sgrib g.yogs bral/ /mnyam rjes mi bya skye med snying por zhog /snang ba rang snang blo yi chos rnams zad//nu mtha' yongs grol lta ba'i rgyal po yin/ /mu med gting yangs bsgom pa'i rgyal po mchog /byar med rang gnas spyod pa'i rgyal po mchog /re med rang gnas 'bras bu'i rgyal po mchog /las ni dang po gcong rong chu dang 'dra//bar du chu bo gaṅgā dal bus 'bab/ /tha ma chu bran ma bu phrad pa 'dra/ /sngags su spru dang pha rol phyin pa dang / /'dul ba'i sde snod la sogs chos rnams dang //26—1623

rang rang gzhung dang grub pa'i mtha' yis kyang / /'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mthong mi 'gyur/ /yid la mi byed zhe 'dod kun dang bral/ /rang byung rang zhi chu yi dba' rlabs 'dra/ /zhe 'dod byung bas 'od gsal ma mthong bsgribs②/ /rtogs pa bsrung sdom dam tshig don las nyams/ /mi gnas mi dmigs don las mi 'da' na/ /dam pa nyams len nun pa'i sgron me yin/ /zhe 'dod kun bral mtha' la mi gnas na/ /sde snod chos rnams ma lus mthong bar 'gyur//don 'dir gzhol na 'khor ba'i btson las thar/ /don 'dis mnyam gzhag ma lus sdig sgrib bsregapa1 /bstan pa'i sgron me zhes su bshad pa yin/ /don 'dir mi mos skye bo blun po rnams/ /'khor ba'i chu bos rtag tu khyer bar zad/ /ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzod snying re rje/ /sdug bsngal thar 'dod bla ma mkhas pa bsten/ /byin rlabs 4 zhugs pas rang sems grol bar 'gyur/ /las rgya bsten na bde stong ye shes 'char/ /thabs dang shes rab byin rlabs ④snyoms par zhukas/ /dal bar dbab cing dkyil 'khor drang ba dang / /gnas su bskyal dang lus la khyab par bya/ /de la zhen med bde stong ye shes 'char/ /tshe ring skra dkar med cing zla ltar rgyas/ /bkrag mdangs gsal zhing stobs kyang seng ge 'dra/ /thun mong dngos grub myur thob mchog la gzhol/ /phyag rgya chen po gnad kyi gdams pa 'di/ /'gro ba skal ldan snying la gnas par shog /dpal tilbi pas rwa pa ro pa la chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du gsungs pa 4 rdzogs so// //26—1624

bsdur mchan/1621 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag bzhugs/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉smon ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradi/1622 ①〈〈pe 〉dzesha ra 〉〉bsgrub/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skabaskams/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bcud/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bcun/ ⑤〈〈be 〉྾po ra 〉〉wartog med gnas gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/⑦〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉ri 'od gsal/ ( )spu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgrib/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/162 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanadags/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾mu ra 〉〉pas/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉sku 'i/ du〈〈pe 〉skosha ra 〉〉 gasdu//pe/〉skon/sdu rdoXsdu/snar ༷/trīl 〉/྾snar 〉༄zung / ༅〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉ṅkayengs pa med na bsgom pa'i rgyal po 1624 ①〈〈pe 〉skosha ra 〉stanabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabag ②④〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stabarlabs/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉te lo pas nā/ du 〈〈the〉྾〈snar 〉 megs par/baḥkā 'bra~X ༵shā) mig26wa 1625

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ dṛsnyu saṃ k+ṣesta tsā ma/ bod skad du/ lta ba mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshang lo thams cad mkhyen nyid skyob pa'i gtso/ /'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lung dang rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /dngos don bsdus te gtan la dbab/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang rig sems ni gud na med/ /snang zhing gsal ba yin pa'i phyir/ /dper na rang rig nyams myong bzhin/ /gal te sems de ma yin na/ /'brel pa med phyir mi snang thal/ /de lhar kun rdzob gtan la dbab/ /chos kun sems la gnas zhes gsungs/ /chos kyi dngos gzhi sems nyid de/ /rig pa bzhi sogs kyis dpyad kyang / /dngos po sgra yi cha tsam med/ /dper na nam mkha'i pad+ma bzhin/ /de ltar yod pa ma grub phyir/ /med pa cung zad grub mi 'gyur/ /phan tshun ltos pa nyid kyi phyir/ /26—1626

tshu rol ma grub pha rol bzhin/ /yod med gnyis ka ma yin te/ /so so nyid du bkag phyir ro/ /gnyis ka med pa ma yin te/ /yod med dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir/ /lus can yang ni ma yin la/ /lus can min pa mi srid phyir/ /des na spros pa thams cad bral/ /de ltar don dam gtan la dbab/ /sems ni nam mkha' la gnas gsungs/ /rang rig spros bral de nyid kyang / /snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang / /de phyir snang stong dbyer med de/ /dper na chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /de ltar gnyis med gtan la dbab/ /nam mkha' ci la'ang mi gnas gsungs/ /rang bzhin spros bral de nyid ni/ /rig pa yin phyir gsal ba'o/ /rang rig min phyir mi rtog ste/ /rang rig rang la rtog mi srid—/ /rnam par rtog bya min pa'i phyir/ /sems de'i rang bzhin mi rtog nyid / /gsal ba mi rtog ye shes te/ /dper na bde gshegs ye shes bzhin//des na sems nyid 'od gsal la/ /sems ni ye shes yin rtogs na/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal gsungs/ /'on kyang sems de glo bur gyi/ /rnam rtog dri mas nyon mongs te/ /chu dang gser dang nam mkha' ltar/ /gnas skabs dag dang ma dag gnyis/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal sems de dang / /glo bur rnam rtog dri ma gnyis/ /gcig gam tha dad gang yin pa/ /shin tu zab pa chen po nyid/ /shin tu zab phyir mkhas pas dpyod/ /bshad pa yod kyang ma bris so/ /stong pa de nyid rig pa sems/ /byang chub sems kyang de nyid do/ /sangs rgyas rigs kyang de nyid yin/ /bde gshegs snying po de nyid de/ /ji bzhin pa yi ro myang bas/ /bde ba chen po'ang de nyid yin/ /gsang sngags zhes pa 'di nyid do/ /thabs dang shes rab de nyid la/ /zab dang rgya che de 26—1627

nyid yin/ /kun bzang yab yum de nyid do/ /nang stong dbyings dang ye shes las—/ /ye sangs rgya zhes de la bya/ /dri ma dang bcas rang rig de/ /de yang gzhan la mi ltos phyir/ /rang byung ye shes de nyid do/ /'khor ba'i dngos gzhi de nyid de/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang de nyid yin/ /dbu ma chen mo'ang de nyid do/ /mthong bar bya ba de nyid do/ /bsgom par bya ba'ang de nyid do/ /thob par bya ba'ang de nyid do/ /tshad ma'i bden pa'ang de nyid yin//rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu yi/ /rgyud ni rnam gsum grags pa dang / /gzhi lam 'bras dur grags pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni gnas skabs so/ /rgyu rkyen rtsa ba kun gzhi dang / /'khor ba ji srid phung po dang / /gzhan dbang shes pa la sogs grags/ /e ma ho/ sems nyid dri ma dang bcas de/ /rnam 'phrul 'gro ba drug la sogs/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' klas par/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor bsam las 'das/ /rnam rtog dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /rang rig spros bral de nyid ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang de nyid yin/ /sangs rgyas drug pa'ang de nyid do/ /rigs drug pa'ang de nyid do/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu'ang de nyid yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad de yin te/ /chos kyi sku dang bde chen dang / /zung 'jug ces pa de nyid do/ /bzhi pa'i dbang yang de yin te/ /lhan cig skyes dga' de nyid do—/ /rang bzhin dag pa'ang de nyid la/ /de la sogs pa mdo rgyud las/ /rnam grangs tha snyad grags pa rnams/ /phal cher de la brten pa yin/ /ji ltar rigs par sbyar bar bya/ /e ma ho/ sems nyid dri ma med pa de'i/ /rnam 'phrul gzugs skur bsdus pa yi/ /zhing khams rnam par dag pa dang / /26—1628

dkyil 'khor rnam 'phrul la sogs pa/ /ngo mtshar dngos gzhi de nyid de/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas khyab par snang / /rang sems de la rmongs pa yi/ /phyi rol mu stegs pa dag gis/ /bdag dang gtso bo la sogs zhes/ /grub mtha' log pa'i rgya mtshor zhugs/ /rang gi sde pa nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal sems tsam pa dag gis/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pa dang / /gnyis med yang dag nyid du rtogs/ /gzhan yang rnam bden rnam brdzun sogs/ /rnam rtog dra bar tshud par 'gyur/ /de ltar lta ba ma nor na/ / sgom pa dang ni spyod pa dag /dngos dang mthun pas byang chub thob/ /dkyus bstan pa yi rta bzhin no/ /lta ba dngos dang ma mthun na/ /bsgom dang spyod pa 'khrul 'gyur bas/ /'azas bu ji bzhin mi 'thob ste/ /dmus long dmigs bu med pa bzhin/ /don dngos rgya mtsho ltar zab pas/ /khron pa'i sbal 'dra bdag gi blos/ /dpyod pas gnying rnyed ga la 'gyur/ /nongs gyur mkhas la bzod par gsol/ /'di byas dge ba gang yin pas/ /skal ldan skye bo dam pa yi/ /'khrul pa'i dri ma rab spangs nas/ /rtogs pa'i shes rab skye bar shog/rje na ro pa'i lha ba ma dor bsdus pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o// //26—1629

bsdur ma na/1626 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing /chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉skosha ra 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bkur byas yod/bsdu/ 'bra~X shāsta) mig26wa 1630

khyab pa zhes bya ba/⑫༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ a lha 0ma hā mu dra tsā khyam/ bod skad du/phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye 'gag med pa'i chos nyid 'od gsal ni/ /smra bsam brjod med phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ /ngos gzungakadang bral yid la mi byed pa'o⑤//zab zhi ④'dus ma byas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ rdo rje dbyer med skye 'jig bral/ /drag pos ⑦khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad ( )'dul/ /mun khung gter la sgron me lhar/ /ma rig spubs nas ④rang rig gsal/ /chos kun rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ /sems nyid rang byung ye shes te/ /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs rgyal ba'i thugs/ /de nyid ji bzhin rtogs gyur na/ /sangs rgyas zhes ni de la bya/ /gdod nas gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ /grub med sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /de lhar 26—1631

rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gdal khyab sa tsal 'bad pa med/ /zag med rnam grol ngang du gdab— / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'di kho na/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs 'phro 'du rnams/ /ched du ma byas ngang nas tsashar/ /'od gsal chu bo'i dba' rlabs kyipa / /ngo mtshar rnam sprul pa —bsam mi khyab/ /de phyir chos rnams sna tshogs kun/ /ji bzhin ma yin 6ma bcos bzhin du snang ④ / /nyon mongs lnga sogs rang bzhin rnams/ /rnam grol ye shes chen por shar/ /de nyid mngon gyur brtan pa na②/ /mi zad rgyan gyi ⑨'khor lo snang ⑫/ /gnyis snang rnam pa mi mnga' bas/ /rang ⑫don rang bzhin lhun kyis grub/ /'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /'khor ba'i rnam rtog sna tshogs las/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang ye shes 'byung / /rang bzhin ma skyes yum gyi klong / /ma 'gags shar ba yab kyi mkha'/ /de ltar gnyis med bde ba ni/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i dgongs pa yin/ /bya byed rig pa'i rtsol mub rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug gsum 'di/ /lhun grub ma bcos sku gsung thugs/ /'dus byas phung po'i rang zhin ni/ /zag med rnam par grol nga dang che/ /sna tshogs snang ba'i 'khor lo 'diche/ /rang bzhin spyod pa sgyu ma'i grogs/ /gsang chen bla med theg pa 'di 6/ /thabs dang shes rab phul du phyin/ /snang dang mi snang gnyis su med/ /'dzin pa bral ba de tsam mo/ /ji bzhin ma bcos sems nyid la/ /ma yengs bcos bslad 3med par gnas/ /des na gsang ba'i snying po ni/ /tshig gi ⑫brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /rang lus dben pa'i dgon pa der/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i yo byad 'dzin/ /sems nyid 26—1632

rin chen za ma tog /chags bral nam mkha' ltar du nyu'achar/ /snang ba sgyur byed rnal 'byor pa/ / rin chen mdzes — pa sna tshogs la/ /'phrul dga' lta bur snang bas gyen/ /don du mi 'gyur yongs ma gsungs⑦ / /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba'i sems/ /rtogs par 'dod pa dgad ( bro sang / /khams gsum ye nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /'khor ba myang 'das gnyis su med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba rang gi rjesems/ /'bad cing rtsol ba'i nang dang bral/ /bde dang sdug bsngal dbyer med la/ /spong len mtshan ma 'dod pa ci/ /de nyid rang gsal 'dzin pa med/ /'dzin med grub mtha' lta ba bral/ /sems kyi she —me long de gsal ba/ /sngags 'chang dgongs pa mnyam pa nyid 4/ /rang la gnas pas gzhan du min/ /rgyun du gnas kyang gting rjedapag dka'/ /rtsol sgrub bral bar yongs la khyab/ /dngos su mthong ba bla ma'i drin/ /ma skyes spros bral sems nyid ni ⑩/ /kha dog dbyibs dang gnas rig bral/ /zab cing rgya che gsal bar ldan/ /brtan g.yo ma lus de lhar byos/ /'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas te/ /gsal bar yod kyang rtogs pa med/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen de/ /spubs na mkha' lding phru gu 'dra/ /dam pa mnyes byed skyes bu yis/ /bde ⑪gshegs dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i don/ /dug gsum sku gsung thugs su dag /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du rgyu/ /theg chen gsang ba'i dal 'byor gyis/ /spyod pa'i khyad par ci spyad kyang / /tshogs bsgyur tshilen med 'dzin dang bral/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i gsang bar zhugs//sku gsung yon tan phrin las la/ /'od gsal ye shes snyoms mdzad pa/ /bdag gzhan gnyis kyi ⑫'dod pa sgrub/ /thugs rjes khams gsum sgrol la 26—1633

brtson tsa—/ /rol pa'i ye shes dgyes pa las/ /thabs chen zab mo'i zeg pa spro/ /mi zad bsdu 6ba zung du 'jug /de lhar mnyam spyod ②rnal 'byor gyis/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nyikhri pas go ri shar ba'i ⑤rgyal po'i khab tu rnal 'byor pa la gdams pa/ rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba yi thi④ ⑦ sha /mthu can la gdams pa bzhugs/ ༅ da / /gdug ⑨pa tshar gcod ye shes chen po'i klong / /rab 'bar 'jigs byed te ru ka la 'dud/ /thabs dang ldan pa rnal 'byor chen po'i gzhung / /ma lus rgyal ba'i rjes su 'jug par bya༅//sdang ba'i sems can zhi bas ⑪mi 'dul ba/ /gnyen pos tshar gcod ⑫phrin las chen po'i lugs/ /bla ma la smod ⑫bstan la sdang sogs la/ /rang gzhan ⑫grol phyir bsgral ba'i sbyor ba tsam/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor chos kun ni—/ /ro gcig zhi bas sdug bsngal rgyu 'ams ⑫bcad/ /thabs ldan lcags kyus 'khor lo ⑫phung po dgug /thugs rje'i ⑩lcid mnan shes rab mtshon gyis dral/ /chu shing kha bye ma rig mun pa bsal⑫/ /ye shes 'od kyis 'byung ba rim par ༅ sbyangs/ /de sems gsal ba ⑫nyi zla'i gdan stengs su/ / a hūṃ sbyor bas 'od kyi ⑪sems dpa'i tshul/ /'og min gnas su ya ⑫yis rab tu bskul/ /gnyis med rgyal ba'i ⑫sras gyur rdo rje sems/ /rig pa'i dbang bskur gzhan don mdzad pa can/ /ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i dpe byad ④rnams kyis spras //phung po la sogs 'byung ba dbang po rnams/ /mchod pa'i sprin du phyogs bcu ⑫ khyab par spro/ /mnyam du sbyor bas de nyid nges pa yi/ /a yi rang bzhin thog mtha' med pa'i nang / / ta la mngon ( mtshon bris pa'i gzugs la blta/ /26—1634

hūṃ bltas phur bus bta bskor rtsad nas bcad/ /1phyag rgya'i snying po bdag po dgu 'das pas/ /go 'phang ster byed chags pas 0sdig pa sgrol/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel pa gsang ba'i thabs/ /dka' thub tshogs dang bral ba grub ༅pa'i lam/ /nyi zla'i rtsi 4 zin zhe sdang bde bar thim/ /nyon mongs dran rtog shes rab snang bar ༅gsal/ /goms pa'i sbyor ba legs gzhag bstan ④ pa yis / /rten med 'dzin pa bral ba ye shes lha/ /mnyam par sbyor bas ༄ 3zag med bde ba che/ /gnyis 'dzin bud shing me ltar rang tshig 'gyur/ /de ltar shes pa'i skyes du 'dzin pa dang / /'phel 'grib zag pa yod med la sogs pa/ /'ching grol khang 3 par sna tshogs snang ba kun/ /sgyu ma'i sbyor ba rgyal ba'i mdzad pas kyiganas/ /sbyor bas gdug 6pa ma lus bsgral bya zhing / /bsgral bas shā smo skye med dbyings su nges par sbyor/ /dngos po ⑫dngos med 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /spyod yul bral bas ⑫gsang ba'i lam mchog go/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i mthu rtsal ngan song lam/ /gnyis 'dzin zhen pas 'urang rgyud 'khor ba ste/ /de nyid med par grol ba srin po'i las⑫/ /yang dag don la gnam sa lta bur 'gyur/ /thams cad rang byung byang chub sems yin pas/ /'di nyid ma skyes phyogs ris cha shas bral/ /ma dmigs mi dmigs dmigs su med pa yi⑫/ /phrin las chen pos 6mi mthun dri ma sel/ /dgug dang bkug dang 'thab dang dgar ⑫ba dang / /'dren dang 'dzin dang 'khyil bar 0 bya ba ste/ /sbyangs ⑪dang spel ba'i las la legs brtsams pas pe/ /rgyun chad med pa'i bde ba chen por 'gyur/ /gsang mchog theg la 3dbyings la rab tu rdzogs—/ /phyi nang snod bcud ye shes chen po'i sku/ /gang gis dpag par mi 26—1636

nus bsam las 'das/ /rang byung mtha' dbus med pa snying po'i ②gsang / /dbang po dman dang rtog ge'i yul min zhing / /gang du 'ching ba'i las la spyad pas ༄ kyang / /de nyid grol ba'i mchog ster rgyal sras lam/ /'phro 'du med pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilpi pas—/ gyad kyi nor du'i grong 3 du mthu can la gdams pa phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba li thi 1 ro gru mkhan la gdams pa bzhugs/— da / kye ho ④sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsang ba'i gsung / /mdzad pa rnam grol ye shes chen po la/ / dgyes mnyam rol pas 1chos kyi phung po rnams/ /yid 'ong gru ru thub pas bka' stsal te / /gsang sngags bad yi tshig mthun ⑫bka' lung can/ /zab mo'i ⑫sgra sgrogs rnam dag sngags nyid de/ /lus can gdung ba sel ba bde ba'i sgra/ /grag 6stong gnyis su med pa zung 'jug dang / /snang ba sku la sgra tshig sna tshogs gsung / / mkhyen pa thugs la bya ba yon tan yin/ /mdzad pa phrin las ye shes rnam pa lnga/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang bzhin no/ /gru yi mkhan po mnyam gnas ngo bo'i sku/ /thams cad sprul pas 'phro bar khyab par gsungs / / ⑫de nyid dbyer med ngang du 'dus ⑫pa thugs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la mtha dad med pa yi/ /a yis ⑫drangs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi ⑫sgra/ /ngo bo skye med brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ /nga ro bcu drug rang byung ⑫dga' ba yin—/ /shes rab yum chen kho nyu rtenas 'dren pa'o/ /gsal byed 'dren pas mi 'byung tshig tu 'brel/ /thub pa'i dgongs pa lkog gyur mkhyen pa gnyis/ /26—1636

thugs rjes spro phyir gsal ba'i tshig tu brgyusasna/ /don chen ston pa glu yi tshig yin no/ /pho yis drangs nas mo yi rgyun dang ldan/ /gnyis med nga ro 1gsal ba mtho dang dma'/ /sems byung rgyun 1gcod ngang du gnas par byed//de'u yi — sgra ste 'dren pa gru yi rgyan༄ / /sgra yis yid mtshon tshig gikyi don la sbyor//dgyes pa'i rang rtsal mi mthun phyogs las rgyal/ /gsang sngags bden pa'i ngag tu byen gyis rlob 3/ /mi dmigs thugs rje mnyam pa'i dbyings las byung / /ye shes chen po sgyu mar zurang snang bas/ /zag med snyan pa'i nga ro bsod nams tshogs—/ /gsang ba'i dbyings las rab tu 'phros gyur pa pe / /dkyil 'khor mtha' yas rnams la rol pas rdzudabul/ /dbang po yul dus rags pa'i ⑪ tshogs rnams dang / /'byung ba shes rab byang chub rdo rje ste/ /lhag pa'i ye shes de bzhin nyid mchog la/ / skal ba tshimanyam pa'i mnyes pa chen po'otshi/ /de lhar glu yis 'jig rten gdung sel cing / /'jig rten 'das pa mnyes pa'i mchod pa ste/ /don du nges pa dag gi kyirig byed can/ /mkhyen pa'i 'jug sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /sdug bsngal bde bar sbyar bas mimathu stobs can / /nyon mongs rnam grol ye shes chen po'i lam/ / las las ye shes 'byung bas 8'dzin pa med/ /nges par sbyor bas rdo rje'i ⑫tshig gi glu/ /rang bzhin gnyis med dgongs pa mtha' yas ston/ /de yi rgyu nyid don dam blo las 'das//'bras du rol pa'i dkyil las 6rngam pa'i gdangs/ /mi dmigs thugs rje'i rtsal du rang shar ro/ /chos rnams ma lus sems su 'dus pa ste/ /sems las ma gtogs ⑫shes bya gzhan med pas⑫/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ye nas rgyal ba'i thugs/ /'pho 'gyur med pas 3'phel 'grib gol sa chod/ /rang byung 26—1637

dga' bas 'gro ba'i gdung ba sel/ /dngas ma rtser phyin mkhyen pa bsam mi khyab—/ /skye dgu'i bdag po tshangs pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /skyong ba'i glu mkhan tilbi 1pa yin no / /kye/ yon tan sgyu ma yin pas skyon la dngos ma grub/ /gnas la nges pa med pas 'pho 'gyur nyam mi nga / /sems la skye shi med de 'od gsal ngang / /dran rig sna tshogs ye shes rol pa'i rtsal/ /de ltar shes pas spang blang 'dzin pa med/ /rig pa'i ngo bo mnyam las ma g.yos par/ /dur khrod chen por smyon pa'i spyod pa gyis/ /rnal 'byor rnams la nga yis lung bstan no / /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilbi pas/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tshong dus mesu gru mkhan la gdams pa rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thi go /mu stegs la gdams pa bzhugs/ — da / / a i rnal 'byor chen po kye/ /gnyis su med pa'i bde ba ni/ /rang byung rtsol ba bral ba ste/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ngo mtshar che/ /thabs chen rnam gnyis ma bstan par/ /de nyid rtogs pa med pa ste/ /sems nyid nor du rin chen la/ /'dod pa med pa'i tshul gyis rtogs/ /shes rab lhun gyis grub pa yiche / /ye shes chen po bsam mi khyab/ /gnyis med lam gyi —'jug pa dang / /zung 'jug chen po rgyal ba'i thugs/ /sgrib med nyi ma gsal ba yis/ /dngos po ma lus snang bar byed—/ /don dam ye shes chen po lartsa/ /kun rdzob rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shar/ /mnyam nyid sems la goms pa ni/ /skyes bu seng ge lta bur bajid 6/ /pad+ma 'dam gyi nyes dang bral/ /mi dbang ma yi lto na gnas/ /sel med shes pa ma bcos pa/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yin/ /gnyen pos lobacos dang 26—1638

dgag pa med/ /rang lugs ye shes chen por gsal/ /mnyam pa'i gdeng dang ldan pa yis/ /dpa' bo mi mthun g.yul las rgyal/ /de ltar brtul zhugs spyod pa yis/ /rnal 'byor che la gnas par bya1/ /rma bya dug gis mdzes pa ltar/ /dpa' bo nyon mongs rgyan du 'gyur/ /rgyal ba gshegs yul 1phrin las bzhi/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pas shes mdzod/ /'dzin med ye shes chen po'i mes1 / /rtog pa'i bag chags sreg par byed/ /sgrib bral byang chub sems la ni/ /dri mas tsunam yang gos pa med/ /rin thang med pa'i pa nor du de/ /bsod nams phun tshogs dag la mnga'/ /ldan min sems kyi gter mdzod de/ /bla ma'i drin thob rnams la gsal/ /rig byed sems kyi rnam pa ni/ /man ngag rim pas — thag bcad de/ /rang bzhin de ltar yid ches pas/ /rnam par mi rtog don dam mo/ /chos rnams nam mkha' mtshon pa ste//ngo bo sems kyi ( yul las 'das/ /smig rgyu'i rgyu yang nam mkha' la/ /sna tshogs snang ba de ltar byos/ /theg mchog yangs pa zab mo'i lam/ /dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das/ /chos kyi dbyings su mnyam pa yi / /de nyid don chen blo la 'char/ /yod med sems kyi 4yul las 'das/ /re dogs 'dzin pa mtha' nas sangs/ /chos rnams du ma ro gcig phyir/ / sgom dang mi sgom brtsol ba bral/ /sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas pas/ /chos nyid gzhan du bsgom skumi dgos/ /yin par shes pa kyiblo thag chod/ /spangs thob yon tan de tsam rtsemo/ /rnam par rtog dang mi rtog kyang / /rang bzhin shes pas yongs 5mi nyams/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes pas ‘/ /rjes med bya lam bcos su med/ /mi mthun gnyen po dbyer med pa/ /de shes 'bad pa'i tsablo 26—1639

dang bral/ /mnyam gzhag khyachen po'i dgongs pa ste/ /gang la de yod rig pa can—/ /gcer bu ral pa'i gtsug phud can/ /las kyis 'phangs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'jig rten sa la mi dor ②zhing / /de nyid ye shes mthong ba med—/ /kun gzhi ཿrnam dag dkar po la/ /snang ba sna tshogs ri mo bkra/ /ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' yi bar/ /shes rab sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ /sprul tsam nyid na ma nges te/ /mnyam nyid rgyal po'i ngang la gnas/ /dbang bsgyur ye shes chen po ste/ /de nyid gzhan min bdag ⑤po nyid/ /sgra tshad lung gi mtshon cha yang / /skye med rang byung ngang nas shar/ /tshangs pa da nga phyug la sogs kyang / /yi ge 3shes par ma mthong ngo / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de//rtsol bas ring du spong shegyur pas/ /rtsol skyamed bla ma'i zhal las ni/ /legs nyes yoring thang bral ba ltos/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po nyilpi 6pas/rgyal po sang grags seng ge'i sgo drung du mu stegs pa la gdams pa chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya nga i thiskya// // ga /shan la pa gdams pa bzhugs/ dab/ /e ma sangs rgyas e ma chos/ /e ma gtum po 'imadzad pa legs/ /e ma gsod pa shin tu zab/ /sa sa sdug bsngal gnas nas bsgral/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig ste/ /gsal zhing dngas pa thugs kyi rigs/ /rdo zhing rtsub pas ⑫'jigs pa yang / /gang la bsnun pas 'joms par byed/ /ma skyes rdo rje ye shes kyang / /no zhing 'jigs 'ipa'i rang bzhin te/ /bsad 6cing phrin las drag po yis/ /gdug pa ma lus zhi bar mdzod/ /brtse zhing mkhas pa'i lngarnal 'byor pas/ /ci nus 26ba 1640

bsad 3pa'i sbyor ba brtsam/ /ngan song gsum du bka' stsal dang / /bsgral ba'i gnas lngar grags pa dang / /snying rje'i yul ni rnam pa gnyis/ /las dang dge bas ④ bsdus pa'o/ /rang bzhin ye nas rnam dag kyang / /ma rtogs nyon mongs dbang gis ni/ /khams gsum sdug bsngal myong 'gyur la/ / bsad pas thar par ⑤bya phyir ro/ /de yi rig pa 'og min nam/ /sangs rgyas zhing las mi ldog pa'i/ /gnas su nges par byas pas ni/ /yon tan ldan pa'i gnas su'o/ /chos rnams ci yang min pa las/ /snying rjes bsadakupar dam bcas nas/ /chos kun 'dzin pa'i shes rab kyis/ /ji ltar rtogs shing — goms pa las/ /yig 'bru 'od zer sna tshogs kyis / /sgrib pa sbyang ( 3zhing go 'phang bsgrod⑫/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ldan pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes gsad par bya ⑩/ /de yis chos kun don gcig ⑪cing / /de rtsal sgrib pa'i bag chags chosas/ /shes rab nying 'dzin dam tshig nye⑫/ /skye 'gyur dogs tshapa med pas bsad⑫/ /de bsad mchod pa'i khyad par gyis/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs mnyes/ /de 'ong kyisems can don bya ste / /sdug bsngal gnas bsgral bsod nams tshogs/ /rang sems khyad par dam tshig nye/ /bdag don phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ngan 'gro rnams kyi pasgrib pa sbyangs/ /bsad pas ⑫byang chub lam la bkod / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /de ltar shes rab chen po yis/ /dngos 'dzin rdul tsam ma dmigs la/ /thabs su ma gyur gang yang med/ /mnyam par shes nas ci dga' gyis/ /⑪ngang las ma g.yos snying rje yis/ /sna tshogs mdzad pa ston par byed/ /gsod pa'i sbyor ba goms 'upa yis/ / sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul shes nas/ /yod med 26—1641

dmigs pa las 'das pas/ /log rtog tsam la srog tu snang / /srog kyang med la gcad bya med/ /srog ni dngos por lta ba dang / /mtshan mar zhen pa rnams la snang / /de ltar mtshan ma bral ba dang / /snying rje'i blo can rnams la min/ /de ltar shes la spong len nam/ /'jug dang rtsol bas len mi 'gyur//sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod pa yis/ /de ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /shām lus rgyal ba'i sa la 'god/ /gtum po rang gi — gnas na 'gying / /dpa' bos g.yul las rgyal bar byed/ /nags kyi — mun pa me yis bsreg /dug mtsho'i sle dal bdud rtsis myos/ /sngon gyi thugs dam chen po yis/ /'jig rten 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor bas na/ /bsad pa'i sbyor ba shes par byos/ /gzhi rtsa bral ba'i skad cig la/ /yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul du snang / /bdag dang gzhan gyi rang bzhin rnams/ /rnam dag dbyings su tshul gcig go/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tikhri zupas/ rigs ngan gtum mo'i grong khyer du shan pa la gdams pa gsod pa'i sbyor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhes bya ba i thi1 // // ga /rig byed mkhan la gdams pa banugs/lo da / /dpal ldan thugs kyi gsang ba nas/ /rin chen sgron gyi 'od zer gyis/ /log rtog mun pa sel mdzad pas / /blo yi milegs spyad bsam bapar rigs/ /sngon sbyangs bskal pa mang po nas/ /rgyal ba mnyes byed dge ba bskrun/ /don dam pa yi skyarang bzhin ni/ /shes rab mchog ldan de la gsal/ /ye shes sgyu 'dra'i rgyal ba dang / /log rtog sgyu 'dra'i sems can yang / /sgyu ma yin phyir rang bzhin 26—1642

mnyam—/ /de lhar yongs shes 'gal ba med/ /shes rab chos skur tshul gcig cing / /thabs rnams gzugs skur tshul gcig pa/ /dbyer med dpyad 3du med pas na/ /sems las sangs rgyas nges par bya/ /de lta bas na bsgrub ( bya'i lam med cing / /'bad pa byas pa 1don med gyi na zhig /dper na dgra med skyes bu zhig /rang gi grib mas mi'ajikas pa lhar/ /brtabs phyapa'i 'khrul blo kyi can la ni/ /snying rje skye bar cis mi rigs/ /snying rje sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /thabs kyi — spyod pa cir yang ston/ /'khor ba spong bar mi byed cing / /thar la —'dod pa mi bskyed rtsakyang / /rang bzhin shes rab chen po yis/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa de ltar bsgoms( 1/ /chos rnams rang bzhin shes pa yis/ /rnam dag sems kyi mdabyings la rol/ /ngo bo stong pas rtag dang bral/ /rang bzhin bde bas michad pa med/ /ma bcos gzod 4nas rnam par dag /dbyer med zung 'jug sngags kyi lam/ /gnyis med spros dang bral ba'i phyir/ /ming tsam du yang mi dmigs so/ /mi lam skyes bus dug 'thungs lhar/ /srid las nyon mongs de ltar shes/ /dug gi tshosdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de tsam mo/ /rmi lam du yang nad bsal 1ltar/ /lam gyi rig pa de bzhin no/ /de nyid 'bras bu mi bslu bas / /ma rig gnyid log rnams la nges/ /'khor ba mi lam ltar shes pas/ /mi 'gyur bde thob rlob sems med/ /mtshan ma'i log rtog bral ba na/ /ye shes chen po chos kyi sku/ /bsod nams rgyal ba'i gzugs sku la/ /ting 'dzin dpe byad dag gis spras/ /rnam smin lus la tshul bzhin du/ /sku gsung 'byor pa 'bras bu'i mchog /dal 'byor shes rab 26nga 1643

ting 'dzin gyis/ /sems can thub pa'i spyod yul spyod/ /gnas med dmigs pa'i rdul dang bral/ /sems can khams la skye snab med/ /de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /mi bya ci yang yod ma yin/ /lus kyi spyod 3pa la sogs med/ /nam mkha'i ri mo bzhin du blta1/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ste —/ /sems dang sems snang tsam du 'dus/ /sems kyi rang bzhin byang chub la/ /byang chub kyang ni sems nyid do/ /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin de/ /nyan thos gang zag med par shes/ /rang rgyal zung kyidon med par shes/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa bgazung 'dzin med/ /dbu mas don dam den pa la/ /sngags kyi 3bden pa dbyer med rtogs/ /snang ba'i bag chags che chung gis/ /theg pa'i dbye ba bsam mi khyab/ /rgyu la ma brten (rdo'abras du ni/ /med ces thub pas 1mdo ru gsungs/ /rgyu med 'azas bur rtsedag pa ni/ /khyod kyi yul min 1bden pa'i bka'/ /chos rnams rnam par sgrub byed cing / /mtshan nyid tsam du dmigs pa kan/ /rigs pas 6gnod pa la sogs pa/ /dngos por lta rnams phan tshun gsal⑫/ /de lhar rnam par dpyad pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul la ni/ /phyogs tsam reg pa ma yin pasaskya/ /rgya mtsho chen po mjal ṇadang mtshungs/ /phyi nang snang srid chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gdod nas dag /lam gyis bcos nas bsgrub ⑩tu med/ /rtsol med lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /gser gyi gling na rdo med ltar/ /phyi nang bsdus pa'i chos rnams la/ /skyon zhes ming yang ma grub ste/ /thams cad rol pa'i rgyan du 'gyuraco/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tikhri 1 pas/ grong khyer pad+ma can gyi 3rig byed mkhan ⑪la gdams pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab 26nga 1644

pa zhes bya i thi3 // // ga /sgyu ma mkhan la gdams pa bzhugs/ 3 ra / /kye ho/ bzhin bzang 4rnal 'byor brtson pas ④nga la nyon/ /legs so legs so khyod kyi 4mdzad pa legs—/ /theg pa'i tshul chen thub pa'i gsung rab rnams/ /sgyu ma lha bur rgyal bas 3rab tu gsungs/ /chos rnams thams cad sgyu ma smig sgyurgyu dang / /rmi lam gzugs brnyan sprul pa lta bu ru/ /legs par shes na nyon mongs spang du med—/ /rang grol ye shes thub pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /khyod kyis de'u shing bu la sogs la/ /sbyor ba goms pas 0sngags kyis brdzun pa na/ /skyes pa bud med rta dang glang po sogs/ /gzugs brnyan sna tshogs snang ba 'byung ba na/ /dang po gang nas kyang ni ma byung la/ /snang ba'i tshe na sgyu ma yin pa'i phyir/ /mtshan nyid 1gang yang yod min sgyu ma bsdus pa na/ / 'gags shing ⑩mi snang gyur tshe gang du'ang song ba med/ /bsdus te ⑩mi snang gyur kyang skad cig rgyud ⑫ma chad/ /de ltar snang dang mi snang gnyis ka'i skyamatshan nyid med/ /gcig gnyis 6yin phyir ji srid rkyen nyid dang / /nye bar gnas par snang tsam mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /de bzhin smig rgyu zhes bya 6mtshan nyid kyang / /sa phyogs tsha sgo can la nye bar gnas / /nyi mas gdung tsadang ser du'i 'jol phyogs 'bab/ /rgyang nas bltas 6pas chu klung gang bar mthong / /de nyid byung dang 6snang ba 'gags pas kyang ⑩/ /snang dang mi snang dbyer med mtshan nyid gcig༅ /mi lam zhes bya skyes bu gnyid log pasabyu/ /gnyid nang kun dga' ra ba skyed mos ⑫tshal/ /longs spyod sna tshogs mi zhing sasnang gyur kyang / /btson ra khri mon sdug bsngal sna 26—1646

tshogs snang / /skye dang gnas dang 'gag par 'gyur ba'i rtatshe/ /don gyi ⑤cha gzhan bsgrub 1par byas pa med/ /gzugs brnyan zhes bya me long dag pa la/ /sna tshogs gzugs su snang bar gyur pa na④/ /skye 'gag la sogs rnam gzhag gzhan med pas/ /snang dang mi snang dbyer med mtshan nyid gcig /sprul pa zhes bya ye shes ting 'dzin nam/ /rig sngags grub pa'i mthu las byung gyur pa//me tog kha doka dbye ba'i rnam pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs snang bar 'gyur—/ /de bzhin phyi nang dngos po sna tshogs snang ba dag /ji srid gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa yis/ /bag chags dbang gis nye bar gnas pa de srid du/ /dngos po sna tshogs snang ba 'byung bar gyur pa rnams/ /dang po byung tshe gang nas ma byung la/ /snang tsam nyid na bag chags dbang gis snang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi — bag chags zad pa na/ /mi snang gyur tshe gang du'ang song ba med/ /khyod kyi sgyu ma sems dang sems byung dang / /tshor ba 'du shes nye bar mi spyod cing / /'gro ba'i phung po sems dang sems byung dang / /tshor dang 'du shes nye bar spyod pa can/ /mgo mi mtshungs zhes yid gnyis byed gyur na/ /mtshungs par gyur pa'i sgyu ma la sogs pa/ /drang srong dag la bha le bcol ba 'am/ /bzang po'i sgyu mas ⑩thub la gdugs tshod phul/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa sgyu ma'i snang ba yis/ /bye brag gyur pa med de mgo mnyam mo/ /smig brgyu dag kyang nyams kyi ⑫'du 'phro yis/ / lam gyi ⑫bya ba byed kyang chemago mnyam mo/ /mi lam dag la lha yis tshilung bstan nas/ /ma 'ongs dngos po ston te bye brag med/ /gzugs brnyan pra ⑫yis sngags las grub pa yis/ /lkog gyur rkun mo'i gzugs mthong tha dad med/ /sprul pa 'gro 26—1646

ba'i don du rgyal bas kyisprul/ /bskal par gnas te mdzad pa sgrub pa yod —/ /lo zla skad cig sna tshogs snang ba yang / /sprul par rtogs te bye brag mtshungs pa'o//de ltar sgyu ma 'dra ba'i dngos po sna tshogs chekun/ /'byin dang sdud —dang 'phel bar byed pa yis/ /de ltar de la sdig pas yongs mi gos/ /bsod nams dag kyang de bzhin shes par bya/ /gang la sdig dang bsod nams gnyis med pa/ /de lhar gyur la byang chub rab tu che gsungs/ /chu yis gnod la gzings kyis phan pa skrubasgyu / /chu med gyur tshe gzings kyis dgos pa med/ /de bzhin gnas ngan len gyis gnod kyi bar/ /sgyu mar shes pa gang la yod pa phan—/ /gnas ngan len gyi gnod pa bral ba na/ /bsod nams sgyu ma lta bus dgos pa med/ /sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin mnyam pa ste/ /chos noms thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /rang bzhin 'od gsal gzod nas 'dus ma byas/ /sgyu mas gos min 1—ye nas sangs rgyas so/ /de ltar shes nas bdag dang kyidabyer med pa/ /phung sogs sgyu ma tsam du snang ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs par shes pa'i skyablo ldan ni/ /lam gyi mchog tu rgyal bas rtarab tu gsungs/ /de ltar khyod kyi bya ba'i bachos mtshon dpe/ /bden pas — stong pa'i cho nyid gang yin de/ /nges pa'i skyadon du yang dag stong par rtogs//chos kyi dbyings yin rnam par dag pa'i ngang / /'gro ba sgyu mas lalam yang der gshegs ⑩nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma lta bus — don byed shog /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tikhri rtsa pas grong khyer grags pa skyong du sgyu ma mkhan la gdams pa dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab ces bya ba rdzogs so// // i this ma pa tha 26—1647

ga /smad 'tshong la gdams pa bzhugs/༅ ma /a ②ho srid rtsa ②bde ba che / /sems can kun gyi rang bzhin ni ④ / /gnyis med bde bas 3tshim gyur pasab / /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor gsal/ /thabs chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dag /rol pa bde ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /phrin las mdzad pa'i dgongs pa las/ /dus gsum mnyam pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ /thabs kyis bskul bas shes rab chags/ /de bzhin shes rab bde zhen sel/ /gnyis med rol pa'i ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rdo rje dbang ༅gis stobs ldan pas/ /'khor lo bzhi dang srog shing gsum/ /me rlung thabs ldan sbyor shes pas1/ /ye shes nam mkha' lta bu ⑫mthong / /gang de thabs las byung ba ni 3/ /gnas bcud thig le mi dmigs pas / /bde chen thig le'i stobs las byung / /byi dang rang gi mtshan nyid gsal/ /phung sogs 'jig rten brtags pa kun/ /rang snang sgyu mar snang tsam las/ /phyi nang bden gnyis mnyam sbyor bas/ / ma 'dres ⑫gcig dang du ma bral/ /bde chen thig le rang byung las/ /man ngag ldan pas ⑫rgyas btab pas/ /ma rig gnyis 'dzin la sogs dang / /dman pa'i theg pa ring du spangs⑫/ /'dzag dang 'phar dang 'bar ba dang / /'dar dang rgyug dang sgra sogs dang //rang gsal nyamangon shes 'chi med sogs/ /skye med nam mkha'i rang bzhin gsal / /rtsa dang rnam shes rgyu ba ⑫las/ /mi dmigs brjod med gang goms pa/ /grangs las 'das pa'i ye shes kyang / /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor kyimathong / /rang byung bde ba thob ⑩ mtha' med/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bde ⑫mthong zhing / /thig le rang shar sprul pa yis/ /mdzad pa'i rnam 'phrul bsam 26nga 1648

mi khyab/ /bde chen theg par grol ①ba yis/ /bstan pa'i rim pa mtha' yas kyang / /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /thig le chen po'i ngang las 'byung / /dug gis 0dug nad bsal ba ltar/ /'gro ba chags pas 'dul ba ste / /skyes bu thabs kyis bder 'jug pa/ /pad+ma la ni 'dam bzhin no/ /bskyed ཿpa thabs kyi ④'od zer gyis/ /a la ba cung zad bde bas 0reg /rang byung gsang ba'i lam du dril3/ /rang rang 'khor lo thim par byed/ /ma lus bde bar shar ba las/ /'khor ba'i bag chags ma lus sangs— tha dad la sogs chos med de/ /skye med bde ba'i snying por gsal/ /'chol pasprin gyi 6dum bu dang / /nyi zla sgra gcan rngomakha' la 'du/ /drag po pho brang sgo la srungs⑫/ /mgo med rang gi gnas na 'gying 6/ /stobs kyis gnas sa'i 8ga'u sbyor/ /zla ba nam mkha'i dbyings su bstem/ /nyi mas ⑫bkod pa'i chu g.yo zhing / /seng ge 'dur bas lam 'phrang bsalasku/ /'phen dang sdud par byed pa dang / /gyen du 'gro dang thur la bskul⑫/ /'khor lo bzhi la rgyas 'debs 8pas/ /bde ba chen po lhun gyis grub/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa rnams/ /gdod nas grub par gnyis su med/ /ma lus bde ba'i gzugs su shar/ /gsang chen mi ldog rigs su nges/ /'gro la gsang lam 'di bstad pa⑫/ /me tog la ni chu bzhin du/ /shes rab gsum la goms pa yis—/ /gsang ba gsum la spyad par bya/ /thabs chen ldan la mngon sum ste//gnyis med thig le 'phro 'du med/ /mnyam pa chen po mchog gi dbyings/ /thabs shes gnyis med rdo rje'i lus/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /dpag med log par 'khyams tsopa rnams/ /thabs kyis ma skyes pa la bkod/ /'chi 26—1649

7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gsung / 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈sha ra 〉thasal/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉sgyu ma/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉thargyan gyis 'khor lo/ /(〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thog 0〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉bden/1649 7〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉skaragro/ ༅〈〈pe mi'i〈snar 〉stan/ ③〈〈pe 〉rasha ra 〉〉skyed/ ④〈pe mi'i'adir 〉8sa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ ༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉staba'i/ ⑦〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉stagol/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snaspangs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉4)sa/ ༅〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉can/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toras bsrungs/kye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)sa gnas nas 'gyings/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ co〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉todakyil du stem//nyi ma'i/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba'i lam 'brang gsal/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabathur la skus/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉ma bas/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas / /6〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stapo'i mchog gis/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshog ma/165 ༅〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉po'i/ ༅〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉mi'i/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ཿ lo/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa/ mi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉 / nya〈〈pe 〉྾0mir 〉〉waska /smad 'tshong la gdams pa bzhugs/sa go/a ho srid rtsa bde ba che// — bde ba chen po zhes bya ba mi thi// //(zhes pa'i g.yung drung gi rtags bar gyi yi ge 'di rnams deb 'di'i ldeb 1634pa'i bsdur mchan shi par dpe bkur byas yod/)bsdur 'azas re'u mig da/ (1141)26wa 1654

bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu/ 3 ma / /rgya gar skad du/ / sa na sa ra mā na ni yā — ṇi ka ra nā ma saji ti1/ bod skad du/ 'khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i glu/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo / /e ma'o/ /'du byed sdug bsngal 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /sdug bsngal sdug bsngal la sogs brgya rtsa bcub/ /sdug bsngal kun las skyob par mdzad pa yi/ /sman pa'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /'khor ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pa dang las/ /nyon mongs khams gaspum gnas ni dgu bcu brgyad/ /zag pa'i chu bo sbyor ba nye bar len/ /rgyu dang yul dang sbyor ba'i stobs kyis byung / /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /sna tshogs 'di dag las las byung / /de yang nyon mongs stobs las byung / /dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan/ /mthong la myong dang skyes nas myong / /26—1666

gzhan du myong dang ma nges pa'i/ /dkar dang gnag dang 'dren ma'o/ /'khor ba'i las ni spru gang dang / /nye ba gang dang goms pa gang / /sngon byas/ gang yin de las ni/ /snga ma snga ma rnam smin 'gyur/ /grogs dag soms shig thog ma med pa nas/ /ma rig la sogs bcu gcig rga shi'i mtha'/ /yan lag bcu gnyis cha gsum zo chun tshul/ /nang gi rten 'brel yang dang yang du 'khor / /tshe rabs tshe rabs grangs med de dang der/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyis yang dang yang du gdungs/ /'khrul nas 'khor gyur 'khrul cing 'khor bar 'gyur/ /kyi hud srid pa'i lam byis dub pa'i 'gron po rnams/ /sdug bsngal bde bar bzung nas mi skyo ba1 / /khyed yid de la rtag tu chags byed pa/ /phyugs dang khyad par med par bla ma gsung / /bla mas zin pa'i skye bo ②mkhas pa dag /skad cig skad cig 'gro ba lnga po kun/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal tshor ma zug 'dra la/ /rus pa'i gting nas snying rje su mi skye/ /las ngan dbang gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /yang yang skye zhing yang yang rga dang na/ /yang yang 'chi 'gyur 'di ni mi sems par / /yul la chags byed bdag gis ji lhar bya/ /grogs dag srid pa gsum nang gnas pa kun sdug bsngal/ /de yang mi yi sdug bsngal bdag gis mthong / /mngal gyi sdug bsngal 'di lta bu ru gnas/ /nur nur mer mer gor gor nar nar po/ /ltar ltar mkhrang dang rkang lag rim gyis rdzogs/ /nu zho mar gyis gso byed cing / /shin tu nyam chung gan rkyal nyal/ /byis pa dar ma lang tsho dang / /rgas pas slar yang byis par 'gyur/ /tshe ni mi rtag shin tu g.yo ba ste/ /yud tsam sdod pa'i mthu yang yod ma yin/ /bdag ni 26—1666

nges par 'chi 'gyur mi sems pa/ /grogs dag skyes bu de ni ngo mtshar che/ /'khor ba'i skyon dang nyes dmigs mi shes pas/ /phyin ci log pa bzhi la gnas nas su/ /bdag ni nges par 'chi 'gyur mi sems par/ /yul la mngon zhen nyin mtshan don med 'das/ /'dzam du'i gling pa dus min 'chi bas te/ /nges pa can yang zad par 'gyur bas na/ /yang dang yang du nges par 'chi'o zhes—/ /bsam par rigs so kwa'i bzhin bzang dag /so ga me tog rgyas pa'i dus 'di byung bar gyur ༅/ /zla ba gsal bas mtshon pa'i ston dus 'di 'byung zhes/ /skye bo thams cad dga' 'gyur bdag gi tshe 'di ni/ /zad par 'gyur zhes shin tu mi dgar 'gyur ba med/ /de ring 'di bya ④sang ni 'di bya de nas 'di dang 'di ②bya zhes/ /srid pa g.yo ba'i rang bzhin ma shes don med yid brtan tshol byed pa'i/ /skye dgu 'chi bdag gi ni chu srin khar ni gru ni zhugs pa ltar/ /bya ba mthar ma phyin par yul gyi chu yi dba' klong nang du lhung //'di ni sang bya 'di ni thang cig 'og tu bya/ /'di ni de'u re bya zhes skye bo sems pa na/ /gshin rje be con lag thogs zur gyis lta byed cing / /mig rtsa dmar khros ma rungs gad mos re snyam 'debs/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos ④thams cad dang / /sbyor ba du ma rab shes kyang / /deng bya sang bya zhes smra zhing / /bsam dang ldan pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /tshe 'di gnod mang ⑤rlung gis btab pa ④ yi/ /chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sang khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /tshe ni yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa lhar/ /rang gi 'dod pa 26—1667

dang la blang bar gyis/ /kye kye ka'i grogs po dag /'jig rten spyod pa dab la phar bltas 2na/ /byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /ci la bsams kyang phan par mi 'gyur bas/ /rang gi sems la lta ba goms par gyis / /kye kye kwa'i grogs po dag /tshad ma bdun dang brda sprod ②rnam pa bzhi / /mngon pa dang ni yo ga tsar+ya'i sa/ /mdo sde dang ni 'dul ba mngon pa dang / /gzhung du bkod pa ma lus thams cad kun/ /ma mthong ma mnyan ma bshad ma bris zhes/ /de la gdung ba ma bskyed bzhin bzangs dag /bla ma'i man ngag ces bya bdud rtsi'i ro/ /gang gis sems mnyam 'jog pa de tsam zhig /yongs su btsal gyis 4gzhung mangs ci zhig dgos/ /thams cad yid ni 'khrul par byed pa'i rgyu/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'di nges pa med pas na/ /pha ma la sogs pha mar ma zhenges pas/ /nye du 'brel pa dag la chags pa spangasadzi//dgra yang ma nges de la sdang ba spangs— / /nad med lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa dang / /'dod yon lnga la rang bzhin gyis chags spangs༄ / /rnyed pa dang ni bkur ste 1grags pa dang / /rigs dang rus dang tshigs su bcad pa spangs/ / slob ma yang slob chos kyi 'brel pa spangs/ / kye kye kwa'i grogs po dga'ajig rten stag snartasprul me dang dug 'dra bar/ /bsams nas spangs te dben par gnas par bya/ /bud med mtshan nyid skyes pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /sman dang glang chen brtags kapa'am gza' skar rtsis/ /mtshon cha brtags pa'am rta dpyad rang bzo 'am/ /bstan bcos rangan pa slob dang klog pa spangs//yul la mngon dga'i sems ni byung ba dang / /rnam rtog de dag rnams ni byung ba nas/ /bdag ni nges par 'chi ba dran byas la/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i 26—1658

gnyen po rnams kyis bzlog /rnam rtog mang ba dbugs bgrang pa yis gzhil//'dod chags sems byung rnam par rtog pa de/ /rang bzhin mi gtsang keng rus blta bas bzlog /zhe sdang la ni byams pa'i chu yis btab3/ /gti mug la ni rten 'brel lam gyis so/ /mi gtsang ba dang byams pa rten 'brel gyi/ /man ngag bla ma'i zhal nas 'byung bzhin bya/ /'khor ba la yid ches par 'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gru/ /slob dpon —dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba rgya brtson seng ges bi ka ma 5la shī la'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o/ /slad nas bla ma de nyid dang / lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gtan la phab pa // //bsdur mazan/1655 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa lhar bkod cing / dz+wa〈pe 〉5khor ba las yid nges par 'byung bar byed pa rmes bya ba'i glu bzhusas so// 8‘pe 〉'a sa ra mā na ni ya 8‘snar 〉ma'i da ra mā na ni ya/ 〈dz+wape 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉te/ dz+wadz+wape 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉ragu/1656 —dī— byedashādī/ 〉 zung nas mi skyob pa / (〈snar 〉 sungs/ dz+wa2pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉༅sa/ dz+wape 〉〉1654 1dz+wa〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉 gyur / dz+wa‘pe 〉〉〈(snar 〉zas / 〈dz+wape 〉〉(dz+wasnar 〉〉dang 'di/ —dz+wadz+wape 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉〉chos1 na‘dz+wape 〉 ‘snar 〉sha sanod ma/ dzi〈(pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༅dra/1658 18dz+wape 〉〉82snar 〉7sa/ dz+wa‘pe 〉〉dz+wadz+wasnar 〉 sam/ 〈dz+wape 〉〉(‘snar 〉༄rda' spro/ (‘pe 〉〉〈‘snar 〉41/dadz+wadz+wape 〉〉8dz+wasnar 〉〉ma/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉ang/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈‘snar 〉 ste/ 〈dz+wape 〉〉dz+wa〈snar 〉〉slob ma yang slob chos kyi 'bre' pa spangs/ (‘pe 〉〉dz+wa8snar 〉7ga radadz+wadz+wape 〉〉(‘snar 〉༅sam/ rngo(‘pe〉〉26nga 1669

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ dhasmyo ṅgā tu sa ra gri ta/ bod skad du/ chos kyi dbyings lta ba'i glu/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig kun du ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshang nas/ /chos dbyings lha zhing gzhan min pa/ /de dag rim bzhin brjod par bya/ /zab zhi spros bral de bzhin nyid/ /'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa gang / /ma skyes ma 'gags gzod das dag /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yis/ /chos dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa/ /blo mig zhib mo rtog bral ba/ /bying — rgod rab rib med pas blta/ /gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de nyid bya ba byas pa las/ /dag pa de ni mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /ji ltar 'o ma dang 'dres pas/ /mar gyi snying po mi snang ba/ /de bzhin nyon 26—1661

mongs dang 'dres pas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi mthong ngo / /ji ltar 'o ma rnam sbyangs pas/ /mar gyi snying po dri med 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyon mongs rnam sbyangs pas/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med 'gyur/ /ji ltar mar me bum nang gnas / /cung zhig snang bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin nyon mongs bum nang gnas / /chos kyi dbyings kyang mi snang ngo / /phyogs ni gang dang gang dag gnas / /bum pa bu ga btod tugyur pa/ /de dang de yi phyogs nyid nas/ /'od kyi rang bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe ting 'dzin rdo rje yis/ /bum pa de nyid bcag gyur pa/ /de tshe de yi nam mkha' yi/ /mthar thug bar du snang bar byed/ /chos kyi dbyings ni skye ma yin/ /nam yang 'gag par 'gyur ba med/ /dus rnams kun du nyon mongs med/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri ma bral//ji ltar rin chen bai ḍūr+ya/ /dus rnams kun du 'od gsal yang / /rdo yi nang na gnas gyur na/ /de yi 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis bsgribs pa'i/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med pas/ /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /ji ltar spun pas g.yogs gyur pa/ /so ba 'bras nyid mi 'dod ltar/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pas/ /de ni sangs rgyas zhes mi rtag /ji ltar spun pa las grol na/ /'bras nyid snang bar 'gyur ba ltar / /de bzhin nyon mongs las grol na/ /chos kyi sku nyid rab tu gsal/ /ji ltar sprum ma'i lto na bu/ /yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pas/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis g.yogs pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyang mthong ma yin/ /chos dbyings gang phyir bdag ma yin/ /bud med ma yin skyes pa min/ /gzung ba kun las rnam grol bas/ /ji ltar 'dzin par brtag par bya/ /mi gtsang mi 26—1662

rtag sdug bsngal zhes/ /bya ba gsum pos sems spyod byed/ /stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji skad gsungs pa ste/ /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs ldog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /mchog tu sems ni sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos ni rang bzhin med pa yin/ /ji ltar ri bong mgo yi rwa/ /brtags pa nyid de med pa ltar/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyang / /brtakas pa nyid de yod ma yin/ /phra rab rdul gyi ngo bo nyid/ /glang gi rwa yang dmigs ma yin/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /de la ji zhig brtag ༅par bya/ /brten nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / /brten nas 'gag par 'gyur ba dang / /gnas pa dag kyang yod min na/ /byis pa ji ltar rtog par byed / /chos dbyings rang bzhin nam mkha' yin/ /khams ltar rgyu med rkyen med de/ /skye dang rga dang gnas pa dang / /'jig pa med pa 'dus ma byas/ /sangs rgyas chos dbyer med pa dang / /de rigs de bzhin thob pa dang / /brdzun med slu med 'tshe med pas/ /gdod nas rang bzhin zhi nyid do/ /gang phyir de ni rgya mtsho lhar/ /sgra dang dpe dang blo rnams kyis/ /gting dang pha rol mi rnyed pa/ /de phyir rab tu zab pa nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med phyir/ /lha ba tha dad rung ma yin/ /'on kyang blo yi bye brag gis/ /lta ba spru dad cung zad brjod/ /dbu ma nyid du smra ba rnams/ /de don bden pa gnyis su 'dod/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam mo/ /bden gnyis rnam dbye shes pa dag /thub pa'i bka' la mi rmongs te/ /de dag ma lus tshogs bsags nas/ /phun tshogs pha rol 'gro ba nyid/ /bdag dang bdag gi rtag chad dang / /nyon mongs rnam 5byang rgyu 'azas dang / /gzung dang 'dzin 26—1663

par gang spros pa/ /'di ni kun rdzob bden pa'o/ /stong nyid bdag med zhi ba gang / /spros pa rnams kyis ma gos pa/ /tha dad don min rnam 3mi rtog /'di ni don dam bden pa'o/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin dang / /rnam grangs rnam grangs ma yin pas/ /de gnyis so sor dbye ba byas/ /rtags tsam snang grags dngos po dang / /tha snyad 'khrul pa sgyu ma dang / /kun rdzob nyid ni rnam grangs so/ /stong pa nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /gang phyir sgrib pas kun rdzob ste/ /'gyur ba med phyir don dam mo/ /yang dag yang dag ma yin pa'i/ /shes pa gnyis phyir bden pa gnyis/ /yang dag shes pa med ce na//bden te tha snyad tsam du yod/ /de nyid tshol la thog mar ni/ /thams cad yod ces brjod par bya/ /don rnams rtogs shing chags med la/ /phyis ni rnam par dbye 1don nyid/ /bden gnyis gcig dang tha dad min/ /nyes pa bzhi bzhi gsungs phyir ro/ /gcig dang tha dad gang rtogs pa/ /de ni tshul min zhugs pa yin/ /dngos por khas len yod na ni/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mi zad 'byung / /lta ba ma rungs yongs su 'dzin/ /de las byung ba'i rtsod par 'gyur/ /dmigs pa'i 'du shes can la ni/ /thob pa med cing mngon rtogs med/ /rjes mthun bzod pa'ang kayod min na/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang smos ci dgos/ /stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ /shes rab chung ldan phung bar 'gyur / /ji ltar sprul la bzung nyes dang / /rig sngags log par ka bsgrubs pa bzhin/ /rgyal ba kun gyis stong nyid ni/ /lta kun nges par 'byin par gsungs—/ /gang dag stong pa nyid lha nga/ /de dag baspub tu med par 26—1664

gsungs—/ /gang dag rang dngos gzhan dngos kyis/ /dngos dang dngos med nyid mthong ba/ /de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /yang dag mthong ba ma yin no/ /med pa yod pa'i zlas grangs te/ /yod pa'ang med pa'i zlas grangs pa/ /de phyir med par brjod mi bya/ /yod pa nyid du 'ang mi brtag go//yod pa pa ni bde 'gror 'gro/ /med pa pa ni ngan 'gror 'gyur/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes phyir/ /gnyis la mi brten thar par 'gyur/ /tshul gnyis shing rta zhon nas su/ /rig kyipa'i srab skyogs 'ju ④byed pa/ /de dag de phyir ji bzhin don/ /theg pa chen po pa nyid 'thob/ /gzugs sogs ji ltar snang ba nas/ /bde gshegs bar gyi chos rnams kun/ /ri bong ba lang rwa yi dpes/ /dbu ma nyid du goms par bya/ /yod min med min yod med min—/ /gnyis min bdag nyid du yang med/ /mtha' bzhi las ni nges grol ba/ /de nyid dbu mar mkhas rnams bzhed/ /dbu ma mtha' las rnam grol na/ /mtha' dang bral phyir dbu ma'ang med/ /mtha' dbus med par gang lta ba/ /de ni yang dag lta ba ste/ /bla na med pa'i lta ba yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyis rtag tu bsgoms/ /gang zhig lta ba 'dir zhugs pa/ /des ni thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /rnam rig tsam du smra ba rnams/ /ngo bo nyid ni gsum du 'dod/ /kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub bo/ /brtags dang rgyu las skyes pa dang / /mi 'gyur phyir na go rims 1bzhin/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis/ /dngos po gang gang rnam brtags pa/ /de nyid kun du brtags pa yis——/ /ngo bo nyid de de med do/ /gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid/ /nom rtog yin te rkyen las byung / /grub ni de la snga ma po/ /rtag tu med par 26—1666
