gyur pa gang / /yod dang med pa'i mtha' gnyis kyis/ /de phyir de nyid gzhan dbang las/ /gzhan min gzhan pa yin pa'ang min/ /mi rtag la sogs bzhin du brjod/ /chu shel bai ḍūr+ya yi dpes/ /ngo bo nyid gsum shes par bya/ /bdag dang chos su brtags pa dang / /rnam par dag dang ma dag dang / /'gyur med phyin ci ma log pa/ /rim bzhin re re'ang gnyis gnyis so//blo gros bzang po thams cad ni/ /nang sems pa la brtson pa yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa las grol ba'i/ /rnam shes dam pa'i don du yod/ /chos rnams 'ga' yang skye ba dang / /'gag pa cung zad yod min te/ /skyes pa 'ba' zhig kho na ni/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag par 'gyur/ /yod min chos rnams de dag snang / /bems po las min gzhan las min/ /med pa las min nyes gnyis phyir/ /de phyir shes pa'i bdag nyid yod/ /rnam shes bems po'i rang bzhin las/ /bzlog par rab tu skye bar gsungs/ /bems min rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de 'dir bdag nyid rig par 'dod/ /nam mkha' sa rlung nyi ma dang / /rgya mtsho phyogs dang 'dab rjechu ni/ /nang gi shes pa yang dag gi— / /cha yin phyi rol ltar snang ngo / /gsal ba'i rang bzhin du snang bas/ /de dag 'aprel pa lkog gyur min/ /gang dang 'brel pas gang rig pa/ /de yis rig bya de rig 'gyur/ /ral gri'i so dang so rtse bzhin/ /blo yis rang 'dzin dor zhe na/ /rang nyid snang ba dor min par/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel las gsungs—/ /de'i phyir blo yi mtshan nyid ni/ /rang rig par ni grub pa yin/de nyid rtogs par dka' ba na/ /'di yi ngo bo dpyad mi nus/ /rang rig de yang phra ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis phra bar gzigs/ /rang la 26nga 666

gnas kyang bdag 'dra bas/ /rmongs pa'i phyir na mthong ba med/ /gsal dang blo ni bdag nyid kyis/ /'brel pa yod phyir don tsam yin/ /shes pa'i rang bzhin bden pa ste/ /rnam pa brdzun zhing 'khrul pa yin/ /sems ni rnam par bslad pa'i phyir/ /gcig gnyis gnyis su snang ba yin/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dbye ba las/ /shin tu mkhas pa cis ma yin/ /gzung ba'i rnam pa mi g.yo'i phyir/ /phyi rol lta bur snang ba yin/ /'dzin pa'i rnam pa rab g.yo bas/ /nang lha bur ni snang ba nyid/ /mtshan ma de ni spangs nas su/ /ye shes nam mkha' lha bur bsgom/ /sems kyi ⑨rang bzhin zag pa med/ /zag bcas sa bon ma zad par/ /kun gzhi gnas skabs de dag nyid/ /zad nas zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /rnam par grol ba'i sku dang ni/ /rtag tu nyi zer nyi ma bzhin/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams gnas yin pas/ /skyob pa rnams kyi chos sku'o/ /nyan thos theg par zhugs pa rnams/ /bdag dang bdag gis dben pa yi/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /bzhi lnga'am dus ni gsum yang rung / /yod pa thams cad gzung bya yin/ /dmigs dang bcas pas 'dzin par byed/ /de gnyis dam pa'i don du 'dod/ /bden pa mthong dang goms pa las/ /nyon mongs spangs pa zhes bshad pa/ /bden pa bdag ni rnam bzhi ste/ /sdug bsngal de bzhin kun 'byung dang / /'gog pa lam ste de lha na/ /de dag ji ltar gdon —rtogs rim/ /sdug bsngal nyer len phung po'o/ /kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs te/ /'gog pa mya ngan 'das pa gnyis—/ /lam ni phyogs mthun sum cu bdun/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa/ /bsgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /dge sbyong tshul ni dri med lam/ /26—1667

'bras bu 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /de dag brgyad cu rtsa dgu'o/ /grol lam zad pa rnams dang bcas/ /'bras bu bzhi rnam gzhag pa ni/ /rgyu lnga dag ni srid phyir ro/ /nyan thos rnam bzhi sprul pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'gyur ba dang / /zhi bgrod grub mtha' 'dzin pa'o/ /de ni gnyis bzhi bco brgyad de/ /gnyis ni bye brag spru ba dang / /de bzhin mdo sde smra ba'o/ /rnam pa med pa'i shes pa yis/ /gzugs la sogs pa don rig 'dod/ /de ni bye brag smra ba yin/ /gang zhig don rmis phan btags pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan rnams la nyams stsongs pas 3/ /don rig 'dod pa mdo sdo pa'o/ /bzhi ni dge 'dun phal chen dang / /thams cad yod smra gnas brtan pa/ /mang pos bkur ba bco brgyad ni/ /shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'jig rten 'das par smra ba'i sde/ /rtag par smra ba'i sde pa dang / /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /gzhi kun yod smra 'od srungs — sde/ /sa ston sde dang 'od srungs sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan pa/ /sa sgrogs ris dang srung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu yi sde pa ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum//yul don slob dpon bye brag gi /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad do/ /rang rgyal byang chub don gnyer bas/ /gzung ba'i rtog pa spangs phyir dang / /'dzin pa ma spangs phyir na ste/ /rten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam/ /bskal pa brgya yi mthar thug bar/ /bsgoms pas byang chub reg par 'gyur/ /de ni rten cing 'asbol 'byung ba/ /yan lag bcu gnyis chags 'gasum mo/ /sngon dang phyi mthar 26— 668

gnyis gnyis dang / /bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan la/ /ma rig nyon mongs sngon gnas skabs/ /'du byed dag ni sngon 'das kyi1/ /rnam shes mtshams sbyor phung po yin/ /ming dang gzugs ni de phan chad/ /skye mched drug dod tshun chad do/ /de ni gsum 'dus tshun chad do/ /reg pa bde sdug la sogs kyi / /rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad do/ /chor 'khrig tshun chad sred pa ni / /longs spyod 'khrig pa chags bcas kyi/ /nye bar len pa longs spyod rnams—/ /thob par bya phyir yongs rgyug pa'o/ /de srid 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /las de nyid ni srid pa yin/ /nying mtshalas sbyor ba skye ba yin/ /tshor ba'i bar ni rga shi yin/ /'di ni gnas skabs bar 'dod lo/ /gtso bo'i phyir na yan lag bsgrags/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' bar dag la/ /rbongs pa rnam par bzlog phyir ro/ /nyon mongs gsum mo las gnyis so/ /bzhi bdun de bzhin 'bras bu yin/ /gnyis kyi rgyu 'bras mdor bsdus pa/ /bar ma'i rjes su dpag pa las/ /'dir ni 'byung ba rgyu yin te/ /byung 1ba 'bras bu nyid du 'dod/ /yan lag bcu gnyis de dag las/ /rgyu ni rnam lnga 'bras bu bdun—/ /'phen par byed dang 'phangs pa dang / /mngon par 'grub byed grub pa dang / /nyes dmigs kyi ni yan lag ste/ /gsum bzhi gsum gcig gcig rim bzhin/ /'du byed sdug bsngal 'gyur ba yi/ /sdug bsngal nyid ni rim bzhin du/ / ldang dang bzhi dang lnga yin no/ /khams gsum na ni rim bzhin du/ /bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu yis 'jug /rdzus skyes yan lag bcu gcig gis/ /mngal dang sgong skyes bcu gnyis kyis/ /drod gsher las skyes ci rigs 'jug /de bzhin 'gro ba lnga la sbyar/ /gsum po 26—1669

dag las gnyis 'byung ste/ /gnyis las bdun 'byung bdun las kyang / /gsum 'byung srid pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /nyid ni yid dang yid 3du 'khor/ /'khor ba'i ngo bo rnam pa dang / /gang zhig gang du gang gis dang / /ji ltar ji srid nyes dmigs ni/ /mtha' yas tshogs kyis rab tu 'jug /brtsam par bya zhing 'byung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya/ /'dam bu'i khyim na glang chen bzhin/ /'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya/ /gang zhig rab tu bag yod par/ /chos 'dul 'di la spyod 'gyur ba/ /skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas/ /sdug bsngal tha mar byed par 'gyur/ /zu ngan gang las 'da' ba dang / /gang zhig gang gis gang gi tshe/ /gang gis gang phyir ji lta bur / /ji srid ngo bo rnam pa dang / /thob bya dbye ba phrin las dang / /yon tan tshogs kyis ldog pa'o/ /mu stegs pa ni rnam pa gnyis/ /sprul pa pa dang rang rgyud pa/ /de yang skyes thob sbyor 'byung ngo / /skyes thob rigs chad log sred can/ /sbyor byung bsam gtan rtog ge ba/ /bsam gtan pa ni mngon shes mthus/ /lta ba drug cu gnyis su rtogs/— /rtag par smra ba rnam bzhi dang / /kha cig rtag par smra ba bzhi/ /mtha' yod sogs bzhi mi sgong bzhi / /rgyud med gnyis ni sngon mthar rtog /'du shes yod spru bcu drug dang / /med smra brgyad dang de bzhin du/ /yod min med min smra ba brgyad/ /chad smra bdun dang tshe 'di la/ /mya ngan 'da' bar smra ba lnga/ /phyi ma'i mthar rtog lta ba'o/ /rtog ge pa ni grangs can sogs/ /tshad mas grub mtha' 'dzin pa'o/ /grangs can yon tan gsum du brjod/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa'o/ /rangs dang mgu dang kun dga' dang / /bde bzhi pa yi sems 26—1670

nyid dag /res 'aka' yang ni snang gyur pa/ /de dag snying stobs yon tan no / /mi dga' ba dang yongs gdud dang / /mya ngan 'dod dang mi bzod dag /gang du snang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /de dag rdul gyi 1rtags su 'dod—/ /rmongs pa de bzhin gti spug dang / /bag med gnyid dang gsal ba ba dag / len 'ga' yang ni snang gyur pa/ / de dag mun pa'i yon tan no//yon tan gsum gyi rang bzhin mchog /mthong ba'i lam du 'gyur ma yin/ /mthong ba'i lam du gang gyur pa/ /sgyu ma bzhin du shin tu gsog /rang bzhin las ni chen po ste/ /de las nga rgyal rnam gsum —'byung / /de las dbang po bcu gcig dang / /de tsam lnga'o de lnga las/ /'byung ba lnga ste nyi shu bzhi/ /gtso bo nyid dang rnam 'gyur ro/ /de dag sems pa yod ma yin/ /skyes bu kun rig sems pa can/ /de dag nyi shu lngas shes na/ /ral pa spyi bo gtsug phud kyis/ /bsnyi gnas gang du dga' ba der/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /bye brag pa ni don drug 'dod/ /rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi / /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /rdzas dgu yon tan nyi shu bzhi/ /las lnga spyi gnyis bye brag gnyis/ /de bzhin 'du ba'ang rnam gnyis te/ /de nyid drug shes rig pa'i mchog /rig byed kun gyi pha rol phyin/ /gcer bu ba noms don dgu smra/ /srog dang zag pa sdom pa dang / /nges par dga' — dang 'chi ba dang / /las dang sdig dang bsod nams dang / /thar pa zhes bya don dgu po/ /gang gis mthong ste rnam par dag /rigs pa can don bcu drug 'dod—/ /tshad ma gzhal bya the tshom dang / /dgos pa dpe dang grub mtha' dang / /cha shas rtog ge gtan la dbab/ /rtsod dang brjod dang rgol ba dang / /26— 67

rgyu lhar snang ba 1tshig dor dang / /ltag chod chad pa'i gnas rnams te/ /bcu drug gis ni nges par 'byung / /dpyod pa pa ni don bzhir brjod/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /de dag 'dus ma byas pa ste/ /rtag tu skye 'gaka med par gnas/ /de bas las 'bras yod ma yin/ /sngon dang phyi mtha' de bzhin med/ /gang zhig de ltar rnam dpyod pa/ /mthong ba tsam gyis rnam grol 'gyur / /khyab 'jug byed rgyur smra ba rnams/ /nyi ma'i nang na khyab bdag 'jug /skar nang 'od gnas zla ba yin/ /rlung nang nga ni 'od zer can/ /snang ba can na nyi ma yin/ /rig byed nang na snyan tshig dang / /lha nang nga ni brgya byin te/ /dbang po'i nang na yid yin no/ /'byung ba'i nang na sa yin zhing / /nga ni bde byed drag po'ang yin/ /srin po gnod sbyin nang rol bdag /nor lha'i nang na me lha nga / /ri bo'i nang na nga ri rab nga ni yi ge'i nang na a/ /nya dang rus sbal phag dang ni/ /mi yi seng ge mi thung dang / /dga' byed ra ma ṇa nag po/ /sangs rgyas tsar ti ka dang bcu/ /gang gis khyab 'jug yon tan rnams/ /rtag tu bsgoms na bde thob 'gyur/ /dbang phyug byed rgyur 'dod pa rnams/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /byed pa po ni dbang phyug yin/ /de ni yon tan brgya dang ldan/ /rab phra yang ba mchod par 'os/ /bdag por gyur dang dbang du gyur/ /gar yang phyin dang 'dod dgur ldan/ /de bzhin dga' mgur gnas pa'o/ /lag pa dag dang rkang pa dang / /mig dang gdong dang lus rnams kyi/ /mang po bskyed cing 'jig byed pas/ /des na phra bar brjod pa yin/ /mkha' dang rlung dang sa dang ni/ /chu dang me dag gnas byed cing / /sdud pa dang ni rgyas 26— 672

byed pas/ /des na yang par brjod pa yin/ /'jig rten gsum na mchod gyur cing / /gan pa bdag chedang rgyu ba dang / /'byung po kun gyis brjed pas na/ /des ni rngo mchod par 'os pa yin/ /'byung po kun la dbang byed cing / /gnas pa bdag midang rgyu ba dang / /gang dang gang 'dod de byed pas/ /des na bdag por gyur zhes bya/ /bdag la rag las rang dbang can/ /'ga' la'ang 'jigs pa yod min te/ /thams cad dbang du nyagyur zhes bya/ /mtho ris ngan song kun khyab pas/ /des na gar yang phyin zhes bya/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa gsum/ /de dag gang la gnas gyur pa/ /mig 'byed tsam gyis byed gyur pas/ /des na 'dod dgur ldan zhes bya/ /thar pa'ang yang na lha yi lus/ /gang du dag nyid ra'adod pa dag /thams cad 'dod pas thob gyur pasadu / /des na dga' mgur gnas zhes bya/ /gang zhig phra gyur gcig pu skyes nas 'dug /de yi 'di kun skyes shing 'jig par byed/ /de ni dbang dag —mchog sbyin lha mchog bya/ /yon tan byed po shin tu zhi ba thob//skyes pa — po 'di shes pa yod min te/ /bdag gi bde sdug bdag la rang dbang med/ /dbang phyug gis btang yang na mtho ris sam/ /g.yang sa dag tu 'gro ba kho nar 'gyur/ /dbang phyug rdza mkhan lta bur sna tshogs 'di sprul byed por ma gyur na/ /ri rab 'di mi grub cing sa gzhi 'di min rgya mtsho'ang ma yin te / /nyi zla skar ldan 'di ltar bkod pa 'di dag mig yul du med 'gyur/ /yod pa'i phyir ni dbang phyug 'gro ba'i byed po yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra/ /phra zhing bsam gyis mi khyab rab srab byed pa kun rig kun byed pa/ /rnal 'byor goms pas thob pa blo can bsam gtan pa yi bsam gtan yul/ /nyi ma zla ba sa chu me 26—1673

rlung phyogs dang nam mkha'i lus can te/ /zhi ba'i bde dga' 'dod pa rnams kyis dbang phyug rtag tu bsgoms/ /dus la ltos kyipar smra ba rnams/ /dngos kun dus kyis bsgyur ste/ /gang gi zhang po nor lha dang / /gang pha nor rgyas yin pa yi/ /'jigs med khro bo'ang bsad gyur pas/ /dus ni 'da' bar dka' ba yin/ /'byung ba rnams ni dus kyis 'byin/ /skye dgu rnams sdud dus kyis byed/ /dus kyis 3gnyid log sad 6par byed/ /dus ni 'da' bar dka' ba yin/ / srung ba sum brtsegs phya'obs ni rgya mtsho dang / /dmag mi srin po nor ni nor sbyin sbyor/ /gang zhig ⑦ bstan bcos pa sangs tshad mnyam pa'i/ /sgra sgrogs bu de'ang dus kyi 3dbang gis nyams/ /ngo bo nyid rgyur smra ba ni/ /dngos dmas ngo bo nyid kyis 'grub/ /me yi dmar ba nyid dang ni/ /dam pa gzhan don byed nyid dang ba / / dam pa min pa'i brtse med nyid/ / gsum po ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /tsher ma rdo bar gyur pa su yis byas/ /ri dwags bya yi ri mo su yis byas/ /bu ram shing mngar nim pa kha ba dag /'di dag thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /nyi ma tsha zhing zla ba rab bsil dang / /skye bo chags shing thub pa de min la/ /bde ba rab bsil sdug bsngal rab gdung ba/ /drug po 'di dag ngo bo nyid kyis grub/ /gang dag rgyu med smra ba ni/ /thams cad rgyu la ltos nyamed par/ /dngos po rnams kyis tshaskye ba ste/ /nyi ma pad+ma'i ge sar sogs/ /sna tshogs gang gis byas pa yin/ /rma bya'i mdongs la sogs pa yang / /sna tshogs gang gis sprul pa yin/ /ji ltar char rlung la sogs pa/ /glo bur 'byung phyir rgyu med ltar/ /sdug bsngal la sogs rgyu med nyid/ /shin tu rgya chen rab zab la/ /sgyid lug shin tu ma 26— 674

sbyangs la/ /bdag bzhin sgra dag gti nug gis/ /da 1ltar theg pa che la smod//tshul khrims las ni nyams bla yi/ /lta las cis kyang ma yin te/ /tshul khrims kyis ni mtho ris 'gro/ /lta bas go 'phang mchog tu 'gyur/ /gti mug dbang gis bsgribs gyur te/ /gang zhig yang dag gegs byed pa/ /de la dge ba'i 'gro ba'ang med/ /thar pa med pa smos ci dgos/ /gnod pa'i sa bon gyur pa yi/ /nu stegs byed mang mthong nas ni/ /thar 'dod skye bo 'dod rnams la / /snying rjer 1mi 'gyur su zhig yod/ /de phyir thar pa don gnyer rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings su lta bar gyis/ /chos kyi dbyings su lta ba'i gru/ /slob dpon chen po dī paṃ ka ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur ba'o// //

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ u pa de sha kā ya pra dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du / man ngag sku'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni gcig nyid la/ /gdul bya'i mos pa'i dbang gis ni / /phyi nang gsang ba gsum du snang / /bde gshegs sprul pa sna tshogs ston / /yab ni thabs kyi rang bzhin la/ /yum ni shes rab rang bzhin te/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /thar pa'i lam gyi gtso bo yin/ /las dang thugs rje'i dbang gis ni/ /la la zhi zhing la la khro/ /zhi bas phan par ma gyur na/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /gdod nas dag pa'i snying po la / /gzugs sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /rang rgyud dngos po ma yin par—/ /rang dbang can gyi sku nyid do/ /skye dang 'chi ba'i cho 'phrul rnams/ 1sems can lta bu ma yin te/ /skye rga na 'chi rang gis shes/ /zhen pa rnams 26nga 1678

las 'da' tshul ston/ /skye dang 'chi ba mi dmigs pas/ /bag chags lus las grol gyur nas/ /rdo rje lta bu'i sku yin pas/ /bltas pa tsam gyis dri ma 'dag /mtshan gzhi dri med me long la/ /mtshan bcas 'dzin med gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zung 'jug blo gros ngo bor rtogs/ /gnyug ma dar ldan me long la/ /bcud dang rtsal sbyong gzugs brnyan 'char/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor rtogs1/ /'khor 'das gzhi med me long la/ /'gro ba drug gi rgazugs brnyan 'char/ /bsgom du med pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ /shes rab gsum gyi me long la/ /yon tan mtha' dag gzugs brnyan 'char/ /yongs su med pa'i ngo bor rtogs/ /bcu gcig ldan pa'i dam pa la/ /brgyad dang lda na pa'i slob ma yis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar rab btud nas/ /ma nyams gsum gyis mchod pa dbul/ /nges pa'i shes pa skyes gyur nas/ /spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /ma 'dres gcig tu rtogs pa yis/ /dus 'di nyid la rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /man ngag sku'i sgron ma rdzogs so// //26—1679

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ yā na wāka pra dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/theg pa gsung gi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum sems can ma lus kun/ /ma rig mun pas 'thibs pa la / /ston pa bcom ldan shāka thub kyis/ /gsung gi sgron ma 'di bstan pas//dam chos rim pa gsum du gsungs/ /rgyas par gsungs dang 'bring du bshad/ /bsdus pa'i don du bstan pa'o/ /de la rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ /dug gsum nyon mongs cha mnyam pa'i/ /gnyen po brgyad khri bzhi stong ste/ /theg pa sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /'bring ni gsung rab bcu gnyis dang / /mdo dang dbyangs bsnyad lung stan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de byung skyes pa'i rabs/ /rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ /bsdus pas sde sdod gsum dag ste/ /mdo sde 'dus pa shechos mngon no/ /lta 26—1681

ba gtsor ston mngon pa ste/ /bsgom pa gtsor ston mdo sde yin/ /spyod pa gtsor ston 'dul ba'o/ /de yang rnam pa gsum yin te/ /che dang chung dang khyab par ro/ /dang po lnga ni mdo yin te/ /de rjes drug ni 'dul ba yin/ /nangs kyi 1tha ma mngon pa'o/ /de ni theg pa chung ngu'i gzhung / /rgyas dang rmad byung mdo yin te/ /mdo sogs dgu ni 'dul ba la/ /gtan la dbab pa mngon pa'i sde/ /de ni theg pa chen po'i gzhung / /mdo sogs rim lnga mang yin te/ /de rjes rnam bzhi 'dul ba la/ /tha ma gsum ni mngon pa'o/ /de ni khyad par bla med gzhung / /de bzhin sbyor ba shes par bya/ /khyad par dbang du byas nas ni/ /mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa dang / /'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o/ /de gnyis rgyu 'bras khyad par yang / /don gcig la yang ma rmongs te/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa yis/ /dbang po non pos dbang byas te/ /pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags//sngags la rgyud sde bzhi ru gsungs / /bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med pa'o/ /dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /rab la rnal 'byor bla med do/ /yang na mi rigs bzhi las ni/ /bram ze'i rigs la bya ba'i rgyud/ /dmangs rigs la ni spyod pa yi/ /de bzhin rje'u rigs rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rgyal rigs dal 'byor bla med do/ /'di ni bla med rgyud du grags/ /rgyud dang thabs dang 'bras bu las//'di ni thabs kyi rgyud du gsungs/ /zab cing rgya che'i zhi byed 'di/ / brgyud pa rnam pa bzhi ru bshad/ / rigs kyi 5rgyud dang don gyi rgyud / /byin rlabs brgyud dang brda yi brgyud/ /ma zhugs rnam bzhi shes par bya/ /theg pa 26— 682

gsung gi sgron ma rdzogs so// //bsdur ma na/1681 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉ga theg pa gsung gi sgron ma zhes bya ba banugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagasung / du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sngaradul ba/1682 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉8sa/ du 〈〈pe 〉dze'ar 〉mido/ du〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉〉〉te/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉masad pa rnam/〈'ar 〉ska/da pa rnams/ ④〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉'ag gi/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thargyud/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1145)26wa 1683

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ dar+sha pra dī pa rā ma/ bod skad du/yang dag lta ba'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal spru ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo / /lhan skyes ye shes ster mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud//mtshon tshod lta ba ma 'gags pas/ /grub mtha' kun dang phyogs gcig mthun/ /yin lugs lta ba mtha' dang zal/ /grub mtha' kun gyi blo ma shog /lta ba rgya che mtha' bral ni/ /mtha' bzhi'i skyon dang bral bas na/ /grub mtha' kun la mi gnas pas/ /yang dag lta bar yid ches bya/ /blta bya lta byed gnyis dang bral/ /lta ba med pa'i lta ba ni/ /lha ba'i dam pa kho na yin/ /dngos 'dzin lta ba kun las grol/ /ma rig pa yi mig bye nas/ /ye shes mig gis bltas pas ni/ /rig pa dri ma med pa lta/ /dri med mthong zhes lta ba yin/ /mthong bya mthong byed gnyis bral nas/ /zung 'jug lta ba gza' gtad med/ /26—1684

phyag rgya chen po lta mchog yin/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i yon tan ni/ /mtshan nyid bzhi ru shes par bya/ /rig pa dri ma med pa la/ /rnam dag sgrib g.yogs med pas ni/ /gzung 'dzin g.ya' yis ma gos pa'o/ /gcig gi sangs rgyas e ma ho/ /rig pa gcer bur kanas pa la/ /mtshan ma'i gos kyis ma g.yogs pa / /rang byung ye shes drod po che/ /chags sdang mtshan ma me bzhin sreg /kun shes rig pa rten med pa'o/ /bag chags spubs 1su ma zhugs par/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba gzugs mi dgos/ /'dod yon sun ma 5rang sar grol/ /'dzin med rig pa barmings pa ni/ /dngos 'dzin yu ba bud pas na/ /snang grags 'dzin pa nus pa yin/ /phyogs cha med pa'i lta 3ba'o / /yang dag lta nga'i sgron ma zhes bya rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/1684 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho/yang dag lta ba'i sgrol ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// kwa 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skor/ sa〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉blta/1685 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉gesteg du 〈〈pe ta'i〈snar 〉mir//rang 'byung / du〈'ar 〉rdzabs/ ④〈〈pe 〉tshogang pa/〈〈snar 〉gapakhar pa/'u〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉sta nam/ (ge〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉blta/brtsar 'bras re'u mig da/ (1146)26wa 1686

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ rat+na pra ( —dī pa nā ma/ bod skad du/ rin po che sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /dang po zin par bya ba dang / /bar du brtan par bya ba gces/ /tha ma bogs kyis dbyung thabs so/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni rjes thob dang / /ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid dang / /rtags dang nyams myong yon tan dang / /tshad dang skyon dang bcos thabs so/ /ma zin zin par byed pa la/ /lus kyi gnad dang dmigs pa'i gnad / /rlung gi gnad ni shes par bya/ /zin pa brtan par byed 'dod na/ /rtsal sbyong gsum la mkhas par bya/ /brtan pa gong du bogs 'byin na/ /bogs 'byin gsum la goms par bya/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni rjes thob la/ /ngo sprod bzhi bzhir shes par bya/ /dang po 26—1687

mnyam gzhag ngo sprod ni/ /rig pa mtha' rkyang ngar dang chas/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /rig pa thang sha gcad pa ni/ /gzhu bzangs bdungs rtapa'i dpe yis mtshon/ /de nas rig pa rtsal sbyang ni/ /dar chen rlung gis bskyod pas mtshon/ /rig pa rjen par gzhag pa ni/ /gnyug ma lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon/ /rjes thob la yang ngo sprod bzhi/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par sprad/ /rkyen la drag zhan med par sprod 1/ /dbang po thogs rdugs med par sprad/ /rang bzhin gsal ba dri med yin/ /mtshan nyid nyams su myong ba'o—/ /rtags la rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /btang na 'gro la bzhag ④na sdod / /dgos pa'i dus su snyeg napa dang / /shes bzhin gnad du tshud pa'o/ /nyams myong la yang de bzhin te/ /bde ba dang ni gsal ba dang / /mi rtog pa dang mi g.yo ba'o/ /yon tan mngon par shes pa 'char/ /tshad ni rtsa ba brtan pa dang / /de bzhin rtse mo no ba nyid/ /bar ni gsal ba ngar dang chas//dmigs pa sna tshogs sgyur shes pa'o/ /skyon ni bying dang rmugs pa dang / /de bzhin rgod dang kayeng ba'o/ /bcos pa la yang rnam gsum ste/ /rin chen gser ltar bcos pa dang / /'tsho mdzad sman pa lta bu dang / /ji shā karma'i bzo bzhin no/ /man ngag bsgom pa'i sgron ma rdzogs so// //26—1688

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ sa ma tā wastu pra dī pa 7tsā ma/ bod skad du / mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang snang me long ston mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /gzhi la rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /spyi yi gzhi dang bye brag gzhi—/ /spyi ni gnyis su lung ma bstan/ /gzhi nyid ming 'dogs bral ba yin / /dper na ga pur sman bzhin no/ /ma bcos khas len bral ba yin/ /nus pa sna tshogs 'char bas na/ /gzhi nyid shes pa'i nus pa yin/ /sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes 'byung / /de ma rtogs pa'i sems can ni/ /lus dang bag chags gnyis su snang / /bye brag gzhi la gnyis yin te/ /'khor ba'i gzhi dang 'das pa'o/ /'khor ba'i mtshan nyid 'dus byas pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pas na/ /snod dang bcud ni mi rtag ste/ /dus bzhi la sogs 26—1690

'gyur bas na/ /de ma shes pas yang yang 'khor/ /'das pa'i gzhi la gnyis yin te/ /dran pa bzhi yis ngos gzung 3la/ /phyag rgya bzhi yis rgyas gdab po//thabs shes gnyis kyis gtan la dbab/ /ā li thabs kyi (1rang bzhin la/ /ka li shes rab rang bzhin no/ /skye med mtshon pas a zhes bya/ /'gag med mtshon pas ka yin no/ /ṛ dzā lo '-i tsazung 'jug go/ /zla ba dang ni nyi ma gnyis/ /g.yas dang g.yon par shes par bya'o/ /de nas dus tshod 'pho ba dang / /chu tshod dbyu gu skad cig dang / /lte ba dang ni snying ga dang / /mgrin pa dang ni spyi bo dang / /'khor lo bzhi ru shes par bya/ /'byung ba lnga dang phyi nang gnyis/ /ro snyoms ma zhu shes par bya/ /phyi nang gnyis su gnas pa la/ /rten 'brel chos rnams ma shes na/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams mi shes so//lte bar a gnas gsang bar spro/ /snying gar re gnas 'bar ba ni/ /mgrin par hri las gsal ba ni/ /byi bor re du bsgom par bya/ /bde stong gnyis su gsal bas ni/ /mtshon pas 5phyag rgya chen po yin/ /spong dang sbyor dang sgyur dang grol/ /zad dang 'phen dang tshig 6dang don/ /sde snod gsum gyi don yang ston/ /dus tshod 'byung ba bzhi yis mtshon/ /ma nor ba ru shes par bya/ /sde tshan lnga yis nang rnams 'joms/ /ā li ka li mgrin par gnas/ /nam mkha'i yi ges 3nga rgyal 'joms/ /rtsa yi sde tshan rkan las 'byung / /me yi yi ges zhe sdang 'joms/ /ṭa yi sde tshan lce las 'byung 1/ /rlung gi yi ges phrag dog 'joms/ /ta yi sde tshan so nas 'byung / /sa yi yi ges gti mug 'joms—/ /pa yi sde tshan mchu nas 'byung / /chu yi yi ges 'dod chags 'joms—/ / hūṃ gis 'og gi marlung rnams bsdus / /a yis steng gi bde 26—1691

ba gsal/ /ha yis bde ba 'phel bar byed/ /nyika gis bde ba gnas nas 'dren / /phyi nas 'byung ba'i dgra gshed dang / /nang nas 'byung ba'i ro snyoms dang / /phyi yi dus tshod g.yon nas gzung 1/ /nang gi dus tshod g.yas nas gzang / /lo yi mgo bo byi ba yin/ /zla ba'i mgo bo stag yin pas/ /༄lho dang byang dang shar dang nub/ /'byung ba bzhi ru shes par bya ④/ /shes na thams cad 'grub par nges/ /tshig gcig bstan ⑤pas sangs rgyas dang / /rdzas gcig rnyed pas don yod 'grub/ /sngags 4gcig bzlas pas nus pa 'byung / /mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma rdzogs so// //baspur ma na116(༷ mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa rtor bkod cing / (‘pe 〉〉ga mnyam nyid gzhi'i sgron ma zhes bya ba banugs so// ‘ —dz+wa pe 〉〉‘'dir 〉ma /16(1 3‘dz+wape 〉ྈdz+wasnar 〉 zung / — 3dz+wadz+wape 〉 snar 〉41sa/ ༅dz+wadz+wape 〉 2snar 〉yod za shā/ dz+wa‘pe 〉〉('dir 〉7 ka8(pe〉〉dz+wa‘snar 〉7ra/ dz+wadz+wasnar 〉ba'igs/ dz+wadz+wape 〉〉〈‘snar 〉rga/ — dz+wa〈pe 〉 2snar 〉btsa/ khya〈‘pe 〉〉(sar 〉༄nga / zedz+wadz+wape 〉 snar 〉yodas/ shāsmodz+wadz+wape 〉 dz+wasnar 〉mkhye gi 'og gis/ tshedz+wadz+wape 〉 snar 〉〉sdus/16(2 32‘pe 〉〉8‘snar 〉 zung / ②dz+wa‘pe 〉 'ar 〉7sa/ ② ‘pe 〉 ‘snar 〉7na/ ④(‘pe 〉 shar 〉 ka26nga 1692
bsdur 'bras re'u migargyad/ (1148)

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ko ṭi niṣ+ṭha pha la pra ⑤dī pa tsā ma/ bod skad du/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i chu las sgrol mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud/ /sgrub pa'i chos la don yod pas/ /dam pas gsungs la yid ches gyis/ /mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma ni/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya/ /gnas skabs rgyu yi 'bras du dang / /mthar thug rtogs zupa'i 'bras bu'o/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rab ster bas/ /byas pa'i chos la nan tan skyed/ /nam mkha' rdo rje grong 'jug gsum/ us su rung ba'i 'bras bu yin/ /rtogs — pa'i 'bras bu sku lnga ste/ /ngo bo stong pa chos sbu la—/ /rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku yin/ /mtshan nyid nyams myong sprul pa'i sku/ /zung 'jug ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /rang grol rang dag bde chen sku/ /26—1694

don la mtshon du ci yang med/ /tha snyad blo la rgyu 'bras dri paṃ /gnyis/ /zhen pa bzlog phyir bstan pa las/ /don dam brjod du med pas na/ /rgyal bas tshig gcig gsungs pa med/ /mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba rje btsun ka ma la bhā las mimadzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1694 snatshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉kho mthar thug 'bras bu'i sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// du 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wapra/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉pa/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mnyag ⑤〈〈pe 〉lo'adir 〉stab stor/ gyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sta1ga1695 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉wadri paṃ/ dzha 〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉gis/bsdur 'bras re'u mig da/ (1149)26wa 1695

༄ /rgya gar skad du/ bo ②rnyi tsar+ya pra dī pa ②tsā ma/ bod skad du/byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /dam pa skyes mchog rnams la 'dud / /'gro ba sdug bsngal gdungs pa la/ /zhi byed bsil ldan dri med bshad / /'jig rten khams 'di mi rtag ste/ /dper na 'ja' tshon yal dang 'dra/ /lo zla tshes grangs 'chi dang nye/ /bu tsha la sogs grogs rnams dang / /bor nas gcig pu 'gro dgos na/ /bar do bzhi las 'chi ba'i tshe/ /sdug bsngal ri bos mnan pas sdug /bdun tsho bdun du bar do ru/ /gshed pos 'tshe zhing sdug re bsngal/ /ma rig 'khrul pas lus blangs te/ /nyon mongs lnga yis sems kyang dkrugs/ /dper na shing rta'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /'gro ba drug gi rtsesdug bsngal myong / /sdug bsngal bzhi sogs sdug bsngal bas/ /26ba 1696

de phyir byang chub baspub par bya/ /le lo g.yeng ba rab spangs te/ /shes rab kasum la blo sbyangs la/ /rtag tu dur khrod gnas su 'dug /dran pa bzhi dang ldan pa yis/ /tho rangs langs te khrus byas la/ /dad dang mos gus sngon btang ste/ /byang chub sems dang rab ldan pas/ /'gro ba du bzhin gdung bar bya/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro ma nyams bya/ /bden pa'i chos la the tshom spang / /'dod pa spel phyir chu sbyin gtang / /mchod bshags ②la sogs kha ton 0bya/ /gru yi tshul du lus kyang btsal/ /bag yod spyod lam blo gros zab/ /lha dang mi 'bral bsam pa bzang / /dang po byung bas dkon mchog mchod/ /kha zas kun las ②rnal 'byor bya/ /lhag ma 'byung bo rnams la bsngo/ /bshang gci rnams kyang sbyin par gtang / /smon lam rgya chen gdab pa'o/ /chos su 'gro ba'i tshig kyang brjod/ /sāts+tsha pya gdab cing srog kyang gdon/ /bsod nams tshogs ni ci nus bsags/ /ye shes tshogs kyang de bzhin te/ /sdom pa gsum dang ldan par bya/ /pha rol phyin pa drug spyad de/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor bya/ /bskor ba bya zhing lus kyang bcag /'byung ba bzhi ni ro snyoms ⑤te/ /mtshan mo nang gi spyad ༷ pa bya/ /srod la gtor tshogs chen po gtang / /nam byed tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /phyi bcud nang bcud rang sor gzhag /nam smad dge ba'i gnyid kyang log /spyod lam rnam bzhi'i chos la bsdu/ /ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun ltar spyad/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal bsre ba yang / /sum cu rtsa bzhi'i gdams pa'i don/ /sems nyid las su rung bas ni/ /rang dbang rgyal po sems la thob/ /de phyir rnal 'byor brtson par spyad/ /byang chub spyod pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba rje btsun ka ma la shī las ④26—1697

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ pā da yo ga pra dī paṃ na ka ma/ bod skad du/rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma 'di/ /bstan tsu pas log pa'i lam mi 'jug /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi mdzad pa/ /dam pa skyes mchog de la 'dud / /ā li kā li'i ④sgra don rtogs/ /sde sdod gsum gyi don yang shes/ /bdag dang skye 'gro'i sems can rnams/ /ye nas skye med 'od gsal yang /ma rig pa yi rlung gis 'khrul/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong / /de las grol bar byed pa'i tsuphyir/ /rnal 'byor lam pas 'di ltar bya/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rab spangs te/ /dge ba'i chos la brtson par bya/ /bka' bye la som nyi mi za zhing / /rtag tu skyabs 'gro ma nyams bya/ /byams pa'i sems dang rab ldan zhing / /'gro la snying rje ci nus bya/ /'dod yon dngos po mi 26—1699

rtag pas/ /gzung 'dzin chags sems rnam par spangs/ /gzhan la smad par mi bya zhing / /'gro ba'i bla ma spyi bor bkur/ /log pa'i lam du mi 'jug cing / /mthu dang ngan sngags spel mi bya/ /longs spyod 'du 'dzi rnam spangs te//gcig pu nags su 'dug la bsgom1/ /'jig rten 'chal tshig mi brjod par/ /sngags dang snying po mdo yang brjod/ /yang na lkugs pa'i tshul du bsdad/ /rang byung dri ma med pa'i brda/ /lus la gru yi blo bzhag ༷ la/ /bcud len gyis ni zungs kyang bskyed/ /gtum mo yis ni ro bsnyams te/ /'byung ba bsnyams zhing nad rnams dbyung / /gnod sbyin bar chad byed pa la/ /brtul zhugs gdams pa'i spyad 1pa bya/ /mi ngal gsum dang 'du ba gsum/ /'khor lo gsum dang rtsa ba gsum/ /'bar ba gsum dang chud mi za/ /thim pa gsum dang rgyas gdab po/ /mdor na thams cad sems yin te/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan med/ /sems su 'dzin pa 'khrul pa'i blo/ /blo las grol na gnyis su med/ /gnyug ma'i ngang las ma yengs —par/ /dngos por snang ba — sgyu mar blta/ /sgyu ma brdzun pa mi lam tshul/ /mi lam tshul sogs rab shes nas/ /dpe brgyad bzhin du shes par bya/ /rnal ma'i chos la rab gnas na/ /gang lhar spyad kyang de ba thob/ /des na rnal 'byor brtson par bya/ / sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa kyi rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba rje btsun ka ma la shī las zumadzad pa rdzogs so// //26—1700

bsdur mchan/1699 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉na rnal 'byor lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉shes the nā/ she〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉stan/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ rgya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rgya ba'i/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉darka'/17 ༷ tshi〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉sgom/ )〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhan/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉gaspyod/ ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanayengs/rgya〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉bar/ ci — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wasdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa/ ( 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gris/bsdur 'azas ze'u migarna/da/ (1151)26wa 1701

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ /tsit+ta gu rgya pra dī paṃ tsā ma/ bod skad du/gsang ba —thugs kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa lnga bcu rtsa lnga yis/ /zhabs kyi pad+mar rab btud nas/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad par lnga yis gdams pa bstan/ /kye ma rnam shes rlung gis 'khrugs / /rlung ni las su rung ba dang / /gtum mo rlung gis sbar bar bya / /'du ba'i nad kyang rlung gis cos/ /'byung ba ro ni mnyam pa dang / /brtul zhugs spyod pas bar chod sel/ /'tsho ba'i bcud ni len pa dang / /e waṃ bde ba'i rlung gis bskyed/ /rten 'brel shes pa 'char ba dang / /rdo rje rkang mgyogs grub par 'gyur/ /sgru tīr tshud de phyag rgya che/ /'dang ldan pad+ma ge sar dadus/ /rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems / /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /chags dang 'bri ba bcu gnyis 26—1702

brgya—/ /la la ra sa dhū tīr bsdu/ /rlung dang byang chub sems kyang de/ /'khor lo bzhi la srog shing tshul/ 1mi 'dra sbar bas haṃ las 'dzag /bcu drug byed phyed thig le ni/ /dkyil rngodang bzlog dang dgram zhing bstem/ /dga' bzhi'i khyad par phyag rgya che/ /skye ba dang ni 'gag pa'o/ /shes pa kho na 'ba' zhig yin/ /sems ni kun gyi sa bon te/ /rang sems rtogs na sangs rgyas la/ /bde ba gzhan du mi btsal lo/ /sems nyid las su rung ba dang / /rnam par mi rtog yang dag don/ /gnyis med gnyis su med pa las/ /gnyis su byar med spros bral mkha'/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das las grol/ /don gyis dbu ma phyag rgya che/ /snying po'i don las ma yengs par/ /gnyug ma'i yid ni gcig tu gtad/ /rnal ma'i don la rab gnas nas/ /yid la mi dmigs 3 bde ba che/ /lhan cig skyes pa bdud rtsi'i ro/ /mtshon du yod pa ma yin te/ /ston ka'i zla ltar dri med 'od/ /bde gsal stong pa'i ye shes can/ /rang la spras pa mig ltar dbye/ /bde ba che las gzhan med pas/ /phyag rgya'i mchog de phyag rgya che/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar bya ba dang / /lus sems 'phyan ④du gzhug pa dang / /'bras du blo yis ma grub pa/ /shes rgyud nam mkhar 'phang ba dang / /dmigs pa sna tshogs bsgyur shes so/ /chos dang chos min sel ba dang / /rig pa dngas snyigs dbye ba dang / /rnam shes rlung yang bsnyim ⑤pa'o//sgyu lus 'od gsal bsre bar bya/ /bag chags spubs su grol ba dang / /phyag rgya chen po dus 'dir thob/ /des na rnal 'byor brtson par bya/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa gsang ba thugs kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ka ma la shī las ༅ mdzad pa rdzogs so// //26—1703

༄ /rgya gar skad du/ maṇ+ḍal ji rnyi ༅tsā ma/ bod skad du/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma mnyes par byed pa yi/ /maṇ+ḍal cho ga bshad par bya/ /maṇ+ḍal la ni rnam lnga ste//ngo bo nges tshig dbul thabs dang / /dbye ba dang ni phan yon no/ /ngo bo dbul bar 'os pa la/ /sngags dang rdzas su bcas pa'o/ /maṇa ni bskyed ②pa'i sa bon te/ /bsod nams 'phel bas ḍal zhes bya/ /dbul thabs dad gus mos pa yis/ /gong ma mnyes par byed pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal dbye na rnam gnyis te/ /dngos dang yid kyis bsam pa'o/ /yid ni las su rung ba ste/ /dran pa tsam gyis gsol pa'o/ /dngos la rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /dbul ba dang ni sgrub pa dang / /mchod pa dang ni mi ( )mdzes pa'o/ /sa yang rung ste gzhi la ni/ /gang yang tshad dang ldan pa la/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ zhes pa de 26—1706

yis byug par bya/ /rnam pa nyi shu dgram bya ste/ /haṃ las 'og gi ri rab bsams3—/ /rang gi ngos kyi shar byas pa'i/ /ya las shar gyi lus 'phags bsam / /ra las byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /la las lho yi 'dzam bu'i gling / /sha las nub kyi ba lang spyod/ /ya las byang shar mtshams su bsam/ /gling g.yog nyi shu byed na yang / /g.yas g.yon sngags kyang de bzhin no/ /ri las nub byang gling phran bsam/ /shaṃ las lho nub mtshams yin no/ /lo las lho shar sping phran bsam/ /tsa las btsun mo rin po che/ /tsha las blon po rin po che—/ /dza las dmag dpon rin po che/ /wa las glang po rin po che/ /rtsa las rta mchog rin po che/ /tsho las 'khor lo rin po che/ /dzo las nor bu rin po che/ /waṃ las gter chen rin po che/ /paṃ las nyi ma shar du bsam/ /a las zla ba nub tu'o/ /oṃ las stong 3gi ri rab po/ /gling bzhi gling phran bcas pa dang / /rin chen dun dang gter dang brgyad/ /ri ra nyi zlar bcas pa rnams/ /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog gsum/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i 'os/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis 'bul lags kyis/ /bla ma dkon mchog bzhes su gsol/ /maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i yon tan ni/ /maṇ+ḍal gcig phul drug dang ldan/ /bsod nams tshogs ni bsam mi khyab/ /des na de la brtson par bya/ /gcig phul yon tan drug dang ldan/ /gling bzhi phul ba'i yon tan gyis—/ /bdud bzhi ma lus zhi bar 'gyur/ /gling phran phul ba'i yon tan gyis| /tshad med bzhi dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rin chen sna bdun phul ba yis—/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun thob par 'gyur/ /gter chen phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /mi zad longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nyi zla phul ba'i yon 26—1706

tan gyis/ /lta bsgom lhasems la gsal bar 'gyur/ /ri rab phul ba'i yon tan gyis/ /rang 'byung ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /maṇ+ḍal dbul ba'i cho ga rje btsun me/ ma la /glo las ri —mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1705 3tshomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉sa maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga ༷/ / sdud trīzhugs so// kru 〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉〉〉/ — 7〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉skyed/ ④〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉thas/ thu〈〈pe 〉〉17༷6 1〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabasam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsams/ cha〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mi/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉dzi/5〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉thosteng /17 7 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bsgoms/ tre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈shamar 〉〉spyos/bsdu/ 'bra~X shāshā )mig26wa 1707

yi ge med pa'i man ngagarje༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra taṭī ༷ tsāk+ṣa ro pa de sha /bod skad du/ de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grub thob dam pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi las//skyes bu khyad par rig 'dzin lnga yi gzhung / /mchog gyur rnams kyi zhabs kyi rdul la reg /de phyir dpe bral phyag rgya chen po bshad/ /rnam gcod dang ni yongs gcod dang / /phung po gsum po sel ba dang / /don dam mjal ba'i tshad ma yis—/ /yang dag yid la lta ba — —bya/ /yang dag don la yi ge med/ /gang gis yi ge med shes pa/ /de yis yi ge thams cad shes/ /yi ge a nas k+ṣa la rdzogs—/ /sde tshan brgyad kyi sgra sbyor ni/ /ā li kā lir shes par bya/ /ma skyes pa dang ma 'gag zupa/ /zung 'jug mtha' bzhi bral ba yi/ /bde ba chen po rgyun— chags su/ /bla ma'i brda yis mtshon par bya/ /kha dog snyemar me me 26nga 1708

long rgya/ /me shel sa bon skyur dang sgra/ /brgyad pa 'di ru don bsdus pa/ /go ba cig shos skye bar 'gyur/ /in+d+ra spyo miti bdag med ma/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor 'dod yon grol/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /bden don rtogs pa 'phags pa lha/ /srog dang rtsol ba nā ga pa/ /phyi nang rlung gsum tshangs par 'dren/ /kha sbyor thig le pad+mar 'byung ka/ /bde bas rgyas pa'i za ma tog/sku gsum mnyam gzhag mda' bsnun na/ /dran med skye med blo las 'das/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni rjes thob dang / /mi lam dang ni bar do la/ /zin dang brtan dang bogs 'byin pa/ /rgyas gdab pa dang rnam pa bzhi/ /dang po dus bzhi mnyam sbyar la/ /gnad gsum gzer bzhi gdab par bya/ /lus kyi gnad dang dmigs pa'i gnad/ /rlung gi gnad ni shes par bya/ /rig pa gcur la gdab pa dang / /shes pa srang du gzhug pa dang / /sems ni rung — dmigs 'dren pa dang / /rten dang dbral zhing bsgom pa gces/ /e waṃ brgyan pa'i bde ba la/ /bde bas byang chub lam du kyer/ /snang srid brda ru slong ba dang / /gang mthong phyag rgya chen por shar/ /thams cad ro mnyam de bzhin nyid/ /gcig zos pa yis gzhan kun grol/ /ji ltar chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du/ /rnal 'byor ma yengs rgyun du bsgom/ /gzung ba dang ni sbyang ba dang / /sgyu ma dang ni kho na nyid/ /nyal dang log pa'i khyad par las/ /rmi lam man ngag shes par bya/ /da lta 'chi kha bar do la/ /rten dang 'ong dang thig le sems/ /grong 'pho'i man ngag shes pa yis/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o//don mthong pa yis sgro 'dogs chod/ /nyams su blangs na byin rlabs 'byung / /drod rtags nus pa tshod zin pas/ /yid zhin nor bu lta bu'o/ /rlung mkhris 26—1709

bad kan 'dus pa'i nad/ /mtshon dang mche 1ba 'byung ba 'khrugs/ /dal yams 'brum po chu ser la/ /nying 'dzin me btsa' skyugs kyis zhi/ /bdud dang mu stegs cho 'phrul gtong / /gdon dang 'byung po bshugs pa 'dren/ /gnod sbyin 'khu ldog byed pa'i tshe/ /mi g.yo rgya mtsho lta bu gzhag — /me dang chu dang dug sbrul dang / /bse dang chom rkun rgyal po'i chad/ /stag dang dred mo gcan gzan khro/ /de tsho nga yis 'dod pa yin/ /dgod dang rtsed mo byed pa dang / /dal dang drag dang shin tu drag /zang zing longs spyod mang po la/ /sbyor ba 'di yis khyab na bde/ /ro snyoms gtum mo mkha' spyod dang //sman dang bcud len bdud rtsi bsten / /ro langs mkha' 'gro dngos grub ster//blang dor med pa'i sems kyis 'bad/ /mtha' rgyas gnyis kyis shan bye la/ /khar phog car phog thog babs su/ /thun dang bcud kyis rtsal sbyangs te/ /snang gsum sbyor ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /dbang po gsum gyis dam mi 'da'/ /ma 'khrul gsum gyis so thub ste/ /srog 'dzin gsum gyis brtan pa thob( / /grol lugs gsum gyis tshad bstan no/ /lo zla gsum gyis zad sar bskyal/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal 'khor bar bying ba la/ /ma rig mig 'byed zhi byed 'di bkod pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid rtogs te/ /kun gyis phyag rgya chen po thob par shog /de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ka ma la shī las rjemadzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po tshwa na gu byu dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bla ma lo btsun chung gis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa // // 26—1710

brtsar mchan/17 / lhamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i man ngag 'jam dpal ri(ba'i seng ge'i man ngag banugs so// ci 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tad twa/ sri〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉blta bar/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉skaragags/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stedon/1709 ①〈〈 〉〉〈0rdor 〉〉 / rngu 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stertog ③〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉sngagang / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉smu ra/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉stabacur/ 'u〈〈pe 〉7〈snar 〉〉dus/ ༅〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 / 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snospong /⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabanabs/171 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toratshe/ rngu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉tshogasu/ ( 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag ④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉brten/ 52po ra 〉〉thogs/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thogang / ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉torathob/ ri dī〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi zhi byed/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mgris/ 0〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa'o/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉 sa maṅgā la// //ba kā 'bra~X /sdu) mig26wa 1711

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ pratsā pā ra mi sna sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spub thabs/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yum gyi skrub pa bshad par bya/ /shes rab pha rol phyin 'byung ba'i/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod pa/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /sku mdog dkar zhing yid 'ong ma / /skra bcings pa la cung zhig 'phyang / /chu skyes dkar la legs gnas pa//phyaka g.yas su ni pad+ma ste/ /kha dog dmar ba'i rnam par bsgom— / /shes rab pha rol phyin pa g.yon/ /rdo rje skyil krung legs par bcas/ /rgyan kun gyis ni legs par brgyan/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgom/ /a yig yi ge la zhugs shing / /mchog tu dga' bar byed pa'o/ /dam tshig sems dpa' rnam bskyed la/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsgom/ /zla ba drug gi sbyor 26—1712

ba yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma bdun gyi sbyor ba yis//bstan bcos kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /zla ba shar ba'i rim gyis ni/ /zla ba byed ni bsgom par bya/ /bzlas pa 'dum byas sbyor ba yis/ /nyin re bzhin du tshigs bcad brgya/ /'bad pa med par sbyor ba 'byung / /gzhung yang brgya tsam 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de la sngags ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra4 bsto ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha badz+nya ni/ rnyi ri rnyi ri busnyi 3 balha ni swā hā/bya rog gi skad ma grag par sngags 'di lan bdun du mngon par bsngags 1par byas nas/ ma brlangs pa'i skyur bapo'i khu ba 'thungs na zla ba drug tu gang 'thung bar byed pa/ de shes rab chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spub thabs/ rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad pa rdzogs so / / //

bsdur ma'adan/ 1712 /mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉skab shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༷ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabasgoms/1713 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉stag / 0〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉༅/ ②〈〈be 〉sko' ra 〉mdzogs/ ④〈〈be 〉5〈snar 〉cangs pa'i bskur/ 〈〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉〉gris/bsdushā 'bra~X shāshā )mig26wa 1714

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ bhasgyu ra kār+ya tā rā sā dha ne+e/ bod skad du/rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub 1thabs/ smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes dri med sgrol ma gsal ba'i thugs/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab phar phyin gsungs/ /stong nyid snying rje'i rdo rje phag mo'i sku/ / rje btsun —sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs la 'dud/ /sgrol ma gsum dang tshul mthun nol 'byor pas/ /rtag tu lha mo 'di bsgom bya phyir bshad/ /dang po rten gyi gang zag gis/ /gdong la sogs pa khrus byas nas/ /yid du 'ong ba'i gnas de ru/ /maṇ+ḍal byi dor legs byas la/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /snying gar zla dkyil yi ge shā/ /lcags kyu 'dra ba'i 'od 'phros pas/ /bla ma lha mo spyan drangs la/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags/ /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol/ /dge ba cung zad ci bsags pa/ /byang chub thob phyir 26—1716

bdas gis bsngo/ /de nas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /sngags 'di bzlas pas stong par bsgom/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā rtatsā na badz+ra su bhā wa āt+pa ko3haṃpaṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng / /hūṃ las rje btsun sgrol ma ni/ /zhal gcis phyag gnyis sbu mdog ljang / /g.yas na mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/ /g.yon na ut+pal sngon po 'dzin/ /rin chen rgyan rnams mdzes pa'i tshul/ /smra ba'i seng ges dbu brgyan pa/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed par bzhugs/ /dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs byas/ /de ltar dam tshig bskyed byas la/ /thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la/ /dad pa'i stobs kyis phyag byas te/ /de nas mchod pa sngags 'dis dbul/ /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgro pe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ni bi bye pū dza hūṃ/ oṃ gī ti —pū dza hūṃ/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgom/ /skyo na bzlas pa 'di ltar bya/ /oṃ tā re tuṭ+wā re tu re swā hā / sngags phreng snying ga nas phyung ste/ /ye shes thugs la mnyes 5pas mchod//byin rlabs tshur 'dus zhal nas 'thon / /bdag la thim zhing 'od 'phros pas / /bar chad sel dang sgrib sbyangs bsam / /des skyo gtor ma gtang bya ste / /mi rtog oṃ las rin chen snod/ /lha'ilas bdud rtsi sna tshogs bsam/ /hūṃ las thim zhing sna tshogs gsol/ /sngags 'dir snying po btags te dbul/ /ba li ta pū dza ahūṃ pū dza ba bo yi rda kṛsna —kha kha khā nyi khā nyi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza khā hi swā hā/ dad pa'i stobs kyis bstod par bya/ /oṃ stong nyid snying rje phag mo che/sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin/ /sgrol ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dri med ye shes gsal ba'i thugs/ /sgrol 26—1716

ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zla 'od srid pa'i mun sel ba/ /'joms byed nyi ma'i dkyil dang mtshungs/ /thabs dang shes rab yon tan ldan/ /sgrol ma la ni rtag tu 'dud/ /'gro la du bzhin rtag tu 'dun1/ /srid gsum rnam thar gsum la 'god/ /seng ldeng nags la rab gnas shing / /'jigs pa brgyad las shin tu skyob/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i skur ston cing / /skye shi med pa'i chos kyang ston/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i skur ston cing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nad rnams sel/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams na/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i skur ston cing / /bde ba chen po'i ngang la gnas/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod / /rnam par dag pa'i zhing khrams na/ /las kyi 1mkha' 'gro'i skur ston cing / /phrin las bzhi yi don yang spub/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod— —/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i zhing khrams na/ /pha rol phyin ma'i skur ston cing / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas tshogs dang bcas/ /sgrol ma la ni phyag 'tshal bstod / /de nas nyal ba'i dus na ni/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ /las dang spyod lam ci spyod pa/ /lha mo'i nga rgyal du ni bsgom / /'di brtsams pa yi dge ba gang / /rje btsun sgol ma'i thugs rje dang / /dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /rje btsun sgol ma 'grub rngo par shog /rje btsun ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //26—1717

ma /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra bā rā tī sā — dha ne+e/ bod skad du/rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /'khor lo'i gtso la rab btud nas/ /de yi zab mo sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dra ba sdom pa'i tshul bzhin bshad/ /de la rdo rje phag mo sgrub par 'dod pas dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug la/ kha nub tu bltas te dang por sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas dad pas gzhi bzung bsod nams kyis tshogs bsag go/ /de nas rim —gyis snang ba 'byung ba la bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la/ yi ge gsum gyi sngags kyis ④byin gyis brlab cing / oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ hre mo/ sgyu spyomi/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ces pas lag pa byin gyis brlabs la go bgo ste bgegs thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ hri gha gha sna ta ya sna ta ya sarba dusbyo pa phaṭa gā hā/26—171pyi

de nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung bas lus ngag yid gsum gyis thabs la mkhas par bya ste/ oṃ su bhā wa shudha ཿsarba dharmāḥ 3su bhā wa shusto3haṃ zhes brjod pas lus rnam par dag pa lha'i gzhal yas khang chos 'byung gi dkyil du bsam / oṃ badz+ra shudha ཿsarba dharmā 1badz+ra shusto3haṃ zhes brjod pas ngag rnam par dag pa sngags kyi 'khor lo la oṃ oṃ bye oṃ sarba dudha ḍā ki bhā ye/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa bhā ye/oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa rī ye/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa gā hābye / zhes bzlas so/ /oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shusto3haṃ zhes brjod yid rnam par dag pa lha'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa gri gug dang thod pa dang kha ṭī gi 'dzin pa/ sku mdog dmar ba la dur khrod —chas kyis brgyan pa zhabs g.yas bskum pa/g.yon brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i gsang gnas su chu'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyag rgya bzhis ye shes kyi lha mo dgug gzhug la sogs pa bya'obyu/ /de yang rang nyid lta bu gcig spyan drangs la phyag 'tshal mchod pa dbul/ sdig pa bshags/rjes su yi rang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /gsol ba gdab/dge ba bsngo/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur/ bdag la mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bstod/ sngags 'dis gtor ma gtang 4ste/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi dī ka tsha ma ru pa yo gi bhā/ dz+wa la mu khi ni kha kha khra nyi khā nyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod cing rkang pa brgyad kyis bstod/ de nas thabs bla na med pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pas yod med gnyis su med pa'i gdams ngag bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o / /mar gyur thugs kyi skyadapal be'u las/ /zab mo bcud kyi thigs pa byung / /skal ldan rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje phag mo 'grub par shog /rdo 26—1720

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ mdzi shrī kro dha sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ 'jam dpal khro bor — sgrub pa/ smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khro bo gshin rje gshed/ /khro rgyal gtso la rab 'dud she nas/ /de yi zab mo sgrub pa'i thabs / /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i tshul du bri/ /de la 'jam dpal gshin rje sgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom—/ de'i dbus su hūṃ mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros pas bar chad thams cad srung ༅zhing bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskul te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/ yan lag bdun pa bya zhing tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms te de ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag go/ /de nas oṃ sarba 26—1722

dharmā 1bhā ba su bhā wa shusto3haṃ/ zhes pas chos thams cad nam mkha' lta bur bsgom / de'i ngang las rang gi rig pa hūṃ mthing nag rab tu 'bar bar bsgom/de gyur pa las rdo rje khro bo hūṃ gis mtshan par bsam/ de las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mthing nag zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa/ mche ba gcigs shing skra gyen du brjes pa/phyag g.yas kyis ral gri rdo rje'i yu ba can bzung ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub ut+pa las mtshan pa/ gcer du dur khrod kyi 1rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dang rol zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ ma te gdan du bting nas las kyi gshin rje 'dul bar bsgom/ de'i thugs ka nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas de lta du'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la phyag dang mchod pa dbul te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ d+ma pe hūṃ/ dī pe hūṃ/ gadhe hūṃ/ ni ri te hūṃ/ ni bi bye 2 hūṃ / shasna hūṃ/ zhes mchod pa dbul gtor ma gtang ngo / /gtor snod mi dmigs pa las rin po che'i rnod du bsam/ hūṃ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam / 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab par bya'o / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug la sogs pa bya zhing / yi ge gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs— 7—/ dbang bskur/ mi skyo bar du bsgom/ de nas bzlas pa'i sngags 'di yin te6/ myo spyoḥ z-iḥbi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nam mkha'i dkyil nas thog skyababs pa ltar shin tu drag par bzlas so/ /de das sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ zung du 'jug pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa sems de la gtad pa'o/ /nag po thugs kyi dpal be'u nas/ /zab mo bdud rtsi'i bcud thigs pas/ /skal ldan rin chen lta du yi 6/ /'jam 26—1723

dpal gshin rje grub par shog /'jam dpal khro bor sgrub pa rje btsun ka ma la shī las ①mjo da pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/1722 17mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉〉sa / /'jam dpal khro bo bsgrubs thabs bzhugs/ 0〈〈snar 〉stabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉btud/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar〉〉bsrung / thu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kyis/ pya 〈〈pe〉dze〈snar 〉〉du/ 4 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bsgom ste/1722 17〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dharma yin pya 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ she〈〈pe 〉྾po ra 〉4)sa/ ④〈〈snar 〉torabul/ thu〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ ⑥〈po ra 〉starabul/ ge〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉thadud rtsir/ ༷ )〈〈pe 〉sko'adir 〉sngag ste/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉5〈snar 〉〉brlab/ ⑩〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉wate/ 7〈〈snar〉stasgyu/ mi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉thogs/ 7〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/1724 〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sdis/bsdukā 'bra~X /sdu) mig26wa 1724

ma / /rgya gar skad du/ ṣa ṭa dharma u pa de sha rā mab/ bod skad du / chos drug gi man ngag ces bya ba/ dpal bde mchog 'khor lo la phyaka 'tshal lo/ /dal 'byor rgyu 'bras las rnams las/ /rnal 4'byor don gyi snying po btsal— / /rnal 'byor lus kyi rtsa yi tshogs/ /phra rags rlung dang ldan pa nib/ /dbang du byed thabs 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /dbyung rngub dgang dang gzhil ba ste/ /la la nā dang ra sa tsā / /a wa spyo tī 'khor lo bzhi/ /lte bar tsaṇ+ḍa lī yi 1me/ /phra rab las 'phel hūṃ las ni/ /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /rgyu mthun la sogs 'bras bu bzhi/ /'khrul 'khor drug gis rgyas par bya/ /tsār+ya pa'i u 3 pa de sha'o // //6snad bcud khams gsum ma lus pa/ /sgyu ma mi lam la sogs dpes/ /26—1726

'gro 'dug spyod lam kun du sbyang / /lha tshogs sgyu ma me long gzugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs/ /de nyid sgyu ma'i gzugs bzhin du/ /sgyu dpe bcu gnyis ltar mthong ba/ /dal 'byor sgyu ma'i don mthong 'o/ /tsā gārdzu na'i u sgyu pa de sha'o // //ḍa mi lam rmi lam don shes shing / /rgyun du zab mo'i don bsgom pa/ /nā da thig le la sogs pa / /rigs lnga'i sa bon la dmigs nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing dang sangs rgyas blta/ /gnyid dus bde chen sgrub 3pa'i thabs la ba pa'i u pa de sha'o // // rnal 'byor a wa ṣ+pe tī pa/ /a wa rtu tīr chesems gnas pa⑩/ /snying gi thig ler sems brtan nyapas/ /'od dang 'od zer 'ja' ris dang / /skya rings kanyi 'od zla 'od dang / /nyi ma zla ba shar 'dra dang / /lha dang sku yi snang ba sogs/ /sna tshogs zhing khams dag par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lam chen te — / /tsā gārdzu na'i u pa 6de sha'o // //6 rna 'byor 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /dbang po rnams dang 'byung ba sdudaza/ /za nyi rlung rnams snying gar 'dus/ /rnal 'byor nying 'dzin sna tshogs 'char/ /rnam shes phyi rol yul song na/ /mi lam yul bzhin sna tshogs snang / /bdun bdun dus tshe 'chi snang dang / /de nas skye bar 'gyur ba nyid/ /de tshe lha yi rnal 'byor sgomaskya/ /yang na de nyid ngang la gzhag5 /de rjes 26—1726

skye la phyogs pa'i tshe/ /mnga' bdag lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /snang srid lha yi rnal 'byor sgomami/ /des ni bar do khegs par 'gyur/ / su kha si rnyi'i u pa de sha'o // // 1de las rnal 'byor 'pho ba'i tshe/ /grong 'jug lha dang sa bon gyisazu / /'gro 'ong ring dang thung ba dang / /lha la bslab mecing 'phar ba'i dus/ /gang 'dod grong du 'jug par bya/ /gong du 'bo phyon stong ra lha/ /yi sprod nyi ka hūṃ dang hūṃ/ /lha dang bla ma'i thugs kar 'phang / /des ni 'dod pa'i gnas su 'phro—/ /su kha si rnyi'i u pa de sha'o // // grub pa'i rnal 'byor 1dbang phyug tikhri pa'i zhabs kyi 6zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhas pa 1tsā ro paṇ+ḍi ta dang / 4mar pa lho brag pa chos kyi blo gros kyis kha che'i gnas puṣ+pe ha rir bsgyur ba'o6// //26—1727
brtsar 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1159)

ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag2ba / /rgya gar skad du/ ā ha pra ma ṇa saṃ myatsā ma ḍā ki rgyu pa de sha /bod skad du/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i man ngag /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zag blo yi khyad par gyis/ /rim gyis pa dang cig car ba/ /rim gyis pa yi sman chen 'di/ /cig car ba yi dug chen yin/ /cig car ba yi sman chen 'di/ /rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur / /des na sbyangs pa'i 'phro can la/ /cig car ba ni bstan par bya/ /sems can dang po'i las can la/ /rim gyis pa 'di bstan par bya/ /dang po nyon mongs gdul ba ni/ /khams kyi rab tu dbye ba bya/ /phung po zhig grol bsgom bar bya/ /bla mas bstan pa'i lam gyi ni/ /slob ma yongs su smin bya zhing / /bskyed rim gzhung las shes par bya/ /ngag dben pa dang rlung sgom pa//bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /sems la dmigs pa'i man ngag ni/ /bde 26—1730

ba chen po'i man ngag go/ /byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni/ /man ngag tshig bsdus dag las shes/ /gtum mo 'od gsal sbyangs pa la/ /sgyu ma lha bu'i lus bsgom pa/ /slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis/ /slob pa la yang gnyis yin te/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dang / /rang nyid lhag par gnas pa'o/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa la/ /gsang ba'i dbang gi dus dag tu/ /me long dri ma med pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris te/ /de yi gzugs brnyan snang dang mtshungs/ /zhes bya ba nas sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas rtogs par bya'o/ /rang nyid lhag par gnas pa la/ /'pho dang grong du 'jug pa dang / /mi lam bar do rnam pa bzhi/ /gong du 'pho ba rnam gsum ste/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul dang ni/ /sgyu ma dngos dang 'od gsal lo/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i tshul la ni/ /hūṃ la sogs pa'i yi ge yis/ /bu ga dag kyang dgag bya ste/ /rang gi sems ni lha yi sku/ /'ja' tshon lha dur bsgom pa'o/ /yang na hūṃ la bsdu bya ste/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga dag tu gdon/ /'og min gnas su yang dang yang / /rgyun mi chad par gnas par bya/ /de ltar sgom pa brtan gyur nas/ /dus dang rtags dmas shes bya ste/ /'pho khar shes pa gnas su bskyal—/ /de ltar byas pas 'pho bar 'gyur/ /sgyu ma dngos kyi 'pho ba ni/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i mi lam la/ /goms par bya ste sum cu ni/ /rtsa gsum gnas su 'pho bya ste/ /de ru sngar ni gang bsgoms pa'i/ /goms pa khrid de bsgoms gyur na/ /bde ba skye ba'i gnas yin pas/ /mi rtog ye shes thob nas ni/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /26—1731

sngags pa'i 'gro sa mchog yin te/ /mtshan nyid pa ni lhung bar 'gyur/ /'od gsal ba yi 'pho ba ni/ /'chi ba'i dus ni shes bya ste/ /mi rtog pa la sems gnas nas/ /lus kyi rtsol ba dag gis ni/ /'od gsal bar ni gzhug bya ste/ /bar dor mya ngan 'da' ba yin/ /bslabs nas 'pho ba de rnams yin/ /'od gsal ba la sems gnas na/ /slob bzhin pa yi rnal 'byor che/ /ma bslabs par yang 'pho ba yod/ /zung 'jug nying 'dzin la gnas na/ /slar zhing gang la'ang mi slob po/ /gdams pa gser 'gyur rtsi 'di yis/ /'chi tshe gang la phog gyur pa/ /dngos de mya ngan 'das gser 'gyur/ /de phyir bla ma thabs la mkhas/ /de la grong du 'jug pa ni/ /mdun du dmigs pa gsal byas la/ /dbugs dang sems ni ma yengs par/ /gtad nas yun du goms gyur na/ /des ni shes lus bya ba dang / /dmigs pa rje gsal ji gsal 'gyur/ /de la yun du goms byas nas/ /bsod nams can gyi lus blangs te/ /rang gi phung po dor byas nas/ /sems can don ni ma lus bya'o/ /rmi lam la yang rnam lnga ste / /dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang / /sbyangs dang goms pa khrid pa dang / /gong du 'pho bar shes par bya/ /dran pa shes bya sgom pa ni/ /gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang / /'dun pa dag ni sngon btang ste/ /log ka ma yi shes pa ni//dran pas yang dang yang bsgug la/ /bsgugs pas log pa lan re bzhin/ /rab 'bring sad dus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar dran pa brtan gyur nas/ /sgyu ma dag tu shes bya ste/ /ma log pa yi dus su yang / /snang srid sgyu mar shes bya ste/ /sgyu ma dngos ni mi lam yin/ /'di nyid sgyu mar ma shes pas/ /bar do sgyu mar ma shes na/ /bar do'i srid pa mi khegs pas/ /skye ba yang nas yang 26—1732

blangs te/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'gas pa yin/ /de ltar mi lam dngos dag la/ /blo ni 'jug tu ma btub na/ /sngon du 'gro ba dag bya ste/ /ma log pa yi dus su yang / /snang srid sgyu mar shes bya ste/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rtags dag dang / /'du 'dzi shin tu nyung ba dang / /sngar gyi goms pas khrid pa dang / /mos pa shin tu drag pa dang / /'gugs pa'i dus dag shes pa'o—/ /gnyid ma log pa'i dus su yang / /dran pas de nyid sgyu ma ru/ /shes bya bsam pa sngon btang la/ /nan tan du ni bsgom par bya/ /de ltar du ni goms pa dang / /phan tshun dag tu byin pa dang / /ngal dub dag ni 'ong ba dang / /'grangs ②ltogs dag ni 'ong dang / /cho 'phrul dag ni ston pa dang / /de la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams/ /gnyid log — pa yi dus su yang / /goms par byas pa'i bag chags kyis/ /log ka ma yi dus su yang / /mtshad ma'i dran pa de nyid la/ /bag mi tsha bar spyad par bya/ /des na sgyu ma'i bsre ba 'grub/ /de ltar sgyu mar yang dang yang / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bsams nas su/ /sgyu mar shes pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /ya mi nga dang bag mi tsha/ /dam dum kam kem 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ltar goms pa brtan par bya/ /de ltar brtan par gyur nas ni/ /'pho ba dag ni bya bar bshad/ /gnyid ma log mipa'i dus su yang / /sems ni gang dgar gtang bar bya/ /'gro sar sems ni btang byas nas/ /log ka ma yi dus su yang / /de ring bag chags dran byas te / /de lhar rang gi rig pa yis/ /dpyad cing gang ltar bde bar 'pho/ /'pho ba brtan par gyur pa na/ /sgyu ma sbyangs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis/ /sngon gyi bsam pa khrid par bya/ /de ltar snga ma ji bzhin bsgom/ /log kar yang dang 26—1733

yang du sgom/ /de ltar mi lam dus su yang / /dam dum bag re 'byung bar 'gyur—/ /de nas rmi lam sbyong ba la/ /gang yang bzang ngan mi lta ste/ /rtags ma byung bar zin pa'ang yod/ /rang gi rig pas rtogs bya ba/ /ma rtogs pa na 'bad cing brtag /rtsol ba dag gis bskyed byas la/ /shes pa tshar ni gcad par bya/ /gong gi bstan pa'i gdams pa ltar/ /de ltar yang dang yang byas pas/ /mod du zin pa dag kyang yod/ /longs spyod la sogs rgyud sbyangs pas/ /lo yis zin pa dag kyang yod/ /ye ma zin pa dag kyang yod—/ /de ltar yang dang yang goms pas/ /mi lam byin gyis rlob pa yin/ /de yis bar do rlobs par 'gyur/ /gong ma'i mi lam goms pa yis 'chi ka'i shes pa gsal byas te/ /'chi ka'i rtags rnams tshang ba dang / /sngar goms pa la sems bzhag ste/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par bya/ /'chi khar gnyid ni log pa ni/ /dran pa dag na sngon btang nas/ /'od gsal ngang la gnas par bya/ /sa bon skye gnas rim khyab pa/ /gzhi dang khang pa nyid dang ni—/ /las dang sbyor ba rang nus la/ /rang gi ngo bo thig ler bcas 1bcu gnyis mtha' yi tshig gi don/ /gang gis rtag tu goms gyur nas/ /des ni dngos grub bde ba yi/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid 'gyur/ /snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim/ /rags pa thim dang phra ba thim/ /thim pa'i rjes la goms pa dang / /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'byung / /de yi rjes la zung 'jug skra//slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis/ /mi slob pa ru gyur pa na/ /'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin/ /sngon byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /bar do de yi mig snga ru/ /thabs dang shes rab mthong ba la/ /26—173‘

bla ma dag tu dmigs byas te/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni dran byas nas/ /mig ser zhe sdang kun spangs te/ /bde ba'am mi rtog pa bsgoms pa'am yang na sngar dus gang bsgoms pa'i/ /sbyangs pa sngon du dran par bya/ /dus su dran pa ra gyur nas ni/ /dang po'i srid pa khegs par 'gyur/ /de nas bdun phrag bdun gyi bar/ /gong ma bzhin du goms byas na/ bzhi bcu rtsa dgu 'das pa dang / /'khor ba'i srid pa khegs pa dang / /de ltar sgyu mar gnas pa la/ /'od gsal ba yis sbyang bya ste/ /'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /rtsigs kyi rgya bdun dang bcas pa'o// //brdzur mazan/143 rngomatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa lhar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di dz+wadz+wape 〉〉〈 snar 〉〉la mi banugs pas 〈〈rtso 〉rar dpe bsdur byas yod/1433 3〈8rtso 〉ma grangs/ —‘ rtso 〉mthogs/
brtsar 'bras re'u migadzid/ (116 〉

ma /bla ma chen po tsā ro pas/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yis/ /sa ni g.yo zhing lung bstan thob—/ /shar phyogs ngogs kyi te lo pa'i/ /zhal sngar gdams pa mnos pa ni//dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ /'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /de la dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ /lus ni byang chub rnam lnga dang / /rtsa dang byang chub sems dang ni/ /mi gtsang rdzas dang dam rtog gis/ /lus kyi chos ni gnas pa yin/ /de la sems kyi gnas thabs ni/ /lus gnas ye shes chen po ste/ /skye 'gag bral ba'i ngo bo yin/ /lam la bskyed tsudang rdzogs pa'o/ /de la gnad ②ni rnam gsum ste/ /lus dang dus dang yul dang gsum/ /de la lus kyi gnad bshad pa/ /chu shing bzhin du bsrang ④ngar bya/ /re mig bzhin du brnol bar bya/ /nor bu rin chen drang por rtsar/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i 26—1737

phyag rgya ni/ /lte ba'i 'og tu bcir bar bya/ /mgul pa bsrang la nor bu sba/ /'phel ka nam mkha' ltar yangs bya/ /yul gyi gnad ni gnyis yin te/ /phyi yi dkar dmar rnam pa can/ /nang du 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi/ /de la thabs lam bgrang mi lang / /de la dus kyi gnad bshad pa/ /g.yas g.yon 'pho dus zer ba yod/ /gnyid dang mi lam snyoms 'jug dang / /tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi/ /de la dus bzhi'i nyams len ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /rlung gi gnad la bzhi yin te/ /rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang / /mda' ltar gyen du 'phangs pa ste/ /srog rtsol gyi 6ni sbyor ba yis/lte ba'i a las me sbar te/ /'khor lo bzhi bsregs rtsa kha dbye/ /me lce haṃ la reg pa yis/ /byang chub sems kyi rtsa rnams dgang / /a las babs shing thigs pa chad/ /bde stong dbyer med don la gzung / /sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na/ /yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba'i nyen/ /'byung bzhi ro snyoms ma shes na//bsgoms kyang bogs ni mi 'byung ste/ /bcos thabs bgrang ni mi lang gis/ /gtum mo'i go cha gcigs su che/ /de las 'bras bu 'char ba ni/ /dang po dro ba lta bu 'byung / /gnyis pa du ba lta bu 'byung / /gsum pa srin bu me khyer dang / /bzhi pa mar me lta bu ste/ /lnga pa nam mkha' lta bur 'char/ /de nas bde ba 'char ba dang / /rnam par rtog pa shugs kyis 'gag /smig rgyu srin bu me khyer dang / /skya rengs shar ba lta bu 'byung / /'byung bzhi gcig la gcig thim nas/ /tsaṇ+ḍa lī ni shugs kyis 'bar/ /shu kra nges par 'bab par nges/ /nang gi tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags/ /nam mkha' sprin dag lha bu rnams / /rim pas grangs kyis 'byung bar gsungs/ /seng ge dkar mo'i 'o 26—1738

ma de/ /gser skyogs dngul skyogs ma yin pa/ /snod ngan phal du mi blugs 'tshal—/ /brgya la gal te blugs pa na/ /snod kyang chag la 'o ma 'bo /bla ma grub thob man ngag 'di/ /slob ma skal ldan ma gtogs pa/ /snod ngan rnams la byin gyur na/ /dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /des na sbya ngas pa'i las can gces/ /bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba gtum mo'i tshig dz+ram/brtson 'grus can tshe 'di la sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa'o// //sgyu lus lam du bya ba ni/ /snang ba 'di dang 'gro ba kun/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dir bshad de/ /sgyu ma lta du'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar mthong / /phyi dang nang du rnam phye ba/ /thams cad sgyu ma las kazhan min/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /sgyu ma'i lus 'di shes par bya/ /kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lha du/ /khyab pa chu yi zla bas so/ /me long dri ma med pa la/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar snang dang mtshungs/ /rnal 'byor pas ni gang gang dmigs/ /de de sgyu ma bzhin du brtags/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan dang / /mi lam sgyu ma chu bur dang / /mig 'phrul mtshungs par gang gis mthong / /smig rgyu mi lam lta bu dang / /dri za'i grong r+ṣa dag dang mtshungs/ /sgyu mar bstan pa'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /'gro ba sgyu ma ji bzhin te/ /dmigs med kun rdzob dag tu ni—/ /sgyu ma lha bur rab tu bshad/ /dag pa lha yi sgyu lus dang / /rnam par smin pa'i sgyu lus te/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri/ /ro dang reg bya nyid dag la/ /mig la sogs pa la 'jug pa/ /sgyu ma lta bu nye bar brtags/ /26—1739

rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid du/ /mang du bshad pas ci zhig bya/ /bag chags dag pas sangs rgya ba sgyu lus kyi tshig spram// //rmi lam lam khyer gdams pa ni/ /chos rnams rmi lam lta bu ste/ /ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing / /rang bzhin dag pa de nyid la/ /'khrul pa log par rab tu gsungs/ /rdo rje las byung sna tshogs pa'i/ /mi lam dri ma med mthong na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /skyes pa bla med 'grub par 'gyur//'di la don lnga rgyas par bshad/ /don bzhis lam du slong ba'o/ /dran dang sgyu mar shes pa dang / /sbyangs dang goms pa khrid pa rnams/ /sngar ni gong du rgyas par bstan/ /don bzhis nyams su blang ba ni/ /dang por mi lam bzung dang / /de das sbyang zhing sgyu mar bslab/ /de nas ya nga spang ba dang / /kho na nyid don bsgom pa'o/ /chos rnams mi lam ltar shes nas/ /sems can don du rab tu 'jug /sgyu ma lha bur lam khyer bas/ /sgyu ma lta bur sangs kyang rgya/ /bag chags can mi lam la brten nas sangs rgya ba'i tshig sbram// //'od gsal lam du bya ba ni/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gdod nas dag pa nam mkha' bzhin/ /ye shes gsum ni rnam dag pa/ /snang ba gsum gyi rgyu can te/ /ma lus yul la zhugs nas nikyi/ /'od gsal bar ni zhugs par 'gyur/ /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /ji ltar dang ba'i chu klung las/ /nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar/ /de 26—1740

bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'byung zhing 'gag /'od sasal 'di ni rnam lnga ste/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal dang / /shes rab 'od gsal 'char ba dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od gsal dang / /de bzhin nyid kyi 'od gsal dang / /rtogs pa'i 'od gsal bstan pa'o/ /de la dus ni lnga yin te/ /'chi ba'i dus dang dbu mar gnas/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni log pa'i tshe/ /mnyam rjes ro gcig gyur pa dang / /lhag mthong rtogs pa'i dus yin no/ /'od gsal mngon du gyur pa las/ /de las zung du 'jug par 'char/ /gnyid 'thug pos sangs rgya ba 'od gsal gyi tshig spram// //'pho ba'i bye brag shin tu mang / /sbyangs te 'pho dang ting 'dzin dang / /srog dang rtsol bas 'pho ba dang / /lus kyi rtsol bas 'pho ba dang / /rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba dang / /btsan thabs dag tu 'pho ba dang / /spros med chos sku'i 'pho ba dang / /spros bcas gzugs sku'i 'pho ba dang / /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i 'pho ba dang / /yid 'ong mkha' 'gro'i 'pho ba'o/ /de dag thams cad ro gcig par/ /sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ /pus mo bskor zhing se gol gdab/ /brgya rtsa brgyad pa zin pa'i tshad/ /snying gar zin nas lkog mar bzung / /dbugs ni ngal bar gyur pa na/ /sna sgor cha mnyam ngal bso bya/ /rang 'dod dbu mar zin gyur na/ /bde ba'i 'khor lor drang bya ste/ /shes pa bde can du gtad/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nas 'pho bar bya/ /rims la sogs pas ma phog par/ /'pho ba'i sbyor ba mchog yin no/ /dus la babs na 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 26—1741

'dam pa'i lus dag las/ /ye shes sku ni rang dgar 'byung / /ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba 'pho ba'i tshig spram// //bar do lam du slong ba ni/ /dang po snang ba gsum gyis ni/ /thim pas 'od gsal ngos bzung ba/ /gnyis pa dag dang ma dag pas/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas ni/ /bar ma dor ni sangs rgya thabs/ /gsum pa mngal sgo dgag pa dang / /bzhi pa mngal sgo bsdam pa'o/ /de la skye shi'i bar do ru/ /bsgoms te sangs rgya gtum mo dang / /sgyu ma'i sku la bablab par bya/ /de la goms par gyur pa dang / /rmi lam sgyu lus gnyis bsres la/ /mi lam bar do sbyang bar bya/mi lam sgyu lus 'byongs pa dang / /'chi ka'i dus kyi bar do ru/ /'od gsa' ba dang 'dres pa las/ /sgyu lus ril 'dzin rjes zhig gis/ /bag chags thams cad bsregs pa na/ /'od gsal me yis sbyangs nas ni/ /zung du 'jug pa'i skur sangs rgya/ /rim gyis 'jug pa'i gang zag gis/ /shes pa skye lugs 'di lta ste/ /snang ba thim dang rtog pa thim/ /rags pa thim dang phra ba thim—/ /thim pa'i rjes su goms pa yis/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'byung / /de yi rjes la zung 'jug 'char/ /sku ni rnam pa gnyis 'byung ste/ /slob pa dang ni mi slob gnyis/ /mi slob pa ru gyur tsa na/ /'bras bu thob ces bstan pa yin/ /gong du bstan pa de dag ni/ /rgyas par bshad na 'di lta ste//dang po lung rigs man ngag gis/ /rgyud la rtogs pa shar tsam na/ /snang ba 'gag lugs bstan pa ni/ /gzugs ni sgra la thim gyur zhing / /sgra yang dri la dri yang ro/ /reg bya'i bar du rim gyis thim/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /26—1742

de rnams rim gyis rnam shes la/ /rnam shes snang ba la thim che/ /phyi rtags zla shar lta bur blta/ /nang rtags du ba lta bu 'byung / /snang ba de nyid mched pa la/ /thim tshe phyi rtags nyi shar 'dra/ /shes pa mar me lta bu 1'byung / /mched pa thob pa la thim pas/ /phyi rtags mun pa lta bu 'byung / /shes rab mar me lta bur 'char/ /thob pa 'od gsal la thim pas/ /phyi rtags tho rangs dus tshod kyi/ /skya rengs shar ba lta bu 'byung / /nang gi shes pa nam mkha' ni/ /sprin dag lta bur 'char ba'o/ /'od gsal de las ldang ba yi/ /zung 'jug ngos ni gzung bya ste/ /mngon par byang chub 'od gsal mes/ /bag chags thams cad sbyong dus su/ /slob pa'i zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed med tsam na/ /goms pa mthar phyin gyur pa ste/ /mi slob zung 'jug ces bya'o/ /'bras bu thob par gyur pa yin/ /de las srid pa'i bar ma do//sgyu lus zung 'juka skur gyur te/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob bo/ /de la goms pas mngal sgo khegs/ /gal te zung 'jug ma shes na/ /srid pa'i skye ba mi khegs pas/ /chags sdang snang ba kun spangs la/ /dran pa'i spyan mas mtshams sbyar te/ /mngal bdam pa yi sbyor ba bya/ /mngon dga'i 'pho ba byas pa yis—/ /gar 'dod gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /'chi ba stong pa chos sku la/ /bar ma do ni longs spyod rdzogs/ /srid par skye ba sprul pa yi/ /skye ba'i cha ni thabs yin la/ /'gag pa shes rab srid mthar byed/ /srid pa bar dor sangs rgya ba bar do rnam pa gsum gyi lam dang bsre ba bar do'i tshig sbram// //grong du 'jug pa'i 'pho ba ni/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i 'pho ba las/ /bye 26—1743

brag gsal bar bstan pa ste/ /dang por sngon 'gro sbyangs pa dang / /dngos gzhi dmigs pa gsal ba yin/ /las la sbyar ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du thod pa ni/ /mtshan ldan cig la hūṃ bris te/ /de la shes pa gtad pa dang / /gsal zhing dang la yang ba yi/ /rig pa bde ba skye bar 'byur/ /rlung dang rnam par shes pa yang / /phyi rol lha dang rang nyid bsre/ /dang po khru gang bar khru gsum/ /tha mar khru bdun pa yi ni/ /dmigs pa rno la ngar ldan pas/ /steng 'og spo bar nus pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis 'grub par gsungs/ /sems can rma med dag la yang / /rlung sems rtsal ni sbyang bar bya /de nas lus kyi rten brje bas/ /las la sbyar ba'i dus tshod du/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i grogs mchog gces/ /lus brjes sems can don bya'o/ /grong 'jug gi tshig spram bstan pa spru// //thabs lam byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ /gling bzhi bsdus la rgya mtsho brag la gtad/ /dar chen phyar la chu mig gyen du bzlog /'og rlung drangs la snying gar phyin par bya/ /stag mo khyi mo wa bzhad skad/ /steng 'og rlung ni bsdams par bshad/ /de ni bzung ba'i man ngag go/ /rtsa mig gang ba'i man ngag ni/ /chu snod g.yas g.yon gsum gcu ste/ /yi ge'i rgyug tshul lan gsum bya/ /lus la khyab par bya ba ni/ /dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng dag tu / /lkog ma lan gsum gcu zhing gzhag /g.yas pa la yang de lhar bya/ /seng ge rnam rol phyag rgya yis/ /lus kun la ni khyab par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po'i man ngag go/ /srog rtsol gnas su bsdams bya ste/ /rtsa rlung thig le 26—1744

mtshan ldan dang / /'od gsal rjes su gnang ba sgom/ /srog rtsol dag la dbang thob na/ /rlung ni g.yas g.yon sgo nus dang / /kha dog bye brag tshor ba med / /bsdams gnod med cing phyi nang bsre/ /tsha grang 'dres pa'i rtags byung na/ /rlung lnga 'od gsal thim pa na/ /dgos dgu thams cad 'byung ba dang / /dngos grub thob par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la/ /chu bo'i rgyun bzhin nyams blangs na/ /dam tshig de yis skong bar gsungs / /mi lam mngon sum gang la yang / /cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba la / /sgyu mar shes na lam du 'gyur/ /bden par bzung na bar chod yin—/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis thob pa na/ /bar chad lam gyi grogs su 'char—/ /gsang sngags thabs kyi lam mchog gi/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bcud bsdus pa/ /snying po 'di ni bla na med/ /skal ldan rnams kyi spyod yul lo/ /'di ni thabs lam bka' dpe kun la ma gnang ba yin no/ /bka' rgya lan gsum du yod do// //

bsdur mchan/1737 1mtshan byang 'di 〈〈lde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈bai 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉la rmye b.rugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/ — sna〈〈co 〉〉10 522ca 〉stananas/ ④〈〈co 〉〉bgrang //rdo// ༷༷༷/ /shās/ 7〈〈co 〉mi 1743 1〈〈co 〉〉bur/ ci ri ci brtsar —'bras re'u mig — da/ (1161) sna 26wa 1746

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ palca kra ma saṃ gra ha pra bha wa/ bod skad du/rim pa lnga bsdus pa gsal ba/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che/ /rim pa lnga la gnas pa po/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni/ /'bras du skye ba'i rim pa'o/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs gnyis yin te/ /sems dang lus kyi gnas thabs las/ /rags dang phra dang shin tu phra/ /thun mong dbyer med rim zhes bya/ /gnyid dang mi lam snyoms 'jug pa/ /tha mal dus dang rnam pa bzhi/ /'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid kyis/ /rtsa ⑤dang thig le sems shes pa/ /lus dang dus dang yul gyi ni/ /gnad ni bzhi ru shes par bya/ /dran pa sna tshogs rnam rtog rnams/ /sems las yang dag 'byung bas na/ /rnam shes srog ni 'du ba'i rten/ /snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom/ /gzhi jilam 'bras bu rab shes pas/ /lus 26—1747

dben sngags dang sems gsum gyi/ /sgyu ma mngon par byang chub pa/ /zung 'jug rim pa shes par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi 3yi ge'i 'khor lo ni/ /dang por chu skyes 'dab brgyad pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /rim pa ldan par bsam gtan bya/ /phyi rim shes rab dbyangs yig mtshan/ /bar ma gsal byed thabs bcas pa/ /gnyis su med par nang mar gnas/ /phyogs mtshams rim par ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum rang bzhin/ /dbus su mig gi thig le ste/ /sa dang bcas pa srog gyur gang / /kun gyi snying po spro zhing sdud/ /'byung ba bzhi yi rlung rnams nyid/ /rlung dang sngags su rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje bzlas pa sbyang bar bya/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa nyi shu bshad / /tha mal rnam rtog bag chags rnams/ /sngags nyid sems su dmigs pas so/ /lus dag pas ni rtog pa dag /rlung dag pas ni dri med 'gyur / /rlung dag pas ni ye shes kyi/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma mngon du byed/ /de nyid mngon par byang chub pas/ /zung 'jug ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /las rnams bya ba phrin las tshogs/ /rnam shes ye shes sbyor bas 'grub/ /rtags rnams rim par 'char ba'i dngos/ /ye shes lnga yi rgyu mthun nyams/ /gsal snang 'bar ba'i ngang du'o/ /yan lag rlung las mngon shes 'thob — / /rtog pa'i tshogs ni mar 'grib cing / /gnyen po ye shes yal 'phel du/ /ye shes rim pa rang las rnyed/ /gcig dang du mar dmigs mi phyed/ /dang po sbig rgyu lta bu'i nyams/ /'od zer lnga dang bcas pa 'char/ /gnyis pa zla ba lta bu dang / /gsum pa nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'khrigs— / /mtshams snang las ni thob pa ste/ /mtshams bral dus kyi ye shes che/ /mngon par byang chub tshul 26—1748
