bzhin 'dzin pas ⑫chos dang / de ltar ༄ na'ang lhag par gnas pa nyid ji ltar byur pa'i gnas skabs de lta bu'i snang bar 'byung bas dbyings so/ /de bas na 'di ltar gzhi med cing mngon par gsal ba'i sems nyid ni chos kyi dbyings te/sbyin pa po la sogs pa'i 'khor gsum po de ni de'i rang bzhin du mnyam pa nyid yin pa de'i pyir 'gyur ba med pa'i 'bras bu 'thob pa'o/ /de dang de lta bu nyid du phyi rol nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dga' ba yang ngo zhes bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa/ji ltar gyur pa nyid kyis na de bzhin nyid de ngo bo ni rang bzhin no/ /der dbyer med pa ni rnam pa'i dbye bas stong pa ste/ gzhi med pa'i chos nyid kyis so//khams gsum po ni lus dang ngag dang yid do/ /gcig par yang dag rig pa ni gang 'ba' zhig tu'o/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyi rgyun zad med pa yi/ /zhes bya ba ni 'di lhar ṭīng nge 'dzin la brtan par mngon du phyogs par byas pa dmas kyi gzhi med pa 'ba' zhig pa'i blo ji srid bar ma chad par 'jug pa de srid du'o/ /dga' ba zhu'adi ni mchod pa'i snying po ste chos kyi dbyings nyid kyis gnas pa mngon sum du yang dag par rig cing nyams su myong bas de bzhin gshegs pa la nye bar spyod pa'i mchod pa chen po nyid du gyur pa'o/ /de ni shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid kyi blo ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa la gnas pas dus thams cad pa dang rnam pa thams cad pa'i gtor ma chen po'o/ /de la 'di lha bur rgya chen po'i tshogs gnyis kyang rnam par dag pa'o zhes ston te/ byang chub ni yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par gsal ba'i sku gsum mo/ /sbyin pa la sogs pa yongs su gyur pas longs spyod chen po la sogs pa dang mchog gi dbang phyug gi sku yang dag pa'i 'bras bu byed pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang /26—1803

de nyid kyang chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi dngos po nyid kyis ji srid du 'od gsal ba dang dbyer med pa'i de bzhin nyid du gnas pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /de dang de lta bu'i tshogs gnyis po yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par dam par dag pas phul du byung ba'i nges pa'i 'bras bu byed pa ste/ gang gi phyir de lta yin pa de'i phyir tshogs thams cad kyang dri ma med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa srid pa dang zhi ba la mi gnas shing nyon mongs pa ma lus pa spangs pas rnam par dag pa nyid du gyur pa la brten pa yin no/ /de bzhin du yon tan shin tu gsal bar yid la byed pas chen po nyid du byed pa rab gnas dang / sngags dang bcas pas bkug nas bsreg za la ⑫sreg blugs byed pa sbyin sreg 0dang / der ji lhar mngon par 'dod pa'i lha la ji ltar rig pa'i mchod pa'i sbyor ba dang /la sogs pa'i sgras slob ma bsdu ba dang de la dbang bskur ba sbyin pa la sogs pa'o//bya ba ni yul gyi tha snyad kyis ji ltar byas pa ste/ sna tshogs pa'i tha snyad nye bar btags pa la mngon par zhen pa brgyud mar 'byung ba kun kyang mi spong bar ting nge 'dzin du byed pas rnam par spyod pas na dri ma med pa'o/ /shes rab ni chos mtha' dag 'gyur ba med par rtogs pa'o/ /thabs ni de gzhi med par snang zhing bde ba'i rang bzhin du rtogs pa ste/ gnyis po de dag sbyor ba ni yang dag par kun nas dbyer med cing tha snyad du 'brel par byas pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag yang dag par rtogs pa ste/ de spub par byed pa ni de dang de lha bu'i ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa 'di mtha' dag las tha snyad du rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub par byed pa'o/ /da ni rab tu gnas pa'i de kho na nyid gsungs pa/ phyi rol gyi rnam par 26—1804

yongs su gzung zhing yid la byas pa'i yul dang yid la byed pa thams cad nub pa ni nye bar zhi ba'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes kyi 'khor lo spro zhing bsdu ba dang gzhug pa la sogs pa ste/ de'i tshe snang ba mtha' dag sgyu ma dang mi lam dang mtshungs par snang bzhin pa dri ma med cing gsal ba shātsam 'ba' zhig pa yang dag par rig pa la'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i rang bzhin yang ste—/ gang gnas pa zhes pa ni gang dbyer med par gnas pa'o/ /de nyid ni mtha' dag sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'ang rab tu gnas pa ste/ bla na med pa ni ji ltar yod pa rtogs pa nyid kyis so/ /'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mchog tu gsang ba chen po las gzhan ma yin la/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par mchod pa'i ched du 'di ltar cho ga ji lta bas khrus la sogs pa de noms bya ba de la ni rnam par dag pa'i dad pa'i stobs dang ldan pa las 'di noms su de bzhin gshegs pa nyid rab tu gnas pa dang byin gyis brlabs 0pa yang de dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i rnam par rol pa ni lus pa med pa'i rol pa sna tshogs pas rnam par rtsen ②pa 'di nyid yang dag par rig —pa las tshogs ma lus pa spub par byed pa'o zhes ston pa ni/ gnyis su med pa'i dag pa yang dag par rig pas chos mtha' dag lha'i bdag nyid du rab tu sad pa rtogs pa'i rnam par rol pa'i tshogs kyi rgyur gyur pa'i rol pa la/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i nga rgyal rab tu byed pas mchog gi bde ba'i tshogs nyams su myong ba las rnal 'byor pas tshogs gnyis po rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /de bzhin du mchod pa'i de kho na nyid ni dga' ba ste/ de yang 'di ltar lha'i rang bzhin gyis rol pas na/ 'di nyid skyo ba 26—1806

med par rnam pa thams cad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi blos rang gi 'dod pa'i ro rab 'byam du gyur pa las phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyid de/ bsam gyis mi khyab sbyor ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /zhes bya ba ni kun du rtog pa ma lus pas stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi ting nge 'dzin te/ gnyis kyi dngos por yongs su dmigs pa'i dmigs pa bcom nas sgyu ma dang rkyadami lam dang mtshungs pa'i sbyor ba rtsom pa'i rim pa mngon par 'phel ba la ②bde ba'i rol pa yang de dang mtshungs par rab tu gsal ba'o/ /rdo rje'i dbang phyug ces bya ba ni bcad cing gzhig tu med pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis rdo rje dang rang ④gzhan phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag po nyid kyis dbang phyug ste/ sku gnyis su nus pa 'di nyid las kye'i rdo rje nyid do//mchod par bya zhes bya ba ni rtogs par bya ba ste/ rtogs par byas pa las rang nyid mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur ba nyid kyis so/ /gzugs la sogs pa lnga ni gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa lnga zhes pa'o / /btags pa ni de la gnyis kyi rnam pas mngon par zhen pa'o/ /za ba ni de ⑤'joms pa'o/ /dam tshig ni kun du ba'i ye shes te/ de lhar na gnyis spangs nas rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa nyid goms pa las kyang kun nas mtha' dag gsal zhing gtugs pa med par ma lus pa'i chos kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gnas skabs thob par 'gyur ba 'di nyid ni 'dir dam tshig chen po yin no/ /gang gi phyir dam tshig de ni rnam par dag pa ste/ nom par dag pas ni thams cad du ji ltar 'dod pa'i kun du spyod pas gnas par bya ba'o / /de'i phyir rnam par dag pa ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub spub par byed pa yin te / de ( 7bas na ji ltar 'dod pa'i kun du spyod pas gnas pa tsam nyid kyis 26—1806

nom par dag par 'gyur ba ni ma yin pas/ 'di ltar rnam par dag pa'i ye shes la brtson par bya ba'o/ /da ni 'di'i phan yon gsungs pa/ rnam par rtog pa dengs pa yis/ /lhag par mos pa mi 'byung ba/ /gsal bar snang ba 'di de ni/ /rang rig bde ba chen po'o/ /'ga' zhig bdud rtsi zhes bya ba'i/ /gtam nyid kyis ni tshim mod kyang / /mngon sum nyams myong bdag nyid ni/ /ro la brtson pa'i rnam smin no/ /su zhig gzugs kyi tshogs bsdu ba3/ /dmigs dang bcas la chags med dang / /dmigs pa med par rtse gcig pa'i/ /mchog de rnams ni dkon pa nyid/ /'ga' zhig stong pa nyid la ngang / /la la sbyor ba'i rim par rmongs / /su zhig bde ba che spro ba'i/ /rang bzhin can 'dir rnal 'byor pa//zhes so/ /go bar byed pa'i snying po rab tu dad pas gsal byas las— /bsod nams phung po dri ma med pa bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des ni 'jig rten rnam par rtog pa'i dra ba yongs bsal nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshogs mchog snying po go bar byed gyur cig /dpe la shin tu rmongs pa ro gcig gyur pa'i yid can rnams kyi dper bya rab gsal ba/ /gsal bar rig pa bla ma'i bla mar gyur la gal te shes rab rang bzhin can yin lhong / /gzhan las rtogs pa'i 'bras min rdo rje can gyi bka' lung thob pa rgyud dang rjes mthun pa/ /de rig pa la go byed snying po brgya par dpal ldan he ru ka yis brjod pa yin/ /dngos po'i yid kyi rol pa mang po'i tshogs kyis phal cher brtse ba'i ro yis ni/ /bsnyems pa'i brtsams pas rnam par bsgyings pa'i gus pas 'jug pa ci yang rung ba spros/ /rnam pa thams cad don ni ji lta'i nyams kyis kun du rtog pas 26—1807

gzung ba las/ /bdag la ches sngar dad ces smra bar bya kuba'am ji lhar bya ba de bzhin gyis / /gang zhig nad pa shin tu skom pa'i gdung ba yis kyang chu/ /mthong nas dang sa der ni snyen kyang rnam par dpyod pa yis/ /rmongs pas 'dir ni 'thung dang bsten par yang ni mi byed pa/ /de la bde ba gcig kyang ga la sgom pa nyid ces bya/ /go bar byed pa'i snying po brgya pa rnam par bshad pa zhes bya ba dpal ho ru ka de ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs sad ②ga ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrī ba na rasna'i zhal sngar/dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mchos sde zhes bya bas dpal ngam ring gi yang rtser mnyan bye zhing bsgyur ba las/ phyis legs par brtags shing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o ⑤brdzur ma na/1shā68 1 mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa rtor bkod cing / dz+wa‘pe 〉 〈snar 〉〉ga /go b.rabyed pa'i snyir po brgya pa'i tshig gsal tshig gsal zhes bya ba'i 'grel pa/ 0dz+wadz+wape 〉 2snar 〉ma / 3〈dz+wape〉〉((snar 〉nga/ —dz+wa‘pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 8〈pe 〉〉(〈snar 〉8da/176‘ nyadz+wa〈pe 〉7dz+wasnar 〉 nga / 0〈 pe 〉ྈdz+wasnar 〉rta/ zhudz+wa2pe 〉 'ar 〉〉du/ ④ ‘dz+wape〉 'ar 〉yartenapa 88pe〉〉dz+wa‘snar 〉 / che ( pe〉〉dz+wadz+wasnar 〉〉zhes/147༷ 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈‘snar 〉〉kyis shes/ ༷ 〈8pe 〉〉‘(snar 〉〉so/1771 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈dz+wasnar 〉8'i/ ḍa ‘‘pe 〉 'dzir 〉chogs/ — ‘‘pe 〉〉dz+wa'adir 〉mdub/ 0〈〈pe 〉 'ar 〉༅sgyur/dzi〈‘pe 〉〉〈‘snar 〉〉rnam pa/ ④〈dz+wape〉〉(dz+wasnar 〉 co 〉༅/ ④‘ pe〉 tsār 〉 ste/ ②(‘pe 〉 dz+wasnar〉1ba'o /'i 8‘pe〉〉8‘snar 〉〉bzhin/ ⑫8‘pe 〉 dz+wasnar 〉lnga'i/ da1472 mi8dz+wape 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ni/ — dz+wa‘pe 〉〉dz+wa〈snar 〉chog pas byang / 1〈〈pe 〉 dz+wasnar 〉7 ba'i/ ((rngo〉〉2‘snar 〉〉skyed/26nga 1808
bskur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (1164)

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ā yuḥsādha dz+wa/ bod skad du/ tshe skrub pa'i thabs/ dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig skyil grung gdan ldan lus kyi rgal tshigs dbyug pa rengs par ni/ /byas nas 'byung 'jug rlung dag yang dang yang du zung gi las bya ste/ /bshang ba'i gnas yongs btsum las gyen du grangs zhing o ṭi yā gnas bsdam/ /srog rnams steng du bkug nas mgrin pa'i dril chung bu gar rnal 'byor bya/ /'di ltar rlung ni sbyangs pa'i cho gas bkug pa na ni rang dbang nyid/ /thob pa rab tu byung ba gang tshe rlung ni glog dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de las de lhar dri med bde ster zla ba lce'u chung las 'bab pas/ /skams pa'i rtsa tshogs nyin dang mtshan du tshig bya de bzhin bza' bas so/ /yo gri bi burtse ka ra'i man ngag ste/ rgya gar shar phyogs sad+ma ga ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal nags kyi rin po che'i spyan sngar dge slong chos smrab 26—1812

bsod nams rgya masna1re sdes bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/1812 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing /chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉la mi banugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bkur byas yod/ba kā 'bra~X ༵shā) mig26wa 1813

chog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud ba yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/3 ༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ ṭī tsakra sasbra ro pa de sha nu kha kaṇ+ḍa pa rasba ra ci'i ma ṇi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor du zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum bdag nyid dgos 'byung bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad ze 'bru dri med 'od zer la phyag 'tshal/ /gsang sngags mthar thug snying po'i bcud phyung yid bzhin nor bu mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin rtogs pas 'dir gsal bkod/ /bde gshegs thugs la snang ba dri med palca pa nas rtogs pas ke ri li ru gsang bdag mnyes/ /spyod pas zil mnan lus kyi bkod pas rnal 'byor rjes bzung mdzad pa tha mas 'gro rnams stong par byas/ /bslab pa gsum dang brgyud par ldan pa nyams su myong bas 'jug tshul shes pas bla ma dam par shes/ /sen dha ba dang rigs chad bran ltar rus sbal spu ste mo gsham bu 26—1814

ltar slob ma skyon lnga bral/ /mchog gi don 'dod gang gi de brten thog mar dbang bzhis rgyud smin thabs dang shes rab 'grel pa nyid/ /'di don rim par brgyud pa rna bar 'pho byed de tshe sangs rgyas bstan gnas gus pas mnyan par gyis/ /sa yi cho ga lhag par gnas pa rig byed slob dpon rig sbyor sogs kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur bya/ /bslab pas rgyud mdzes thos bsam nor ldan bla mar 'os pa phul ba bla mas gsal stong la sogs bskur/ /nyer lnga lhag spangs rigs ldan rgyan spras zag bcas bskul sogs gsum pa byin nas brtul zhugs brtan par bya/ /dga' ba gsum son lhan cig skyes pa rnyoka pa dang bral yul du bya sogs 'bras bur shes par gyis/ /dbang bzhi dang 'brel brda yis mtshon pa shes rab bdag nyid sin+d+ra ra la mnyes sogs ston mos brgyan/ /slob dpon bzhi la dbang bzhi dus bzhi byed pa bcu gnyis chos nyid dbang la mtshon du med par byos/ /dbang gis smin nas rim pa gnyis shes rnal 'byor dbang phyug zung du 'jug pa rgyal ba'i sku sgrub phyir/ /dbang po'i rim pas dbye dang bsdu ba'i rim pa shes nas 'du 'dzi med par rgyun du 'bad pas spyad/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi gsol dang khams sogs bablab pa 'khor lo tshogs brten rgyu 'bras nyid dang phra mor brjod/ /go cha ye shes rgyas btab sku gsung mchod dang bzlas pa rdzogs rim phrin las phyokas dang thub pa nyid/ /bsdus pa'i sbyor ba tshad med bzhi ldan rdzus te skyes pa skad cig rnal 'byor bzlas par bcas pa nyid/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po lhan cig skyes pa snang sems dbyer med rnon po'i spyod yul zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku/ /kun la khyab pa'i ngo bo nyid ston gsal rig mtshan nyid thub pa'i dbang po bde gshegs kun gyi gtso/ /gsum gsal bdag gis 26—1815

mngon sum nyid du legs par rtogs nas bsgom dang bzlas pa gsal por rab tu byekhya/ /chos dbyings skye med rgyal ba yum gcig rgyal dang rgyal ba nyid de nam mkha'i ri mo lta/ /brtan dang g.yo ba rten dang brten pa lha yi rang bzhin rang la bcug nas sna yi rtse mor rdo rje bzlas/ /gtor ma byin nas dbang po 'jing pos 'od gsal bsgoms ⑫te dbang sogs lam dang dam tshig 'bras dur bsre/ /bdag 'jug dbang dang bla ma mchod byed nyams chags bskang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' brtan pa'i cho ga bzlas/ /rgyal po blon po dmangs kyi byed pas mtshams kyi kun spyod za nyal 'gro dang khrus sogs rnal 'byor bya/ /rnam rtog dang bral zla ba drug tu nges par bsams nas grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas rol par gnas//thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad dngos grub mthar phyin zab dang rgya che ba dang gnyis med dam tshig kun gyi gzhi/ /bag yod bsgom zhing rten dang gsal ba mi bsag mi 'bral bza' bsrung mchog gyur thub pas rab tu gsungs/ /bslab pa gsum dang rgyu 'bras zhen med dbang sogs 'bras bu rgyud gzhan las gsungs rang sems brtan pas bsrungs/ /sku gsum la brten ting 'dzin gsum gyis rgya cher rab gsal gzhi lam 'bras bus lta ba mtshon par gyis/ /rnal 'byor srog rtsol sangs rgyas mnga' bdag g.yon dang g.yas su rim pa ji bzhin rgyu ba nges pa ste—/ /mnyam par bzhag pas 'jug pa'i rlung nyid bum pa can du byas nas bstan pa'i go 'phang so sor thob/ /rlung gi sbyor ba 'di nyid mi shes las dalda las min mi grub rlung rig pas ni 'bras bu ster/ /gdams pas tshe dang bzlas pa'i rim pa goms pas dge dang mi dge 'chi bzlog rlung rig pas ni shes/ /bya dang byed las chos mtshungs rgyu mtshan gdams pa'i sbyor ba bskyed rim goms pas 26—1816

mthun pa'i rkyen dang ldan/ /gsang spyod la gnas sdug bsngal bzod pas lus gnad gsum ldan dmigs pa bzhi las sbyor ba'i skyon bsal te/ /steng 'og bar du 'bugs pa'i sbyor ba li ri'i tshul du sgo gsum sbyang bar bya phyir nges par rol / /rdo rje bzlas pa yig 'bru gsum la goms shing sangs rgyas lnga la kha dog so sor basbab par bya/ /'byung ba lnga yi rlung zin pas ni du ba smig rgyu me khyer mar me sprin med nam mkha' 'byung / /brtan pa'i rtags su zla zer nyi zer glog gi zer dang 'ja' tshon nyi zlar bsres pa dngos su mthong / /spyod lam dang ni sbyor ba mkhas pas dug sogs gzhom dang 'chi ba rtag pa la sogs sna tshogs rgyur//rtsa dang rlung dang thig le 'dres pas bde gsal mi rtog rgyun mi 'chad par rgyal por 'gyur ro kye/ /rim pa 'di nyid 'phel bar bya phyir snang dmigs dngos po sgyu mar bsams la dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mtshan dpes spras pa'i gzugs brnyan la ni rab tu dmigs la dngos po chu zla lhar/ /bcu gnyis sgyu ma'i dpe yis mtshon te mnyam rjes la ni chos brgyad las 'das mkha' bzhin snyoms par 'jug /de ltar shes pas mi bya ba med sngags zlos bsrung sogs mi dgos dge slong sogs la phyag mi bya/ /'di dang mtshan dus bsre zhing sbyang dang goms pas gyen du 'phangs te bde gshegs bltas la chos sogs mnyan//rmi lam med dus gnad dang ldan pas 'dod chags la sogs brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'od gsal chen pos sa bcur gyur pa lam ma bgrod na rnam shes gong du 'pho/ /sna tshogs don chen mthong nas shes pa spong ste rim pa gnyis ldan 'jug phyir gzhan gyi mi 'gyur ro/ /chags dang chags bral 'di ma shes par gzhan ni don med dus gsum sangs 26—1817

rgyas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /ri bong rgyug dang zla ba chu 'dzin dus dang 'brel pa bslab bcas sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes phyir/ /sgo gsum gnad kyis sbyang bar bya zhing ngal na sna rtser bltas la nges shes skyes nas chen por blta/ /dang po'i las kyi yid 'ong la brten goms pas sngags las zhing dang lhan cika skyes sogs rtsa bsnyen bya/ /cig car mgon po bsgoms nas mthar gnas rdo rje'i bzlas pa rtsa la mkhas pas pad+ma'i skyon bzhi bsal/ /bde ba'i lam drangs ye shes mtshon pa mar la 'du bar rgyu 'bras shes nas zhes bya'i dkyil 'khor blta//thur sel gcud nas glang chen seng ge rma bya'i 'dren dang bya rgod stag mos snang dmigs bde bar 'char/ /sbyor bar dngas ma rlung dang mnyam zhing rig mas bde ba lus la spros nas rtsa mdud dgrol bar bya/ /bde ba'i nyams skyes tshorgas drug kun la ro mnyam lugs las 'byung dang bzlog pas dga' bzhi mtshon par bya//dga' ba gsum dang dpe don bsres nas rgyu tshogs gzung 'dzin chos nyid goms nas rtsol med 'bras bu 'char/ /ye shes gsal byed dbang gi 'bras bur rdo rje'i lus la 'khor lor mdud pa byi bor grol ba'i gnas/ /sgo dgu 'gags nas sgo bzhi thim pa gnyis kyi rnam grol ye shes lus can sgra brnyan lta bur 'bral/ /mig sogs stong dang bdud bzhi grol ba chos nyid la mkhas gsum po gcig gyur ye shes rgyun chad med/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gcig gyur bde chen dngos po ro mnyam yi ge bzhi don 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur/ /mthar ma skyol na nye bar spyod pa lus ldan bzhi dang nges shes brtags te ngo sprod shes par bya/ /skye shi b.rado shes pa snga phyi gnyid du dran mtshams 'chi ba'i dus su phra rags thim nas ni/ /'od gsal chen po de ma rtogs na bla ma sogs kyi skyel bsu nying mtshams rlung 26—1818

gsum bcing ba'i phyir/ /yon tan rdzogs pa bar dor longs sku yon tan bdun ldan de ma brtan na dug gsum las gyur pa'i/ /rtogs par bcas la dbang dus nyams dang lha sogs sgyu ma zung du 'jug pa slob dang mi slob pa/ /bdun phrag re la brgyal bar gyur pa de ma khegs na skye ba sna tshogs sprul sku nying mtshams sbyor/ /bar do gsum la 'dod chags la sogs dug gsum shes pa zag med 'od gsal sgyu mar bsres la sgom/ /'di don rim pa 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das las rgyal ba gnyis med zung 'jug phyag rgya chen por 'gyur/ /dbang dang dam tshig 'brel par ②shes pa gdod nas dag pa rkyen gyis bskur tshul nyams su blang dang rtogs/ /bum sogs dam tshig mnyam gzhag rjes spyod mi 'bral bza' bsrungs spros bcas spros med yan lag bshags bya nyid/ /dbang dus lta sogs mtshon par byas la bdud rigs ngos bzung zil gyis mnan nas sgom dang rtags su 'byel/ /tha ma 'bring dang rab dang mchog gyur 'jug sgo shes pas bsgoms la sbyar te gang dang gang la sogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir 'dod pa dus dang 'brel par spyod pa byas nas gol sa bcad par bya/ /bya dang spyod sogs tshogs su bsgyur la phrin las byed par rab gnas sbyin sreg nom bzhis 'dod dgur bsgyur/ /'khor lo bzhi la sku bzhir yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje sems dpa' sgo gsum ngo sprod mtshan dpes spras/ /rgyud rnams snying phyung man ngag bcud bsdus lam gyi rim pa bde gshegs kun thugs yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar bya phyir 'jug pa'i tshul dang zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gsal ba'i thabs nyid do/ /lus la go gyon ngag gis g.yul sprad sems kyis mtshon bsnun skru gsung khrus bcud rlung dang 'khor lo 26—1819

bskor—/ /rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgus nad sman dpyad bar chad srung 'khor gnad bral gegs bsal te/ /sa la sogs pa'i ro bzhi ngos bzung 'khor lo bzhi yis ro bzhi mnyam la zhi gnas phyogs la ni/ /thabs dang ldan pa pi wang sgra sogs rtsa rlung la ni shes rab sku gsum mthun sbyor rdzas sogs lnga/ /zin dang ma zin legs par shes nas lus kyi gnad la nyi ma zla sogs brdzis nas rdul sprugs byed/ /'byung bzhi rlung la lte ba la sogs stong ra bcas nas na tsha bogs 'don 'gags 'khyil la sogs bsal/ /bcu pa'i rlung shes ting 'dzin rang grol sman pa lta bus brgyad po bsal nas dngul chu ltar sprad bya/ /dngas ma bsrubs nas skyon rnams sel phyir bdag tu lta ba'i bud shing bsregs nas 'od gsal chos skur bsgral/ /'di don rim brgyud bla ma la bsten gus pas blang phyir byin rlabs lam khyer snyan nas snyan du brgyud/ /mchog gi bla can brtse ba chen pos theg gzhan spangs pa smin dang grol ba rim pa gnyis la 'bad/ /snod bcud la sogs gzhal yas khang dang phung po khams sogs lha ru dag pas rgyal ba thams cad bsdu'o/ /rdo rje'i lus la bde chen gnas pas pho nya la sogs spros dang spros med 'khor lo zung du 'jug /rim pa 'di la mos pa brtan pas sprul pa mthong zhing skyon yon dang bcas chung ngu yin phyir tshogs/ /skad cig bzhi yis dga' ba gsum son 'bring po'i drod de lhan cig skyes pa sgro tī'i lam zhugs nas—/ /'jig rten las 'das brgya phrag bdun po yon tan gyis spras gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs/ /dngas ma yas byon pūkhri sogs khyab rgyu ba mas brtan bde chen brtol nas ma chags pad+ma'i sa/ /rab bkram chen po phrag bdun yon tan ye shes gsal byed chos sku bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /26—1820

'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs la sogs gting dpag dka' ba gsal por rab phye snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang / /dri med bsags pa'i dge ba des ni sa gsum gnas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang tshig tikhri pas bkod pa rdzogs so// //rtsigs kyi rgya mdud dang bcas pa nā ro paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis pusgo ①ha ri'i gnas su bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur ma na/1814 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / chos tshan 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la mi bzhugs pas 〈〈co 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/1816 0〈〈co 〉༅da/ 0〈〈co 〉thasgom/1819 ①〈〈co 〉〉pa na/1821 ①〈〈co 〉〉gaji/bsdur+sha 'bra~X shāḥ )mig26—1821

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ kaṇ+ḍa tan+d+ra badz+ra pa da tsā ④ma/ bod skad du/snyan brgyud chordo rje'i tshig rkang zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal ( rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /e ma ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba'i mchog / ye shes 5rgyal po thig le mchog gi lam/ /tshig tu brjod pa kun dang bral ba'i don/ /theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos④ / /rdo rje 'chang ngas skal ldan don du bshad/ /gus tsubatud nas ni ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon/ /bslab gsum rgyan ka ldan nyams sbong bla ma'i — mchog /dad brtson ⑩shes rab snying rje slob ma'o⑫/ /nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btang / /thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la brten nas tshe/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi bskur/ /skulha mo bco lnga dbang bzhi brda yis mtshon/ /smin par byas nas thabs shes zung du stel/ /rgyal po blon sogs ⑫rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad//26—1822

bsre ba ro snyoms dam tshig gsum la sbyar/ /gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung / /lus gnad bdun ldan lha sku'i nyustong ra gnad/ / byu tī rngo la la ra sa 'khor lo bzhi/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag srog rtsol thur sel gcudatsa/ /rdo rje bzlas ④pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom/ /zin dang brtan pa shes rab 3snyoms par 'jug /dga' bzhi goms pas rtsa rlung thig le 'dres/ / sgro tīr che rlung sems tshud ⑫pas mi rtog pa/ /nyon mongs rang zhi bde gsal rgyun mi 'chad| /ngo bo mthong nas chos sku'i ngang du gnas/ /bogs 'don sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol la/ /'khor 'das thams cad sgyu mar shes byas te bye/ /sgyu ma'ang 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'o/ /da ltar snang ba ⑨dngos po'i chos rnams ni//bden cing rtag na 'gyur bar ga la rigs/ /'khrul gzugs yin phyir don la grub pa med/ /gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams brag car ltos/ /gnyis 'dzin zhig pas chags sdang kun dang bral/ /de ltar shes pas sna tshogs zhen med spyod/ /'ja' lus chos sku thob par 'gyur ro kye/ /mtshan dus rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs la/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa dran pa'i lcags kyus gzung / /'dzin sbyangs spel bsgyur ⑫sprul cing gegs rnams sel⑪/ /nyi zla zhon dang zhing khams mtha' dag bgrod/ /bzang ngan sgyu ma cir snang rang grol ltos/ /mthar phyin sa bcu non nas don chen thob/ /khyad par 'od gsal ma rig mun bral la/ /lus gnad thabs ldan ting 'dzin bzhi la sbyor ⑫/ /thig le gus ldan dug ⑫gsum 'dzin med ltos/ /gnyid dang mi lam rnam rtog bar nas bzung / /rim ⑫pa bzhi dang nyin mtshan bsre zhing goms/ /⑫gsal stong 'dzin bral lhan skyes ye shes de/ /brjod du med pa 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad/ /26—1823

ma rtogs sbyang zhing phyag rgya chen por blta/ /khya'apho ba gser 'gyur ma bsgoms sangs rgyas ni/ /'chi ltas shar tshe dga' zhing zhen pa btang / /sgo dgu bkag la rdzas dang smon lam rgyan②/ /hūṃ dang rlung sems dbyer med rtso tīr ②drang / /k+ṣa yig gsal ④ la tshangs pa'i lam nas 'phang / /chos sku bla ma rgyal ba'i zhing du 'pho/ /lhag par grong 'jug sprul lngags 'dor len ༅ni/ /rlung sems dbang thob bskyed rdzogs brtan pa yis/ /skyon med ro la rnam shes yika 'bru 'phang / /dus yul rdzas dang gnad shes ( )mngon du gyur/ /the tshom bral ba'i skyes bu gzhan don spyod/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba 3bde ba chen po ni/ /bcu drug nyer lnga'i bar gyi rig ma ni 3 / /pad+ma ri dwags dung cad la sogs pa/ /phyag rgya mtshan ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /skal ldan skyes bu te ru ka lta bu⑫/ /gnyis med 'khril sbyor zag bcas zag med rol/ /thig le dbab bzung bzlog dgram ⑩ gnas su spe4 ’/ /bya rgod gcud ⑫la seng ge glang chen dang / /rma bya stag mo rus sbal la sogs bya/ /dga' ba bzhi gsum bcu gnyis don la blta⑫—/ /lhan skyes ye shes rang bzhin dbyer med ston/ /snang srid thams cad zag med bde bar 'char/ /gsang dbang phyag rgya bdud rtsi ril bu'i phyir//thig le bcu drug byed byed bzhi cha sbyin/ /bzhi gsum 'khor lo dag la dgram par bya/ /bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos/ /don la ⑫nyams shing slar yang ngan song lhung / /des na rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med/ /phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed ni—/ /sgo gsum g.yo med sgo lnga ha dngas gzhag /bltas ⑫pas mthong med sems kyi mtshan nyid ltos/ /dmigs su med pas ma bcos rang sor gzhag⑫ /26— 824

gzhan du ma tshal ngo bo rtogs par gyis/ /gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la//tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na/ /'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i 4 klong yangs su/ /skye shi med pa chos sku'i lus mthong — 'gyur/ /phyi rol yul sems khyechos rnams ji snyed pa/ /rang sems yin phyir gzhan na grub pa med/ /'khrul rtog gnyis 'dzin sna tshogs gang shar rnams/ /cir snang gzhi med rang byung rang brlag ltas④/ /sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku/ /'gag med gsal dngas gang shar sprul pa'i sku/ /gnas med bde chen zung 'jug ⑤longs spyod rdzogs/ /phyag ni gnyis med ye shes ngo yis zin6/ /rgya ni 'khor ba'i mdud pa dral bas bde④/ /chen po zung 'jug sgron me bltams ༄pa las/ /gzhan kyis ma yin rang grol chos sku'o/ /sgrib gnyis rang dag gzung 1'dzin mtha' dang ⑫bral/ /'du shes blo dang 'khor 'das chos rnams zad/ /mkhyen tshad ⑪yon tan ji snyed rang la rdzogs/ /bsam brjod blo 'das sangs rgyas rang 'khrungs yin/ /bar do ngo sprod yang dag zab don bstan/ /skye shi rmi lam srid pa'i ⑫bar do gcod/ / bltar med bltas 6pas mthong med mthong ba'i mchog /rang rig gsal stong mi rtog sgrib g.yogs bral/ /bde chen chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rang bzhin dbyer med sku gsum rang shar ltos 1 /ma rtogs lus ldan bar do rnam gsum la/ /bskyed rim sgyu lus 'od gsal chos sku 'dre / /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rim 'ugyis thim/ /brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te/ /dkar dmar sems gsum chu skyes nang du 'dzom/ /'od gsal ngos 'dzin 8ma du dbyer med 'dretsho/ /chos skru sangs rgyas dbang po yang rab bo/ /de ma zin na rlung gsum rkyen gyis 'ching / /26—— 826

'bring po chu la nya ltar longs skur 'gyur/ /rtsal ༅lnga zer lnga dug ②gsum las kyi dbang / /chags sdang gnyis kyis mngal du 'jug 'gyur bas/ /bsre ba lnga ldan lam khyer phyag rgya bzhi/ /sngar sbyangs ldan pas bar do ②rang grol 'gyur/ /tha mas chags sdang grol nas sprul sku thob/ /gdams pa spyi la gegs bsal bdud dngos ④bzung / /rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgu yi/ /rdo rje lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gnad du bsnun/ /bya spyod thams cad tshogs su bsgyur bar bya/ /go rims ma nor nyams su blangs gyur na/ /skad cig bzhi la dga' ⑤ba gsum ston pa te/ /dngas ma yas byon 'gyu ba mas brten pa④/ /rtsa mdud rim pas ༅grol nas sgro tīr༅'gyur/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtsa ba lnga/ /rlung dang nyon mongs 'gags nas ye shes 'gyur/ /gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs / / pūlbi ma ru yar chad gang bar 'gyur/ /sprul sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i — zhal ston cing ⑫/ /mngon shes yon tan brgya dang ⑫ther 'dum thob—/ /dus 'dir sa lam rim pa sgrod byed dekyi/ 1rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /bcu gsum bar du tshig rgyud rgya yis gdabacho/ /mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po 'di yin pas/ /skal ldan grol phyir gsang maba'i nges don mdzodatsho/ /ces ye shes 1mkha' 'gro ma la gdams pa/ snyan brgyud 14rdo rje'i tshig rkang rdzogs so// // mkhas pa tsā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal snga dang / lo tsā 3 ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis pusbo ha ri'i rtaganas chen du bsgyur cing —rtagatan la phab pa'o// //26— 826

༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ āt+pa yo ga tsā ma/ bod skad du/ bdag gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor spyod la mkhas pa yis/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dngos grub ched du las sgrub thabs/ /de nas de la 0yang dag bshad/ /'jig rten thar la brten phyir yang / /'khor lo drug gi cho ga dang —/ /de bzhin las sbyor cho ga yis/ /las kyi sgrub thabs mchog bya'o/ /gang zhig rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni nges 'thob ④pa/ /bdag nyid kyi ni sgrub thabs mchog /de phyir de las bshad par bya/ /dang por re zhig bshang lam nas—/ /sum mdo ru ni dgug bya ste/ /sgo bzhi 'dab chom bzhi pa la/ /ge sar rgyan gyis ④dge byas pa/ / de yi ⑫dbus na nges phyung ba'i/ /brtse ka mtshungs sa bon dmar/ /de nas 'khor lo la gnas lnga༄ / /nag po 'jigs 26— /829

su rung ba'i gzugs/ /'jigs byed ces byar bsgrags pa ni/ /'jigs pa 'joms pas 'jigs byed do/ /gnyis pa lte ba'i dbus gnas shing / /lag 'gro'i rnam par rab nyal ba/ /de la 'khyil par bsgrags pa ste/ /'char dang nub pa'i rgyu yin no/ /me yi sa bon re phas shākyang / /gru gsum pa can me yi lha/ /kha dog dmar zhing lus che ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'od 'khrigs pa'o/ /gsum pa snying ga'i 'khor lo ni/ /sum cu rtsa drug 'dab ②mar khyab/ /pad+ma'i snal ma dang 'dra zhing / /nyi ma dang mnyam gzi bajid can/ /sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab 6brgyad kyi/ /lte ba'i ze'u 'azu la gnas pa/ /tsā da thig ler yang dag ldan—/ /sems kyi rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /bzhi pa mgrin pa la gnas pa'i//rtsa yi tshogs kyi ④spyod yul ni/ /rtsa rnams thams cad tshogs pa ste/ /rdzu 'phrul la sogs spyod yul lo/ /bcu drug 'dab ma'i ④ze'u 'bru la/ /gsung gi rdo rje de bzhin gshegs/ /rkan dang mgrin pa rnam dag che / /kha dog dmar po dpal ldan che/ /lnga pa tshangs pa'i bug par ni/ /dus gsum nam mkha'i spyod yul te/ /nam mkha' las 'das mchog tu phra/ /thig le'i gzugs can dbyangs dbang phyug /'khor lo'i nges pa drug pa rkan/ /lha rnams kyis kyang rnyed dka' ba⑫/ /zla ba chu shel dang mtshungs pa/ /'dzag pa zhes bya bsam par bya/ /so gnyis bdud rtsi'i cha shas rigs kyi ni/ /'khor lor gnas pa sku yi rdo rje ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kha dog dkar po che/ /ral pa'i cod pan la brgyan dpal ldan no/ /de bzhin spyi bo'i rtsa bar ni/ /'khor lo zla ba klum pos khyabargyan/ /chos kyi dbyings dang de bzhin lha/ /thig le yi ni gzugs rang bzhin/ /ye shes rnam shes sbyor ba dang / /sum cu'i 26—1830

dbang phyug khyab byad de/ /rdzu 'phrul dngos grub sbyin pa dang / /thar pa'i lam sbyin de zhes bya'o/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /tog rtse pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar shar phyogs sad+dha ga ①ra'i mkhas pa chen po nags kyi rin chen gyi spyan sngar/ dge slong chos smra ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes bsgyur ba'o// //②bsdur mchan/1829 ①mtshan byang 'di chos 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉)ri /bdag gi rnal 'byor bzhugs so// 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉pang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈sha ra 〉〉thob/⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stabadab/ /61〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉7)/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8sa/ thu〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉skam/183 ①〈〈snar 〉glos/ du rgya〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉zodab/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉8sa/ tshon〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉d+ku ba'i/ 'u〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ther/ ⑦〈〈be+e mi'i〈snar 〉sta nga / ⑧〈〈pe 〉po'ar 〉sta'/1831 ①〈〈be 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa rnag ②〈〈pe 〉mi shu bhams//ba kā 'bra~X shāshi )mig26wa /831

1242tshog /thams cad grub par byed ba zhes bya ba/kyi༄ / /rgya gar skad du/ sarba sirnyi ka ro tsā ma/ bod skad du/thams cad grub (gyepar byed pa zhes bya ba/ grub pa mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bkra shis la sogs rim pas kyang / /rnal 'byor ltad ④mo rab brjod bya/ /dang po —gza' bkra shis shar ba'i dus su/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig /sa chu tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis so༄ — / /mtshan mo'i dang po me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu khyatshod gnyis/chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' lhag pa shar ba'i dus su/ sa thun tshod gcig /rlung chu tshod gnyis / me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig go/ /mtshan mo chu chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me chu tshod gnyis so/ /26—1832

lha'i bla ma la/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis—/ sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tu)tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis so—/ /mtshan mo me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig ( dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' pa sangs ②la/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ sa chu tshod gnyis so—/ /mtshan mo sa thun tshod gcig dang ④/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis / me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' spen pa shar ba na/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis so//mtshan mo rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' nyi ma shar ba na/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis so/ /mtshan mo rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis / sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis so/ /gza' zla ba shar ba na/ me thun tshod gcig /sa thun tshod gcig dang chu tshod gnyis/ chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me chu tshod gnyis so/ ba /mtshan mo sa thun tshod gcig /chu chu tshod gnyis/ rlung chu tshod gnyis/ me thun tshod gcig — /sa thun tshod gcig go/ /rnal 'byor pas 'di ltar bya ste/ rlung dang me gnyis spang bar bya'o/ /26—1833

me 'phel ba'i bdag nyid dang / rlung gi ⑫bya ba thams cad rmongs par 'gyur zhing / chu dang sa'i las brgyad po mtha' dag shesakubya ste/ de ltar shes nas me dang rlung spang bar bya'o/ /rgyal po dbang bskur ba dang /khron pa bru ②ba dang / bag ma bya ba dang rab tu gnas pa'i las rnams las gtso bo'o/ /mig sman dang ril bu dang mchi ④lham gnyis dang / ral gri dang mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dang gtsug phud dang ⑤g.yul dang gsad 0 pa dang zas dang mdzod dang dgon pa bya ba rnams la sa gtso bo'o/ /dka' thub kyi las dang / slong ba ⑦la me gtso bo'o/ /bskrad pa la rlung gtso bo'o/ /rengs pa dang dgug ②pa la chu ⑫gtso bo ste/ zhi ba'i las dang rgyas pa las gtso bo'o/ /ltad ⑩mo dang bstan bcos rtsom pa dang gtsang bar byed pa yang ngo las thams cad grub ⑫par byed pa rdzogs so// //tsarba ṭi'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o/ /dge slong rgya mtshos ⑫bsgyur ba'o// //⑫26—1834
